papers.title: Privacy-Preserving Depth-Only Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation Via Uncertainty-Guided Test-Time Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Privacy-preserving perception is a critical requirement for deploying 3D scene understanding systems in real-world indoor environments, yet it remains underexplored in open-vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation. Existing methods typically rely on obtaining rich semantic cues from RGB images, which may expose privacy-sensitive visual information. Depth-only 3D geometry provides a privacy-preserving alternative, but the absence of appearance-based semantic cues makes open-vocabulary predictions highly uncertain and less reliable. Under this setting, we propose to convert uncertainty into a guidance signal to identify unreliable semantic responses and use semantic priors from foundation models to regularize their refinement. We present UTTO, an uncertainty-guided test-time optimization framework for depth-only open-vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation. Without additional training, experiments on ScanNet20, ScanNet40, and ScanNet200 demonstrate that UTTO consistently improves depth-only open-vocabulary 3D segmentation and outperforms representative baselines under privacy-preserving conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UTTO框架，用于仅深度图像的开放词汇3D语义分割，通过不确定性引导的测试时优化，利用基础模型的语义先验来修正不可靠的预测，无需额外训练。在ScanNet20、ScanNet40和ScanNet200数据集上，该方法在隐私保护条件下持续提升了深度仅分割的性能，并优于代表性基线。
Motivation: 现有开放词汇3D语义分割方法多依赖RGB图像获取语义线索，可能泄露隐私；而仅深度图像缺乏外观语义，导致预测高度不确定。需要一种既能保护隐私又能可靠进行开放词汇分割的方法。
Method: 提出不确定性引导的测试时优化框架UTTO，将模型预测的不确定性转化为引导信号，识别不可靠的语义响应，并利用基础模型的语义先验来正则化这些响应的细化过程。
Result: 在ScanNet20、ScanNet40和ScanNet200上，UTTO一致性地提升了仅深度开放词汇3D语义分割的性能，并优于隐私保护条件下的代表性基线。
Conclusion: 本文展示了不确定性引导的测试时优化能够有效利用基础模型知识，提升仅深度开放词汇3D语义分割的可靠性，为隐私保护感知提供了一种有效途径。

papers.title: TRCGL-Net: A Long-Tailed Multi-Label Chest X-Ray Classification Framework with Generative Data Augmentation and Label Co-Occurrence Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Chest X-ray multi-label classification is a core task in intelligent medical imaging diagnosis. However, real clinical data often exhibit extreme long-tailed distributions, leading to degraded performance on rare diseases in tail classes. This issue is not only driven by data scarcity but also by two intrinsic factors:1) attenuation of tail-class lesion representations under complex anatomical backgrounds, and 2) dominance of head classes in modeling label co-occurrence relationships. To address these challenges, we propose TRCGL-Net. First, a learnable text-guided conditional diffusion model is employed to generate high-quality tail-class chest X-ray image samples under disease semantic constraints, improving data diversity and realism of rare disease patterns while alleviating class imbalance and preserving pathology-consistent semantics.Second, a channel reweighting mechanism is introduced to perform feature recalibration by emphasizing disease-relevant feature channels, thereby improving feature discriminability under long-tailed distributions.A class-aware attention mechanism is further applied to generate class-specific attention maps, enabling the model to localize disease-relevant regions and focus on fine-grained lesion areas.Finally, a graph convolution network based on label co occurrence is introduced to establish an information propagation mechanism among categories. Experiments on the PadChest dataset show that the proposed method achieves a tail-class mAP of 0.4904, an overall mAP of 0.4408, and an mAUC of 0.8989, outperforming state-of-the-art methods. TRCGL-Net effectively improves recognition performance for rare diseases under long-tailed distributions and mitigates the impact of extreme class imbalance in chest X-ray multi-label classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TRCGL-Net，用于解决胸部X光多标签分类中的长尾分布问题。该方法结合文本引导的扩散模型生成尾类样本、通道重加权特征校准、类别注意力定位以及基于标签共现的图卷积网络。在PadChest数据集上，尾类mAP为0.4904，整体mAP为0.4408，mAUC为0.8989，优于现有方法。
Motivation: 真实临床数据存在极端长尾分布，导致罕见疾病识别性能下降。原因包括尾类病变表示在复杂解剖背景下的衰减以及头类在标签共现建模中的主导地位。

Result: 在PadChest数据集上，尾类mAP达到0.4904，整体mAP为0.4408，mAUC为0.8989，超越最先进方法。
Conclusion: TRCGL-Net有效提升长尾分布下罕见疾病的识别性能，缓解胸部X光多标签分类中的极端类别不平衡问题。

papers.title: QuaMoE-DRF: Proactive Beam and Rate Adaptation via Multimodal Dynamic Radio Map Forecasting in ISAC Networks
papers.abstract_en: Static radio maps provide location-dependent propagation priors, but they cannot capture short-term blockage caused by moving objects. Direct sensing-assisted beam prediction is also limited because a beam index discards SINR margins, MCS thresholds, BS alternatives, and communication-equivalent neighboring beams. This paper proposes QuaMoE-DRF, a quality-aware multimodal dynamic radio map forecasting framework for proactive beam and rate adaptation in ISAC networks. Its core representation is a future beam-SINR field. We show that the full multi-BS beam-SINR field is sufficient for finite-codebook threshold-rate BS, beam, MCS, goodput, and outage decisions. For tractability, the implemented model learns a compact reference-BS local field, complemented by BS-level supervision, joint BS--beam supervision, and latent network context; we also clarify that this compact projection alone is not sufficient for BS association. QuaMoE-DRF fuses static geometry, event-like motion observations, structured sensing states, and wireless history through a quality-aware mixture-of-experts module motivated by inverse-variance fusion under heteroscedastic modality errors. It jointly predicts communication-oriented map channels and proactive BS, beam, and MCS decisions. On a dynamic multi-BS and multi-UE urban benchmark, QuaMoE-DRF achieves 402.5 Mbps effective rate, 0.0417 outage probability, and 0.1836 map RMSE, improving the effective rate by 5.67% and reducing outage by 8.35% over the strongest completed effective-rate baseline. The current validation uses labels from a compact blockage/path-loss simulator, with ray tracing used only for calibration and sanity checking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出QuaMoE-DRF框架，用于ISAC网络中基于多模态动态无线电地图预测的主动波束和速率自适应。核心是预测未来波束SINR场，通过质量感知的专家混合模块融合静态几何、运动观测、传感状态和无线历史，联合预测通信地图和主动决策。在动态多BS多UE城市基准上，有效速率达到402.5 Mbps，中断概率0.0417，地图RMSE 0.1836，相比最强基线有效速率提升5.67%，中断降低8.35%。
Motivation: 静态无线电地图无法捕获移动物体引起的短期阻塞，而直接传感辅助的波束预测因丢弃SINR余量、MCS阈值、邻BS等信息而受限，需要更全面的预测框架。
Method: 提出QuaMoE-DRF，其核心表示是未来波束SINR场；实现中学习紧凑的参考BS局部场，并辅以BS级监督、联合BS-波束监督和潜在网络上下文；通过质量感知的专家混合模块融合多模态数据，联合预测通信地图和主动决策。
Result: 在动态多BS多UE城市基准上，有效速率402.5 Mbps，中断概率0.0417，地图RMSE 0.1836；有效速率比最强基线提升5.67%，中断降低8.35%。
Conclusion: 该框架展示了主动波束和速率自适应的有效性，但当前验证使用紧凑阻塞/路径损耗模拟器标签，射线追踪仅用于校准和合理性检查，实际部署需进一步验证。

papers.title: Bayesian Uncertainty Propagation for Agentic RAG Pipelines: A Proof-of-Concept Study on Multi-Hop Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Trustworthy deployment of Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems requires mechanisms for estimating when multi-stage reasoning pipelines may fail. This paper presents an uncertainty-aware Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework in which planner, evaluator and generator stages produce uncertainty signals derived from semantic divergence and generator self-evaluation. These signals are propagated through a Bayesian Network (BN) to estimate system-level uncertainty and provide node-level indicators of potential failure points across the workflow. The approach is evaluated on StrategyQA and HotpotQA using GPT-3.5-Turbo and GPT-4.1-Nano, with Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (AUROC), Area Under the Accuracy-Rejection Curve (AUARC), Expected Calibration Error (ECE), and Brier Score used to assess discrimination, selective prediction and calibration. Results show that Bayesian propagation is more effective on HotpotQA, where uncertainty accumulates across multi-hop reasoning stages, while StrategyQA exposes limitations caused by miscalibration and unreliable upstream signals. The study positions Bayesian uncertainty propagation as a promising but preliminary mechanism for monitoring Agentic RAG systems, with future validation required in industrial domains such as Offshore Wind (OSW) maintenance decision support.
papers.comment: Submitted for 7th International Conference on Maintenance and Intelligent Asset Management (ICMIAM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种不确定性感知的Agentic检索增强生成（RAG）框架，通过贝叶斯网络传播来自语义分歧和生成器自评估的不确定性信号，以估计多阶段推理管线的失败点。在StrategyQA和HotpotQA数据集上使用GPT-3.5-Turbo和GPT-4.1-Nano进行实验，结果表明贝叶斯传播在多跳推理场景（HotpotQA）中更有效，但在StrategyQA上因校准问题表现有限。论文定位为概念验证，未来需在工业领域（如海上风电维护决策支持）进一步验证。
Motivation: Agentic RAG系统的可信赖部署需要机制来估计多阶段推理何时可能失败，现有方法缺乏系统级的不确定性量化。
Method: 提出一个包含规划器、评估器和生成器三阶段的Agentic RAG框架，每个阶段产生不确定性信号（基于语义分歧和自评估），通过贝叶斯网络传播这些信号以估计系统级不确定性并定位潜在故障节点。
Result: 在HotpotQA上，贝叶斯不确定性传播显示出更优的性能（AUROC, AUARC, ECE, Brier Score），因为不确定性在多跳推理中累积；但在StrategyQA上，由于信号校准不佳和上游不可靠，性能受限。
Conclusion: 贝叶斯不确定性传播是监控Agentic RAG系统的一个有前景但初步的机制，需要在工业领域（如海上风电维护）进一步验证。

papers.title: Understanding How Humans Inject Knowledge into Machine Learning Workflows through Visual Analytics
papers.abstract_en: Visual analytics (VA) plays an increasingly important role in supporting machine learning (ML) workflows. In the field of visualization, such approaches and techniques are referred to as VIS4ML. While ML models are mostly learned automatically, the corresponding ML workflows receive a variety of human inputs, such as data labelling, feature engineering, model architecture designing, hyper-parameter tuning, and so on. In this work, we surveyed over 200 VIS4ML papers to gain an understanding of how humans inject their knowledge into ML workflows through interactive visualization. We collected a corpus of VIS4ML papers from the IEEE VIS conferences in the past decade. We developed a coding scheme to facilitate the literature research from four perspectives: characteristics of ML, visualization, interaction, and actions. The analysis of the coded dataset allows us to observe different pathways that transfer human knowledge to ML workflows via interactive visualization. Building on the analysis, we explain the phenomena of VIS4ML using the conceptual model that views VA as model building and the information-theoretic cost-benefit analysis that reasons VA as for optimizing ML workflows. This work provides unequivocal evidence showing the merits of using VA in ML workflows. The full list of surveyed papers, along with all analysis results and figures, is available at https://vis4ml4hd.github.io/ml-knowledge-inject-va/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文调查了超过200篇VIS4ML论文，通过编码方案分析人类如何通过交互式可视化将知识注入机器学习工作流。基于信息论成本效益分析，解释了VIS4ML现象，并提供了VA在ML工作流中优势的证据。
Motivation: 理解人类知识如何通过可视化分析注入机器学习工作流，缺乏系统性分析。
Method: 对过去十年IEEE VIS会议的VIS4ML论文进行文献调查，开发编码方案从四个视角（ML特征、可视化、交互、行动）分析。
Result: 观察到不同的人类知识传递路径，并基于信息论成本效益分析解释了VIS4ML现象。
Conclusion: 提供了VA在ML工作流中优势的明确证据。

papers.title: Slope-Guided Mamba and Angular-Refined Transformer for Light Field Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Light Field Super-Resolution (LFSR) necessitates accurate modeling of spatial-angular correlations while preserving intrinsic 4D ray coherence. However, maintaining such high-dimensional consistency remains challenging, primarily due to two inherent limitations in prevailing modeling paradigms. First, spatial and angular dimensions are often modeled in a decoupled manner, restricting early cross-dimensional interaction and leading to geometric inconsistencies. Moreover, although continuous sequence modeling paradigms show promise in representing epipolar structures, their rigid scanning mechanisms fundamentally conflict with epipolar geometry, limiting geometry-aware feature aggregation. To address these challenges, we propose a hybrid light field super-resolution network, termed SMART, which integrates a Slope-Guided Mamba and an Angular-Refined Transformer to effectively overcome these limitations. Specifically, we introduce an angular-modulated spatial module to bridge the decoupling gap, incorporating angular priors to strengthen spatial-angular correlation modeling. To mitigate the scan-geometry mismatch, we propose a manifold-aligned trajectory module that enables geometry-consistent sequence modeling along epipolar structures. Experiments on five benchmarks demonstrate that SMART achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing previous methods by 0.42 dB (PSNR) with significantly reduced artifacts.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Accepted by IEEE ICME 2026. Hangzhou International Innovation Institute, Beihang University, Hangzhou, China Corresponding author: Jie Wu (jiewu@buaa.edu.cn) Emails: {lijin01, hj, ljd2406107, shuaiwang, shenghao, jiewu}@buaa.edu.cn
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合光场超分辨率网络SMART，结合Slope-Guided Mamba和Angular-Refined Transformer，解决空间-角度相关性建模和扫描-几何不一致问题。在五个基准上取得SOTA，PSNR提升0.42 dB，伪影显著减少。
Motivation: 现有方法将空间和角度维度解耦建模，限制早期交叉交互，且连续序列模型的刚性扫描机制与极线几何冲突，导致几何不一致。
Method: 提出角调制空间模块（angular-modulated spatial module）增强空间-角度相关性，以及流形对齐轨迹模块（manifold-aligned trajectory module）实现沿极线结构的几何一致序列建模。
Result: 在五个基准数据集上达到最先进性能，PSNR比先前方法提高0.42 dB，伪影显著减少。
Conclusion: SMART通过混合Mamba-Transformer架构有效克服了光场超分辨率中的解耦和扫描-几何不匹配问题。

papers.title: Bridging Quantum Computing Paradigms toward Semiconductor Yield: A Controlled CV-versus-DV Comparison on Wafer-Map Defect Classification
papers.abstract_en: Realizing quantum neural networks (QNNs) in industry requires knowing which quantum computing paradigm suits which task. Motivated by AI accelerators and high-bandwidth memory, where die stacking makes wafer-level defect screening central to yield, we study WM-811K wafer-map defect classification (eight classes), comparing the dominant paradigms, continuous-variable (CV) and discrete-variable (DV), under controlled conditions. To isolate the quantum circuit as the sole variable, a shared convolutional backbone (~4.3M parameters) feeds interchangeable heads (classical dense, CV-QNN, or DV-QNN) as the only structural difference; each quantum head is scaled over three sizes (3, 4, 8 qumodes/qubits). The CV head consistently outperforms the DV head: at four qumodes/qubits it reaches 79.7 +/- 1.8% accuracy versus 61.6 +/- 1.4%, a non-overlapping 18-point gap. The advantage is sharpest on the spatially localized Edge-Loc class, easily confused with Scratch, which CV recovers with recall 0.66 +/- 0.06 while DV fails at every size (<=0.05), showing the structured CV layer better captures fine spatial distinctions between defect types. Training curves show the DV limitation is a representational-capacity ceiling, not an optimization failure; at the Fock cutoff used here (d = 2) the CV advantage reflects two intrinsic properties, a structured, neural-network-analogue layer and continuous phase-space encoding, not Hilbert-space dimensionality. On IBM hardware, DV accuracy holds at shallow depth, degrading only at the deepest circuit. Both quantum heads remain below the classical baseline (85.0%), but the controlled setting isolates where a structured head already helps and, as noise and scale improve, which paradigm can deliver practical advantage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在晶圆缺陷分类任务上，控制其他条件不变，比较了连续变量（CV）和离散变量（DV）量子神经网络（QNN）的性能。共享卷积骨干网络后接可互换头部，CV头部在WM-811K数据集上显著优于DV头部，但两者均低于经典基线（85.0%）。实验揭示了CV优势源于结构化层和连续相空间编码。
Motivation: 量子神经网络（QNN）在工业应用中需确定哪种范式适合特定任务，而晶圆级缺陷筛选对AI加速器和HBM的良率至关重要。本文旨在控制条件下比较CV和DV范式在缺陷分类上的表现。
Method: 使用约4.3M参数的共享卷积骨干网络，后接经典全连接、CV-QNN或DV-QNN头部，每种量子头部按3、4、8个qumodes/qubits缩放。在Fock截断d=2下进行实验，确保仅量子电路为变量。
Result: 在4个qumodes/qubits时，CV头部准确率79.7±1.8%，DV为61.6±1.4%，差距18个百分点。CV在空间定位的Edge-Loc类上召回率0.66±0.06，DV不超过0.05。经典基线为85.0%。
Conclusion: 控制实验表明DV局限源于表征容量上限而非优化失败；CV优势来自结构化类神经网络层和连续相空间编码。随着噪声降低和规模提升，CV范式有望实现实际优势。

papers.title: GaussianEmoTalker: Real-Time Emotional Talking Head Synthesis with Audio-Driven and Blendshape-Based 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Audio-driven talking head synthesis has achieved impressive progress in lip synchronization and visual quality, yet generating expressive emotional avatars with controllable intensity remains challenging, especially under real-time constraints. In this paper, we present GaussianEmoTalker, an audio-driven framework for real-time emotional talking head synthesis based on 3D Gaussian Splatting. Instead of directly predicting the final emotional avatar from speech, we formulate emotional animation as a neutral-to-emotional residual deformation problem. GaussianEmoTalker first constructs an identity-specific neutral talking space with GaussianBlendshapes, which provides high-fidelity Gaussian attributes and phoneme-synchronized neutral motion. It then predicts an emotion-conditioned residual deformation by combining mesh displacement cues, audio features, emotion categories, and intensity encodings. To fuse these heterogeneous signals, we introduce a spatial-audio-emotion attention module that estimates the offsets of Gaussian attributes for expressive and temporally stable rendering. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GaussianEmoTalker achieves competitive video quality, accurate lip synchronization, controllable emotional expression, and real-time rendering compared with recent emotional talking head methods. Our project page is available at https://njust-yang.github.io/GaussianEmoTalker.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出GaussianEmoTalker，一种基于3D高斯溅射的音频驱动实时情感说话头合成框架。将情感动画建模为中性到情感的残差形变问题，先构建身份特定的中性说话空间（GaussianBlendshapes），再预测情感条件残差，并引入空间-音频-情感注意力模块融合异构信号。实验表明在视频质量、唇同步、可控情感表达和实时渲染方面达到竞争性能。
Motivation: 现有音频驱动说话头合成在唇同步和视觉质量上虽有进步，但生成具有可控强度的情感表达且满足实时约束仍然困难。
Method: 首先为每个身份构建基于GaussianBlendshapes的中性说话空间，提供高保真高斯属性和音素同步的中性运动；然后预测情感条件残差形变，结合网格位移、音频特征、情感类别和强度编码；通过空间-音频-情感注意力模块估计高斯属性偏移，实现表达性和时间稳定的渲染。
Result: 实验表明，该方法与近期情感说话头方法相比，在视频质量、唇同步精度、可控情感表达和实时渲染速度上具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确强调局限性，但该方法实现了实时、可控情感表达的高质量说话头合成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LeNEPA: No-Augmentation Next-Latent Prediction for Time-Series Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Time series are central to modern data mining applications, from industrial telemetry and server metrics to finance and physiology, yet time-series self-supervised learning often depends on view and augmentation choices that encode domain-specific invariances. We study how an SSL recipe behaves when its method-specific configuration is reused unchanged after the pretraining signal family changes, framing this as a fixed-recipe stress test rather than a comparison against optimally tuned methods. We introduce Latent Euclidean Next-Embedding Prediction Architecture (LeNEPA), a no-augmentation next-latent-token objective with a causal backbone. LeNEPA replaces the stop-gradient/EMA stabilization used by vanilla NEPA with SIGReg-based isotropy regularization and computes the predictive loss in a lightweight projected space that is discarded for evaluation. We compare LeNEPA with an ECG-tuned JEPA recipe under a fixed-horizon frozen-probe protocol on PTB-XL and Diag, a synthetic diagnostic corpus generated with Aionoscope. Both methods are retrained independently on each dataset while keeping their method-specific recipes unchanged. In this protocol, the ECG-tuned JEPA recipe is strong in-domain on PTB-XL but weaker when reused unchanged on Diag, whereas LeNEPA preserves useful frozen-probe gains on both datasets. Learning curves suggest faster early representation acquisition: LeNEPA reaches 80% of its final AUROC/AUPRC gain after 2--5k updates, compared with 5--10k updates for the faster JEPA readout. As a separate external frozen-encoder check, a CauKer-pretrained LeNEPA variant reaches 77.65% mean UCR-128 Random-Forest accuracy in a single-seed, best-checkpoint run, within 1.16 points of Mantis and within 0.24 points of MOMENT (77.89%). Overall, the results support no-augmentation latent prediction as a useful candidate recipe for low-retuning time-series SSL.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables; accepted by the 12th Mining and Learning from Time Series (KDD MILETS 2026); source code and artifacts: https://github.com/langotime/lenepa-milets-2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LeNEPA提出了一种无需数据增强的下一潜在预测（next-latent prediction）目标，用于时间序列自监督表示学习。该方法使用因果骨干网络和基于SIGReg的各向同性正则化替代stop-gradient/EMA，在固定水平冻结探测协议下，与ECG调优的JEPA方法对比，表明LeNEPA在域内和跨域数据集上均能保持有用表示，且早期表示学习速度更快。
Motivation: 现有时间序列自监督学习严重依赖视图和数据增强，这些增强编码了特定领域的先验不变性，导致方法泛化性受限。论文旨在探索一种无需数据增强的通用自监督学习范式。
Method: 提出Latent Euclidean Next-Embedding Prediction Architecture (LeNEPA)，采用因果骨干网络，使用SIGReg正则化稳定训练，并在轻量投影空间中计算预测损失，该投影空间在评估时被丢弃。
Result: 在PTB-XL和Diag数据集上，固定水平冻结探测协议下，ECG调优的JEPA在域内强但跨域弱，而LeNEPA在两者上均保持收益。LeNEPA在2-5k更新后达到80%的最终AUROC/AUPRC增益（JEPA需5-10k）。在UCR-128随机森林准确率上，LeNEPA变体达到77.65%，与Mantis和MOMENT差距在1.16和0.24个百分点内。
Conclusion: 无需数据增强的潜在预测可作为低调优成本的时间序列自监督学习的候选方案，尤其适用于固定配方迁移场景。

papers.title: Aionoscope: Debugging Latent-State Accessibility in Time-Series Representations
papers.abstract_en: Time-series models are often evaluated by what they can forecast or classify, but those scores do not show whether their representations preserve the process state a user may want to inspect: event timing, phase, amplitude, frequency, or regime variables. We introduce Aionoscope, a generator-based diagnostic tool for debugging latent-state accessibility in frozen time-series representations. Aionoscope separates process generation from observation rendering, producing seeded synthetic streams with exact categorical and dense labels across mixture complexity and nuisance variation. We instantiate Aionoscope as Primitive Process Mixtures and evaluate 37 model-plus-adapter systems with a common pooled linear-probe protocol. The main result is a mismatch between coarse and fine-grained accessibility. Most systems make component presence easy to recover, but expose dense process state much less reliably: the highest observed dense-probe row reaches 0.689 mean masked $R^2$, while a dense-feature oracle reaches 0.999. This is the failure mode Aionoscope is designed to surface: a representation can look informative at the level of "what kind of signal is present" while hiding the timing, phase, amplitude, frequency, or regime variables needed for debugging.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Accepted by the 12th Mining and Learning from Time Series (KDD MILETS 2026). Interactive results: https://aionoscope.langotime.ai/ . Source artifacts: https://github.com/langotime/aionoscope/ and https://github.com/langotime/aionoscope-benchmarks/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Aionoscope 是一个基于生成器的诊断工具，用于调试冻结时间序列表示中的潜在状态可访问性。它将过程生成与观测渲染分离，生成带精确标签的合成流，并评估了37个模型-适配器系统。主要发现是粗粒度与细粒度可访问性之间的不匹配：大多数系统容易恢复成分存在性，但难以可靠地暴露密集过程状态。
Motivation: 时间序列模型通常通过预测或分类精度评估，但这些分数无法反映表示是否保留了用户可能想要检查的过程状态（如事件时序、相位、幅度、频率或状态变量）。现有评估方法缺乏对潜在状态可访问性的诊断。
Method: Aionoscope 作为原始过程混合体（Primitive Process Mixtures）实例化，分离过程生成与观测渲染，生成具有精确分类和密集标签的合成流，并通过统一的线性探测协议评估37个模型-适配器系统。
Result: 最高密集探测行平均掩膜 R² 仅为 0.689，而密集特征 oracle 达到 0.999，表明大多数系统在粗粒度成分识别上表现良好，但在细粒度密集状态（如时序、相位等）上可靠性不足。
Conclusion: Aionoscope 暴露了表示可以在“存在何种信号”层面看似信息丰富，同时隐藏用于调试的时序、相位、幅度、频率或状态变量。该工具旨在揭示这种故障模式。
Relevance: 40

papers.title: Learning Cardiac Motion Priors for Implicit Neural Representations
papers.abstract_en: Implicit neural representations (INRs) are well suited to cardiac motion estimation, providing continuous, compact representations of motion fields. However, fitting an INR to each image sequence is time-consuming and sensitive to the optimisation trajectory. Learned priors can help guide optimisation towards plausible motion fields and enable faster adaptation, but learning priors for cardiac motion INRs remains under-explored. In this work, we compare four strategies for learning cardiac motion priors, including a population prior learned by joint optimisation, a consensus prior obtained by weight averaging, auto-decoders, and meta-learning. Using short-axis tagged cardiac magnetic resonance images from the UK Biobank, we evaluate their impact on tracking accuracy, motion behaviour, and adaptation trajectory. All learned priors substantially improved early adaptation performance compared with random initialisation. While the simple consensus prior was effective, auto-decoders recovered large deformations faster during early adaptation. Meta-learning achieved strong early performance and maintained the best adaptation trajectory over 50 iterations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了隐式神经表示（INR）在心脏运动估计中的先验学习策略。比较了四种方法：种群先验、共识先验、自动解码器和元学习。使用UK Biobank的短轴标记心脏磁共振图像评估跟踪精度、运动行为和适应轨迹。所有学习先验均显著优于随机初始化，其中共识先验简单有效，自动解码器在早期适应中恢复大变形更快，元学习在50次迭代中保持最佳适应轨迹。
Motivation: 将INR拟合到每个图像序列耗时且对优化轨迹敏感，学习先验可引导优化并加速适应，但心脏运动INR的先验学习尚未充分探索。
Method: 比较四种学习先验策略：通过联合优化学习的种群先验、通过权重平均获得的共识先验、自动解码器和元学习。
Result: 所有学习先验均显著改善早期适应性能；共识先验有效，自动解码器在早期适应中更快恢复大变形，元学习在50次迭代中保持最佳适应轨迹。
Conclusion: 学习先验能有效提升心脏运动INR的适应速度和性能，不同策略各有优势，元学习整体表现最佳。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dataset Biases and Shortcut Learning in Motion-Based AI-Generated Video Detection
papers.abstract_en: The visual quality of AI-generated videos has improved drastically in recent years, making it increasingly difficult for humans to distinguish between real and synthetic media. In this work, we evaluate the robustness and applicability of four state-of-the-art motion-based AI-generated video detectors. We identify significant preprocessing and sampling biases in these methods and demonstrate that they account for a substantial portion of their reported performance. Furthermore, we find that these detectors are highly sensitive to motion patterns specific to their evaluation datasets, where AI-generated videos generally exhibit less inter-frame movement than real videos. We show that for all detectors, performance collapses to near-random levels when evaluated on a dataset that does not contain this motion bias. Additionally, through dataset rebalancing and the application of simple spatial augmentations, we observe severe performance degradation across all evaluated models. In contrast, we find that an existing frequency-based detector maintains strong performance across all evaluated datasets, suggesting that frequency-based approaches may offer a more generalizable path forward for AI-generated video detection. We hope that our work raises awareness towards these vulnerabilities and encourages the development of more representative, unbiased datasets and more robust evaluation protocols.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了四种基于运动（motion）的AI生成视频检测器的鲁棒性，发现它们存在显著的预处理和采样偏差，并且高度依赖评估数据集中的运动模式（AI视频通常帧间运动更少）。当在无运动偏差的数据集上评估时，所有检测器性能降至随机水平；而基于频率（frequency）的检测器在所有数据集上保持强性能，表明频率方法可能更泛化。
Motivation: 现有AI生成视频检测器可能依赖数据集特定偏差而非真实检测能力，导致泛化性差，需要识别和缓解这些偏差。
Method: 评估四种运动检测器，识别其预处理和采样偏差；通过数据集重平衡和简单空间增强分析性能退化；对比基于频率的检测器。
Result: 所有运动检测器在无运动偏差的数据集上性能崩溃至随机水平；简单空间增强也导致严重性能退化；而频率检测器保持稳定。
Conclusion: 运动基检测器依赖数据集的运动偏差，频率基方法可能更具泛化性；呼吁开发更具代表性的数据集和鲁棒评估协议。

papers.title: Diffeomorphic Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Generative models learn data distributions that reside on a low-dimensional manifold within a higher-dimensional ambient space. Optimizing differentiable objectives on this manifold is challenging: the ambient loss landscape is high-dimensional, rugged, and non-convex. Direct gradient descent, blind to the manifold's geometry, quickly drifts off it. Diffeomorphic optimization starts from the observation that diffusion and flow models provide a map from the data manifold to a much simpler base space in which we perform gradient descent. Using differential geometry, we show this is equivalent to Riemannian gradient descent on the data manifold up to $\mathcal{O}(λ^2)$ corrections, keeping trajectories on-manifold by construction and yielding a smoother optimization surface. For protein design, we extend diffeomorphic optimization to the matrix Lie groups $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ and $\mathrm{SE}(3)$, deriving an autograd-compatible $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ gradient and a generalized adjoint-state method for backpropagation through Lie-group ODE solvers. Diffeomorphic optimization improves over tuned guidance on secondary-structure targeting with FrameFlow ($91.3\%$ vs. $63.3\%$ of residues in the Ramachandran target), outperforms OC-Flow on peptide binding affinity at $2\times$ the speed, and reduces Rosetta energies by thousands of units across the PDB test set for structures with hundreds of residues.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出微分同胚优化（Diffeomorphic optimization）方法，利用扩散/流模型将数据流形映射到简单基空间，在该基空间执行梯度下降，从而自动保持轨迹在流形上并得到更平滑的优化面。该方法扩展到SO(3)和SE(3)李群，并用于蛋白质设计任务，在二级结构靶向、肽结合亲和力和Rosetta能量方面取得显著改进。
Motivation: 在低维流形上优化高维非凸目标函数时，直接梯度下降会偏离流形，且损失面崎岖不平，需要一种能保持轨迹在流形上的优化方法。
Method: 通过扩散或流模型建立数据流形到简单基空间的微分同胚映射，在基空间执行梯度下降，等价于数据流形上的黎曼梯度下降；进一步导出SO(3)和SE(3)李群的自动微分兼容梯度和广义伴随状态方法，支持通过李群ODE求解器反向传播。
Result: 在蛋白质二级结构靶向任务中达到91.3% vs 63.3%（FrameFlow基线）；肽结合亲和力任务以2倍速度优于OC-Flow；在PDB测试集上对含数百残基的结构将Rosetta能量降低数千单位。
Conclusion: 微分同胚优化能自动保持轨迹在流形上并获得更平滑的优化表面，在蛋白质设计中显著提升效果，但本文未讨论在其他数据领域的适用性。

papers.title: A Geometric Perspective on Composable Emotion Steering in Text-to-Speech Models
papers.abstract_en: While prior work has explored emotion control in hybrid text-to-speech systems, the geometric properties of these modules, and their implications for steerability, remain poorly understood. We present the first comparative study of speech language model (SLM) and conditional flow-matching (CFM) modules as activation steering sites for mixed emotion speech synthesis. We first characterize emotion representations using linear probing and local intrinsic dimensionality (LID), and then evaluate single-site and joint steering for mixed-emotion synthesis. Our results show that SLM offers a clean, low-dimensional emotion-specific subspace with strong speaker--emotion disentanglement, while CFM exhibitspoor cross-speaker generalization due to speaker--emotion entanglement. Joint steering increases emotion intensity but degrades proportional control and speech quality on in-distribution data. These findings provide practical guidance for multi-site activation steering in hybrid TTS systems and highlight the importance of representation geometry in controllable speech generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次比较了语音语言模型(SLM)和条件流匹配(CFM)模块作为激活引导位在混合情绪语音合成中的表现。通过线性探测和局部本征维数分析，发现SLM具有干净的低维情绪子空间和强说话人-情绪解耦，而CFM因说话人-情绪纠缠导致跨说话人泛化差。联合引导虽能增加情绪强度，但会降低比例控制能力和语音质量。
Motivation: 现有研究探索了混合文本转语音系统中的情绪控制，但这些模块的几何性质及其对可控性的影响尚不明确，需要系统比较不同模块作为引导位的表现。
Method: 采用线性探测和局部本征维数表征情绪表示，然后评估单站点和联合站点激活引导用于混合情绪合成。
Result: SLM提供低维情绪子空间且说话人-情绪解耦好；CFM因纠缠导致跨说话人泛化差；联合引导增加情绪强度但损害比例控制和语音质量。
Conclusion: 为混合TTS系统的多站点激活引导提供了实用指导，强调了表示几何在可控语音生成中的重要性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Explainable AI for Cancer Drug Response Prediction: Beyond Univariate Feature Attributions
papers.abstract_en: Predicting cancer drug response from transcriptomic profiles is a cornerstone of precision oncology, yet the scientific value of machine learning models hinges not solely on predictive accuracy, but also on their capacity to generate reliable biological insights. Current explainability approaches in this setting are computationally costly, lack robustness, and reduce complex drug response to univariate gene importance scores, overlooking the coordinated gene activity that drives sensitivity and resistance. In this work, we present ILLUME+, a scalable post-hoc explainability framework that moves beyond single-gene assessments to capture multiple, complementary forms of explanation. Integrated into our end-to-end pipeline, ILLUME+ produces more stable gene importance scores than existing baselines, recovers established drug-gene associations and mechanisms of action, and enables AI-assisted hypothesis generation to uncover novel interaction-driven molecular signals in cancer biology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ILLUME+，一个可扩展的事后可解释性框架，用于癌症药物反应预测。该框架超越了单基因特征归因，捕获多种互补的解释形式，产生更稳定的基因重要性分数，恢复已知的药物-基因关联和作用机制，并支持 AI 辅助假设生成以发现癌症生物学中新型相互作用驱动的分子信号。
Motivation: 现有癌症药物反应预测的可解释性方法计算成本高、缺乏鲁棒性，且仅考虑单基因重要性评分，忽略了驱动敏感性和耐药性的协调基因活动。
Method: 提出 ILLUME+，一个可扩展的事后解释框架，集成到端到端流水线中，生成稳定的基因重要性分数，并提供多种互补的解释形式。
Result: ILLUME+ 在稳定性上优于现有基线，能恢复已知的药物-基因关联和作用机制，并支持 AI 辅助假设生成。
Conclusion: 该方法为癌症药物反应预测提供了超越单变量特征归因的可靠生物学见解，有助于发现新分子信号。

papers.title: Post-Training Pruning for Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have demonstrated impressive performance in image generation but suffer from substantial computational overhead and resource consumption. Post-training pruning offers a promising solution; however, due to DiTs' unique architectural design and parameter distribution, traditional pruning methods are inapplicable, leading to significant performance degradation. Specifically, prior methods developed for LLMs, which derive metrics through a series of approximations, amplify the relative contribution of weights in the saliency metric. In addition, weights in DiTs exhibit significantly larger magnitudes than those in LLMs. Moreover, existing pruning granularity overlooks variations in model structures. In this paper, we propose DiT-Pruning, which improves pruning performance by introducing customized saliency criteria and pruning granularity. We design a novel metric that balances the contributions of weights and activations from an energy-based perspective, enabling more effective identification of important elements. Furthermore, we observe distinct clustering patterns in the two-dimensional weight space. Accordingly, we adopt a clustering-aware pruning granularity, enabling effective sparse allocation. Extensive evaluations on various DiTs show that our method consistently preserves image quality, especially under high sparsity. For FLUX.1-dev at 512x512 resolution on MJHQ, DiT-Pruning achieves only a 0.001 loss in CLIP score at 50% sparsity, dramatically outperforming recent pruning methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiT-Pruning，一种针对扩散变压器（DiTs）的后训练剪枝方法。通过设计基于能量的新度量平衡权重和激活的贡献，并采用聚类感知的剪枝粒度，该方法在保持图像质量的同时大幅降低计算开销。在 FLUX.1-dev 模型上，50% 稀疏度下 CLIP 分数仅下降 0.001，优于现有剪枝方法。
Motivation: 扩散变压器（DiTs）计算开销大，现有后训练剪枝方法因 DiTs 的独特架构和参数分布不适用，导致性能严重下降。
Method: 提出 DiT-Pruning，包含基于能量视角的显著性度量（平衡权重和激活贡献）和聚类感知的剪枝粒度（利用二维权重空间的聚类模式）。
Result: 在多种 DiT 上评估，高稀疏度下保持图像质量。FLUX.1-dev 在 512×512 分辨率 MJHQ 上，50% 稀疏度时 CLIP 分数仅下降 0.001，显著优于近期方法。
Conclusion: 该方法通过定制化的显著性准则和剪枝粒度，有效针对 DiTs 实现高效后训练剪枝，尤其适用于高稀疏度场景。

papers.title: Human-Machine Collaboration on Generative Meta-Learning: Model and Algorithm
papers.abstract_en: Generalizing machine learning models to environments that differ from their training distribution remains a critical hurdle, particularly when data from the target domain is entirely or partially unavailable. We propose Generative Meta-Learning with Human Feedback (GMHF), a novel framework that bridges this domain gap by leveraging expert intuition to guide data synthesis. Grounded in a theoretical analysis of generalization error, we derive bounds demonstrating that aligning the distribution of generated data with human beliefs regarding the target physics significantly mitigates risk. GMHF operationalizes this insight by employing a Conditional Neural ODE (cNODE) as a generative digital twin, coupled with a Reinforcement Learning (RL) agent. The agent iteratively refines the latent physical parameters of the generated trajectories based on feedback, effectively steering the meta-learner toward the unobserved target distribution. Empirical validation on a nonlinear Duffing oscillator shows that GMHF substantially reduces deployment loss as expert reliability increases, and that the divergence between generated and target data falls under reliable feedback, directly corroborating the divergence-minimisation mechanism predicted by our theory. Further experiments on a non-dynamical probabilistic model confirm that the framework extends beyond ODE-governed systems, establishing human-AI collaboration as a rigorous catalyst for robust generalisation under distribution shift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出生成式元学习与人类反馈（GMHF）框架，通过专家直觉指导数据合成，弥合训练与目标域分布差异。理论分析推导泛化误差界，表明对齐生成数据分布与人类信念可降低风险。实验在非线性Duffing振子上验证，随专家可靠性提高部署损失显著降低，并扩展到非动力学概率模型。
Motivation: 机器学习模型在分布外泛化中面临目标域数据完全或部分缺失的挑战，现有方法难以利用人类专家对目标物理的直觉来引导数据生成。
Method: 采用条件神经ODE（cNODE）作为生成数字孪生，结合强化学习（RL）代理，根据反馈迭代优化生成轨迹的潜在物理参数，引导元学习器向未观测目标分布偏移。
Result: 在非线性Duffing振子实验中，GMHF随专家可靠性提高显著降低部署损失，且生成数据与目标数据之间的散度在可靠反馈下减小，验证了理论预测的散度最小化机制。
Conclusion: GMHF框架将人类-AI协作作为分布偏移下鲁棒泛化的严格催化剂，并扩展至非ODE系统。

summary_sections.conclusion: GMHF框架将人类-AI协作作为分布偏移下鲁棒泛化的严格催化剂，并扩展至非ODE系统。

papers.title: Graph-Native Reinforcement Learning Enables Traceable Scientific Hypothesis Generation through Conceptual Recombination
papers.abstract_en: Accelerating materials discovery requires AI systems that can generate scientifically valid hypotheses through multi-step, domain-grounded reasoning. Standard large language models often produce fluent but weakly traceable responses to open-ended materials design problems, making it difficult to determine whether final answers are supported by coherent intermediate reasoning. We develop Graph-PRefLexOR, a family of graph-native reasoning models fine-tuned with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to organize reasoning into explicit phases for mechanism exploration, graph construction, pattern extraction, and hypothesis synthesis. This design links neural language generation with symbolic relational structure, enabling causal connections to be constructed, inspected, and reused. On 100 open-ended questions from materials science and mechanics literature, Graph-PRefLexOR achieves 40-65% improvements over corresponding base models, with the largest gains in reasoning traceability. Embedding analyses show broader semantic exploration and approximately 2-3 times greater semantic diversity than baselines. Semantic backtracking and layer-wise hidden-state analyses further show stronger alignment between structured reasoning and final answers. Finally, test-time graph expansion reveals that additional compute primarily increases long-range conceptual recombination within a bounded semantic space, rather than simply expanding semantic coverage. These results establish graph-native reinforcement learning as a pathway toward interpretable AI systems for scientific hypothesis generation in materials design and other scientific applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出Graph-PRefLexOR，一种图原生推理模型系列，通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）微调，将推理组织为机制探索、图构建、模式提取和假设合成等显式阶段。在材料科学和力学的100个开放式问题上，相比基础模型提升40-65%，推理可追溯性增益最大。嵌入分析显示语义探索更广泛，语义多样性约2-3倍。测试时图扩展表明额外计算主要增加长程概念重组，而非语义覆盖。

Method: 开发Graph-PRefLexOR系列，结合图原生推理和组相对策略优化（GRPO），将推理过程分解为显式阶段：机制探索、图构建、模式提取和假设合成，实现神经语言生成与符号关系结构的链接。
Result: 在100个材料科学和力学开放式问题上，相比基础模型提升40-65%，推理可追溯性增益最大；嵌入分析显示语义多样性约2-3倍；测试时图扩展主要增加长程概念重组。
Conclusion: 图原生强化学习为材料设计等科学应用中可解释的科学假设生成提供了途径，其结构化推理支持因果连接的构建、检查和复用。

papers.title: GMO-E$^2$DIT: Grounded Multi-Operation Editing for E-Commerce Images
papers.abstract_en: Real-world e-commerce image editing often requires multiple, localized, and auditable operations rather than global restyling. This compositional nature poses a dual challenge: models must precisely apply all requested edits to the correct regions while preserving unmodified content, even under ambiguous instructions. Existing one-shot editors conflate intent resolution, spatial grounding, and synthesis into a single step, frequently resulting in partial execution failures, which is unacceptable for commercial scenarios. To address this, we introduce GMO-E$^2$DIT, an agentic editing framework that couples a Vision-Language Model (VLM) with a mask-conditioned image editor to tackle structured multi-turn task completion. Given an underspecified instruction, the VLM agent constructs a region-grounded edit agenda, effectively decoupling cognitive reasoning from generative rendering. The framework then executes sub-programs via operation-aware masks and references, utilizing a reflection-driven loop to inspect intermediate results and determine the subsequent state. This iterative mechanism reliably preserves safe partial progress, retries unfinished operations, and recovers from errors. Furthermore, we develop a unified data pipeline providing aligned supervision for planning, execution, and reflection, alongside EComEditBench, a comprehensive benchmark for instruction-driven evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GMO-E$^2$DIT achieves competitive performance compared to strong closed-source models, yielding superior instruction accuracy and edit fidelity over existing baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GMO-E$^2$DIT，一个结合视觉语言模型 (VLM) 与掩码条件图像编辑器的智能框架，用于电商图像的多操作、局部化编辑。框架通过 VLM 构建区域锚定的编辑议程，解耦认知推理与生成渲染，并利用反思驱动循环迭代执行子程序、重试未完成操作和恢复错误。同时构建了统一数据管道和基准 EComEditBench。实验表明，该方法在指令准确性和编辑保真度上优于现有基线，接近强闭源模型。
Motivation: 现有电商图像编辑方法常将意图解析、空间定位和合成混为一步，导致部分执行失败，不适用于商业场景。需要一种能精确应用多种局部编辑并保持未修改内容的框架。
Method: 提出 GMO-E$^2$DIT 框架，包含 VLM 代理（用于规划区域锚定编辑议程）和掩码条件图像编辑器（用于执行子程序）。通过反思驱动循环检查中间结果，重试失败操作，恢复错误。配套开发统一数据管道和 EComEditBench 基准。
Result: 在多个电商图像编辑任务上，GMO-E$^2$DIT 取得与强闭源模型相当的性能，在指令准确性和编辑保真度上优于现有基线。
Conclusion: 该方法展示了将认知推理与生成渲染解耦，并通过迭代反思机制实现可靠的多操作编辑的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Personas to Plot: Character-Grounded Multi-Agent Story Generation for Long-Form Narratives
papers.abstract_en: Although large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive creative fiction generation, they struggle to maintain narrative consistency and coherent plot lines in long-form stories. In this work, we introduce a unified framework for long-form narrative generation and verification. MAGNET, a multi-agent goal-driven narrative engine for storytelling, generates stories with persona-grounded character agents that propose actions based on a shared world state and evolving story goals, while ATLAS is a graph-based pipeline that compares scene-level world representations across a generated story to detect hallucinations. By evaluating MAGNET using an LLM editor, pairwise rubric scoring, and ATLAS, we show that our framework produces coherent narratives compared to single-model prompting and IBSEN. At 100 pages, MAGNET reduced annotations and hallucinations by 41 and 50%, respectively, compared to the single model baseline and by 34 and 45%, respectively, compared to IBSEN, with pairwise rubric evaluation showing similar results. These results suggest that long-form narratives can emerge from explicit world-state tracking and goal-driven multi-agent generation, providing a foundation for controllable and structurally coherent long-form narrative generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于长篇小说生成的多智能体框架 MAGNET 和幻觉检测管道 ATLAS。MAGNET 使用基于角色的智能体根据共享世界状态和目标生成行动，ATLAS 通过场景级世界表征比较检测幻觉。在100页故事上，MAGNET 相比单模型基线和 IBSEN 分别减少41%和34%的注释，减少50%和45%的幻觉。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 生成长篇小说时难以保持叙事一致性和连贯的情节线。
Method: 提出多智能体目标驱动叙事引擎 MAGNET，其角色智能体基于人格和共享世界状态提出行动；以及图基管道 ATLAS，比较场景级世界表征以检测幻觉。
Result: 在100页故事上，MAGNET 相比单模型基线减少41%注释和50%幻觉，相比 IBSEN 减少34%注释和45%幻觉，成对评分也显示类似优势。
Conclusion: 显式世界状态跟踪和目标驱动多智能体生成可以产生连贯的长篇叙事，为可控且结构一致的长篇故事生成提供基础。

papers.title: Valdi: Value Diffusion World Models
papers.abstract_en: World models can enable Model Predictive Control (MPC), but this requires dynamics prediction that is both fast enough for online use and expressive enough to represent uncertain futures. Diffusion models offer a natural mechanism for modeling uncertain dynamics, yet their iterative inference procedure makes them difficult to use for low-latency latent planning. We bridge this gap with Value Diffusion World Models (Valdi), combining end-to-end online training for MPC with a latent diffusion dynamics model. In preliminary experiments on the CarRacing environment, we show that Valdi, using a single diffusion step at both training and inference, matches a deterministic MLP baseline. Our experiments expose a trade-off between predictive multimodality and control performance in this setup. Code is available at https://github.com/Kit115/ValueDiffusionWorldModels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Valdi（Value Diffusion World Models），将端到端在线 MPC 训练与潜空间扩散动力学模型结合，旨在实现快速且具有表达能力的动力学预测。在 CarRacing 环境的初步实验中，Valdi 在训练和推理时仅使用单步扩散，其性能与确定性 MLP 基线相当。实验揭示了预测多模态性与控制性能之间的权衡。
Motivation: 世界模型用于模型预测控制（MPC）时需要同时满足在线推理的快速性和对未来不确定性建模的表达能力。扩散模型虽能自然建模不确定性，但其迭代推理过程不适合低延迟的潜空间规划。
Method: 提出 Valdi 框架，采用端到端在线训练，将价值函数学习与潜空间扩散动力学模型结合，并在训练和推理时均使用单步扩散采样以降低延迟。
Result: 在 CarRacing 环境中，Valdi 使用单步扩散的性能与确定性 MLP 基线相当；实验表明预测多模态性与控制性能之间存在权衡。
Conclusion: Valdi 初步证明了单步扩散动力学模型用于在线 MPC 的可行性，但尚需在更复杂环境中验证其多模态优势，且当前性能与确定性模型接近。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Condensing Large-Scale Datasets Directly with Minimal Information Loss
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in scaling dataset distillation rely heavily on decoupled information extraction pipelines, comprising SQUEEZE, RECOVER, and RELABEL stages. Despite their scalability to large-scale datasets, these methods suffer from prohibitive computational overhead and poor cross-architecture generalization. In this paper, we reveal the root cause of these bottlenecks: the implicit dual-compression process, from data to model and back to images, inherently induces severe information loss. Crucially, we empirically and theoretically demonstrate that this loss creates a distribution shift that fundamentally compromises the widely adopted RELABEL strategy, transforming the pre-trained model into an unreliable labeler that yields sub-optimal labels. To overcome these critical flaws, we propose CIM, a novel, metric-driven framework that abandons the flawed dual-compression paradigm. Instead, CIM explicitly quantifies and minimizes the information gap between the original and synthetic datasets. By directly aligning the data distributions, our approach ensures high-fidelity information condensation and inherently satisfies the prerequisites for effective relabeling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CIM establishes a new state-of-the-art. Notably, it distills ImageNet-1K at an IPC=10 in merely 80 minutes on a single RTX-4090 GPU, achieving an unprecedented 48.7% Top-1 accuracy on ResNet-18 and significantly outperforming previous SOTA approaches, such as NRR-DD and DELT, by 2.6% and 2.9%, respectively. Our code is available at https://github.com/LINs-lab/CIM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大规模数据集蒸馏（dataset distillation）中解耦信息提取流水线（SQUEEZE-RECOVER-RELABEL）存在的计算开销高和跨架构泛化差的问题，指出其根本原因是隐式双压缩过程导致的信息损失，并证明该损失使预训练模型成为不可靠标注器。作者提出CIM框架，直接对齐原始数据集与合成数据集的数据分布，显式量化并最小化信息差距，从而避免双压缩范式。实验表明，CIM在ImageNet-1K上以IPC=10在单张RTX-4090上仅需80分钟训练，在ResNet-18上达到48.7% Top-1准确率，分别比NRR-DD和DELT高出2.6%和2.9%，创下新SOTA。
Motivation: 现有可扩展数据集蒸馏方法（如SQUEEZE-RECOVER-RELABEL）虽能处理大规模数据集，但存在严重计算开销和跨架构泛化能力差的问题。作者揭示其根本原因是隐式双压缩过程导致信息损失，该损失进一步造成分布偏移，使RELABEL策略失效，即预训练模型变为不可靠标注者。
Method: 提出的CIM框架放弃双压缩范式，直接通过度量驱动的方式显式量化并最小化原始数据集与合成数据集之间的信息差距。它直接对齐数据分布，确保高保真信息压缩，并自然满足有效重标注的前提条件。
Result: 在ImageNet-1K上，CIM以每类10张图片（IPC=10）在单张RTX-4090上仅需80分钟完成蒸馏，在ResNet-18上达到48.7% Top-1准确率，分别比NRR-DD和DELT高出2.6%和2.9%，刷新了SOTA。
Conclusion: CIM通过直接对齐数据分布而非依赖潜变量模型，解决了大规模数据集蒸馏中的信息损失和重标注失效问题，实现了高效且高精度的数据集压缩。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Two AI Metrics Diverged: Will it Make All the Difference?
papers.abstract_en: As exponential compute scaling continues, will the capabilities of frontier AI models outstrip what is accessible to developers on a small fixed budget? Or will capabilities converge, with "meek models inheriting the earth"? Building on Gundlach et al. (2025b), we show that the answer depends on how we value and measure AI capabilities. We discuss conventional performance measures and show that, while validation loss shows a shrinking gap, on other metrics frontier models grow their lead forever. Classifying performance metrics by their functional forms in relation to training (and inference) compute, we provide tight mathematical conditions for determining which metrics favor meek models, and show that bounded performance metrics always do. But careful interpretation of performance metrics is essential: we show that many common bounded metrics have closely-related counterpart metrics that are unbounded (and vice versa). Determining the apt metric in a domain is a prerequisite for policy, since bounded and unbounded metrics may suggest opposing policy responses. If a particular capability -- like software engineering, synthetic biology, or rhetorical persuasiveness -- is unbounded when measured in the terms we care about, frontier-level capability will likely be concentrated in the hands of a few wealthy actors. Conversely, if that capability is instead bounded, frontier-level capabilities proliferate through meek models into the hands of the many.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨在指数级计算扩展背景下，前沿AI模型能力是否会超越小固定预算开发者所能达到的水平，或者能力是否会收敛（“温顺模型继承地球”）。作者基于Gundlach et al. (2025b)表明答案取决于如何衡量AI能力。他们展示传统验证损失显示差距缩小，但其他指标上前沿模型领先持续扩大。通过将性能指标按其与训练（和推理）计算的函数形式分类，文章提供了严格数学条件来确定哪些指标有利于温顺模型，并证明有界性能指标总是有利。同时指出许多常见有界指标有紧密相关的无界对应指标，反之亦然。确定特定领域中的适当指标是政策的前提，因为不同指标可能暗示相反的政策响应。
Motivation: 随着计算扩展持续，需要理解前沿模型能力是否会集中在少数富裕行动者手中，还是通过温顺模型普及。答案依赖于AI能力的度量方式，但现有度量存在分歧（有界vs无界）。因此需要系统性理论分析不同度量对能力分布的影响。
Method: 论文通过分类性能指标的函数形式（有界vs无界），建立数学条件确定哪些指标倾向于温顺模型。对每种形式分析其渐近行为，并讨论常见指标如验证损失、软件工程能力等的对应对。
Result: 摘要报告验证损失显示差距缩小，但其他指标（如软件工程、合成生物学、修辞说服力）如果按其关注的术语是无界的，则前沿能力将集中；如果是有界的，则能力扩散。
Conclusion: 适当指标的选择对于政策制定至关重要，因为不同度量可能导向相反的政策响应。研究提供了分类框架和数学条件，但未提供具体数据集上的经验比较。

papers.title: Beyond Activation Alignment:The Alignment-Diversity Tradeoff in Task-Aware LLM Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Mixed-precision quantization (MPQ) has become a key technique for deploying large language models under stringent memory and compute constraints. We first identify a phenomenon that we term the Perplexity Illusion: layers ranked as important by perplexity-based sensitivity show little rank correlation with those that are most influential for complex reasoning performance, with Kendall $τ\approx 0$ in our analysis. We further reveal an Alignment-Diversity Tradeoff: using only target-task calibration data can degrade post-quantization performance, whereas incorporating general-domain data stabilizes sensitivity estimation and improves robustness across tasks. Based on these observations, we propose TASA (Task-Aware Sensitivity Analysis), a two-level framework that jointly optimizes calibration-data composition and mixed-precision bit allocation. Specifically, TASA searches for a calibration-data mixture using a training-free gradient-trace alignment criterion, and then aggregates perplexity and reasoning-oriented sensitivity signals to guide both inter-layer and intra-layer bit allocation. Experiments on LLaMA-3-8B and Qwen2.5-7B reveal a precision inversion: appropriately allocated 3.5-bit models can match or surpass less task-aware 4-bit baselines. At an average precision of 3.5 bits, TASA matches or outperforms several competitive 4-bit uniform baselines in aggregate accuracy, and improves over the strongest W3 baseline on GSM8K by more than 20 absolute points on LLaMA-3-8B. These results show that calibration-data composition substantially affects task-sensitive quantization, a factor underexplored in prior work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现LLM混合精度量化中存在“困惑度幻觉”（perplexity illusion）和“对齐-多样性权衡”（alignment-diversity tradeoff），并提出TASA框架，通过优化校准数据组成和混合精度位分配来提升量化性能。实验表明适当分配的3.5-bit模型可以匹配或超越4-bit基线。
Motivation: 现有混合精度量化方法中，基于困惑度的灵敏度评估与复杂推理性能高度不相关（Kendall τ≈0），且仅使用目标任务校准数据会降低量化后性能，需要解决校准数据组成对任务敏感量化的影响。
Method: 提出TASA（任务感知灵敏度分析）两级框架：第一级使用无训练梯度迹对齐准则搜索校准数据混合；第二级聚合困惑度与推理导向的灵敏度信号指导层内和层间的位分配。
Result: 在LLaMA-3-8B和Qwen2.5-7B上，TASA在平均3.5位精度下匹配或超越多个4位均匀量化基线，在GSM8K上比最强W3基线提高超过20个绝对点（LLaMA-3-8B）。
Conclusion: 校准数据组成对任务敏感量化有显著影响，这是之前工作中被低估的因素；TASA通过优化数据混合和位分配实现了任务感知的量化。

papers.title: MG-RWKV: Multi-Grained Context-Aware RWKV for Temporal Forgery Localization
papers.abstract_en: Driven by Artificial Intelligence-Generated Content (AIGC), the authenticity of audio-visual content is facing severe challenges. Temporal Forgery Localization (TFL) aims to precisely identify manipulated segments within untrimmed sequences. However, existing methods are limited by CNNs' local receptive fields or Transformers' quadratic complexity, while emerging linear models often struggle to balance global authentic context compression with local abrupt forgery perception. To address this, we propose MG-RWKV, a multi-granularity framework that leverages the data-dependent state evolution of RWKV to achieve efficient full-sequence processing with O(T) complexity. Our framework features three core innovations: (1) a Bidirectional RWKV architecture that captures bidirectional temporal contexts without quadratic overhead; (2) a Multi-Granularity Mixture of Experts (MG-MoE) that performs dynamic routing over explicit temporal receptive fields, adaptively selecting granularities based on forgery duration to significantly enhance decision interpretability; and (3) Cross-Granularity Consistency (CGC), which aligns adjacent feature pyramid levels through hierarchical scale-wise pairing and spatial boundary-aware weighting, effectively reducing false positives in authentic regions. Extensive experiments on Lav-DF, TVIL, and Psynd datasets demonstrate that MG-RWKV achieves state-of-the-art performance with low computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MG-RWKV，一种用于时间伪造定位（TFL）的多粒度框架，利用RWKV的线性复杂度实现高效全序列处理。核心创新包括双向RWKV架构、多粒度混合专家（MG-MoE）动态路由和跨粒度一致性（CGC）对齐，在三个数据集上取得最优性能且计算成本低。
Motivation: 现有TFL方法受限于CNN的局部感受野或Transformer的二次复杂度，新兴线性模型难以平衡全局上下文压缩与局部伪造感知。
Method: 提出基于RWKV的多粒度框架，包含双向RWKV捕获时序上下文、多粒度混合专家（MG-MoE）动态选择粒度、跨粒度一致性（CGC）减少假阳性。
Result: 在Lav-DF、TVIL和Psynd数据集上达到最优性能，计算复杂度为O(T)。
Conclusion: MG-RWKV实现了高效且可解释的时间伪造定位，适合长序列处理。

papers.title: DeWorldSG: Depth-Aware 3D Semantic Scene Graph Generation via World-Model Priors
papers.abstract_en: We present DeWorldSG, a novel framework that generates spatio-temporally robust 3D Semantic Scene Graphs from RGB-D sequences. Existing methods often struggle to construct reliable 3D scene graphs due to unstable 3D object representations and missing relations caused by frame-wise inference. DeWorldSG addresses these issues by estimating instance-level geometric 3D Gaussian distributions through depth-guided filtering and representing each object as a probabilistic 3D node rather than a single projected point. To mitigate relational sparsity from frame-wise inference, our framework further aggregates spatiotemporal evidence across object pairs and refines relations using contextual priors derived from a world model (V-JEPA 2). Experiments on the 3DSSG and ReplicaSSG datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art (SoTA) performance in both object and predicate prediction, while producing temporally consistent scene structures. In particular, our method improves triplet recall by 77.4% and predicate recall by 23.2% over prior SoTA approaches, making it suitable for robotic manipulation and AR applications. Our code and models are open-sourced.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DeWorldSG框架，从RGB-D序列生成时空鲁棒的3D语义场景图。通过深度引导滤波估计实例级几何3D高斯分布，将每个对象表示为概率性3D节点，并利用世界模型(V-JEPA 2)的上下文先验聚合时空证据以细化关系。在3DSSG和ReplicaSSG数据集上，三元组召回率提升77.4%，谓词召回率提升23.2%，达到最先进水平。
Motivation: 现有方法因不稳定的3D对象表示和帧级推理导致的关系缺失，难以构建可靠的3D场景图。
Method: 提出深度引导滤波估计实例几何分布，用概率节点代替单点投影；通过世界模型先验聚合跨帧证据，细化关系。
Result: 在3DSSG和ReplicaSSG上，三元组召回率提升77.4%，谓词召回率提升23.2%，超越之前最佳方法。
Conclusion: 该方法在物体和谓词预测上均达到最先进性能，并产生时序一致的场景结构，适用于机器人操作和增强现实。

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Cross-Height Channel Knowledge Map Prediction for UAV-Assisted Communications With Uncertainty-Guided 3D Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Low-altitude Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) often need to infer channel knowledge across a range of heights from only sparse observations collected at a few altitude layers. To address this challenge, this paper studies height-conditioned cross-height channel knowledge map (CKM) prediction for UAV-assisted communications in geometry-rich urban environments. We develop a geometry-aware conditional prediction framework that combines urban scene priors, sparse multi-altitude observations, and target-height descriptors to reconstruct dense CKMs at unobserved target heights. An uncertainty head is further introduced to characterize prediction confidence and to support cost-aware online UAV sensing under motion and safety constraints. Experiments on a layered aerial CKM benchmark show that the proposed Feature Pyramid Network (FPN)-Transformer achieves the best overall performance under both unseen-scene zero-shot and legacy patch-random protocols, reducing the Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) to 5.347dB and 1.111dB, respectively, compared with 6.937dB and 1.221dB for the strongest baseline 3D-RadioDiff. Moreover, after applying our unseen-scene few-shot adaptation, the RMSE further decreases from 5.347dB in zero-shot prediction to 3.518dB with 10-shot two-height support, while the uncertainty-guided cost-aware sensing policy improves active reconstruction from 6.94dB at initialization to 4.79dB at sensing budget 40, outperforming uncertainty-only sensing at 5.08dB and random aerial sampling at 5.84dB.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无人机辅助通信中跨高度信道知识图（CKM）预测问题，提出了一种几何感知的条件预测框架。该框架结合城市场景先验、稀疏多高度观测和目标高度描述符，重建未观测目标高度处的密集CKM，并引入不确定性头部以支持代价感知的在线无人机感知。在分层空中CKM基准上的实验表明，所提FPN-Transformer在未见场景零样本和遗留patch随机协议下均取得最优性能，将RMSE分别降至5.347 dB和1.111 dB，优于最强基线3D-RadioDiff的6.937 dB和1.221 dB。
Motivation: 低空无人机通常需要从仅在少数高度层收集的稀疏观测中推断跨高度的信道知识，这在几何丰富的城市环境中具有挑战性。现有方法缺乏高度条件化和几何感知能力，难以有效利用城市场景先验。
Method: 提出一个几何感知的条件预测框架，包括Feature Pyramid Network (FPN)-Transformer架构，该架构融合城市场景先验、稀疏多高度观测和目标高度描述符来预测目标高度处的CKM。此外，引入不确定性头部以量化预测置信度，并设计不确定性引导的代价感知在线感知策略。
Result: 在分层空中CKM基准上，FPN-Transformer在未见场景零样本和遗留patch随机协议下分别达到5.347 dB和1.111 dB的RMSE，优于3D-RadioDiff的6.937 dB和1.221 dB。未见场景少样本适应（10-shot两高度支持）使RMSE从零样本的5.347 dB降至3.518 dB。不确定性引导的代价感知感知策略在预算40时将主动重建RMSE从初始化6.94 dB降至4.79 dB，优于仅不确定性感知（5.08 dB）和随机采样（5.84 dB）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提几何感知框架利用城市先验和不确定性引导，能有效改善跨高度CKM预测和在线感知效率。该方法在真实城市场景中具有潜力，但未讨论泛化到其他环境或处理动态障碍物的局限性。

papers.title: Beyond Pixel Overlap: A Framework for Decomposing Segmentation Evaluation Metrics
papers.abstract_en: Evaluation metrics are central to binary target segmentation because they determine how progress is measured, compared, and interpreted. In this paper, target denotes the task-defined positive region to be segmented rather than a generic foreground object. It may be salient, camouflaged, transparent, glass-like, mirror-like, shadow-like, lesion-like, or defined by other application-specific semantics. We treat existing metrics as compositions of modular design choices rather than isolated formulas. The proposed framework decomposes each metric into five stages covering prediction representation, target extraction, target matching, score computation, and metric reporting. We use this framework to analyze representative metrics and show how newer metrics address specific limits in earlier protocols. The stage choices keep each metric's assumptions visible. We then discuss the design space opened by the framework and its implications for task-aware evaluation protocols. Reference code is available at https://github.com/lartpang/PySODMetrics.

papers.title: Improving Sparse-View 3DGS Generalization via Flat Minima Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in neural rendering have established 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) as a highly efficient representation for novel view synthesis, enabling fast training and real-time rendering with strong fidelity. However, when supervision is limited to sparse input views, 3DGS tends to overfit to the observed images and generalize poorly to unseen viewpoints. We address this challenge from the perspective of flat minima (FM) optimization, which seeks solutions that remain stable under small parameter perturbations. Viewing Gaussian parameters as trainable weights, we adapt FM principles to the geometric and dynamic nature of 3DGS with a lightweight training framework. Our method regularizes optimization with controlled Gaussian perturbations that account for each Gaussian's anisotropy and the training progress, preserving fine details while improving robustness to sparse-view overfitting. To further stabilize this flat minima optimization process, we introduce periodic reinitialization, which temporarily returns non-positional parameters to their initial states for a short window. Together, these techniques integrate seamlessly into existing 3DGS pipelines without architectural changes. Experiments on LLFF and Mip-NeRF360 datasets demonstrate improved quantitative metrics and perceptual quality under sparse-view supervision, producing reconstructions that are sharper, more stable, and better generalized to novel viewpoints.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project Page: https://kangrnin.github.io/FlatMinGS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）在稀疏视角监督下过拟合的问题，提出一种基于平坦最小值（flat minima）优化的轻量训练框架。通过考虑各向异性和训练进度的可控高斯扰动进行正则化，并引入周期性重初始化稳定优化过程。在LLFF和Mip-NeRF360数据集上的实验表明，该方法在稀疏视角下提升了定量指标和感知质量，生成更清晰、更稳定、泛化更好的新视角合成结果。
Motivation: 当监督仅来自稀疏输入视图时，3DGS容易过拟合观察到的图像，对未见过视角泛化差。现有方法未从平坦最小值优化的角度解决该问题。
Method: 将高斯参数视为可训练权重，适应3DGS的几何和动态性质，采用可控高斯扰动进行正则化（考虑各向异性和训练进度），并引入周期性重初始化（临时将非位置参数恢复到初始状态）来稳定平坦最小值优化过程。该方法无需架构更改即可集成到现有3DGS流水线中。
Result: 在LLFF和Mip-NeRF360数据集上，该方法在稀疏视角监督下改进了定量指标和感知质量，产生更清晰、更稳定、泛化更好的新视角合成。
Conclusion: 通过平坦最小值优化和周期性重初始化，有效改善了3DGS在稀疏视角下的泛化能力，且易于集成。

papers.title: OmniView-Space: Reinforcing Spatial Reasoning via Multi-Perspective Spatial Mapping
papers.abstract_en: Spatial intelligence remains a persistent challenge for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), as it requires coherent spatial scene representations beyond basic object recognition. Existing methods typically build such representations through textual reasoning or 3D reconstruction. However, they often falter during multi-step reasoning, particularly when required to dynamically re-anchor evidence to the specific camera-, object-, or direction-centric reference frames demanded by complex queries. To address this, we propose OmniView-Space, a framework designed to maintain spatial consistency through multimodal egocentric evidence. Our approach consists of three core components: (1) Multi-Perspective Spatial Mapping (MPSM), which re-anchors reconstructed geometry into a query-aligned visual cognitive map and a textual spatial graph; (2) Tool-Guided Egocentric Reasoning, an interleaved policy trained to actively select the ego anchor required by the query and request the corresponding MPSM evidence; and (3) Cognitive-Map Distillation, which uses MPSM-generated trajectories and ego-frame rewards to train the model to reason with self-generated cognitive maps. Experiments on single- and multi-image spatial reasoning benchmarks show that OmniView-Space achieves state-of-the-art performance. Furthermore, the distilled model maintains this performance while reducing reliance on external geometry pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OmniView-Space框架，通过多视角空间映射（MPSM）、工具引导的自我中心推理和认知图蒸馏，增强多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在单/多图像空间推理任务中的空间一致性。实验在多个基准上达到最先进性能，且蒸馏模型减少对外部几何管线的依赖。
Motivation: 现有MLLMs在多步空间推理中难以动态重锚定证据到查询所需的参考框架（如相机、物体、方向中心），导致空间一致性不足。
Method: 框架由三部分组成：1）多视角空间映射（MPSM），将重建几何重锚定为查询对齐的视觉认知图和文本空间图；2）工具引导的自我中心推理，训练交错策略主动选择需要的自我锚点并请求对应MPSM证据；3）认知图蒸馏，利用MPSM生成的轨迹和自我帧奖励训练模型用自生成认知图推理。
Result: 在单图像和多图像空间推理基准上取得最先进性能，蒸馏模型保持性能的同时减少对外部几何管线的依赖。
Conclusion: OmniView-Space通过多模态自我中心证据维护空间一致性，有效提升MLLMs的空间推理能力，且蒸馏版本更高效。

papers.title: Hierarchical Variational Kalman Filtering
papers.abstract_en: Traditional variational Kalman filtering with unknown noise statistics suffers from inconsistent process covariance estimation and slow convergence speed, limiting its practical utility. To address these issues, we introduce a surrogate variable representing the process-noise-free state, which enables explicit modeling and inference of process noise statistics. In addition, we reformulate the conventional coordinate ascent variation inference (CAVI) as a marginalized maximum a posteriori problem, followed by a single-step hyperparameter fitting. This reformulation obviates the need for multiple inner iterations inherent to CAVI and decouples the design of the covariance tracking filters. Consequently, this architecture permits the deployment of higher-order filters for covariance tracking and enables sliding-window hyperparameter estimation. Notably, when this window encompasses all historical data, the covariance tracking estimator intrinsically operates as a zero-phase filter. Numerical simulations validate the theoretical framework, demonstrating the enhanced convergence speed and superior estimation accuracy compared with existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对未知噪声统计下传统变分卡尔曼滤波存在的过程协方差估计不一致和收敛速度慢的问题，引入一个表示无过程噪声状态的代理变量，从而显式建模和推断过程噪声统计。此外，将传统坐标上升变分推理(CAVI)重新表述为边际化最大后验问题，随后进行单步超参数拟合，避免了CAVI的多重内迭代并解耦协方差跟踪滤波器的设计。该架构允许使用高阶滤波器进行协方差跟踪，并支持滑窗超参数估计。数值仿真验证了该方法相比现有方法具有更快的收敛速度和更高的估计精度。
Motivation: 传统变分卡尔曼滤波在噪声统计未知时，过程协方差估计不一致且收敛速度慢，限制了其实用性。
Method: 引入无过程噪声状态的代理变量以显式建模过程噪声统计；将CAVI重新表述为边际化MAP问题，再单步拟合超参数，从而消除内迭代并解耦协方差跟踪滤波器设计。支持高阶滤波器和滑窗超参数估计。
Result: 数值仿真显示，该方法相比现有方法具有更快的收敛速度和更高的估计精度。
Conclusion: 本文提出的层次化变分卡尔曼滤波框架通过解耦协方差跟踪和超参数估计，提升了收敛速度与估计精度，尤其当滑窗覆盖全部历史数据时，协方差跟踪估计器呈现零相位滤波特性。

papers.title: The Binary Tree Mechanism is Optimal for Approximate Differentially Private Continual Counting
papers.abstract_en: Private continual counting is a fundamental problem in differential privacy: given a binary stream of length $n$, where each $1$ corresponds to the contribution of one individual, the goal is to release all running counts while protecting the privacy of each individual. The standard algorithm is the binary tree mechanism, whose Gaussian-noise variant achieves expected $\ell_\infty$ error proportional to $\log^{3/2} n$ for approximate differential privacy. Whether this dependence on the stream length is necessary has remained a central open problem. In this work, we resolve the dependence on $n$ by proving that every differentially private mechanism for continual counting must incur expected $\ell_\infty$ error $Ω(\log^{3/2} n)$. This shows that the binary tree mechanism is asymptotically optimal in the approximate-DP setting. As a consequence, we also obtain a largest-possible separation between hereditary discrepancy and private $\ell_\infty$ error for linear queries, showing that the known general upper bound in terms of hereditary discrepancy has the optimal dependence on the number of queries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明了在近似差分隐私（approximate differential privacy）设置下，持续计数（continual counting）问题的期望ℓ∞误差下界为Ω(log^{3/2} n)，与二叉树机制（binary tree mechanism）的误差上界匹配，从而表明二叉树机制是渐近最优的。该结果还给出了线性查询中遗传差异（hereditary discrepancy）与私有ℓ∞误差之间的最大可能分离。
Motivation: 持续计数是差分隐私中的基础问题，二叉树机制是标准算法，但其对数误差是否必要是长期未解的开放问题。本文旨在证明该下界，以确定最佳可能的误差依赖关系。
Method: 通过构造一个下界证明，表明任何满足近似差分隐私的持续计数机制必须具有期望ℓ∞误差Ω(log^{3/2} n)。
Result: 证明了二叉树机制在高斯噪声变体下的期望ℓ∞误差Θ(log^{3/2} n)是最优的，并得到了遗传差异与私有ℓ∞误差之间最优的分离结果。
Conclusion: 二叉树机制在近似差分隐私的持续计数问题中是渐近最优的，同时该下界也回答了线性查询中一个重要理论问题。

papers.title: Self-Evolving Agents with Anytime-Valid Certificates
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving agents violate the assumption behind most learning-theoretic guarantees: the data, evaluator, components, and hypothesis space are produced by the policy being updated. We present \textbf{SEA}, an architecture that confines self-modification to a small steering adapter and a versioned harness around a \emph{frozen} base model and admits each modification only through an anytime-valid gate that emits an auditable certificate against a fixed error budget. Five loop controllers compose published guarantees; because such gates can only \emph{select} among behaviors the frozen base already produces, five verifier-in-the-loop mechanisms -- best-of-$N$, micro-step search, self-authored reproduction oracles, search-layer control, and self-repair -- supply the dense, grader-free signal the gates require, computed from the issue text alone. On a $52$-instance SWE-bench Verified subset across four base models, base capability is the dominant, confound-free effect, and on two strong base models a deliberate no-op-composite control isolates the suite's contribution at $+4$ and $+5$ (\textsc{Glm}~5.2 $24\to28$; \textsc{Gpt} $29\to34$, the $65\%$ best), with event logs confirming that its mechanisms fire and prevent regressions. Results are single-run on expensive evaluations; confirming run-to-run variance and adapting the per-task algorithm mix are future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SEA架构，通过冻结基模型、使用小型适配器和版本化封装来限制自我修改，并利用任意有效门（anytime-valid gate）对每次修改进行认证，确保在固定误差预算内。在SWE-bench Verified子集上的实验表明，基础能力是主要影响因素，而SEA套件在强基模型上带来4-5个百分点的提升。
Motivation: 自我进化智能体违反了大多数学习理论保证的假设：数据、评估器、组件和假设空间由正在更新的策略产生。现有方法缺乏对修改的严格认证机制。
Method: 提出SEA架构，将自我修改限制在一个小型适配器和版本化封装中，基模型冻结。每次修改通过任意有效门，该门根据固定误差预算发出可审计证书。使用五种验证器在环机制（best-of-N、微步搜索、自作者复制预言、搜索层控制、自修复）提供门所需的高密度无评分者信号。
Result: 在52个SWE-bench Verified实例上，四个基模型中基础能力是主导效应。在强基模型GLM 5.2上从24提升至28，GPT上从29提升至34（即65%最佳），事件日志确认机制触发并防止回归。
Conclusion: SEA通过严格认证和验证器在环机制实现了可控的自我进化，但结果是单次运行，未来需要确认运行间方差和调整每任务算法组合。

summary_sections.method: 提出SEA架构，将自我修改限制在一个小型适配器和版本化封装中，基模型冻结。每次修改通过任意有效门，该门根据固定误差预算发出可审计证书。使用五种验证器在环机制（best-of-N、微步搜索、自作者复制预言、搜索层控制、自修复）提供门所需的高密度无评分者信号。
summary_sections.result: 在52个SWE-bench Verified实例上，四个基模型中基础能力是主导效应。在强基模型GLM 5.2上从24提升至28，GPT上从29提升至34（即65%最佳），事件日志确认机制触发并防止回归。
summary_sections.conclusion: SEA通过严格认证和验证器在环机制实现了可控的自我进化，但结果是单次运行，未来需要确认运行间方差和调整每任务算法组合。

papers.title: EFlow: Learning Evidence Flow for Long-Video Reasoning with Adaptive Reflection
papers.abstract_en: Long-video reasoning is fundamentally constrained by how models acquire and utilize visual evidence. Existing tool-augmented video frameworks often interleave temporal grounding and answer reasoning within a single trajectory, causing early semantic hypotheses to bias evidence localization. We term this failure mode premature semantic commitment, where biased grounding retrieves incomplete evidence and incomplete evidence further reinforces incorrect reasoning. To address this issue, we propose EFlow, an evidence-first video reasoning framework built upon Qwen3-VL. EFlow explicitly separates temporal grounding and logical reasoning through CoT for Temporal Grounding and CoT for Reasoning, enabling the model to retrieve relevant evidence before answer inference. In addition, EFlow introduces a confidence-aware reflection mechanism that re-evaluates the full video when retrieved evidence is potentially insufficient. We further construct dedicated trajectory datasets and train EFlow through supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and reinforcement fine-tuning. Extensive experiments across five video understanding benchmarks demonstrate that EFlow consistently improves long-video reasoning performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EFlow，一种证据优先的视频推理框架，通过分离时间定位和推理步骤（CoT for Temporal Grounding 和 CoT for Reasoning）以及引入置信度感知的反思机制，解决长视频推理中的早期语义承诺问题。在五个视频理解基准上取得一致改进。
Motivation: 现有工具增强的视频框架往往将时间定位和答案推理交织在单一轨迹中，导致早期语义假设偏置证据定位，造成“过早语义承诺”（premature semantic commitment）问题。
Method: 提出EFlow，基于Qwen3-VL，明确分离时间定位和逻辑推理，使用CoT for Temporal Grounding和CoT for Reasoning；引入置信度感知的反思机制，在检索证据可能不足时重新评估整个视频；构建专门的轨迹数据集，通过监督微调、强化学习和强化微调进行训练。
Result: 在五个视频理解基准上的广泛实验表明EFlow一致地提升了长视频推理性能。
Conclusion: EFlow通过证据优先的设计和自适应反思机制有效缓解了过早语义承诺，提升了长视频推理的准确性和鲁棒性。

papers.title: Constrained Bayesian Optimisation with Multiple Information Sources
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian Optimisation (BO) under unknown constraints is particularly challenging when feasible regions are small. In such settings, existing methods that typically rely solely on evaluations of the true objective and constraints struggle to efficiently explore the design space. However, many real-world applications offer auxiliary data sources (e.g. surrogate models or simplified simulations) that can support early exploration. Despite this potential, their integration into constrained BO remains largely unexplored. We propose a general multi-source framework that extends constrained Max-value Entropy Search, capturing inter-source correlation while balancing evaluation cost and information gain. Experiments on both synthetic and physics-based benchmarks show that our method efficiently identifies feasible and optimal solutions, even when auxiliary data are only weakly correlated. The proposed approach consistently outperforms existing methods, particularly in early-stage exploration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多源约束贝叶斯优化框架，扩展了约束最大熵搜索（constrained Max-value Entropy Search），通过建模辅助数据源（如代理模型或简化仿真）与真实目标之间的相关性，在低可行区域比例下高效探索设计空间。实验表明，即使辅助数据弱相关，该方法在基准测试中仍优于现有方法，尤其在早期探索阶段。
Motivation: 现有约束贝叶斯优化方法在可行区域小的场景下效率低下，且未充分利用工程应用中常见的辅助数据源（如低成本仿真或替代模型）来加速早期探索。
Method: 提出多源约束最大熵搜索框架，集成多个信息源，建模源间相关性，并在信息增益与评估成本之间进行平衡，以指导采样。
Result: 在合成基准和基于物理的基准上，该方法能高效识别可行且最优的解，尤其在早期探索阶段一致优于现有约束BO方法，即使辅助数据仅弱相关。
Conclusion: 多源信息集成能显著提升约束贝叶斯优化在稀疏可行区域中的性能，且对辅助数据质量具有一定鲁棒性。

papers.title: CAT: Confidence-Adaptive Thinking for Efficient Reasoning of Large Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have achieved remarkable success on complex tasks by leveraging long chain-of-thought (CoT) trajectories, yet they frequently exhibit overthinking on simple queries, resulting in significant token overhead and reduced inference efficiency. However, existing compression methods predominantly apply uniform length reduction or rely on coarse-grained difficulty estimation, often leading to performance degradation on difficult problems. To address this limitation, we propose Confidence-Adaptive Thinking (CAT), a framework that incorporates the model's intrinsic self-certainty signals as confidence into the preference optimization process, which autonomously modulates reasoning lengths based on problem difficulty. Experimental results show that CAT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on reasoning accuracy across multiple benchmarks on different base models. Our work enables LRMs to effectively compress confident responses while deliberating on uncertain ones, offering a potentially robust solution for balancing accuracy and latency in practical industrial scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大推理模型（LRM）在简单查询上过度思考导致推理效率低下的问题，提出置信度自适应推理（CAT）框架。该框架将模型内在的自信心信号作为置信度纳入偏好优化过程，使模型能根据问题难度自主调节推理长度。实验表明，CAT在多个基准和不同基模型上均一致优于现有最先进基线。
Motivation: 现有LRM在简单任务上会生成过长的推理链，造成大量令牌浪费；而现有压缩方法要么统一缩短长度，要么依赖粗略的难度估计，在困难任务上性能下降明显。
Method: CAT通过将模型输出的自置信度信号融入偏好优化，使模型自主调整推理长度：对高置信度问题缩短推理，对低置信度问题延长推理。
Result: 在多个推理基准上，CAT相比现有压缩方法在保持准确率的同时显著降低了令牌消耗，且在不同基模型上均表现一致。
Conclusion: CAT提供了一种有效平衡准确率与推理延迟的方案，尤其适用于对延迟敏感的工业场景。

papers.title: TrajLoc: Trajectory-Attention Localization for Multi-Object Motion Control
papers.abstract_en: Controlling the motion of multiple objects in image-to-video (I2V) generation requires preserving object identities while enforcing adherence to distinct target trajectories. This becomes particularly challenging as the number of objects increases and their paths intersect or occlude one another. Existing approaches entangle multiple trajectories within a shared, dense conditioning signal, making object-level correspondence difficult to preserve in crowded scenes. We depart from this paradigm and enforce a strict, per object spatial constraint that isolates instances independently. Our method, TrajLoc, achieves this directly within the attention layers by substituting the cross-attention weights of each object token with a Gaussian heatmap centered on its target location at every frame. The same per object token interface carries trajectory and depth through a learned embedding and preserves identity by encoding first frame appearance in place of an object token. Evaluations across six datasets, featuring up to 20 simultaneously controlled objects and out of distribution real world scenes, demonstrate that our method consistently improves both visual fidelity and trajectory adherence. Applied to two architecturally distinct backbones (CogVideoX 5B and WaN 2.1 14B), our approach achieves average gains of +4.3 dB PSNR and a 51% reduction in trajectory end point error compared to the strongest baselines. Project page: https://sela-omer.github.io/traj-loc/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TrajLoc 方法，用于多目标运动控制的图像到视频生成，通过在每个帧中将每个物体 token 的交叉注意力权重替换为以目标位置为中心的高斯热图，强制每物体空间约束，以保持物体身份并遵循不同轨迹。在多达20个同时控制物体的数据集上，相比最强基线，平均 PSNR 提升4.3 dB，轨迹端点误差降低51%。
Motivation: 现有方法将多个轨迹纠缠在共享的密集条件信号中，在拥挤场景中难以保持物体级对应，物体数量增加及路径交叉或遮挡时问题更严重。
Method: 在注意力层内，将每个物体 token 的交叉注意力权重替换为以该物体每帧目标位置为中心的高斯热图，同时通过学习嵌入传递轨迹和深度，通过编码第一帧外观代替物体 token 来保持身份。
Result: 在六个数据集上（最多20个同时控制物体和分布外真实场景），应用在两种架构（CogVideoX 5B 和 WaN 2.1 14B）上，PSNR 平均提升+4.3 dB，轨迹端点误差降低51%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该方法通过严格的每物体空间约束，一致提升了视觉保真度和轨迹遵循度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Meta-Transfer Learning for mmWave Beam Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) beam alignment plays a critical role in next-generation wireless systems, yet its efficient implementation remains challenging. Meta-learning and transfer learning have been explored to enable deep learning-based beam prediction models to rapidly adapt to unseen environments; however, existing meta-learning approaches adapt the entire network and are trained from random initialization, leading to a large number of updated parameters and a high meta-training cost, while transfer learning approaches restrict adaptation to part of the network but do not exploit episodic meta-learning, which explicitly trains the model over multiple tasks, to optimize the adaptation process itself. To overcome these limitations, we propose MTL-BA, a meta-transfer learning framework for beam alignment in millimeter-wave multiple-input single-output (MISO) systems that freezes a pre-trained convolutional backbone and meta-learns only lightweight Scale-and-Shift (SS) adapters together with a classifier head. Warm-starting from the pre-trained model and restricting adaptation to the SS adapters and classifier head reduce both the adaptation cost and the meta-training budget without sacrificing prediction performance. Simulation results on the DeepMIMO ray-tracing dataset show that MTL-BA matches the accuracy and spectral efficiency of full fine-tuning across various SNR levels despite updating approximately $17\times$ fewer parameters than both full fine-tuning and Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML), outperforms last-layer fine-tuning while updating a comparable number of parameters, and approaches MAML's performance while requiring $60\%$ fewer meta-training epochs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MTL-BA，一种针对毫米波MISO系统波束对齐的元迁移学习框架。该方法冻结预训练的卷积骨干，仅元学习轻量级Scale-and-Shift适配器和分类头，从而减少适应成本和元训练开销。在DeepMIMO数据集上的仿真显示，MTL-BA在更新参数比全微调和MAML少约17倍的情况下，仍能匹配其精度和频谱效率，并比最后一层微调表现更好。
Motivation: 现有元学习方法适应整个网络且从随机初始化训练，导致参数更新多、元训练成本高；而迁移学习方法虽限制适应部分网络，但未利用元学习优化适应过程。
Method: 提出MTL-BA框架：先预训练卷积骨干网络，然后冻结骨干，仅对Scale-and-Shift适配器和分类头进行元学习。
Result: 在DeepMIMO数据集上，MTL-BA与全微调和MAML精度和频谱效率相当，但参数更新量减少约17倍，且元训练轮次减少60%。
Conclusion: 证明了冻结预训练骨干并元学习轻量适配器可同时降低适应成本和元训练预算，而不牺牲性能。
Relevance: 0
