papers.title: MoVA: Learning Asymmetric Dual Projections for Modular Long Video-Text Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive pre-training has propelled video-text alignment, yet models often inherit the critical limitations of their image-text predecessors like CLIP, resulting in entangled representations. These challenges are severely exacerbated by two fundamental properties in the video domain: Temporal Misalignment, where textual descriptions often correlate only to specific, constrained temporal windows, leaving other frames text-irrelevant; and Semantic Asymmetry, which dictates a sparse, bidirectional, and non-equivalent relevance between frame-level visual details and caption-level concepts. This failure persists whether captions are short and temporally disjoint, creating ambiguity, or long and detailed, fostering entanglement between static objects and their temporal evolution. In this paper, we establish theoretical conditions that enable flexible alignment between video and text representations across the temporal dimension and at varying levels of granularity. Building on these theoretical insights, we introduce MoVA, Modular Long Video-Text Alignment, which learns dual asymmetric projections: a text-side projection that adaptively selects frame-aware subspaces of the caption, and a video-side projection that disentangles text-relevant visual concepts. Our framework ensures that the model can preserve global cross-modal semantics while disentangling evolving, frame-specific concepts and scale naturally to long captions and videos. Empirical evaluations show that MoVA outperforms existing methods in multiple video-text alignment tasks, demonstrating the effectiveness of our method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MoVA框架，通过非对称双投影（文本侧投影选择帧感知子空间，视频侧投影解缠文本相关视觉概念）实现模块化长视频-文本对齐，解决时序错位和语义不对称问题，在多个视频-文本对齐任务上超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有对比预训练模型（如CLIP）在视频域面临时序错位（文本仅匹配特定时间窗口）和语义不对称（帧级细节与标题概念稀疏双向非等值关联）的挑战，导致表征纠缠。
Method: MoVA学习非对称双投影：文本侧投影自适应选择标题的帧感知子空间，视频侧投影解缠文本相关的视觉概念，保留全局跨模态语义的同时解缠帧级概念，支持长视频和长标题。
Result: 实验表明MoVA在多个视频-文本对齐任务上优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 本文建立的理论条件使视频与文本表示在时间维度和不同粒度下灵活对齐，MoVA框架证明有效。

papers.title: Shapley in Context: Explaining Financial Language with Domain Expertise
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, large language models have achieved remarkable success and have seen growing adoption in financial applications. At the same time, explainability remains critical in finance, a domain characterized by high stakes and strict regulatory requirements. Although numerous methods have been proposed to explain black box machine learning models, the majority of these approaches are designed for general purpose tasks and do not incorporate domain specific knowledge. In this work, we study the explainability of financial textual data modeled by large language models through the lens of the Shapley value. Specifically, we investigate whether Shapley based attributions align with established financial domain knowledge. Through rigorous theoretical analysis and extensive empirical evaluations, we demonstrate that Shapley values can yield explanations that are consistent with financial reasoning and can offer meaningful insights into the model's behavior in text based financial applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了大语言模型在金融文本数据上的可解释性，运用Shapley值进行归因分析，并通过理论和实验验证Shapley值的解释与金融领域知识的一致性。
Motivation: 金融领域对模型可解释性有高要求，但现有解释方法大多为通用任务设计，缺乏领域知识整合。
Method: 基于Shapley值对金融文本数据的大语言模型进行特征归因，分析其与金融领域知识的对齐程度。

Conclusion: Shapley值在金融语言模型解释中有效，可结合领域知识提升可解释性。

papers.title: Recovering Input Text from Hidden States: Study of Gradient-Based Inversion of Decoder-Only Language Models
papers.abstract_en: This work studies the hidden-state inversion problem: recovering the original input token sequence of a decoder-only language model from its last-layer hidden states. Rather than treating inversion as a one-shot reconstruction, we study it as a continuous embedding-space optimisation in which a soft proxy is driven towards the leaked target without any hard-token projection during the search, and a token is committed only once, at the end of the inner loop. This design choice has two consequences which are the main focus of this paper. First, keeping the optimisation entirely in continuous space exposes a rich set of internal signals: rank trajectories of the ground-truth token, per-position loss curves, and a discrete loss measured at commit time. Second, the discrete loss allows assessing the correctness of recovery via cumulative discrete loss. We further analyse which tokens break the reconstructions and find a sharp categorical asymmetry: space-prefixed, high-frequency function words in dense regions of the embedding matrix dominate the failures, while content-bearing tokens are recovered almost perfectly. On 10-token C4 prompts the exact-match rate rises from 66.9% to 97.5% (mean similarity 0.994) as the candidate window is widened, confirming that most errors are recoverable near-misses rather than genuine ambiguities. A comparison with the released SIPIT reference situates these findings: per-step hard projection is faster, but the continuous formulation is what makes the optimisation observable and its failures detectable. The results show that last-layer hidden states of GPT-2 are as sensitive as the original text.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从decoder-only语言模型的最后一层隐藏状态中恢复原始输入文本的梯度反演方法。与一次性重建不同，作者采用连续嵌入空间优化，在搜索过程中不进行硬token投影，仅在内部循环结束时提交token。该设计暴露了丰富的内部信号（如真实token的秩轨迹、位置损失曲线和提交时的离散损失），并允许通过累积离散损失评估恢复正确性。分析发现，空格前缀的高频功能词（嵌入矩阵密集区域）主导了失败，而内容词几乎完美恢复。在10-token C4提示上，候选窗口扩大后精确匹配率从66.9%提升至97.5%（平均相似度0.994），表明大多数错误是可恢复的近失而非真正歧义。与SIPIT参考比较表明，每步硬投影更快，但连续公式使优化可观察且故障可检测。
Motivation: 现有的隐藏状态反演方法通常将重建视为一次性任务，缺乏对优化过程和失败模式的分析。本文旨在通过连续空间优化暴露内部信号，并理解哪些token导致重建失败。
Method: 提出连续嵌入空间优化方法：不进行硬token投影，而是驱动软代理向泄露目标移动，仅在内部循环结束时提交一个token。利用真实token的秩轨迹、位置损失曲线和提交时的离散损失作为信号。
Result: 在10-token C4提示上，精确匹配率从66.9%（窄窗口）升至97.5%（宽窗口），平均相似度0.994。失败主要由空格前缀的高频功能词引起，内容词恢复几乎完美。
Conclusion: GPT-2的最后一层隐藏状态对原始文本的敏感性相当于原始文本本身；连续优化公式虽然比硬投影慢，但使优化过程可观测且故障可检测。

papers.title: Mirror-Fusion Attention for Reflection-Aware Self-Supervised Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Most self-supervised learning (SSL) methods encourage invariance across augmentations, but strict flip invariance can suppress informative left--right correspondences in approximately bilateral data such as medical images and human faces. We propose Mirror-Fusion-Augmented Self-Supervised Learning (MFASSL), a Vision Transformer framework that injects a soft reflection prior into standard SSL without redesigning the backbone. MFASSL constructs mirror-paired views aligned to an estimated symmetry axis and introduces a lightweight Mirror-Fusion Attention (MFA) module for adaptive token-level interaction between mirrored regions while preserving asymmetric cues. The base SSL objective is further coupled with reflection-consistency and mid-layer token-alignment losses. Across CheXpert, BraTS, CelebA-HQ, and WFLW, MFASSL improves downstream performance, calibration, and reflection robustness over MoCo-v3, DINO, and MAE baselines under matched ViT-B/16 settings. It also achieves stronger and more consistent gains than recent equivariant SSL approaches with only approximately 2.7\% additional parameters. These results show that lightweight geometry-aware priors can effectively complement invariance-based SSL.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECML PKDD 2026. The final authenticated version will be available in the Springer LNCS proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Mirror-Fusion-Augmented Self-Supervised Learning (MFASSL)，在Vision Transformer框架中注入软反射先验以提高自监督学习在近似对称数据上的表现。通过构建镜像配对视图和轻量级Mirror-Fusion Attention模块，该方法在不增加太多参数的情况下，在CheXpert、BraTS、CelebA-HQ、WFLW等数据集上改善了下游任务性能、校准和反射鲁棒性。
Motivation: 标准自监督学习鼓励跨增强的不变性，但严格的翻转不变性会抑制医学图像和人脸等近似对称数据中有价值的左右对应关系。
Method: 提出MFASSL框架，包括：根据估计对称轴构建镜像配对视图；引入轻量级Mirror-Fusion Attention (MFA)模块实现自适应令牌级镜像区域交互，同时保留非对称线索；在基础SSL目标基础上增加反射一致性和中间层令牌对齐损失。
Result: 在CheXpert、BraTS、CelebA-HQ、WFLW上，MFASSL在ViT-B/16设置下比MoCo-v3、DINO、MAE基线在性能、校准和反射鲁棒性上均有提升，且仅增加约2.7%参数。
Conclusion: 摘要强调轻量的几何感知先验可以有效补充基于不变性的SSL。

papers.title: Rethinking Multi-Label Image Classification With Deep Learning: Taxonomy, Challenge, and Outlook
papers.abstract_en: Multi-label image classification (MLIC), a fundamental task in computer vision, focuses on identifying multiple objects or concepts within an image, underpinning numerous read-world applications, such as autonomous driving, disease diagnosis, recommendation system, and mobile service robot. Over the past decade, deep learning paradigms based on convolutional neural networks, recurrent neural networks, and Transformers have significantly advanced this field, owing to their powerful capability in visual representation and relationship modeling. These advances have markedly improved the robustness, scalability, and generalization ability of MLIC models across diverse datasets and application domains. In this survey, we provide a comprehensive review of the deep learning-based literature on MLIC. Concretely, we first revisit the background, including problem definition, datasets, backbones and evaluation metrics. Next, we develop a plausible taxonomy for the deep learning-based MLIC approaches, organizing them into six groups: region-oriented methods, label-oriented methods, architecture-oriented methods, representation-oriented methods, learning-oriented methods, and data-oriented methods. Finally, we provide an insightful exposition of the underlying learning game in MLIC and its implications for other vision domains, and we empirically summarize the key challenges and research directions in MLIC while outlining promising avenues for future development. We believe this survey offers the research community a holistic and systematic perspective on MLIC, thereby facilitating subsequent exploration and innovation in this field and beyond.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于基于深度学习的多标签图像分类（MLIC）的综述，回顾了问题定义、数据集、骨干网络和评估指标，将现有方法分为六大类：区域导向、标签导向、架构导向、表示导向、学习导向和数据导向方法，并总结了关键挑战和未来研究方向。
Motivation: 多标签图像分类是计算机视觉的基础任务，广泛应用于自动驾驶、疾病诊断等场景。近年来深度学习技术显著提升了MLIC的性能，但缺乏系统性的综述来组织该领域的方法和挑战。
Method: 构建了一个新的分类体系，将MLIC方法分为六类：区域导向、标签导向、架构导向、表示导向、学习导向和数据导向方法，并深入分析了各类方法的本质。
Result: 归纳了MLIC中的关键学习博弈及其对其他视觉领域的启示，指出了当前的主要挑战（如长尾分布、标签关联建模）和未来发展方向（如小样本学习、自监督学习）。
Conclusion: 本文为研究社区提供了MLIC的整体系统视角，有助于后续在该领域及其他领域的探索和创新。

papers.title: From World Models to World Action Models: A Concise Tutorial for Robotics
papers.abstract_en: World models are increasingly used in embodied intelligence and generative simulation, yet their scope remains ambiguous across communities. This tutorial presents a design-space view of world models as action-conditioned predictive models that estimate the future evolution of task-relevant observations or states. We categorize existing methods into observation-space and state-space world models, comparing their trade-offs in visual fidelity, spatial structure, physical interpretability, and control usability. We further introduce world action models, which connect predicted futures with executable robot actions, and summarize four representative paradigms: imagine-then-execute, video-feature-conditioned action prediction, joint video-action modeling, and auxiliary video prediction for policy learning. The goal of this tutorial is to clarify the conceptual scope of world (action) models and provide a structured taxonomy for embodied prediction and control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本教程以设计空间视角审视世界模型，将其视为动作条件预测模型，并区分为观察空间和状态空间两类。进一步引入世界行动模型概念，总结四种代表性范式：想象-执行、视频特征条件行动预测、联合视频-行动建模、辅助视频预测策略学习。旨在为机器人领域的具身预测与控制提供清晰的概念范围与结构化分类。
Motivation: 世界模型在具身智能与生成模拟中日益重要，但不同社区对其定义模糊，需要明确分类与界定。
Method: 采用分类学方法，对现有世界模型进行归类，比较观察空间模型与状态空间模型在视觉保真度、空间结构、物理可解释性和控制可用性上的权衡。并引入世界行动模型，总结四种范式。
Conclusion: 本教程旨在澄清世界（行动）模型的概念范围，为具身预测与控制提供结构化的分类体系。

papers.title: Spectroscopy Analysis with Machine Learning Regression for the Quantification of Carbon and Nitrogen Contents in Inceptisol and Oxisol Soil Types: Comparing Different Preprocessing and Validation methods as well as Feature Importance
papers.abstract_en: Near-Infrared (NIR) spectroscopy has emerged as a promising alternative to traditional soil analysis methods, offering advantages such as speed, low cost, and non-destructive testing. This work proposes a machine learning (ML) approach to calibrate predictive models for carbon (C) and nitrogen (N) content in Oxisols and Inceptisols, utilizing NIR spectral data acquired with a portable MyNIR device. Various preprocessing methods were evaluated, with the most effective being the Savitzky-Golay (SG) filter and a robust outlier removal method based on the Nonlinear Iterative Partial Least Squares (NIPALS) algorithm coupled with a Huber loss function. Multiple validation strategies were compared, including 10-fold cross-validation, leave-one-out, and holdout via the Kennard-Stone method, followed by standardization. Stacking ensemble learning models were employed, using Partial Least Squares (PLS), Support Vector Regression (SVR), and Ridge as base models, with linear regression as the meta-model. The models were evaluated using R2, Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE), and Ratio of Performance Deviation (RPD) metrics. The performance gap between soil types suggests the influence of pedological characteristics. Furthermore, the models achieved an RPD > 2.0 with low overfitting, validating the potential of this approach for rapid C and N quantification. This study contributes to the optimization of sustainable agricultural practices, aligning with the demand for efficient and environmentally friendly analytical methods. The developed technique enables faster decision-making for producers and consultants based on organic matter content, fertility indicators, and nutrient availability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用便携式MyNIR设备获取近红外光谱，结合机器学习回归方法对Oxisols和Inceptisols两种土壤类型的碳和氮含量进行定量分析。比较了多种预处理方法（Savitzky-Golay滤波、NIPALS+Huber异常值去除）和验证策略（10折交叉验证、留一法、Kennard-Stone划分），采用堆叠集成模型（PLS、SVR、Ridge作为基模型，线性回归为元模型）。模型RPD>2.0且过拟合低，表明该方法可用于快速碳氮定量。
Motivation: 传统土壤分析方法耗时、成本高，近红外光谱技术快速、无损、低成本，是理想的替代方案。本文旨在为该技术在不同土壤类型（Oxisols和Inceptisols）中碳氮含量的预测建立准确的机器学习模型。
Method: 使用Savitzky-Golay滤波和基于NIPALS算法与Huber损失函数的鲁棒异常值去除进行预处理。验证策略包括10折交叉验证、留一法和Kennard-Stone划分后标准化。采用堆叠集成学习，基模型为偏最小二乘回归（PLS）、支持向量回归（SVR）和岭回归（Ridge），元模型为线性回归。
Result: 模型在碳和氮的定量上均达到RPD>2.0，且过拟合程度低。不同土壤类型间的性能差异表明土壤学特征对模型有影响。
Conclusion: 该方法能够快速、准确地定量土壤碳和氮含量，有助于可持续农业实践，为生产者和顾问提供基于有机质含量和养分可用性的快速决策支持。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pano2World: End-to-End 3D Generation via Unified Multi-View Sequences
papers.abstract_en: A single panorama captures the full visual sphere from one camera center, yet confines users to looking around in place without enabling true scene exploration. Converting a single panorama into a persistent, renderable 3D representation for free-viewpoint navigation has attracted growing interest; existing methods either adopt iterative per-view completion that propagates inpainting results to update the underlying geometry, leading to progressive error accumulation and cumbersome multi-step pipelines, or leverage the temporal consistency priors of video generation models, yet the continuous-trajectory constraint intrinsic to such models limits their flexibility in covering scenes from multiple directions simultaneously. We present Pano2World, which takes a single indoor panorama as input and directly outputs a persistent, explorable 3D Gaussian scene. Given the source panorama, Pano2World first reconstructs a coarse 3D Gaussian proxy and renders it at adaptively sampled nearby poses to obtain geometrically aligned guidance panoramas; a panoramic diffusion model then jointly denoises all target views via View-Aware Attention Routing, where each target view simultaneously receives geometric constraints from its corresponding guidance panorama and global semantic guidance from the source panorama, naturally enforcing cross-view consistency. To avoid the information loss incurred by decoding the multi-view hidden features formed during joint denoising back to the pixel domain via VAE, we introduce Latent Feature Adapter, a geometry-aware bridge module that directly distills these hidden features into a scene latent, subsequently decoded into the final 3D Gaussian scene. Experiments demonstrate that Pano2World significantly outperforms existing methods on the multi-position panoramic novel-view synthesis benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Pano2World，从单张室内全景图直接生成可探索的3D高斯场景。方法先重建粗3D高斯代理，渲染得到几何对齐的引导全景图，再通过全景扩散模型联合去噪所有目标视图，使用视图感知注意力路由（View-Aware Attention Routing）施加几何和全局语义约束。引入潜在特征适配器（Latent Feature Adapter）直接将联合去噪的隐特征解码为3D高斯场景，避免VAE解码信息损失。实验在多位置全景新视角合成基准上显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有单全景图转3D表示的方法存在误差累积或多步流程，或受限于视频生成模型的连续轨迹约束，难以灵活覆盖多方向场景。
Method: Pano2World：1) 从输入全景图重建粗3D高斯代理；2) 在自适应采样邻近位姿渲染得到几何对齐的引导全景图；3) 全景扩散模型通过视图感知注意力路由联合去噪所有目标视图，每个视图接收对应引导全景图的几何约束和源全景图的全局语义约束；4) 潜在特征适配器将联合去噪的隐特征直接蒸馏为场景潜在表示，进而解码为最终3D高斯场景。
Result: 在多位置全景新视角合成基准上，Pano2World显著优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确讨论局限性，但表明该方法通过端到端联合去噪和隐特征适配实现了有效且一致的3D场景生成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stitched Embeddings: A Unified Latent Space for 3D Garments and 2D Patterns
papers.abstract_en: While garments are essential for realistic digital humans, their topological variety makes them much harder to model than parametric bodies. Traditional tailoring relies on 2D sewing patterns, yet bridging these patterns to 3D geometry currently requires physical simulations. We present Stitched Embeddings, the first simulation-free framework to unify 3D garment reconstruction and sewing pattern inference within a single bidirectional latent space. By leveraging the geometric priors of a pretrained 3D foundation model, our approach overcomes the data scarcity typically associated with high-quality garment modeling. We propose to use the BoxMesh as a critical intermediate representation to align 2D panels into 3D configurations without the computational overhead of a simulator. This architecture achieves state-of-the-art accuracy in pattern reconstruction while significantly improving efficiency. Furthermore, our differentiable pipeline enables novel applications, including pattern recovery from meshes and 3D editing from 2D patterns. Finally, this work provides a scalable link between neural 3D vision and the physical garment manufacturing pipeline. Project Page: https://andreus00.github.io/stitchedembeddings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Stitched Embeddings，首个无需物理模拟的统一框架，在单个双向潜在空间中实现 3D 服装重建与 2D 缝纫图案推断。利用预训练 3D 基础模型的几何先验，以 BoxMesh 作为中间表示对齐 2D 面板到 3D 配置，在图案重建上达到最先进精度并显著提升效率。支持从网格恢复图案、从 2D 图案编辑 3D 等新应用。
Motivation: 服装拓扑多样性使其比参数化人体更难建模，传统方法需依赖物理模拟桥接 2D 缝纫图案与 3D 几何，计算开销大。本文旨在实现无模拟的统一建模框架。
Method: 提出 Stitched Embeddings 双向潜在空间，利用预训练 3D 基础模型的几何先验，以 BoxMesh 作为关键中间表示对齐 2D 面板到 3D 配置，整个流程可微，避免物理模拟器计算开销。
Result: 在图案重建上达到最先进精度，显著提高效率；支持从网格恢复图案和从 2D 图案编辑 3D 等新应用。
Conclusion: 该工作为神经 3D 视觉与物理服装制造流程提供了可扩展链接，展示了无模拟框架在服装建模中的可行性与效率优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Exploring the Semantic Gap in Agentic Data Systems: A Formative Study of Operationalization Failures in Analytical Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate queries, invoke tools, and construct analytical workflows. Although recent advances have substantially improved workflow generation and execution, the semantic information required to operationalize analytical concepts often lies beyond what is explicitly represented in database schemas and data values. We present a cross-domain formative study of operationalization failures in agent-generated analytical workflows. Across 236 analytical intents spanning finance, human resources, and public safety domains, we identify 153 recurring failures despite successful workflow generation and execution. Our analysis reveals five recurring classes of failures: comparative grounding, process reasoning, quantitative reasoning, role confusion, and policy grounding. These findings suggest a semantic gap between user-level analytical concepts and the information available to workflow-generation systems. More broadly, they raise questions about the admissibility of analytical operations and suggest that future agentic data systems may require richer semantic representations to bridge the gap between analytical intent and executable computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）生成的代理数据分析工作流中的操作化失败问题。通过跨领域（金融、人力资源、公共安全）的236个分析意图分析，发现153个重复失败，归纳出五类失败模式：比较基础、过程推理、定量推理、角色混淆和政策基础。研究揭示了用户层面的分析概念与工作流生成系统可用信息之间的语义鸿沟。
Motivation: 当前LLM驱动的代理系统在生成查询、调用工具和构建分析工作流时，常因缺乏超出数据库模式和数据值的语义信息而导致操作化失败，阻碍了分析意图到可执行计算的准确转化。
Method: 采用跨领域形成性研究方法，收集236个来自金融、人力资源和公共安全领域的分析意图，分析代理生成工作流中的失败实例，并归类失败模式。
Result: 在236个分析意图中识别出153个重复失败，归纳出五类系统性的失败模式：比较基础、过程推理、定量推理、角色混淆和政策基础。
Conclusion: 当前代理数据系统存在语义鸿沟，未来需要更丰富的语义表示来桥接分析意图与可执行计算之间的差距，并重新审视分析操作的合理性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Training-Free Debiasing of Diffusion Models via CLIP-Guided Denoising Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models achieve impressive visual quality, yet demographic bias remains a challenge, as neutral prompts consistently produce stereotypical representations across gender and race. Existing approaches remain limited by costly retraining or by inference-time interventions that often degrade image quality and semantic alignment. We propose Text Embedding Steering (TES), a training-free framework that mitigates demographic bias by directly optimizing conditional text embeddings during the diffusion process. We show that a two-stage strategy - early-stage global alignment followed by iterative denoising-time refinement with CLIP-based feedback - enables stable and controllable attribute steering without modifying model parameters. Extensive experiments on Stable Diffusion demonstrate that TES outperforms existing training-free baselines in fairness while maintaining competitive image quality. These results highlight that inference-time text embedding optimization is a practical and scalable solution for fairness-aware generation in diffusion models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Text Embedding Steering (TES)，一种无需训练的去偏框架，通过在扩散过程中直接优化条件文本嵌入来缓解文本到图像扩散模型中的性别和种族偏见。该方法采用两阶段策略：早期全局对齐和基于CLIP反馈的迭代去噪时细化，无需修改模型参数。实验表明，TES在保持竞争力的图像质量的同时，在公平性上优于现有无需训练的基线方法。
Motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型存在人口统计偏见，中性提示词常生成刻板印象的性别和种族表征。现有方法要么需要昂贵的重新训练，要么在推理时干预导致图像质量和语义对齐下降。
Method: 提出 Text Embedding Steering (TES)，通过两阶段优化条件文本嵌入：早期阶段进行全局对齐，然后在去噪过程中利用CLIP反馈进行迭代细化，实现稳定可控的属性引导，无需修改模型参数。
Result: 在Stable Diffusion上的实验表明，TES在公平性指标上优于现有无需训练的方法，同时保持有竞争力的图像质量。
Conclusion: 推理时文本嵌入优化是一种实用且可扩展的解决方案，可用于扩散模型中的公平感知生成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards High-Resolution Visual Perception via Hierarchical Entity Exploration
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution (HR) image perception remains a key challenge in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), as fine-grained details are often lost when the image is processed as a whole. Existing methods either require training to teach models where to look or heuristically divide the image into fixed regions, both of which struggle to generalize in complex HR scenes. In this work, we propose Hierarchical Entity Exploration (HEE), a training-free and model-agnostic framework that transforms static image understanding into dynamic, query-guided entity exploration. HEE first evaluates each region using a dual scoring mechanism to determine whether it already contains sufficient evidence to answer the question. If not, it applies object detection within the most promising region to extract fine-grained entities, clusters them into coherent subregions, and organizes them into a multi-level semantic hierarchy for deeper exploration. When deeper regions still fail to yield confident answers, a confidence-guided backtracking mechanism revisits alternative paths to ensure adaptive perception. Extensive results show that HEE outperforms training-free methods like ZoomEye and RAP in both accuracy and efficiency on two complex HR benchmarks (Visual Probe and HR-Bench), across different MLLMs such as Qwen2.5-VL and LLaVA-OneVision. Moreover, HEE demonstrates generalization on the MME-RealWorld benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出层次实体探索（HEE）框架，用于高分辨率图像感知，无需训练，通过动态查询引导实体探索，在复杂HR场景中提升准确率和效率。
Motivation: 现有高分辨率图像感知方法要么需要训练，要么启发式固定区域划分，难以泛化到复杂HR场景。
Method: 提出HEE框架，使用双评分机制评估区域是否足够回答查询；若不足，则在最有希望的区域进行目标检测提取细粒度实体，聚类为子区域，构建多级语义层次进行深入探索；当更深区域仍无法获得置信答案时，使用置信度引导回溯机制。
Result: 在Visual Probe和HR-Bench两个复杂HR基准上，HEE在准确率和效率上优于ZoomEye和RAP等无训练方法，并在不同MLLM上泛化。
Conclusion: HEE是一种训练无关、模型无关的框架，将静态图像理解转化为动态实体探索，有效提升HR感知性能。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有高分辨率图像感知方法要么需要训练，要么启发式固定区域划分，难以泛化到复杂HR场景。
summary_sections.method: 提出HEE框架，使用双评分机制评估区域是否足够回答查询；若不足，则在最有希望的区域进行目标检测提取细粒度实体，聚类为子区域，构建多级语义层次进行深入探索；当更深区域仍无法获得置信答案时，使用置信度引导回溯机制。
summary_sections.result: 在Visual Probe和HR-Bench两个复杂HR基准上，HEE在准确率和效率上优于ZoomEye和RAP等无训练方法，并在不同MLLM上泛化。
summary_sections.conclusion: HEE是一种训练无关、模型无关的框架，将静态图像理解转化为动态实体探索，有效提升HR感知性能。

papers.title: LRAT-Catcher: Importing SAT Solver Certificates into Lean4 by Reflection
papers.abstract_en: SAT solvers settle combinatorial problems beyond the reach of interactive theorem provers and produce LRAT certificates for independent verification. We present LRAT-Catcher, a standalone, general-purpose tool that imports a DIMACS formula together with an LRAT certificate into Lean 4 as a theorem. LRAT-Catcher runs the formally verified LRAT checker from Lean core as compiled native code via reflection. This scales to instances where Mathlib's explicit proof-term import exhausts memory. LRAT-Catcher also composes cube-and-conquer solving runs entirely inside Lean. Per-cube refutations are combined with a cover-completeness certificate, itself an LRAT proof, into a single unsatisfiability theorem. Verified encodings connect CNF-level results to the original combinatorial problems. We evaluate the tool against Mathlib's proof-term import and the external checker cake_lpr on establishing the Schur number S(4) = 44 and the Ramsey number R(4,4) = 18 as Lean theorems.

TL;DR: 本文介绍 LRAT-Catcher，一个独立的通用工具，将 DIMACS 公式和 LRAT 证书导入 Lean 4 作为定理。它通过反射运行 Lean 核心中形式验证的 LRAT 检查器，可处理 Mathlib 显式证明项导入会耗尽内存的大规模实例，并支持在 Lean 内部组合 cube-and-conquer 求解。评估表明，该工具成功建立了 Schur 数 S(4)=44 和 Ramsey 数 R(4,4)=18 的 Lean 定理。
Motivation: 现有显式证明项导入方法在大型 SAT 实例上会耗尽内存，需要一种可扩展的、经过形式验证的证书导入方式。
Method: LRAT-Catcher 通过反射调用 Lean 核心的形式验证 LRAT 检查器，将 DIMACS 公式与 LRAT 证书组合成 Lean 定理；并支持 cube-and-conquer 求解，将每个子问题的反证与覆盖完备性证书（本身也是 LRAT 证明）合并。
Result: 该工具能够处理 Mathlib 显式导入无法处理的实例，并在 Lean 中成功证明了 Schur 数 S(4)=44 和 Ramsey 数 R(4,4)=18。
Conclusion: LRAT-Catcher 提供了一种可扩展、形式验证的 SAT 证书导入方法，可将组合问题的 CNF 层结果可靠地对应到原始问题。

papers.title: From Pixels to Temporal Correlations: Learning Informative Representations for Reinforcement Learning Pre-training
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised pre-training on large-scale datasets has demonstrated significant potential for improving the sample efficiency and performance of Reinforcement Learning (RL). Given the large-scale action-free internet videos, existing methods utilize single-step transition prediction and image reconstruction to learn representations. However, these methods prefer to preserve large-proportion stationary information in the pixel space, neglecting small but crucial information. To preserve enough information in the representation, it is essential to pay equal attention to each element in videos. Specifically, we propose a temporal correlation space to distinguish each element. For implementation, we introduce the Multi-scale Temporal Contrastive Learning (MTCL) method to model multi-scale temporal correlations separately. This approach can balance the attention of different elements and yield more informative representations, effectively supporting policy learning in various downstream tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that our method improves sample efficiency and asymptotic performance across various downstream tasks.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 8 figures. Accepted by ACM MM 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于时间相关性的无监督预训练方法，用于强化学习（RL）表示学习。现有方法在像素空间中倾向于保留大比例静态信息，而忽略关键的小变化。为此，作者引入多尺度时间对比学习（MTCL）方法，通过建模多尺度时间相关性来平衡不同元素的注意力，从而生成信息更丰富的表示。实验表明，该方法在多个下游任务中提高了样本效率和渐近性能。
Motivation: 现有RL预训练方法在像素空间保留大量静态信息，忽略关键动态信息，导致表示不够充分。需要一种方法能平等关注视频中的每个元素，从而保留足够信息。
Method: 提出时间相关空间以区分每个元素，并引入多尺度时间对比学习（MTCL）方法，分别建模多尺度时间相关性，以平衡不同元素的注意力并生成信息更丰富的表示。
Result: 在多个下游RL任务中，该方法提升了样本效率和渐近性能，表明预训练表示更有效。
Conclusion: 通过多尺度时间对比学习，可以更均衡地关注视频中的动态和静态信息，从而提升RL预训练表示的质量，支持后续策略学习。

papers.title: Local Motion Matters: A Deconstruct-Recompose Paradigm for Reinforcement Learning Pre-training from Videos
papers.abstract_en: Pre-training on large-scale videos to improve reinforcement learning efficiency is promising yet remains challenging. Existing methods typically treat the agent as an indivisible entity, modeling motion patterns globally. Such global modeling is tightly coupled with the morphology, hindering transfer across domains. In contrast, despite the vast disparity in global motions, the local components exhibit similar motion patterns across different agents. Building on this insight, we propose a novel Deconstruct-Recompose Paradigm (DRP) for learning transferable local motion representations. Specifically, in the Deconstruct phase, we identify multiple local points and track their frame-wise motions, defining each as an Atomic Action. We introduce a Dual-Attention Encoder (DAE) to learn local motion representations from these Atomic Actions, capturing their spatiotemporal relationships. In the Recompose phase, we compose local motion representations with a learnable Motion Aggregation Token [MAT] via latent dynamics model learning. Additionally, an adapter bridges local motion and downstream action-specific dynamics to accelerate policy learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method effectively transfers to diverse robotic control and manipulation tasks, significantly improving sample efficiency and performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种解构-重组范式（DRP），用于从视频中学习可迁移的局部运动表征，以提升强化学习的预训练效率。方法包括解构阶段提取局部原子动作并通过双注意力编码器学习表征，重组阶段通过潜在动力学模型和适配器整合局部信息以加速下游策略学习。实验表明该方法在多种机器人控制任务上提升了样本效率和性能。
Motivation: 现有基于视频的强化学习预训练方法通常将智能体视为不可分割的整体，全局建模运动模式，导致与形态紧密耦合，难以跨域迁移。
Method: 提出DRP范式：解构阶段识别多个局部点并跟踪其帧间运动作为原子动作，使用双注意力编码器学习局部运动表征和时空关系；重组阶段通过可学习的运动聚合令牌（MAT）和潜在动力学模型组合局部表征，并利用适配器桥接局部运动与下游动作特定动力学。
Result: 实验表明该方法有效迁移到多种机器人控制和操作任务，显著提升了样本效率和性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调局部运动在跨形态迁移中的重要作用，并验证了所提范式在强化学习预训练中的有效性。

papers.title: Spotted: Location-informed Reidentification of Hyenas and Leopards in Camera Trap Surveys
papers.abstract_en: Animal re-identification (ReID) in camera-trap surveys remains challenging due to low image quality, strong variation in illumination and viewpoint, and highly imbalanced numbers of observations per individual. As a result, current ReID performance is often insufficient for fully automated use, and practical workflows typically depend on expert review of algorithmically proposed candidate matches. Moreover, most existing approaches focus almost exclusively on visual cues and overlook auxiliary information routinely available in field studies, such as image timestamps and camera-trap locations. We introduce Spotted, a location-informed, human-in-the-loop animal ReID framework that integrates visual similarity with spatio-temporal feasibility priors derived from camera locations, thereby reducing the amount of required expert review. Our method (i) computes an image-model-agnostic feasibility score based on the minimum travel speed required for two detections to correspond to the same individual, (ii) uses these feasibility cues as pseudo-supervision to train a lightweight head on top of a frozen visual foundation model, and (iii) fuses adapted visual similarity with spatio-temporal feasibility to obtain a robust pairwise matching score. We additionally integrate an active pair sampling strategy to accelerate annotation by initially prioritizing uncertain predictions. We evaluate Spotted on three challenging camera-trap ReID datasets comprised of spotted hyenas and leopards, which we release as part of this work. Our model improves average top-5 identification accuracy by 9pp, 2pp and 9pp over the best baseline on our LeopardID102, SpottedHyenaID109 and SpottedHyenaID415 datasets, respectively. Further, we show that our human-in-the-loop strategy reduces the number of queried comparisons by up to 69pp while achieving equivalent positive matches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Spotted框架，一种结合位置信息的动物再识别(ReID)方法，利用相机陷阱的位置和时间戳计算时空可行性先验，与视觉相似度融合，减少专家审查工作量。在三个斑鬣狗和豹数据集上，top-5准确率提升2-9个百分点，人工验证查询量减少高达69%。
Motivation: 现有动物ReID方法主要依赖视觉特征，忽略了相机陷阱调查中常有的位置和时间信息，导致自动识别性能不足，仍需大量专家审核。
Method: 提出基于相机位置的最小旅行速度计算可行性分数，作为伪监督训练轻量分类头，融合视觉基础模型特征与时空先验，并采用主动对采样策略优先标注不确定匹配。
Result: 在LeopardID102、SpottedHyenaID109和SpottedHyenaID415数据集上，top-5准确率分别提升9pp、2pp和9pp；人工验证查询量减少69pp时仍达到同等正确匹配数。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，融入位置信息可显著降低动物ReID的人工审核成本，同时保持或提升识别准确性。

papers.title: ClinRAG-GRAPH: Clinical-prior Retrieval-Augmented Graph Model with Domain Adversarial Learning for Breast pCR Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC) response prediction is clinically important for treatment stratification in breast cancer. However, robust pre-treatment pathological complete response (pCR) prediction remains challenging due to insufficient cross-modal modeling, multicenter imaging heterogeneity, and weak evidence-grounded interpretability. We propose ClinRAG-GRAPH, a Clinically informed Retrieval-Augmented Generation Graph framework, for pre-treatment pCR prediction from DCE-MRI, structured clinical variables, and biopsy-derived pathological biomarkers. ClinRAG-GRAPH constructs an intra-patient clinical-prior graph and applies a prior-guided relation-aware graph convolutional network for structured multimodal representation learning. To improve cross-center robustness, we introduce a dual-branch domain-adversarial learning strategy to suppress protocol-related MRI bias while preserving pCR-relevant features. To enhance interpretability, we further incorporate large language model (LLM)-driven subgraph RAG module that retrieves clinically analogous historical cases and integrates retrieved evidence for pCR inference. We assemble a large-scale multicenter NAC breast cancer cohort for extensive validation, drawing from two public sources and three in-house centers.Results show that ClinRAG-GRAPH achieves AUCs of 0.815 on the internal test set and 0.774/0.712 on two external test sets, demonstrating robust pre-treatment pCR prediction across centers. The code is available at the anonymized https://github.com/miccai26-1181/ClinRAG-GRAPH.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ClinRAG-GRAPH 框架，利用 DCE-MRI、结构化临床变量和活检病理生物标志物进行乳腺癌新辅助化疗前病理完全缓解预测。该框架构建患者内部临床先验图，采用先验引导的关系感知图卷积网络进行多模态表示学习，并通过双分支域对抗学习抑制 MRI 协议相关偏差，同时引入大语言模型驱动的子图检索增强生成模块以提升可解释性。在大型多中心数据集上验证，内部测试集 AUC 达 0.815，两个外部测试集 AUC 分别为 0.774 和 0.712。
Motivation: 新辅助化疗反应预测对乳腺癌治疗分层至关重要，但现有方法面临跨模态建模不足、多中心成像异质性和弱证据可解释性等挑战。
Method: 构建患者内部临床先验图，使用先验引导的关系感知图卷积网络进行结构化多模态表示学习；采用双分支域对抗学习策略抑制协议相关 MRI 偏差；引入大语言模型驱动的子图检索增强生成模块，检索历史相似病例并整合证据进行 pCR 推断。
Result: 在内部测试集上 AUC 0.815，两个外部测试集上 AUC 分别为 0.774 和 0.712，表明跨中心鲁棒的 pCR 预测性能。
Conclusion: ClinRAG-GRAPH 通过结合临床先验图、域对抗学习和检索增强生成，能够提升多中心 pCR 预测的准确性和可解释性。

papers.title: Task-Relevant Representation Decoupling for Visual Reinforcement Learning Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Visual Reinforcement Learning (VRL) has achieved considerable success in solving control tasks. However, generalizing learned policies to new environments remains a major challenge, as agents often overfit to task-irrelevant features in the training environment. To solve this problem, we introduce the concept of decoupling observations into task-relevant and task-irrelevant representations. Building on this idea, we propose a self-supervised Task-Relevant Representation Decoupling (T2RD) algorithm for VRL. This algorithm consists of three components: task-relevant representation consistency, cross-reconstruction, and cross-dynamic prediction. The first two components achieve the decoupling of content and style features, but the resulting content representations are not necessarily task-relevant. To further refine task-relevant features from content representations, we design the third component that introduces dynamic prediction. T2RD achieves State-Of-The-Art (SOTA) generalization performance and sample efficiency in the DeepMind Control Suite and Robotic Manipulation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉强化学习（VRL）中策略泛化困难的问题，提出任务相关表示解耦（T2RD）算法。该算法通过自监督方式将观测分解为任务相关和任务无关表示，包含三个组件：任务相关表示一致性、交叉重建和交叉动态预测。在DeepMind Control Suite和机器人操作任务上，T2RD达到了当前最优的泛化性能和样本效率。
Motivation: 视觉强化学习代理常过拟合训练环境中的任务无关特征，导致在新环境中泛化能力差。
Method: 提出T2RD算法，包括三个部分：任务相关表示一致性（维持不同风格下的相同内容）、交叉重建（重建原始观测）、交叉动态预测（基于内容表示预测动态，确保任务相关性）。
Result: 在DeepMind Control Suite和机器人操作任务的多个泛化场景中，T2RD取得了最新的最优（SOTA）泛化性能和样本效率。
Conclusion: T2RD通过自监督解耦任务相关与无关表示，有效提升了VRL在视觉变化下的泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Which Metric Reflects the Spelling Rate Accuracy in Event-Related Potential-Based Brain-Computer Interfaces?
papers.abstract_en: For predictive models, the often-reported performance metrics are the loss and accuracy. In synchronous Brain- Computer Interface (BCI) systems, these metrics are informative for most BCI paradigms; however, for Event-Related Potential (ERP) applications the spelling rate, which measures the number of characters correctly selected is more important as it influences the estimation of information transfer rate (ITR) and any related metric measuring spelling performance. Moreover, ERP-based BCIs hold imbalanced data class distributions, which require reporting metrics that can handle the imbalance, such as the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC AUC). In this work, we study the correlation of the spelling rate with 13 metrics to identify which among them best reflect user spelling performance and how they are affected by trial repetition. The Results of two datasets (a private LARESI ERP dataset and the public OpenBMI ERP dataset) favor the Brier score, Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC), and the metrics that account for class imbalance in binary classification: ROC AUC, area under the Precision-Recall curve (PR AUC), Average Precision (AP), and partial AUC (pAUC). These findings encourage researchers and practitioners to report those metrics in ERP-based BCI experiments.
papers.comment: paper is accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Metrology for eXtended Reality, Artificial Intelligence and Neural Engineering - IEEE MetroXRAINE 2026, Chemnitz, Germany
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在基于事件相关电位（ERP）的脑机接口（BCI）中，哪些性能指标与拼写率（spelling rate）最相关。通过在两个数据集（私有LARESI ERP数据集和公共OpenBMI ERP数据集）上分析13个指标，发现Brier分数、马修斯相关系数（MCC）、ROC AUC、PR AUC、平均精度（AP）和部分AUC（pAUC）与拼写率相关性最高，并能处理类别不平衡问题。建议研究者在ERP-BCI实验中优先报告这些指标。
Motivation: 同步BCI系统中常用的损失和准确率指标对拼写率不敏感，而拼写率直接影响信息传输率（ITR）和拼写性能评估。ERP数据存在类别不平衡，需要能处理不平衡的指标。
Method: 通过计算13种常用性能指标与拼写率之间的相关性，并在两个数据集上验证，评估各指标对用户拼写性能的反映程度。
Result: Brier分数、MCC、ROC AUC、PR AUC、AP和pAUC与拼写率高度相关，且对类别不平衡鲁棒。
Conclusion: 研究人员应报告上述指标以准确评估ERP-BCI的拼写性能，尤其是在类别不平衡条件下。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LeVLJEPA: End-to-End Vision-Language Pretraining Without Negatives
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language pretraining remains dominated by contrastive objectives, whereas vision-only self-supervised learning has largely adopted non-contrastive methods. At the same time, the role of vision-language encoders has shifted: they are increasingly deployed not as zero-shot classifiers but as the frozen visual backbone of vision-language models and dense prediction systems, which consume the full grid of patch tokens rather than a single pooled embedding. We introduce LeVLJEPA, the first fully non-contrastive end-to-end vision-language pretraining method. LeVLJEPA learns through cross-modal prediction with stop-gradient targets and per-modality distributional regularization, without negatives, temperature, momentum encoder, or teacher-student schedule, and trains stably at large scale. We find that the resulting encoder provides markedly stronger dense semantic features for downstream use: as a frozen vision-language-model backbone, LeVLJEPA is the strongest of the evaluated encoders across GQA, VQAv2, and POPE under two distinct language models, and outperforms contrastive baselines on semantic segmentation, while remaining on par on global readouts such as linear probing. These results establish non-contrastive pretraining as an effective means of producing dense semantic vision features.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LeVLJEPA，首个完全非对比学习的端到端视觉-语言预训练方法。该方法通过跨模态预测、停止梯度目标和逐模态分布正则化进行训练，无需负样本、温度参数、动量编码器或师生调度，在大规模训练下保持稳定。结果表明，作为冻结的视觉-语言模型骨干，LeVLJEPA在GQA、VQAv2和POPE等下游任务上优于对比基线，在语义分割上表现更好，同时在全局读入任务（如线性探测）上持平。这确立了非对比预训练作为生成密集语义视觉特征的有效手段。
Motivation: 对比学习主导了视觉-语言预训练，而视觉自监督学习已广泛采用非对比方法。同时，视觉-语言编码器的角色已从零样本分类器转变为视觉-语言模型和密集预测系统的冻结视觉骨干，这些系统消耗完整的patch token网格而非单个池化嵌入。现有对比方法在处理密集特征时存在局限。
Method: 提出非对比端到端预训练，通过跨模态预测（使用停止梯度目标）和逐模态分布正则化进行学习，无需负样本、温度、动量编码器或师生训练安排，且在大规模下稳定训练。
Result: 作为冻结视觉骨干，LeVLJEPA在两个不同语言模型下，在GQA、VQAv2和POPE上强于所有评估的编码器；在语义分割上优于对比基线，在全局读入（如线性探测）上持平。
Conclusion: 非对比预训练是产生密集语义视觉特征的有效方法，尤其适用于作为视觉-语言模型的冻结骨干。

papers.title: SpiralFovea: Input-Adaptive Foveated Tokenization as a Third Lever of Resource-Adaptive Inference
papers.abstract_en: Most adaptive-inference techniques for foundation models change what the model does - early exit, MoE routing, KV-cache compression, dynamic attention sparsity. The input that hits the backbone, however, remains a fixed-grid tokenisation indifferent to image content. We argue that this is a missed lever. We present SpiralFovea, a parameter-free, input-adaptive tokeniser in which token identity, location, scale, and count are all functions of local visual entropy and selection completes before any backbone parameter is queried. Around content-driven hotspot anchors, multi-scale spiral rings produce <= 78 patches that replace the standard 196-patch ViT grid at the input stage. Across four canonical fine-grained benchmarks, SpiralFovea yields +1.7-2.1 pp accuracy with a 60% reduction in input tokens, an 84% reduction in self-attention FLOPs at every transformer layer, and 18-29% throughput gains over the matched static tokenisation baseline. A controlled ablation on CUB-200-2011 Genus across four backbones reveals a clean diagnostic: the gain magnitude tracks inversely with the strength of the backbone's whole-image positional prior, isolating self-supervised foundation models as the regime where input-adaptive tokenisation is most valuable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpiralFovea 是一种无需参数的、输入自适应的 tokenizer，根据局部视觉熵动态决定 token 的身份、位置、尺度和数量，在输入阶段用 ≤78 个多尺度螺旋环 patch 替代 ViT 标准的 196 个固定网格 patch。在四个细粒度基准上，该方法在减少 60% 输入 token、每层 self-attention FLOPs 降低 84% 的同时，准确率提升 1.7-2.1 个百分点，吞吐量提升 18-29%。消融实验表明，增益大小与 backbone 的全图位置先验强度成反比，在自监督基础模型上最为显著。
Motivation: 现有自适应推理技术通常改变模型内部结构（如早退、MoE 路由、KV 缓存压缩），但输入到 backbone 的 token 仍然是固定网格的，不随图像内容变化。作者认为这遗漏了一个可利用的杠杆。
Method: 提出 SpiralFovea，一种无需参数的输入自适应 tokenizer：基于局部视觉熵确定热点锚点，围绕锚点生成多尺度螺旋环 patch，token 数量、位置和尺度均由内容驱动，且在 backbone 参数调用前完成选择。
Result: 在四个细粒度基准上，相比静态 tokenization 基线，准确率提升 1.7-2.1 个百分点，输入 token 减少 60%，每层 self-attention FLOPs 降低 84%，吞吐量提升 18-29%。在 CUB-200-2011 Genus 上的消融实验表明，增益大小与 backbone 的全图位置先验强度成反比。
Conclusion: 输入自适应 tokenization 是资源自适应推理中一个有效的新维度，尤其对自监督基础模型价值最大。

papers.title: Evaluating Pretrained Music Embeddings for Cross-Performance Jazz Standard Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Recognizing jazz standards from audio is a challenging form of tune-level music retrieval: different performances of the same standard may vary in tempo, key, arrangement, instrumentation, improvisational content, and even whether the head melody is present. We study this problem using a curated subset of the Jazz Trio Database designed for cross-performance standard recognition. We compare a from-scratch trained Harmonic CNN baseline against frozen pretrained music representations from recent music understanding foundation models, using both supervised probing and nearest-neighbor retrieval. Our results suggest that from-scratch spectrogram models overfit strongly to training performances, while pretrained embeddings provide better top-$k$ results but are sensitive to performer identity, which can be partially reduced with a lightweight contrastive projection. Our findings motivate jazz standard recognition as a useful stress test for music representation models and as a step toward retrieval-based standard identification. Project page: https://github.com/cagries/tipofmyear.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Accepted to the ICML 2026 Workshop on Machine Learning for Audio
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从音频中识别爵士乐标准曲目（jazz standard）的跨演奏检索问题。使用Jazz Trio Database的子集，对比了从头训练的Harmonic CNN与冻结的预训练音乐表示（通过监督探测和最近邻检索），发现预训练嵌入在top-k结果上更好，但对演奏者身份敏感，可通过轻量对比投影减轻。
Motivation: 爵士标准曲的跨演奏识别是困难的音乐检索任务：不同演奏在速度、调性、编曲、即兴内容等方面差异大。现有方法可能过拟合特定演奏，需更强的表示。
Method: 使用Jazz Trio Database子集，比较从头训练的Harmonic CNN基线、冻结的预训练音乐表示（监督探测和最近邻检索），以及轻量对比投影。
Result: 从头训练的频谱图模型对训练演奏过拟合严重；预训练嵌入在top-k结果上更优，但对演奏者身份敏感，对比投影可部分缓解此问题。
Conclusion: 爵士标准曲识别可作为音乐表示模型的压力测试，并推动基于检索的标准识别。

papers.title: Soft Mixture-of-Recursions: Going Deeper with Recursive Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Recent recursive Transformer studies have primarily reused shared parameters across computation steps to construct compact, parameter-efficient models. In this work, we leverage recursion to build effectively deeper Transformers with stronger representational capacity. However, in Vision Transformers, simply increasing recursion depth does not reliably improve performance, as existing recursive approaches do not fully utilize the intermediate representations produced throughout recursive computation. We propose Soft Mixture-of-Recursions (SoftMoR) and its Vision Transformer instantiation, Soft Recursive Vision Transformer (SR-ViT). SoftMoR learns token-wise mixture weights to softly combine outputs from all recursion steps, allowing intermediate representations to be utilized in a learnable and flexible way. Across diverse vision tasks, SR-ViT consistently improves as recursion depth increases with minimal parameter overhead. On ImageNet-1K, increasing recursion depth from 1 to 4 improves SR-ViT-S top-1 accuracy from 79.83% to 82.48% with only 1.7M additional parameters, outperforming the substantially larger DeiT-B while using approximately 27% of its parameters. These results demonstrate that SoftMoR provides a parameter-efficient path to deeper and stronger Vision Transformers through recursion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Soft Mixture-of-Recursions (SoftMoR) 及其 Vision Transformer 实例化 SR-ViT，通过学习 token 级别的混合权重，软组合所有递归步骤的输出，使得增加递归深度能持续提升性能。在 ImageNet-1K 上，SR-ViT-S 在递归深度从 1 增加到 4 时，top-1 准确率从 79.83% 提升至 82.48%，仅增加 1.7M 参数，性能超越参数规模大得多的 DeiT-B。
Motivation: 现有递归方法未能充分利用递归计算产生的中间表示，导致简单增加递归深度无法可靠提升性能。
Method: 提出 SoftMoR，为每个 token 学习可微的混合权重，以软方式组合所有递归步骤的输出，使中间表示得到灵活利用。
Result: 在 ImageNet-1K 上，SR-ViT-S 递归深度从 1 增至 4 时，top-1 准确率提升 2.65 个百分点（79.83%→82.48%），仅增加 1.7M 参数，且以约 27% 的参数达到优于 DeiT-B 的性能。
Conclusion: SoftMoR 提供了一种参数高效的路径，通过递归构建更深且更强的 Vision Transformer。

summary_sections.method: 提出 SoftMoR，为每个 token 学习可微的混合权重，以软方式组合所有递归步骤的输出，使中间表示得到灵活利用。

summary_sections.conclusion: SoftMoR 提供了一种参数高效的路径，通过递归构建更深且更强的 Vision Transformer。

papers.title: Accelerating Discrete Diffusion Models with Parallel-In-Time Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Discrete diffusion models are widely used for learning and generating discrete distributions. As the generation process is inherently sequential, the acceleration of sampling is of significant importance. In this work, we parallelize the mainstream $τ$-leaping algorithm for absorbing discrete diffusion in a Continuous-Time Markov Chain (CTMC) framework. By leveraging the continuous-time stochastic integral form of the $τ$-leaping algorithm and the Picard iteration method, we achieve parallel-in-time sampling acceleration and provide a proof of exponential-factorial convergence for our algorithm. We improve the overall time complexity of $τ$-leaping under absorbing settings from ${\mathcal{O}}(d \log S)$ to ${\mathcal{O}}(\log (d\log S)\cdot \log d)$ with respect to NFE. Empirically, our method shows consistent acceleration across synthetic and real-data settings. The new sampler achieves at most $7$--$9\times$ runtime speedup for synthetic distribution, and maintains the same quality with $50\%$ fewer NFE and $1.45$--$1.86\times$ runtime speedups in image/text tasks on a single GPU. Our research expands the potential of discrete diffusion models for efficient parallel inference, with broader implications for applications such as molecular structure and language generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种并行时间采样方法加速离散扩散模型的生成过程，基于连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）框架下的τ-leaping算法，利用Picard迭代实现并行化，并在吸收设置下将时间复杂度从O(d log S)降低到O(log(d log S)·log d)。实验表明，该方法在合成数据上获得7-9倍加速，在图像/文本任务中以50%更少的NFE保持了相同质量，并取得1.45-1.86倍运行时加速。
Motivation: 离散扩散模型的采样本质上是顺序的，加速采样对于实际应用至关重要。
Method: 将τ-leaping算法与Picard迭代相结合，在CTMC框架下实现并行时间采样，并给出了指数阶乘收敛的证明。
Result: 在吸收设置下时间复杂度从O(d log S)降至O(log(d log S)·log d)；合成数据上实现7-9倍加速，图像/文本任务上NFE减少50%，运行时加速1.45-1.86倍。
Conclusion: 该方法扩展了离散扩散模型在并行推理中的潜力，对分子结构和语言生成等应用具有广泛意义。

papers.title: Decoupled Guidance: Disentangling Subject and Context Pathways in Text-to-Image Personalization
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image personalization aims to generate a user-provided subject in novel scenes described by text. However, most existing methods encode subject identity (fidelity) and context (editability) through the same conditioning pathway, forcing the two to compete for attention-map resources. We refer to this phenomenon as conditioning entanglement and show that it induces a fidelity-editability trade-off. We further provide causal evidence by replacing the target subject token with a generic subject token, which produces shifts in attention allocation and corresponding changes in context adherence. To this end, we propose Decoupled Guidance (DeGu), a plug-and-play framework that routes subject identity and scene context through two independent guidance streams. We further introduce a spatial mixing mechanism that dynamically fuses these streams, ensuring each operates within its semantically relevant region without interference. Furthermore, DeGu can be readily applied to existing personalization methods without modifying the underlying backbone models, consistently improving the overall personalization performance while enabling inference-time control over the fidelity-editability balance, across diverse methods and backbones, including flow-matching Diffusion Transformers (DiTs).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文本到图像个性化中主体身份与场景上下文通过同一条件路径编码导致的忠实性-可编辑性权衡问题，提出解耦引导（DeGu）框架。DeGu将主体和上下文路由到两个独立的引导流中，并通过空间混合机制动态融合，确保两者在语义相关区域互不干扰。该框架即插即用，可应用于现有个性化方法，包括流匹配扩散Transformer，在不修改骨干模型的情况下提升整体性能并支持推理时平衡控制。
Motivation: 现有方法通过同一条件路径同时编码主体身份和场景上下文，导致注意力图资源竞争，产生忠实性-可编辑性权衡。
Method: 提出DeGu框架，采用两个独立的引导流分别处理主体身份和场景上下文，并引入空间混合机制动态融合这两个流，使其在各自语义相关区域独立运作。
Result: DeGu可即插即用于多种现有个性化方法和骨干模型（包括流匹配DiTs），在保持性能的同时提升整体个性化效果，并支持推理时调整忠实性-可编辑性平衡。
Conclusion: DeGu通过解耦引导流有效缓解了忠实性与可编辑性之间的冲突，是一种无需修改基础模型的通用解决方案。

papers.title: Forensic-Oriented Intrusion Detection Using Synthetic Network Traffic Data and Explainable Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Digital forensic investigations of network intrusions require analytical outputs that are traceable, reproducible, and court-defensible - requirements existing machine learning pipelines do not satisfy, since they treat original evidence as training data and produce opaque classifications without instance-level justification. This paper presents a forensic-oriented intrusion detection framework resolving both problems simultaneously, integrating synthetic data generation, binary classification, and explainability within a single pipeline governed by ISO/IEC 27037, 27041, 27042, and NIST SP 800-86. The framework operationalises the ISO/IEC 27037 requirement for strict separation between original digital evidence and derived analytical artefacts. Original datasets are treated as immutable, hash-verified artefacts; all training operates on parameterized synthetic derivatives via SDV + CTGAN. XGBoost binary classification provides high-performance detection on tabular network flow data, and SHAP TreeExplainer produces instance-level feature attributions mapping statistical predictions to observable network behaviour for forensic reporting. Train-on-Synthetic, Test-on-Real (TSTR) evaluation on CICIDS2017 achieves F1-macro = 0.96, within cross-validation variance of the real-data baseline (0.97). Kolmogorov-Smirnov testing confirms synthetic privacy preservation (mean |KS| = 0.38) alongside operational utility. Cross-dataset validation on UNSW-NB15 and Kitsune identifies feature space dimensionality as the primary determinant of synthetic training effectiveness, establishing a practical deployment boundary of approximately 30 numeric flow-level features. SHAP attributions for Brute Force, Port Scan, and DoS attacks are consistent across real and synthetic instances, confirming synthetic training preserves forensically relevant attack fingerprints required for expert witness testimony.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向数字取证的入侵检测框架，集成合成数据生成、XGBoost二分类和SHAP可解释性，遵守ISO/IEC 27037等取证标准。通过SDV+CTGAN生成合成数据，在CICIDS2017上达到F1-macro=0.96，接近真实数据基线，且SHAP归因保留了攻击指纹。
Motivation: 现有机器学习入侵检测管道不满足数字取证对可追溯、可复现和法庭可辩护的要求，且原始证据被用于训练，分类缺乏实例级解释。
Method: 采用SDV+CTGAN生成参数化合成数据，严格分离原始证据与分析产物；使用XGBoost进行二分类，并用SHAP TreeExplainer提供实例级特征归因。
Result: TSTR评估在CICIDS2017上F1-macro=0.96（真实数据基线0.97）；KS检验证明合成数据隐私保留（平均|KS|=0.38）；跨数据集验证表明特征维度约30维是有效边界。
Conclusion: 合成训练能保持取证相关的攻击指纹，适用于专家证人证词，但有效性受特征空间维度限制。

papers.title: MosaicKV: Serving Long-Context LLM with Dynamic Two-D KV Cache Compression
papers.abstract_en: Long-context LLM services now sustain prompts with hundreds of thousands to millions of tokens, making the key-value (KV) cache a first-order serving cost. Because the cache grows linearly with context length, it can exhaust GPU memory, force smaller batches, and reduce serving throughput. Prior KV cache compression techniques typically target only the sequence dimension or only the channel dimension, which leaves limited headroom as context windows scale. Compressing both dimensions promises higher memory reduction, but applying the two forms of compression directly leads to significant accuracy loss. This paper introduces MosaicKV, a dynamic two-D (dimensional) KV cache compression system for extremely long-context serving. MosaicKV uses dynamic two-D compression to address the accuracy challenge, exploiting the non-uniform importance distribution of elements within the KV cache. Instead of applying one compression pattern globally, MosaicKV identifies important elements for each KV vector and selects compression strategies at the granularity of KV cache segments. To address the performance challenge, where fine-grained sparsity and compression management overhead can offset the gains from compression, MosaicKV introduces compressed KV cache management. This mechanism uses underutilized GPU and CPU resources to maintain compressed KV caches and accelerate attention computation. Evaluation on an H800 GPU with multiple LLMs shows that MosaicKV delivers up to 16x attention speedup, 4.8x lower decode latency, and 7.3x higher throughput than the uncompressed baseline. At the same time, it reduces memory usage by 3x and incurs only 1.76% average accuracy loss on LongBench and RULER.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MosaicKV，一个面向超长上下文 LLM 服务的动态二维 KV 缓存压缩系统。现有方法通常只压缩序列维度或通道维度，而直接联合压缩两者会导致精度显著下降。MosaicKV 根据 KV 缓存元素的重要性分布，在 KV 向量和段粒度动态选择压缩策略，并通过未充分利用的 GPU/CPU 资源管理压缩缓存以加速注意力计算。在 H800 GPU 上，相比未压缩基线，MosaicKV 实现最高 16 倍注意力加速、4.8 倍解码延迟降低、7.3 倍吞吐提升，内存减少 3 倍，平均精度损失仅 1.76%。
Motivation: 长上下文 LLM 的 KV 缓存随上下文长度线性增长，会耗尽 GPU 内存、迫使批次变小并降低服务吞吐。现有压缩技术仅针对序列或通道单维度，联合压缩两个维度会导致明显精度损失。
Method: 提出动态二维压缩系统 MosaicKV：利用 KV 缓存元素非均匀重要性分布，在每个 KV 向量中识别重要元素，并在 KV 缓存段粒度选择压缩策略；引入压缩 KV 缓存管理机制，利用未充分利用的 GPU 和 CPU 资源维护压缩缓存并加速注意力计算。
Result: 在 H800 GPU 上，MosaicKV 相比未压缩基线实现最高 16 倍注意力加速、4.8 倍解码延迟降低、7.3 倍吞吐提升，内存减少 3 倍，在 LongBench 和 RULER 上平均精度损失仅 1.76%。
Conclusion: MosaicKV 通过动态二维压缩有效解决长上下文 KV 缓存的内存瓶颈，在保持高精度的同时显著提升服务性能。

papers.title: GKDT: General Keypoint Detection Transformer
papers.abstract_en: With the emergence of various pre-trained vision and language models, computer vision is shifting from narrow-domain to open-domain recognition. The construction of a more powerful yet general keypoint detection (GKD) model to support diverse tasks has become increasingly important in the field. To this end, we firstly present a large-scale unified keypoint dataset called MegaKPT. The dataset is composed of over 1.3 million diverse object instances from twenty-nine existing datasets, and enjoys high-quality unified annotations with keypoint text descriptions. Based on MegaKPT, we develop GKDT, a simple, flexible and powerful DINOv3 based Transformer model for General Keypoint Detection. Our GKDT supports visual prompts, text prompts, or both. To enhance model training, we also propose a suite of useful strategies such as mix-modal prompted training and dynamic importance sampling. By testing over 22 test sets with seen or unseen objects, our single GKDT model shows strong performance and generality in detecting keypoints on broad categories, with most categories over 90\% PCK@0.1 accuracy, offering high practical applicability to real-world problems. The dataset, models, and codes will be released at https://github.com/AlanLuSun/General-Keypoint-Detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个大规模统一关键点数据集MegaKPT（包含130万个实例和文本描述），并基于DINOv3开发了通用关键点检测Transformer模型GKDT，支持视觉和文本提示。在22个测试集上，大多数类别的PCK@0.1准确率超过90%，展示了在广泛类别上的强泛化能力。
Motivation: 随着预训练模型的发展，计算机视觉正转向开放域识别，但缺乏统一的、大规模的关键点数据集和通用检测模型来支持多样任务。
Method: 构建MegaKPT数据集（29个现有数据集，130万实例，统一标注和文本描述）；提出GKDT模型（基于DINOv3 Transformer），支持视觉/文本提示；采用混合模态提示训练和动态重要性采样等策略增强训练。
Result: 在22个测试集（含未见类别）上，大多数类别的PCK@0.1准确率超过90%。
Conclusion: GKDT在通用关键点检测上表现出强性能和实用性，数据集和代码将开源。

papers.title: FrameONE: Hierarchical Motion Modeling for Universal Multi-View Echocardiographic Keyframe Detection
papers.abstract_en: Accurate detection of end-systole (ES) and end-diastole (ED) frames is fundamental to echocardiographic assessment. Existing methods are typically developed in a view-specific manner, depend on auxiliary annotations or intensive visual modeling, which limits their generalizability. In multi-view modeling, keyframe detection is driven by shared cardiac motion, yet large appearance differences and motion patterns make unified modeling challenging. To address these issues, we propose FrameONE, a unified end-to-end framework for multi-view echocardiographic keyframe detection. FrameONE introduces a Hierarchical Motion Modeling strategy: an intra-view multi-task learning reduces appearance bias and promotes motion-focused representations within each view; an inter-view general motion learning module further separates view-agnostic dynamics from view-specific patterns, enabling shared yet flexible motion representation learning across views. Extensive experiments on 25,872 videos spanning four standard views demonstrate that FrameONE achieves state-of-the-art keyframe detection accuracy with strong cross-view generalization. Code is available at https://github.com/szuboy/FrameONE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FrameONE，一个统一的多视图超声心动图关键帧检测框架。通过层次化运动建模策略，包括视图内多任务学习减少外观偏差和视图间通用运动学习分离视图无关与特有运动模式，在25,872个视频四个标准视图上取得了最先进的检测精度和强跨视图泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有方法多为视图特定，依赖辅助标注或密集视觉建模，泛化性差；多视图建模中，关键帧检测由共享心脏运动驱动，但外观差异和运动模式使统一建模困难。
Method: 提出层次化运动建模：视图内多任务学习减少外观偏差并促进运动聚焦表示；视图间通用运动学习模块分离视图无关动态与视图特有模式，实现共享且灵活的运动表示学习。
Result: 在25,872个视频、四个标准视图上，FrameONE达到了最先进的关键帧检测精度，并展示了强跨视图泛化能力。
Conclusion: FrameONE通过层次化运动建模实现了多视图超声心动图关键帧检测的统一框架，有效解决了外观差异和运动模式多样性问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Active Learning for Cascaded Object Detection: Balancing Coverage and Uncertainty in Table Extraction Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: Table extraction from business documents relies on a cascaded pipeline where Table Detection (TD) first localizes tables and Table Structure Recognition (TSR) then recovers their internal layout. Building task-specific training sets for this pipeline is costly, particularly for TSR which requires fine-grained structural annotations. Active learning (AL) can reduce this annotation burden, yet most AL strategies are designed for single-model tasks and do not account for inter-stage dependencies in cascaded architectures. In this work, we present the first adaptation of Uncertainty Herding (UHerding), a hybrid coverage-uncertainty sampling method originally proposed for image classification, to cascaded object detection pipelines. We propose two pipeline-aware extensions that exploit the TD-to-TSR dependency: RankFusion adds dual-manifold coverage over both detection and structure representation spaces, while CAPA further incorporates stage-dependent gating and per-task uncertainty calibration. Extensive experiments across two public (PubTables-1M and FinTabNet) and two private table extraction datasets, with various annotation budgets (from 71 to 500 documents) show that UHerding generalizes well to table extraction, outperforming each baseline. Among pipeline-aware variants, RankFusion achieves higher expected gains but at the cost of greater variance, while CAPA emerges as the most consistent strategy, outperforming standard UHerding on three out of four datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次将不确定性采样方法UHerding（混合覆盖-不确定性采样）从图像分类适配到级联目标检测流水线，特别是表格提取中的表格检测（TD）和表格结构识别（TSR）两个阶段。作者提出两种流水线感知扩展：RankFusion（双流形覆盖）和CAPA（阶段门控+任务不确定性校准）。实验在四个数据集（PubTables-1M、FinTabNet及两个私有数据集）上，使用不同标注预算（71-500文档），表明UHerding在表格提取中表现良好，其中CAPA在四个数据集中三个上优于标准UHerding，且方差更低。
Motivation: 表格提取依赖于级联流水线（TD→TSR），然而主动学习方法大多针对单任务设计，未考虑阶段间依赖。TSR需要细粒度结构标注，标注成本高，亟需能利用级联依赖关系的主动采样策略。
Method: 将UHerding（覆盖-不确定性混合采样）从图像分类扩展到级联目标检测，并提出RankFusion（在检测和结构表示空间上增加双流形覆盖）和CAPA（增加阶段门控和逐任务不确定性校准）。
Result: 实验表明UHerding在表格提取中优于各基线；RankFusion预期增益更大但方差较高；CAPA最稳定，在三个数据集上优于标准UHerding。
Conclusion: 本文首次证明UHerding可有效适配级联目标检测流水线，并表明考虑阶段依赖的主动学习能在保持稳定性的同时提升性能。

papers.title: GaussianFusion: Unified 3D Gaussian Representation for Multi-Modal Fusion Perception
papers.abstract_en: The bird's-eye view (BEV) representation enables multi-sensor features to be fused within a unified space, serving as the primary approach for achieving comprehensive 3D perception. However, the discrete grid representation of BEV leads to significant detail loss and limits feature alignment and cross-modal information interaction in multimodal fusion perception. In this work, we break from the conventional BEV paradigm and propose a new universal framework for multi-modal fusion based on 3D Gaussian representation. This approach naturally unifies multi-modal features within a shared and continuous 3D Gaussian space, effectively preserving edge and fine texture details. To achieve this, we design a novel forward-projection-based multi-modal Gaussian initialization module and a shared cross-modal Gaussian encoder that iteratively updates Gaussian properties based on an attention mechanism. GaussianFusion is inherently a task-agnostic model, with its unified Gaussian representation naturally supporting various 3D perception tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate the generality and robustness of GaussianFusion. On the nuScenes dataset, it outperforms the 3D object detection baseline BEVFusion by 2.6 NDS. Its variant surpasses GaussFormer on 3D semantic occupancy with 1.55 mIoU improvement while using only 30% of the Gaussians and achieving a 450% speedup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GaussianFusion，一种基于 3D 高斯表示的多模态融合感知通用框架，替代传统的 BEV 栅格表示。通过前向投影初始化模块和跨模态高斯注意力编码器，统一多模态特征在连续 3D 高斯空间中，保留细节并支持多种 3D 感知任务。在 nuScenes 数据集上，3D 目标检测 NDS 比 BEVFusion 提升 2.6，语义占用变体相比 GaussFormer 在仅 30% 高斯数量下 mIoU 提升 1.55 且加速 450%。
Motivation: BEV 表示采用离散栅格导致细节损失和跨模态对齐困难，限制了多模态融合感知的性能；现有方法难以在统一空间中自然融合多传感器特征并保留边缘和纹理细节。
Method: 设计前向投影的多模态高斯初始化模块，将不同模态特征投影到共享 3D 高斯空间；提出共享的跨模态高斯编码器，基于注意力机制迭代更新高斯属性（位置、协方差、颜色等），实现任务无关的连续表示。
Result: 在 nuScenes 上，3D 目标检测 NDS 较 BEVFusion 提升 2.6；语义占用变种较 GaussFormer 仅用 30% 高斯数即获 1.55 mIoU 提升，推理速度提升 450%。
Conclusion: GaussianFusion 作为任务无关框架，通过统一连续 3D 高斯表示有效保留细节，优于基于 BEV 的方法，且高斯数量更少、速度更快，可推广至多种 3D 感知任务。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Foundation Model-driven Key Anatomy Frame Selection for Blind-sweep Ultrasound Fetal Birth Weight Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate fetal birth weight (FBW) estimation shortly before delivery is clinically valuable yet challenging due to its reliance on operator expertise, particularly in low-resource settings. To reduce this reliance, we study near-term birth-weight regression from blind-sweep ultrasound (US) videos acquired within 48 hours prior to delivery, with post-delivery weighing as ground truth. Accordingly, we propose a foundation model-driven key anatomy frame selection framework that enables accurate FBW regression despite the absence of plane constraints in blind sweeps. Our highlights are as follows: (1) We believe this is the first work to estimate FBW using blind-sweep US videos, enabling operator-independent assessment. (2) An Anatomy-Guided Frame Selection module equipped with a vision-language foundation model is proposed for keyframe collection in unconstrained sweeps. (3) A Redundancy-Aware Feature Compression module is designed to compress frame features while preserving task-relevant information, alleviating temporal redundancy. Extensively validated on prospectively collected data from 839 patients, our method achieves an MAE of 161.3 g, with 90.23% and 100% of cases falling within 10% and 15% absolute percentage error, outperforming typical Hadlock estimation and strong competitors. Codes are available at https://github.com/ouleoule/BlindSweep-EBW.
papers.comment: Accepted by MICCAI 2026. 10 pages, 2 figures. Code: https://github.com/ouleoule/BlindSweep-EBW
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次提出利用盲扫超声视频估计胎儿出生体重（FBW），设计了一个基础模型驱动的关键解剖帧选择框架，包括解剖引导帧选择模块（基于视觉-语言基础模型）和冗余感知特征压缩模块。在839名患者的前瞻性数据上，该方法平均绝对误差（MAE）为161.3克，90.23%和100%的病例分别落在10%和15%绝对百分比误差内，优于传统Hadlock估计方法。
Motivation: 准确的FBW估计依赖于操作者经验，尤其在资源匮乏地区。传统方法需要标准平面，而盲扫超声视频无平面约束，但存在帧选择和冗余问题。本文旨在实现操作者无关的FBW估计。
Method: 提出解剖引导帧选择模块，利用视觉-语言基础模型提取关键帧；设计冗余感知特征压缩模块，压缩帧特征并保留任务相关信息。
Result: 在839名患者的前瞻性数据上，MAE为161.3克，90.23%的病例绝对百分比误差≤10%，100%≤15%，表现优于Hadlock估计等基线方法。
Conclusion: 该方法实现了操作者无关的盲扫超声FBW估计，性能优于传统方法，且代码已开源。

papers.title: Prototype Memory-Guided Training-Free Anomaly Classification and Localization in Prenatal Ultrasound
papers.abstract_en: Prenatal anomaly classification and localization is of critical importance for fetal health and pregnancy management. Although ultrasound (US) is the primary modality for prenatal screening, accurate diagnosis remains challenging due to the low prevalence and high heterogeneity of anomalies. Existing deep learning methods for prenatal tasks rely on large-scale annotated datasets, which are difficult to obtain in practice. Although few-shot learning alleviates data scarcity, it typically requires fine-tuning for new categories, limiting its practicality in resource-limited clinical settings. To address these challenges, we propose a training-free framework for multi-class prenatal US anomaly classification and localization that operates with only a few reference images per class, representing the first exploration of this setting. Our framework comprises three key components: (1) a memory bank with multi-granular prototypes that explicitly models both class-level semantics and anomaly characteristics; (2) a prototype-driven soft merging mechanism that aggregates discriminative features to detect the anomaly region; and (3) a class-aware refinement strategy that leverages prototype consistency to improve category prediction. Extensively validated on a multi-center prenatal US dataset containing 1,149 cases, with a total of 2,357 images and 9 categories, our proposed method outperforms the competitors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的产前超声异常分类与定位框架，仅需每类少量参考图像。框架包含多粒度原型记忆库、原型驱动的软融合机制和类别感知精化策略。在包含1149例病例、2357张图像和9个类别的多中心数据集上，该方法优于现有方法。
Motivation: 产前异常分类定位对胎儿健康至关重要，但现有深度学习方法依赖大规模标注数据，小样本学习方法需要微调，限制了临床应用。
Method: 提出训练无关框架，包括多粒度原型记忆库（显式建模类别语义和异常特征）、原型驱动软融合机制（聚合判别特征检测异常区域）和类别感知精化策略（利用原型一致性改进类别预测）。
Result: 在多中心产前超声数据集（1149例病例，2357张图像，9个类别）上，该方法优于对比方法。
Conclusion: 这是首次在训练无关设置下研究多类产前超声异常分类与定位，表明原型记忆驱动的方法有效。

papers.title: Phantom References: Hallucinated Citations That Survive Peer Review at Top-Tier Conferences
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can generate polished scientific text that includes unsupported claims, allowing hallucinations to enter the archival record. Assessing this risk via technical statements is difficult and often requires expert judgment, but citations provide a more auditable surface: a reference either resolves to a real scholarly work with compatible authorship, or it does not. We measure citation hallucination in peer-reviewed proceedings using a conservative definition limited to identity-level failures: non-existent works and substantial author-list mismatches. We explicitly exclude ordinary bibliographic drift (e.g., venue/year differences, publication-status updates, minor name variants). To audit citations at scale, we build RefChecker, a verification pipeline that resolves bibliography entries against multiple bibliographic sources and escalates unresolved cases to web-search re-verification. We apply RefChecker to accepted camera-ready papers from ICLR, ICML, NeurIPS, and USENIX Security. Hallucinated citations have entered the archival record. While reference-level rates are usually below 1%, proceedings are large enough that paper-level failures are visible: in 2025, roughly one in twenty NeurIPS and USENIX Security papers contains at least two likely hallucinated academic-paper-like references under our strict definition. We also observe post-ChatGPT increases in several venues, including a tail of papers with 5+ failures in a single bibliography, and likely hallucinated citations even among award-winning papers. These results suggest peer review alone does not reliably enforce citation integrity, yet auditing is tractable (about 0.04$ per paper in one venue-scale scan). We open-source RefChecker for routine, reproducible citation verification before publication (https://github.com/markrussinovich/refchecker).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文测量了大型语言模型在顶级会议论文中生成的幻觉引用（不存在的引用或作者严重不匹配），构建了RefChecker流水线进行大规模验证。在ICLR、ICML、NeurIPS和USENIX Security的接收论文中检测到幻觉引用，尽管引用级错误率低于1%，但论文级问题显著，如2025年约1/20的NeurIPS和USENIX Security论文包含至少两个疑似幻觉引用。作者还观察到ChatGPT后某些会议幻觉引用的增加，并开源了RefChecker用于常规预发布验证。
Motivation: 大型语言模型生成的学术文本可能包含虚假引用，而同行评审难以全面核查，需要一种可审计的方法来量化这种风险。
Method: 提出RefChecker验证流水线：将参考文献与多个书目源核对，未解决案例进行网页搜索重新验证，并在ICLR、ICML、NeurIPS和USENIX Security的最终接收论文上应用。
Result: 引用级幻觉率低于1%，但论文级问题明显：2025年NeurIPS和USENIX Security中约5%的论文包含至少两个疑似幻觉引用，存在单篇论文有5个以上幻觉引用的尾部现象，甚至获奖论文也有幻觉引用；每篇论文验证成本约0.04美元。
Conclusion: 同行评审不能可靠保证引用完整性，而自动化审计可行且成本低廉；开源RefChecker用于常规预发布引用验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Robust Driving Perception: A Flexible Scale-Driven Family for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE) has garnered attention in recent years due to its independence from ground truth. However, most existing models are limited to a single scale and exhibit considerable performance degradation in complex driving environments. Networks specifically designed to handle dynamic traffic participants tend to be overly complex, hindering their deployment on resource-constrained automotive edge devices. To address these limitations and move towards robust driving perception, we propose FlexDepth, a scale-driven and flexible family of self-supervised MDE models tailored for challenging road scenarios. FlexDepth employs a two-stage static-dynamic decoupled training strategy, enabling the independent assessment of confidence for both static backgrounds and dynamic road objects. Furthermore, it introduces a meticulously designed Scale-Driven Decoder (SDD) to dynamically select components based on scale size, facilitating efficient feature fusion and the output of high-precision depth maps. Extensive experiments on standard driving benchmarks demonstrate that without any auxiliary information, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance across arbitrary scales with minimal computational overhead. Our smallest model, Flex-Nano, requires only 0.7 GFLOPs and achieves 37.6 FPS on mobile platforms, ensuring reliable real-time perception while maintaining excellent zero-shot generalization.Our source code is avalible: https://github.com/startnew/flexdepth
papers.comment: Accepted by ECCV2026. Code is available at https://github.com/startnew/flexdepth
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FlexDepth，一个尺度驱动的自监督单目深度估计模型家族，用于复杂驾驶场景。通过两阶段静态-动态解耦训练策略和尺度驱动解码器（SDD），实现了对静态背景和动态物体的独立置信度评估，并在任意尺度上以最小计算开销达到最先进性能。最小模型Flex-Nano仅需0.7 GFLOPs，在移动平台上达到37.6 FPS，具有良好的零样本泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有自监督单目深度估计模型局限于单一尺度，在复杂驾驶环境中性能下降明显，而针对动态交通参与者的专用网络过于复杂，难以部署在资源受限的汽车边缘设备上。
Method: 提出FlexDepth，采用两阶段静态-动态解耦训练策略，独立评估静态背景和动态物体的置信度；并引入尺度驱动解码器（SDD），根据尺度大小动态选择组件，实现高效特征融合和高精度深度图输出。
Result: 在标准驾驶基准上，无需任何辅助信息，模型在任意尺度上达到最先进性能，且计算开销极小。Flex-Nano仅需0.7 GFLOPs，在移动平台上达到37.6 FPS，零样本泛化性能优异。
Conclusion: FlexDepth通过尺度驱动设计，在保持实时性的同时提高了复杂驾驶场景下的深度估计鲁棒性，适合部署于资源受限的汽车边缘设备。

papers.title: ConRTF: Edge-Constrained Boundary Distribution Refinement for Realtime TransFormer Table Structure Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Table Structure Recognition (TSR) aims to recover the row and column layout of tables from document images, a key step in document understanding pipelines. Accurate TSR depends on precise boundary localization: small errors in row or column boundaries can propagate into incorrect cell assignments and structural inconsistencies. Yet detection-based approaches treat table elements as generic objects, ignoring a fundamental property of table layout: rows and columns play structurally distinct roles and their boundaries carry unequal importance. We propose an Edge-constrained Fine-grained Localization loss (EFL) that formalizes this structural asymmetry by encoding table-specific geometric priors into the training objective: row-like elements are supervised with emphasis on their horizontal boundaries, while column-like elements prioritize vertical boundaries. Implemented within a real-time detector with distribution-based boundary refinement (D-FINE), EFL operates during training only and guides boundary refinement toward structurally meaningful adjustments with no change to the inference pipeline. The proposed approach, ConRTF, is also data-efficient, maintaining robust accuracy with as few as 2k--3k annotated tables. Experiments on PubTables-1M and two private datasets show consistent improvements over the optimized baseline and several real-time detectors including RT-DETRv2 and YOLOv10-11, with gains of up to +1.6 GriTS points at equal inference speed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向实时表格结构识别的边缘约束边界分布精炼方法（ConRTF）。核心贡献是边缘约束细粒度定位损失（EFL），该损失将表格特有的几何先验（行元素强调水平边界、列元素强调垂直边界）编码到训练目标中，在实时检测器D-FINE基础上实现边界精炼，且不改变推理流程。实验表明，在PubTables-1M和两个私有数据集上，ConRTF在相同推理速度下比优化的基线及RT-DETRv2、YOLOv10-11等实时检测器提升最多+1.6 GriTS点，且仅需2000-3000张标注表格即可保持稳健精度。
Motivation: 现有检测方法将表格元素视为通用对象，忽略了行列结构角色的不对称性，导致边界定位误差传播为单元格分配错误和结构不一致。
Method: 提出边缘约束细粒度定位损失（EFL），在训练时对行类元素的水平边界和列类元素的垂直边界施加差异化监督，内嵌于具有分布边界精炼的实时检测器D-FINE中，不修改推理流程。
Result: 在PubTables-1M和两个私有数据集上，ConRTF以相同推理速度比优化基线及RT-DETRv2、YOLOv10-11等实时检测器提升最多+1.6 GriTS点，且仅需2000-3000张标注表格即可达到稳健精度。
Conclusion: EFL通过编码表格几何先验实现了结构感知的边界精炼，在不增加推理开销的前提下提升了表格结构识别的精度和数据效率。

papers.title: LLM-Guided ODE Discovery and Parameter Inference from Small-Cohort Aggregate Data
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic modeling via ordinary differential equations (ODEs) provides interpretable descriptions of complex dynamics and enables inference of underlying mechanisms, which is particularly valuable in clinical settings. However, in rare diseases, both the structure and parameters of the model are typically unknown, while individual-level data is scarce, noisy, heterogeneous, and subject to privacy constraints. In such settings, population-level summary statistics provide a practical privacy-preserving data representation, while capturing heterogeneity further requires modeling parameters as distributions rather than fixed values. Yet no existing method jointly discovers ODE structure and refines parameter distributions solely from summary statistics. We present AgentODE, an end-to-end framework that addresses this gap. An LLM proposes candidate ODE structures, while a tool-augmented inference agent iteratively refines parameter distributions through a diagnosis--update loop, operating on population-level summary statistics alone. We evaluate AgentODE on three benchmark problems across different fields and two clinical datasets, including the rare disease recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (RDEB), with only 231 observations across 46 patients. AgentODE recovers functionally consistent ODE structures across all settings, and experiments on RDEB demonstrates that in sparse and noisy data settings reasoning from summary statistics promotes mechanistically principled structure discovery, whereas baselines with individual-level data access recover implausible structures despite better predictive performance. AgentODE opens new possibilities for mechanistic modeling of rare diseases directly from population-level summary statistics, where data scarcity and privacy constraints have traditionally limited such analyses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AgentODE框架，利用LLM生成候选ODE结构，并通过工具增强的推理代理从群体层面汇总统计量中迭代优化参数分布，实现无需个体数据的ODE结构发现与参数推断。在三个跨领域基准问题和两个临床数据集（包括仅46名患者的罕见病RDEB）上，AgentODE均恢复出功能一致的ODE结构，且在稀疏噪声数据下基于汇总统计的推理促进了更符合机制的发现，而访问个体数据的基线方法虽预测更准但结构不合理。
Motivation: 罕见病中ODE结构与参数未知，个体数据稀缺、噪声大且受隐私限制，现有方法无法仅从群体汇总统计量联合发现ODE结构并推断参数分布。
Method: AgentODE采用LLM提议候选ODE结构，并通过工具增强的推理代理以“诊断-更新”循环迭代优化参数分布，全程仅依赖群体层面的汇总统计量。
Result: 在三个基准问题和两个临床数据集上成功恢复一致ODE结构；RDEB实验中，基于汇总统计的推理得到机制合理的结构，而使用个体数据的基线方法虽预测更优却得到不合理结构。
Conclusion: AgentODE为数据稀缺且受隐私限制的罕见病提供了直接从群体汇总统计量进行机制建模的新途径。

papers.title: AV-SyncBench: Decoupled Benchmarking of Temporal and Semantic Audio-Visual Synchronization
papers.abstract_en: Audio-visual feature extraction is a fundamental component of multimodal understanding and generation tasks. However, existing evaluation protocols for feature extraction models exhibit dimensional bias, typically focusing on either semantic matching or temporal offset detection. Moreover, their data construction remains coupled, preventing independent assessment of temporal and semantic consistency. We propose AV-SyncBench, the first benchmark to fully separate temporal and semantic evaluation for audio-visual synchronization. Built from in-the-wild videos, it spans Voice, Music, and Sound across 10 scenarios and 5 challenge tasks. Data are automatically filtered and manually verified to ensure on-screen sound sources. The benchmark contains 3,269 videos and 38,390 samples, and we evaluate five representative models to quantify feature quality for alignment and downstream tasks. The code and dataset are available at: https://fgt7t6g.github.io/AV-SyncBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 AV-SyncBench，首个完全解耦时间和语义评估的音频-视觉同步基准。基于野外视频构建，覆盖语音、音乐和声音，包含10个场景、5个挑战任务，共3,269个视频和38,390个样本。评估了五个代表性模型的特征质量。
Motivation: 现有音频-视觉特征提取的评估方法存在维度偏差，通常只关注语义匹配或时间偏移检测之一，且数据构建耦合，无法独立评估时间和语义一致性。
Method: 从野外视频中自动过滤并人工验证，确保声源在画面内，构建包含语音、音乐和声音三大类，覆盖10个场景和5个挑战任务的基准数据集。
Result: 基准包含3,269个视频和38,390个样本，并基于五个代表性模型评估了特征在对齐和下游任务中的表现。
Conclusion: AV-SyncBench为独立评估音频-视觉同步的时间与语义方面提供了标准化测试平台，代码和数据集已公开。
