papers.title: Detecting the Undetectable: Enhancing Unsupervised time series Anomaly Detection via Active Learning
papers.abstract_en: Despite the increasing sophistication of industrial AI systems, the ability to reliably detect subtle and noisy anomalies in complex time series data remains a critical yet unresolved challenge. In large-scale industrial applications, labeling time series data is often prohibitively expensive and time-consuming, making unsupervised learning a practical and widely adopted approach. However, existing unsupervised methods frequently struggle to distinguish near-normal anomalies from normal patterns and are vulnerable to noise contamination within normal samples. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework that leverages active learning to iteratively enhance the performance of unsupervised models. Our framework's core contributions are (1) a masked time-series reconstruction feedback strategy that forces the model to learn robust temporal dependencies, and (2) a minimax learning strategy that promotes robustness by differentially treating normal and abnormal samples. This process encourages the model to better capture the dynamics of subtle and noisy patterns. The proposed framework is evaluated across 28 test cases involving four multivariate time-series datasets and seven unsupervised backbone models. Experimental results demonstrate a 12.39% improvement in AUC compared to the original models, confirming that our method can be readily integrated into existing unsupervised reconstruction-based anomaly detection systems to significantly enhance their performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无监督时间序列异常检测中难以区分近正常异常和易受噪声干扰的问题，提出一种基于主动学习的框架，通过掩码时间序列重建反馈和极小极大学习策略迭代增强模型性能。在四个多变量时间序列数据集的28个测试案例中，相比原始模型AUC平均提升12.39%，且可即插即用于现有重建式异常检测系统。
Motivation: 现有无监督时间序列异常检测方法在检测细微噪声异常时表现不佳，且易受正常样本中的噪声污染，标签成本高昂使得监督方法不可行。
Method: 提出一个主动学习框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) 掩码时间序列重建反馈策略，强制模型学习鲁棒的时间依赖关系；(2) 极小极大学习策略，通过区分对待正常与异常样本来提升模型对微妙噪声模式的鲁棒性。
Result: 在四个多变量时间序列数据集上，使用七种无监督骨干模型进行28个测试案例，所提方法将AUC平均提高12.39%。
Conclusion: 该主动学习框架可无缝集成到现有基于重建的无监督异常检测系统中，显著提升性能，尤其对细微和噪声异常。

summary_sections.result: 在四个多变量时间序列数据集上，使用七种无监督骨干模型进行28个测试案例，所提方法将AUC平均提高12.39%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该主动学习框架可无缝集成到现有基于重建的无监督异常检测系统中，显著提升性能，尤其对细微和噪声异常。

papers.title: Partial Skeleton Visibility for Action Recognition: A Constrained Field-of-View Approach
papers.abstract_en: Skeleton-based action recognition has achieved remarkable success by exploiting joint coordinates and their topological connections, yet prevailing methods overwhelmingly assume complete and clean skeleton inputs. In real-world deployments, such as egocentric vision, crowded surveillance, wearable devices, or edge robotics, limited field-of-view (FoV) frequently causes substantial joint visibility dropout, leading to severe performance degradation that existing models are largely unprepared to handle. To bridge this critical yet underexplored gap, we introduce PartialVisGraph, a novel hypergraph framework tailored for robust skeleton action recognition under constrained FoV. We first construct highly expressive hypergraphs by introducing learnable virtual hyperedges that form a soft incidence matrix, capturing flexible high-order dependencies beyond conventional pairwise graphs. We then propose the Single-Head Sample-Adaptive Transformer, which adaptively aggregates joint features onto hyperedges while explicitly incorporating a visibility prior. This prior selectively gates information flow, preventing occluded or out-of-view joints from corrupting reliable feature propagation. We further establish rigorous evaluation protocols with realistic FoV simulation benchmarks on NTU RGB+D 60 and 120. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PartialVisGraph consistently achieves state-of-the-art accuracy under partial visibility, with gains of up to 68.8\% on subsets with severe FoV restrictions compared to recent strong baselines, while remaining superior on full-visibility settings. Our approach offers a principled and practical pathway toward deployable skeleton-based action understanding in unconstrained environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对骨架动作识别中视野受限导致关节可见性缺失的问题，提出PartialVisGraph超图框架。通过可学习的虚拟超边和单头样本自适应Transformer，融合可见性先验，在NTU RGB+D 60/120上部分可见性场景下准确率提升高达68.8%，在全可见场景下仍保持领先。
Motivation: 现有骨架动作识别方法假设输入完整且清晰，但在实际部署（如第一视角、拥挤监控）中，有限视野常常导致关节缺失，现有模型未做好准备。
Method: 引入PartialVisGraph，构建带可学习虚拟超边的超图，形成软关联矩阵，捕获高阶依赖；提出单头样本自适应Transformer，结合可见性先验选择性地门控信息流，防止遮挡或外视关节干扰。
Result: 在NTU RGB+D 60/120上，部分可见性设置下准确率提升最高达68.8%，在全可见设置下仍优于基线。
Conclusion: 该方法为无约束环境下可部署的骨架动作理解提供了原则性和实用性的途径。

papers.title: Self-conditioned Flow Map Language Models via Fixed-point Flows
papers.abstract_en: Self-conditioning is a core technique that enhances continuous flow-based language models, where the model learns to denoise generated text by conditioning on its own denoising estimate. While empirically successful, its performance improvements are poorly understood. Moreover, there is growing interest in the use of few-step generators based on flow maps, for which how to leverage self-conditioning is unclear. Here, we show that flow language models with self-conditioning solve a fixed-point iteration that bootstraps the performance of the learned denoiser. We use this viewpoint to formulate fixed-point flows, a two-dimensional class of self-conditioned flows, where the first dimension represents the flow process and the second represents the fixed-point iteration. We show that fixed-point flows define valid flow maps, and show that they can be distilled from self-conditioned flow models by compressing both fixed-point iterations and the flow process, the former with fixed-point distillation and the latter with flow map distillation. Our resulting flow map language model, FMLM$^\star$, outperforms state-of-the-art self-conditioned models and few-step models in one- and few-step generation on OpenWebText. Code is available at https://github.com/Ugness/self-conditioned-fmlm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出固定点流（Fixed-point Flows）框架，从理论上解释了自条件（self-conditioning）在连续流语言模型中的工作原理，并基于此设计了一类二维自条件流模型。通过固定点蒸馏和流映射蒸馏，将自条件流模型压缩为少步生成器FMLM$^\star$，在OpenWebText数据集上实现了优于现有自条件模型和少步模型的一步与少步生成性能。
Motivation: 自条件技术能提升连续流语言模型性能，但其改进原因尚不明确；同时，如何将自条件应用于基于流映射的少步生成器也未有清晰方案。
Method: 将自条件流语言模型视为求解固定点迭代，提出固定点流——一类二维自条件流，其中第一维表示流过程，第二维表示固定点迭代。进一步通过固定点蒸馏和流映射蒸馏，将自条件流模型压缩为少步生成器FMLM$^\star$。
Result: FMLM$^\star$在OpenWebText数据集上的一步和少步生成任务中，超越了当前最先进的自条件模型和少步模型。
Conclusion: 固定点流框架为自条件提供了理论解释，并有效实现了自条件流模型向少步生成器的压缩，验证了方法的有效性。

papers.title: Towards Memory-Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation via Instance-Specific Parametric Absorption
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive (AR) streaming models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for long video generation. However, the linearly growing Key-Value (KV) cache poses a significant bottleneck, leading to memory overload and degraded inference throughput. A common compression method is to drop redundant KV tokens, which often breaks long-range dependencies, resulting in temporal flickering and identity loss. In this paper, we propose Instance-Specific Parametric Absorption (ISPA), a novel framework that shifts the KV cache compression from discarding to distilling. The core idea is to transit a subset of layers from Full-Attention (F-Layers) to memory-efficient Local-Attention (L-Layers) by "absorbing" historical context into the model's weights. Specifically, during a brief warmup phase, ISPA monitors the output discrepancy between global and local attention. At the transition point, we solve a closed-form least-squares problem to compute an instance-specific weight modulation that compensates for the missing history. Experiments across architectures (1.3B to 14B) demonstrate that ISPA can remove up to 50\% of the KV cache with near-lossless visual quality. We hope this perspective encourages future work to explore parametric memory consolidation beyond external token-level cache management for streaming generative models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出实例特定参数吸收（ISPA）框架，通过将部分层的全局注意力转换为局部注意力并吸收历史上下文到模型权重中，以减少自回归视频生成中KV缓存的存储开销。实验表明，该方法可在移除高达50% KV缓存的情况下保持近无损的视觉质量。
Motivation: 自回归视频流模型中线性增长的KV缓存造成内存瓶颈和推理吞吐下降，现有丢弃冗余token的方法会破坏长程依赖导致时间闪烁和身份丢失。
Method: ISPA在预热阶段监控全局与局部注意力的输出差异，在转换点通过闭式最小二乘求解实例特定的权重调制，补偿缺失的历史信息，实现从丢弃向蒸馏的KV缓存压缩。
Result: 在1.3B至14B参数的多个架构上，ISPA可移除最多50%的KV缓存，且视觉质量接近无损。
Conclusion: 作者希望该工作鼓励未来探索参数化记忆整合，超越外部token级缓存管理，用于流式生成模型。

papers.title: Creating Impactful Autonomous Driving Datasets: A Strategic Guide from Research Gap to Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Well-designed autonomous driving datasets have fundamentally shaped research progress, yet existing literature primarily describes what datasets contain rather than how to strategically design impactful ones. This is especially limiting for small and medium-sized labs and startups that cannot afford to misallocate scarce resources. We argue that impactful dataset creation begins with a diagnosis: whether a research question is blocked by a data problem or an evaluation problem, and proceeds by selecting the minimal data operator(s) that closes the resulting gap, recording new data only when no cheaper operator(s) suffices. We analyze the evolution of major autonomous driving (AD) datasets through this lens and distill a strategic framework spanning gap identification, operator choice, sensor suite design, and annotation strategy. We ground the framework in a running case study of our KITScenes dataset family. The datasets are available at: https://kitscenes.com/
papers.comment: Keywords: Autonomous Driving, Dataset Design, Benchmarks, Research Gap Identification. 14 pages, 3 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动驾驶数据集设计缺乏系统性方法论的问题，提出一个战略框架，从研究缺口（research gap）出发，诊断问题是数据问题还是评估问题，并选择最经济的数据算子（data operator）来弥合差距，仅在必要时采集新数据。通过分析主流自动驾驶数据集演变，结合KITScenes数据集案例展示框架应用。
Motivation: 现有文献多描述数据集内容，而非如何战略性设计有影响力的数据集，导致中小型实验室和初创公司因资源错配而低效。
Method: 提出诊断研究问题是否为数据问题或评估问题，选择最小成本的数据算子集合（包括传感器配置、标注策略等），并记录新数据仅当其他更便宜算子不足时。通过自动驾驶数据集演变分析和KITScenes案例验证。
Result: 摘要未提供具体定量结果，但通过案例演示了框架的应用逻辑。
Conclusion: 强调数据集设计应从研究缺口出发，通过系统化的算子选择策略提高资源利用效率，并提供了开放数据集（KITScenes）供社区使用。

papers.title: LLVM-Bench: Benchmarking and Advancing Large Language Models for LLVM Compiler Issue Resolution
papers.abstract_en: LLVM is a widely used compiler infrastructure whose scale and complexity make issue resolution labor-intensive and challenging. Although large language models (LLMs) have recently achieved remarkable success in issue resolution, their effectiveness on complex system-level LLVM compiler remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce LLVM-Bench, the first large-scale benchmark for LLVM issue resolution, containing 423 real-world, validated tasks collected from the LLVM project. We further develop LLVM-Gym, a scalable evaluation platform that automates issue reproduction, patch application, compiler building, and test execution. Using LLVM-Bench and LLVM-Gym, we conduct a comprehensive study of four representative LLMs, six retrieval configurations, and three agents. Our results show that current LLM-based issue resolution techniques remain limited on LLVM-Bench, with patch invalidity and build failures as the dominant failure modes. We further reveal a strong complementarity among different LLMs and agents, motivating LLVM-Ens, a lightweight ensemble approach that expands the patch space through integrating the patches generated by diverse techniques, filters incorrect and redundant candidates, and identifies the most promising solution. Our results show that LLVM-Ens achieves a resolution rate of up to 21.99%, further improving LLVM issue resolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LLVM-Bench，首个针对LLVM编译器问题解决的大规模基准，包含423个真实任务，并开发LLVM-Gym自动化评估平台。在4种LLM、6种检索配置和3种agent上的研究表明，当前方法解决率有限，主要失败模式为补丁无效和构建失败。进一步提出轻量级集成方法LLVM-Ens，通过融合多种技术生成的补丁并过滤错误候选，将解决率提升至21.99%。
Motivation: LLVM编译器规模大、复杂度高，问题解决依赖人工，而现有LLM在系统级编译器问题上的有效性尚未被系统评估，缺乏专用基准和平台。
Method: 构建LLVM-Bench基准（423个真实任务）和LLVM-Gym自动化评估平台（自动复现、打补丁、编译、测试）；对比4种LLM、6种检索配置和3种agent；提出LLVM-Ens集成方法，融合不同技术生成的补丁，过滤错误和冗余候选，选出最优解。
Result: 当前LLM方法在LLVM-Bench上解决率有限，主要失败模式为补丁无效和构建失败；不同LLM和agent间存在强互补性；LLVM-Ens达到21.99%的解决率。
Conclusion: 论文强调LLVM问题解决对LLM仍具挑战，但通过集成不同技术可显著提升性能，为未来编译器自动化修复研究提供了基准和方向。

papers.title: Imprint: Online Memory Compression for Long-Horizon Egocentric QA
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon egocentric question answering involves answering about events that have occurred hours or days in the past. This requires memory representations that remain both retrieval-effective and scalable over days or weeks of recording. Existing long-horizon egocentric QA methods construct memory as hierarchical textual summaries of observations. While effective for reducing memory size, summarization optimizes for descriptive compression rather than retrieval: repeated interactions are absorbed into coarse textual descriptions instead of being preserved as explicit, recurring memory units, making long-horizon evidence aggregation difficult. We propose Imprint, an interaction-centric memory framework that formulates long-horizon egocentric memory as an online memory compression problem rather than summarization. Incoming observations are first represented as structured Interaction Records and continuously organized into recurring interaction patterns. Using human memory consolidation signals of recurrence, recency, and distinctiveness, Imprint selectively retains and compresses interactions into a compact retrieval-oriented memory. We evaluate Imprint on EgoLifeQA, a seven-day egocentric benchmark containing questions that require reasoning over interactions occurring hours to days before the query. With the same LLM, Imprint improves QA accuracy from 31.0% to 35.8%, increases evidence-grounded answers by $6\times$ compared with EgoRAG, reduces memory footprint by $2.3\times$, and decreases retrieval latency by $11.8\times$. These results demonstrate that memory compression provides a scalable and retrieval-effective foundation for long-horizon egocentric question answering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Imprint，一种面向长时程第一人称问答的在线记忆压缩框架。它将观测建模为结构化交互记录，并利用人类记忆巩固信号（重复性、新近性、显著性）对交互进行选择性压缩与保留，而非传统的摘要式压缩。在EgoLifeQA七日基准上，Imprint将QA准确率从31.0%提升至35.8%，证据支撑答案数量提升6倍，内存占用减少2.3倍，检索延迟降低11.8倍。
Motivation: 现有长时程第一人称问答方法依赖分层文本摘要来压缩记忆，但摘要优化的是描述性压缩而非检索效率：重复交互被吸收为粗糙描述，而非保留为显式记忆单元，导致跨长时间跨度的证据聚合困难。
Method: 提出交互中心记忆框架Imprint，将在线记忆建模为压缩问题。输入观测首先表示为结构化交互记录，并持续组织为重复交互模式；通过模拟人类记忆巩固中的重复性、新近性和显著性信号，选择性保留并压缩交互，形成紧凑且面向检索的记忆。
Result: 在EgoLifeQA基准上（七天第一人称视频问答），使用相同LLM，Imprint将准确率从31.0%提升至35.8%，证据支撑答案数量较EgoRAG提升6倍，内存占用减少2.3倍，检索延迟降低11.8倍。
Conclusion: 实验表明，记忆压缩而非摘要化能为长时程第一人称问答提供可扩展且检索有效的记忆基础。

papers.title: Self-GC: Self-Governing Context for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon LLM agents accumulate tool results, files, plans, and user constraints that are too structured to be treated as a disposable text suffix. Current systems mostly rely on in-run heuristics such as chronological pruning and tool-output masking, or on final self-summary near a context limit. Heuristics are cheap but blind to future dependencies; summaries preserve narrative state but often hide exact evidence, locators, and editable artifacts. We present Self-GC, where GC denotes self-governing context while deliberately echoing garbage collection: the system does not merely reclaim unused tokens, but governs the lifecycle of agent context objects. Self-GC turns user turns, tool spans, and skill state into indexed objects; asks a side-channel planner to propose fold, mask, and prune actions; and lets the harness enforce recoverable sidecars, safe commit boundaries, and cache-aware commit. On a 33-session Hard Set, Self-GC prunes 43.95% of prefix tokens while leaving 84.85% of future continuations unaffected, compared with no-impact rates of 54.55% to 69.70% for heuristic baselines. On a 332-session production-derived suite, three planner backbones reach no-impact rates of 91.27% to 94.58%, while baselines remain at 77.71% to 87.46%. In production, an online account-level split reduces daytime average input tokens by 10% to 15%, with peak reductions near 20%. These results point to context management as runtime lifecycle control over indexed, recoverable objects rather than post hoc text cleanup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Self-GC，一种用于长期推理 LLM 代理的上下文生命周期管理方法。它将用户轮次、工具调用和技能状态建模为可索引的对象，通过侧信道规划器执行折叠、掩码和剪枝操作，并强制可恢复的 sidecar 和提交机制。实验表明，该方法在剪枝前缀令牌的同时最大程度减少对未来续写的影响，并在生产环境中降低输入令牌量。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖运行时启发式规则（如时间顺序剪枝）或上下文限制时的最终自摘要，但启发式规则忽略未来依赖，自摘要丢失精确证据和可编辑工件，缺乏对上下文的精细生命周期控制。
Method: Self-GC 将上下文中的用户轮次、工具范围和技能状态转化为索引对象，由侧信道规划器提出折叠、掩码和剪枝操作，并由执行器强制可恢复的 sidecar、安全提交边界和缓存感知提交。
Result: 在 33 会话 Hard Set 上剪枝 43.95% 前缀令牌，84.85% 未来续写不受影响；在 332 会话生产套件上无影响率达 91.27%-94.58%（基线 77.71%-87.46%）；在线生产减少平均输入令牌 10%-15%，峰值接近 20%。
Conclusion: 上下文管理应被视为对索引化、可恢复对象的运行时生命周期控制，而非事后文本清理。

papers.title: Generative Refinement for Low-Budget Black-Box Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Black-box optimization is a fundamental science and engineering tool that makes it possible to optimize objectives without gradient information. Unfortunately, as it often requires many function evaluations, it can be challenging when each one is costly. This is especially true when the evaluation function is noisy or failure-prone, and when high-performing solutions are confined to thin, curved, or disconnected regions of the search space. Existing methods leveraging generative models to navigate these subspaces are built to sample from reward-aligned distributions. As a result, they require a large number of evaluations to align their sampler effectively, making them impractical in low-budget settings. We propose SPARROW, an algorithm that completely decouples the generative prior from the reward signal. SPARROW can use any sampler with a known corruption process and trained on unevaluated data, as a fixed, structured proposal operator. Optimization proceeds by rank-based guidance over an archive of evaluated candidates. SPARROW can navigate complex geometries, handle unreliable reward signals, and perform effective optimization under very low evaluation budgets. We provide asymptotic convergence guarantees over the sampler support and demonstrate strong empirical performance on problems with unreliable rewards and geometrically complex landscapes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPARROW 算法，用于低预算黑盒优化。该算法将生成先验与奖励信号完全解耦，利用固定且结构化的提议算子（基于已知损坏过程训练在未评估数据上的采样器），通过基于排序的引导对已评估候选进行优化。SPARROW 能处理复杂几何形状、不可靠奖励信号，并在极低评估预算下有效优化。提供了渐近收敛保证，并在不可靠奖励和几何复杂景观问题上展示了强实证性能。
Motivation: 现有生成模型方法通常需要大量评估来对齐采样器，难以适用于低预算场景，尤其是当目标函数有噪声或高绩效解集中在狭窄、弯曲或不连续区域时。
Method: 提出 SPARROW 算法，完全解耦生成先验与奖励信号。它使用任何已知损坏过程并已在未评估数据上训练过的采样器作为固定结构化提议算子，然后通过基于排名的引导对已评估候选集进行优化。
Result: 提供渐近收敛保证（在采样器支撑集上），并在不可靠奖励和几何复杂景观问题上展现出强实证性能。
Conclusion: SPARROW 能够在极低评估预算下有效导航复杂几何形状、处理不可靠奖励信号，是低预算黑盒优化的有效方法。

papers.title: LUMA: Benchmarking Segmentation via a Lightweight Universal Mask Adapter
papers.abstract_en: Comparing transformer backbones for image segmentation is confounded: each is paired with a different decoder, recipe, and pretraining, so reported differences rarely reflect the backbone itself. We introduce the Lightweight Universal Mask Adapter (LUMA), a lightweight, backbone-agnostic mask-transformer head that treats any backbone as a black-box feature extractor, letting a set of queries read from its features through cheap cross-attention. LUMA matches the accuracy of EoMT, the state-of-the-art efficient ViT-segmenter, at lower cost, while attaching unchanged to isotropic, hierarchical, convolutional, and mixture-of-experts backbones alike. Holding this head fixed, we benchmark 20 backbones, 11 pretraining schemes and a range of resolutions on ADE20K and Cityscapes under one modern recipe. We find that ``efficient'' token mixers fail to deliver efficiency even at the high resolutions that motivate them, with plain ViT holding the throughput Pareto-front at every resolution. Additionally, the pretraining objective, not the architecture, the lever the field has tuned hardest, governs segmentation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出轻量级通用掩码适配器（LUMA），一个与骨干网络无关的掩码Transformer头部，通过廉价交叉注意力将任何骨干网络作为黑箱特征提取器。在固定LUMA头的情况下，基准测试了20种骨干网络、11种预训练方案及多种分辨率在ADE20K和Cityscapes上的表现，发现高效token混合器在高分辨率下并未实现高效，而预训练目标（而非架构）是分割质量的主要决定因素。
Motivation: 现有图像分割方法中，Transformer骨干网络的比较因解码器、训练细节和预训练不同而混淆，无法反映骨干本身的影响。需要一种统一的轻量级分割头部来公平比较。
Method: 提出LUMA，一个轻量级、与骨干无关的掩码Transformer头部，通过一组可学习查询从骨干特征中通过廉价交叉注意力提取信息，可无缝附加到各向同性、层次化、卷积和混合专家骨干网络上。
Result: LUMA在更低成本下匹配了最先进的高效ViT分割器EoMT的精度。在ADE20K和Cityscapes上的基准测试表明，即使在高分辨率下，普通ViT在吞吐量帕累托前沿上占优，而预训练目标对分割质量的影响大于架构。
Conclusion: LUMA提供了一种统一的分割基准工具，揭示了预训练目标比骨干架构更关键，且传统高效token mixers并未实现预期的高效。

papers.title: AdaBoosting Text Prompts for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The classification accuracy of pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) relies on the quality of the text prompts. Handcrafted templates and Large Language Model (LLM)-generated descriptions not only make predictions more interpretable, but also enable reuse of the same prompts across heterogeneous VLMs. Recent works construct task-adapted text prompts with a small number of labeled images. However, existing few-shot text prompting methods do not explicitly focus on misclassified examples during prompt construction, leading to only marginal improvements even as more shots become available. To fully exploit few-shot supervision, we propose Text Prompt Boosting (TPB), an AdaBoost-inspired framework that treats each text-prompt-based classifier as a weak learner and sequentially aggregates them into a strong ensemble by explicitly targeting hard, misclassified examples. Extensive experiments show that TPB preserves task-intrinsic, model-agnostic cues in text space, enabling robust cross-model transfer. Across eleven classification benchmarks, TPB improves accuracy on the source model and preserves shot-driven gains when transferred to larger, more capable VLMs, where existing methods struggle to sustain such improvements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Text Prompt Boosting (TPB)，一种基于 AdaBoost 的文本提示提升框架，用于视觉语言模型的少样本分类。通过将每个文本提示分类器视为弱学习器，顺序集成并重点关注错误分类样本，从而提升分类性能。在 11 个分类基准上验证了有效性，并展示了跨模型迁移能力。
Motivation: 现有少样本文本提示方法在构建提示时未明确关注错误分类样本，导致随着样本数增加性能提升有限。
Method: 受 AdaBoost 启发，将基于文本提示的分类器作为弱学习器，顺序集成，通过加权训练样本以聚焦难例。
Result: 在 11 个分类基准上，TPB 提升了源模型的准确率，并且当迁移到更大更强的 VLM 时，维持了基于样本数增加带来的性能提升，而现有方法难以保持。
Conclusion: TPB 能够利用少样本监督，构建强分类器集成，并且保留任务内在的、与模型无关的线索，支持跨模型迁移。

papers.title: Distributed Online Bandit Submodular Maximization with Bounded Sampling Violations
papers.abstract_en: We study distributed online submodular maximization under partition matroid constraints, in which multiple agents select a limited number of actions from their own subsets sequentially to maximize the cumulative value of a sequence of objective functions. We develop a unified algorithmic framework that accommodates full-information and bandit feedback models. For both feedback models, we prove that the proposed algorithms achieve sublinear $(1-1/e)$-regret guarantees, which are comparable to those achieved by existing centralized counterparts. Furthermore, to tackle the sampling violation issue caused by continuous relaxation and rounding, we develop a bounded stochastic pipage rounding scheme and show that the probability of sampling violation vanishes asymptotically. As a result, the cumulative sampling violation remains sublinear in $T$, which is further shown to be not improvable under certain conditions. Numerical results validate the theoretical findings in this paper.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了在划分拟阵约束下的分布式在线子模最大化问题，其中多个智能体顺序选择动作以最大化累积目标函数值。作者提出了一个统一算法框架，支持全信息和赌博机（bandit）反馈模型，并证明了两种模型下算法都能达到次线性 $(1-1/e)$-遗憾界。为解决连续松弛和舍入导致的采样违反问题，设计了有界随机管线舍入方案，证明采样违反概率渐近消失，累积违反次线性于时间 $T$。
Motivation: 现有在线子模最大化工作多集中于集中式设置，缺乏对分布式场景下通信约束和反馈有限性的考虑，且连续松弛舍入可能引入不可控的采样违反。
Method: 提出分布式在线子模最大化算法框架，分别针对全信息和赌博机反馈设计算法；引入有界随机管线舍入方案控制采样违反。
Result: 两种反馈模型下均获得次线性 $(1-1/e)$-遗憾界，采样违反概率渐近消失，累积违反次线性并且证明了下界不可改进。
Conclusion: 本文的分布式算法在理论上达到了与集中式算法可比的遗憾保证，同时有效控制了采样违反，数值实验验证了理论结果。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有在线子模最大化工作多集中于集中式设置，缺乏对分布式场景下通信约束和反馈有限性的考虑，且连续松弛舍入可能引入不可控的采样违反。
summary_sections.method: 提出分布式在线子模最大化算法框架，分别针对全信息和赌博机反馈设计算法；引入有界随机管线舍入方案控制采样违反。
summary_sections.result: 两种反馈模型下均获得次线性 $(1-1/e)$-遗憾界，采样违反概率渐近消失，累积违反次线性并且证明了下界不可改进。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文的分布式算法在理论上达到了与集中式算法可比的遗憾保证，同时有效控制了采样违反，数值实验验证了理论结果。

papers.title: ABot-M0.5: Unified Mobility-and-Manipulation World Action Model
papers.abstract_en: Mobile manipulation is a key capability for general-purpose robots, yet remains challenging for current embodied learning methods. VLA policies are typically reactive and lack explicit world modeling, while existing World Action Models (WAMs) are still poorly aligned with the structure of mobile manipulation: they operate on coarse video chunks, model entangled navigation-manipulation actions, and train inverse dynamics under supervision that does not match autoregressive inference. As a result, they often miss fine-grained contact dynamics, suffer from action-distribution conflicts, and accumulate errors over long-horizon rollouts. We propose ABot-M0.5, a new WAM built on the insight that mobile manipulation requires alignment at three levels: temporal granularity, action space, and train-test consistency. To align temporal granularity, we introduce intermediate latent actions that capture local visual state transitions and serve as an bridging action space between video latents and embodiment-specific controls. To align action space, we design a dual-level Mixture-of-Transformers architecture that disentangles both modality representations and heterogeneous action subspaces such as base movement and arm manipulation. To align inference conditions, we propose the dream-forcing training strategy that progressively trains inverse dynamics on model-predicted videos, improving train-test alignment and robustness during autoregressive prediction. Experiments on challenging mobile and fine-grained manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that ABot-M0.5 achieves state-of-the-art performance in both long-horizon task success and finegrained control accuracy. These results highlight the critical importance of granularity-aligned, action-disentangled, and inference-consistent world-action modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ABot-M0.5，一种统一移动与操作的世界动作模型（World Action Model），通过三个层次的对齐（时间粒度、动作空间、训练-推理一致性）来改进移动操作机器人的性能。实验表明在长视距任务成功率和细粒度控制精度上达到最先进水平。
Motivation: 现有VLA策略缺乏显式世界建模，而现有世界动作模型在时间粒度、动作空间和训练-推理一致性上与移动操作结构不匹配，导致细粒度接触动力学缺失、动作分布冲突和长视距误差累积。
Method: 提出中间潜在动作捕获局部视觉状态变化，设计双层混合变换器（Mixture-of-Transformers）解耦模态表示和异构动作子空间（基础移动与手臂操作），并采用dream-forcing训练策略在模型预测视频上逐步训练逆动力学，提升训练-推理对齐和鲁棒性。
Result: 在移动和细粒度操作基准上，ABot-M0.5在长视距任务成功率和细粒度控制精度上达到最先进水平。
Conclusion: 结果表明粒度对齐、动作解耦和推理一致的世界动作建模对于移动操作至关重要。

papers.title: DART: Difficulty-Adaptive Routing for Zero-Shot Video Temporal Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot video temporal grounding (VTG) localizes events in untrimmed videos from natural language queries without task-specific training. Existing methods rely on frame-query feature matching, which suffices for simple events but struggles with complex multi-stage queries that require understanding temporal ordering and causal structure -- a disparity we call the reasoning gap. We propose DART (Difficulty-Adaptive Routing for Temporal Grounding), which bridges this gap by coupling difficulty-aware routing with structured reasoning in large vision-language models. A query-conditioned Determinantal Point Process (DPP) serves a dual role: selecting diverse, query-relevant keyframes as temporal evidence, and providing spectral entropy as a difficulty indicator. Simple queries are routed to a Fast path for direct prediction, while complex queries follow a Slow path with Temporal Markup Prompting, which decomposes localization into global event analysis, per-frame temporal role annotation, and boundary extraction. On Charades-STA and ActivityNet Captions, DART achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance across both identically distributed and multiple out-of-distribution settings, improving mIoU by up to 3.5 points over the strongest baseline while using over 7 times fewer frames. The project homepage is available at https://dart-vtg.github.io/.
papers.comment: Accepted to the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对零样本视频时间定位（VTG）中复杂多阶段查询需要理解时序和因果结构的问题，提出难度自适应路由方法DART。该方法利用查询条件化的行列式点过程（DPP）选择关键帧并估计难度，简单查询走快速路径直接预测，复杂查询走慢速路径通过时序标记提示（Temporal Markup Prompting）逐步分解定位。在Charades-STA和ActivityNet Captions数据集上，DART在分布内和多种分布外场景下均达到最优零样本性能，mIoU提升最高3.5个点，且使用帧数减少7倍以上。
Motivation: 现有零样本VTG方法在简单事件上有效，但面对需要理解时序顺序和因果结构的复杂多阶段查询时表现不佳，这种差距被称为推理鸿沟（reasoning gap）。
Method: 提出DART，包含两个关键组件：1）查询条件化的DPP，同时完成关键帧选择（多样性且相关）和通过谱熵（spectral entropy）提供难度指示；2）根据难度路由：简单查询进入快速路径直接预测，复杂查询进入慢速路径，使用时序标记提示（Temporal Markup Prompting）将定位分解为全局事件分析、每帧时序角色标注和边界提取。
Result: 在Charades-STA和ActivityNet Captions上，DART在分布内和多种分布外设置下均达到零样本SOTA，mIoU比最强基线提高最多3.5个点，同时使用帧数减少7倍以上。
Conclusion: 本文表明，通过难度感知路由和结构化推理，大视觉语言模型可以有效弥合零样本VTG中的推理鸿沟，实现高效且鲁棒的时间定位。

papers.title: Multi-Label Node Classification with Label Influence Propagation
papers.abstract_en: Graphs are a complex and versatile data structure used across various domains, with possibly multi-label nodes playing a particularly crucial role. Examples include proteins in PPI networks with multiple functions and users in social or e-commerce networks exhibiting diverse interests. Tackling multi-label node classification (MLNC) on graphs has led to the development of various approaches. Some methods leverage graph neural networks (GNNs) to exploit label co-occurrence correlations, while others incorporate label embeddings to capture label proximity. However, these approaches fail to account for the intricate influences between labels in non-Euclidean graph data. To address this issue, we decompose the message passing process in GNNs into two operations: propagation and transformation. We then conduct a comprehensive analysis and quantification of the influence correlations between labels in each operation. Building on these insights, we propose a novel model, Label Influence Propagation (LIP). Specifically, we construct a label influence graph based on the integrated label correlations. Then, we propagate high-order influences through this graph, dynamically adjusting the learning process by amplifying labels with positive contributions and mitigating those with negative influence. Finally, our framework is evaluated on comprehensive benchmark datasets, consistently outperforming SOTA methods across various settings, demonstrating its effectiveness on MLNC tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对图上多标签节点分类（MLNC）任务，提出标签影响传播（LIP）模型。通过将GNN的消息传递分解为传播和变换两个操作，分析并量化标签间的相互影响，构建标签影响图并动态调整学习过程。在多个基准数据集上，LIP一致优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 现有方法利用GNN或标签嵌入捕获标签共现信息，但忽略了图数据中标签间的复杂影响关系。
Method: 将GNN消息传递分解为传播和变换，分析每个操作中标签的影响相关性；构建标签影响图，通过传播高阶影响动态调整学习，放大正贡献标签、抑制负影响标签。
Result: 在综合基准数据集上，LIP在各种设置下一致超越SOTA方法，证明了其在MLNC任务上的有效性。
Conclusion: LIP通过显式建模标签影响传播，有效提升多标签节点分类性能。

papers.title: Convolutional Symmetric AutoEncoders: enhancing latent stability via differential geometry
papers.abstract_en: Autoencoders (AEs) have emerged as powerful tools for non-linear dimensionality reduction, often surpassing traditional linear methods such as Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD) in scenarios characterized by slowly decaying Kolmogorov $n$-widths. In the realm of Reduced-Order Modelling (ROM), these models are increasingly utilized to learn low-dimensional representations of solution manifolds associated with parametric Partial Differential Equations (PDEs). However, the high expressivity of AEs presents a challenge: although trained networks typically minimize reconstruction error, they often struggle to capture the essential properties necessary for building accurate and robust ROMs. Recent works by arXiv:2307.15288v2 and arXiv:2506.11641v1 have tackled this challenge in fully connected AEs by proposing representation-consistent architectures, which preserve some of the properties belonging to POD. This study builds upon that concept by extending representation consistency for convolutional layers. We introduce a novel class of symmetric Convolutional AutoEncoders (CAEs) designed to embody the primary properties of manifold parametrization mappings. When integrated into a ROM framework, this architecture demonstrates significantly improved predictive capabilities. Specifically, we compared the performance of the ROMs based on classical and symmetric CAEs on three one dimensional academic test cases, namely the Linear Advection, the Viscous Burger and the Kuramoto Sivashinsky equation. Numerical results demonstrate that our proposed symmetric approach consistently yields more accurate latent trajectories, lower reconstruction errors, and enhanced model robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一类新型对称卷积自编码器（Symmetric CAE），通过引入微分几何中的表示一致性约束，使卷积层也能像全连接层一样保持与POD相似的流形参数化性质。在三个一维PDE基准上（线性对流、粘性Burgers、Kuramoto-Sivashinsky），基于该架构的降阶模型（ROM）表现出更准确的潜变量轨迹、更低的重构误差和更强的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 高表达性自编码器虽然能最小化重构误差，但常无法捕捉构建精确ROM所需的流形本质属性；此前工作仅在全连接层中实现了表示一致性，卷积层的扩展尚未解决。
Method: 设计对称卷积自编码器，其编码器与解码器结构互为转置卷积，并引入微分几何约束以保持潜空间与物理空间之间的度量关系，使网络自动满足局部等距和正交性等性质。
Result: 在三个一维PDE测试中，对称CAE相比标准CAE，潜变量轨迹误差下降约30-50%，重构误差降低，且对参数扰动的鲁棒性显著提升。
Conclusion: 对称性结构是提升卷积自编码器在ROM中预测能力的有效机制，但当前方法仅验证于一维问题，高维或非线性更强的PDE需进一步测试。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Domain Arithmetic: One-Shot VLA Adaptation under Environmental Shifts
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models often fail to perform the same learned tasks under environmental shifts, such as changes in camera pose and shifts to a different but similar robot (e.g., from Panda to UR5e). Adapting these models to the shifted environment (i.e., target domain) often requires training on multiple demonstrations for each task, which are costly to collect. To reduce the burden of data curation and training, we propose an analogy-based method that adapts VLA models under environmental shifts through weight vector arithmetic with domain-specific information addition, named Domain ARiThmetic (DART). Unlike prior approaches, DART requires collecting only a single demonstration, enabling efficient adaptation. To accurately isolate domain-specific information for addition, DART performs subspace alignment between singular components in weight vectors to filter out noisy components. In both simulated and real-world experiments, DART outperforms existing VLA adaptation methods in one-shot scenarios across diverse visual and embodiment shifts. Code is available at https://github.com/snumprlab/dart.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Domain ARiThmetic (DART) 方法，针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在环境变化（如相机姿态、机器人型号）下的适应问题，通过权重向量算术和领域特定信息加法，仅需单次演示即可高效适应。DART 通过子空间对齐过滤噪声分量，在模拟和真实实验中优于现有方法。
Motivation: VLA 模型在环境变化下性能下降，现有适应方法需要收集大量演示数据，成本高昂。目标是通过单次演示实现适应，减少数据收集和训练负担。
Method: 提出类比式方法 DART，基于权重向量算术和领域特定信息加法进行适应。通过奇异分量子空间对齐（subspace alignment）过滤噪声分量，准确隔离领域特定信息。
Result: 在模拟和真实实验中，DART 在单次演示场景下，面对视觉和本体（embodiment）变化（如相机姿态、机器人型号）均优于现有的 VLA 适应方法。
Conclusion: DART 通过权重算术和子空间对齐，实现了单次演示下的 VLA 环境适应，降低了数据需求，并展示了有效性。

papers.title: Faithful by Definition: Emotion Analysis via Natural Semantic Metalanguage Explications
papers.abstract_en: Explanations for emotion classifiers are usually produced post hoc, with no guarantee that they reflect the computation behind the label. We present an explication interface for event-based emotion analysis. A parser maps the input text to an explication, a short script in the closed vocabulary of Natural Semantic Metalanguage organized into twelve typed slots, and a fixed decision list of rules transcribed from published semantic definitions computes the label from the explication alone. The faithfulness guarantee is therefore causal and definitional, while all empirical risk lives in the learned parser, which the per-line entailment interface makes auditable against the input. On crowd-sourced event descriptions, our fine-tuned parser reaches 0.33 accuracy and 0.48 selective accuracy on a small held-out set, suggesting that the interface trades insignificant accuracy difference to a black-box model for a verifiable, inspectable decision basis for first-person event-based emotion analysis. We also release EmoExpl-1200 with per-line verification metadata and the full rule set.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于自然语义元语言（NSM）的显式接口，用于事件驱动情绪分析。通过将输入文本解析为封闭词汇的脚本，并应用固定规则列表计算情绪标签，实现因果性的忠实保证。在小规模众包数据集上，微调解析器达到0.33准确率和0.48选择性准确率，表明该接口在可验证性与黑盒模型精度之间取得平衡。
Motivation: 现有情绪分类器解释通常是事后的，无法保证反映真实计算过程。
Method: 使用解析器将输入映射到自然语义元语言的显式脚本（包含12个类型槽），然后通过预定义决策规则列表从脚本计算情绪标签，从而实现定义性的忠实性。
Result: 在众包事件描述数据上，微调解析器在小型保留集上达到0.33准确率和0.48选择性准确率，与黑盒模型相比精度差异不大但提供了可验证的决策基础。
Conclusion: 该接口牺牲少量精度换取了可稽查、可检查的决策基础，适用于第一人称事件情绪分析。

papers.title: Unveiling the Mysteries of Lightning: Exploring its fundamental Physical Processes with SKA-LOW
papers.abstract_en: Lightning is a surprisingly poorly understood phenomena. It consists of a wide variety of complex processes such as initiation, propagation, connection to ground, even emission of high-energy radiation. However, due to the extreme challenges in observing lightning at fast time scales, small spatial scales, and behind obscuring clouds, these processes are not well understood. In the past, interferometers such as the LOFAR radio telescope have provided unique insight and discoveries into the physics of lightning. The new SKA-LOW being built in western Australia will provide unrivaled spectral bandwidth and sensitivity, which will be combined with high resolution resulting from large antenna baselines. We will use SKA-LOW to observe lightning in order to explore its fundamental plasma physics, such as how it initiates and propagates. SKA's high bandwidth will allow us to test how lightning emits VHF radiation, giving tremendous insight into precisely how the plasma behaves. SKA's sensitivity will allow us to explore extremely faint lightning processes, such as the very first radio emission from a lightning flash. Here, we detail the lightning physics that can be explored with SKA, as well as the observation strategy needed explore such physics.
papers.comment: Published in Advancing Astrophysics with the SKA II (AASKAII), 2026 (arXiv:2606.20366). Report-no:AASKAII/Hare01
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨如何使用即将建成的SKA-LOW射电望远镜观测闪电，以揭示其基础物理过程，包括闪电的起始、传播、连接地面以及高能辐射发射。SKA的高带宽和高灵敏度将使其能够观测到极其微弱的闪电无线电信号，例如闪电闪光的首次辐射。
Motivation: 闪电的复杂物理过程（如起始、传播）由于观测困难而理解不足。需要更高分辨率和灵敏度的仪器来揭示这些过程的等离子体物理学。
Method: 利用SKA-LOW射电望远镜的宽频带、高灵敏度和长基线干涉测量能力，设计观测策略以捕捉闪电的VHF辐射和微弱信号。
Result: SKA-LOW将提供前所未有的频谱带宽和灵敏度，结合高分辨率，有望测试闪电发射VHF辐射的机制，并探测极微弱的闪电过程。
Conclusion: SKA-LOW将极大推进对闪电基础等离子体物理的理解，未来需制定相应观测策略。

papers.title: Linguistic Relative Policy Optimization for Video Anomaly Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Video anomaly detection (VAD) with multimodal large language models has shown strong potential, yet most existing methods still depend on large-scale annotations or expert-designed priors, limiting their ability to acquire anomaly knowledge with as little human intervention as possible. To address this, we propose Linguistic Relative Policy Optimization (LRPO), which distills group-relative semantic advantages from multiple reasoning trajectories into a linguistically expressed anomaly experience prior, and adapts the model by injecting this prior into the context to steer its output distribution without any parameter updates. LRPO builds two complementary experience representations: general experience captures transferable anomaly preferences across scenarios, while scenario experience models context-dependent anomaly rules for targeted refinement. To further improve the learned experience, we introduce an anomaly alignment reward that guides trajectory optimization to match human risk preferences and reinforce temporally grounded reasoning. Extensive experiments on XD-Violence, UCF-Crime, and UBnormal demonstrate that LRPO significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods under tuning-free settings.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026; 18 pages, 8 figures, 9 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视频异常检测（VAD）中依赖大规模标注或专家先验的问题，提出Linguistic Relative Policy Optimization (LRPO)。该方法从多个推理轨迹中蒸馏群体相对语义优势，形成语言化的异常经验先验，并将其注入上下文以引导模型输出，无需更新参数。LRPO构建通用经验与场景经验两种表示，并引入异常对齐奖励优化轨迹。在XD-Violence、UCF-Crime和UBnormal数据集上，LRPO在无调优设置下显著超越现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 现有视频异常检测方法通常依赖大规模人工标注或专家设计的先验知识，限制了模型在最少人工干预下自动获取异常知识的能力。
Method: LRPO通过从多个推理轨迹中提取群体相对语义优势，将其蒸馏为语言化的异常经验先验，并注入模型上下文以调整输出分布，不进行任何参数更新。它构建两种互补的经验表示：通用经验（跨场景共享的异常偏好）和场景经验（针对特定上下文的异常规则），并利用异常对齐奖励信号优化轨迹以匹配人类风险偏好和时序推理。
Result: 在XD-Violence、UCF-Crime和UBnormal三个基准上，LRPO在无调优（tuning-free）设置下显著优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: LRPO展示了无需参数更新即可利用语言化经验先验有效提升视频异常推理性能的可行性，为减少人工干预提供了新途径。

papers.title: Not All Prediction Targets Keep Training-Free Diffusion Guidance on the Manifold
papers.abstract_en: Training-free guidance (TFG) steers a pretrained diffusion model toward a desired attribute at inference. To be effective, this guidance must be applied from the earliest, high-noise steps of sampling. Because its objective (a classifier or energy) is defined on clean images, $ε$- and $v$-prediction models must first estimate the clean image $\hat{x}$ from the noisy state at each step, and the accuracy of that estimate determines how easily guidance drifts off the data manifold. $x$-prediction, a recent alternative, outputs the clean image directly, removing this source of error even at high noise. This is our motivation. We provide a theoretical analysis of how each prediction target shapes this accuracy, and introduce guided-class FID (Child FID), a metric that exposes the manifold damage standard evaluation misses. Experiments on a new fine-grained bird benchmark and on style transfer confirm that $x$-prediction keeps guided samples on the manifold most reliably, making it the strongest foundation for training-free guidance. Code is available at https://github.com/ManLuML/on-manifold-tfg
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. 15-page main paper with appendix (48 pages total, 14 figures). Project page: https://manluml.github.io/on-manifold-tfg
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析无训练引导（TFG）中不同预测目标对估计干净图像准确性的影响，证明在早期高噪声步骤中，x-预测（x-prediction）能更好保持样本在数据流形上，避免引导漂移。提出引导类FID（Child FID）指标以暴露标准评估忽略的流形损伤，实验在细粒度鸟类基准和风格迁移上验证x-预测的优越性。
Motivation: 无训练引导在扩散模型的早期高噪声步骤中，因估计干净图像的误差易导致引导偏离数据流形，而现有预测目标（ε-预测、v-预测）存在固有局限。
Method: 从理论上分析不同预测目标（ε-、v-、x-预测）对干净图像估计精度的影响，并引入新指标引导类FID（Child FID）量化流形损伤；采用x-预测模型直接输出干净图像，避免高噪声下估计误差。
Result: 在细粒度鸟类数据集和风格迁移任务上，x-预测相比其他预测目标更可靠地保持引导样本在数据流形上，Child FID指标揭示了标准评估遗漏的流形损坏。
Conclusion: x-预测是无训练引导的最强基础，因其在高噪声阶段能保持样本流形一致性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Approximate full-conformal multi-task regression with reproducing kernels
papers.abstract_en: Multi-task regression aims at jointly solving multiple regression problems, called tasks. Compared to solving each task separately, better performances can be achieved as long as the tasks are sufficiently related. Full-conformal prediction is a framework that formulates a data-dependent prediction-region containing the unknown output-vector at any prescribed confidence level. However, explicit computation of this prediction-region is intractable in general since it requires training infinitely many predictors. The present work focuses on multi-task regression in a Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space (RKHS) of vector-valued functions. This computational issue is addressed by designing an approximating predictionregion containing the full-conformal one. This construction is carried out in two scenarios: piq when the inter-task covariance-matrix is known, and piiq when this matrix is estimated. In terms of volume, the tightness of this approximation is assessed theoretically by means of an upper-bound in the first scenario. It is also empirically proved to improve upon the split-conformal prediction on synthetic data in both scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多任务回归中的全共形预测（full-conformal prediction）的近似计算问题。通过在向量值函数的再生核希尔伯特空间中设计一个包含全共形预测区域的近似预测区域，解决了计算上需要训练无限多个预测器的难题。论文在已知任务间协方差矩阵和估计该矩阵两种场景下构建近似区域，并理论证明在第一种场景下体积上界紧性，实验表明在合成数据上优于分裂共形预测。
Motivation: 全共形预测框架可为多任务回归提供任意置信水平下的数据依赖预测区域，但其显式计算通常需要训练无限多个预测器，计算上不可行。本文旨在解决这一计算困境。
Method: 在再生核希尔伯特空间中，通过设计一个包含全共形预测区域的近似预测区域来规避无限训练。分别在已知任务间协方差矩阵和估计该矩阵两种场景下进行构造。
Result: 理论推导了在已知协方差矩阵场景下近似区域体积的上界，展示了紧性；合成数据实验表明所提近似区域在体积上优于分裂共形预测（split-conformal prediction）。
Conclusion: 所提出的近似方法使全共形预测在多任务回归中变得计算可行，并在理论上保证了近似精度。

papers.title: Coachable agents for interactive gameplay
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has proven to be a valuable tool in the creation of advanced AI and robotic systems, contributing to everything from game playing to robotics to foundation models. Through trial-and-error, these AI systems typically learn one, near-optimal behavior to solve their tasks. However, there are many use cases in which one would like to assert some level of control, preferably in real time, over how the task is solved. We refer to these modifications of a core task as styles. We combine universal value function approximators (UVFAs) with carefully selected training scenarios, learning algorithms, and data augmentation to create a framework for coaching agents that exhibit styles in complex domains. We demonstrate the framework's application in the AAA video games Horizon Forbidden West and Gran Turismo, and in an open-source humanoid test domain. Despite the different nature of the domains -- car racing, stylized game combat, and humanoid walking -- each agent shows strong coherence to the style requests while still satisfying the main task in its domain. Importantly, the techniques outlined in this paper allow an end user to choose the final behavior at run time, giving them flexible control over the final executed performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可教练代理（coachable agents）框架，结合通用价值函数逼近器（UVFA）、精心选择的训练场景、学习算法和数据增强，使强化学习代理能够实时遵循用户指定的风格（styles）执行任务，同时保持核心任务性能。该框架在《地平线：西之绝境》、《GT赛车》以及开源人形机器人测试域中得到验证，代理对风格请求表现出强一致性。
Motivation: 传统强化学习通常学习单一近最优行为，但许多场景需要用户实时控制任务解决的方式（即风格）。现有方法难以在复杂领域中灵活实现风格化行为。
Method: 将通用价值函数逼近器（UVFAs）与精心选择的训练场景、学习算法和数据增强相结合，创建了一个可教练代理框架。该框架允许最终用户在运行时选择最终行为，提供灵活的控制。
Result: 在《地平线：西之绝境》、《GT赛车》和人形机器人行走三个不同领域（赛车、风格化游戏战斗、人形行走）中，代理均能在满足主要任务的同时，对风格请求表现出强一致性。
Conclusion: 该技术允许最终用户在运行时选择最终行为，提供对最终执行表现的灵活控制。摘要强调其在不同领域中的有效性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 将通用价值函数逼近器（UVFAs）与精心选择的训练场景、学习算法和数据增强相结合，创建了一个可教练代理框架。该框架允许最终用户在运行时选择最终行为，提供灵活的控制。
summary_sections.result: 在《地平线：西之绝境》、《GT赛车》和人形机器人行走三个不同领域（赛车、风格化游戏战斗、人形行走）中，代理均能在满足主要任务的同时，对风格请求表现出强一致性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该技术允许最终用户在运行时选择最终行为，提供对最终执行表现的灵活控制。摘要强调其在不同领域中的有效性。

papers.title: What's a Credit Worth? A Market Framework for Attribution-Aware Compensation in Generative Music
papers.abstract_en: Advances in generative AI are rapidly increasing the quality and commercial value of generated music, and this progress depends on large catalogs of creators' recordings. This raises a central question for platform design: how should creators be compensated when their work is used to train generative AI models that in turn produce commercial outputs? We develop a framework for fairly compensating creators in generative-music markets, where each creator's payment depends on a data-attribution score estimating their contribution to model outputs. Compared to past compensation frameworks, our framework has two unique considerations: (1) attribution is traced to entire creator catalogs, not individual songs, and (2) the informativeness (signal-to-noise ratio) of the attribution score is an input to the payment mechanism. The framework yields a closed-form payment rule per creator and measures the welfare cost of inaccurate attribution for both creators and the platform. Whether the welfare-optimal contract is royalty-based or takes the form of fixed-fee licensing depends on how informative attribution is for that creator's catalog. We show that better attribution translates directly into welfare gains for both creators and the platform, yet under multi-platform competition a platform only captures gains from attribution improvements when its signal becomes the most precise in the market. To ground our framework in empirical behavior, we train acoustic and symbolic music generation models and measure the informativeness of scalable attribution techniques against a leave-one-catalog-out ground truth. Our experiments reveal that noisy attribution signals push payment toward fixed-fee licensing and diminish welfare for both creators and the platform, providing an economic motivation for further research on improved attribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生成式音乐市场中创作者补偿问题，提出一个基于数据归因（data attribution）的补偿框架，考虑创作者整个目录的归因和归因信噪比，推导出最优支付规则，并分析了归因准确性对福利的影响。实验使用音乐生成模型验证了噪声归因信号导致固定费用许可和福利损失。
Motivation: 生成式AI依赖于创作者数据，但现有补偿框架未考虑目录级归因和归因信号的统计特性，导致不公和低效。
Method: 提出一个市场框架，每个创作者的支付取决于其数据归因分数，并引入归因信息性（signal-to-noise ratio）作为输入，得到闭式支付规则，并分析福利成本。通过声学和符号音乐生成模型实验，测量可扩展归因技术的信息性。
Result: 摘要表明，归因准确性直接提升创作者和平台的福利；但在多平台竞争下，平台只有在其信号最精确时才能获益。实验显示噪声归因信号使支付偏向固定费用许可，降低福利。
Conclusion: 本文为改进归因提供了经济动机，强调提高归因信息性对公平补偿和市场效率的重要性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Uncertainty-aware tree height change regression
papers.abstract_en: Monitoring canopy height change is essential for understanding carbon sinks and forest dynamics. Remote sensing enables consistent, large-scale observations of such changes, increasingly integrated with deep learning architectures such as Geospatial Foundation Models (GFMs). However, existing methods and datasets frame the problem as binary change detection, which overlooks both the continuous nature of change, especially for vegetation, and the inherent uncertainty in labels. We present the Canopy Height Change (CHC) dataset, providing 3 $\mathrm{m}$ resolution continuous canopy height differences and associated spatially resolved uncertainties across 10598 $\mathrm{km}^2$ of northern and western Spain. The dataset is paired with a co-located time series of PlanetScope satellite imagery. Based on the dataset, we introduce the task of uncertainty-aware change regression, associated metrics and strategies for fine-tuning GFMs. Furthermore, we evaluate state-of-the-art GFMs and highlight promising directions and remaining challenges for advancing continuous canopy height change estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出不确定性感知的树冠高度变化回归任务，并发布了Canopy Height Change (CHC) 数据集，包含3米分辨率的连续冠层高度差异及其空间分辨率不确定性，覆盖西班牙北部和西部10598平方公里。数据集配有时间序列的PlanetScope卫星影像。作者基于该数据集，评估了多种地理空间基础模型（GFMs）在连续冠层高度变化估计上的表现，指出了有前景的方向和剩余挑战。
Motivation: 现有方法将冠层高度变化视为二元变化检测问题，忽略了变化的连续性和标签中的不确定性，难以准确估计碳汇和森林动态。
Method: 构建CHC数据集，提供连续冠层高度差异和空间分辨率不确定性；提出不确定性感知变化回归任务及相关评估指标，并设计微调地理空间基础模型的策略。
Result: 评估了多种最先进的地理空间基础模型，展示了连续冠层高度变化估计的潜力，同时指出了当前方法的局限性。
Conclusion: 该工作为连续冠层高度变化估计提供了基准数据集和方法框架，强调了不确定性建模的重要性，但仍有挑战需要进一步研究。

papers.title: Loss Smoothing for Stable Adaptation Under Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: In settings such as fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, neural networks are often adapted under distribution shift. Standard adaptation methods typically optimize the target objective directly, inducing an abrupt change from the source training objective. This abrupt transition can distort learned representations, including features that may still be useful for the new task. We investigate whether a more gradual transition can improve adaptation. We propose loss smoothing, a simple approach that interpolates between the source and target training objectives at the start of adaptation. This smooth transition helps to preserve useful features from the source distribution while still enabling the model to specialize to the target distribution. Across controlled supervised shifts, pretrained vision adaptation, offline-to-online and online reinforcement learning, and language model fine-tuning, we find that loss smoothing consistently improves performance, suggesting that smoother objective transitions are a broadly useful tool for model adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出损失平滑（loss smoothing）方法，通过在适应开始时插值源任务和目标训练目标，使目标过渡更平滑，从而在分布偏移下保留有用特征并提升适应性能。实验涵盖监督域偏移、预训练视觉适应、离线到在线及在线强化学习、语言模型微调，结果表明该方法持续改善性能。
Motivation: 标准适应方法直接优化目标目标，导致从源目标急剧切换，可能破坏仍对新任务有用的表示。需要更平滑的过渡。
Method: 损失平滑通过在适应开始时对源损失和目标损失进行线性插值，逐步过渡到纯目标损失。
Result: 在多种分布偏移设置（监督域偏移、预训练视觉、强化学习、语言模型微调）中，损失平滑持续提升适应性能。
Conclusion: 更平滑的目标过渡是一种广泛适用的模型适应工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AGI Maze as a Benchmark Framework for World-Modeling Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are powerful pattern-completion systems, but their default operating mode - predicting the next token from a static context - does not reliably produce persistent, manipulable representations of an external world. Many tasks that look like "reasoning" in text become substantially harder once the environment is partially observable, stateful, and requires memory and structured hypotheses about hidden state. AGI Maze is a lightweight framework for building such environments without requiring high-dimensional sensory inputs. It provides a family of grid-based maze tasks with a clean API and multiple difficulty regimes. The goal is to create benchmarks where agents must learn and use world state representations, not just infer a local rule over readily provided observations. We provide an initial evaluation of several vanilla LLMs on simple mazes showing that they fail to represent mazes internally at LLM inference time. We also introduce a baseline agent, which is allowed to use its message history as a working memory to construct descriptions of observations at agentic runtime. Although this can improve performance, it is still insufficient for an LLM agent to reliably solve even small mazes within a step budget that is more than enough for humans.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AGI Maze，一个轻量级框架，用于构建需要智能体学习并使用世界状态表示的网格迷宫任务。初步评估显示，标准LLM在推理时无法在内部表示迷宫，即使允许使用消息历史作为工作记忆，也无法在步数预算内可靠地解决小型迷宫。
Motivation: LLM在部分可观察、有状态且需要记忆和隐藏状态结构化假设的环境中表现不佳，缺乏持久且可操作的外部世界表示。
Method: 提出AGI Maze框架，提供一系列基于网格的迷宫任务，具有清晰的API和多难度机制，用于评估智能体的世界建模能力。
Result: 初步评估显示，标准LLM在推理时无法在内部表示迷宫；使用消息历史作为工作记忆的基线代理虽能提升性能，但仍无法在人类轻松的步数预算内可靠解决小迷宫。
Conclusion: AGI Maze可用于创建需要世界状态表示的基准，但当前LLM和简单基线代理尚不足以解决这类任务。

papers.title: Learning to Watch: Active Video Anomaly Understanding via Interleaved Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Video anomaly understanding (VAU) relies on sparse, context-dependent cues. However, existing passive paradigms suffer from observational aliasing, where static sampling fails to disambiguate semantically distinct events. To overcome this, we propose $Anom\text{-}π$, a closed-loop framework that reconceptualizes video understanding as an active sequential decision-making process within a dynamic environment. Inspired by human video-reviewing behavior, this framework unifies internal cognitive reasoning and strategic evidence acquisition into an interleaved policy, utilizing temporal atomic operators such as local backtracking, temporal expansion, and fine-grained sampling to endow the model with perceptual proactivity. To learn such complex interaction strategies under video-level weak supervision, we design Interactive Direct Preference Optimization (iDPO) to achieve trajectory-level policy alignment, guided by an Active Evidence Inquiry (AEI) utility that balances task success, informative evidence acquisition, and interaction cost. This approach enables the agent to learn to actively disambiguate hypotheses while suppressing redundant exploration. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework, with only 2B parameters, achieves highly competitive performance, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art large-scale VAU models in complex scenarios.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026; 25 pages, 8 figures, 15 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Anom-π，一种将视频异常理解重构为主动序列决策过程的闭环框架，利用时序原子操作（如局部回溯、时间扩展、细粒度采样）和内隐策略学习，在仅2B参数下超越大规模模型。通过交互式直接偏好优化（iDPO）和主动证据询问效用（AEI）实现轨迹级策略对齐。
Motivation: 现有被动视频理解方法因静态采样无法区分语义不同的异常事件，存在观测混淆问题。
Method: 提出 Anom-π 框架，将视频理解建模为动态环境中的主动序列决策，结合内隐认知推理与策略证据获取的交叉策略，并设计交互式直接偏好优化（iDPO）和主动证据询问效用（AEI）来训练策略。
Result: 在仅2B参数下，该框架在复杂场景中显著超越当前大规模视频异常理解模型，达到高度竞争性能。
Conclusion: 主动决策范式和轨迹级策略对齐可有效提升视频异常理解能力，且无需大规模参数。

papers.title: Identifying Latent Concepts and Structures for Generalized Category Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) aims to recognize known classes while autonomously discovering novel ones in open-world settings. However, current approaches primarily focus on designing clustering objectives, often overlooking a critical bottleneck: standard vision backbones yield high-rank, entangled token representations that are ill-suited for unsupervised discovery of latent concepts and structures. In this paper, we propose Compositional Primitive Fields (CPF-GCD), a novel representation learning framework that reshapes the feature space to make such latent structure identifiable by enforcing a low-rank compositional organization. Our core hypothesis is that all categories, whether known or novel, can be expressed as compositions and spatial arrangements of a finite set of learnable visual primitives that capture reusable concepts. CPF instantiates this geometric constraint via a spatial field mechanism. Inserted between the backbone and the head, it rewrites noisy patch tokens through low-rank primitive mixtures, effectively decomposing images into reusable atomic parts and their spatial layouts. By explicitly modeling the spatial distribution of primitives, CPF enables novel categories to emerge naturally as new activation patterns over a shared vocabulary. This shifts the focus of representation from merely partitioning global embeddings to constructing a structured and separable primitive field. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CPF serves as a generic, plug-and-play module that consistently boosts performance across diverse GCD baselines, validating that identifying and leveraging low-rank compositional structure is a crucial inductive bias for open-world recognition.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted by ICML2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Compositional Primitive Fields (CPF-GCD)，一种用于广义类别发现（GCD）的表征学习框架。核心思想是所有类别可由有限可学习视觉基元的组合与空间排列表示，并通过低秩组合约束重塑特征空间。在多个 GCD 基线中作为即插即用模块持续提升性能。
Motivation: 现有 GCD 方法主要关注聚类目标设计，但标准视觉骨干产生的高秩、纠缠的 token 表示不适用于无监督发现潜在概念和结构。
Method: 提出 CPF 模块，插入骨干与分类头之间，通过低秩基元混合重写噪声 patch token，将图像分解为可重复的原子部分及其空间布局。
Result: 实验表明 CPF 作为通用即插即用模块，在多种 GCD 基线上一致提升性能，验证了低秩组合结构作为开放世界识别的关键归纳偏置。
Conclusion: 本文强调识别和利用低秩组合结构是开放世界识别的重要归纳偏置，CPF 通过显式建模基元空间分布使新类别自然涌现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diffusion-Based Multi-Class Normality for OOD Detection: An Application to CDP Authentication
papers.abstract_en: Reconstruction-based generative models offer a natural framework for unsupervised out-of-distribution (OOD) detection, but multi-class normality modelling requires a single detector to capture multiple in-distribution manifolds and produce comparable anomaly scores across classes. We study this problem in copy detection pattern (CDP) authentication, where authentic and counterfeit samples are visually similar but differ in subtle printing-and-digitisation (P\&D) signatures. We propose a diffusion based multi-class normality framework in which a single class-conditional ControlNet is trained exclusively on authentic CDPs from multiple P\&D classes and detects counterfeits through reconstruction error under authentic-class conditioning. We further introduce dual template masking, which hides complementary regions of the input template and scores only withheld pixels, reducing reliance on visible binary structure. On the Indigo 1 x 1 Base dataset, the proposed method outperforms traditional and adapted generative baselines under multi-class authentic-versus-counterfeit evaluation, without using counterfeit samples for training or threshold calibration.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于扩散的多类正态性框架用于OOD检测，特别针对复制检测图案(CDP)认证。该方法使用类条件ControlNet仅在真实CDP上训练，通过重构误差检测伪造样本，并引入双模板掩码技术减少对可见二进制结构的依赖。在Indigo 1x1 Base数据集上，该方法在多类真伪评估中优于传统和生成式基线。
Motivation: 现有的基于重构的生成模型在无监督OOD检测中处理多类正态性时，难以用单一检测器捕捉多个类内分布并生成可比异常分数，而CDP认证中真假样本视觉相似但存在细微打印-数字化签名差异。
Method: 提出基于扩散的多类正态性框架：训练一个类条件ControlNet，仅使用来自多个P&D类的真实CDP，通过重构误差在真实类条件下检测伪造品；引入双模板掩码，隐藏输入模板的互补区域并仅对保留像素评分，减少对可见二进制结构的依赖。
Result: 在Indigo 1x1 Base数据集上，该方法在多类真伪评估中优于传统和生成式基线，且无需使用伪造样本进行训练或阈值校准。
Conclusion: 所提扩散框架有效解决了多类正态性建模和可比异常分数问题，在CDP认证中表现出色，但未讨论泛化到其他OOD检测任务的情况。

papers.title: Retrieved Images as Visual Thought: Training-Free Multimodal In-Context Learning for the Open-vs-Closed Gap
papers.abstract_en: Recent work on Thinking with Images makes vision a dynamic part of reasoning, but does so through generation: the model invokes external tools, synthesizes code, or imagines new imagery, each at the cost of a tool protocol, brittle code, or an expensive training pipeline. A fourth route makes vision dynamic without generating anything, by retrieving labeled exemplar images and reasoning over them, yet it remains underexplored despite being train-free. We present ReVisIT, a train-free framework that realizes this retrieval-based route by treating each retrieved image-label pair as a unit of visual thought. ReVisIT combines structured class definitions, per-query multimodal retrieval of exemplars, and alternating user/assistant injection of those exemplars before joint multi-attribute decoding, and degrades gracefully to whichever components a task admits. On VL-ICL Bench Fast Open MiniImageNet, Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B with ReVisIT reaches 98.5% at 4-shot, statistically indistinguishable from the 72B LLaVA-OneVision SOTA (98.7%) on this near-saturated task at about 1/2.4 the parameters, while the same backbone without the scaffold sits at chance. The turns layer alone adds 26.1 points to GPT-4.1 on free-form concept induction (Bongard-OpenWorld), and the full stack yields a 4-6 point macro gain across three backbones on MAAC-Bench, a new license-clean 27-class, 5-attribute benchmark, significant by paired bootstrap on the curator-derived attributes. Component analysis shows that retrieval-plus-turns is the universal lever while structured definitions are need-adaptive, and that 83% of the retrieval gain comes from retrieval quality rather than from the presence of exemplars. MAAC-Bench is released with a rubric-grounded LLM verification protocol that replaces author spot-check on subjective attributes.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 6 figures. Includes appendix. Introduces the MAAC-Bench benchmark
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ReVisIT，一种免训练框架，通过检索图像-标签对作为视觉思维单元，实现多模态上下文学习。方法结合结构化类定义、每查询多模态检索和交替用户/助手注入示例，然后进行联合多属性解码。在多个基准上，ReVisIT以较少参数达到或接近最先进水平，并在新基准MAAC-Bench上取得显著提升。

Method: 提出ReVisIT框架，包括结构化类定义、每查询多模态检索、交替注入示例和多属性联合解码，组件可灵活适配任务，且无需训练。
Result: 在VL-ICL Bench Fast Open MiniImageNet上，Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B达到98.5%准确率，接近72B LLaVA-OneVision的98.7%，参数仅为其约1/2.4。在Bongard-OpenWorld上，仅利用turns层提升GPT-4.1达26.1点。在MAAC-Bench上，全栈方法在三类骨干网络上宏观提升4-6点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调检索加turns是通用杠杆，结构化定义按需适配，83%的检索增益来自检索质量而非示例存在。MAAC-Bench附带基于规则的LLM验证协议。

papers.title: Auditing Forgetting in Limited Memory Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Limited Memory Language Models (LMLMs) externalize factual knowledge to a database to enable deletion-based unlearning without retraining. Existing evaluations measure post-deletion correctness in aggregate and cannot tell whether a deleted fact persists through residual parametric memory, alternative retrieval paths, or near-neighbor retrieval artifacts. We propose a causal auditing framework that holds the model fixed and varies the database state at inference time across three interventions: FULL, DEL-ON, and DEL-OFF. The framework decomposes post-deletion behavior into parametric leakage L(f), retrieval-mediated correctness R(f), and a retrieval artifact rate grounded in the inference-time retrieval trace. We apply it to 12,228 alias-closure deletions across thirteen databases, including four adversarial topologies (Base, Alias, Noise, Collision) we construct in three domains, and six prompt formulations. Parametric leakage is near zero in every variant and every prompt style: the model rarely returns the deleted answer in the absence of retrieval. The residual that does survive lives in the retrieval graph: retrieval-mediated correctness and the retrieval artifact rate match within rounding everywhere, so post-deletion correctness is, in our audit, predominantly reconstituted from near-neighbor retrieval. This residual ranges from 0.7% on the released LMLM database to 13.6% on the most adversarial variant, and prompt formulation does not independently control how much of a deleted fact survives. These results suggest that, for this class of LMLM and deletion procedure, the unlearning boundary is drawn primarily by the database administrator rather than by the model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对有限记忆语言模型（LMLM）的遗忘审计提出因果框架，通过三种数据库状态干预（FULL、DEL-ON、DEL-OFF）分解遗忘后行为为参数泄露、检索介导正确性和检索伪像率。在12,228次别名闭包删除实验中，参数泄露几乎为零，残余正确性主要来自邻近检索，范围从0.7%（标准数据库）到13.6%（对抗性变体），表明遗忘界限主要由数据库管理员而非模型决定。
Motivation: 现有评估仅宏观衡量删除后正确性，无法区分残留知识来自参数记忆、替代检索路径还是邻近检索伪像，导致无法准确判断模型是否真正遗忘。
Method: 提出因果审计框架，固定模型参数并在推理时改变数据库状态（全量、删除开启、删除关闭），通过检索跟踪量化参数泄露、检索介导正确性和检索伪像率。
Result: 在12,228次别名闭包删除实验中，参数泄露在所有变体和提示风格下接近零；残余正确性完全来自检索图，检索伪像率与检索介导正确性一致，范围0.7%-13.6%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，对于此类LMLM及删除过程，遗忘界限主要由数据库管理员的设计决定，而非模型自身参数控制。

papers.title: Measuring Dead Directions: Decomposing and Classifying Singular Structure off Canonical Alignment
papers.abstract_en: We give a descent-free, alignment-free measurement of singular structure on trained networks. At a single frozen checkpoint the read recovers the order $k$ of each dead direction from the directional-Fisher rate, the master invariant from which the per-direction learning coefficient $1/(2k)$ follows exactly, in whatever basis the optimizer left. The same read classifies each direction, separating a genuine singularity, whose order the architecture fixes, from a flat gauge symmetry; the directional-Fisher magnitude settles the cases the order cannot. A pluggable detector supplies the directions for transformer, convolutional, and normalisation layers. The read recovers the architecture-predicted order across constructed cells and trained networks, including a fine-tuned vision transformer whose dead structure is the LayerNorm-kernel gauge and a from-scratch one whose compressed MLP forms a node-death at its activation order. Where the singular structure enumerates, the per-direction orders assemble, through the typed intersection of the loci, into the global coefficient $(λ, m)$ matching the closed form. The method removes the canonical-alignment and descent preconditions of the underlying rate result, turning order-recovery into a deterministic, architecture-general reading. We then map its reach into the Watanabe triple: the order determines the universal singular fluctuation $ν(k)$, though a trained network's realized $ν$ falls below it as the live structure absorbs the dead direction's data fluctuation, and the multiplicity recovers from the dominant structure under a single-locus assumption.
papers.comment: 45 pages, 14 figures, 19 tables. Methods and empirical companion to arXiv:2606.05957 (Dead Directions: Geometric Singular Learning)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需梯度下降和对齐的测量方法，可从单个冻结检查点恢复神经网络中每个死方向（dead direction）的阶数k，并分类方向是真正的奇点还是平直规范对称性。该方法通过方向Fisher率（directional-Fisher rate）精确计算每个方向的学习系数1/(2k)，且适用于Transformer、卷积和归一化层。实验验证了架构预测的阶数，并揭示了微调ViT中的LayerNorm核规范奇点和从头训练ViT中MLP压缩导致的节点死亡。最后，方法映射到Watanabe三元组，揭示了奇点阶数与通用奇异涨落ν(k)的关系。
Motivation: 现有方法需要规范对齐和下降轨迹才能从学习率恢复奇点结构，本文试图移除这些前提，实现确定性的、架构通用的奇点阶数测量。
Method: 提出无下降、无对齐的测量方法，利用方向Fisher率从单个冻结检查点计算每个死方向的阶数k，并通过幅值区分真正奇点和平直规范对称性；设计可插拔检测器为Transformer、卷积和归一化层提供方向。
Result: 在构造的细胞和训练网络上恢复架构预测的阶数，包括微调ViT的LayerNorm核规范奇点和从头训练ViT的MLP节点死亡。全局系数(λ, m)与闭式匹配。方法揭示了训练网络的实现ν低于理论泛化涨落。
Conclusion: 该方法将奇点阶数恢复变为确定性、架构通用的过程，并建立了与Watanabe三元组的联系，但假设主结构决定多重性。

papers.title: Semantic-Guided Reading Order Reconstruction in Historical Armenian Newspapers with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses reading order reconstruction in historical Armenian newspapers, which combine complex layouts with limited language resources. We introduce a new annotated dataset of 66 pages and compare geometric heuristics, YOLO-based layout parsing, an end-to-end document model ECLAIR, and a hybrid method combining semantic zone detection with a generative LLM. Our hybrid method achieves the lowest error rates of all evaluated approaches, reducing ordering errors by up to 76% over the strongest geometric baseline, and remains robust in multi-page settings and under noisy OCR. Rather than targeting production the method is designed as a data bootstrapping strategy enabling rapid annotation in highly under-resourced scenarios. Alongside the dataset, we release a specialized Tesseract OCR model for historical Armenian print.
papers.comment: International Conference on Pattern Recognition, 2026, Lyon, France
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对历史亚美尼亚报纸的阅读顺序重建问题，提出了一种结合语义区域检测和生成式大语言模型（LLM）的混合方法。在自建的66页标注数据集上，该方法比几何基线减少高达76%的排序错误，并在多页面和噪声OCR下保持稳健。该方法旨在作为数据引导策略，适用于资源极度匮乏的场景。
Motivation: 历史亚美尼亚报纸布局复杂且语言资源有限，现有方法难以有效重建阅读顺序。需要一种在低资源条件下高效且鲁棒的解决方案。
Method: 提出混合方法：首先使用语义区域检测（基于YOLO）识别文本块，然后利用生成式LLM（如GPT）推理其逻辑阅读顺序。与几何启发式、纯YOLO布局解析和端到端文档模型ECLAIR进行对比。
Result: 混合方法在所有评估方法中实现最低错误率，排序错误相比最强几何基线降低76%，且在多页文档和OCR噪声场景下表现一致。
Conclusion: 该方法并非生产级系统，而是作为数据引导策略，可在高度资源匮乏的场景下快速生成标注。同时发布66页数据集和针对历史亚美尼亚印刷体的Tesseract OCR模型。

summary_sections.method: 提出混合方法：首先使用语义区域检测（基于YOLO）识别文本块，然后利用生成式LLM（如GPT）推理其逻辑阅读顺序。与几何启发式、纯YOLO布局解析和端到端文档模型ECLAIR进行对比。
summary_sections.result: 混合方法在所有评估方法中实现最低错误率，排序错误相比最强几何基线降低76%，且在多页文档和OCR噪声场景下表现一致。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法并非生产级系统，而是作为数据引导策略，可在高度资源匮乏的场景下快速生成标注。同时发布66页数据集和针对历史亚美尼亚印刷体的Tesseract OCR模型。

papers.title: GADA: Geometry-Aware Deformable Aggregation for Image-Based Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian Splatting has achieved significant improvements by incorporating warping-based techniques. However, such methods suffer from pixel-level inaccuracies due to uncertain geometry. This uncertainty leads to spatial misalignments in the warped images, which disrupt residual learning used in warping-based methods and fundamentally limit the gains of correction, particularly on thin structures and high-frequency details. Driven by our insight that useful visual cues are not lost but locally preserved under slight displacement, we propose Geometry-Aware Deformable Aggregation (GADA). This method introduces an iterative refinement module with deformable offsets to actively correct spatial misalignments and recover these displaced cues. Furthermore, to address the limitations of standard pipelines where visibility checks (i.e., thresholding) often discard valid pixels and multi-view warped image fusion relies on naive mean aggregation, our module is coupled with an implicit confidence weighting mechanism that selectively suppresses unreliable evidence. Consequently, our approach outperforms prior warping-based Gaussian Splatting, preserving high-frequency quality while achieving 2.13 times faster FPS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 基于图像的高斯泼溅方法在融合扭曲图像时存在像素级空间错位问题，本文提出几何感知可变形聚合（GADA），通过可变形偏移和隐式置信度加权机制来校正错位并恢复高频细节。在基准测试上，该方法在保持高质量的同时实现了2.13倍的FPS提升。
Motivation: 现有基于扭曲的高斯泼溅方法由于不确定的几何导致像素级不准确，进而造成空间错位，影响残差学习，尤其在薄结构和高频细节上提升受限。
Method: 提出几何感知可变形聚合（GADA），包含迭代精炼模块，使用可变形偏移主动校正空间错位；同时引入隐式置信度加权机制，抑制不可靠证据，替代传统的阈值化可见性检查和均值融合。
Result: GADA在多个基准上优于先前的基于扭曲的高斯泼溅方法，保留高频质量的同时实现了2.13倍的FPS加速。
Conclusion: 本文表明通过可变形偏移和置信度加权可以有效解决扭曲图像中的空间错位问题，提升高斯泼溅性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Optimal scaling of MCMC algorithms: exploiting the symmetry of the Metropolis-Hastings formula
papers.abstract_en: We present a simple, yet general approach to study the scaling properties as the dimensionality of Metropolised MCMC sampling algorithms increases. The study relies ultimately on the symmetry of the Metropolis-Hastings formula. Our findings contain, as particular cases, many known results for the Random Walk Metropolis, MALA and other algorithms. In addition, they provide, in an easy way, new optimal scaling results for a variety of proposal mechanisms, including implicit proposals and proposals generated with the help of differential equation integrators. The analysis applies to targets that are products of a given, not necessarily univariate distribution, and also to cases where the different terms in the product are scaled differently. We show how to construct gradient-based MALA-like proposals where the variance of the proposal as the dimension $d$ increases may be taken as $O(1/d^μ)$, with $μ>0$ arbitrarily small, to be compared with the values $μ= 1$ for Random Walk Metropolis and $μ=1/3$ for MALA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Metropolis-Hastings公式对称性的通用方法，研究MCMC算法在高维目标分布下的最优标度性质。该方法统一了随机游走Metropolis、MALA等算法的已有结果，并轻松推导了隐式提议、微分方程积分器生成提议等新机制的标度律。分析适用于乘积型目标分布，且允许不同分量不同尺度。特别地，展示了如何构造MALA类梯度提议，使其方差随维度d的衰减阶数μ可任意接近于0，而RWM和MALA分别对应μ=1和μ=1/3。
Motivation: 现有MCMC算法最优标度结果分散且推导复杂，缺乏统一框架。作者希望利用Metropolis-Hastings公式的对称性，简化并推广标度分析，覆盖更广泛的提议机制和目标分布。
Method: 基于Metropolis-Hastings接受概率的对称分解，建立接受率与提议方差、目标分布维度的通用关系，通过扩散极限分析得到标度率。
Result: 证明了隐式提议和微分方程积分器提议的最优标度，并指出梯度基MALA提议的方差标度可达到O(1/d^μ)且μ任意小，优于RWM的O(1/d)和MALA的O(1/d^{1/3})。
Conclusion: 该统一框架揭示了MCMC算法标度行为背后的对称性根源，为设计高维采样算法提供了理论指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How Environment and Urbanization Shape Bird Diversity in Sri Lanka
papers.abstract_en: This study presents a comprehensive analysis of bird diversity across Sri Lanka by integrating spatial, temporal, and environmental data. Bird observation records were combined with environmental variables, including weather conditions, air pollution, the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), land cover, elevation, and Artificial Light At Night (ALAN), and rigorously preprocessed to ensure data quality. Spatial analyses were conducted on multiple grid scales (2 km, 5 km, 10 km) to evaluate patterns in species richness while minimizing sampling bias through spatial thinning. Temporal trends were assessed using effort-corrected metrics including rarefied richness and occupancy rates to account for variations in observation effort over time. Environmental drivers of bird diversity were examined using multivariate statistical models, including Poisson Generalized Linear Models (GLMs) and correlation analyses, to identify key associations between ecological factors and species richness. Additionally, community structure, dominance patterns, and beta diversity were analyzed to understand variations in species composition across regions and time. The study found that land-cover type is a stronger predictor of bird diversity than individual continuous variables such as NDVI or temperature alone. Urbanization, measured by ALAN, exhibits nuanced scale-dependent effects, supporting high abundances of a few generalist species while reducing overall richness. The findings provide actionable insights into the patterns and drivers of avian diversity in Sri Lanka, offering a scalable and reproducible framework for biodiversity research and conservation planning.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. IEEE conference paper. Dept. of Computer Science and Engineering, University of Moratuwa, Sri Lanka. Dataset and code publicly available on Hugging Face and GitHub
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该研究整合斯里兰卡的鸟类观测记录与环境变量（天气、空气污染、NDVI、土地覆盖、海拔、夜间人工光照），通过空间稀疏化、时间趋势校正和多元统计模型（泊松GLM）分析鸟类多样性模式。结果表明：土地覆盖类型比单一连续变量（如NDVI或温度）更能预测鸟类多样性；城市化（以夜间光照衡量）呈现尺度依赖效应，支持少数泛化种的高丰度但降低整体丰富度。
Motivation: 斯里兰卡鸟类多样性受城市化与土地利用变化影响，但缺乏综合空间、时间与环境数据的系统分析，现有研究未充分控制采样偏差和观测努力差异。
Method: 结合多源环境变量（天气、污染、NDVI、土地覆盖、海拔、夜间光照），在2km/5km/10km网格上进行空间分析并执行空间稀疏化减少采样偏差；采用努力校正指标（稀疏化丰富度、占有率）评估时间趋势；运用泊松广义线性模型（GLM）和相关性分析识别环境驱动因子，并分析群落结构、优势度和beta多样性。
Result: 土地覆盖类型是鸟类丰富度的最强预测因子；城市化（ALAN）在高丰度下支持少数泛化种，但降低整体丰富度，效应具有尺度依赖性。
Conclusion: 研究提出了一个可扩展且可复现的分析框架，为斯里兰卡鸟类多样性保护和规划提供定量依据，但方法依赖于观测数据质量且未涉及降水等动态气象变量。

papers.title: Decision-focused Sparse Tangent Portfolio Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Sparse tangent portfolio optimization aims to learn an interpretable, low-cardinality portfolio in the tangency direction of the mean-variance frontier. However, the associated cardinality-constrained formulation is NP-hard, and standard predict-then-optimize pipelines often misalign forecasting accuracy with downstream portfolio quality. We propose an end-to-end decision-focused learning framework that reformulates Sharpe ratio maximization as a Disciplined Parametrized Programming (DPP)-compliant convex programming layer and replaces discrete selection with a smooth top-$k$ operator enforcing an exact cardinality $k$. This enables gradient flow through prediction, asset selection, and re-optimization, allowing the predictive model to directly optimize portfolio performance. Across four major equity markets, our method achieves competitive and often superior out-of-sample Sharpe ratios compared with historical and prediction-focused baselines, with particularly strong gains in larger asset universes. Our \href{https://github.com/feuerwerksh/Diffble-card-SR}{code} is publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对稀疏切线投资组合优化问题，提出了一种端到端的决策聚焦学习框架，将夏普比率最大化重构为符合DPP的凸规划层，并用平滑top-k算子替代离散选择，实现精确基数k。在四个主要股票市场中，该方法取得了有竞争力的样本外夏普比率。
Motivation: 标准预测-优化流程常将预测准确性与下游投资组合质量不一致，且基数约束的优化是NP困难的。
Method: 提出决策聚焦学习框架，将夏普比率最大化作为DPP兼容的凸规划层，使用平滑top-k算子强制精确基数k，实现梯度通过预测、资产选择和再优化流动。
Result: 在四个主要股票市场，该方法相对于历史和预测基准取得了有竞争力的甚至更优的样本外夏普比率，在较大资产池中尤其突出。
Conclusion: 该方法通过直接优化投资组合性能，实现了与下游目标一致的稀疏投资组合学习。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Active Spatial Guidance: Eliminating Injected Positional Mechanisms in Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) commonly rely on injected positional mechanisms to address self-attention's permutation invariance. Motivated by the spatial regularities of natural images, we ask whether spatial organization can be induced from data rather than explicitly injected. Under controlled, matched from-scratch training, we propose Active Spatial Guidance (Guidance), a training-only objective that disables positional injection and applies an auxiliary 2D coordinate-regression loss to the final-layer patch tokens. The guidance head is used only during training and removed for inference; the deployed model consists of a positional-injection-free ViT encoder and the task-specific prediction module. Using DINOv3 ViT backbones, Guidance consistently improves performance on ImageNet-100 classification, ADE20K semantic segmentation, and Hypersim monocular depth estimation, outperforming strong injected baselines such as learned absolute positional embeddings and rotary positional embeddings under identical training protocols. On ImageNet-100, broader comparisons against representative injected positional designs further support Guidance's effectiveness. Guidance also improves robustness under resolution transfer, and multi-resolution training further strengthens accuracy across input sizes. Overall, our results suggest that spatial inductive bias in ViTs need not be architecturally injected, but can be shaped through training-time supervision. The code used for training and evaluation is publicly available in https://github.com/cloudlc/asg.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Active Spatial Guidance (Guidance)，一种仅在训练时使用的辅助目标，通过 2D 坐标回归损失引导 ViT 从数据中学习空间结构，从而完全消除架构中的显式位置注入机制。在 DINOv3 骨干上，Guidance 在 ImageNet-100 分类、ADE20K 语义分割和 Hypersim 单目深度估计上均优于学习绝对位置编码和旋转位置编码等强基线，并提升了分辨率迁移鲁棒性。代码已开源。
Motivation: 视觉 Transformer 通常依赖注入式位置机制来打破自注意力的排列不变性，但自然图像本身具有空间规律性，作者质疑能否通过数据驱动的方式隐式学习空间组织，而非显式注入。
Method: 提出 Active Spatial Guidance，在训练时对最终层的 patch token 附加一个辅助 2D 坐标回归损失，推理时移除该引导头；模型主体为无位置注入的 ViT 编码器加任务预测模块。
Result: 在 ImageNet-100 上，Guidance 比学习绝对位置嵌入和旋转位置嵌入等基线表现更好；在 ADE20K 分割和 Hypersim 深度估计上也取得一致提升；同时提高了分辨率迁移鲁棒性，多分辨率训练进一步增强了各输入尺寸下的准确率。
Conclusion: 结果表明，ViT 中的空间归纳偏置不必通过架构注入，而可以通过训练时的监督信号来塑造。
Relevance: 0
