papers.title: EPO: Boosting 3D Foundation Models with Edge-based Pose Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We introduce \textbf{Edge-based Pose Optimization (EPO)}, a trackless geometric optimization framework specifically designed to boost the Structure-from-Motion reconstructions generated by 3D Foundation Models. These models achieve rapid inference by bypassing the time-consuming feature extraction and matching stages of traditional pipelines, where explicit correspondences between each 3D point and multiple images, referred to as tracks, are established. However, their geometric accuracy currently falls short of traditional pipelines. While this can be addressed in a post-processing step via Bundle Adjustment-like refinement, doing so requires extracting feature tracks, thus defeating the original speed advantage. Instead, our fully differentiable framework uses edge map alignment as a proxy for geometric optimization, avoiding feature extraction and track construction entirely. Through extensive evaluation across multiple datasets and tasks, we demonstrate that EPO matches or outperforms Bundle Adjustment-like methods while requiring significantly lower runtime and memory. Notably, its reduced memory footprint makes EPO suitable for consumer-grade hardware, where competing refinement methods cannot run.

papers.title: Caption Bottleneck Models
papers.abstract_en: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) provide interpretability by routing predictions through a layer of human-understandable concepts. However, defining an optimal concept set for a specific dataset remains an open challenge. Existing approaches rely on expensive expert annotations or LLM-generated lists based solely on class names. Even "open-vocabulary" variants typically depend on static concept sets, which restrict discovery and introduce label bias. Furthermore, traditional CBMs often suffer from information leakage, where unmodeled visual features bypass the bottleneck and compromise the integrity of the explanations. To overcome these limitations, we propose Caption Bottleneck Models (CaBM), a framework that circumvents the need for predefined concept sets by replacing rigid concept layers with free-form natural language. By representing images via LMM-generated captions and training a classifier strictly on this text, CaBM ensures a leakage-free architecture by construction. Additionally, by analyzing the text classifier post-training, CaBM autonomously discovers high-quality, dataset-specific concepts. Our results across fine- and coarse-grained benchmarks demonstrate that CaBM achieves competitive accuracy while preserving interpretability without the constraints of external dictionaries or manual labeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Caption Bottleneck Models (CaBM)，用大语言模型生成的自由文本描述替代传统概念瓶颈模型中的预定义概念集，通过仅在文本上训练分类器确保架构无信息泄露，并能在训练后自动发现高质量数据集特定概念。在细粒度与粗粒度基准上，CaBM 在保持可解释性的同时达到有竞争力的准确率。
Motivation: 传统概念瓶颈模型依赖专家标注或基于类名的LLM列表定义概念集，存在标签偏差、信息泄露和静态概念限制可发现性等问题。
Method: 用大型多模态模型 (LMM) 生成图像描述，将描述作为唯一输入训练文本分类器，从而绕过预定义概念层；训练后通过分析文本分类器自主发现概念。
Result: 在细粒度和粗粒度分类基准上，CaBM 达到与现有方法竞争的分类准确率，同时保持可解释性。
Conclusion: CaBM 无需外部字典或人工标注即可实现可解释分类，并自动发现数据集特定概念，但摘要未讨论在复杂场景或开放世界中的局限性。

papers.title: BrainFIBRE: A Foundation Model via Information Decomposition for Brain Microstructure
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion MRI probes brain microstructure with particular sensitivity to early cerebrovascular and neurodegenerative changes. Neurite Orientation Dispersion and Density Imaging (NODDI) decomposes the diffusion signal into three biophysically interpretable maps: neurite density index (NDI), orientation dispersion index (ODI), and free water fraction (FWF), capturing neurite packing, fiber coherence, and extracellular fluid. These 3D maps offer a rich substrate for transferable microstructural representations, yet integrating them is challenging: standard representation learning struggles to disentangle the unique information in each map from their shared and synergistic interactions. We present BrainFIBRE, the first foundation model for brain microstructure, pretrained on NODDI-derived maps from 55,592 UK Biobank participants. We propose Self-supervised Partial Information Decomposition (SPID), which extends PID-guided multimodal learning to the self-supervised regime for the first time. A novel Counterfactual Candidate Construction (CCC) paradigm perturbs inter-modality alignment through modality dropping and swapping, providing the contrastive signal for a Mixture-of-Experts architecture to disentangle unique, synergistic, and redundant information without any downstream label. On both Caucasian and Asian cohorts, BrainFIBRE achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse tasks predicting age, sex, cerebrovascular and neurodegenerative markers, and cognition, while yielding neurobiologically interpretable representations that reveal task- and cohort-specific interaction patterns. BrainFIBRE establishes a versatile foundation for neuroimaging analysis at the microstructural level.
papers.comment: ECCV 2026. The first three authors contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BrainFIBRE，首个脑微观结构基础模型，基于NODDI（神经突方向分散和密度成像）的三张生物物理图（NDI、ODI、FWF）。通过自监督部分信息分解（SPID）和反事实候选构建（CCC）范式，利用Mixture-of-Experts架构解耦各图的唯一、协同和冗余信息。在55,592名UK Biobank数据上预训练后，在多种预测任务（年龄、性别、脑血管及神经退行性标记、认知）上达到最优性能，并产生神经生物学可解释的表征。
Motivation: 标准表征学习难以区分多模态脑微观结构图谱中的独特信息和共享/协同交互，限制了迁移学习的有效性。
Method: 提出Self-supervised Partial Information Decomposition (SPID)，首次将部分信息分解（PID）引入自监督多模态学习；结合Counterfactual Candidate Construction (CCC)范式，通过模态丢弃和交换扰动模态对齐，为Mixture-of-Experts提供对比信号以解耦信息。
Result: 在55,592名UK Biobank参与者上预训练，在多种任务（年龄、性别、脑血管及神经退行性标记、认知）上，在白种人和亚洲人群中都达到最先进性能，并揭示任务和队列特异的交互模式。
Conclusion: BrainFIBRE建立了微观层面神经影像分析的通用基础，其可解释表征有助于理解脑微结构与临床表型的关联。

papers.title: HARC: Coupling Harmfulness and Refusal Directions for Robust Safety Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how aligned LLMs internally represent safety is critical for diagnosing alignment vulnerabilities, as it explains why jailbreaks succeed and informs the design of robust alignment strategies. Prior work shows that aligned LLMs encode harmfulness and refusal as separable directions in the residual stream at prompt-side token positions. We show that jailbreaks succeed at prompt encoding by suppressing either the refusal or harmfulness direction before any token is generated, with distinct attack classes occupying separable regions of the harmfulness-refusal plane. Extending the analysis to response-token positions, we find that the model recognizes harmful content while it is generating that content, even when it failed to recognize the input as harmful at the prompt side. Motivated by our findings, we introduce HARC (Harmfulness-And-Refusal Coupling), a fine-tuning method that pairs the two directions across both prompt and response positions. Since the intervention is confined to the harmfulness-refusal subspace, it leaves the rest of the residual stream intact and does not degrade general capability or inflate over-refusal. Across extensive experiments, HARC achieves the strongest robustness-capability-usability trade-off among six baselines spanning the major training-time and inference-time safety methods. The harmfulness and refusal directions at prompt and response positions transfer across the five model families and two scales we tested without architecture-specific tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了对齐LLM内部安全表示中的有害性（harmfulness）和拒绝（refusal）方向，发现越狱攻击通过抑制这些方向成功。提出HARC（Harmfulness-And-Refusal Coupling）微调方法，通过耦合提示侧和响应侧的这两个方向来增强鲁棒性，同时保持通用能力和避免过度拒绝。实验表明，HARC在多个基准测试中实现了最强的鲁棒性-能力-可用性权衡。
Motivation: 理解对齐LLM的内部安全表示对于诊断对齐漏洞和设计鲁棒对齐策略至关重要，现有工作发现有害性和拒绝方向是可分离的，但攻击如何利用这些方向尚不清楚。
Method: 提出HARC微调方法，通过联合优化提示位置和响应位置的有害性与拒绝方向对，将干预限制在有害性-拒绝子空间中，不影响残差流的其余部分。
Result: 在六个基线方法（涵盖训练时和推理时安全方法）中，HARC实现了最佳的鲁棒性-能力-可用性权衡，且有害性和拒绝方向在五个模型家族和两个规模上无需架构调整即可迁移。
Conclusion: HARC通过耦合有害性和拒绝方向显著提升安全性，同时不降低通用能力或导致过度拒绝，其方向可跨模型迁移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Methodology for Investigating AI Patterns Prevalence in Software Repositories
papers.abstract_en: As Artificial Intelligence(AI)-based applications take off, a clear understanding of AI patterns can uplift the quality of AI applications. Many AI patterns have been proposed in the literature; however, their prevalence in real-life code has not yet been validated. Understanding the actual use of those patterns in practice can clarify our understanding both of the significance of these patterns and their utility. In this paper, we present a methodology to a) identify relevant patterns by mining the literature and then to b) validate their presence and prevalence in actual code repositories using active learning. To that end, we identify 14 AI pattern classes by mining 44 published AI pattern-related sources. Then we use an active learning approach to determine the prevalence of the most common pattern class across 100 GitHub open AI repositories. Using prevalence estimation, we propose bounds on the accuracy of the occurrences. The model achieves 56\% accuracy and 55\% recall in an 8-way classification task, significantly outperforming the 11\% random-chance baseline. Furthermore, the prevalence estimation offers usable bounds for analyzing pattern applications. This methodology provides a robust foundation to start understanding how AI patterns are used in practice, a field that currently lacks empirical data.
papers.comment: Published in PATTERNS 2026 : The Eighteenth International Conference on Pervasive Patterns and Applications
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种方法论，通过文献挖掘识别AI模式，并利用主动学习验证其在真实代码仓库中的普遍性。作者从44个AI模式相关来源中提取出14个模式类别，针对最常见的模式在100个GitHub开源AI仓库中进行普遍性估计。分类任务达到56%准确率和55%召回率，显著优于随机基线，同时普遍性估计为分析提供了有效界限。该研究填补了AI模式实际应用缺乏经验数据的空白。
Motivation: 虽然文献中提出了许多AI模式，但其在实际代码中的普及程度尚未被验证。理解这些模式在实践中的真实使用情况，有助于厘清其重要性和实用性。
Method: 方法论分为两步：一是通过系统挖掘文献识别AI模式类别；二是采用主动学习方法，在开源代码仓库中验证模式的普遍性。具体识别了14个模式类别，并选择最常见的类别在100个GitHub仓库中进行标注和分类，利用普遍性估计给出发生率的可信区间。
Result: 在8-way分类任务上，模型准确率56%、召回率55%，远高于11%的随机基线；普遍性估计提供了适用于分析模式应用的可量化界限。
Conclusion: 该工作为理解AI模式在实际软件开发中的使用情况建立了稳健的方法论基础，弥补了该领域缺乏经验数据的不足。

papers.title: Group-Equivariant Poincaré Convolutional Networks
papers.abstract_en: While recent advancements like the Poincaré ResNet have demonstrated the potential of learning visual representations directly in hyperbolic space, their optimisation remains hampered by the computationally intensive nature of Riemannian gradients and the strict boundaries of the manifold. Furthermore, standard hyperbolic networks treat spatial transformations of the same object as distinct hierarchical concepts, leading to redundant parameter usage and vanishing signals. We propose Equivariant Poincaré ResNets, combining hyperbolic geometry with discrete symmetry groups ($C_4$ and $D_4$). We identify critical roadblocks in applying Euclidean equivariance to hyperbolic space and propose geometrically safe tensor reshaping, left-regular permutations for hyperbolic group convolutions, and joint-orientation Poincaré Midpoint Batch normalisation. Empirically, embedding equivariance drastically reduces the optimisation space, accelerating convergence while accelerating convergence while respecting the boundary constraints of the Poincaré ball and preserving spatial-group equivariance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Equivariant Poincaré ResNets，将群等变性（C4, D4）引入双曲空间中的视觉表示学习，通过几何安全的张量重塑、左正则置换用于双曲群卷积以及联合定向 Poincaré 中点批归一化，克服了双曲网络优化困难的问题，加速收敛并保持空间群等变性。
Motivation: 现有双曲网络（如 Poincaré ResNet）因黎曼梯度计算昂贵和流形边界约束而优化困难，且将同一对象的不同空间变换视为不同层次概念，导致参数冗余和信号消失。
Method: 提出组合双曲几何与离散对称群（C4, D4）的等变网络，包括几何安全的张量重塑、左正则置换实现双曲群卷积，以及联合定向 Poincaré 中点批归一化。
Result: 嵌入群等变性显著减少优化空间，加速收敛，同时尊重 Poincaré 球的边界约束并保持空间群等变性。
Conclusion: 该方法在双曲空间中有效结合等变性，改善了优化效率和表示能力。

papers.title: Cross-Domain Generalization Failure in Lightweight Intrusion Detection Models for IIoT Networks
papers.abstract_en: Lightweight machine learning models are increasingly proposed for intrusion detection in Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) networks due to their suitability for resource-constrained edge deployment. Most reported results evaluate these models only within their training network, leaving behavior on unseen networks unverified. This study trains four lightweight architectures on one IIoT dataset and evaluates them, without retraining, on two structurally distinct IIoT datasets using a feature representation restricted to attributes available across all three sources. Explainability analysis across two top-performing models shows both rely overwhelmingly on coarse port-category features; the most influential category occurs in source-domain attack traffic at 96 to 435 times the rate in the two target domains, indicating that coarsening port resolution relocates rather than removes a documented shortcut. Evaluation under naturally imbalanced class distributions reveals a further effect: the evaluation protocol used can reverse which target network appears to pose the greater generalization challenge. Adversarial robustness and recovery through limited target-domain exposure are also assessed; robustness to adversarial perturbation is unrelated to cross-network generalization, and recovery through adaptation varies considerably by architecture. These findings suggest deployment readiness should be assessed using cross-network evaluation under realistic class distributions, rather than within-domain accuracy alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究轻量级IIoT入侵检测模型的跨域泛化问题。训练四种轻量级架构在一个IIoT数据集上，评估在两个不同结构的IIoT数据集上，使用受限特征表示。可解释性分析发现模型过度依赖粗端口类别特征，源域该特征出现频率比目标域高96-435倍，表明粗化端口分辨率只是转移了捷径。评估协议（类别分布）可改变对哪个目标域更难的评价。对抗鲁棒性与跨网络泛化无关，恢复能力因架构而异。
Motivation: 现有轻量级入侵检测模型通常仅在同一网络内评估，其在未见网络上的泛化行为未经验证，可能导致部署失败。
Method: 训练四种轻量级架构（具体未命名）在一个IIoT数据集上，使用跨三个数据集共有的特征表示，在另外两个数据集上零样本评估，并进行可解释性分析、对抗鲁棒性测试和有限目标域暴露恢复。
Result: 模型过度依赖粗端口类别特征（源域频率为目标域96-435倍）；粗化端口分辨率未消除捷径；评估协议（自然不平衡分布）可逆转哪个目标域更具挑战性；对抗鲁棒性与跨网络泛化无关；恢复能力因架构而异。
Conclusion: 部署准备度应使用跨网络评估和真实类别分布来评估，而非仅依赖域内准确率。

papers.title: EgoGapBench: Benchmarking Egocentric Action Selection in Multi-Agent Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Existing egocentric benchmarks have primarily constructed the egocentric setting from first-person-view data, which makes it difficult to evaluate egocentric perspective itself in isolation. However, understanding first-person-view input and taking an egocentric perspective are separable abilities, especially when first-person body cues are absent or when other agents are present. To isolate egocentric perspective understanding, we introduce EgoGapBench, a diagnostic benchmark for measuring action selection in multi-agent egocentric scenes. We define the ability measured by this benchmark as Egocentric Action Selection (EAS): selecting an appropriate action from the agent's perspective in the presence of other agents. On EgoGapBench, humans answer reliably, whereas both open-source and proprietary MLLMs perform substantially worse and systematically select actions performed by other visible agents. Fine-tuning on existing egocentric data fails to close this gap and can even be detrimental. In contrast, fine-tuning on EgoGapBench training data improves accuracy but does not reach human performance. These results show that EAS is difficult to acquire from first-person-view data alone, and that MLLMs should be evaluated and trained not only for scene understanding but also for egocentric action selection.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/jhCOR/EgoGapBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EgoGapBench，一个用于评估多智能体场景中自我中心动作选择（EAS）的诊断基准。现有自我中心基准主要基于第一人称视角数据，难以单独评估自我中心视角理解。实验表明人类表现可靠，而MLLMs表现较差，倾向于选择其他智能体的动作。微调现有自我中心数据无效甚至有害，微调EgoGapBench数据可提升但未达人类水平。
Motivation: 现有自我中心基准未能区分第一人称视角输入与自我中心视角理解，尤其在第一人称身体线索缺失或存在其他智能体时，导致评估不准确。
Method: 引入EgoGapBench基准，通过多智能体自我中心场景中的动作选择任务，定义并测量Egocentric Action Selection (EAS)能力。
Result: 人类在基准上表现可靠，而开源和专有MLLMs显著更差，系统性地选择其他可见智能体的动作。微调现有自我中心数据无法缩小差距，甚至有害；微调EgoGapBench训练数据提升准确率，但未达人类水平。
Conclusion: EAS难以仅从第一人称视角数据获得，MLLMs需同时评估场景理解和自我中心动作选择。

papers.title: ECoSim: Data Efficient Fine-Tuning for Controllable Traffic Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Controllable traffic simulation is critical for testing autonomous driving systems, yet existing approaches often require retraining large generative models with extensive annotated data. We introduce a lightweight control adaptation framework that enables multi-modal controllability (sketch, latent behavior codes, and text) for pretrained state-of-the-art diffusion and autoregressive traffic models. By modulating intermediate features through identity-initialized FiLM layers, our method efficiently adds new control modalities while preserving the base model's generative prior. Evaluated on Waymo Open Sim Agents Challenge, our approach demonstrates strong controllability with less than 1% of the paired control data. Through context-aware condition transfer, our framework enables counterfactual scenario generation and long-tail synthesis while maintaining stable closed-loop driving realism and safety. Our framework unlocks new possibilities for controllable traffic simulation, enabling targeted scenario generation through lightweight adaptation of pretrained generative models. Project page: https://ecosim-web.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对可控交通仿真中需要大量标注数据的问题，提出一种轻量级控制适应框架ECoSim，通过在预训练的扩散或自回归交通模型中插入身份初始化的FiLM层，实现多模态可控性（草图、潜在行为代码、文本）。在Waymo Open Sim Agents Challenge上，该方法使用不到1%的配对控制数据即展现出强可控性，并支持反事实场景生成和长尾合成，保持闭环驾驶真实性和安全性。
Motivation: 现有的可控交通仿真方法通常需要重新训练大型生成模型，并依赖大量标注数据，效率低下。
Method: 提出轻量级控制适应框架，通过在预训练模型的中间特征上应用身份初始化的FiLM层，添加新的控制模态，同时保持基础模型的生成先验。
Result: 在Waymo Open Sim Agents Challenge上，使用不到1%的配对控制数据实现了强可控性，并支持反事实场景生成和长尾合成。
Conclusion: 该框架通过轻量级适配预训练生成模型，为可控交通仿真提供了新的可能性，实现了目标场景生成。

papers.title: GEAR-Seg: A Grounded Explainable Agent for Reasoning Segmentation and Data Engine
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning segmentation requires localizing targets based on complex, implicit queries. Current end-to-end models typically entangle perception and deduction into an opaque black box, severely limiting interpretability and scalability. To address this, we propose GEAR-Seg (Grounded Explainable Agent for Reasoning Segmentation), an explicitly decoupled agent that shifts the paradigm by translating visual pixels into dense, attribute-rich text. By decoupling class-agnostic segmentation, semantic description, and Large Language Model (LLM) deduction, GEAR-Seg transforms implicit reasoning into an explicit, trackable logic chain. As a zero-shot inference framework, it achieves highly competitive performance across diverse reasoning and fine-grained referring segmentation benchmarks. Furthermore, GEAR-Seg inherently functions as a highly scalable data engine. Utilizing this engine, we construct GEAR-131K, a massive benchmark (over 38k images, 656k QA-mask pairs) introducing a multifaceted taxonomy tailored for complex real-world manipulation-oriented reasoning. Finally, distillation experiments demonstrate that lightweight models supervised exclusively by our automated pipeline closely match the upper-bound performance of costly human-annotated baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GEAR-Seg，一个显式解耦的推理分割代理，通过将像素转换为密集属性文本，将类无关分割、语义描述和LLM推理分离，实现可解释的逻辑链。作为零样本推理框架，它在多个推理和细粒度指代分割基准上取得竞争性能。同时，该方法可作数据引擎，构建了GEAR-131K数据集（38k图像，656k QA-mask对），蒸馏实验表明轻量模型在纯自动标注下接近人类标注上限。
Motivation: 当前端到端推理分割模型将感知和推理混在不可解释的黑盒中，严重限制了可解释性和可扩展性。
Method: 提出显式解耦的代理GEAR-Seg，将类无关分割、语义描述和LLM推理步骤分离，将隐式推理转化为显式可追踪的逻辑链。
Result: 在多个推理和细粒度指代分割基准上取得具有竞争力的零样本性能；构建了GEAR-131K大规模数据集；蒸馏实验表明仅用自动管道的轻量模型性能接近昂贵人工标注上限。
Conclusion: 论文强调解耦范式为推理分割提供了可解释性和可扩展性，并展示了其作为高效数据引擎的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Flow-Map GRPO: Reinforcement Learning for Few-Step Flow-Map Generators via Anchored Stochastic Composition
papers.abstract_en: Few-step flow-map generators, such as consistency models and MeanFlow, accelerate sampling by directly learning long-range transport maps between noise and data. However, these models are typically deterministic, which makes them difficult to optimize with reinforcement learning (RL) post-training methods that require stochastic trajectories and well-defined likelihood ratios. Existing SDE-based stochasticization techniques are designed for velocity-based samplers with infinitesimal or finely discretized transitions, and therefore do not directly apply to long-range flow maps. In this work, we propose Flow-Map GRPO, an online RL post-training framework for deterministic few-step flow-map generators. The key component is Anchored Stochastic Flow Map Composition (ASFMC), a path-preserving stochasticization mechanism that introduces randomness through anchor-based conditional resampling while preserving the original marginal probability path of the deterministic flow map. We derive GRPO objectives for both single-time and two-time flow-map parameterizations. Experiments on few-step FLUX-based text-to-image generators, including MeanFlow and sCM, show that Flow-Map GRPO improves pretrained deterministic flow-map models across reward-based, perceptual, and task-level evaluation metrics. Our results demonstrate that deterministic few-step flow-map generators can be effectively aligned with RL post-training without modifying their original model parameterization or retraining them as native stochastic models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Flow-Map GRPO 是一种在线强化学习后训练框架，用于优化确定性的少步流映射生成器（如一致性模型和 MeanFlow）。其核心是锚定随机流映射组合（ASFMC），通过锚点条件重采样引入随机性，同时保持原始边际概率路径。实验在 FLUX-based MeanFlow 和 sCM 上证明该方法能改善奖励、感知和任务级指标。
Motivation: 现有确定性少步流映射生成器难以直接应用强化学习后训练，因为需要随机轨迹和似然比。而基于 SDE 的随机化技术仅适用于速度型采样器，不适用于长程流映射。
Method: 提出 Flow-Map GRPO 框架，包含 ASFMC 路径保持随机化机制，并推导了单时间与双时间流映射参数化的 GRPO 目标函数。
Result: 在 FLUX-based MeanFlow 和 sCM 等少步文本到图像生成器上，Flow-Map GRPO 在奖励、感知和任务级评估指标上均取得改进。
Conclusion: 确定性少步流映射生成器可通过强化学习后训练有效对齐，无需修改模型参数化或重训练为原生随机模型。

papers.title: Active-GRPO: Adaptive Imitation and Self-Improving Reasoning for Molecular Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Scientific reasoning is an increasingly important capability of large language models, yet improving the robustness and efficiency of training such reasoning remains a key open challenge. We study this problem in instruction-based molecular optimization, where answer-only supervised fine-tuning (SFT) collapses multi-step reasoning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) suffers from sparse feedback. Reference-guided Policy Optimization mitigates both by anchoring policy updates to dataset-provided references, but its effectiveness is tightly coupled to reference quality: weak or misaligned references impose a performance ceiling. To overcome this ceiling, we propose active reasoning, a paradigm in which the policy actively decides, on a per-instance basis, when to imitate a reference and when to reinforce its own discoveries, while continuously upgrading what it imitates. We instantiate this paradigm as Active Group Relative Policy Optimization (Active-GRPO), realized through two coupled mechanisms: active imitate-reinforce and active referencing. The former performs imitation learning when the reference still outperforms the policy's own candidates, and shifts to self-improvement via reinforcement learning once the policy has generated molecules that surpass the reference. The latter continuously upgrades the reference itself by replacing it with the best policy-generated candidate discovered so far, progressively raising the imitation target and ensuring that reference guidance remains informative-rather than restrictive-throughout training. Across TOMG-Bench MOLOPT, Active-GRPO improves average SRxSim from 0.0959 for GRPO and 0.1665 for RePO to 0.1773 under matched three-seed evaluation, with statistically significant gains on LogP, MR, and QED.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Active-GRPO，一种用于指令式分子优化的主动推理范式，通过实例级别的自适应模仿与自我改进机制，克服了参考策略优化（RePO）受限于参考质量的性能天花板。实验在TOMG-Bench MOLOPT基准上将平均SRxSim从GRPO的0.0959和RePO的0.1665提升至0.1773，并在LogP、MR和QED指标上取得统计显著改进。
Motivation: 现有方法中，有监督微调（SFT）忽略了多步推理过程，基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）面临稀疏反馈问题，而参考引导策略优化（RePO）虽能缓解上述问题但其性能受限于参考质量，弱参考导致性能天花板。
Method: 提出Active-GRPO，包含两个耦合机制：主动模仿-增强（active imitate-reinforce）和主动引用（active referencing）。前者在参考仍优于策略自身候选时进行模仿学习，否则转向自我改进；后者持续用策略生成的最佳分子替换参考，逐步提高模仿目标。
Result: 在TOMG-Bench MOLOPT上，Active-GRPO将平均SRxSim从GRPO的0.0959和RePO的0.1665提升至0.1773（三种子评估），并在LogP、MR和QED上取得统计显著提升。
Conclusion: 主动推理范式通过实例级别的自适应模仿与自我改进，能够有效提升分子优化中策略的性能，避免受限于固定参考质量。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有方法中，有监督微调（SFT）忽略了多步推理过程，基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）面临稀疏反馈问题，而参考引导策略优化（RePO）虽能缓解上述问题但其性能受限于参考质量，弱参考导致性能天花板。
summary_sections.method: 提出Active-GRPO，包含两个耦合机制：主动模仿-增强（active imitate-reinforce）和主动引用（active referencing）。前者在参考仍优于策略自身候选时进行模仿学习，否则转向自我改进；后者持续用策略生成的最佳分子替换参考，逐步提高模仿目标。
summary_sections.result: 在TOMG-Bench MOLOPT上，Active-GRPO将平均SRxSim从GRPO的0.0959和RePO的0.1665提升至0.1773（三种子评估），并在LogP、MR和QED上取得统计显著提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 主动推理范式通过实例级别的自适应模仿与自我改进，能够有效提升分子优化中策略的性能，避免受限于固定参考质量。

papers.title: From Technical Metrics to User Perception: A User Study of a Multimodal Human-Robot Interaction System for Object Detection and Grasping
papers.abstract_en: Improvements in the technical performance of human--robot interaction (HRI) systems do not automatically translate into differences that human users can detect during live interaction. This paper investigates whether a 15 percentage point gain in end-to-end task success (from 75% in a multimodal baseline system to 90% in an improved configuration identified through a prior ablation study) is sufficient to produce consistent and measurable differences in user perception. The baseline system combines Whisper for speech recognition, Florence-2 for open-vocabulary object detection, LLaMA 3.1 for action extraction, and an interval Type-2 fuzzy logic controller for motion execution. The improved configuration replaces the perception and language modules with Grounding DINO + SAM and Qwen 3.5 9B, respectively, while retaining the same controller. A within-subject user study with 24 participants compared both systems on the same tabletop object-grasping task. After interacting with each configuration, participants rated perceived speed, reliability, and overall competence and fluency on a 7-point Likert scale. Results show that 17 out of 24 participants (70.83%) preferred the improved system (exact binomial test, p = 0.043, h = 0.43), and all three perceptual constructs were rated significantly higher for the improved configuration after Holm correction, with large to very large effect sizes (p < 0.001). These findings confirm that the identified technical improvements are perceptible to users in direct interaction and underscore the importance of complementing benchmark evaluation with user-centred evidence when assessing robotic manipulation pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过用户实验验证了技术指标提升能否转化为用户可感知的差异。基线系统使用Whisper、Florence-2、LLaMA 3.1和区间二型模糊逻辑控制器，改进系统将感知和语言模块替换为Grounding DINO + SAM和Qwen 3.5 9B。24名受试者在桌面物体抓取任务中比较两种配置，结果显示70.83%的参与者偏好改进系统，且感知速度、可靠性和整体能力评分均显著更高。
Motivation: 人机交互系统技术性能的提升并不自动意味着用户能在实际交互中感受到差异，需要验证这种差距是否可被用户感知。
Method: 开展受试者内用户研究，24名参与者在相同任务中体验两种系统配置（基线和改进），并通过7点李克特量表评估感知速度、可靠性和整体能力。
Result: 17/24名参与者偏好改进系统（精确二项检验p=0.043, h=0.43），所有三个感知构念在Holm校正后均显著更高，效应量大至极大（p<0.001）。
Conclusion: 技术改进（15个百分点的任务成功率提升）能被用户直接感知，强调在机器人操控流水线评估中应结合基准测试和用户中心证据。

papers.title: NoPA: Non-Parametric Online 3D Scene Graph Generation
papers.abstract_en: Classic 3D scene graph generation approaches fail to work in real-time due to the heavy computational cost of environment mapping and the need to generate intermediate point-cloud representations. To alleviate this issue, a recent work eschews point clouds in favor of a lightweight Gaussian distribution for each object. This approximation drastically speeds up inference and enables real-time 3D scene graph generation. However, the representation has two key weaknesses. \textbf{1)} Each object is approximated by a single 3D Gaussian, which causes a severe loss of 3D geometric detail. \textbf{2)} The discrepancy between this approximation and the true object geometry exacerbates the inaccurate merging of object candidates during online inference. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{NoPA}, which represents each object as a separate non-parametric distribution. This formulation retains 3D geometric information while preserving real-time inference of the parametric Gaussian formulation. To build upon our novel object representation, we propose a tailored merging strategy to recover coherent object instances. Specifically, we leverage maximum mean discrepancy on kernel density estimates to enable robust merging of object candidates during online exploration while minimizing added computational complexity. The key is to maintain a fixed particle set per object. Furthermore, to rectify the relation loss caused by misclassified objects, NoPA propagates relationships between objects with high affinity. Experiments show that NoPA substantially outperforms current methods without sacrificing real-time inference speed.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted in ECCV 26
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对实时3D场景图生成中，现有参数化高斯表示丢失几何细节且导致对象合并不准确的问题，本文提出NoPA，采用非参数分布表示每个对象，保留几何信息同时保持实时推理。提出基于最大均值差异（MMD）的核密度估计合并策略，以及高亲和性关系传播机制。实验表明该方法在不牺牲实时性的前提下显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 传统3D场景图生成方法因环境映射和点云表示计算量大而无法实时；近期工作采用轻量级高斯近似实现实时性，但单个高斯丢失几何细节，且近似误差导致在线推理中对象合并不准确。
Method: NoPA将每个对象表示为独立的非参数分布（固定粒子集），保留3D几何信息。提出基于最大均值差异（MMD）的核密度估计合并策略，用于在线探索中鲁棒合并对象候选；同时通过高亲和性关系传播修正因误分类导致的关系损失。
Result: 摘要报告NoPA在3D场景图生成任务上显著优于现有方法，且不牺牲实时推理速度。
Conclusion: 非参数对象表示结合MMD合并策略，能在保持实时性的同时提升3D场景图生成的几何保真度和对象合并准确性。

papers.title: AI Native Games: A Survey and Roadmap
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI now enables games to produce dialogue, quests, characters, images, and worlds at runtime. Yet generation alone does not make a game AI-native, nor does it guarantee playability. This paper defines AI-native games by whether runtime generative AI is constitutive of the core loop: if the AI component were removed or trivially replaced, the central form of play would collapse or become fundamentally different. This counterfactual criterion separates AI-native games from AI-augmented games, boundary artifacts, chatbots, tavern-style role-play, procedural content generation, and AI-assisted production. Using this definition, we screen candidate artifacts and analyze 53 publicly available AI-native games and prototypes. We introduce a dual-axis G/N taxonomy: the G-axis captures player-facing game type, while the N-axis captures the dominant AI mechanic that makes generative AI indispensable to play. The corpus is concentrated around language-forward designs, especially narrative adventure, epistemic interaction, and generative narrative, while categories such as semantic adjudication, multi-agent simulation, generative construction, and relationship/companion play remain less represented. We argue that the central design problem is organizing semantic openness into stable gameplay. AI-native design depends on mechanical invariants: goals, rules, state, feedback, pacing, and player agency that make open-ended AI outputs interpretable and consequential. We conclude with a roadmap for controllable generation, AI-as-mechanic design, multimodal and multi-agent systems, inference economics, evaluation, safety, and regulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文定义了AI原生游戏（AI-native games）的概念，要求运行时生成式AI构成核心玩法循环的不可或缺部分，否则游戏形式会崩溃或根本不同。基于此判据，筛选并分析了53个公开的AI原生游戏及原型，提出了G/N双轴分类法（G轴捕捉面向玩家的游戏类型，N轴捕捉使生成式AI不可或缺的主导AI机制）。分析发现现有作品集中于语言前向设计，而语义裁定、多智能体模拟等类别尚不充分。作者认为核心设计问题是将语义开放性组织为稳定的可玩机制，并依赖于目标、规则、状态等机械不变量。
Motivation: 现有生成式AI虽能生成对话、任务等内容，但仅生成不意味着游戏是AI原生的，也不保证可玩性。需要明确区分AI原生游戏与AI增强游戏、边界制品等，以指导设计。
Method: 提出反事实判据：若移除或平凡替换AI组件，核心玩法会崩塌或根本改变。基于此筛选候选作品，并引入G/N双轴分类法对53个原型进行分析。
Result: 发现现有AI原生游戏主要集中在语言前向设计（如叙事冒险、认知交互、生成叙事），而语义裁定、多智能体模拟、生成式构建、关系/伙伴陪伴等类别代表不足。
Conclusion: 核心设计挑战是将语义开放性组织为稳定的游戏玩法，依赖于目标、规则、状态、反馈、节奏和玩家能动性等机械不变量。最后提出可控生成、AI作为机制设计、多模态/多智能体系统、推理经济学、评估、安全与监管的路线图。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SPECSIA: Stylization Dataset for Novel-View Enhancement in Drawing-based 3D Animation
papers.abstract_en: Generating animation from a single 2D drawing is challenging because the output must preserve character appearance while remaining plausible and temporally coherent under motion. Existing drawing-based 3D animation pipelines often use sample-wise 2D refinement to align animated renderings with the input image, but such optimization tends to overfit to the observed view and fails to correct projection-induced artifacts in novel views. To address this limitation, we introduce SPECSIA-15K, a paired stylization dataset containing 14,980 artifact-corrupted projection/refinement-target pairs from 1,498 3DBiCar characters. We further present DraViE (Drawing-based View Enhancement), a lightweight plug-and-play module trained with data-level priors to remove novel-view artifacts while preserving style and motion plausibility. Experiments show consistent gains in novel-view fidelity and temporal coherence with lower per-character adaptation cost than sample-wise fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对单张2D草图生成3D动画时新视角出现投影伪影的问题，提出了SPECSIA-15K数据集和轻量级模块DraViE，用于去除新视角伪影同时保持风格和运动合理性。实验表明该方法在新视角保真度和时间一致性上优于逐样本微调，且适应成本更低。
Motivation: 现有基于草图的3D动画管线通常使用逐样本2D精炼来对齐渲染结果与输入图像，但容易过拟合到观察视角，无法修正新视角下的投影伪影。
Method: 构建包含14,980对伪影投影/精炼目标的配对数据集SPECSIA-15K，并设计轻量级即插即用模块DraViE，基于数据级先验训练以去除新视角伪影。
Result: 在新视角保真度和时间一致性上取得一致提升，且每个角色的适应成本低于逐样本微调。
Conclusion: 所提出的数据集和模块能有效去除新视角伪影，降低适配成本，适用于基于草图的3D动画增强。

papers.title: AI, Trust, and Teaming: The Humans-as-Handlers Approach for Autonomous and Opaque AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is becoming ubiquitous, and across domains, increasingly autonomous systems are carrying out tasks which raise significant ethical and legal challenges which demonstrate a need for strong human-machine teams rooted in trust. In this article, I argue that within highly impactful areas (such as medicine or warfighting) there are grounds for us initially treating autonomous and opaque systems as relevantly analogous to dogs (or other animals with which we have close relationships). Under this analogy, humans making use of these systems are not to be viewed as "users" or "deployers" of these systems, but instead take the role of "handlers". This recasting of roles shifts the way we view humans, AI-enabled and autonomous systems, and the relations between them, and moreover clarifies the clear and traceable lines of responsibility humans have for the outcomes brought about when using these systems. In developing this point, I clarify that the machine-animal analogy does admit disanalogous elements, but that its touch-points ground it as a starting point. I then explore how we can divest the humans-as-handlers approach of those aspects of our relationships with animals which are unfitting for how we engage with and make use of autonomous and AI-enabled systems. I conclude by arguing that the trajectory of human-machine teamings for autonomous and AI-enabled systems should be a state where we authentically view these not as artifacts which we simply make use of, but as collaborators with which we pursue complex goals and carry out complex tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将人类视为“处理者”(handlers)而非“用户”或“部署者”的框架，用于处理自主且不透明的AI系统，类比人类与狗的关系。文章论证在医学或作战等高影响力领域，这种角色转换能明确责任线。虽然机器-动物类比有不相称之处，但可以作为起点。最终主张将自主AI系统视为协作伙伴而非简单工具。
Motivation: 当前自主AI系统负责任不明确，需要建立可信的人机团队，尤其在伦理法律挑战大的领域。
Method: 通过哲学论证提出“人类作为处理者”方法，将人类比作狗类动物的处理者，并探讨如何剥离不合适的方面。
Result: 文章本身是理论论证，没有实证结果。
Conclusion: 自主AI系统应被视为协作伙伴，人类对其结果有清晰可追溯的责任。

papers.title: Restore3D: Breathing Life into Broken Objects with Shape and Texture Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Restoring incomplete or damaged 3D objects is crucial for cultural heritage preservation, occluded object reconstruction, and artistic design. Existing methods primarily focus on geometric completion, often neglecting texture restoration and struggling with relatively complex and diverse objects. We introduce Restore3D, a novel framework that simultaneously restores both the shape and texture of broken objects using multi-view images. To address limited training data, we develop an automated data generation pipeline that synthesizes paired incomplete-complete samples from large-scale 3D datasets. Central to Restore3D is a multi-view model, enhanced by a carefully designed Mask Self-Perceiver module with a Depth-Aware Mask Rectifier. The rectified masks learned by the self-perceiver guide an image integration and enhancement phase, helping retain observed shape and texture patterns while refining the generated regions and mitigating the low-resolution limitations of the base model, yielding high-resolution, semantically coherent, and view-consistent multi-view images. A coarse-to-fine reconstruction strategy is then employed to recover detailed textured 3D meshes from refined multi-view images. Experiments on synthetic and real broken-object benchmarks show that Restore3D improves multi-view restoration quality and textured-mesh reconstruction over representative inpainting, completion, and reconstruction baselines in the evaluated settings. Project Page: restore3dx.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Restore3D是一个同时修复破损3D物体形状和纹理的框架，利用多视图图像和掩码自感知器（Mask Self-Perceiver）模块，结合深度感知掩码修正器，从合成数据中学习，生成高分辨率、语义一致的多视图图像，并通过粗到细策略重建带纹理的3D网格。
Motivation: 现有方法主要关注几何补全，忽视纹理修复，且对复杂多样物体的处理能力有限，影响文化遗产保护、遮挡物体重建和艺术设计等应用。
Method: 提出Restore3D框架，包括自动数据生成管线合成配对的不完整-完整样本，以及一个多视图模型，其核心是带有深度感知掩码修正器的掩码自感知器模块，用于引导图像整合增强，再通过粗到细重建恢复带纹理的3D网格。
Result: 在合成和真实破损物体基准上，Restore3D在多视图修复质量和带纹理网格重建方面优于代表性的修复、补全和重建基线。
Conclusion: Restore3D能够同时恢复形状和纹理，生成高分辨率、语义一致且视图一致的多视图图像，适用于破损物体修复。

papers.title: Cross4D-JEPA: Dense Cross-modal Correspondence Distillation for 4D Point Cloud Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Automatic understanding of dynamic 4D point clouds, the 3D-point sequences captured over time by depth sensors and LiDAR, is central to robotics and embodied perception. Yet annotating them densely is expensive, making self-supervised pretraining the natural route to transferable representations. Existing pretext tasks, however, are almost entirely intra-modal, and the few methods that transfer knowledge from 2D foundation models rely on a single global embedding per clip, discarding the rich per-patch semantics that these models compute. To address this gap, we propose Cross4D-JEPA, a teacher-student method that distills a frozen 2D foundation model, an image model DINOv2, or a video model V-JEPA 2, into a 4D point encoder. The proposed method combines (1) a dense cross-modal correspondence that maps every 3D point to the teacher patch feature it projects to, and (2) a per-point objective that trains the student to match these features in latent space with no masking, negatives, or decoder. We evaluate Cross4D-JEPA on four benchmarks, MSR-Action3D, DeformingThings4D, NTU-RGB+D 60, and HOI4D, against intra-modal and global cross-modal baselines. Experimental results show that, under a matched protocol, the proposed method consistently outperforms intra-modal and global cross-modal baselines across the four benchmarks and is competitive with heavier published 4D methods; further analysis attributes this gain primarily to the granularity of the correspondence rather than the teacher modality. Beyond recognition accuracy, the dense representation learned by Cross4D-JEPA transfers across domains, improves label efficiency, and improves full-label fine-tuning under the same training budget, while a 13x smaller encoder matches a heavyweight pooling backbone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Cross4D-JEPA，一种自监督预训练方法，通过教师-学生框架将冻结的2D基础模型（如DINOv2或V-JEPA 2）的密集跨模态对应关系蒸馏到4D点云编码器中。该方法逐点匹配3D点与教师补丁特征，在无掩码、负样本或解码器的情况下训练学生网络。在四个基准（MSR-Action3D, DeformingThings4D, NTU-RGB+D 60, HOI4D）上，该方法优于同模态和全局跨模态基线，并与更重的4D方法竞争。密集表示具有跨域迁移能力，提高了标签效率和微调性能。
Motivation: 现有4D点云自监督方法多为模态内预训练，而少数利用2D基础模型的方法仅使用全局嵌入，丢弃了丰富的逐补丁语义。本文旨在利用密集的跨模态对应来学习更丰富的4D点云表示。
Method: 使用冻结的2D基础模型（DINOv2或V-JEPA 2）作为教师，将每个3D点投影到教师补丁特征，并设计逐点目标，让学生网络在潜在空间中匹配这些特征，无需掩码、负样本或解码器。
Result: 在四个基准上，Cross4D-JEPA一致优于模态内和全局跨模态基线，并与更重的已发表4D方法竞争。性能提升主要归因于对应关系的粒度而非教师模态。密集表示跨域迁移，改善标签效率，并在相同训练预算下提升全标签微调；使用13倍小的编码器即可匹配重型池化骨干。
Conclusion: 本文展示了通过密集跨模态对应蒸馏可以显著提升4D点云表示学习，且该方法在多个下游任务上有效，并具备域迁移优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Structural Equation Modelling to Double Machine Learning: Robustness Analysis for Survey-Based Research
papers.abstract_en: Structural equation modelling (SEM) is widely used in survey-based business and information systems research to assess latent constructs and theory-driven structural relationships. However, SEM path significance is obtained within a particular model specification and may not show whether findings remain stable under alternative estimation frameworks. This study develops and demonstrates a staged robustness analysis framework that connects SEM, ordinary least squares (OLS) regression, and Double Machine Learning (DML). SEM is first used to refine the measurement structure and estimate the robustness-baseline SEM model, in which the full theory-specified structural path system is retained for downstream robustness analysis before final structural path evaluation. OLS regression is then applied to SEM-derived construct scores as a transparent regression benchmark. Finally, DML-style residualisation is used to examine whether each tested focal relationship remains stable after flexible machine-learning-based adjustment for observed controls. Learner-sensitivity checks compare Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and Support Vector Machine learners, and selected reverse-direction diagnostics are used to examine directional sensitivity. The framework is demonstrated using a FinTech Digital Customer Intimacy survey model. The findings identify which relationships are stable across SEM, OLS, and DML-style checks, and which require more cautious interpretation. A reproducible Google Colab workbook and generated result files are publicly available, providing a reusable template that researchers and students can adapt to other survey-based latent-construct studies. The paper contributes a practical robustness workflow and interpretation guide for survey-based researchers seeking to complement SEM with conventional and machine-learning-based robustness checks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于调查的结构方程模型（SEM）结果可能依赖于特定模型规范的问题，提出一个分阶段的鲁棒性分析框架，将SEM、普通最小二乘（OLS）回归和双重机器学习（DML）相结合。首先用SEM细化测量结构并估计鲁棒性基线，然后对SEM导出的构造分数应用OLS作为透明基准，最后通过DML风格的残差化检验每个焦点关系是否在基于机器学习的灵活调整后保持稳定。该框架在FinTech数字客户亲密调查模型上演示，识别出不同估计框架下稳定的关系及需要谨慎解释的关系，并提供了可复现的Google Colab工作簿。
Motivation: SEM路径显著性依赖于特定模型规范，可能无法反映发现是否在其他估计框架下保持稳定，因此需要系统性的鲁棒性检查方法。
Method: 提出三阶段鲁棒性分析框架：第一阶段使用SEM建立鲁棒性基线模型，保留完整的理论指定结构路径；第二阶段对SEM导出的构造分数应用OLS回归作为透明基准；第三阶段采用DML风格的残差化方法，通过随机森林、梯度提升机和支持向量机进行学习器敏感性检查，并辅以反向方向诊断。
Result: 通过FinTech数字客户亲密调查模型演示，识别出哪些关系在SEM、OLS和DML检查中稳定，哪些需要更谨慎的解释。提供可复现的Google Colab工作簿和结果文件。
Conclusion: 论文贡献了一个实用的鲁棒性工作流和解释指南，供调查研究者将SEM与常规及基于机器学习的鲁棒性检查互补使用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prototype Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Knowing which training examples drive outputs is fundamental to auditing, correcting, and understanding language models, yet for modern LLMs this remains expensive, approximate, and largely post-hoc. Standard language models generate tokens through a dense network pathway, causing training data's influence to be distributed across parameters rather than organized along explicit, traceable components. We introduce a prototype language model architecture, Prototypes for Interpretable Sequence Modeling (PRISM), that forms each prediction via a sparse, non-negative mixture of learned prototypes, trained with clustering objectives that anchor each prototype to coherent neighborhoods of training examples. Across architectures from 130M to 1.6B parameters trained on up to 50B tokens, prototype language models either surpass or remain within 2.5 percentage points on average downstream accuracy of matched dense baselines. We show that sparse prototype structure localizes curvature in the loss landscape, yielding a more tractable Hessian and enabling training data attribution that is ~500x faster than post hoc baselines when consuming equivalent memory. Calibrating linear prototype controllers can improve downstream accuracy by roughly 3 points while tracing those corrections back to training neighborhoods, and targeted prototype suppression can remove model behaviors without finetuning or measurable loss in generation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种原型语言模型架构PRISM，通过稀疏非负原型混合进行预测，将每个原型锚定到训练样本的连贯邻域。在130M至1.6B参数模型上，在下游准确率上超过或接近密集基线（差距在2.5个百分点以内）。该结构使损失曲面曲率局部化，实现比事后基线快约500倍的训练数据归因，并通过线性原型控制器校准或原型抑制实现模型行为修正。
Motivation: 现有语言模型的训练数据影响分散在参数中，难以追溯具体训练示例对输出的贡献，导致审计、修正和理解成本高且近似。
Method: 提出原型语言模型架构PRISM，每个预测通过稀疏非负原型混合生成，原型通过聚类目标学习锚定到训练样本的连贯邻域。
Result: 在130M至1.6B参数模型上，PRISM在下游准确率上超过或接近密集基线（差距≤2.5个百分点）。训练数据归因速度比事后基线快约500倍（同等内存）。线性原型控制器校准可提升准确率约3点，原型抑制可在不微调的情况下移除特定行为且不损失生成质量。
Conclusion: 原型语言模型通过稀疏原型结构实现了可解释性、高效数据归因和可控修正，同时保持与密集模型相当的性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AnF-DiffPET: Anatomy- and Frequency-Guided Diffusion for PET/CT Denoising
papers.abstract_en: Positron emission tomography (PET) provides essential functional information for disease assessment, however reducing injected activity or acquisition time produces low-dose (LD) PET with stronger count dependent noise and less reliable uptake quantification. Diffusion models offer a promising solution for PET denoising by progressively recovering high-dose (HD) PET images from LD inputs. However, LD-to-HD PET denoising is still challenging due to insufficient anatomical guidance, unstable multi-scale feature propagation, and uncertain frequency domain uptake recovery. We propose AnF-DiffPET, an anatomy- and frequency-guided diffusion framework for computed tomography (CT) conditioned LD PET denoising. The framework integrates Anatomical-Frequency Guidance (AFG), Multi-Scale Cross-Transformer Reconstruction (MSCTR), and Frequency-Contrastive Hard Mining (FCHM) to enhance anatomy aware feature modulation and frequency domain consistency during denoising. Experimental results across four PET/CT datasets show that the proposed method improves image fidelity, anatomical consistency, and quantitative fidelity over representative CNN-based, GAN-based, transformer-based, and diffusion-based methods. The code and trained models will be publicly released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AnF-DiffPET，一种基于解剖和频率引导的扩散模型，用于CT条件低剂量PET去噪。框架集成了解剖-频率引导、多尺度跨Transformer重建和频率对比硬挖掘，以在去噪过程中增强解剖感知特征调制和频域一致性。在四个PET/CT数据集上的实验表明，该方法在图像保真度、解剖一致性和定量保真度上优于代表性的CNN、GAN、Transformer和扩散方法。
Motivation: 低剂量PET图像因噪声强、定量不准确而影响诊断，现有扩散模型去噪面临解剖引导不足、多尺度特征传播不稳定以及频域摄取恢复不确定的问题。
Method: 提出AnF-DiffPET框架，包括解剖-频率引导（AFG）模块、多尺度跨Transformer重建（MSCTR）和频率对比硬挖掘（FCHM），以增强解剖感知特征调制和频域一致性。
Result: 在四个PET/CT数据集上，该方法在图像保真度、解剖一致性和定量指标上均优于CNN、GAN、Transformer和基于扩散的对比方法。
Conclusion: AnF-DiffPET有效改善了低剂量PET去噪质量，代码和模型将在接收后公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BaseRT: Best-in-Class LLM Inference on Apple Silicon via Native Metal
papers.abstract_en: We present BaseRT, a native Metal inference runtime for large language models (LLMs) on Apple Silicon, and report the highest inference throughput on this hardware to date. Existing runtimes, including llama.cpp and MLX-based frameworks, incur overhead from abstractions not designed for Metal's execution model or Apple Silicon's unified memory topology. By building natively on Metal with chip-specific kernel fusion, unified memory-aware optimisation, and custom dispatch logic, BaseRT recovers performance that framework-based approaches leave on the table. BaseRT supports a wide range of model families across eight quantisation formats (Q2 to FP16) on all Apple M-series devices. In this paper, we evaluate the Qwen3, Llama 3.2, and Gemma 4 families at Q4 and Q8 quantisation on M3 and M4 Pro devices. BaseRT achieves up to 1.56x higher decode throughput than llama.cpp and up to 1.35x higher than MLX, with substantially larger margins on prefill for mixture-of-experts models, delivering consistent best-in-class throughput from sub-1B to 30B parameter models. These results establish Apple Silicon as a more capable inference platform than previously reported, with direct implications for the emerging edge inference paradigm: as privacy requirements, latency constraints, and cloud cost pressures drive inference toward on-device deployment, performance-optimised local runtimes are a critical enabling layer for this transition. BaseRT is publicly available at https://github.com/basecompute/baseRT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BaseRT，一个基于Apple Silicon原生Metal的LLM推理运行时，通过芯片特定内核融合、统一内存感知优化和自定义调度逻辑，在M3和M4 Pro设备上实现比llama.cpp高1.56倍、比MLX高1.35倍的解码吞吐量，并支持多种模型和量化格式。
Motivation: 现有推理运行时（如llama.cpp、MLX）未针对Metal执行模型和Apple Silicon统一内存拓扑优化，导致性能损失。
Method: 原生构建于Metal之上，采用芯片特定内核融合、统一内存感知优化和自定义调度逻辑，支持Q2至FP16量化。
Result: 在Qwen3、Llama 3.2、Gemma 4等模型上，BaseRT在M3/M4 Pro设备上实现最高1.56倍（vs llama.cpp）和1.35倍（vs MLX）的解码吞吐量提升，对MoE模型预填阶段优势更大。
Conclusion: 该工作表明Apple Silicon是比先前报告更强大的推理平台，对边缘推理部署具有重要价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Closed-loop coupling of personalised and foundation models for real-time treatment guidance with MRI
papers.abstract_en: Image-guided therapies, including radiotherapy, biopsy and deep brain stimulation, rely on real-time targeting of anatomical structures. However, in the presence of motion, imaging latencies create a temporal misalignment between observed and true anatomy, compromising treatment accuracy. Artificial intelligence-based frameworks have increasingly been presented to close this latency gap, but leading personalised models can fail due to a lack of stable anatomical grounding. Foundation models can provide grounded behaviour, but they do not adapt to real-time, individual patient dynamics. Here we introduce a closed-loop coupling framework that synergises patient-specific temporal prediction with continuous segmentation-based anatomical interpretation from a foundation model. A personalised model predicts future anatomy to compensate for system latency, while a streaming foundation model provides anatomical supervision used to continuously update the temporal predictor in real time during treatment. We validate the framework using a digital phantom and intrafraction magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) from patients undergoing MRI-guided radiotherapy. For a prediction horizon of 400 ms, the proposed method improves anatomical prediction and reduces dosimetric error compared with existing approaches, within clinically relevant latency constraints. These results establish closed-loop coupling as a general strategy for real-time image-guided intervention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对MRI引导治疗中的成像延迟问题，提出一种闭环耦合框架，将患者特异性时间预测模型与基于基础模型的连续分割解剖解释相结合。个性化模型预测未来解剖以补偿系统延迟，流式基础模型提供解剖监督，实时更新预测器。在数字体模和患者MRI数据上，该方法在400ms预测范围内改善了解剖预测精度并降低了剂量误差。
Motivation: 现有基于AI的方法中，个性化模型因缺乏稳定解剖基础而失效，基础模型无法适应实时个体动态，导致治疗精度不足。
Method: 提出闭环耦合框架：个性化模型（如LSTM）预测未来解剖，流式分割基础模型（如SAM）持续提供解剖监督，用于在线更新预测器参数。
Result: 在数字体模和接受MRI引导放疗的患者数据上，对于400ms预测范围，该方法相比现有方法降低了解剖预测误差和剂量误差，且满足临床延迟约束。
Conclusion: 闭环耦合可作为实时图像引导干预的通用策略，弥合成像延迟与治疗精度之间的差距。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prior-Anchored Debiasing for Long-Tailed Multi-Organ Pathology Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Automated pathology report generation from Whole Slide Images (WSIs) has attracted increasing attention in digital pathology. However, existing methods are predominantly developed under single-organ settings, overlooking the multi-organ scenarios encountered in clinical practice, where organ types typically follow a long-tailed distribution. To address this gap, we identify two critical biases: (1) visual representation bias, where the encoder favors head-class patterns over tail-class discriminative features, and (2) textual decoding bias, where the decoder overfits to head-class narrative patterns, yielding diagnostically unreliable outputs for tail-class organs. To mitigate these two biases, we propose a novel Prior-anchored multi-Organ pathology report Generation framework (PriOrGen). Specifically, a Visual-Prototype Anchored Bottleneck module leverages the information bottleneck principle with learnable anchor representations to selectively retain diagnostically relevant visual information while filtering out head-biased redundancy. Secondly, a Meta-Report Anchored Bank module constructs an organ-specific meta-report anchored bank and retrieves organ-faithful textual priors to steer the decoder away from head-class narrative patterns. Extensive experiments on a multi- organ pathology dataset demonstrate that our method effectively mitigates long-tail biases and achieves superior report generation performance across both head and tail organ categories compared to state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多器官病理报告生成中的长尾分布问题，提出Prior-anchored multi-Organ pathology report Generation framework (PriOrGen)，通过视觉原型锚定瓶颈模块和元报告锚定银行模块分别缓解视觉表征偏差和文本解码偏差，在多器官病理数据集上实现了优于现有方法的报告生成性能。
Motivation: 现有病理报告生成方法主要针对单器官场景，忽略了临床中多器官的长尾分布，导致模型对尾部器官的视觉表征和文本解码存在偏差，生成诊断不可靠的报告。
Method: 提出PriOrGen框架，包含两个核心模块：Visual-Prototype Anchored Bottleneck利用信息瓶颈原理和可学习锚表示过滤头部偏差冗余；Meta-Report Anchored Bank构建器官特定的元报告锚库，检索器官忠实文本先验以纠正解码偏差。
Result: 在多器官病理数据集上的实验表明，该方法有效缓解长尾偏差，在头部和尾部器官类别上均取得优于最先进方法的报告生成性能。
Conclusion: 该工作通过锚定先验缓解多器官长尾偏差，为临床多器官病理报告生成提供了有效方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Robust 3D Alignment of Generative Reconstructions via Partial Monocular Observations
papers.abstract_en: Aligning generative 3D reconstructions with partial monocular observations is a critical but under-explored challenge in computer vision. This task is inherently ill-posed due to severe asymmetries between noisy, sparse monocular inputs and dense generative priors, whose scale ambiguity and geometric hallucinations, combined with the lack of initial overlap, render traditional registration pipelines ineffective. To resolve these issues, we propose a training-free and interpretable geometric alignment framework that grounds generative 3D priors via a 3D similarity transformation (Sim(3)), which can recover accurate metric scale and pose. Specifically, we introduce an explicit scale factor to resolve metric ambiguity and employ a coarse-to-fine alignment strategy, leveraging geometry-aware descriptors for robust initialization and a decoupled closed-form solver for precision refinement. In addition, we introduce a Hallucination Filtering operation to effectively suppress outliers caused by hallucinated geometry. To evaluate alignment performance under these extreme conditions, we introduce GenPMOAlign--Where2Place, a rigorous benchmark specifically designed for Generative-to-Partial Monocular Observational Alignment. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves stable and accurate registration, substantially outperforming both classical geometric pipelines and state-of-the-art learning-based baselines. Code and the benchmark will be publicly released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的几何对齐框架，通过3D相似变换（Sim(3)）将生成式3D重建与部分单目观测对齐，解决尺度模糊和几何幻觉问题。采用粗到细对齐策略，并引入幻觉过滤操作。在提出的GenPMOAlign--Where2Place基准上，该方法超越经典几何和学习基线。
Motivation: 生成式3D重建与部分单目观测对齐是一个未充分探索的挑战，由于单目输入的稀疏噪声与生成先验的尺度模糊和几何幻觉，以及缺乏初始重叠，传统配准方法失效。
Method: 提出一个无需训练的可解释几何对齐框架，利用3D相似变换恢复尺度位姿。包含显式尺度因子、粗到细对齐（几何感知描述子初始化 + 解耦闭式求解器精修），以及幻觉过滤操作抑制幻觉几何造成的异常点。
Result: 在提出的GenPMOAlign--Where2Place基准上，该方法实现稳定准确配准，显著优于经典几何基线和SOTA学习基线。
Conclusion: 本文展示了无需训练的方法在极端对齐条件下的有效性，并提供了基准和代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HieDG: A Hierarchical Discrete Geometry-Guided Framework for Multi-Animal Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Multi-animal tracking (MAT) is critical for wildlife monitoring and behavioral analysis, yet remains challenging due to uniform appearance, high density, and irregular motion. Existing methods typically follow heuristic- or query-based paradigms: the former relies on handcrafted geometric associations without end-to-end optimization, whereas the latter enables joint optimization but relies heavily on appearance embeddings. In such conditions, continuous geometric embeddings can be unstable, as small coordinate perturbations may disproportionately alter cross-frame attention weights, degrading identity association performance. To address this limitation, we propose HieDG, a Hierarchical Discrete Geometry-guided tracking framework that reformulates geometric dynamics as structured discrete representations within a query-based tracker. Instead of directly using raw geometric signals, HieDG employs a two-stage residual codebook to discretize position, scale, and velocity cues, transforming unstable continuous geometry into structured, stable discrete tokens. These tokens are aligned with visual embeddings and integrated into the tracking queries to enhance identity consistency. Extensive experiments on animal-specific benchmarks (AnimalTrack, BFT, and BuckTales) demonstrate state-of-the-art association performance with significant improvements in HOTA, AssA, and IDF1. Additional evaluations on generic multi-object tracking benchmarks, including DanceTrack and SportsMOT, show competitive performance, indicating the broader applicability of discretized geometric modeling beyond animal-specific scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HieDG，一个分层离散几何引导的多动物跟踪框架。通过两级残差码本将位置、尺度和速度离散化为稳定令牌，并与视觉嵌入对齐，增强身份一致性。在动物跟踪基准（AnimalTrack, BFT, BuckTales）上达到 SOTA，HOTA、AssA 和 IDF1 显著提升；在通用多目标跟踪基准（DanceTrack, SportsMOT）上也表现竞争性。
Motivation: 现有基于查询的跟踪器依赖连续几何嵌入，但坐标微小扰动会导致跨帧注意力权重剧变，损害身份关联性能；启发式方法则缺乏端到端优化。
Method: 提出 HieDG，在查询型跟踪器中引入分层离散几何表示：使用两级残差码本将连续几何信号（位置、尺度、速度）离散化为结构化令牌，并与视觉嵌入对齐后整合到跟踪查询中。
Result: 在 AnimalTrack、BFT、BuckTales 上取得 SOTA 关联性能，HOTA、AssA、IDF1 显著提升；在 DanceTrack 和 SportsMOT 上表现竞争性。
Conclusion: 离散化几何建模能提升多动物跟踪的身份一致性，且泛化到通用多目标跟踪场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GenSP: Consistent Spherical Parameterization via Learning Shape Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: We introduce GenSP, a data-driven framework that learns consistent spherical parameterizations across a collection of genus-0 shapes. Instead of optimizing the parameterization of each shape independently, our method learns a neural generative model that predicts a continuous mapping from the unit sphere to shapes in a dataset. Under this formulation, spherical parameterizations are obtained through the inverse mappings of the learned generator, which encourages similar shapes to share consistent parameterizations. To make this formulation practical, we address several key challenges in learning such a generative model. First, we introduce a continuous neural deformation model that predicts surface points from sphere coordinates and latent shape codes, avoiding discretization artifacts common in mesh-based formulations. Second, we augment the training space with intermediate shapes that bridge the sphere and input shapes, allowing the model to learn meaningful deformations across a heterogeneous shape collection. Third, we compute reliable initial correspondences by propagating mappings along a spanning tree of training shapes in the latent space. Experiments on the ShapeNet dataset demonstrate that our approach significantly reduces geometric distortion and improves cross-shape consistency compared with state-of-the-art spherical parameterization methods.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. Sai Karthikey Pentapati and Shashank Gupta contributed equally to this work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GenSP 是一个数据驱动的框架，用于学习一组 genus-0 形状之间一致的球面参数化。该方法通过训练一个神经生成模型来预测从单位球面到形状的连续映射，并通过逆映射获得参数化，从而鼓励相似形状共享一致的参数化。实验在 ShapeNet 数据集上表明，该方法相比现有方法显著减少了几何畸变并提高了跨形状一致性。
Motivation: 传统的球面参数化方法独立优化每个形状，难以保证不同形状之间参数化的一致性。
Method: 提出 GenSP 框架，包含三个关键组件：连续神经变形模型（从球面坐标和潜在形状编码预测表面点）、利用中间形状扩展训练空间、以及通过潜在空间中的生成树传播映射来获得可靠的初始对应。
Result: 在 ShapeNet 数据集上的实验显示，该方法在减少几何畸变和提高跨形状一致性方面优于现有的球面参数化方法。
Conclusion: GenSP 通过数据驱动的生成模型实现了形状集合的一致球面参数化，为后续形状分析任务提供了更好的基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MindEdit-Bench: Benchmarking Object-Level Counterfactual Spatial Reasoning in VLMs from In-the-Wild Photos
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarks for vision-language models (VLMs) mostly test observational spatial reasoning: models describe relations already visible in the input. Existing what-if tasks typically vary the observer while keeping the scene fixed. Can VLMs instead predict the consequences of hypothetically moving or rotating an object? We introduce MindEdit-Bench, a benchmark of six spatial reasoning tasks built from three-photo smartphone triplets of newly captured indoor scenes via an automatic in-the-wild 3D scene-graph extraction pipeline. Four tasks probe perception and perspective transformation over observed structure; two new tasks, L4 (spatial editing) and L5 (cross-view visibility editing), probe object-level counterfactual reasoning, where correct answers are absent from all input images. Each question provides 8-24 structured answer choices, enabling answer-letter-level diagnosis of spatial and fallback errors. The benchmark covers 120 private indoor scenes not drawn from public datasets, reducing public-data pretraining-overlap risk. Across 15 VLMs on 1,003 human-verified questions, task-wise mean VLM accuracy is only 8%-31%, versus 81%-97% human majority-vote accuracy. The pooled human--best-VLM gap is 53 pp, with at least 39 pp on every task. The structured answer space further reveals non-uniform failures, including weaker camera-depth-axis inference and fallback behavior on difficult visibility-editing cases.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: PAPA: Online Personalized Active Preference Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models are highly effective at modeling complex data distributions, including images and text. However, in applications like personalized recommender systems, the objective often shifts to modeling specific regions of the distribution that maximize user preferences-initially unknown but gradually uncovered through interactive feedback. This can naturally be framed as a reinforcement learning problem, where the goal is to fine-tune a diffusion model to maximize a reward function based on preferences. However, the main challenge lies in learning a parameterized reward model, which typically requires large-scale preference data-something that is often not feasible in practice. In this work, we introduce Personalized Active Preference Alignment PAPA, a novel method that bypasses the requirement for a parametrized reward model by directly optimizing the diffusion model using real-time user feedback. PAPA enables feedback-efficient preference alignment, drawing inspiration from the variational inference framework. We demonstrate PAPA's effectiveness through extensive experiments and ablation studies across diverse class-conditioned and fine-grained alignment tasks. Additionally, based on theoretical insights, we propose an enhanced fine-tuning strategy, referred to as EPAPA, that requires less computational budget and accelerates the fine-tuning process, further boosting PAPA's suitability for real-world deployment. Our code is made publicly available at https://github.com/NasikNafi/papa.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Personalized Active Preference Alignment (PAPA)，一种无需参数化奖励模型的在线个性化偏好对齐方法，通过实时用户反馈直接优化扩散模型。结合变分推断框架实现反馈高效对齐，并进一步提出EPAPA加速微调。实验在类条件和细粒度对齐任务上验证有效性。
Motivation: 现有偏好对齐方法依赖大量偏好数据训练奖励模型，在个性化推荐等实时交互场景中不切实际。
Method: PAPA基于变分推断框架，直接利用实时用户反馈优化扩散模型，避免显式奖励模型；EPAPA通过理论驱动策略降低计算成本并加速微调。
Result: 实验证明PAPA在类条件和细粒度对齐任务上有效，EPAPA进一步减少计算资源并加速收敛。
Conclusion: PAPA为无需预训练奖励模型的在线个性化偏好对齐提供可行方案，EPAPA增强其实际部署适用性。

papers.title: Beyond the Prompt: Jailbreaking Function-Calling LLMs via Simulated Moderation Traces
papers.abstract_en: Jailbreak attacks remain a critical threat to the safe deployment of large language models (LLMs). While prior work has primarily studied attacks and defenses at the prompt level, we show that this prompt-centric paradigm overlooks a structural vulnerability in stateful, function-calling environments. In such applications, developer-defined schemas, structured arguments, and untrusted tool outputs are interleaved into a single shared model context. This architecture expands the attack surface by blurring the boundary between trusted control logic and untrusted data, allowing adversarial intent to be distributed across a multi-turn execution path. We exploit this architectural flaw through SMT, a black-box attack framework based on Simulated Moderation Traces. Departing from purely prompt-based interactions, SMT constructs a multi-turn trajectory that simulates a legitimate moderation-auditing workflow. Within this trajectory, a fabricated moderation frame leverages red-team testing as a pretext to elicit harmful generations. The subsequent validation feedback treats safety refusals as execution failures, prompting refinements that gradually weaken the model's safety constraints and ultimately trigger harmful outputs. Extensive empirical evaluations on prominent commercial LLMs from five different providers across two standardized safety benchmarks show that SMT consistently achieves the highest average attack success rate and HarmScore while requiring a near-minimal number of queries, substantially outperforming existing baselines. These findings demonstrate that prompt-level sanitization alone is fundamentally insufficient for defending tool-enabled LLM systems and highlight the urgent need for context-aware validation across schemas, arguments, tool outputs, and accumulated conversation state. The code is available at https://github.com/liujlong27/SMT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示状态化函数调用 LLM 中提示级防御的结构性漏洞，提出模拟审查轨迹（SMT）的黑盒攻击框架，通过构建多轮交互模拟合法审核流程，利用伪造的审查帧以红队测试为借口诱导有害输出，并在主流商业模型上取得高攻击成功率和 HarmScore，证明提示级过滤不足。
Motivation: 现有越狱攻击研究主要关注提示级，忽略了函数调用环境中开发者定义的模式、结构化参数和不可信工具输出交织在共享上下文中的结构性漏洞。
Method: 提出 SMT 框架，通过模拟合法审核工作流的多轮轨迹，在其中插入伪造的审核帧，将安全拒绝视为执行失败并逐步削弱安全约束，最终触发有害输出。
Result: 在五个提供商的商业模型和两个安全基准上，SMT 以近最少的查询数达到最高平均攻击成功率和 HarmScore，显著优于现有基线。
Conclusion: 提示级净化对工具支持的 LLM 系统根本不足，需要跨模式、参数、工具输出和累积对话状态的上下文感知验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Ghost in the Kernel: In-Context Learning with Efficient Transformers via Domain Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based large models have demonstrated remarkable generalization abilities across different tasks by leveraging a context-aware attention module for in-context learning. With richer context, transformers adapt more effectively to the current use case without any parameter updates. However, the quadratic computational and memory complexity with respect to context length significantly slows data processing in softmax transformers. Linear transformers were proposed to address this issue by reducing the complexity to linear dependence on context length, but the design and understanding of the feature mapping in linear attention, from a theoretical viewpoint, remain unclear. In this paper, we investigate the approximation and generalization abilities of linear transformers under a two-staged sampling process from domain generalization. We show that linear transformers perform in-context learning as learning a mapping from context distributions to response functions. A dimension-independent convergence rate is obtained for our generalization analysis, which also exhibits the tradeoff between the regularities of data distributions and latent features. Guided by our theoretical framework, we propose a new perspective on activation and loss design for linearizing pretrained softmax large language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从域泛化（domain generalization）角度研究线性Transformer的上下文学习（in-context learning）能力。通过两阶段采样过程，证明线性Transformer学习从上下文分布到响应函数的映射，并得到维度无关的收敛率，揭示数据分布规律与潜在特征的权衡。基于此理论，提出线性化预训练softmax大语言模型的激活和损失设计新视角。
Motivation: 线性注意力机制虽将复杂度降至线性，但特征映射的设计和理论理解仍不清楚，缺乏从理论视角对其近似和泛化能力的分析。
Method: 采用域泛化中的两阶段采样过程，将线性Transformer的上下文学习建模为从上下文分布到响应函数的映射学习，并推导泛化误差的收敛率。
Result: 获得维度无关的收敛率，表明数据分布规律与潜在特征之间存在权衡。
Conclusion: 为线性化预训练softmax大语言模型提供激活和损失设计的新理论视角。

papers.title: Interpretable vs Learned Encoders for High-Cardinality Fraud Detection
papers.abstract_en: A total of seven categorical encoding methods were tested on the IEEE-CIS fraud benchmark dataset (590,540 records, 3.5% positives, 8 high-cardinality columns). The encoders were evaluated using a stratified 5-fold cross-validation (CV) with three repetitions. Five of the encoders had identical frozen LightGBM learners in the downstream phase, allowing for controlled comparisons of their performance to each other. CatBoost and TabNet were included as comparisons across paradigms using different learners. The entity embeddings produced the highest AUC-ROC (0.9612), with a statistically significant tie with that of CatBoost (0.9602) and statistically superior to tier group encoding (0.9548), whereas target encoding was only 0.0023 worse than tier group encoding and the auditor-friendly tier boundaries were maintained. Off-the-shelf TabNet did not outperform tree-based pipelines and collapsed under data scarcity. On AUC-PR, CatBoost leads (0.822 vs. 0.793); no encoder dominated both metrics. Per-column analysis confirmed the embedding advantage arises from joint multi-column representation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在IEEE-CIS欺诈数据集（590,540条记录，3.5%正样本，8个高基数类别列）上，使用分层5折交叉验证重复3次，比较了7种分类编码方法。在相同LightGBM基学习器下，实体嵌入取得了最高AUC-ROC（0.9612），与CatBoost（0.9602）无统计显著差异，且显著优于tier group编码（0.9548）。CatBoost在AUC-PR上领先（0.822 vs 0.793）。按列分析表明嵌入优势来自联合多列表示。
Motivation: 高基数分类变量的编码方式在欺诈检测中缺乏系统性比较，特别是可解释编码（如目标编码、层级编码）与学习型编码（如实体嵌入）之间的性能权衡尚未明确。
Method: 采用分层5折交叉验证，在冻结的LightGBM下游模型下比较了实体嵌入、目标编码、tier group编码等五种编码器，并引入CatBoost和TabNet作为跨范式对比。
Result: 实体嵌入AUC-ROC最高（0.9612），与CatBoost（0.9602）无显著差异，显著优于tier group（0.9548）和目标编码（0.9525）；CatBoost在AUC-PR上表现最佳（0.822），但无编码器同时主导两个指标。TabNet未超越树模型，且在数据稀疏时失效。
Conclusion: 实体嵌入和CatBoost在欺诈检测中表现优异，但各有侧重：实体嵌入在AUC-ROC上占优，CatBoost在AUC-PR上更好。实际应用中需根据具体需求权衡可解释性与性能。

papers.title: How Early Is Early Enough? Design-Dependent Observation-Window Sufficiency in Subscription Churn Prediction
papers.abstract_en: How many days of early behavior suffice for subscription churn prediction? In the public KKBox dataset, the early indicator of churn is typically an indicator of someone's contract status; however, when looking in the heavily churned manual-renewal segment, having access to early behavior creates a substantial increase in prediction for that specific segment (PR +0.10 at 120 days). A nine-window sufficiency curve shows a diminishing-returns knee in a 45-90 day band. However, stress-testing over three cohort/task designs shows that this curve is singular to the design being tested; for example, in our test with a moving target, the curve inverts and can shift depending on the feature set used. Therefore, any window-sufficiency claim should state its cohort construction, target definition, and feature families. All evidence is from one music-streaming dataset; the mechanism should generalize but the magnitudes may not.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究订阅流失预测中早期行为观察窗口的充分性问题。基于KKBox数据集，发现手动续费细分群体中早期行为能显著提升预测性能（120天PR提升+0.10），窗口充分性曲线在45-90天出现收益递减拐点。但压力测试表明该曲线依赖于实验设计（如任务定义、特征集），因此任何窗口充分性结论必须明确说明其设计条件。
Motivation: 订阅流失预测中需要确定多少天的早期行为数据足够进行有效预测，但现有研究缺乏对窗口充分性设计依赖性的系统分析。
Method: 使用KKBox音乐流媒体数据集，构建九窗口充分性曲线，并在三个不同队列/任务设计（包括移动目标场景）下进行压力测试，比较不同特征集对曲线形状的影响。
Result: 手动续费细分群体中，早期行为在120天窗口比无早期行为带来PR+0.10的提升；窗口充分性曲线在45-90天出现收益递减拐点，但该曲线在移动目标设计中会反转或偏移。
Conclusion: 订阅流失预测的窗口充分性结论高度依赖于实验设计（队列构建、目标定义、特征族），任何此类主张必须明确设计条件。基于单一数据集，机制可能泛化但数值幅度不一定。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 手动续费细分群体中，早期行为在120天窗口比无早期行为带来PR+0.10的提升；窗口充分性曲线在45-90天出现收益递减拐点，但该曲线在移动目标设计中会反转或偏移。
summary_sections.conclusion: 订阅流失预测的窗口充分性结论高度依赖于实验设计（队列构建、目标定义、特征族），任何此类主张必须明确设计条件。基于单一数据集，机制可能泛化但数值幅度不一定。

papers.title: Predicting Lethal Outcome (Cause) And Understanding Key Biomarkers Linked With Acute Myocardial Infarction Using Deep Artificial Neural Network And Ensemble Of Machine Learning Methodologies
papers.abstract_en: Cardiovascular disease is still one of the main causes of death around the world. Acute myocardial infarction (MI), or heart attack, claims millions of lives each year. MI happens when blood flow to the coronary arteries is blocked or reduced, which causes permanent damage to the heart muscle. Without treatment, this can lead to cardiac arrest, where the heart stops pumping blood to the organs, resulting in organ failure and death. Even survivors often face serious problems like heart failure, pulmonary edema, and asystole. Research shows that 5 to 10 percent of survivors die within the first year after an MI, and nearly half need to be hospitalized again. Early thrombolytic treatment leads to better outcomes, so there is a clear need for faster and more accurate ways to diagnose MI. Right now, doctors usually review patient history and use their own experience to find the causes of MI. This process takes a lot of time and can be inconsistent. Detecting MI accurately and quickly can help patients take better care of themselves and prevent fatal events. In this study, we introduce an automated model to predict deadly outcomes of MI and help doctors understand important biomarkers linked to its complications. This approach aims to make diagnosis clearer, faster, and more affordable. The process includes preparing the data, filling in missing values, and handling imbalanced data using SVMSMOTE, ADASYN, and class-weighted methods. We use wrapper and embedded feature selection to find the most important variables, then scale the features for consistency. The model combines Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Light-GBM, and Bagging SVM, and is further improved with an artificial neural network to increase accuracy. We evaluate all models using precision, recall, and other key measures to find the best option for clinical use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文开发了一个自动预测急性心肌梗死致死结局的模型，结合数据处理、特征选择（包装法和嵌入法）、多种机器学习分类器（逻辑回归、随机森林、LightGBM、Bagging SVM）以及人工神经网络以提高准确性。在预处理中使用了SVMSMOTE、ADASYN和类别加权方法处理不平衡数据。实验评估了精确率、召回率等指标，旨在为临床提供更快、更准确的诊断辅助工具。
Motivation: 急性心肌梗死是全球主要死因之一，现有诊断依赖医生经验，耗时且不一致。早期溶栓治疗能改善预后，因此迫切需要更快速、准确的自动化诊断方法，以帮助医生理解关键生物标志物并预测致死结局。
Method: 数据预处理（缺失值填充、SVMSMOTE/ADASYN/类别加权处理不平衡）、包装法和嵌入法特征选择、特征缩放、集成多种机器学习模型（逻辑回归、随机森林、LightGBM、Bagging SVM），并进一步使用人工神经网络提升精度。评估使用精确率、召回率等指标。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，仅声明模型组合和神经网络提升了准确性，并通过精确率、召回率等指标选择最佳临床模型。
Conclusion: 该方法有望使心肌梗死诊断更清晰、快速和经济，帮助患者预防致命事件。但摘要未提及方法在实际临床中的验证或局限性。

papers.title: Neural Network-Based Estimation of Time-Dependent Parameters in AR(p) Processes
papers.abstract_en: We investigate a forecasting framework based on a simple discrete-time dynamic model with coefficients varying in time. The parameters of the model are recovered within a deep learning framework, which makes it possible to retain a transparent parametric structure while simultaneously accounting for complex and nonstationary patterns in the observed phenomenon. Our analysis covers two specifications of the noise process. Besides the standard Gaussian setting, we also consider Laplace-distributed noise, which can offer a more adequate description in the presence of heavier tails and sharper local fluctuations. For both cases, we formulate the predictive scheme of the model and analyze the associated uncertainty quantification, including the construction of prediction intervals. The results illustrate that a relatively simple model, when combined with time-dependent parameter estimation, can serve as a mathematically tractable and practically flexible tool for forecasting complex dynamics under different noise assumptions. The general model is stated for TVAR($p$), while the prediction-interval formulas and the numerical experiments are developed for the TVAR(1) case.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于神经网络的框架，用于估计自回归过程（AR(p)）中的时变参数，同时保持模型参数透明且能捕捉非平稳模式。考虑了高斯和拉普拉斯两种噪声分布，并推导了预测区间的构造方法。数值实验针对TVAR(1)情形展开，表明简单模型结合时变参数估计在复杂动态预测中具有灵活性和数学可处理性。
Motivation: 传统自回归模型假设参数恒定，难以适应非平稳时间序列；而纯黑箱深度学习缺乏参数可解释性。本文旨在结合两者优势，在保留参数结构的同时利用神经网络灵活估计时变系数。
Method: 采用深度学习框架（神经网络）来估计TVAR(p)模型中的时变参数，并针对高斯噪声和拉普拉斯噪声分别建立预测方案，包括预测区间的构造。
Result: 数值实验在TVAR(1)情形下验证了所提方法的有效性，具体结果摘要未详述，但指出该模型在复杂动态预测中兼具数学可解释性与实际灵活性。
Conclusion: 一个相对简单的模型，当结合时变参数估计时，能够成为在不同噪声假设下预测复杂动态的数学可处理且实用的工具。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: StochasT: Learning with Stochastic Turn Depth for Visual Instruction Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) rely extensively on Visual Instruction Tuning (VIT) to elicit their multimodal reasoning capabilities. However, we find a discrepancy: VIT often packs multiple language tasks about the same image for conversational, multi-turn training, whereas existing benchmarks evaluate LVLMs in isolated, single-turn scenarios. The models can suffer from visual attention decay and contextual overfitting during multi-turn training, making it hard for them to realize their full potential in the mismatched test phase. To close the gap, we propose learning with Stochastic Turn Depth (StochasT), which stochastically groups language tasks for the same image into clusters of varying sizes (turn depth) while preserving their organic order. Hence, while StochasT draws on Dropout and stochastic depth for ResNets, it does not actually drop anything to maximize the utility of the training data. Furthermore, we introduce a challenging, benchmark-agnostic evaluation mechanism based on the Balanced Latin Square to measure LVLMs' robustness under varying contextual dependencies. Extensive experiments demonstrate that StochasT effectively grants LVLMs strong, harmonized capabilities for both single-turn and multi-turn use cases.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page and code: https://yuanqing-ai.github.io/StochasT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现视觉指令微调（VIT）中多轮训练与单轮测试不匹配的问题，提出随机轮次深度（StochasT）方法，随机分组语言任务以模拟不同轮次深度，从而提升模型在单轮和多轮场景下的鲁棒性。实验表明该方法能有效增强LVLM的统一能力。
Motivation: 现有VIT多轮训练导致视觉注意力衰减和上下文过拟合，测试时却用单轮评估，存在训练-测试不匹配，限制了模型潜力。
Method: 提出StochasT，受Dropout和随机深度启发，将同一图像的语言任务随机分组为不同大小的簇（即轮次深度），保持原始顺序但不丢弃任何数据，以最大化训练数据利用率。同时引入基于平衡拉丁方的鲁棒性评估机制。
Result: 大量实验表明StochasT有效赋予LVLM在单轮和多轮场景下强大且协调的能力。
Conclusion: 通过随机轮次深度训练，可以弥合多轮训练与单轮测试之间的差距，提升模型在不同上下文依赖下的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MolSafeEval: A Benchmark for Uncovering Safety Risks in AI-Generated Molecules
papers.abstract_en: Current molecular generation benchmarks emphasize task complexity, molecule novelty, and property alignment; they largely overlook a critical concern: the potential safety risks of AI-generated molecules. In practice, many generative models may produce molecules with toxic, reactive, or otherwise hazardous characteristics - posing hidden dangers that remain insufficiently addressed. To address this gap, we introduce MolSafeEval, a benchmark dedicated to evaluating and analyzing the safety risks of molecular generation. Unlike prior approaches that rely on narrow toxicity predictors, MolSafeEval integrates heterogeneous safety knowledge - ranging from toxicological databases to hazard rules - into a structured molecular safety knowledge graph. This graph serves as a foundation for large language model-based reasoning, enabling systematic detection and explanation of unsafe features in generated compounds. We further categorize molecular generative models into four representative task types - unconditional generation, property optimization, target protein-based design, and text-based generation - and provide standardized datasets and safety evaluation protocols for each. By systematically revealing the safety vulnerabilities of current generative approaches, MolSafeEval offers a new lens for benchmarking molecular models and provides essential guidance toward safer, more trustworthy molecular design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MolSafeEval是一个专门评估AI生成分子安全风险的基准，它构建了结构化分子安全知识图谱，整合毒理学数据库和危害规则，并基于大语言模型推理检测不安全特征。该基准覆盖四种分子生成任务类型（无条件生成、性质优化、靶点蛋白设计、文本生成），并提供标准化数据集和评估协议，系统揭示了当前生成模型的安全漏洞。
Motivation: 现有分子生成基准侧重任务复杂度、分子新颖性和性质对齐，忽视了生成分子可能具有毒性、反应性等安全风险，缺乏系统评估的基准。
Method: 构建分子安全知识图谱集成异构安全知识（毒理学数据库、危害规则），以此作为大语言模型推理的基础，实现不安全特征的检测与解释；并分类分子生成模型为四种任务类型，分别提供标准化数据集和评估协议。
Result: 通过系统性分析揭示了当前分子生成方法的安全脆弱性，为分子模型安全评估提供了新视角。
Conclusion: MolSafeEval旨在引导更安全、更可信的分子设计，强调安全评估应成为分子生成基准的重要组成部分。
Relevance: 0
