papers.title: DroneFINE: Domain-Aware Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Vision-Language Detectors for Drone Images
papers.abstract_en: Object detection for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) working in open and dynamic environments is a highly challenging task. While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have offered a powerful solution for universal object detection, adapting them to UAV scenarios remains non-trivial due to a substantial domain gap between VLM pre-training data and aerial imagery. The prevailing Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods prove ineffective in bridging this gap, as VLMs' "natural-scene, foreground-dominant" visual priors misalign with the "bird's-eye-view, background-dominant, small-object" characteristics of UAV data. To address this issue, we propose DroneFINE, a novel PEFT paradigm comprising two domain-aware complementary modules tailored for VLM-based drone image detectors. Specifically, a data-dependent, foreground-aware, and multi-path adaptation mechanism named HyperAdapter is designed, which overcomes the static structural constraints of PEFT. In addition, a background suppression algorithm named SemanticGate is developed. It is a text-conditioned guidance strategy that employs background vocabulary to actively guide the model in suppressing responses from irrelevant regions. Extensive experiments on VisDrone and UAVDT demonstrate that DroneFINE significantly outperforms existing PEFT methods and achieves performance comparable to full fine-tuning while substantially reducing the number of trainable parameters.

papers.title: Managed Autonomy at Runtime: Gear-Based Safety and Governance for Single- and Multi-Agent Cyber-Physical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous agents, whether LLM-driven software agents or robotic physical agents, face a common class of failure modes when operating without continuous human oversight: safety violations from unverified actions, behavioral instability from unconstrained loops, and continuity loss from unhandled error states. We develop \system{}, a discrete-time control system that combines five execution gears (\Gobs{}, \Gsug{}, \Gplan{}, \Gexec{}, \Gint{}) with utility-gated dispatch and event-driven fallback. For the single-agent case, we prove monotonic stability, execution safety, eventual stabilization, fallback completeness, and equivalence to a gear-constrained Markov decision process. For multi-agent cyber-physical systems (CPS), we apply the established \smart{} managed-autonomy lifecycle and map runtime evidence into its four governance states (\Stable{}/\Meta{}/\Assisted{}/\Regulated{}). Consensus gating, swarm-level Lyapunov analysis, per-agent gear authority, and rendezvous control provide distributed safety and stability guarantees, including zero collision under the stated assumptions. We evaluate the resulting runtime on a three-agent UR5 robotic assembly cell using fault magnitudes calibrated from the NIST \emph{Degradation Measurement of Robot Arm Position Accuracy} dataset across 10,000 Monte Carlo episodes. It achieves a 99.6\% anomaly detection rate versus 2.1\% for the single-agent baseline, reduces detection latency by $3.5\times$, and supplies a formal physical-workspace safety certificate. The execution gears act as micro-level permissions beneath the \smart{} runtime governance states, separating action control from autonomy governance.
papers.comment: to be submitted to a Journal, 18 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个名为\system{}的离散时间控制系统，通过五个执行档位（观察、建议、规划、执行、中断）和效用门控调度实现单智能体与多智能体CPS的安全自治。在单智能体场景下证明了单调稳定性、执行安全、最终稳定、回退完备性，并等价于档位约束的MDP。在多智能体场景下，集成smart生命周期与四个治理状态，通过共识门控、群体Lyapunov分析和逐智能体档位权限提供分布式安全保证。在三个UR5机器人装配单元上，使用NIST数据集校准的故障进行10000次蒙特卡洛评估，异常检测率达99.6%（单智能体基线2.1%），检测延迟降低3.5倍，并给出形式化的工作空间安全证书。
Motivation: 自主代理在无持续人工监督时面临共性的故障模式：未验证动作导致的安全违规、无约束循环引发的行为不稳定、未处理错误状态导致的连续性损失。
Method: 设计一个离散时间控制系统，包含五个执行档位（Gear），结合效用门控调度和事件驱动回退。单智能体场景下给出稳定性与安全性证明；多智能体CPS场景中，应用smart管理自治生命周期，将运行时证据映射到四个治理状态，并使用共识门控、群体Lyapunov分析、逐智能体档位权限和领航-跟随控制实现分布式安全与稳定性保证。
Result: 在三台UR5机器人装配单元上，使用NIST机器人手臂位置精度退化数据集校准的故障进行10000次蒙特卡洛实验。系统异常检测率99.6%（单智能体基线仅为2.1%），检测延迟降低3.5倍，并提供形式化工作空间安全证书。
Conclusion: 执行档位作为微观权限在smart运行时治理状态之下运行，实现了动作控制与自主治理的分离，为混合自治系统提供了可证明的安全保障。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: K-Inverse-RFM: A Modified RFM that Bridges the Gap to Neural Networks for Data-Corrupted Mathematical Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Recursive Feature Machines (RFMs) are a class of kernel machines that utilize the Average Gradient Outer Product (AGOP) as a mechanism for feature learning. They have been shown to effectively replicate the learning dynamics and feature representations of Feedforward Neural Networks (FNNs) across various settings. However, despite comparable capacity for feature learning and the similarities in the features they acquire, RFMs exhibit significantly lower performance than neural networks in certain data-corrupted scenarios. In this work, we investigate these limitations in mathematical problems. As a solution, we introduce a remarkably effective transformation applied to the training labels which promotes learning in noisy, complexly represented, and class-imbalanced data. This simple yet powerful adjustment enables RFMs to close the performance gap with FNNs and, in some cases, even surpass them.
papers.comment: Master's thesis, University of California San Diego, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Recursive Feature Machines (RFMs) 在数据损坏场景下的性能限制，并提出一种对训练标签的简单有效变换，使 RFMs 能缩小甚至超越前馈神经网络（FNNs）在数学问题上的表现。
Motivation: RFMs 在特征学习方面与神经网络有相似能力，但在某些数据损坏（噪声、复杂表征、类别不平衡）场景下性能显著低于神经网络。
Method: 提出对训练标签进行转换的方法（K-Inverse-RFM），以促进在噪声、复杂表示和类别不平衡数据中的学习。
Result: 该方法使 RFMs 能够缩小与 FNNs 的性能差距，在某些情况下甚至超越 FNNs。
Conclusion: 文章强调了这种简单调整的有效性，并指出其在数学问题数据损坏场景下的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Watermarking for Proprietary Dataset Protection
papers.abstract_en: A growing body of literature suggests that training data membership inference problems are fundamentally hard tasks in modern language modeling settings. We argue that output watermarking techniques are the right gadget to make training membership tests for generative models more tractable, based on prior results showing that language models exhibit residual watermark "radioactivity" under partially watermarked training datasets. We pit a watermark-based dataset inference approach head-to-head against traditional loss-based membership inference methods and show that watermarking can achieve comparable membership detection performance when subset exposure is high enough, under an alternate set of assumptions.
papers.comment: 8 pages and 6 figures in the main body; presented at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Trustworthy AI for Good
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨将输出水印技术用于生成式模型的训练数据成员推断问题。基于语言模型在部分水印训练数据下会残留水印“放射性”的已有发现，作者将基于水印的数据集推断方法与传统的基于损失的成员推断方法进行对比，证明在子集曝光度足够高且替代假设条件下，水印方法可以达到可比的成员检测性能。
Motivation: 训练数据成员推断在当代语言模型设置中被认为是本质上困难的任务，现有方法往往不可靠。
Method: 利用输出水印技术，通过检测生成文本中残留的水印信号来判断训练数据成员身份，并与基于损失的传统成员推断方法进行对比。
Result: 在子集曝光度足够高且特定假设下，基于水印的方法可以达到与基于损失的方法相当的成员检测性能。
Conclusion: 输出水印技术可作为使生成式模型的训练成员测试更可行的工具，但依赖于一定的条件假设。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CORGI: Consistency-Aware 3D Dog Reconstruction from a Single Image in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing high-fidelity 3D models of highly articulated animals, such as dogs, from a single in-the-wild image remains a formidable challenge. In this paper, we introduce CORGI, a novel framework for consistency-aware 3D dog reconstruction from a single unconstrained image that completely eliminates the need for 3D supervision. To overcome generative inconsistencies and the lack of multi-view capture, our pipeline introduces three core components. First, we propose a Canonical-Driven Orbital Generation (CDOG) strategy, utilizing specialized Canonical and Orbit LoRAs to normalize arbitrary input poses and synthesize reliable 360-degree video observations. Second, we design a Consistency-aware Deformable 3DGS (CA-3DGS) module that anchors on a D-SMAL prior, explicitly modeling per-view generative errors through dedicated neural deformation fields to learn accurate vertex-level displacements. Finally, to eliminate structural distortions and recover high-frequency details, we introduce a self-supervised Deformation-Conditioned Generative Repair (DCGR) module. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CORGI achieves state-of-the-art performance, generalizing seamlessly across diverse dog breeds to produce geometrically accurate, visually coherent, and fully animatable 3D assets ready for downstream applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CORGI框架，从单张野外图像重建高保真3D狗模型，无需3D监督。通过Canonical-Driven Orbital Generation、Consistency-aware Deformable 3DGS和Deformation-Conditioned Generative Repair三个模块，在多种犬种上取得SOTA性能，生成几何精确、视觉连贯且可动画的3D资产。
Motivation: 从单张图像重建高铰接动物（如狗）的3D模型极具挑战，现有方法存在生成不一致和缺乏多视图监督的问题。
Method: 提出CORGI框架，包括：1) Canonical-Driven Orbital Generation (CDOG) 策略，利用专用LoRA归一化姿态并生成360度视频；2) Consistency-aware Deformable 3DGS (CA-3DGS) 模块，基于D-SMAL先验建模每视图生成误差；3) 自监督Deformation-Conditioned Generative Repair (DCGR) 模块消除结构畸变并恢复高频细节。
Result: 实验表明CORGI在多种犬种上取得SOTA性能，生成几何精确、视觉连贯且可动画的3D资产。
Conclusion: 该框架无需3D监督即可从单张图像重建高质量3D狗模型，适用于下游应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Spectral Methods to Sample Complexity Bounds for Fourier Neural Operators
papers.abstract_en: We establish approximation and learning guarantees for Fourier neural operators (FNOs) applied to time-$T$ solution operators of dissipative evolution equations. The analysis builds on the premise that FNOs can efficiently approximate and learn solution operators whenever these operators admit stable and accurate spectral discretizations. To formalize this idea, we introduce classes of evolution operators defined through spectral methods and derive FNO approximation bounds and polynomial sample complexity guarantees for these classes. For equations with polynomial nonlinearities, the learning rates depend primarily on the smoothness of the input space and the dimension of the physical domain. Our results hold uniformly over broad families of dissipative equations, rather than for a single fixed PDE, and apply in particular to the Navier--Stokes, Allen--Cahn, and Cahn--Hilliard equations. For equations with non-polynomial smooth nonlinearities, we prove that polynomial sample complexity still holds with rates that now additionally depend on the smoothness of the nonlinear terms and the dissipation strength. Overall, we connect classical spectral approximation theory with modern operator learning and explain when FNOs can learn nonlinear evolution operators efficiently.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为傅立叶神经算子（FNO）应用于耗散演化方程的时间-T解算子建立了近似和学习的保证。分析基于FNO能够高效逼近和学习解算子的前提，只要这些算子具有稳定且精确的谱离散化。作者通过谱方法引入演化算子类，推导了FNO逼近界和多项式样本复杂度保证。对于具有多项式非线性的方程，学习速率主要取决于输入空间的光滑度和物理区域的维度。结果一致适用于广泛的耗散方程族，包括Navier-Stokes、Allen-Cahn和Cahn-Hilliard方程。对于非多项式光滑非线性项，证明了多项式样本复杂度仍然成立，但速率额外依赖于非线性项的光滑度和耗散强度。总体而言，本文将经典谱近似理论与现代算子学习联系起来，解释了FNO何时能高效学习非线性演化算子。
Motivation: 现有算子学习方法缺乏对FNO在非线性演化方程上的逼近和样本复杂度的理论理解，尤其是跨不同方程族的统一保证。
Method: 基于谱方法定义演化算子类，利用FNO的谱逼近性质，推导出逼近误差界和学习所需的样本复杂度界限，考虑多项式和非多项式非线性两种情况。
Result: 对于多项式非线性方程，学习速率主要依赖于输入光滑度和空间维度；对于非多项式光滑非线性，仍需多项式样本复杂度，但速率额外依赖于非线性项光滑度和耗散强度。结果适用于Navier-Stokes、Allen-Cahn和Cahn-Hilliard等方程。
Conclusion: 建立了经典谱近似理论与FNO算子学习之间的联系，揭示了FNO高效学习非线性演化算子的条件，但结果局限于耗散方程且依赖谱离散化的性质。

summary_sections.result: 对于多项式非线性方程，学习速率主要依赖于输入光滑度和空间维度；对于非多项式光滑非线性，仍需多项式样本复杂度，但速率额外依赖于非线性项光滑度和耗散强度。结果适用于Navier-Stokes、Allen-Cahn和Cahn-Hilliard等方程。
summary_sections.conclusion: 建立了经典谱近似理论与FNO算子学习之间的联系，揭示了FNO高效学习非线性演化算子的条件，但结果局限于耗散方程且依赖谱离散化的性质。

papers.title: Typography-Based Monocular Distance Estimation for Advanced Driver-Assistance Systems
papers.abstract_en: Estimating the distance to a leading vehicle is a basic input to forward collision warning, adaptive cruise control, and automated emergency braking. Production systems obtain this distance from radar, laser scanners, or stereo camera pairs, which add cost, power draw, and packaging constraints. This paper asks whether a single ordinary camera can recover the same distance by using a target that is standardized in size and present on every road vehicle: the rear license plate. U.S. plates share a fixed outer size and a character height that is set by regulation and varies only narrowly between states, so the height of a plate character in the image is a direct measure of distance once the camera geometry is known. The proposed method (Typography-Based Monocular Distance Estimation) detects the plate, measures the height of its printed characters, identifies the issuing state to select the correct physical character height, and recovers distance from the camera projection. Three measurements taken from the same plate: the character height, the stroke width, and the character spacing. Together with the spacing of the two mounting holes and a single-image depth network, are combined so that a weak or corrupted measurement is given less weight automatically. The distance, its rate of change, and a time-to-collision estimate are smoothed across frames and used to raise a warning with the timing used by U.S. collision-warning regulations. The same plate that anchors the scale also identifies the vehicle, so the method returns a distance, a bearing, and an identity from one passive sensor. It reads scale from a printed standard instead of from time of flight or parallax, making it a cheap, low-maintenance complement to those sensors in a fault-tolerant perception stack, achieving the cost-effective distance estimation with error less than 0.13 m.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于车牌印刷字体（Typography）的单目距离估计方法，用于高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）。该方法通过检测后车牌、测量字符高度、识别发牌州以获取标准物理尺寸，结合字符笔画宽度、字符间距、安装孔距以及单图像深度网络，自动加权融合多个测量值，并跨帧平滑距离、变化率和碰撞时间估计，最终以低成本实现误差小于0.13米的距离估计。
Motivation: 现有ADAS系统依赖雷达、激光扫描仪或立体相机获取前车距离，成本高、功耗大且受封装限制。本文探索仅用普通单目相机，利用每辆车后车牌这一标准尺寸目标来恢复距离，以降低成本和复杂度。
Method: 提出Typography-Based Monocular Distance Estimation方法：检测车牌，测量印刷字符高度、笔画宽度和字符间距，结合安装孔间距和单图像深度网络，自动为弱或损坏的测量赋予较低权重，融合得到稳定距离，并跨帧平滑输出距离、变化率和碰撞时间估计。
Result: 摘要报告该方法实现了误差小于0.13米的距离估计，且能提供距离、方位和车辆身份信息，无需飞行时间或视差，为ADAS感知系统提供低成本、低维护的容错补充。
Conclusion: 本文强调，利用车牌这一强制标准化印刷物作为尺度基准，可以从单一被动传感器中同时获取距离、方位和身份信息，作为一种低成本、低维护的传感器补充方案，适用于容错感知堆栈。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RetailSMV: Exocentric vs. Egocentric Adaptation of Foundation Video World Models in Retail
papers.abstract_en: Foundation video diffusion models are increasingly viewed as world simulators for embodied agents, yet their pretraining on internet-scale generic video leaves them poorly aligned with real-world deployment domains. We study parameter-efficient adaptation of a pretrained foundation video world model to retail scenes: when synchronized egocentric and exocentric video of the same activity are available, which viewpoint of training data produces the strongest adapted model? We introduce RetailSMV (Retail Synchronized Multi-View), a corpus of 32,105 captioned retail clips from five supermarkets with synchronized ego/exo capture from the store-staff perspective (stocking, arranging, weighing, managing supply carts, scanning at checkout), rather than the customer-centric framing of prior retail video corpora, and train three matched Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) configurations of Cosmos3-Nano (egocentric-only, exocentric-only, combined) under identical hyperparameters. On a 200-clip held-out test set evaluated with seven complementary metrics under a strict paired statistical protocol, exocentric-only adaptation matches or exceeds combined adaptation on six of seven point estimates and is significantly better on LPIPS, PSNR, and DreamSim, despite training on only 15,985 exocentric clips (versus 32,105 for combined). A symmetric paired comparison further shows that adding exocentric data to egocentric-only training helps while adding egocentric data to exocentric-only training hurts. The absolute adaptation gap is largest at the shortest rollout time, identifying the near-horizon prediction window as the regime in which adaptation is most beneficial.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究零售场景下基础视频世界模型的参数高效适应，比较了在外视角（exocentric）和内视角（egocentric）训练数据上的效果。作者构建了RetailSMV数据集，包含从超市员工视角同步采集的32,105段带标注视频片段，并训练了三种LoRA配置。实验表明，仅使用外视角数据在六项指标上匹配或优于联合训练，且添加外视角数据对内视角训练有帮助，反之则有害。
Motivation: 基础视频扩散模型在互联网通用视频上预训练后，难以直接适应真实部署场景（如零售）。需要研究哪种视角的训练数据能最有效地适应零售环境。
Method: 构建RetailSMV数据集，包含五个超市的同步内外视角视频；对Cosmos3-Nano模型进行三种LoRA适应（仅内视角、仅外视角、联合），在相同超参数下训练，并使用七种指标在200片段测试集上评估。
Result: 仅外视角适应在六项指标（LPIPS、PSNR、DreamSim等）上优于或等于联合适应，且统计显著；对称对比显示，向外视角训练添加内视角数据有害，而向内视角训练添加外视角数据有益；适应差距在短时间滚动预测窗口最大。
Conclusion: 在外视角数据比内视角或联合数据更有效地适应零售场景的基础世界模型，且短时预测窗口是适应最有效的区域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mapping the Evaluation Frontier: An Empirical Survey of the Bias-Reliability Tradeoff Across Eleven Evaluator-Agent Conditions
papers.abstract_en: The bias-reliability tradeoff conjectures that LLM evaluation systems are constrained in (gamma, H, CV) space, where evaluator coupling (gamma), strategy diversity (H), and small-sample measurement reliability (CV(N)) cannot be simultaneously optimized at fixed sample size N. Prior evidence rests on n=5 conditions with complete metrics from a single study. We expand the empirical base to 11 conditions, measuring gamma and H for all 11 (nine with valid weight vectors) and CV(N=5) for seven with sufficient seeds (N >= 5). Five conditions provide the complete (gamma, H, CV) triple. The data confirm the trade-off: conditions with low evaluator coupling (gamma < 0.2) exhibit high measurement noise (CV(N=5) > 1.0), while conditions with strong coupling (gamma > 0.9) achieve low noise (CV(N=5) < 0.16). The correlation r(H, gamma) = -0.989 (n=5, excluding GPT-4o conditions) confirms that evaluator coupling suppresses strategy diversity. Four GPT-4o conditions show gamma=0.000 and H=1.000 across all seeds -- a pattern we attribute to version drift in the June 2026 GPT-4o API. No condition occupies the region {gamma < 0.2, CV(N=5) < 0.3}. We release all per-condition metrics as a standardized benchmark dataset for evaluator comparison.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过扩展经验基础至11种评估者-智能体条件，实证检验了LLM评估系统中的偏差-可靠性权衡。数据证实了低评估者耦合（gamma < 0.2）与高测量噪声（CV > 1.0）的关联，以及强耦合（gamma > 0.9）与低噪声（CV < 0.16）的关联。四种GPT-4o条件因API版本漂移而呈现gamma=0且H=1的异常模式。没有条件同时满足gamma<0.2和CV<0.3的指标。
Motivation: 现有偏差-可靠性权衡的证据仅基于5种条件的单一研究，缺乏大规模实证验证。
Method: 在11种条件下测量评估者耦合（gamma）、策略多样性（H）和小样本测量可靠性（CV），其中9种有有效权重向量，7种有足够种子（N>=5），5种提供完整三元组。
Result: 确认了权衡：低耦合条件CV>1.0，高耦合条件CV<0.16；gamma与H的相关系数为-0.989（n=5，排除GPT-4o条件）；GPT-4o条件呈现gamma=0且H=1的异常。
Conclusion: 本文的实证结果支持偏差-可靠性权衡，并提供了标准化的基准数据集以供评估者比较。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Wake up for Touch! Mask-isolated Tactile Alignment Learning in MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Touch supplies the physical grounding needed to perceive intrinsic material properties, such as friction and compliance, that vision alone often cannot resolve. Recent efforts for equipping multimodal LLMs with this tactile sense, however, expose a zero-sum trade-off: the limited parameter budget of compact models forces a choice between acquiring the new sensory modality and preserving the established vision-language reasoning. We present Splash, a mask-isolated tactile alignment learning framework for MLLMs. Splash quantifies the significance of each pretrained parameter, and partitions the parameter space into a dormant and critical subspace. While the frozen critical subspace acts as a stable anchor to safeguard general visual knowledge, Splash updates the isolated dormant subspace to internalize tactile alignment towards LLMs. This selective, non-destructive expansion effectively prevents catastrophic forgetting and ensures non-destructive modality expansion. Extensive experiments show that Splash effectively achieves tactile reasoning without additional inference overhead in the LLM part, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance on visuo-tactile benchmarks, including SSVTP, TVL, and TacQuad, while preserving its original general-purpose capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Splash，一种掩码隔离的触觉对齐学习框架，用于多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）。该方法通过量化预训练参数的重要性，将参数空间划分为休眠子空间和关键子空间，冻结关键子空间以保持视觉知识，仅更新休眠子空间以吸收触觉对齐，从而避免灾难性遗忘，实现非破坏性模态扩展。在 SSVTP、TVL 和 TacQuad 等视觉-触觉基准上达到最先进性能，同时保持通用能力。
Motivation: 现有紧凑多模态大语言模型在增加触觉感知时面临零和权衡：参数预算有限，必须在获取新模态和保留视觉-语言推理能力之间做出选择，导致灾难性遗忘。
Method: 提出 Splash 框架：量化每个预训练参数的重要性，将参数空间分为休眠子空间和关键子空间；冻结关键子空间作为稳定锚，仅更新休眠子空间以内部化触觉对齐，实现非破坏性模态扩展。
Result: 摘要报告在 SSVTP、TVL 和 TacQuad 等视觉-触觉基准上达到最先进性能，且未增加 LLM 部分的推理开销，同时保持原有通用能力。
Conclusion: Splash 通过选择性非破坏性参数更新有效实现触觉推理，避免灾难性遗忘，为多模态大语言模型添加新模态提供了可行框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generative Modeling of Quantum Distribution with Functional Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of powerful deep generative models based on diffusion and flow matching has enabled the learning and modeling of complex distributions. Learning quantum distributions, however, remains challenging due to the inherent difficulty of accurately modeling the meaningful physical properties of quantum states. We propose Quantum Flow Matching (QFM), a novel generative model designed to learn quantum distribution by utilizing spin Wigner function and flow matching. By converting density matrix into the spin Wigner function and leveraging functional flow matching to learn distributions in function space, QFM enables accurate and effective learning of multi-qubit quantum distributions. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method by evaluating physical quantities such as trace, purity, and entanglement entropy of the generated quantum states, accurately capturing the underlying physics of the given quantum distributions.
papers.comment: Accepted as an extended abstract at the Quantum Techniques in Machine Learning (QTML) 2024
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Quantum Flow Matching (QFM)模型，利用自旋Wigner函数和函数空间中的流匹配学习多量子比特量子分布。通过评估生成量子态的迹、纯度、纠缠熵等物理量验证其准确性。
Motivation: 现有深度生成模型难以准确建模量子分布中具有物理意义的关键属性。
Method: 将密度矩阵转换为自旋Wigner函数，使用函数流匹配（functional flow matching）在函数空间中学习分布。
Result: 评估生成量子态的迹、纯度、纠缠熵等物理量，准确捕捉了给定量子分布的基础物理。
Conclusion: QFM能够有效学习多量子比特量子分布，并准确反映其物理性质。

papers.title: EPC: A Standardized Protocol for Measuring Evaluator Preference Dynamics in LLM Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: When LLM agents use evaluator feedback to adapt their behavior in closed loops, evaluator biases propagate through the agent's strategy distribution -- a phenomenon known as evaluator preference coupling. Prior work has documented coupling across multiple evaluator families and model versions, but the field lacks a standardized protocol that enables third-party researchers to (i) reproduce coupling measurements, (ii) compare results across evaluators and time points, and (iii) detect measurement decay as proprietary evaluators silently update. This paper provides the protocol. We specify EPC (Evaluator Preference Coupling) -- a detailed, RFC-style protocol specification for the four-phase isolation paradigm, covering executor and evaluator configuration, strategy and task design, the TTRL update rule, metric computation (gamma, JSD, ECE, Brier), and output schema. We accompany the protocol with a versioned Reference Snapshot v1.0: coupling measurements for eight evaluator conditions (N=122 unique experimental repetitions across GPT-4o, Qwen, DeepSeek, and others) derived from five independent studies, annotated with evaluator version identifiers, API endpoints, and measurement dates. The snapshot is explicitly time-bound: all values are conditional on specific model versions and are expected to decay as proprietary evaluators update. We define a versioning convention (vX.Y-Z, encoding protocol version, snapshot version, and evaluator generation) and provide a usage guide covering adoption, interpretation, and known pitfalls. The protocol, reference snapshot, and implementation code are released as open infrastructure.

papers.title: Learning When to Listen: Gated Affect Fusion for Human Motion Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Human motion forecasting in unconstrained real-world videos remains challenging due to the ambiguity of future behaviors and the presence of noisy multimodal observations. While facial affect potentially provides complementary behavioral cues, its practical utility and mechanistic boundaries within motion forecasting frameworks remain poorly understood. In this work, we present a systematic study investigating the utility and temporal limitations of affect-conditioned forecasting in-the-wild. We establish a rigorous multimodal pipeline combining MediaPipe body pose trajectories with HSEmotion facial affect representations, and introduce the Gated Affect Transformer (GAT) to dynamically regulate cross-modal information flow. Through extensive multi-horizon evaluations under a strict subject-wise protocol, we demonstrate that naive early cross-modal concatenation consistently degrades forecasting accuracy relative to pose-only baselines. Conversely, our proposed gating mechanism stabilizes cross-modal integration by adaptively controlling the affective stream. Crucially, controlled counterfactual experiments using shuffled and randomized affect inputs reveal that the learned gate successfully suppresses unstructured cross-modal noise while remaining responsive to plausible affective signals. Furthermore, our empirical results indicate that facial affect features provide bounded, horizon-dependent predictive cues strictly within short-to-medium windows (e.g., 30 frames), whereas long-term trajectories remain predominantly governed by intrinsic kinematic continuity. Our findings provide empirical evidence that facial affect should be regarded as a complementary behavioral cue rather than a dominant driver of future motion, offering practical guidance for selective multimodal fusion in unconstrained human motion forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在非约束真实世界视频中，利用面部情感特征辅助人体运动预测。作者提出门控情感Transformer（GAT）动态调节跨模态信息流。实验表明，简单早期跨模态拼接会降低预测精度，而门控机制通过自适应控制情感流稳定了融合。情感特征仅在短中期窗口（如30帧内）提供有限预测线索，长期轨迹仍由运动连续性主导。结论认为面部情感应视为互补线索而非主导因素。
Motivation: 现有运动预测在非约束视频中受限于未来行为模糊性和多模态噪声，面部情感可能提供行为线索，但其实际效用和机制边界尚不清楚。
Method: 建立多模态流程，结合MediaPipe身体姿态轨迹与HSEmotion面部情感表示，提出门控情感Transformer（GAT）动态调节跨模态信息流。采用严格的subject-wise协议进行多时间跨度评估，并通过反事实实验（随机情感输入）验证门控效果。
Result: 简单早期跨模态拼接相对于纯姿态基线会降低预测精度，而门控机制通过自适应控制情感流稳定了融合。情感特征在短中期窗口（如30帧内）提供有限预测线索，长期轨迹仍由运动连续性主导。
Conclusion: 面部情感应视为互补行为线索而非未来运动的主导驱动因素，为非约束人体运动预测中选择性多模态融合提供了实用指导。

papers.title: Rosetta: Composable Native Multimodal Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Achieving true artificial general intelligence requires foundation models capable of integrating new modalities without forgetting prior knowledge. However, accommodating continuous generative objectives alongside discrete understanding tasks causes severe gradient conflicts. Existing architectures, including standard Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), are highly susceptible to representation overwriting. Even structurally partitioned paradigms like Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) remain vulnerable to catastrophic forgetting, severely impeding multimodal scalability. In this work, we introduce Rosetta, a composable native multimodal pretraining framework designed for seamless and non-destructive modality expansion. Rosetta adopts a modular paradigm where core foundational knowledge is preserved within global shared experts, while modality-specific capabilities are distributed across plug-and-play experts. To guarantee non-destructive composition, we propose Momentum-Anchored Orthogonal Projection (MAOP). MAOP leverages the optimizer's momentum state as an implicit semantic anchor, selectively neutralizing conflicting gradient components from new modalities while preserving synergistic updates. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that, while standard MoE and MoT architectures suffer catastrophic forgetting of previously acquired knowledge, Rosetta robustly preserves established language and visual understanding. Furthermore, it delivers superior image generation and unlocks cross-modal synergy, paving the way for truly composable and unified multimodal foundation models. To facilitate further multimodal research, we release our code and checkpoints to the community. Project page at https://rosetta-lmm.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Rosetta，一种可组合的原生多模态预训练框架，通过模块化设计保留基础知识，利用动量锚定正交投影（MAOP）减少梯度冲突，实现无损模态扩展。实验表明，Rosetta 能保留语言和视觉理解能力，同时提升图像生成性能，避免标准 MoE 和 MoT 的灾难性遗忘。
Motivation: 现有多模态架构（如 MoE、MoT）在扩展新模态时容易发生表示覆盖和灾难性遗忘，梯度冲突严重，限制了多模态模型的扩展性。
Method: Rosetta 采用模块化范式，核心知识由全局共享专家保存，模态特定能力通过即插即用专家实现。提出动量锚定正交投影（MAOP），利用优化器动量状态作为隐式语义锚点，选择性中和冲突梯度成分，保留协同更新。
Result: 与标准 MoE 和 MoT 相比，Rosetta 在保留已学语言和视觉理解能力的同时，在图像生成任务上表现更优，并实现跨模态协同。
Conclusion: Rosetta 为可组合的统一多模态基础模型提供了一种非破坏性模态扩展方案，缓解了灾难性遗忘问题。

papers.title: An LLM-Based Framework for Intent-Driven Network Topology Design
papers.abstract_en: Designing deployable and resilient network topologies from natural language requirements remains a challenging problem in network automation. This work investigates the ability of Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate structurally valid and constraint-compliant network topologies through a constraint-driven pipeline combining hierarchical modeling and systematic validation. The framework is evaluated via a multimodel comparison of proprietary and open-weight LLMs across four realistic network scenarios released as a public dataset. We assess structural correctness using node and edge F1-scores against reference topologies, and evaluate resilience through server and content connectivity metrics. In addition, we analyze common failure modes, including interface mismatches and directional inconsistencies in generated topologies. Overall, this work provides a systematic benchmark for understanding how LLMs handle structural and resilience constraints in topology synthesis, and supports informed model selection for AI-driven network design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究利用大语言模型（LLM）从自然语言需求中生成网络拓扑，提出一个结合分层建模和系统性验证的约束驱动流水线。通过对比多个闭源和开源LLM在四个现实网络场景上的表现，评估结构正确性和弹性，并分析常见失败模式。
Motivation: 从自然语言需求自动生成可部署且鲁棒的网络拓扑是网络自动化中的难题。
Method: 提出一个约束驱动的流水线，结合分层建模和系统性验证，利用LLM生成拓扑，并通过节点和边F1分数以及连接性指标进行评估。
Result: 在四个现实网络场景上，通过多模型比较，衡量了结构正确性和弹性，并总结了接口不匹配和方向不一致等失败模式。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了系统基准，帮助理解LLM在拓扑合成中处理结构和弹性约束的能力，并支持AI驱动网络设计的模型选择。

papers.title: OnPoint: Offline-to-Online Multi-Level Distillation for Point-Supervised Online Temporal Action Localization
papers.abstract_en: Temporal Action Localization (TAL) typically relies on segment annotations or offline access to full videos, limiting scalability and online use. We introduce Point-Supervised Online TAL (POTAL), which localizes actions in streaming videos using only one temporal point per instance. To solve POTAL, we propose OnPoint, an offline-to-online multi-level distillation framework that transfers knowledge from a point-supervised offline teacher to an online student via (i) pseudo-segment instance distillation, (ii) class-activation sequence distillation, and (iii) anticipatory window-level distillation. We further improve robustness by incorporating the original point labels into student training and by refining anchor decoding with actionness-guided attention calibration. Experiments on five datasets show OnPoint consistently outperforms strong baselines, establishing a solid foundation for POTAL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出点监督在线时序动作定位（POTAL）任务，只需每个实例一个时间点标注。提出OnPoint框架，通过伪片段实例蒸馏、类激活序列蒸馏和预测窗口级蒸馏，将离线教师知识迁移到在线学生。在五个数据集上优于强基线。
Motivation: TAL通常依赖片段标注或离线访问完整视频，限制了可扩展性和在线使用。引入POTAL以降低标注成本并支持在线场景。
Method: OnPoint框架包含三个蒸馏组件：伪片段实例蒸馏、类激活序列蒸馏和预测窗口级蒸馏。另外将原始点标签纳入学生训练，并通过动作引导注意力校准改进锚点解码。
Result: 在五个数据集上，OnPoint一致优于强基线，为POTAL奠定基础。
Conclusion: 该工作为点监督在线时序动作定位建立了基准方法。

papers.title: Self-Organized Learning in Oscillatory Neural Networks with Memristive Signed Couplings
papers.abstract_en: Oscillatory neural networks (ONNs) have emerged as a promising neuromorphic architecture, leveraging coupled dynamical systems to perform computation and represent information through phase relationships. Their interactions can be designed to support intrinsic energy-minimizing dynamics, enabling tasks such as associative memory and optimization, and positioning them as a candidate architecture for continuous learning and inference. We present a neuromorphic primitive implemented using memristive edges with inhibitory couplings as a potential design for autonomous learning, and provide circuit simulation validation that the system is capable of denoising noisy inputs on an auto-associative task. While numerical Hopfield/Ising models routinely assume signed weights, neuromorphic implementations of ONNs often fail to realize negative weights due to device and circuit constraints. A practically implementable route to inhibitory (negative) weights is particularly valuable: it expands the class of attractor structures accessible to oscillator networks beyond purely synchronous couplings, and supports phase-coded memories where anti-phase constraints are not merely transiently enforced during training but can persist autonomously after release. We provide circuit simulations and theoretical analyses demonstrating that signed effective weights are necessary for anti-phase attractors to persist autonomously.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于忆阻振荡神经网络的自主学习基本构建块，利用抑制性耦合实现负权重，并通过电路仿真验证其在自动关联任务中能去噪。理论分析表明，符号有效权重对于反相吸引子自主持久存在是必要的。

Method: 提出使用忆阻边缘实现抑制性耦合的ONN基本构建块，通过电路仿真和理论分析验证符号有效权重对反相吸引子自主持久存在的必要性。
Result: 电路仿真验证了系统在自动关联任务中能去噪，且符号有效权重是反相吸引子自主持久存在的必要条件。
Conclusion: 该工作为ONN实现自主学习和相编码记忆提供了实际可行的抑制性权重实现路径。

papers.title: What's Hidden Matters: Identifying Planning-Critical Occluded Agents using Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous vehicles must safely navigate complex environments where planning-critical agents may be hidden from view. Current approaches often treat all occlusions with uniform conservatism, yielding needlessly defensive driving, or they infer hidden spaces without estimating the impact on the planner. This work bridges the critical gap between perception and planning by enabling Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to identify and reason about the specific hidden agents that are most critical to the ego-vehicle's trajectory. We introduce a novel framework that uses Planning KL-divergence (PKL), an information-theoretic metric, to systematically identify and rank occluded agents based on their impact on the ego vehicle's plan. Using this planning-aware ranking, we employ an expert VLM (GPT-5) to generate rich, structured annotations that capture the visual evidence and reasoning required for this task. We apply this framework to the nuScenes dataset to create a new benchmark focused on high-impact scenarios. We conduct comprehensive experiments on a wide range of general-purpose and domain-adapted VLMs, demonstrating that fine-tuning on our PKL-guided data yields dramatic performance improvements across all models. Notably, our results show that smaller, fine-tuned models significantly outperform their much larger zero-shot counterparts, and that our PKL-guided data selection strategy improves performance by approximately 30\% over random sampling. Our work presents the first systematic approach for training VLMs to focus on planning-critical occlusions, enabling more semantically grounded and efficient risk assessment in autonomous driving.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用视觉语言模型（VLM）识别对自动驾驶规划至关重要的被遮挡智能体。通过引入规划KL散度（PKL）量化遮挡智能体对自车轨迹的影响，并基于此排序生成结构化标注，构建新基准。实验表明，在nuScenes上微调小模型可显著超越大模型零样本性能，且PKL引导的数据选择策略比随机采样提升约30%。
Motivation: 现有方法对所有遮挡统一处理导致过度保守，或推断隐藏空间但未评估对规划的影响。需要一种规划感知的遮挡推理方法。
Method: 提出框架使用规划KL散度（PKL）系统识别和排序对自车规划影响最大的被遮挡智能体，并利用专家VLM（GPT-5）生成丰富的结构化标注。
Result: 微调后的小模型在规划关键遮挡识别任务上显著优于更大的零样本模型；PKL引导的数据选择策略相比随机采样性能提升约30%。
Conclusion: 本文首次系统训练VLM关注规划关键遮挡，实现更语义化和高效的风险评估，证明了规划感知数据选择的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Understanding Guest Preferences and Optimizing Two-sided Marketplaces: Airbnb as an Example
papers.abstract_en: Airbnb is a community based on connection and belonging -- many hosts on Airbnb are everyday people who share their worlds to provide guests with the feeling of connection and being at home; Airbnb strives to connect people and places. Among our efforts to connect guests and hosts, we provide tools to enable hosts to set competitive prices, which helps improve affordability for guests while helping hosts get more bookings. We also personalize the guest experience to show them the listings that match their needs. To help inform these efforts, we combine economic modeling and causal inference techniques to understand how guests book stays based on the prices hosts set, among other factors, and how that preference varies across different guests and listings. Such understanding helps us identify opportunities for Airbnb to support the marketplace and better connect guests and hosts. For example, understanding how much guests respond to different prices helps optimize the tools that we provide to hosts, in order to enable hosts to choose and set competitive prices that further balance demand and supply. As another example, understanding heterogeneity in guest preferences helps us personalize the guest experience and better match them with the listings that meet their needs, based on how much they respond to different prices and other factors.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures. Presented at the KDD 2024 Workshop on Two-Sided Marketplace Optimization, Barcelona, Spain
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以Airbnb为例，结合经济建模和因果推断技术，研究客人如何根据房东定价等因素预订住宿，并分析不同客人和房源的偏好异质性。作者旨在通过理解客人对价格的敏感度，优化房东定价工具，平衡供需，并个性化客人体验，提高匹配效率。
Motivation: 在线双面市场（如Airbnb）中，连接客人与房东的关键在于理解客人偏好及其对价格的响应，这有助于设计更好的定价工具和个性化推荐，从而优化市场效率。
Method: 采用经济模型与因果推断相结合的方法，分析客人预订行为与定价等因素的关系，并估计偏好异质性。
Result: 摘要指出，理解客人对价格的响应程度有助于优化定价工具，使房东能设定有竞争力的价格，平衡供需；同时，偏好异质性信息可用于个性化客人体验，提升匹配质量。
Conclusion: 本文通过Airbnb案例展示了经济建模与因果推断在双面市场优化中的应用，强调基于偏好理解可以改善市场工具和个性化服务，从而更好地连接客人与房东。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Training Vision-Language-Action Models with Dense Embodied Chain-of-Thought Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Cross-embodiment transfer in vision-language-action (VLA) models remains challenging because low-level state and action spaces differ fundamentally across robot platforms. We observe that the high-level cognitive process underlying manipulation, including scene perception, object identification, task planning, and sub-task decomposition, is largely shared across embodiments. Based on this observation, we present ZR-0, a 2.6 billion parameter end-to-end VLA model that uses dense Embodied Chain-of-Thought (ECoT) supervision to align cross-embodiment representations within the vision-language model (VLM). ZR-0 adopts a dual-stream architecture: a pre-trained VLM (System 2) generates structured ECoT reasoning during training, while a Diffusion Transformer-based action expert (System 1) produces continuous action chunks via flow matching. The two components are coupled through cross-attention, with an attention mask that restricts the action expert to input prompt features only, enabling ECoT generation to be entirely skipped at inference without any performance loss. ZR-0 is pre-trained on ProcCorpus-60M, a large-scale dataset comprising approximately 60 million frames (approximately 1,000 hours) from over 400K trajectories, with dense ECoT annotations covering 96.8% of all frames. We evaluate ZR-0 on three simulation benchmarks spanning single-arm (LIBERO), bimanual (RoboTwin 2.0), and humanoid (RoboCasa GR-1 Tabletop) embodiments, as well as real-world experiments on the xArm platform, demonstrating strong performance across all settings. Code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/RUCKBReasoning/ZR-0.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ZR-0，一个26亿参数的端到端视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，通过密集的具身链式思维（ECoT）监督来对齐跨本体表示。模型采用双流架构：预训练的视觉语言模型（System 2）在训练时生成结构化的ECoT推理，而基于扩散Transformer的动作专家（System 1）通过流匹配生成连续动作块。两者通过交叉注意力耦合，推理时可完全跳过ECoT生成而无性能损失。模型在大规模数据集ProcCorpus-60M（约6000万帧，1000小时，40万条轨迹）上预训练，ECoT标注覆盖96.8%帧。在单臂、双臂和人形三个仿真基准以及真实世界xArm平台上均表现强劲。
Motivation: 跨本体迁移在VLA模型中具有挑战性，因为低级状态和动作空间在不同机器人平台上差异很大。观察到高层认知过程（场景感知、物体识别、任务规划、子任务分解）在不同本体间共享，因此利用密集ECoT监督来对齐跨本体表示。
Method: 提出ZR-0模型，包含双流架构：System 2（预训练VLM）在训练时生成结构化ECoT推理；System 1（扩散Transformer动作专家）通过流匹配生成连续动作块。两者通过交叉注意力耦合，推理时通过注意力掩码限制动作专家仅使用输入提示特征，从而完全跳过ECoT生成。模型在ProcCorpus-60M数据集上预训练，具有密集的ECoT标注。
Result: 在单臂（LIBERO）、双臂（RoboTwin 2.0）和人形（RoboCasa GR-1 Tabletop）三个仿真基准以及真实世界xArm平台上均表现出强性能。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，通过密集的ECoT监督可以对齐跨本体表示，实现一个模型在多种机器人平台上有效执行任务，且推理时不增加计算开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: 3D Scene-Adaptive Trajectory-Controllable Human Image Animation with Camera Movement
papers.abstract_en: Human image animation, which aims to generate a video of a reference subject following a provided action sequence, has received increasing research interest. With the development of diffusion-based/flow-based video foundation models, existing animation works have began to upgrade the guidance information from 2D skeleton/pose to 3D modeling conditions. Despite achieving reasonable results, these approaches face challenges in synthesizing trajectory-controllable human motion within natural scene under changed camera views. In this work, we present a scene-adaptive human image animation framework that controls both human motion and camera trajectories within a reconstructed 3D environment for video generation. To achieve this, we first develop a ground-adaptive 3D motion retargeting approach to enable user-friendly motion trajectory control adapting to the changes of elevations of ground and orientations automatically. Then we design a viewpoint-adaptive latent fusion mechanism to inject point-cloud geometric priors through scene-visibility masking into the generative process, providing precise guidance of viewpoint changes under camera control. Experiments on two standard human image animation benchmark datasets demonstrate remarkable improvements of our method over the state of the arts in related video generation metics. Project page: https://robinhood256100.github.io/web-disp
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个3D场景自适应的人类图像动画框架，可在重建的3D环境中同时控制人体运动和相机轨迹。通过地面自适应3D运动重定向和视角自适应潜在融合机制，利用点云几何先验和场景可见性掩码指导生成过程，在两个标准数据集上取得了优于现有方法的视频生成指标。
Motivation: 现有动画方法在自然场景中生成轨迹可控的人体运动并适应视角变化时面临挑战。
Method: 提出地面自适应3D运动重定向（适应地面高度和朝向变化）和视角自适应潜在融合机制（通过场景可见性掩码注入点云几何先验）。
Result: 在两个标准人类图像动画基准数据集上，视频生成指标显著优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 该方法展示了在3D重建环境中联合控制人体运动和相机轨迹实现高质量视频生成的潜力。

papers.title: ManimAgent: Self-Evolving Multimodal Agents for Visual Education
papers.abstract_en: Multi-round reflection lets agents built on large language models recover from failures within a single task, but each task remains an isolated episode: lessons learned across many reflection rounds on one task are discarded before the next begins. We study this gap on a code-generation task: from a scientific paper section, the agent writes Python in the open-source Manim library to render a mathematical animation. We present ManimAgent, a self-evolving multimodal agent that carries reflection experience across tasks through a dual-channel Episodic Memory Bank grown entirely from its own task stream, with no weight updates and no human seeds. After each animation converges, a vision-language model scores the rendered keyframes; the resulting signals populate a positive channel M+ that stores success rationales as soft Reference Examples, and a negative channel M- that stores validated failure patterns as hard Known Pitfalls. On a fixed-probe evaluation against no-memory, matched-budget retrieval-augmented generation, and shuffled-memory baselines, blind human Pass@1 rises and reflection rounds fall as memory size grows. We will release the code, frozen memory snapshots, and the task stream.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ManimAgent，一种基于大语言模型的自进化多模态智能体，用于从学术论文片段生成数学动画（Manim 代码）。通过双通道情景记忆库（M+ 和 M-）跨任务传递反思经验，无需权重更新或人工种子。实验表明，随着记忆库增长，人类盲审 Pass@1 提升，反思轮次减少。
Motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的多轮反思智能体在单任务内可恢复错误，但学到的经验无法跨任务迁移，导致每项任务孤立执行。本文针对从论文片段生成数学动画的代码生成任务，研究如何让智能体积累和复用跨任务经验。
Method: 提出 ManimAgent，包含一个双通道情景记忆库：正通道 M+ 存储成功案例作为软参考示例，负通道 M- 存储已验证的失败模式作为硬已知陷阱。每次动画收敛后，视觉语言模型对关键帧评分，生成信号填入记忆库。智能体在后续任务中利用记忆库指导代码生成。
Result: 在固定探针评估中，与无记忆、匹配预算的检索增强生成和打乱记忆基线相比，人类盲审 Pass@1 随记忆库增大而提升，同时反思轮次下降。
Conclusion: 本文证明了跨任务经验记忆库可以有效提升多模态智能体在代码生成任务中的表现，且无需模型权重更新。未来将开源代码、冻结记忆快照和任务流。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Relevance Is Not Permission: Warranted Attention for Value Contributions
papers.abstract_en: Relevance is not permission. Attention lets a model read key-value items related to the current query, but it does not guarantee that the value contribution of such an item becomes prediction evidence. A retrieved passage may be relevant to a question without being supporting evidence, and a historical fact or temporal neighbor may even blur true-tail ranking or the current edge score. This paper formalizes this gap as a permission problem for the weighted value term alpha_ij * v_j that is actually added to the prediction path. We propose Warrant, a path-localized interface that preserves attention relevance alpha_ij, exposes the value path leading to the primary metric, and, in the full model, turns alpha_ij * v_j into alpha_ij * g_ij * v_j through learned query-item permission g_ij. We place the same operator on the metric-defining value paths of CTDG link prediction, MTPP next-mark ranking, RAG supporting evidence selection, STPP next-location forecasting, and TKG tail prediction. Across 32 paired comparisons, 3 seeds, and 192 total runs, Warrant improves the primary metric in 27 comparisons; practical tiers consist of 10 substantial effects, 1 marginal effect, 8 positive but uncertain effects, 8 tie/negligible effects, and 5 drops. In the path-localization check, correct-path placement outperforms direction-aware Base performance in every domain and exceeds generic attention placement by +0.1076 AUC in CTDG and +0.0683 MRR in TKG. Ablations show that most TKG gains come from historical-tail value path exposure, whereas the core CTDG gain comes from edge-conditioned query-item permission. In conclusion, prediction evidence is not attention mass. A weighted value term becomes evidence only when it is warranted on the path to the metric.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化了注意力机制中相关性与证据许可之间的差距，提出Warrant——一种路径定位接口，通过引入查询-项许可（query-item permission）g_ij将加权值项从alpha_ij * v_j转换为alpha_ij * g_ij * v_j，从而仅在预测路径上赋予证据地位。该方法在CTDG链接预测、MTPP next-mark排序、RAG支持证据选择、STPP位置预测和TKG尾预测等8个领域的192次运行中，主指标在27/32次配对比较中提升。
Motivation: 现有注意力机制仅保证查询与键值的相关性，但相关项的值贡献不一定成为预测证据（例如检索段落相关但不支持答案、历史事实模糊当前预测等），因此需要显式的“许可”机制来控制值项是否加入预测路径。
Method: 提出Warrant——一个路径定位的接口，保留注意力相关性alpha_ij，暴露通向主指标的值路径，并在全模型中通过学习到的查询-项许可g_ij将alpha_ij * v_j变为alpha_ij * g_ij * v_j。该算子统一应用于CTDG、MTPP、RAG、STPP、TKG等领域的指标定义值路径上。
Result: 在32对比较、3种随机种子、共192次运行中，Warrant在27次比较中改进了主指标：10次实质效果、1次边际效果、8次正向但不确定、8次平局/可忽略、5次下降。路径定位检查中，正确路径放置优于方向感知基础方法（Base）并在各领域超越通用注意力放置（CTDG中AUC高+0.1076，TKG中MRR高+0.0683）。消融显示TKG大部分增益来自历史尾值路径暴露，而CTDG核心增益来自边条件查询-项许可。
Conclusion: 预测证据并非注意力质量，而是加权值项仅在路径上获得许可时才成为证据。本文形式化了这一“许可问题”，并通过跨领域验证表明路径定位的许可机制比通用注意力放置更有效。

papers.title: Explainability-Aware Frustum Attack: Exposing Structural Vulnerabilities in LiDAR-Based 3D Object Detectors
papers.abstract_en: The structural vulnerabilities of point cloud-based 3D object detectors remain poorly understood. Prior work has studied adversarial robustness primarily on isolated 3D object models, while recent LiDAR spoofing attacks target richer and more realistic driving scenes but focus mainly on physical realizability rather than understanding detector behavior or attack efficiency. In this work, we investigate how LiDAR-based detectors rely on spatial evidence in complex scenes and whether these reliance patterns can be exploited to induce failures more efficiently. To this end, we propose an explainability-guided adversarial analysis methodology. We introduce the Saliency-LiDAR (SALL) method, which aggregates Integrated Gradient attributions across scenes to produce universal saliency maps for LiDAR-based 3D object detectors. Guided by these maps, we design the Explainability-aware Frustum Attack (EFA), which selectively perturbs only the most influential frustums rather than uniformly attacking entire object regions. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes, across detectors such as PointPillars and SECOND, show that EFA reduces detection recall by more than 15 percentage points while requiring 25-50% fewer perturbed frustums than the state-of-the-art non-saliency-aware baseline. These findings reveal that modern 3D detectors concentrate discriminative evidence in a small subset of spatial regions, exposing a structural robustness vulnerability in current LiDAR perception systems. Our code is released at https://github.com/SecMindLab/Saliency_LiDAR.
papers.comment: European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV), September 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可解释性引导的对抗攻击方法，用于暴露LiDAR-based 3D物体检测器的结构性脆弱性。作者提出Saliency-LiDAR (SALL)方法，通过聚合集成梯度归因生成通用显著性图，并基于此设计Explainability-aware Frustum Attack (EFA)，选择性扰动最关键的视锥体区域。在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，针对PointPillars和SECOND等检测器，EFA在减少25-50%扰动视锥体的情况下，使检测召回率下降超过15个百分点。结果表明，现代3D检测器将判别性证据集中在少数空间区域，存在结构鲁棒性漏洞。
Motivation: 现有激光雷达攻击主要关注物理可实现性，而非理解检测器行为或攻击效率；点云3D检测器的结构性脆弱性尚不明确。
Method: 提出可解释性引导的对抗分析框架：首先通过SALL方法（集成梯度归因聚合）生成通用显著性图，然后基于显著性图设计EFA，选择性地扰动最影响检测结果的视锥体区域。
Result: 在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，针对PointPillars和SECOND检测器，相比非显著性基线，EFA在减少25-50%扰动视锥体的情况下，使检测召回率下降超过15个百分点。
Conclusion: 现代3D检测器依赖少数关键空间区域，暴露了结构鲁棒性漏洞；可解释性引导的攻击方法比均匀攻击更高效。

papers.title: Beyond Triplet Plausibility: Relation Set Completion in Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge graphs (KGs) organize real-world knowledge as triplets and underpin many downstream applications. Due to their inherent incompleteness, knowledge graph completion (KGC) is widely studied and is typically formulated as triplet prediction, with link prediction as the dominant paradigm. However, this formulation focuses on the incompleteness of triplet-wise information and overlooks the incompleteness of entity-relation compatibility information. To address this limitation, we introduce a relation set completion task (RSC), which complements the link prediction task and aims to reason about missing relations that are semantically compatible with a given entity. We further propose a Relation Set Embedding model (RelSetE), which models latent patterns among the observed relations of entities to infer missing ones. To evaluate RelSetE, we derive three benchmark datasets from standard KG benchmarks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RelSetE effectively captures entity-relation compatibility patterns and performs favorably in inferring missing relations of entities. Code and data are publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对知识图谱中实体-关系相容性信息不完整的问题，提出关系集补全任务（RSC），旨在推断与给定实体语义相容的缺失关系。作者设计Relation Set Embedding模型（RelSetE），通过建模实体已有关系的潜在模式来预测缺失关系，并从标准KG基准派生出三个数据集进行评测。实验表明RelSetE有效捕捉实体-关系相容模式，在推断缺失关系上表现良好。代码和数据已公开。
Motivation: 现有知识图谱补全（KGC）主要聚焦于三元组预测（如链接预测），忽略了实体与关系之间是否相容这一层面的不完整性。本文提出关系集补全（RSC）任务，旨在补充链接预测，解决实体-关系相容性信息的缺失问题。
Method: 提出关系集补全任务RSC，并设计RelSetE模型，该模型学习实体观测到的关系集合中的潜在模式，从而推断实体可能缺失但语义相容的关系。
Result: 从标准KG基准（如WN18RR、FB15k-237）派生三个RSC数据集，实验表明RelSetE能够有效捕捉实体-关系相容性模式，并在推断缺失关系任务上表现优于基线方法。
Conclusion: 论文指出RSC任务是对传统链接预测的有益补充，RelSetE模型能有效建模实体与关系的相容性。代码和数据已开源。

papers.title: PoseShield: Neural Collision Fields for Human Self-Collision Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Self-collision remains a persistent challenge in SMPL-based human pose estimation and motion generation. Under extreme articulations or stochastic motion synthesis, generated meshes frequently exhibit self-penetrations, leading to physically implausible results. We propose PoseShield, a neural collision constraint defined directly in SMPL pose space. We formulate collision correction as a constrained optimization problem and connect the learned constraint with the Eikonal equation. Enforcing Eikonal regularization ensures non-vanishing gradients near the collision boundary, improving numerical stability and robustness of the optimization process. Unlike prior methods that operate in the mesh space or rely on heuristic penalties, our approach operates directly in the low-dimensional space of human poses and is theoretically grounded. The same learned constraint extends to human motion sequences, providing a generator-agnostic post-hoc collision corrector without retraining the underlying motion model. Experiments on a newly constructed SMPL pose benchmark show that our method achieves a 95.8% success rate and outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PoseShield，一种直接在 SMPL 姿态空间定义的神经碰撞约束，用于解决人体自碰撞问题。该方法将碰撞校正建模为带约束的优化问题，并引入 Eikonal 方程正则化以保证梯度非零，提升数值稳定性。实验在新构建的 SMPL 姿态基准上达到 95.8% 的成功率，优于现有方法。
Motivation: 基于 SMPL 的人体姿态估计和运动生成中，极端姿态或随机运动合成常导致网格自穿透，产生物理不真实的结果。现有方法多在网格空间操作或依赖启发式惩罚，缺乏理论依据和低维空间效率。
Method: 在 SMPL 姿态空间定义神经碰撞场，将碰撞校正转化为约束优化问题，并连接 Eikonal 方程进行正则化，确保碰撞边界附近梯度不消失。该方法可直接扩展到运动序列，作为生成器无关的后处理校正器。
Result: 在新构建的 SMPL 姿态基准上，方法达到 95.8% 的成功率，性能优于现有基线。
Conclusion: PoseShield 提供了理论严谨、低维空间的高效自碰撞校正方案，且无需重新训练底层运动模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FADE: Mitigating Hallucinations by Reducing Language-Prior Dominance in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Despite the impressive capabilities of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), they remain susceptible to hallucination, generating content inconsistent with the input image. Recent studies attribute this to the dominance of language priors over visual inputs and employ contrastive decoding methods to mitigate this dominance, but the mechanistic origin remains unexplored. We investigate the information flow through each transformer layer and find that attention modules consistently aggregate visual evidence, while FFN modules at critical layers act as the source of language priors. These priors can override visual evidence, causing correct predictions in intermediate layers to drift toward incorrect outputs. Based on this insight, we propose FADE (FFN Attenuation for DEcoding), a training-free method that attenuates FFN outputs to reduce language-prior dominance. Evaluations on POPE, CHAIR, and MME benchmarks across LLaVA-1.5, mPLUG-Owl2, and InstructBLIP show that FADE effectively mitigates hallucinations while preserving inference efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）中的幻觉问题，发现FFN模块在关键层作为语言先验的来源，会覆盖视觉证据导致预测漂移。提出无需训练的FADE方法，通过衰减FFN输出来减少语言先验主导，在POPE、CHAIR、MME基准上对LLaVA-1.5、mPLUG-Owl2、InstructBLIP进行评估，有效缓解幻觉并保持推理效率。
Motivation: LVLMs仍易产生与图像不一致的幻觉，先前归因于语言先验主导视觉输入，但机制起源未明。本文旨在探索信息流中语言先验的来源并提出缓解方法。
Method: 提出FADE（FFN Attenuation for DEcoding），一个无需训练的推理时方法，通过衰减关键层FFN模块的输出来降低语言先验的主导作用。
Result: 在POPE、CHAIR、MME基准上，FADE在LLaVA-1.5、mPLUG-Owl2、InstructBLIP上均有效缓解幻觉，且不牺牲推理效率。
Conclusion: FADE通过直接抑制FFN中的语言先验来减轻幻觉，是一种训练免费、高效的解码策略。

papers.title: Understanding Evaluation Illusion in Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Despite the capability of parallel decoding, diffusion large language models (dLLMs) require many denoising steps to maintain generation quality, motivating recent research on efficient decoding strategies. However, existing studies have reported inconsistent evaluation results even under seemingly identical evaluation settings, risking biased conclusions about dLLM decoding methods. To understand this evaluation concern, we conduct a rigorous evaluation of current decoding methods for dLLMs across diverse evaluation settings. Surprisingly, our analysis reveals that the ranking of decoding methods is highly sensitive to the choice of prompt templates. Single-template evaluation can lead to an illusion that decoding methods improve inference efficiency without performance degradation. Through comprehensive experiments, we find that current parallel decoding methods consistently underperform the single-token decoding baseline, failing to overcome the speed-quality trade-off. We further identify this evaluation inconsistency as the high sensitivity of parallel decoding methods to minor variations in prompt templates. Our experiments show that an effective prompt template can achieve strong evaluation results even with fewer denoising steps, markedly outperforming the marginal gain from increasing denoising steps. Beyond prompt templates, our experiments indicate that overlooked evaluation settings can also notably affect the assessment of decoding methods. Based on these findings, we propose practical guidelines for the reliable evaluation of decoding methods in dLLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）解码方法的评估不一致问题，发现单模板评估会导致评估幻觉，并行解码方法实际不如单token解码基线，且对提示模板高度敏感。提出可靠评估指南。
Motivation: 现有dLLMs解码方法评估结果不一致，可能导致错误结论。
Method: 通过系统性实验，分析不同评估设置（尤其是提示模板）对解码方法排名的影响。
Result: 并行解码方法在速度-质量权衡上始终不如单token解码基线，提示模板的有效性比增加去噪步数更重要。
Conclusion: 提出可靠评估指南，强调多模板评估和注意被忽视的评估设置。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HiComm: Hierarchical Communication for Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) often relies on communication to mitigate partial observability, yet most existing protocols treat messages as flat dense vectors detached from the structure of the observations they summarize. This design overlooks an important source of inductive bias in many cooperative environments, where observations naturally follow a hierarchy such as groups and entities. We propose \textsc{HiComm}, a plug-in communication module that grounds messages in the sender's hierarchical observation. \textsc{HiComm} is receiver-driven: the receiver issues a query, and the hierarchy is resolved through a three-stage decoding process that first selects a group, then a sender, and then an entity within that group, returning the corresponding feature slice as the message. This converts communication from unstructured vector transmission into structured information retrieval over the sender's observation hierarchy. We instantiate this mechanism with Straight-Through Gumbel-Softmax for differentiable discrete selection and a lightweight shared projection design that attaches to standard MARL pipelines. Experiments across cooperative MARL tasks with different observation structures and coordination demands show that \textsc{HiComm} matches or outperforms representative learned communication baselines while reducing communication volume by up to $23\times$ per receiver per episode.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HiComm，一种用于多智能体强化学习的分层通信模块，将消息基于发送者的分层观察结构，通过接收者驱动的查询和三阶段解码（组-发送者-实体）实现结构化信息检索。实验表明HiComm在多种合作任务上匹配或超越基线，同时每接收者每轮通信量降低至多23倍。
Motivation: 现有通信协议将消息视为平坦密集向量，忽略了观察中的层次结构（如分组和实体），缺乏归纳偏置。

Conclusion: 将通信从非结构化向量传输转换为结构化信息检索，有效利用观察层次结构，提升通信效率。

papers.title: Diff-Based Code Corruption using LLMs for Large-Scale Bugfix Benchmarking
papers.abstract_en: There are various benchmarks to evaluate bugfixing capabilities of Large Language Models. However, most widespread benchmarks do not fully reflect real-world bugfixing practices. They are small, weakening statistical reliability, and the buggy programs are often similar to one another, potentially distorting evaluation results. The range of bug types can also be narrow, failing to capture a representative range of bugs. To address these issues, we introduce MegaBugFix, a large-scale bugfixing benchmark containing 12,629 buggy Python programs synthesized from correct ones by a Large Language Model. Bug injections were generated as diffs representing code changes. Through this approach, we were able to avoid common pitfalls of LLM-based mutation techniques like injecting overly simplistic bugs or failing to modify the input program. We evaluated 13 open-weight models on MegaBugFix and baseline benchmarks, finding consistently lower performance on MegaBugFix. This reveals that our benchmark presents more challenging bugs and exposes model failures that may remain hidden when evaluating on existing benchmarks. The benchmark and fine-tuned model used for bug injection are available at hf.co/collections/szalontaib/megabugfix.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MegaBugFix，一个由LLM通过diff代码变更从正确代码合成12,629个有bug Python程序的大规模bug修复基准，旨在克服现有基准规模小、bug类型窄、评估不可靠的问题。在13个开源模型上的评估显示模型在该基准上性能一致低于现有基准，表明其包含更具挑战性的bug。
Motivation: 现有bug修复基准规模小、bug类型狭窄，且程序间相似度高，不能反映真实bug修复实践，导致评估统计可靠性低且结果可能失真。
Method: 使用LLM基于diff（代码变更）从正确程序注入bug，避免LLM变异技术常见问题（如注入过于简单的bug或未修改输入程序）。
Result: 在13个开源模型上评估，模型在MegaBugFix上的性能一致低于现有基准，表明其包含更难的bug并暴露了现有基准中隐藏的模型失败。
Conclusion: MegaBugFix提供了一个更具挑战性和代表性的bug修复基准，有助于更可靠地评估LLM的bug修复能力。基准和用于bug注入的微调模型已公开。

papers.title: MVPruner: Dynamic Token Pruning for Accelerating Multi-view Vision-Language Models in Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) improve generalization and interpretability in autonomous driving but suffer from efficiency issues due to long visual token sequences, particularly in standard multi-view settings. Existing token pruning methods employ fixed pruning rate allocation and static importance metrics, ignoring dynamic inter-view importance differences and the evolving information importance during inference. Our analysis reveals that multi-view VLMs inherently encode task-related view priors in deeper layers and exhibit dynamic information requirements. Motivated by these findings, we propose MVPruner, a two-stage adaptive token pruning method that aligns pruning behavior with the model's dynamic information requirements. The first stage allocates pruning budgets based on the information diversity of each view, and retains tokens with consistent contribution across stages, ensuring semantic representational capacity. The second stage allocates budgets and selects tokens guided by instruction text to guarantee task alignment. Experimental results on four benchmarks demonstrate the superior performance of our method. For example, DriveMM equipped with MVPruner achieves 87.3% reduction in FLOPs, 4.97* speedup in prefilling phase while retaining 98.5% accuracy on DriveLM benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多视图视觉语言模型（VLM）在自动驾驶中因长视觉token序列导致的效率问题，提出了一种两阶段自适应token剪枝方法MVPruner。第一阶段根据视图信息多样性分配剪枝预算并保留跨阶段一致性贡献的token；第二阶段利用指令文本引导预算分配和token选择，确保任务对齐。实验表明，DriveMM结合MVPruner在DriveLM基准上实现了87.3%的FLOPs减少、预填充阶段4.97倍加速，同时保留98.5%的准确率。
Motivation: 现有token剪枝方法采用固定剪枝率分配和静态重要性度量，忽略了多视图VLM中视图间动态重要性差异以及推理过程中信息需求的演变，导致效率低下。
Method: 提出MVPruner，包含两阶段：第一阶段基于各视图信息多样性分配剪枝预算，并保留跨阶段贡献一致的token以维持语义表示能力；第二阶段根据指令文本引导预算分配和token选择，增强任务对齐。
Result: 在四个基准上验证了有效性，以DriveMM为例，MVPruner实现了87.3%的FLOPs减少、预填充阶段4.97倍加速，在DriveLM上准确率保留98.5%。
Conclusion: MVPruner通过动态对齐剪枝行为与模型信息需求，显著加速多视图VLM，同时保持高精度，适用于自动驾驶场景。

papers.title: PersistentKV: Page-Aware Decode Scheduling for Long-Context LLM Serving on Commodity GPUs
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive large language model (LLM) serving is increasingly limited by key-value (KV) cache movement rather than dense matrix multiplication. Modern paged-attention systems reduce fragmentation, and mature kernels like FlashInfer provide highly optimized decode attention. However, the best single-kernel implementation is not always the best serving schedule: low-active long-context decode can under-utilize GPUs, while mixed sequence lengths introduce tension between many exact-length launches and coarse padded batches. We present PersistentKV, a native block-table decode attention engine and page-aware scheduling study for grouped-query attention (GQA). PersistentKV maps work by KV-head group, executes directly over native page tables, and adds a compact workqueue schedule executing only non-empty row-KV-head-sequence-split tasks. On an RTX 3060 (FP16, page size 16, Hq=32, Hkv=8, d=128), a calibrated roofline-style policy selects FlashInfer for small active batches, PersistentKV sequence splitting for batch size 1 (B1) long-context steps, and PersistentKV workqueue scheduling for supported B8 long-context GQA steps. With cost-model constants fixed on calibration traces, five held-out seeds improve mean wall decode-token throughput by 1.04x to 1.08x on B8 bimodal, uniform, and Zipf-like workloads, and by 1.40x on a B1 bucketed trace. For the B4 boundary case and uncalibrated GQA ratios, the policy avoids regressions by routing to FlashInfer. We also report an attention-plus-MLP timing proxy and workload counters showing workqueue scheduling reduces launch fan-out from 16.00 to 2.00 launches per step on held-out bimodal B8. These results show that work assignment is a decisive serving-system variable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长上下文LLM服务中KV缓存移动成为瓶颈的问题，提出PersistentKV，一种基于页表的解码注意力引擎和页面感知调度策略。PersistentKV通过按KV头分组映射工作、直接操作原生页表，并引入紧凑工作队列调度仅执行非空row-KV-head-sequence-split任务。在RTX 3060上，结合校准的roofline策略，在不同批量大小和序列长度下选择FlashInfer或PersistentKV调度，在保持的测试集上平均解码吞吐量提升1.04x至1.40x，并减少了启动次数。
Motivation: 自回归LLM服务中，KV缓存移动而非密集矩阵乘法成为主要瓶颈，现有分页注意力系统虽减少了碎片，但最佳单内核实现并非总是最优调度，长上下文解码可能低效利用GPU，混合序列长度带来精确启动与粗粒度批处理之间的张力。
Method: 提出PersistentKV，一个原生块表解码注意力引擎和页面感知调度研究，按KV头组映射工作，直接执行于页表，并添加紧凑工作队列调度仅执行非空row-KV-head-sequence-split任务。使用校准的roofline策略在不同场景下选择FlashInfer或PersistentKV调度。
Result: 在RTX 3060上，保持的测试集显示B8双峰、均匀和Zipf负载平均解码吞吐量提升1.04x至1.08x，B1分桶负载提升1.40x；B4边界情况通过回退FlashInfer避免退化；工作队列调度将每次启动数从16.00降至2.00。
Conclusion: 工作分配是LLM服务系统中的一个决定性变量，PersistentKV通过页面感知调度和精确任务拆分优化了长上下文解码性能。

papers.title: Text Over Image: Auditing Multimodal Robustness in Synthetic Medical Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid adoption of generative AI, synthetic medical images pose growing risks, including diagnostic deception and insurance fraud. Although prior work has explored vision-language model (VLM)-based synthetic image detection, these evaluations typically consider images in isolation. In clinical practice, however, images are interpreted alongside structured records and metadata, and VLMs are increasingly deployed under joint image-record inputs. We uncover a previously underexamined multimodal vulnerability: when given both modalities, VLMs may overweight record context in authenticity judgments, such that the same image receives different predictions solely due to changes in its accompanying text. This raises concerns about robustness in real-world deployment. To systematically characterize this effect, we reformulate synthetic medical image detection as an audit of multimodal robustness at the image-record interface and introduce a paired benchmark that holds the image fixed while swapping controlled metadata variants. Across multiple imaging modalities, we evaluate diverse open-weight and frontier API VLMs and find that changing the metadata context alone can flip authenticity judgments, with accuracy on authentic images dropping by 61.1% on average under an explicit AI-origin tag. We further propose an inference-time mitigation pipeline that detects and neutralizes provenance shortcuts without model retraining, substantially outperforming direct prompt-based suppression on the affected subset. Our benchmark provides a standardized tool for assessing and improving multimodal robustness beyond image-only settings. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.
papers.comment: Accepted at MICCAI 2026. Version 2 is a substantial journal extension of the MICCAI 2026 conference version, with additional provenance perturbations, paired statistical analysis, extended SAVC mitigation experiments, and broader deployment discussion. 19 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现多模态视觉语言模型（VLM）在合成医学图像检测中存在一个被忽视的脆弱性：当同时提供图像和文本（如病历记录、元数据）时，模型可能过度依赖文本上下文做出真实性判断，导致同一张图像因伴随文本的变化而得到不同预测结果。为了系统评估这一效应，作者将合成医学图像检测重新定义为图像-记录接口上的多模态鲁棒性审计，并引入配对基准，保持图像不变而交换受控的元数据变体。实验表明，仅改变元数据就足以翻转真实性判断，在显式标注AI来源标签的情况下，真实图像的准确率平均下降61.1%。作者还提出了一种无需模型重训练的推理时缓解管线，用于检测和消除来源捷径（provenance shortcuts），在受影响子集上显著优于直接基于提示的抑制方法。
Motivation: 临床实践中图像常与结构化记录和元数据一起解读，而现有VLM评估通常只考虑图像本身，忽略了多模态输入下模型可能过度依赖文本上下文的漏洞，这在实际部署中会引发鲁棒性问题。
Method: 将合成医学图像检测重新定义为多模态鲁棒性审计，提出一个配对基准（图像固定、元数据变体交换），并设计一种推理时缓解管线，无需重训练即可检测和消除来源捷径。
Result: 在多种成像模态上评估多个开源和前沿API VLM，发现仅改变元数据就能翻转真实性判断；在显式AI来源标签下，真实图像准确率平均下降61.1%。提出的缓解方法在受影响子集上优于直接基于提示的抑制。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个标准化基准工具，用于评估和提升超出纯图像设置的多模态鲁棒性，并展示了无需重训练的缓解策略的有效性。代码和数据将在接受后公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Heuresis: Search Strategies for Autonomous AI Research Agents Across Quality, Diversity and Novelty
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous AI Research promises to accelerate the scientific progress of machine learning. To realise this goal, current Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents need to go beyond just writing code, to mastering the exploration of simultaneously performant, diverse and novel ideas. To this end, we introduce Heuresis, a framework that abstracts the research pipeline into a set of general and composable primitives, enabling open-ended scientific exploration in machine learning research. We implement six search strategies: a greedy baseline, two archive-based (MAP-Elites, Go-Explore), one evolutionary (Islands), and two divergent (Curiosity, Omni), and evaluate them across three axes (Quality, Diversity, and Novelty) on three domains (LLM Pretraining, On-Policy RL, and Model Unlearning), totalling 3,222 scored runs. We find that completely novel ideas are rare. No idea across our scored runs is rated as "Original", and only a few achieve only "Minor Similarity" to prior work. Moreover, novel ideas never approach the highest-performing known-recipe scores. Across all six strategies and three domains, only one such idea lands in the top-10 by quality. We also observed agents resorting to a variety of reward-hacking techniques during execution (40 confirmed fabrications across 1,628 scored runs), and detecting them was necessary to keep the search faithful to the task. Our results show that while current search and Quality-Diversity strategies enable us to steer where the generated ideas land on the quality, diversity, and novelty axes, they do not expand the quality-novelty frontier. Bridging this gap is the open challenge towards the ultimate goal of perpetual, autonomous scientific progress. Code is available at github.com/a-antoniades/Heuresis.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Heuresis 框架，将自主 AI 研究抽象为可组合原语，并实现了六种搜索策略（贪婪、MAP-Elites、Go-Explore、Islands、Curiosity、Omni），在 LLM 预训练、在线强化学习和模型遗忘三个领域评估质量、多样性和新颖性。实验发现，全新想法极为罕见，且新颖性高的想法在质量上无法达到已知最优配方水平；同时观察到大量奖励黑客行为。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 代理在自主科研中仅擅长写代码，缺乏对同时具有高性能、多样性和新颖性想法的探索能力。
Method: 将研究流程抽象为一组通用可组合原语，实现六种搜索策略，并在三个领域运行 3,222 次评分实验，评估质量、多样性和新颖性。
Result: 全新想法几乎不存在（无想法被评为“原创”，仅少数与先前工作“轻微相似”），且新颖想法从未达到最高性能。在所有策略和领域中，仅有一个新颖想法进入质量前十。此外，检测到大量奖励黑客行为（1,628 次评分中 40 次确凿虚构）。
Conclusion: 当前搜索和质量-多样性策略可引导想法在质量、多样性和新颖性轴上的分布，但无法扩展质量-新颖性前沿，这是实现持续自主科学进步的关键挑战。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Laplace-Fisher Gate Identities for Optimal Matrix-Gated Blended Score Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Sampling from an unnormalized target by reversing an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck diffusion requires the score of each noise-perturbed marginal. Tweedie's identity and a target-score identity give unbiased finite-reference estimators for this score. Scalar blends can reduce variance, but are too rigid for singular or strongly anisotropic targets. We cast blended score estimation as conditional risk minimization over matrix-valued blending coefficients, or gates, and derive the variance-optimal gate G*(y,t) = alpha_t^2 (alpha_t^2 I_d + gamma_t E[H_0(X_0) | Y_t = y])^{-1}, H_0 = -nabla^2 log p_0. Here alpha_t = e^{-t} and gamma_t = 1 - e^{-2t}. We call this formula the Laplace-Fisher Gate Identity (LFGI). Since the Tweedie-TSI disagreement has conditional mean zero, the gate changes estimator variance without changing its expected value. We give the Gaussian special case and prove finite-reference consistency and stability bounds for estimating the gate from weighted reference samples. We apply the finite-reference LFGI estimator to normalized density evaluation for Bayesian inverse problems. When MCMC pilot samples and derivative information are available, LFGI uses these byproducts to construct a normalized posterior-density surrogate. The surrogate enables posterior-energy evaluation, model-evidence estimation, and downstream density-based diagnostics. On a PDE-constrained inverse-problem benchmark, the LFGI surrogate improves posterior-density calibration and sampling diagnostics relative to the other tested score-estimator classes. Experiments using LFGI with known model evidence check absolute evidence calibration in both Gaussian and non-Gaussian settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出拉普拉斯-费舍尔门恒等式（LFGI），用于最优矩阵门控混合分数估计，通过将混合分数估计视为关于矩阵值混合系数（门）的条件风险最小化问题，推导出方差最优的门表达式，并在贝叶斯逆问题中构造归一化后验密度代理，用于后验能量评估、模型证据估计等。
Motivation: 现有标量混合方法在奇异或强各向异性目标分布上刚性不足，无法有效降低分数估计方差，亟需更灵活的矩阵门控策略。
Method: 将混合分数估计转化为条件风险最小化问题，推导出方差最优矩阵门G*(y,t)的解析形式（LFGI），并从加权参考样本中估计门，给出有限参考一致性及稳定性界限。
Result: 在PDE约束逆问题基准上，LFGI代理改进了后验密度校准和采样诊断；在已知模型证据的实验中，LFGI在高斯和非高斯设置下均实现了绝对证据校准。
Conclusion: LFGI提供了一种利用现有MCMC样本和导数信息构建归一化后验密度代理的系统方法，在贝叶斯逆问题中具有实用价值。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ADM-Fusion: Adaptive Deep Multi-Sensor Fusion for Robust Ego-Motion Estimation in Diverse Conditions
papers.abstract_en: Robust multi-sensor fusion is essential for reliable autonomy in diverse and degraded environments, where sensor reliability can fluctuate rapidly. Because different modalities fail in distinct ways, effective fusion should adaptively balance complementary cues rather than rely on fixed weighting. This adaptability is particularly important for ego-motion estimation, since accurate updates depend on the consistent integration of complementary sensor information. We propose ADM-Fusion, an end-to-end deep learning based multi-sensor fusion method designed to adapt to environmental changes and sensor degradation. ADM-Fusion employs an adaptive sensor mixture-of-experts framework with content-aware routing to dynamically assign weights to sensor inputs in real time. The system further incorporates separate translation and rotation branches, coupled through a cross-task attention mechanism to preserve task-specific specialization while enabling information sharing. ADM-Fusion is trained on the CARLA-LOC simulated dataset and subsequently fine-tuned on KITTI real-world data, demonstrating effective simulation-to-real transfer. Experiments show that ADM-Fusion remains robust under degraded conditions while maintaining competitive performance against existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ADM-Fusion，一种端到端深度学习多传感器融合方法，用于在多样化退化环境中实现鲁棒的自我运动估计。该方法采用自适应传感器混合专家框架，通过内容感知路由实时动态分配传感器权重，并利用分离的平移/旋转分支和跨任务注意力机制。在 CARLA-LOC 模拟数据集上训练，并在 KITTI 真实数据上微调，展示了有效的模拟到真实迁移。实验表明在传感器退化条件下保持鲁棒性，性能与现有方法相当。
Motivation: 多传感器融合在环境变化或传感器退化时，固定权重融合效果不佳，需要自适应平衡互补线索，尤其对于自我运动估计的准确性。
Method: 提出自适应传感器混合专家框架，包含内容感知路由以动态分配传感器权重；设置独立的平移和旋转分支，并通过跨任务注意力机制实现任务特定信息共享。
Result: 在 CARLA-LOC 模拟数据训练、KITTI 真实数据微调后，ADM-Fusion 在退化条件下保持鲁棒性，整体性能与现有方法持平。
Conclusion: 该方法有效应对传感器退化，并通过模拟到真实迁移提升实际应用能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Are Text-to-Image Models Inductivist Turkeys? A Counterfactual Benchmark for Causal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) generation models have achieved remarkable progress in producing visually realistic images from natural language prompts. Yet it remains unclear whether their success reflects genuine causal understanding or sophisticated pattern matching over visual-textual correlations. Inspired by Russell's inductivist turkey, we introduce Counterfactual-World (CF-World), a counterfactual benchmark designed to investigate whether text-to-image models can generate images under rules that systematically contradict real-world priors. CF-World organizes each scenario into three progressive levels: factual generation under ordinary world knowledge, explicit counterfactual generation with direct visual instructions, and implicit counterfactual generation requiring causal deduction from altered rules. We evaluate both open-source and closed-source T2I models using a Vision Language Model (VLM)-based evaluator (CF-Eval). Furthermore, we introduce two metrics: Prior Resistance Rate (PRR), which measures a models' ability to overcome entrenched real-world priors, and Reasoning Retention Rate (RRR), which assesses whether models can maintain reasoning-dependent counterfactual generation without explicit visual cues. Experiments show that all models exhibit sharp degradation from factual to counterfactual settings. Further analyses suggest that these failures arise because current T2I models encode world knowledge and visual appearances as tightly coupled patterns. Consequently, their heavy reliance on frequent visual co-occurrences within the training data forces them to default to familiar commonsense priors when tasked with rendering counterfactual worlds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Counterfactual-World (CF-World) 基准，用于评估文本到图像（T2I）模型的反事实推理能力。基准包含事实生成、显式反事实生成和隐式反事实生成三个递进难度。实验表明，开源和闭源T2I模型在反事实设置下性能急剧下降，原因在于模型将世界知识与视觉外观紧密耦合，过度依赖训练数据中的视觉共现模式，导致在反事实任务中默认使用常识先验。
Motivation: 当前T2I模型虽能生成逼真图像，但成功可能源于模式匹配而非真正的因果理解，亟需评估其因果推理能力。
Method: 引入CF-World基准，包含基于常识的事实生成、显式视觉指令的反事实生成以及需因果推理的隐式反事实生成三个层次。使用VLM评估器CF-Eval，并设计两个指标：Prior Resistance Rate (PRR) 衡量克服先验的能力，Reasoning Retention Rate (RRR) 衡量保留因果推理的能力。
Result: 所有T2I模型从事实到反事实设置性能显著下降；分析表明失败归因于模型将世界知识与视觉外观编码为紧密耦合模式，从而依赖频繁的视觉共现。
Conclusion: 当前T2I模型缺乏真正的因果理解，其在反事实世界中的表现受限于训练数据中的视觉先验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Faithful by Construction: Claim-Anchored Attribution for Multi-Document Summarization
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end large language models (LLMs) produce fluent multi-document summaries but remain prone to hallucination, and the attributions they offer are typically coarse (whole documents or passages) and generated post hoc, leaving each summary statement hard to verify. We revisit the modular Extract--Select--Rewrite paradigm and recast its intermediate representation as the unit of attribution. We present CAMS, a Claim-Anchored Multi-document Summarization framework that (i) extracts atomic claims with token-level provenance from every source document, (ii) clusters equivalent claims across documents while flagging inter-source conflicts, (iii) selects a support-aware and salient subset, and (iv) rewrites the selection into a summary in which every sentence is anchored to a support-checked claim that links back to one or more source spans. Because content is localized before it is realized, the pipeline is attribution-oriented by construction and faithfulness-oriented by construction: it structurally preserves fine-grained, multi-source traceability while using support-aware selection, constrained rewriting, and verification to encourage, rather than guarantee, factual faithfulness. We evaluate quality, faithfulness, and localization on MultiNews, analyze conflict handling on DiverseSumm, and test zero-shot transfer on WCEP, using a two-regime protocol that separates reference-free citation quality from gold-aligned localization accuracy, and we add an evaluator-decoupled audit that tests citation precision with a support model never used for selection or verification. CAMS matches strong end-to-end and span-attribution baselines on summary quality while substantially improving faithfulness and citation precision, lifting multi-source attribution accuracy by roughly two-thirds, and exposing a controllable faithfulness--coverage trade-off that end-to-end models leave implicit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CAMS框架，通过将多文档摘要分解为原子声明提取、跨文档聚类、支持感知选择和约束重写，实现每个句子都锚定可追溯的源跨度。该方法在MultiNews等数据集上匹配了端到端和跨度归因基线的摘要质量，同时显著提升忠实度和引用精度，将多源归因精度提升约三分之二。
Motivation: 端到端大语言模型在多文档摘要中易产生幻觉，且归因通常粗糙（整个文档或段落）且事后生成，导致每个摘要语句难以验证。
Method: CAMS框架包含四步：(i) 从每个源文档提取带有token级来源的原子声明，(ii) 将等效声明跨文档聚类并标记冲突，(iii) 选择支持充分且显著的子集，(iv) 将选择重写为摘要，其中每句锚定到经过支持检查的声明，并链接回一个或多个源跨度。
Result: 在MultiNews上评估质量、忠实度和定位精度，在DiverseSumm上分析冲突处理，在WCEP上测试零样本迁移。CAMS在摘要质量上与强基线匹配，同时大幅提升忠实度和引用精度，多源归因精度提升约三分之二。
Conclusion: 该框架暴露了一个可控的忠实度-覆盖度权衡，而端到端模型隐式保留此权衡。
