papers.title: Concept Alignment Contrast and Long-Short Prompt Memory for Test-Time Adaptation of SAM3 in Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Concept segmentation models like Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) show strong generalization on natural images, yet their performance degrades in medical imaging due to the domain gap caused by different imaging principles and styles. Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) is essential for improving the testing performance by updating the model on the fly without annotations. However, existing vision-language TTA methods are mainly driven by image-level uncertainty minimization, which does not necessarily reflect region-level semantic correctness in medical segmentation. Moreover, they often lack mechanisms to maintain stability in continual one-pass adaptation, leading to limited performance when reliable dense supervision is missing for segmentation. To address these issues, we propose Concept Alignment Contrast and LongShort Prompt Memory for Test-Time Adaptation (CM-TTA) of SAM3 for medical images. First, for a test sample with multiple augmentations, we introduce a novel Concept Alignment Contrast (CAC) metric, which leverages textual-visual semantic consistency to robustly evaluate prediction quality to select the best augmented view as the supervision. Second, to balance rapid and stable adaptation, we design a Long-Short Prompt Memory (LSPM) module. The short memory dynamically fuses recent prompts based on CAC scores for agile local adaptation, while the long memory maintains a stable global prompt to generate enhanced pseudo-labels. Finally, a Densely Supervised Prompt Update (DSPU) strategy is proposed to optimize the prompt embeddings with enhanced pseudo labels as dense supervision. Extensive experiments on prostate and skin lesion segmentation demonstrate that our CM-TTA framework significantly outperforms existing methods for TTA of SAM3. The code is available at https://github.com/SherlockZYB/CM-TTA.

papers.title: FeLoG: Scalable and Efficient Distributed Graph Embedding with Feedback Loop Mechanism
papers.abstract_en: Graph embedding maps graph nodes into low-dimensional vectors to support applications such as recommendation, fraud detection, and graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG). As graphs scale to billions of edges, scalable and efficient graph embedding has become increasingly important. Existing frameworks commonly adopt a sampling-training paradigm, in which mini-batches are constructed by sampling nodes and their neighbors. However, sampling is typically decoupled from evolving embedding quality, causing redundant exploration of well-trained regions while under-sampling undertrained nodes. At the system level, such decoupling further leads to excessive communication, serialized execution, and low resource utilization in distributed environments. We present FeLoG, a feedback loop-driven system for scalable distributed graph embedding. (1) FeLoG introduces feedback-coupled sampling and training, dynamically prioritizing undertrained nodes according to real-time embedding-quality feedback, thereby reducing redundant computation and accelerating convergence. (2) It employs activity-aware communication that compresses frequently occurring node sequences to reduce intra-machine PCIe traffic and selectively synchronizes frequently updated embeddings to reduce inter-machine communication. (3) It adopts a round-interleaved pipeline that overlaps next-round sampling with current-round training to improve CPU-GPU utilization. Experiments against six state-of-the-art baselines on large-scale graphs show that FeLoG achieves an average speedup of 27.9x, reduces communication cost by more than 53.1%, and sustains over 80% CPU-GPU utilization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FeLoG 是一个基于反馈循环 (feedback loop) 机制的分布式图嵌入系统。它将采样与训练耦合，根据嵌入质量的实时反馈动态优先处理未充分训练的节点，从而减少冗余计算并加速收敛。系统还采用活动感知通信 (activity-aware communication) 和轮次交错流水线 (round-interleaved pipeline) 来降低通信开销并提高 CPU-GPU 利用率。在大规模图上与六个基线相比，平均加速 27.9 倍，通信成本降低超过 53.1%，CPU-GPU 利用率超过 80%。
Motivation: 现有图嵌入框架采用采样-训练范式，但采样与嵌入质量解耦，导致对已充分训练区域的冗余探索和未训练节点的欠采样，在分布式环境中引发过度通信、串行执行和低资源利用率。
Method: 提出三个关键技术：(1) 反馈耦合采样与训练，根据实时嵌入质量动态调整采样优先级；(2) 活动感知通信，压缩频繁出现的节点序列以减少 PCIe 流量，并选择性同步高频更新的嵌入以减少机器间通信；(3) 轮次交错流水线，重叠下一轮的采样与当前轮的训练。
Result: 在大型图上对六个基线进行实验，平均加速 27.9 倍，通信成本降低超过 53.1%，CPU-GPU 利用率超过 80%。
Conclusion: FeLoG 证明了反馈耦合机制和系统级优化可以显著提升分布式图嵌入的可扩展性和效率。

papers.title: A new classification method based on Minimum Spanning Trees
papers.abstract_en: Minimum Spanning Trees have been used in unsupervised learning, particularly in clustering tasks, due to their ability to recognize clusters by removing edges that are considered inconsistent in defining those clusters. This paper aims to study the use of Minimum Spanning Trees in supervised learning. Specifically, we propose a classification algorithm based on Minimum Spanning Trees. To improve its performance, we introduce a robust version of the method that is also computationally more efficient. We evaluate the effectiveness of our proposed method through an extensive simulation study. We also apply the proposed methodology to a real-world case study involving aircraft trajectories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于最小生成树（MST）的分类方法，并引入鲁棒且计算高效的改进版本。通过广泛的仿真研究评估方法性能，并在飞机轨迹的真实案例中展示了应用效果。
Motivation: 最小生成树已广泛用于无监督学习（聚类），但尚未充分探索其在监督学习分类任务中的潜力。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 提出一种基于最小生成树的分类算法，并进一步开发鲁棒版本以提高计算效率和抗噪性。
Result: 仿真研究表明所提方法具有良好性能；真实飞机轨迹案例验证了实用性。
Conclusion: 最小生成树可以有效地用于监督分类，且鲁棒版本在效率和稳定性上更优。

papers.title: Topological Neural Dynamics: A Neuron-wise Framework for Sequence Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Existing sequence models, including RNNs, LSTMs, continuous-time networks, and Transformers, share a common structural principle: layer-wise dynamics, where all neurons in the same layer co-evolve through a shared parameterized operator, leaving individual neurons no freedom to evolve independently. Yet in many complex dynamical systems, rich global behavior emerges precisely from locally evolving units interacting through structured connectivity. Inspired by this principle, we introduce Topological Neural Dynamics (TND), a sequence modeling framework that shifts computation from layer-wise to neuron-wise dynamics. TND represents a neural system as a directed neuron graph, an interaction operator, and a local dynamics function, where each neuron evolves independently and collective computation emerges from interactions through the explicit graph topology. We instantiate TND as a discrete-time graph-coupled dynamical system and evaluate it as a case study on a behavior cloning task in single-player Pong. Compared with Vanilla RNN, Sparse RNN, LSTM, Closed-form continuous-time neural network (CfC), and Transformer baselines, TND achieves the best catch rate and a mean of 17.47 consecutive catches per round, more than three times that of the strongest baseline. These results suggest that shifting from layer-wise to neuron-wise dynamics provides an effective inductive bias for sequence modeling.
papers.comment: We found that some claims in our paper were inappropriate and needed to be substantially rephrased
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Topological Neural Dynamics (TND)，一种基于神经元级动力学（而非层间动力学）的序列建模框架。TND将神经表示为有向神经元图、交互算子和局部动力学函数，每个神经元独立演化，集体计算通过显式图拓扑交互产生。在单玩家Pong的行为克隆任务上，TND相比Vanilla RNN、LSTM、CfC、Transformer等基线取得了更好的抓取率和平均连续抓取次数（17.47次），是强基线的三倍以上。
Motivation: 现有序列模型（RNN, LSTM, 连续时间网络, Transformer）都采用层间动力学，即同一层所有神经元通过共享参数算子共同演化，个体神经元没有独立演化自由。然而许多复杂动力系统的全局行为源于局部单元的独立演化与结构化连接交互。本文旨在引入神经元级动力学来提供更好的归纳偏置。
Method: 提出Topological Neural Dynamics (TND)框架，将计算从层间动力学转换为神经元级动力学。TND将神经系统表示为有向神经元图、交互算子和局部动力学函数，每个神经元独立演化，集体计算通过显式图拓扑交互实现。具体实例化为离散时间图耦合动力系统。
Result: 在单玩家Pong的行为克隆任务上，TND实现了最佳抓取率和平均每轮17.47次连续抓取，超过最强基线（Vanilla RNN, Sparse RNN, LSTM, CfC, Transformer）三倍以上。
Conclusion: 结果表明，从层间动力学转向神经元级动力学为序列建模提供了有效的归纳偏置。

papers.title: Statistical Properties of Training & Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has managed to evade numerous intuitions from classical statistics to achieve unprecedented performance on a number of real-world tasks. In this article, we investigate the key features and surprises of deep learning from a physics-informed perspective, taking care to point out and justify where possible the many choices inherent in constructing a deep learning model. In particular, we review the phenomenon of neural scaling laws and discuss their interplay with the constraints and inductive biases which may be present when applying machine learning to problems in physics.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 3 figures. Part of the VERaiPHY initiative
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从物理视角审视深度学习的统计特性，重点回顾神经缩放定律及其与物理问题中约束和归纳偏置的相互作用。作者试图解释深度学习何以超越经典统计直觉，并讨论模型构建中的多种选择。
Motivation: 深度学习在许多任务上超越了经典统计学的预期，但其成功背后的关键特征和惊喜仍需从物理学视角加以阐明。
Method: 作者采用物理学启发的视角，系统梳理深度学习中的现象（如神经缩放定律），并分析其在物理问题中的适用性。
Result: 本文为综述性讨论，未提供具体实证结果，主要提出神经缩放定律与物理约束之间关系的分析框架。
Conclusion: 论文强调理解深度学习的统计特性对于将其成功应用于物理问题的重要性，并指出归纳偏置和约束在设计模型时的关键作用。

papers.title: Holo-World: Unified Camera, Object and Weather Control for Video World Model
papers.abstract_en: Video world models are moving toward preserving an observed world under controllable camera and object motion while allowing its environmental state to change. Yet these controls remain isolated, and weather generation typically relies on a source video or reconstructed scene that already specifies future structure. We study a first-frame-anchored source-to-state setting, where the model starts from a single image and follows explicit camera and object controls and an optional weather instruction, then generates a video that either preserves the source world or transfers it to a target weather state. To address these challenges, we first build HoloStateData, a state video dataset that turns diverse videos into unified control samples for camera, object, and weather supervision. Second, we introduce Holo-World, a unified controllable video world model that jointly controls the scene from a single image. Its Unified Scene Adapter factorizes world preservation and weather transfer into distinct parameter subspaces, using rendered background, geometry buffers, and object controls to maintain controlled scene structure while modeling weather-dependent appearance and particle effects. Additionally, Scene-Weather Decomposed CFG guides scene and weather residuals separately, strengthening target weather effects without over-amplifying the full condition. Quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that Holo-World maintains precise camera and object controls with consistent scene structure while transferring scenes into diverse target weather states, outperforming video-to-video weather editing baselines on weather-state generation. Our project page is available at https://xiangchenyin.github.io/Holo-World/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Holo-World，一个从单张图像联合控制相机、物体运动和天气状态的视频世界模型。通过构建 HoloStateData 数据集统一监督信号，并设计 Unified Scene Adapter 将世界保持与天气转移分解为独立参数子空间，结合 Scene-Weather Decomposed CFG 引导，实现了在保持场景结构的同时生成多样目标天气状态的视频。
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型对相机、物体和天气的控制相互独立，天气生成通常依赖源视频或重建场景，缺乏从单张图像出发的统一控制框架。
Method: 构建 HoloStateData 数据集，将多样化视频转化为相机、物体和天气的统一控制样本；提出 Holo-World 模型，其 Unified Scene Adapter 通过渲染背景、几何缓冲和物体控制维护场景结构，同时建模天气相关外观和粒子效果；Scene-Weather Decomposed CFG 分别引导场景和天气残差。
Result: 定量和定性实验表明，Holo-World 在保持精确相机和物体控制及一致场景结构的同时，能够将场景转换为多种目标天气状态，在天气状态生成上优于视频到视频的天气编辑基线。
Conclusion: Holo-World 实现了从单张图像出发的相机、物体和天气联合控制，为视频世界模型提供了统一框架，但天气控制主要面向视觉外观和粒子效果，未涉及气象物理过程。

papers.title: Triangular Consistency as a Universal Constraint for Learning Optical Flow
papers.abstract_en: We propose triangular consistency as a first-principled constraint for optical flow, which is agnostic to network architecture, supervision type, and dataset, and applies to both image-pair and multi-frame settings. This simple but powerful constraint is to compose two flows to induce a third flow and enforce consistency among the three. The composed flows may arise from (i) image pairs, yielding cycle consistency; (ii) multiple video frames, producing longer-range motion through temporal chaining; or (iii) image pairs combined with controlled synthetic transformations, which becomes data augmentation. This triangular consistency introduces negligible computational overhead and requires no additional annotations. Since it is derived directly from the geometry of optical flow, it does not rely on model-specific assumptions and serves as a ``universal'' plug-and-play component for optical flow training. Experiments show consistent improvement across supervised, unsupervised, and transfer learning settings.

papers.title: Do Time Series Foundation Model Benchmarks Hide Regime-Dependent Failures? Evidence from Traffic Speed Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Standard benchmarks evaluate time series foundation models (TSFMs) using aggregate metrics, but these can mask severe failures in critical operating regimes. We introduce regime-stratified evaluation and apply it to three TSFMs on two standard traffic speed benchmarks. Traffic exhibits abrupt regime switching between free-flow and congested states, producing bimodal speed distributions during transitions. When we stratify by traffic regime, both accuracy and prediction-interval coverage degrade sharply during transitions: transition-regime MAE reaches 11 mph (versus 3 mph overall), and empirical coverage of 90% prediction intervals drops as low as 55%. These failures are invisible in aggregate metrics because free-flow observations dominate the sample. A simple historical conditional baseline (sampling from per-sensor training distributions) achieves better transition coverage than any TSFM, but has far worse overall accuracy. We propose bimodal mixture augmentation (BMA), a post-hoc method that combines TSFM forecasts with historical distributional knowledge, approaching the historical baseline's transition coverage while preserving the TSFM's accuracy. Our results suggest that TSFM benchmarks should incorporate regime-aware evaluation to surface failures that aggregate metrics hide.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the Workshop on Forecasting as a New Frontier of Intelligence, ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出按状态分层评估方法，应用于三个时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）在交通速度预测基准上。结果发现标准聚合指标掩盖了过渡状态（从自由流到拥堵）下的严重失败：过渡状态MAE达11 mph（整体为3 mph），90%预测区间覆盖率降至55%。一种简单的历史条件基线（按传感器训练分布采样）在过渡状态覆盖率上优于所有TSFM，但整体准确度更差。作者提出后处理方法双峰混合增强（BMA），结合TSFM预测与历史分布信息，在保持TSFM准确度的同时接近历史基线的过渡覆盖率。
Motivation: 标准基准使用聚合指标评估时间序列基础模型，可能掩盖关键操作区域（如交通状态切换）中的严重失败。
Method: 引入按交通状态（自由流、拥堵、过渡）分层的评估策略，并设计后处理方法双峰混合增强（BMA），将TSFM预测与每个传感器的历史速度分布采样进行结合。
Result: 在交通速度预测基准上，过渡状态MAE达11 mph（整体3 mph），90%预测区间覆盖率低至55%；历史条件基线在过渡状态覆盖率上优于所有TSFM，但整体准确度更差；BMA在保持TSFM准确度的同时显著提升过渡状态覆盖率。
Conclusion: 作者认为TSFM基准应纳入状态感知评估，以暴露聚合指标隐藏的失败模式，但该方法仅限于交通速度预测场景，且BMA依赖于历史分布的先验知识。

papers.title: Finite-Time Queue Peak Laws in Stochastic Networks: Logarithmic Scaling After Geometric Thresholds
papers.abstract_en: We study finite-horizon queue peaks in generalized switches, a standard stochastic-network model in which many queues share constrained service resources. Arrivals may be dependent, nonstationary, and responsive to the system history; the only load condition is uniform interior slack, meaning the conditional mean arrival vector stays in a fixed contraction of the capacity region. We show that this slack reshapes the finite-time peak law for drift-minimizing scheduling policies such as MaxWeight. The square-root envelope that is sharp without slack persists only up to a geometry-dependent threshold; beyond that threshold, the running maximum grows only logarithmically with the horizon, both with high probability and in expectation. The mechanism is self-normalization: in the current queue direction, the projected fluctuation scale is normalized by the stabilizing drift scale. This removes capacity geometry from the logarithmic coefficient, while geometry remains in the threshold. Matching lower bounds show that both the logarithmic term and a geometric threshold are unavoidable. When finite-time state-space collapse is available, the threshold can be sharpened using local bottleneck geometry. For generalized input-queued switches, we obtain finite-time peak bounds with tight logarithmic coefficients. Simulations illustrate the two-phase envelope, local geometric refinements, and variance-sensitive improvements predicted by the theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究广义交换机中有限时间内的队列峰值行为。在均匀内部松弛条件下，证明漂移最小化调度策略（如MaxWeight）的队列峰值存在两阶段：在几何阈值之前服从平方根包络，之后随视界对数增长。机制是自归一化，即投影波动被漂移尺度归一化，使对数系数与容量几何无关，而阈值保留了几何依赖。匹配下界表明对数项和几何阈值均不可避免。对广义输入排队交换机，得到紧的对数系数界。模拟验证了两阶段包络、局部几何细化和方差敏感改进。
Motivation: 随机网络中队列峰值会影响延迟和资源分配，但现有结果多针对稳态或特定到达过程，缺乏对有限时间、依赖性和非平稳性到达的准确刻画。
Method: 利用自归一化技术，通过分析漂移尺度与波动尺度的相互作用，证明对数增长阶段；结合匹配下界和几何阈值分析，推导有限时间峰值律。
Result: 证明在均匀内部松弛条件下，有限时间队列峰值在几何阈值前为平方根增长，阈值后为对数增长；对数系数与容量几何无关，阈值由局部瓶颈几何决定。对广义输入排队交换机，得到紧的对数系数边界。
Conclusion: 揭示了有限时间队列峰值的两阶段规律，为随机网络调度理论提供了新见解。但结果限于漂移最小化策略和特定负载条件，扩展至更通用策略和负载仍需后续工作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: L-Proto: Language-Aware Episodic Prototypical Training for Multilingual Speaker Verification
papers.abstract_en: Multilingual speaker verification remains challenging because language-dependent acoustic variability causes speaker identity to become entangled with linguistic characteristics, degrading generalization across languages. In multilingual training, embeddings often encode language cues with speaker identity, causing speakers to form language-specific clusters. We propose L-Proto, a language-aware episodic prototypical training strategy that constructs language-consistent episodes. By sampling speakers from a single language per episode, L-Proto reduces language-driven variation during training and encourages embeddings to focus more directly on speaker identity. Experiments on the TidyVoice Challenge benchmark demonstrate consistent performance improvements over conventional fine-tuning and random episodic sampling across multiple backbone architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多语言说话人验证中语言与说话人特征纠缠的问题，提出L-Proto语言感知episodic prototypical训练策略。通过在每个训练片段中仅采样同一语言的说话人，减少语言驱动的声学变异，使嵌入更专注于说话人身份。在TidyVoice Challenge基准上，该方法在多种骨干网络上均优于常规微调和随机片段采样。
Motivation: 多语言说话人验证中，语言相关的声学变异导致说话人身份与语言特征纠缠，降低跨语言泛化能力。
Method: 提出L-Proto，一种语言感知的episodic prototypical训练方法，在每个episode内仅采样同一语言的说话人，减少语言驱动变异，迫使模型关注说话人身份而非语言线索。
Result: 在TidyVoice Challenge基准上，L-Proto在多个骨干网络上一致提升了说话人验证性能，优于常规微调和随机episodic采样。
Conclusion: 语言感知的episodic训练能有效解耦语言和说话人特征，是多语言说话人验证的一种有前景的范式。

papers.title: Vibe Coding Ate My Homework: An evaluation of AI approaches to greenfield software engineering and programming
papers.abstract_en: Thanks to rapid developments in generative AI, we are in the midst of a paradigm shift that may change how we interact with computers forever. We have observed a growth in the use of natural language prompts to build applications and coding infrastructures without underlying knowledge of the field, and this practice has been dubbed `vibe coding.' It arguably represents what the field of programming has been building towards since the beginning, with every higher level of abstraction that is conceived. Vibe coding promises to be the endpoint for the meta of high-level programming as far as method of input is concerned: eliminating a human's use of code syntax entirely in favour of programming in their mother tongue. This paper aims to evaluate the viability of vibe coding for greenfield software engineering tasks, as well as analyse the benchmarks that have been used to measure its software engineering prowess. To this end, we have developed an evaluation suite for analysing an LLM's proficiency in carrying out simple, isolated greenfield programming tasks in Python to provide scoped insight on the matter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨了“vibe coding”（用自然语言提示编程而不需底层知识）这一新兴范式，并评估其在绿场软件工程任务中的可行性。作者开发了一个评估套件，用于分析LLM在Python中执行简单、孤立的绿场编程任务的能力，以提供对该问题的针对性洞察。
Motivation: 随着生成式AI的快速发展，人们开始利用自然语言构建应用和编码基础设施，形成“vibe coding”实践。作者希望评估这种方法在绿场软件工程中的实际效果，并审视现有的基准测试是否足以衡量其软件工程能力。
Method: 开发了一个专门的评估套件，针对LLM在Python中完成简单、孤立的绿场编程任务的能力进行测试和分析。
Result: 本文提供了关于LLM在特定绿场编程任务中表现的分析和洞察，但摘要未报告具体的量化结果。
Conclusion: 该评估套件为衡量vibe coding在绿场编程中的可行性提供了可参考的见解，但适用范围限于简单、孤立的Python任务。

papers.title: Tail-Shape Estimation in LLM Evaluation Is Fragile: A Protocol for Diagnosing False Positives
papers.abstract_en: Recent work motivates moving large language model (LLM) evaluation from mean-based to tail-aware metrics, including conditional value-at-risk and tail-index estimates of reward-model error. We ask whether the canonical extreme-value-theory tail-index parameter, which isolates how heavy a tail is from how large the tail mass is, adds discriminative information beyond the mean and a standard tail-magnitude statistic in LLM evaluation. We pre-register a protocol covering admissibility, goodness-of-fit, threshold-stability, and effect-size requirements for any positive tail-shape claim. The protocol is the contribution of this paper; the empirical study below is a demonstration of what its gates catch. Applied to a standard LLM toxicity-evaluation setup under two structurally different scorer families, the protocol catches three distinct modes of false positives that a naive analysis would have published, and rejects the headline tail-shape claim on both scorers. We conclude that tail-shape estimation in the LLM toxicity-evaluation setups we examined is more fragile than the recent literature suggests, and recommend the protocol as a starting point for tail-index claims in similar setups.
papers.comment: 9 pages of main paper, 4 figures and 4 tables in the main paper, more in the appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文质疑LLM评估中尾形状估计（如条件风险价值和尾指数）是否能提供超越均值和标准尾幅度统计的判别信息。作者预注册了一个包含可接受性、拟合优度、阈值稳定性和效应量要求的协议，并在两个毒性评估评分器上应用该协议，发现了三种假阳性模式，拒绝了主要的尾形状主张。结论是LLM毒性评估设置中的尾形状估计比近期文献所暗示的更脆弱。
Motivation: 近期工作提倡从基于均值的LLM评估转向尾感知指标，但尾形状参数（尾指数）是否真正增加判别信息尚不清楚。需要严格的诊断协议来避免假阳性。
Method: 预注册了一个四重门控协议：可接受性、拟合优度、阈值稳定性和效应量要求，用于任何正尾形状主张的验证。
Result: 在两种结构不同的评分器上应用协议，捕获了三种假阳性模式，拒绝了两个评分器上的尾形状主张。
Conclusion: LLM毒性评估中的尾形状估计比文献中显示的更脆弱，建议将该协议作为类似设置中尾指数主张的起点。

summary_sections.result: 在两种结构不同的评分器上应用协议，捕获了三种假阳性模式，拒绝了两个评分器上的尾形状主张。
summary_sections.conclusion: LLM毒性评估中的尾形状估计比文献中显示的更脆弱，建议将该协议作为类似设置中尾指数主张的起点。

papers.title: Prompt2Effect: Training-Free Image-to-Video Model Specialization via LoRA Generation
papers.abstract_en: While personalizing Image-to-Video (I2V) diffusion models with specific visual effects is increasingly demanded for high-end generation, current practice requires training a separate Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) module for each effect, incurring substantial data curation and iterative optimization costs that hinder interactive control. We present Prompt2Effect, a weight-driven hypernetwork that amortizes per-effect training by directly synthesizing effect-specific LoRA weights in a single forward pass. Unlike prior hypernetworks that regress adapter weights purely from semantics, Prompt2Effect is explicitly conditioned on the frozen base model weights, grounding prediction in the structural geometry of each layer. Furthermore, instead of predicting raw LoRA matrices, we introduce an SVD-canonicalized parameterization that resolves factorization ambiguity and stabilizes large-scale synthesis. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Prompt2Effect achieves on-par or superior video quality and effect alignment compared to conventional LoRA fine-tuning, while reducing the computational cost from 56 GPU training hours to 3.3 seconds of hypernetwork inference. When used as initialization for subsequent fine-tuning, our predicted weights further improve final performance and accelerate optimization by approximately 10x.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Prompt2Effect，一个权重驱动的超网络，通过单次前向传播直接合成特定效果的 LoRA 权重，避免了对每个效果单独训练 LoRA 模块的高昂成本。该方法利用冻结的基础模型权重作为条件，并引入 SVD 规范化的参数化方式，在视频质量和效果对齐上达到或超越传统 LoRA 微调，同时将计算时间从 56 GPU 训练小时降低到 3.3 秒超网络推理。当作为后续微调的初始化时，还能加速约 10 倍优化。
Motivation: 当前为图像到视频（I2V）扩散模型个性化添加视觉效果需要为每个效果单独训练 LoRA 模块，这需要大量的数据整理和迭代优化，难以实现交互式控制。
Method: 提出权重驱动的超网络 Prompt2Effect，以冻结的基础模型权重为条件，直接生成效果特定的 LoRA 权重；采用 SVD 规范化的参数化方式解决分解歧义并稳定大规模合成。
Result: 与常规 LoRA 微调相比，Prompt2Effect 达到或超过其视频质量和效果对齐，而计算成本从 56 GPU 训练小时降至 3.3 秒推理时间；作为微调初始化可加速优化约 10 倍。
Conclusion: 该方法实现了无需训练的特效 LoRA 权重生成，为 I2V 模型的个性化提供了高效且交互式的替代方案。

papers.title: TerraBench: Can Agents Reason Over Heterogeneous Earth-System Data?
papers.abstract_en: Climate and environmental decision-making increasingly requires reasoning across heterogeneous inputs, including gridded physical data, satellite imagery, geospatial context, and simulator outputs. Weather and climate foundation models can forecast well, but do not reason interactively in language, while large language models (LLMs) reason in language but cannot operate directly on high-dimensional Earth-system data. As a result, real scientific workflows in Earth-science remain underserved. We introduce TerraBench, a benchmark for grounded Earth-science reasoning, built on TerraAgent, a ReAct-style executable framework that interleaves reasoning, tool calls, and observations to couple LLM planning with scientific tools for environmental retrieval, geospatial processing, simulation, and artifact-backed computation. TerraBench unifies analysis of Earth observation imagery, gridded data, GIS reasoning and simulation in a single executable interface, whereas prior benchmarks isolate these capabilities into narrow individual tasks. It is also the first in this space to pair process-level tool-use metrics with tolerance-aware numeric scoring. The benchmark comprises 403 extensive agentic tasks across three tracks (Fundamentals, Simulator-Grounded, and Document-Grounded Verification) and eight application domains with 24,500 verified execution steps. These results indicate that reliable Earth-science agents must go beyond tool access to coordinate heterogeneous workflows, parameterize tools precisely, and preserve artifact provenance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TerraBench，一个用于地球科学推理的基准，基于 TerraAgent 可执行框架，该框架结合 LLM 的推理能力与科学工具（环境检索、地理空间处理、模拟等）处理异构地球系统数据。基准包含 403 个任务，跨三个跟踪和八个应用领域，共 24,500 个验证执行步骤。结果发现可靠的地球科学代理需要协调异构工作流、精确参数化工具并保持工件来源。
Motivation: 现有气候与 AI 模型要么擅长预测但不以语言交互推理，要么擅长语言推理但无法直接处理高维地球系统数据，导致地球科学真实工作流缺乏支持。
Method: 构建 TerraAgent 框架，采用 ReAct 风格，将 LLM 规划与工具调用（环境检索、地理空间处理、模拟、计算）交错，并在此基础上创建 TerraBench 基准，包含 403 个任务和三个跟踪（基础、模拟接地、文档接地验证）。
Result: 基准包含 403 个任务、24,500 个验证执行步骤，并首次在同类基准中引入过程级工具使用指标和容忍感知数值评分。
Conclusion: 可靠的地球科学代理不能仅依赖工具访问，还需协调异构工作流、精确参数化工具并保持工件来源。

papers.title: WorkBench Revisited: Workplace Agents Two Years On
papers.abstract_en: The best agent on WorkBench in March 2024, GPT-4, completed just 43% of tasks. We revisit the benchmark in June 2026 and find that the best agent to date, Claude Fable 5, now completes 98%. Beyond this considerable progress in frontier agent performance, three things stand out. First, unintended harmful actions, such as emailing the wrong person, fell from 26% of tasks for GPT-4 to 1.9% for Claude Fable 5; capability and safety go together on WorkBench rather than trade off, so the models that finish the most tasks also do the least unintended damage. Second, the rise of open-weight models has drastically lowered costs for a performance level that was only accessible to proprietary models, while frontier costs have stayed stable. Third, while several classes of error have been eliminated, frontier models still make some basic mistakes that occasionally result in irreversible harm. We release an updated version of the benchmark with data and code quality improvements, new model scores, and analysis of agent progress on WorkBench since 2024.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视了2024年发布的WorkBench基准测试，报告了截至2026年6月智能体性能的显著进步：最佳智能体（Claude Fable 5）任务完成率从GPT-4的43%提升至98%，同时意外有害行为从26%降至1.9%，表明能力与安全性并非权衡而是协同提升。开放权重模型大幅降低了达到以往仅专有模型可及性能水平的成本，而前沿模型成本保持稳定。尽管多种错误类型已被消除，前沿模型仍偶尔犯下导致不可逆伤害的基本错误。作者发布了基准测试的更新版本，包含数据与代码质量改进、新模型分数以及自2024年以来的智能体进展分析。
Motivation: WorkBench基准测试是评估工作场所智能体能力与安全性的重要工具，两年后重新评估可揭示前沿智能体的进步路径、成本变化及剩余挑战。
Method: 作者在2026年6月对WorkBench基准测试进行了重新评估，比较了多个最新模型（包括Claude Fable 5）与2024年GPT-4的性能，并分析了任务完成率、意外有害行为发生率及成本变化。
Result: 最佳智能体任务完成率从43%升至98%，意外有害行为从26%降至1.9%；开放权重模型在低成本下达到了2024年仅专有模型可及的性能水平；前沿模型仍存在导致不可逆伤害的基本错误。
Conclusion: 能力与安全性在WorkBench上正向关联；开放权重模型促进了性能民主化；但前沿模型仍需解决残余的基本错误以避免不可逆后果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LC-QAT: Data-Efficient 2-Bit QAT for LLMs via Linear-Constrained Vector Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Quantization-aware training (QAT) is essential for extremely low-bit large language models (LLMs). Current QAT methods are mainly based on scalar quantization (SQ), which enables efficient optimization but suffers from severe performance degradation at 2-bit precision. On the other hand, vector quantization (VQ) provides substantially higher representational capacity, but its discrete codebook lookup prevents end-to-end training. We propose LC-QAT, a 2-bit weight-only VQ-QAT framework that represents quantized weights via a learned affine mapping over discrete vectors, which yields a high-quality PTQ initialization and enables fully differentiable end-to-end optimization without explicit codebook lookup in the training forward pass. This strong post-training initialization makes LC-QAT highly data-efficient. Experiments across diverse LLMs demonstrate that LC-QAT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art QAT methods while using only 0.1%--10% of the training data. Our results establish LC-QAT as a practical and scalable solution for extreme low-bit model deployment. Codes are publicly available at https://github.com/AI9Stars/UniSVQ.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LC-QAT，一种用于大语言模型（LLM）的2比特权重量化感知训练框架。它通过线性约束向量量化（Linear-Constrained Vector Quantization）将权重表示为离散向量的仿射映射，在训练前向传播中无需显式码本查找，实现完全可微的端到端优化。该方法结合高质量的PTQ初始化，仅需0.1%–10%的训练数据即可超越现有QAT方法。
Motivation: 现有标量量化（SQ）在2比特精度下性能严重下降，而向量量化（VQ）能力更强但离散码本查找阻碍端到端训练。需要一种兼具高表示能力和可微训练的量化方法。
Method: 提出线性约束向量量化（LC-QAT）：将量化权重表示为离散向量的学习仿射映射，在训练中利用可微的线性变换替代码本查找，结合高质量的PTQ初始化实现数据高效的端到端优化。
Result: 在多种LLM上，LC-QAT仅使用0.1%–10%的训练数据即可持续超越现有最优QAT方法，在2比特权重量化下取得更好性能。
Conclusion: LC-QAT为极端低比特模型部署提供了一种实用且可扩展的解决方案，其数据高效性降低了QAT的计算成本。

papers.title: Seeing is Believing: Aligning Prompt Rewriting with Visual Anchors for Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Despite the impressive capabilities of text-to-image (T2I) models, an intent-generation gap often persists due to the brevity and ambiguity of user prompts. Existing approaches primarily polish the prompt for fluency and readability. However, the enhancement process still lacks visual grounding. As a result, the rewriter may over-infer missing details, causing an intent-generation gap. To address this limitation, we propose FaithRewriter, a novel prompt-enhancement framework for T2I generation. Specifically, FaithRewriter first leverages a multimodal MLLM to generate an image from the original prompt as an intermediate visual cue. This cue is then combined with the prompt and fed into a large-scale LLM to produce visually grounded augmentations that better reflect how the intended content should appear in images. Finally, these augmentations are distilled into a small-scale LLM for efficient deployment, enhancing its ability to generate effective T2I prompts. Experiments show that FaithRewriter yields prompts that are more faithful to the user intent and more visually plausible than strong baselines, helping narrow the intent-generation gap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FaithRewriter，一种通过视觉锚定（visual anchors）来对齐提示改写（prompt rewriting）与用户意图的文生图提示增强框架。该方法先利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）从原始提示生成中间图像作为视觉线索，再结合提示输入大规模语言模型（LLM）生成视觉接地（visually grounded）的增强描述，最后蒸馏到小规模 LLM 实现高效部署。实验表明 FaithRewriter 生成的提示更忠实于用户意图且视觉上更合理，缩小了意图与生成之间的差距。
Motivation: 现有文本到图像模型常因用户提示的简短和模糊而存在意图-生成差距（intent-generation gap），已有的提示改写方法缺乏视觉接地，容易过度推断缺失细节，导致生成结果偏离用户意图。
Method: 提出三阶段框架 FaithRewriter：1）用多模态 MLLM 从原始提示生成中间图像作为视觉锚定；2）将图像与提示拼接输入大规模 LLM 生成视觉接地的增强描述；3）将增强能力蒸馏到小规模 LLM 以实现高效推理。
Result: 摘要报告 FaithRewriter 在忠实于用户意图和视觉合理性方面优于强基线，有效缩小了意图-生成差距。
Conclusion: 通过引入视觉锚定（visual anchors）来指导提示改写，可以缓解文生图中的意图-生成差距，且蒸馏策略使得模型可以高效部署。

papers.title: Anchored, Not Graded: Vision-Language Models Fail at Slant-from-Texture Perception
papers.abstract_en: Human perception of surface slant from texture exhibits systematic, graded biases that emerge reliably in psychophysical experiments. Prior work showed that unsupervised CNNs reproduce several human-like biases, while supervised CNNs do not. Do Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit similar competences? Across multiple VLM families and model scales, zero-shot and in-context prompting both produce distinctive failures: slant is predicted at only a small set of anchors (e.g., 0\degree, $\pm$25\degree, $\pm$45\degree) with little dependence on stimulus field of view, optical slant, or surface curvature. Supervised fine-tuning partially remediates the failure, but residual anchoring persists. While success in high-level vision-language benchmarks might not require sensitivity to low-level geometric cues, we interpret anchoring as a failure at the representation-to-output language interface: not necessarily an absence of geometric encoding, but a failure to express it in a graded form.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）在从纹理感知表面倾斜（slant-from-texture）任务中的表现。跨多个VLM家族和模型尺度，零样本和上下文提示均产生独特的失败：倾斜预测仅集中于少量锚点（如0°、±25°、±45°），对刺激视场、光学倾斜或曲面曲率变化不敏感。监督微调部分修复但残留锚定现象，作者将其解释为表示到输出语言接口的失败。
Motivation: 人类对纹理倾斜的感知表现出系统性的渐变偏差，且无监督CNN能复现类似人类偏差，但监督CNN不能。VLM是否具备类似能力尚不清楚。
Method: 在多个VLM家族和模型尺度上，通过零样本和上下文提示测试其对表面倾斜的预测，并尝试监督微调以缓解锚定现象。
Result: VLM仅在少数锚定值（0°、±25°、±45°）上预测倾斜，对连续变化刺激不敏感；微调部分修复但残留锚定。
Conclusion: 锚定失败主要源于表示到输出的语言接口问题，而非缺乏几何编码能力。

papers.title: Think-Before-Speak: From Internal Evaluation to Public Expression in Multi-Agent Social Simulation
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based multi-agent simulation offers a promising way to study social interaction, deliberation, and collective opinion dynamics. However, many existing dialogue simulation frameworks represent interaction mainly as observable turn exchange or aggregated outputs, leaving the internal evaluative processes behind silence, speaking intention, and public expression difficult to examine. We introduce TBS (Think-Before-Speak), an interval-based multi-agent simulation framework that separates agents' private reasoning from public utterance generation. At each interval, all agents update structured internal states based on the shared dialogue history and their own memory. These states include dissonance-related appraisal, perceived opinion climate, perceived isolation risk, response strategy, and willingness to speak. The orchestrator then resolves competing speaking intentions and commits one utterance to the public dialogue, allowing internal evaluation and public interaction to co-evolve over time. We evaluate TBS in simulated town hall discussions on a climate-related policy issue. Results show that TBS produces coherent internal-state traces and that these traces vary systematically across turn-allocation, silence, and memory conditions. Dissonance-related appraisal increases agents' willingness to speak, whereas silence-pressure appraisal decreases it. Once speaking intention is formed, public expression is shaped mainly by turn-allocation rules. These findings suggest that TBS supports mechanism-sensitive social simulation by making the pathway from internal evaluation to public expression observable and analyzable.
papers.comment: 8 pages of main content, 14 pages including references and appendices, 3 figures. Accepted to the KDD'26 Workshop on SciSoc Agents & LLMs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TBS（Think-Before-Speak），一种基于区间的多智能体社会模拟框架，将智能体的内部推理（认知评价、沉默压力等）与公开表达分离。在气候政策市政厅讨论模拟中，TBS 产生连贯的内部状态轨迹，并发现认知评价增加说话意愿，沉默压力降低说话意愿，而发言意图形成后公开表达主要由轮次分配规则决定。该框架使从内部评价到公开表达的路径可观察可分析。
Motivation: 现有对话模拟框架主要关注可观察的轮次交换或聚合输出，难以检查沉默、说话意图等内部评价过程。作者希望分离智能体的私人推理与公开表达生成。
Method: 提出 TBS 框架，在每个区间所有智能体基于共享对话历史和自身记忆更新结构化内部状态（包括认知失调评价、感知意见气候、感知孤立风险、回应策略、说话意愿），然后由协调器解决冲突的说话意图并选择一个话语加入公共对话。
Result: 在气候政策市政厅讨论模拟中，TBS 产生连贯的内部状态轨迹；认知失调评价增加说话意愿，沉默压力评价降低说话意愿；发言意图形成后，公开表达主要由轮次分配规则塑造。
Conclusion: TBS 支持机制敏感的社会模拟，使从内部评价到公开表达的路径可观察可分析。

papers.title: ROGLE: Robust Global-Local Alignment with Automated Region Supervision for Text-Based Person Search
papers.abstract_en: Text-Based Person Search (TBPS) aims to retrieve pedestrian images using natural language queries. However, existing TBPS models, especially those based on CLIP, struggle with fine-grained understanding due to global representational bias and semantic sparsity inherited from training on short captions. This results in weak fine-grained alignment, exacerbated by the scarcity of region-level annotations. To address this, we propose ROGLE (Robust Global-Local Embedding), a unified framework that overcomes reliance on costly manual annotations through an automated Region-to-Sentence Matching (RSM) strategy. RSM automatically mines pseudo region-sentence pairs for scalable fine-grained supervision. Furthermore, ROGLE employs a multi-granular learning strategy that fuses global contrastive learning with region-level local alignment. We also introduce the P-VLG Benchmark, a large-scale dataset constructed by curating and enriching images from established public benchmarks. It features over 100,000 annotated regions and rich long-form captions, making it the first TBPS benchmark to support both global and local assessment protocols. Extensive experiments show that ROGLE significantly outperforms existing approaches, particularly on challenging long-form queries. Code and the P-VLG benchmark will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ROGLE框架，用于文本-行人检索任务，通过自动区域-句子匹配策略生成伪标签，缓解区域级标注稀缺问题，并引入P-VLG基准数据集，在长文本查询上显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有基于CLIP的文本-行人检索模型受全局表示偏差和短文本语义稀疏性影响，细粒度对齐能力弱，且缺乏区域级标注。
Method: 提出ROGLE框架，包含自动区域-句子匹配策略（RSM）生成伪监督，以及结合全局对比学习和区域级局部对齐的多粒度学习策略。
Result: 在P-VLG基准及多个公开数据集上，ROGLE显著优于现有方法，尤其在长文本查询上表现突出。
Conclusion: ROGLE通过自动区域监督缓解了标注稀缺问题，为文本-行人检索提供了有效的细粒度对齐方案。

papers.title: Korzhinskii-Net: Physics-Informed Neural Network for Sub-Surface Mineral Prospectivity Modelling
papers.abstract_en: Mineral prospectivity modelling (MPM) underpins exploration economics, yet most operational pipelines reduce to data-driven classifiers trained on shallow surface proxies. Such models are blind to the subsurface physics that actually localises ore: heat advection, fluid flow, and lithology-dependent precipitation. We present Korzhinskii-Net, a 2-D radial physics-informed neural network (PINN) that couples Darcy flow, advective-diffusive heat transport, and a softplus-saturated reaction rate into a single differentiable forward model, weakly supervised by surface and remote-sensing proxies. The network is named after Dmitri S. Korzhinskii (1899-1985), whose theory of infiltration metasomatism provides the physical scaffold. We evaluate Korzhinskii-Net on six ore provinces spanning three commodity classes - Udokan (sandstone-hosted Cu), Sukhoi Log, Olimpiada, and Berezovskoye (orogenic Au), Vorontsovskoye (Carlin-type Au), and Dalnegorsk (skarn polymetallic) - under a fair, leakage-controlled 5-fold cross-validation protocol with hard ring-shaped negatives and baseline proxy features disabled. Korzhinskii-Net attains a mean PR-AUC of 0.708 versus 0.235 for the strongest classical baseline (support vector machine), and a mean fractional rank of 0.036 versus 0.475. The improvement is consistent across all six provinces and three commodity systems, suggesting that physics-informed differentiable simulators, even when constrained only by global open-data proxies, can recover localisation patterns that pure feature-based learners systematically miss. We release the full pipeline and evaluation harness as open source.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Korzhinskii-Net 是一种二维径向物理信息神经网络 (PINN)，耦合达西流动、对流-扩散热传输和软饱和反应速率，用于地下矿产潜力建模 (MPM)。该网络受 Korzhinskii 的渗透交代理论启发，仅利用地表和遥感代理数据弱监督训练。在六个跨越三种矿产类型的矿区（Udokan, Sukhoi Log, Olimpiada, Berezovskoye, Vorontsovskoye, Dalnegorsk）上，Korzhinskii-Net 的平均 PR-AUC 达到 0.708，而最强经典基线 (SVM) 仅为 0.235；平均分数排名为 0.036 vs 0.475。结果表明，即使仅使用全球开放数据代理，物理信息可微模拟器也能恢复纯特征学习器遗漏的定位模式。
Motivation: 现有矿产潜力建模方法大多简化为基于浅层地表代理的数据驱动分类器，忽略了控制矿化的地下物理过程（热对流、流体流动和岩性依赖的沉淀），导致模型对地下物理盲视。
Method: 提出 Korzhinskii-Net，一个 2D 径向 PINN，将 Darcy 流动、对流-扩散热传输方程和 softplus 饱和反应速率耦合为单一可微正向模型，通过表面和遥感代理进行弱监督训练。
Result: 在六种矿产区（砂岩型铜、造山型金、卡林型金、矽卡岩多金属）的严格 5 折交叉验证中，Korzhinskii-Net 平均 PR-AUC 为 0.708，SVM 基线为 0.235；平均分数排名为 0.036 对比 0.475。改进在所有矿区一致。
Conclusion: 论文强调，物理信息可微模拟器即使在仅受全局开放数据代理约束时，也能恢复纯特征学习器系统性遗漏的定位模式。开源了完整流程和评估工具。

papers.title: SOCO: Benchmarking Semantic Object Correspondence in Vision Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Measuring structured object understanding in vision foundation models remains challenging due to inconsistent evaluation protocols and limited part-level supervision. Semantic correspondence (SC) evaluates this capability by testing whether object parts can be matched across instances and categories under large variations in appearance, viewpoint, and geometry. To enable a systematic SC evaluation, we introduce SOCO, a new benchmark for Semantic Object Correspondence that introduces a taxonomy of correspondence types and provides consistent, functionally meaningful keypoint annotations across 100 categories and over 1M correspondence pairs. In addition, SOCO includes keypoint language descriptions, enabling the evaluation of large vision-language models (LVLMs) and their fine-grained part-level understanding. Comprehensive experiments reveal that (i) vision foundation backbones encode strong semantic structure but transfer correspondences poorly across related categories and only partially capture object-part position, (ii) LVLMs are stronger at text-prompted part localization than at visual-reference cross-image matching, exposing a gap between language-grounded localization and fine-grained visual correspondence, and (iii) correspondence performance predicts performance on dense downstream tasks, including segmentation, tracking, 3D pose estimation, and 3D detection, more strongly than ImageNet classification. Together, these findings position SOCO as a benchmark for structured, part-level representation quality in vision and multimodal foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SOCO 基准，用于评估视觉基础模型中的语义对象对应能力，包含 100 个类别和超过 100 万对应点对，并引入关键点语言描述以评估大型视觉语言模型。实验发现视觉基础骨干网络编码了强语义结构但跨类别传递较差，LVLM 在文本提示定位上优于视觉参考跨图像匹配，且对应性能与密集下游任务性能高度相关。
Motivation: 现有视觉基础模型的语义理解评估缺乏一致协议和部件级监督，尤其是语义对应能力尚未被系统评估。
Method: 构建 SOCO 基准，包含对应类型分类、100 类别的语义关键点标注（超 100 万对应点对）以及关键点语言描述，支持评估标准视觉模型和 LVLM。
Result: 实验表明视觉基础骨干网络编码强语义结构但跨类别对应差；LVLM 文本提示定位优于视觉参考匹配；对应性能与分割、跟踪、3D 姿态估计等下游任务性能强相关。
Conclusion: SOCO 可作为评估视觉和多模态基础模型部件级表示质量的基准。

papers.title: SVI-Bench: A Dynamic Microworld for Strategic Video Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: True video intelligence demands more than recognizing what is visible: it requires reasoning about why events unfold, predicting what would change under different conditions, and deciding what to do next. We refer to this progression, from perception through causal reasoning and simulation to strategic planning, as Strategic Video Intelligence (SVI). No existing benchmark evaluates this capability stack: in-the-wild videos lack verifiable ground truth for causal and strategic questions, while synthetic environments sacrifice the complexity of real multi-agent systems. To bridge this gap, we introduce SVI-Bench, a large-scale benchmark that leverages team sports as a dynamic microworld, combining the complexity of real-world multi-agent interaction (10-22 agents making coordinated decisions under adversarial pressure) with the verifiability of explicit rules and definitive outcomes. SVI-Bench comprises approximately 35K hours of broadcast video, 15M annotated actions, 15K hours of expert commentary, 23K game reports, and 103K structured statistical records across basketball, soccer, and hockey, all constructed via a data engine that transforms raw game data into a dense, cross-referenced corpus. We organize evaluation into 9 tasks spanning a progressive four-pillar hierarchy: Dynamic Scene Understanding, Causal Reasoning, Strategic Simulation, and Agentic Synthesis. Evaluating strong multimodal and agentic baselines, we find a capability cliff: models perform competently on perceptual tasks, achieving approximately 74% on fine-grained action QA, but degrade sharply at each successive cognitive level. Agentic tasks prove hardest: the strongest model achieves only 5% accuracy when required to autonomously gather and integrate evidence across a corpus of 1.8M clips.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SVI-Bench 是一个大规模基准测试，利用团队运动（篮球、足球、冰球）作为动态微世界，评估视频智能从感知到因果推理、模拟和战略规划的完整能力。该基准包含约35K小时广播视频、1500万标注动作、1.5万小时专家解说等数据，涵盖9个任务和四个层级。实验表明，多模态模型在感知任务上表现较好（如精细动作问答约74%），但在更高认知层级上性能急剧下降，最强模型在自主决策任务上仅达5%准确率。
Motivation: 现有视频基准要么无法验证因果和战略问题的真实答案（真实视频），要么牺牲了真实多智能体系统的复杂性（合成环境）。需要同时具备真实复杂性和可验证性的基准来评估战略性视频智能。
Method: 构建了一个数据引擎，将原始比赛数据转化为密集交叉引用语料库，包含广播视频、动作标注、解说、比赛报告和统计记录。评估采用四层递进架构：动态场景理解、因果推理、战略模拟和自主合成，共9个任务。
Result: 最强模型在感知任务上达到约74%准确率，但在因果推理、战略模拟和自主合成任务上性能急剧下降，自主任务仅5%准确率，揭示了当前模型在战略性视频智能上的能力悬崖。
Conclusion: SVI-Bench 为战略性视频智能提供了全面的评估平台，暴露了现有模型在高阶认知任务上的严重不足，为未来研究指明了方向。

papers.title: Wasserstein Contraction of Coordinate Ascent Variational Inference
papers.abstract_en: We study the non-asymptotic contraction in Wasserstein distance of the sequential, parallel, and random-scan coordinate ascent variational inference algorithms. This is shown to hold under a functional smoothness condition of the optimality maps and a transportation-information inequality at their fixed points. Our results are sharp and general, and as opposed to those based on global strong log-concavity assumptions, they allow for local convergence on smooth, non-smooth, and discrete manifolds, including within the context of data augmentation. We consider many applications in statistical physics and Bayesian statistics. These include pairwise Markov Random field models such as Ising and Curie-Weiss, unbalanced Bayesian Gaussian Mixture Models, high-dimensional Bayesian Probit Regression, and high-dimensional Logistic Regression with Pólya--Gamma random variables (i.e. Jaakkola-Jordan's algorithm). In many of these models, these represent the first available convergence results of their kind.
papers.comment: 30 pages + 4 pages appendix, 3 figures. V3 includes new results on multi block algorithms, analysis on discrete spaces, and new applications
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究坐标上升变分推断算法在Wasserstein距离下的非渐近收缩性质，证明了在最优性映射的函数光滑性条件和固定点的传输-信息不等式下，序列、并行和随机扫描三种算法均具有收缩性。结果尖锐且通用，不依赖于全局强对数凹假设，允许在光滑、非光滑和离散流形上局部收敛，包括数据增强场景。在统计物理和贝叶斯统计的多个模型（如Ising模型、Curie-Weiss模型、非平衡贝叶斯高斯混合模型、高维贝叶斯Probit回归和Pólya-Gamma逻辑回归）中给出了首次收敛结果。
Motivation: 现有变分推断收敛性分析通常依赖全局强对数凹性假设，限制了应用范围。本文旨在建立更一般的Wasserstein收缩理论，适用于非光滑和离散空间，以及数据增强算法。
Method: 利用最优性映射的函数光滑性和固定点的传输-信息不等式，证明序列、并行和随机扫描坐标上升变分推断算法的Wasserstein收缩。
Result: 在多个统计物理和贝叶斯统计模型上获得了首次收敛结果，包括Ising、Curie-Weiss、贝叶斯高斯混合模型、贝叶斯Probit回归和Pólya-Gamma逻辑回归。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了不依赖全局强对数凹性的收敛保证，适用于更广泛的模型，包括离散和非光滑情形。

papers.title: Density and sea level changes weaken the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation through ocean bottom pressure
papers.abstract_en: Observations from the RAPID array at 26.5$^\circ$N indicate a linear decline in the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC) over the past two decades, linked to contrasting boundary changes: a weakening western-boundary contribution that is partly compensated by strengthening at the eastern boundary. Yet it remains unclear whether this partial compensation reflects a basin-wide adjustment or a regional feature, and what processes drive it. Here we use a high-resolution ocean model to investigate the spatial structure and underlying mechanisms of the AMOC change across the mid-latitude North Atlantic. The model reproduces a meridionally coherent decline in western-boundary deep overturning transport together with a partially compensating strengthening at the eastern boundary, consistent with observations at 26.5$^\circ$N. These opposing trends arise from a vertically coherent ocean bottom pressure trend shaped by two competing drivers: rising coastal sea level and decreasing interior density. Through geostrophic balance, this mechanism produces partial boundary compensation across latitudes, yielding a basin-wide AMOC decline throughout the mid-latitude North Atlantic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用高分辨率海洋模式研究大西洋经向翻转环流（AMOC）在中纬度北大西洋的空间结构及衰退机制。模型再现了与RAPID阵列观测一致的西边界深层经向输运减弱和东边界部分补偿增强的相反趋势，并指出这些趋势源于海岸海平面上升与海洋内部密度下降共同驱动的垂直一致的海底压力变化。
Motivation: RAPID观测显示AMOC在过去二十年线性下降，但东、西边界贡献的相反变化是否反映整个海盆的调整尚不明确，驱动这一过程的机制也不清楚。
Method: 使用高分辨率海洋模式模拟中纬度北大西洋AMOC变化，分析其空间结构与底层物理机制。
Result: 模型再现了与观测一致的经向连贯的西边界深层输运减弱和东边界部分补偿增强现象；这些相反趋势由垂直一致的海底压力趋势引起，该趋势由海岸海平面上升和内部密度下降两个竞争因子共同塑造。
Conclusion: 通过地转平衡，上述机制产生跨纬度的部分边界补偿，导致整个中纬度北大西洋AMOC呈海盆尺度的减弱。

papers.title: Explaining Tabular Foundation Model Differences Through Meta-Features
papers.abstract_en: With the rise of tabular foundation models alongside traditional models still performing well on many tasks, choosing the right model for a tabular dataset remains difficult. We investigate whether dataset meta-features can explain performance gaps between model families on tabular prediction tasks. Using the TabArena benchmark results, we analyze dataset-level performance gaps and relate them to model-agnostic meta-features. After strict statistical tests with false discovery control, we find that (1) for neural network vs. tree gaps, no meta-feature survives false discovery control, (2) for non-foundation vs. foundation model gaps, one association is robust but does not generalize when tested in leave-one-dataset-out prediction, and (3) for TabICLv2 vs. TabPFN-2.6, one robust association also improves held-out prediction. Furthermore, we conduct a leave-one-dataset-out analysis and find that meta-feature predictors fail to improve meaningfully over a simple baseline. Overall, our results show the heterogeneity of tabular datasets and that global meta-feature approaches are not robust enough to offer explanations on the 51 TabArena datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用TabArena基准中的51个表格数据集，通过统计检验分析数据集元特征能否解释不同模型族（神经网络vs树模型、非基础模型vs基础模型、TabICLv2 vs TabPFN-2.6）之间的性能差距。结果发现，经过严格假发现率控制后，大多数关联不稳健，元特征预测器在留一数据集预测中未能显著优于简单基线，表明表格数据集高度异质性，全局元特征方法无法提供可靠解释。
Motivation: 尽管表格基础模型兴起，传统模型仍表现良好，但为特定表格数据集选择合适的模型仍困难。现有方法缺乏对模型族间性能差距成因的系统性理解。
Method: 基于TabArena基准数据集，计算数据集级性能差距，提取模型无关的元特征，通过严格统计检验（假发现率控制）和留一数据集预测验证关联的稳健性。
Result: (1) 神经网络与树模型差距中无元特征通过假发现率控制；(2) 非基础模型与基础模型差距中仅一个稳健关联，但无法泛化到留一数据集预测；(3) TabICLv2与TabPFN-2.6差距中一个稳健关联改善了留一预测。整体上，元特征预测器未能优于简单基线。
Conclusion: 表格数据集的异质性使全局元特征方法难以提供解释，未来需考虑局部或更细粒度方法。

papers.title: ChainCaps: Composition-Safe Tool-Using Agents via Monotonic Capability Attenuation
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using agents increasingly operate in open-ended deployment environments, where they compose file systems, web APIs, code interpreters, and enterprise services at runtime. This creates a safety gap in tool composition: an agent can satisfy every per-tool permission check and still produce an unsafe end-to-end effect, such as reading a confidential document, summarizing it, and sending the summary to an external endpoint. We call this failure mode permission laundering. ChainCaps addresses it with a runtime rule: every value carries a sink-specific capability budget, and tool composition propagates budgets by intersection. A value can preserve or lose authority as it moves through a tool chain, but it cannot gain new authority through composition. We implement ChainCaps as a transparent MCP proxy that requires no changes to the agent or tool servers. On 82 tasks across five frontier models from three providers, ChainCaps reduces attack success rate from 25-68% to 0-4.8% while preserving 96-100% benign completion. In replay experiments, it also outperforms scalar-IFC and per-function-isolation baselines. Manifest quality is the dominant deployment bottleneck: expert manifests reach 100% attack blocking, while naive manifests fall to 27.3%. Our claims are limited to explicit-flow composition safety under trusted manifests and proxy-visible data movement, a practical gap in deployed tool-using agents today.
papers.comment: Published at the Second Workshop on Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond (AIWILD) at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对工具使用代理在组合文件系统、Web API、代码解释器等工具时的安全性问题，提出ChainCaps，通过运行时规则保证每个值携带接收器特定的能力预算，组合时通过交集传播，确保权限只能衰减或保持，不能增长。实现为透明的MCP代理，无需修改代理或工具服务器。在五个前沿模型的82个任务上，攻击成功率从25-68%降至0-4.8%，良性完成率保持96-100%。
Motivation: 工具使用代理在开放部署环境中可以满足每个工具的权限检查，但组合后可能产生不安全端到端效果（权限清洗），例如读取机密文档、摘要并发送到外部端点，现有方法无法解决此类问题。
Method: 提出ChainCaps运行时规则：每个值携带接收器特定的能力预算，工具组合通过交集传播预算。值在工具链中只能丢失或保持权限，不能获得新权限。实现为透明的MCP代理，无需修改代理或工具服务器。
Result: 在82个任务上，攻击成功率从25-68%降至0-4.8%，良性完成率96-100%。超越标量-IFC和函数隔离基线。专家清单达到100%攻击阻止，朴素清单仅27.3%。
Conclusion: 该方法在可信清单和代理可见数据移动条件下保证显式流组合安全，解决了当前部署工具使用代理中的实际差距。局限性包括依赖清单质量和代理可见的数据移动。

papers.title: Diffusion Image Generation with Explicit Modeling of Data Manifold Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Image generative models aim to sample data points from the underlying data manifold, a task that requires learning and decoding a dense, low-dimensional, and compact parameterization space. To achieve this, we propose the Data Manifold-aware Image diffusioN moDel (MIND), a novel framework that explicitly models manifold geometry by integrating discrete patch tokenization into the score function of a continuous diffusion model. This approach successfully leverages both the structural quantification capabilities of discrete tokens and the parallel generation flexibility of continuous diffusion. Moreover, we enable end-to-end differentiable training via a novel soft top-$k$ aggregation mechanism and introduce dual-branch high-frequency feature embedding layers to alleviate the spectral bias of transformer backbones on low-dimensional inputs. Furthermore, for inference, we design a multi-stage transition sampling scheme that dynamically adjusts the sampling scheme based on timestep. Extensive experiments on ImageNet 256$\times$256 demonstrate the effectiveness of MIND. After 80-epoch training, our base model achieves an FID of 22.73 without guidance, nearly halving the 43.47 FID of the vanilla DiT-B/2 baseline. The proposed method reduces FID by 15.95 and 9.06 on average compared with the baselines DiT and SiT, respectively. For image generation on ImageNet-256$\times$256 with guidance, the proposed MIND-B with only 130M parameters achieves an FID of 2.06, superpassing the LlamaGen-3B with 3.1B parameters. The proposed MIND-XL with 715M parameters further reduces the FID to 1.95. Our MIND introduces a fresh perspective on diffusion-based image generation, paving the way for future research and innovation in this community. The code will be publicly available.

papers.title: QuadLink: Autoregressive Quad-Dominant Mesh Generation via Point-Relation Learning
papers.abstract_en: The generation of production-ready quad-dominant meshes is a cornerstone of modern 3D content creation. Generating anisotropic quad-dominant meshes from point clouds is challenging, as existing methods are typically limited to producing either pure triangular meshes or pure quadrilateral meshes with isotropic densities. In this paper, we present QuadLink, a unified framework consisting of three stages for quad-dominant mesh generation by linking points into structured faces. QuadLink formulates polygonal mesh generation as a hybrid centroid-conditioned vertex linking model: it first predicts a unified set of anchors (vertices and face centroids), then learns centroid-conditioned links that associate vertices with face centroids, and finally assembles polygonal faces with a quad-first strategy guided by robust geometric verification strategies. This link-based formulation enables efficient generation of sparse and anisotropic quad-dominant meshes with coherent edge flow and meanwhile supporting hybrid polygonal topology. To construct training data for this model, we further introduce a Tri-to-Quad Operator that converts artistic triangle meshes into quad-dominant training data via global merge selection. Extensive experiments show that QuadLink produces production-ready quad-dominant meshes from point clouds and achieves improved geometric fidelity and topological quality compared to prior baselines. Our method natively supports hybrid polygonal topology, generalizing to arbitrary n-gon meshes without architectural changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QuadLink，一个三阶段统一框架，用于从点云生成四边形主导的网格。该方法将多边形网格生成公式化为混合质心条件顶点链接模型：先预测锚点（顶点和面质心），再学习质心条件链接以关联顶点与面质心，最后通过鲁棒几何验证以四边形优先策略组装多边形面。还引入 Tri-to-Quad 算子将艺术三角形网格转换为训练数据。实验表明 QuadLink 能生成生产就绪的四边形主导网格，几何保真度和拓扑质量优于基线。
Motivation: 现有方法通常只能生成纯三角形网格或各向同性密度的纯四边形网格，难以从点云生成各向异性的四边形主导网格。
Method: 提出 QuadLink，包含三阶段：1) 预测一组锚点（顶点和面质心）；2) 学习质心条件链接，将顶点与面质心关联；3) 采用四边形优先策略并结合鲁棒几何验证来组装多边形面。同时引入 Tri-to-Quad 算子将艺术三角形网格转换为训练数据。
Result: 实验表明，QuadLink 生成生产就绪的四边形主导网格，相比基线提升了几何保真度和拓扑质量。
Conclusion: 该方法原生支持混合多边形拓扑，可推广到任意 n 边形网格而无需架构更改。

papers.title: Real-time virtual circuits for plasma shape control via neural network emulators
papers.abstract_en: Reliable position and shape control in tokamak plasmas requires accurate real-time regulation of several strongly coupled shape parameters. The control vectors that disentangle these couplings, referred to as \textit{virtual circuits} (VCs), enable independent shape parameter control for a specific Grad--Shafranov (GS) equilibrium. Numerical calculation of VCs is not currently feasible in real time, therefore VCs are usually computed prior to each experiment, using a small number of reference GS equilibria sampled along the desired scenario trajectory, with each VC used to control the plasma within a preset time interval. While effective near the reference equilibrium, this approach can lead to degraded performance as the plasma departs from the reference equilibrium and/or from the desired trajectory, and it complicates the design of robust control strategies for rapidly evolving plasma configurations. In this paper, we construct neural-network-based emulators of plasma shape parameters from which VCs can be derived, to provide the MAST Upgrade (MAST-U) plasma control system with state-aware VCs in real-time. To do this, we develop an extensive library of over a million simulated GS equilibria, covering a substantial portion of the MAST-U operational space. These emulators provide differentiable functions whose gradients can be rapidly computed, enabling the derivation of accurate VCs for real-time shape control. We perform extensive verification of the emulated VCs by testing whether they disentangle the control problem. The neural-network-based approach delivers high accuracy and orthogonality across a diverse range of equilibria. This work establishes the physical validity of emulated VCs as a scalable and general alternative to schedules of precomputed VCs.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对托卡马克等离子体形状控制中虚拟电路（VC）实时计算困难的问题，提出使用神经网络仿真器从大量Grad-Shafranov平衡模拟中学习等离子体形状参数，从而在MAST Upgrade装置上实现状态感知的实时虚拟电路。仿真器提供可微函数，快速计算梯度以导出高精度虚拟电路，经验证在多种平衡下具有良好的解耦性能。
Motivation: 传统虚拟电路需预先计算少量参考平衡，当等离子体偏离参考平衡时性能下降，且难以设计鲁棒控制策略。亟需一种可实时计算状态感知虚拟电路的方法。
Method: 构建包含超过一百万个模拟Grad-Shafranov平衡的数据库，训练神经网络仿真器逼近等离子体形状参数；利用仿真器的可微性快速计算梯度，实时导出虚拟电路。
Result: 神经网络方法在广泛平衡范围内实现高精度和正交性验证，能够有效解耦形状参数控制问题。
Conclusion: 该工作建立了仿真虚拟电路的物理有效性，作为一种可扩展且通用的替代方案，可取代预计算虚拟电路的时间表调度。

papers.title: HIR-ALIGN: Enhancing Hyperspectral Image Restoration via Diffusion-Based Data Generation
papers.abstract_en: Hyperspectral image (HSI) restoration is crucial for reliable analysis, as real-world HSIs suffer from noise, blur, and resolution loss. However, existing models trained on source data often fail on target domains lacking clean references, a common real-world scenario. To address this, we present HIR-ALIGN, a plug-and-play target-adaptive augmentation framework that enhances HSI restoration by augmenting limited training images with synthetic data matching the target distribution, without extra clean target-domain HSI data. It has three stages: (i) proxy generation, where off-the-shelf restoration models are applied to degraded target observations to produce semantics-preserving proxy HSIs that approximate clean target-domain images; (ii) distribution-adaptive synthesis, where a blur-robust unCLIP diffusion model generates target-aligned RGBs from proxy RGBs with prompt conditioning and embedding-space noise initialization. The warp-based spectral transfer module then synthesizes HSIs by aligning each generated RGB with its proxy RGB, estimating soft patch-wise transport weights, and applying these weights and learnable local interpolation kernels to the proxy HSI; and (iii) aligned supervised finetuning, where restoration networks pretrained on the source distribution are finetuned with proxy HSIs and synthesized target-aligned HSIs, then deployed on degraded target images. We also provide theoretical analysis showing that, under stated assumptions, the proposed augmentation-based finetuning obtains a tighter target-domain restoration-risk upper bound by jointly improving target-distribution coverage and controlling spectral bias. Experiments on simulated and real datasets across denoising, super-resolution, and other restoration tasks demonstrate that HIR-ALIGN is superior to proxy-only target-adaptation baselines and outperforms representative unsupervised methods in most cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HIR-ALIGN，一个即插即用的目标自适应增强框架，用于高光谱图像（HSI）恢复。框架通过三个步骤生成目标域对齐的合成数据：首先用现成模型生成代理HSI，然后用抗模糊的unCLIP扩散模型合成目标对齐RGB并通过光谱传输模块生成HSI，最后在合成数据上微调恢复网络。实验表明，该方法在去噪、超分辨率等任务上优于仅代理的自适应基线和大多数无监督方法。
Motivation: 现有HSI恢复模型在目标域上因缺乏干净参考图像而性能下降，需要一种无需目标域干净数据即可自适应增强恢复的方法。
Method: HIR-ALIGN框架包含三个阶段：(i) 代理生成：用现成恢复模型处理退化目标观测产生代理HSI；(ii) 分布自适应合成：利用抗模糊的unCLIP扩散模型从代理RGB生成目标对齐RGB，再通过基于扭曲的光谱传输模块（warp-based spectral transfer）合成HSI；(iii) 对齐监督微调：在代理HSI和合成HSI上微调预训练网络。同时提供理论分析证明该微调能降低目标域恢复风险上界。
Result: 在模拟和真实数据集上的去噪、超分辨率等任务中，HIR-ALIGN优于仅代理的自适应基线和大多数代表性无监督方法。
Conclusion: 本文提出的数据生成与微调方法有效提升了HSI恢复在目标域上的性能，避免了目标域干净参考的限制。

papers.title: EcoGEO: Trajectory-Aware Evidence Ecosystems for Web-Enabled LLM Search Agents
papers.abstract_en: Web-enabled LLM agents are changing how online information influences search outcomes. Existing Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) studies mainly focus on individual webpages. However, agentic web search is not a single-document setting: an agent may issue queries, crawl pages, follow links, reformulate searches, and synthesize evidence across multiple browsing steps. Influence therefore depends not only on page content, but also on how pages are organized, connected, and encountered along the agent's browsing trajectory. We study this shift through Ecosystem Generative Engine Optimization (EcoGEO), which treats GEO as an environment-level influence problem for web-enabled LLM agents. To instantiate this perspective, we propose TRACE, a Trajectory-Aware Coordinated Evidence Ecosystem. Given a recommendation query and a fictional target product, our method builds a controlled evidence environment that coordinates an agent-facing navigation entry page with heterogeneous support pages. These pages use shared terminology, internal links, and consistent product attributes to introduce, verify, and reinforce the target product. We evaluate our method on OPR-Bench, a benchmark for open-ended product recommendation. Experiments show that it consistently outperforms page-level GEO baselines in final target recommendation. Trajectory-level metrics further show increased initial target-result crawls, target-specific follow-up searches, and internal-link crawls, suggesting that the gains come from shaping the agent's evidence-acquisition process rather than merely adding more target-related content. Overall, our findings support an ecosystem research paradigm for GEO, where web-enabled LLM agents are studied in relation to the broader evidence environments that guide search, browsing, and answer synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EcoGEO框架，将生成引擎优化（GEO）从页面级扩展到环境级，针对支持网页的LLM搜索代理。具体方法TRACE通过构建协调的证据生态系统（包括导航入口页和异构支持页）来影响代理的浏览轨迹，从而提升目标推荐效果。在OPR-Bench基准上，该方法优于页面级GEO基线，并通过轨迹级指标证实其通过塑造代理的证据获取过程而非单纯增加内容来取得收益。
Motivation: 现有GEO研究主要关注单一网页，但代理式网络搜索涉及多步浏览（查询、爬取、链接、综合），影响不仅取决于页面内容，还取决于页面在代理浏览轨迹中的组织与相遇方式。因此需要一种环境级的影响优化方法。
Method: 提出TRACE（Trajectory-Aware Coordinated Evidence Ecosystem），针对一个推荐查询和目标产品，构建一个受控的证据环境，包含一个面向代理的导航入口页和多个异构支持页，这些页面通过共享术语、内部链接和一致的产品属性来引入、验证和强化目标产品。
Result: 在OPR-Bench开放产品推荐基准上，TRACE在最终目标推荐上持续优于页面级GEO基线。轨迹级指标显示初始目标结果爬取、目标特定后续搜索和内部链接爬取均有增加，表明收益来自塑造代理的证据获取过程。
Conclusion: 该工作支持了GEO的生态系统研究范式，即应将LLM搜索代理置于更广泛的证据环境中进行研究。

summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作支持了GEO的生态系统研究范式，即应将LLM搜索代理置于更广泛的证据环境中进行研究。

papers.title: A Data Efficiency Study of Synthetic Fog for Object Detection Using the Clear2Fog Pipeline
papers.abstract_en: Object detection in adverse weather is critical for the safety of autonomous vehicles; however, the scarcity of labelled, real-world foggy data remains a significant bottleneck. In this paper, we propose Clear2Fog (C2F), an end-to-end, physics-based pipeline that simulates fog on clear-weather datasets while ensuring cross-modal consistency across camera and LiDAR. C2F combines monocular depth estimation with a novel atmospheric light estimation method to improve the physical consistency of synthetic fog generation while reducing structural artifacts and chromatic biases observed in existing frameworks. Utilising a training set of 270,000 images from the Waymo Open Dataset, we conduct an extensive data efficiency study to investigate whether environmental diversity can reduce dataset scale requirements and improve model generalisation under varying fog conditions. Our findings reveal that models trained on mixed-density fog datasets at 75% scale achieve comparable detection performance to those trained on fixed-density datasets at 100% scale, reducing synthetic training data requirements by 25%. We observe that this efficiency trend is consistent across two representative detector architectures. Furthermore, we investigate the sim-to-real transfer by using C2F-generated data as a pre-training foundation before fine-tuning on real-world fog data. We demonstrate that, within the evaluated settings, a relative 10x increase in the default fine-tuning learning rate reduces the negative transfer caused by standard fine-tuning, achieving up to a 1.17 mAP point improvement beyond the real-only baseline. Overall, this work demonstrates the value of diverse synthetic fog as a pre-training tool for real-world adaptation.
papers.comment: Project code and experimental configs available at https://github.com/mmohamed28/Clear2Fog
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Clear2Fog (C2F)管道，一种基于物理的端到端方法，在晴朗天气数据集上模拟雾天，同时保持相机和激光雷达的跨模态一致性。利用Waymo Open Dataset的27万张图像，研究数据效率，发现混合密度雾数据集在75%规模下可达到与固定密度100%规模相当的检测性能，减少25%训练数据需求。此外，使用C2F生成数据作为预训练基础，将默认微调学习率提高10倍可减少负迁移，在真实雾天数据上比纯真实基线提升1.17 mAP。
Motivation: 自动驾驶安全需要恶劣天气下的目标检测，但标记的真实雾天数据稀缺，现有合成雾生成方法存在物理不一致、结构伪影和色偏问题。
Method: 提出Clear2Fog管道，结合单目深度估计和一种新的大气光估计方法，在晴朗天气数据上模拟物理一致的雾天，并保持跨模态一致性。
Result: 在Waymo数据集上，75%规模混合密度雾训练数据达到100%固定密度数据的检测精度；提高微调学习率10倍后，在真实雾天数据上比纯真实基线提升1.17 mAP。
Conclusion: 多样化的合成雾可作为真实环境适应的有效预训练工具，通过数据效率分析和微调策略改进减少负迁移。

papers.title: Federated Client Selection under Partial Visibility: A POMDP Approach with Spatio-Temporal Attention
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning relies on effective client selection to alleviate the performance degradation caused by data heterogeneity. Most existing methods assume full visibility of all clients at each communication round. However, in large-scale or edge-based deployments, the server can only access a subset of clients due to communication, mobility, or availability constraints, resulting in partial visibility where only a subset of clients is observable for aggregation in each communication round. In this paper, we formulate federated client selection under partial visibility as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) and propose a Spatial-Temporal attention-based reinforcement learning framework. By integrating historical global models and client identity embeddings, the proposed method captures both the temporal contexts of training and the persistent characteristics of clients. Experimental results across multiple datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves superior performance compared to existing baselines in heterogeneous and partially visible settings, validating its effectiveness in addressing the challenges of incomplete observations in practical federated learning systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对联邦学习中服务器在每轮仅能访问部分客户端（局部可见性）的问题，将其建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），并提出基于时空注意力的强化学习框架。该方法通过整合历史全局模型和客户端身份嵌入，捕捉训练时间上下文和客户端持久特征。在多个数据集上的实验表明，该方法在异构和部分可见设置下优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有联邦学习客户端选择方法大多假设每轮回合服务器对所有客户端完全可见，但在大规模或边缘部署中，由于通信、移动性等约束，服务器只能访问部分客户端，导致性能下降。
Method: 将部分可见性下的客户选择建模为POMDP，并提出基于时空注意力（Spatial-Temporal attention）的强化学习框架，集成历史全局模型和客户端身份嵌入以捕获时序上下文和客户端持久特征。
Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，该方法在异构和部分可见设置下，性能优于现有基线。
Conclusion: 验证了所提方法在处理实际联邦学习系统不完整观测挑战中的有效性。

papers.title: A Mimetic Detector for Adversarial Image Perturbations
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial attacks fool deep image classifiers by adding tiny, almost invisible noise patterns to a clean image. The standard $\ell^\infty$-bounded attacks (FGSM, PGD, and the $\ell^\infty$ variant of Carlini--Wagner) produce high-frequency, near-random sign patterns at the pixel level: small in $\ell^2$, but carrying disproportionate gradient energy. We exploit this with a single-shot, training-free detector using the high-order Corbino--Castillo mimetic operators from the open-source MOLE library. No retraining, no surrogate classifier, no access to the network under attack: the verdict is a property of the input alone, computed in $O(HW)$ time. We illustrate the detector on the standard \emph{peppers} test image: untargeted FGSM and PGD attacks at the canonical $\ell^\infty$ budget $\varepsilon = 16/255$ flip SqueezeNet's prediction from \emph{bell pepper} to \emph{doormat} (FGSM) and \emph{maraca} (PGD), and the detector separates these adversarial inputs from the clean image by $4.1\times$--$5.0\times$ (FGSM) and $1.9\times$--$2.2\times$ (PGD). The margin grows monotonically with the operator order $k$, while an equal-amplitude smooth perturbation leaves the statistic within $1\%$ of its clean value.
papers.comment: v3: Evaluation now uses real FGSM/PGD attacks on SqueezeNet (which flip the prediction) in place of the earlier random sign; table, figure, and references updated
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的单次检测器，利用高阶Corbino-Castillo模拟算子从输入图像中直接检测对抗性扰动。在peppers测试图像上，针对FGSM和PGD攻击（ε=16/255），检测器能将对抗样本与干净图像分离4.1×–5.0×（FGSM）和1.9×–2.2×（PGD），且分离倍数随算子阶数单调增长，而同等幅度的平滑扰动不影响检测统计量。
Motivation: 标准ℓ∞约束对抗攻击（FGSM、PGD等）产生的高频准随机噪声难以被现有检测器有效识别，且多数方法需要重新训练或访问被攻击网络。
Method: 使用开源MOLE库中的高阶Corbino-Castillo模拟算子，对输入图像进行单次前向计算（O(HW)时间），无需重新训练、无需替代分类器、无需访问被攻击网络。
Result: 在peppers图像上，FGSM攻击（ε=16/255）下检测器将对抗样本与干净图像分离4.1×–5.0×，PGD攻击下分离1.9×–2.2×，分离倍数随算子阶数k单调增长；而同等幅度的平滑扰动仅引起1%内的变化。
Conclusion: 该检测器揭示了对抗扰动的高频特性与模拟算子之间的内在关系，为无需训练的输入级对抗检测提供了新思路。

papers.title: FastUMAP: Scalable Dimensionality Reduction via Bipartite Landmark Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Exploratory analysis of high-dimensional data rarely stops at a single embedding. In practice, analysts rerun dimensionality reduction after changing preprocessing, subsets, or hyperparameters, and standard nonlinear methods can quickly become the bottleneck. We introduce FastUMAP (Bipartite Manifold Approximation and Projection), a landmark-based method designed for this repeated-use setting. FastUMAP builds a sparse point-landmark fuzzy graph, computes a Nystrom spectral warm start from the induced landmark affinity, and then refines all sample coordinates with a UMAP-style objective on the bipartite graph. The landmark ratio r = m/n provides a direct way to trade runtime against fidelity. On 9 benchmark datasets spanning 178 to 70,000 samples, FastUMAP has the lowest runtime on 7 datasets in our reported default-implementation comparison on one workstation. On MNIST and Fashion-MNIST (n=70000), it runs in about 4.6 seconds, compared with about 73--75 seconds for Barnes--Hut t-SNE, while reaching 91.4% mean kNN accuracy versus 94.6% for the strongest accuracy baseline. FastUMAP is therefore best viewed as a fast option for repeated exploratory embedding, rather than as a replacement for accuracy-first methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FastUMAP 是一种基于二分地标采样的可扩展降维方法，专为重复探索性分析设计。它构建稀疏点-地标模糊图，通过 Nyström 谱热启动初始化坐标，并在二分图上用 UMAP 目标优化。在 9 个基准数据集上，FastUMAP 在 7 个数据集上运行时间最短，MNIST 和 Fashion-MNIST 上约 4.6 秒，而 Barnes-Hut t-SNE 约 73–75 秒，但 kNN 准确率 91.4% 略低于最佳基准的 94.6%。
Motivation: 高维数据探索性分析常需多次嵌入，而标准非线性降维方法（如 t-SNE、UMAP）在重复使用时计算开销大，成为瓶颈。
Method: 提出 FastUMAP：首先对输入数据通过二分采样选择地标点，构建稀疏点-地标模糊图；然后利用 Nyström 扩展从地标亲和矩阵计算谱嵌入作为热启动；最后在二分图上优化 UMAP 风格目标函数以获得所有样本坐标。地标比例 r = m/n 直接控制运行时间与保真度的权衡。
Result: 在 9 个基准数据集（样本量 178 至 70,000）上，FastUMAP 在 7 个数据集上运行时间最短；MNIST 和 Fashion-MNIST（n=70,000）上约 4.6 秒，而 Barnes-Hut t-SNE 约 73–75 秒；kNN 准确率 91.4%，最强基线为 94.6%。
Conclusion: FastUMAP 适合作为重复探索性嵌入的快速选项，而非替代高精度方法。

papers.title: Cornerstones or Stumbling Blocks? Deciphering the Rock Tokens in On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: While recent work in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has shown that a small subset of critical tokens disproportionately drives reasoning gains, an analogous token-level understanding of On-Policy Distillation (OPD) remains largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate high-loss tokens, a token type that--as the most direct signal of student-teacher mismatch under OPD's per-token KL objective--should progressively diminish as training converges according to existing studies; however, our empirical analysis shows otherwise. Even after OPD training reaches apparent saturation, a substantial subset of tokens continues to exhibit persistently high loss; these tokens, which we term Rock Tokens, can account for up to 18\% of the tokens in generated outputs. Our investigation reveals two startling paradoxes. First, despite their high occurrence frequency providing a disproportionately large share of total gradient norms, Rock Tokens themselves remain stagnant throughout training, resisting teacher-driven corrections. Second, through causal intervention, we find that these tokens provide negligible functional contribution to the model's actual reasoning performance. These findings suggest that a vast amount of optimization bandwidth is spent on structural and discourse residuals that the student model cannot or need not internalize. By deconstructing these dynamics, we demonstrate that strategically bypassing these ``stumbling blocks'' can significantly streamline the alignment process, challenging the necessity of uniform token weighting and offering a more efficient paradigm for large-scale model distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中的高损失token，发现一类称为“岩石token”的token在训练收敛后仍持续高损失，占生成输出的18%，且梯度贡献大但功能贡献微小。绕过这些token可以简化对齐过程。
Motivation: 现有RLVR研究关注关键token对推理的驱动作用，但OPD中token级理解尚缺，尤其是高损失token的行为和影响。
Method: 通过实证分析OPD训练中高损失token的分布、梯度贡献和因果关系，进行因果干预实验评估其功能贡献。
Result: 岩石token在收敛后仍占18%的token，提供大量梯度但自身参数停滞，且对推理性能贡献可忽略。
Conclusion: 优化带宽浪费在结构性和话语性残差上，战略性地绕过这些token可提高蒸馏效率，质疑统一token加权的必要性。

papers.title: Dependence on Early and Late Reverberation of Single-Channel Speaker Distance Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Single-channel speaker distance estimation has recently achieved centimeter-level accuracy in simulated environments, yet it remains unclear which components of the room impulse response (RIR) the model exploits and how performance depends on the recording conditions. In this work, we decompose simulated RIRs into four variants (full, direct-only, no-late, and no-early) using the mixing time estimated from the echo density function as the boundary between early reflections and late reverberation. We define four calibration scenarios, from fully calibrated (synchronised capture, known source level) to fully uncalibrated (arbitrary onset, unknown level), and evaluate all combinations on a matched dataset. Results show that without time calibration, mean absolute error (MAE) increases to $1.29$ m and the model extracts reverberation-based cues, with early reflections emerging as the most informative component. Further analysis against DRR, $C_{50}$, and $T_{60}$ confirms that estimation accuracy improves with stronger early energy and degrades in highly reverberant environments. When time calibration is available, the model achieves a MAE of $0.14$ m by extracting the propagation delay alone, regardless of the RIR content.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了单通道说话人距离估计对房间脉冲响应（RIR）中早期反射和晚期混响的依赖关系。通过将模拟RIR分解为四种变体（全、直达、无晚期、无早期），并在四种校准场景下评估模型性能，发现无时间校准时模型依赖基于混响的线索（早期反射信息量最大），MAE增至1.29米；有时间校准时模型仅提取传播延迟，MAE降至0.14米。
Motivation: 尽管单通道说话人距离估计在仿真中已达厘米级精度，但模型具体利用RIR的哪些成分以及性能如何依赖录音条件尚不清楚。
Method: 利用混响密度函数估计的混合时间将模拟RIR分解为全、直达、无晚期、无早期四种变体，并在从完全校准到完全未校准的四种场景下评估所有组合。
Result: 无时间校准时MAE升至1.29米，模型提取基于混响的线索，早期反射信息量最大；有时间校准时MAE为0.14米，模型仅依赖传播延迟。
Conclusion: 时间校准可大幅提升距离估计精度，且早期反射是混响线索中最具信息量的成分。

papers.title: TriDE: Triangle-Consistent Translation Directions for Global Camera Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Pairwise translation directions are a key input to camera location estimation in global structure-from-motion. Existing estimators usually process each image pair independently, producing directions that may be locally plausible but inconsistent with the other relative directions in the viewing graph. To jointly estimate the direction, we propose TriDE, which exploits camera-triangle consistency as an efficient higher-order verification signal. Instead of solving a costly global nonlinear optimization problem that is sensitive to initialization, TriDE refines unreliable pairwise directions through message passing between directions and their incident weighted triangles. This information propagation strategy enables us to establish a strong phase-transition bound for exact recovery under a realistic random corruption model. Experiments on real image graphs show that TriDE improves direction accuracy by a large margin and yields better downstream camera locations, providing a practical link between local pairwise estimation and global camera pose geometry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对全局运动恢复结构中的相机位置估计问题，提出TriDE方法，利用相机三角形一致性作为高阶验证信号，通过消息传递机制优化不可靠的成对平移方向，从而在无需全局非线性优化的前提下提升方向估计准确性，并在真实图像图实验中验证了效果。
Motivation: 现有全局SfM方法独立估计每对图像的平移方向，导致局部合理但全局不一致的问题，需要更高效的全局一致性约束。
Method: 提出TriDE方法，利用相机三角形一致性作为高阶验证信号，通过方向与关联加权三角形之间的消息传递机制，迭代优化不可靠的成对平移方向，避免昂贵的全局非线性优化。
Result: 在真实图像图实验中，TriDE显著提升成对方向估计精度，并产生更准确的相机位置，为局部估计与全局位姿几何之间建立了实用桥梁。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了利用三角形一致性进行消息传递可有效改善成对方向估计的全局一致性，且方法在理论上给出了精确恢复的相位转移界。
