papers.title: Large-Scale High-Quality 3D Gaussian Head Reconstruction from Multi-View Captures
papers.abstract_en: We propose HeadsUp, a scalable feed-forward method for reconstructing high-quality 3D Gaussian heads from large-scale multi-camera setups. Our method employs an efficient encoder-decoder architecture that compresses input views into a compact latent representation. This latent representation is then decoded into a set of UV-parameterized 3D Gaussians anchored to a neutral head template. This UV representation decouples the number of 3D Gaussians from the number and resolution of input images, enabling training with many high-resolution input views. We train and evaluate our model on an internal dataset with more than 10,000 subjects, which is an order of magnitude larger than existing multi-view human head datasets. HeadsUp achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction quality and generalizes to novel identities without test-time optimization. We extensively analyze the scaling behavior of our model across identities, views, and model capacity, revealing practical insights for quality-compute trade-offs. Finally, we highlight the strength of our latent space by showcasing two downstream applications: generating novel 3D identities and animating the 3D heads with expression blendshapes.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project website: https://apple.github.io/ml-headsup/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HeadsUp，一种可扩展的前馈方法，用于从多摄像机装置重建高质量 3D 高斯人头。该方法采用编码器-解码器架构，将输入视图压缩为紧凑潜在表示，再解码为 UV 参数化的 3D 高斯，锚定到中性人头模板。在包含超过 10,000 个主体的内部数据集上训练，HeadsUp 达到了最先进的重建质量，并能泛化到未见身份，无需测试时优化。
Motivation: 现有多视图人头重建方法在可扩展性上受限，通常需要测试时优化或受限于输入视图数量和分辨率。HeadsUp 旨在通过解耦高斯数量与输入图像数量和分辨率，实现大规模高质量重建。
Method: 使用高效编码器-解码器架构，输入多视图图像，压缩为紧凑潜在表示，再解码为 UV 参数化的 3D 高斯集合，这些高斯锚定到一个中性人头模板上，从而将高斯数量与输入视图解耦。
Result: 在内部数据集上训练（>10,000 个主体，比现有数据集大一个数量级），HeadsUp 实现了最先进的重建质量，并能泛化到新身份，无需测试时优化。此外，模型在身份、视图和容量上的缩放行为被分析，揭示了质量-计算权衡。
Conclusion: HeadsUp 展示了可扩展的 3D 高斯人头重建能力，其潜在空间可用于下游应用如生成新 3D 身份和通过表情混合形状动画化人头。

papers.title: Mechanical Conscience: A Mathematical Framework for Dependability of Machine Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Distributed collaborative intelligence (DCI), encompassing edge-to-edge architectures, federated learning, transfer learning, and swarm systems, creates environments in which emergent risk is structurally unavoidable: locally correct decisions by individual agents compose into globally unacceptable behavioral trajectories under uncertainty. Existing approaches such as constrained optimization, safe reinforcement learning, and runtime assurance evaluate acceptability at the level of individual actions rather than across behavioral trajectories, and none addresses the multi-participant, uncertainty-laden nature of DCI deployments. This paper introduces mechanical conscience (MC), a novel concept and simplified mathematical framework that operationalizes trajectory-level normative regulation for both single-agent and distributed intelligent systems. Mechanical conscience is defined as a supervisory filter that minimally corrects a baseline policy's actions to reduce cumulative deviation from a normatively admissible region, while accounting for epistemic uncertainty. We introduce associated constructs, conscience score, mechanical guilt, and resonant dependability, that provide an interpretable vocabulary and computable governance signals for this emerging field. Core theoretical properties are established: admissibility equivalence, existence of optimal regulation, and monotonic deviation reduction. Illustrative results demonstrate that MC-regulated agents maintain trajectory-level normative acceptability where conventional controllers drift outside admissible bounds, and that the framework naturally extends to suppress interaction-induced emergent risk in multi-agent DCI settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出机械良知（Mechanical Conscience, MC）概念和简化数学框架，用于对单智能体和分布式智能系统进行轨迹级别的规范性调控。MC被定义为一种监督过滤器，最小化基线策略动作以降低与规范性可接受区域的累积偏差，并考虑认知不确定性。文章建立了可接受性等价、最优调控存在性和单调偏差减少等核心理论性质，并通过示例表明MC调控的智能体能维持轨迹级别的规范性可接受性，而传统控制器会偏离，该框架也自然地扩展到抑制多智能体分布式协作智能中的交互引发的涌现风险。
Motivation: 分布式协作智能（DCI）中，局部正确决策在不确定性下组合成全局不可接受行为轨迹，现有方法如约束优化、安全强化学习等仅评估单个动作的可接受性，未处理多参与者、不确定性环境下的轨迹级别问题。
Method: 定义机械良知作为监督过滤器，通过最小化基线策略动作来减少与规范性可接受区域的累积偏差，引入良知分数、机械内疚和共振可靠性等概念，提供可解释的治理信号。通过理论证明建立可接受性等价、最优调控存在性和单调偏差减少性质。
Result: 示例结果表明，MC调控的智能体能维持轨迹级别的规范性可接受性，传统控制器则漂移到可接受边界之外；该框架可自然扩展到多智能体DCI场景以抑制交互引发涌现风险。
Conclusion: 机械良知为分布式智能系统的轨迹级规范性调控提供了理论框架和可计算信号，适用于单智能体和多智能体环境。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: FreeTimeGS++: Secrets of Dynamic Gaussian Splatting and Their Principles
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) has achieved impressive dynamic scene reconstruction results. While these methods demonstrate remarkable performance, the specific factors behind their gains remain underexplored, making a systematic understanding of the underlying principles challenging. In this paper, we perform a comprehensive analysis of these hidden factors to provide a clearer perspective on the 4DGS framework. We first establish a controlled baseline, FreeTimeGS_ours, by formalizing and reproducing the heuristics of the state-of-the-art FreeTimeGS. Using this framework, we examine 4DGS along its fundamental axes and identify practical secrets, including the emergent temporal partitioning driven by Gaussian durations and the decoupling between photometric fidelity and motion behavior. Based on these insights, we propose FreeTimeGS++, a principled method that employs gated marginalization, UFM-guided initialization, and color correction to improve stability and reproducibility. Our approach yields reproducible results with reduced run-to-run variance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对4D高斯溅射（4DGS）中的隐藏因素进行系统分析，建立受控基线FreeTimeGS_ours，识别高斯持续时间驱动的临时分区等实际秘密，并提出FreeTimeGS++方法，采用门控边缘化、UFM引导初始化和颜色校正以提高稳定性和可重复性。
Motivation: 4DGS方法虽然表现出色，但其性能提升的具体因素尚不明确，缺乏对基本原理的系统理解。
Method: 通过形式化现有方法启发式构建基线，沿基本轴分析4DGS，提出包含门控边缘化、UFM引导初始化和颜色校正的FreeTimeGS++。
Result: 新方法减少了运行间方差，得到可重复结果。
Conclusion: 论文通过揭示隐藏因素并设计原则性方法，提高了动态场景重建的稳定性和可重复性。

papers.title: SHIELD: A Diverse Clinical Note Dataset and Distilled Small Language Models for Enterprise-Scale De-identification
papers.abstract_en: De-identification of clinical text is a prerequisite for the secondary use of electronic health records. Existing public benchmarks such as the i2b2 2006 and 2014 corpora are over a decade old and lack the semantic and demographic diversity of modern clinical narratives. Large Language Models (LLMs) reach state-of-the-art zero-shot extraction, but their use at enterprise scale is limited by computational cost and by hospital data governance that restricts sending Protected Health Information (PHI) to cloud APIs. We introduce SHIELD (Synthetic Human-annotated Identifier-replaced Entries for Learning and De-identification), a diverse clinical note dataset of 1,381 notes with 10,229 gold-standard PHI spans across 9 categories, built with set-cover diversity sampling across demographic and document-type strata and human-in-the-loop adjudication. We evaluate four LLMs (two proprietary, two open-weight) to establish a performance ceiling on SHIELD, then show that a teacher-student distillation framework transfers these capabilities into locally deployable Small Language Models. Our best distilled model reaches micro-averaged span-level precision of 0.89 and recall of 0.88 while running on standard workstation hardware. It trails its cloud teacher on per-category recall (0.90 vs. 0.81 macro-averaged) but remains competitive given its lower cost and on-premise deployability. Cross-dataset evaluation shows that diversity-trained models generalize well on universal structured PHI categories, while institution-specific entities remain hard to transfer in both directions, which suggests pairing broad-coverage models with specialized models for high-volume, semi-structured note types. We publicly release the SHIELD dataset and the distilled DeBERTa v3 model to provide an accurate, cost-effective de-identification pipeline deployable entirely behind institutional firewalls.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 SHIELD，一个包含 1,381 份临床笔记、10,229 个金标准 PHI 跨度（9 个类别）的多样化数据集，通过集合覆盖多样性采样和人工审核构建。作者评估了四个大语言模型（LLMs）的性能上限，然后使用教师-学生蒸馏框架将能力迁移到本地可部署的小语言模型（SLMs）。最佳蒸馏模型在标准工作站硬件上达到微平均跨度级精度 0.89、召回率 0.88，与云教师模型相比在宏观平均召回率上略低（0.90 vs 0.81），但具有更低的成本和内部部署优势。跨数据集评估表明，多样性训练的模型在通用结构化 PHI 类别上泛化良好，而机构特定实体在双向转移中仍然困难。数据集和蒸馏模型已公开。
Motivation: 现有临床文本去标识化基准（如 i2b2 2006/2014）已过时，缺乏现代临床叙述的语义和人口多样性。大型语言模型虽达到最先进水平，但企业级部署受限于计算成本和医疗数据治理（禁止云 API 传输 PHI）。
Method: 构建 SHIELD 数据集：使用集合覆盖多样性采样跨人口统计和文档类型分层，并结合人工审核。采用教师-学生蒸馏框架，将 LLM 能力转移到较小的 SLM（如 DeBERTa v3）。
Result: 最佳蒸馏模型在 SHIELD 上达到微平均精度 0.89、召回率 0.88；宏观平均召回率 0.81，低于云教师模型的 0.90。跨数据集泛化良好，但机构特定实体转移困难。
Conclusion: SHIELD 和蒸馏模型提供了一个准确、经济高效的内部部署去标识化管线，但建议将广覆盖模型与针对高流量半结构化的专用模型结合。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文介绍 SHIELD，一个包含 1,381 份临床笔记、10,229 个金标准 PHI 跨度（9 个类别）的多样化数据集，通过集合覆盖多样性采样和人工审核构建。作者评估了四个大语言模型（LLMs）的性能上限，然后使用教师-学生蒸馏框架将能力迁移到本地可部署的小语言模型（SLMs）。最佳蒸馏模型在标准工作站硬件上达到微平均跨度级精度 0.89、召回率 0.88，与云教师模型相比在宏观平均召回率上略低（0.90 vs 0.81），但具有更低的成本和内部部署优势。跨数据集评估表明，多样性训练的模型在通用结构化 PHI 类别上泛化良好，而机构特定实体在双向转移中仍然困难。数据集和蒸馏模型已公开。

papers.title: Divide and Conquer: Decoupled Representation Alignment for Multimodal World Models
papers.abstract_en: Emerging multi-modal world models attempt to jointly generate videos across diverse modalities (e.g., RGB, depth, and mask), yet they fail to fully exploit the rich priors of existing foundation models. We propose $M^2$-REPA, the first representation alignment method tailored for multi-modal video generation. Our key insight is that foundation models trained on different modality spaces naturally capture distinct domain-specific priors, acting as complementary "experts." Specifically, we first decouple modality-specific features from the diffusion model's intermediate representations, then align each with its corresponding expert foundation model. To this end, we design two synergistic objectives: a multi-modal representation alignment loss that enforces feature-to-expert matching, and a modality-specific decoupling regularization that encourages complementarity across different modalities. This design enables joint optimization, fully exploiting priors from multiple foundation models. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms baselines in visual quality and long-term consistency.

papers.title: Geometric and dynamical analysis of attractor boundaries and storage limits in kernel Hopfield networks
papers.abstract_en: High-capacity associative memories based on Kernel Logistic Regression (KLR) exhibit strong storage capabilities, but the dynamical and geometric mechanisms underlying their stability remain poorly understood. This paper investigates the global geometry of attractor basins and the mechanisms governing the storage limit in KLR-trained Hopfield networks. We combine empirical evaluations using random sequences and real-world image embeddings (CIFAR-10) with morphing experiments and statistical Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) analysis. Our experiments show that the network achieves a storage capacity for random sequences up to $P/N \approx 16$, while maintaining stable retrieval for structured data at effective loads near $P/N \approx 20$. Morphing analysis indicates that attractors on the "Ridge of Optimization" are separated by sharp, phase-transition-like boundaries, characterized by steep effective potential barriers and critical slowing down. Furthermore, by comparing an SNR analysis with a geometric reference point inspired by Cover's theorem, we show that the practical storage limit is governed primarily not by a lack of geometric separability in the feature space, but by the loss of dynamical stability against crosstalk noise. These findings suggest that KLR networks function as highly localized exemplar-based memories that operate near the onset of dynamical collapse, providing a useful perspective on the design of robust, large-scale retrieval systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了基于核逻辑回归（KLR）训练的Hopfield网络的吸引子盆地全局几何和存储极限机制。通过随机序列和CIFAR-10图像嵌入的实证评估、变形实验及信噪比（SNR）分析，发现网络对随机序列的存储容量达P/N≈16，对结构化数据有效负载约P/N≈20。吸引子由尖锐的相变状边界分隔，存储极限主要受限于对串扰噪声的动力稳定性丧失，而非特征空间的可分性。
Motivation: 高容量联想记忆（如KLR网络）的存储能力已知较强，但稳定性的动力学和几何机制尚不明确，本文旨在填补这一理解空白。
Method: 结合随机序列和CIFAR-10图像嵌入的实证测试、形态学(morphing)实验以及统计信噪比(SNR)分析，并引入Cover定理的几何参考点进行对比。
Result: 随机序列存储容量达P/N≈16，结构化数据有效负载约P/N≈20；吸引子边界呈现尖锐相变特征及临界慢化现象；SNR分析表明实际存储极限由动力稳定性（串扰噪声）主导，而非特征空间几何可分性。
Conclusion: KLR网络作为高度局部化的基于范例的记忆，在动力学崩溃边界附近运行，为设计鲁棒的大规模检索系统提供了视角。

papers.title: REALM: An RGB- and Event-Aligned Latent Manifold for Cross-Modal Perception
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras provide several unique advantages over standard frame-based sensors, including high temporal resolution, low latency, and robustness to extreme lighting. However, existing learning-based approaches for event processing are typically confined to narrow, task-specific silos and lack the ability to generalize across modalities. We address this gap with REALM, a cross-modal framework that learns an RGB- and Event-Aligned Latent Manifold by projecting event representations into the pretrained latent space of RGB foundation models. Instead of task-specific training, we leverage low-rank adaptation (LoRA) to bridge the modality gap, effectively unlocking the geometric and semantic priors of frozen RGB backbones for asynchronous event streams. We demonstrate that REALM effectively maps events into the ViT-based foundation latent space. Our method performs downstream tasks, such as depth estimation and semantic segmentation, by simply transferring linear heads trained on the RGB teacher. Most significantly, REALM enables the direct, zero-shot application of complex, frozen image-trained decoders, such as MASt3R, to raw event data. We demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in wide-baseline feature matching, significantly outperforming specialized architectures. Code and models are available at https://papers.starslab.ca/realm/.
papers.comment: Accepted to the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV), Malmö, SE, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出REALM，一个跨模态框架，通过低秩适配（LoRA）将事件表示映射到预训练的RGB基础模型的潜空间，实现事件流与RGB对齐。无需任务特定训练，只需训练线性头即可完成深度估计和语义分割等下游任务，并实现零样本应用如MASt3R到事件数据。在宽基线特征匹配上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有事件处理方法局限于特定任务，缺乏跨模态泛化能力。
Method: 使用LoRA桥接事件表示与冻结的RGB基础模型（ViT）的潜空间，学习对齐的隐流形。
Result: 在宽基线特征匹配上显著超越专用架构，实现零样本应用。
Conclusion: REALM有效利用RGB基础模型的先验处理异步事件流，无需任务特定训练。

papers.title: FED-FSTQ: Fisher-Guided Token Quantization for Communication-Efficient Federated Fine-Tuning of LLMs on Edge Devices
papers.abstract_en: Federated fine-tuning provides a practical route to adapt large language models (LLMs) on edge devices without centralizing private data, yet in mobile deployments the training wall-clock is often bottlenecked by straggler-limited uplink communication under heterogeneous bandwidth and intermittent participation. Although parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) reduces trainable parameters, per-round payloads remain prohibitive in non-IID regimes, where uniform compression can discard rare but task-critical signals. We propose Fed-FSTQ, a Fisher-guided token quantization system primitive for communication-efficient federated LLM fine-tuning. Fed-FSTQ employs a lightweight Fisher proxy to estimate token sensitivity, coupling importance-aware token selection with non-uniform mixed-precision quantization to allocate higher fidelity to informative evidence while suppressing redundant transmission. The method is model-agnostic, serves as a drop-in module for standard federated PEFT pipelines, e.g., LoRA, without modifying the server aggregation rule, and supports bandwidth-heterogeneous clients via compact sparse message packing. Experiments on multilingual QA and medical QA under non-IID partitions show that Fed-FSTQ reduces cumulative uplink traffic required to reach a fixed quality threshold by 46x relative to a standard LoRA baseline, and improves end-to-end wall-clock time-to-accuracy by 52%. Furthermore, enabling Fisher-guided token reduction at inference yields up to a 1.55x end-to-end speedup on NVIDIA Jetson-class edge devices, demonstrating deployability under tight resource constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Fed-FSTQ，一种基于Fisher引导的token量化系统，用于联邦LLM微调中的通信高效。通过轻量级Fisher代理估计token敏感性，结合重要性感知的token选择和非均匀混合精度量化，减少上行通信量。实验表明，在非IID多语言QA和医学QA任务上，相比标准LoRA基线，累积上行流量降低46倍，端到端时间-精度改善52%；推理时在NVIDIA Jetson边缘设备上实现1.55倍加速。
Motivation: 联邦微调在边缘设备上面临异构带宽和间歇参与导致的通信瓶颈，非IID数据分布下均匀压缩会丢弃稀有但关键的任务信号。
Method: 提出Fed-FSTQ，包括一个轻量级Fisher代理来估计token敏感性，并据此进行重要性感知的token选择和非均匀混合精度量化，同时支持带宽异构客户端的紧凑稀疏消息打包。方法模型无关，可作为即插即用模块集成到标准联邦PEFT流水线（如LoRA）中。
Result: 在非IID多语言QA和医学QA实验中，累积上行流量减少46倍，端到端时间-精度改善52%；推理时在NVIDIA Jetson-class边缘设备上获得1.55倍加速。
Conclusion: Fed-FSTQ是一种模型无关、即插即用的通信高效联邦微调模块，适用于LoRA等PEFT方法，并在资源受限边缘设备上展示了可部署性。

papers.title: RF-HiT: Rectified Flow Hierarchical Transformer for General Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate medical image segmentation requires both long-range contextual reasoning and precise boundary delineation, a task where existing transformer- and diffusion-based paradigms are frequently bottlenecked by quadratic computational complexity and prohibitive inference latency. We propose RF-HiT, a Rectified Flow Hierarchical Transformer that integrates an Hourglass Transformer backbone with a multi-scale hierarchical encoder for anatomically guided feature conditioning. Unlike prior diffusion-based approaches that rely on hundreds of denoising steps, RF-HiT leverages rectified flow with efficient transformer blocks, achieving linear complexity and requiring only a few discretization steps. The model further fuses conditioning features at each resolution via learnable interpolation, enabling effective multi-scale feature integration with minimal computational overhead. As a result, RF-HiT achieves a strong efficiency-performance trade-off, requiring only 10.14 GFLOPs, 13.6M parameters, and inference in as few as 3 steps. Despite its compact design, RF-HiT attains 91.27% mean Dice on ACDC and 87.40% on BraTS 2021, achieving performance comparable to or exceeding that of significantly more intensive architectures. These results suggest that RF-HiT is a promising, computationally efficient foundation for clinical image segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出RF-HiT，一种结合沙漏Transformer骨干和多尺度层次编码器的整流流层次Transformer，用于通用医学图像分割。该模型利用整流流和高效Transformer块，实现线性复杂度，仅需少量离散化步骤，在ACDC和BraTS 2021上分别达到91.27%和87.40%的平均Dice分数，同时保持低计算量（10.14 GFLOPs）和参数量（13.6M）。
Motivation: 现有基于Transformer和扩散的医学图像分割方法受限于二次计算复杂度和高推理延迟，需要一种高效且性能强的替代方案。
Method: 集成沙漏Transformer骨干与多尺度层次编码器，使用整流流和高效Transformer块，通过可学习插值融合不同分辨率的条件特征，实现多尺度特征集成。
Result: 在ACDC上平均Dice为91.27%，BraTS 2021上为87.40%，仅需3步推理，计算量10.14 GFLOPs，参数13.6M。
Conclusion: RF-HiT在医学图像分割中实现了高效性与性能的良好平衡，有望成为临床分割的计算高效基础。

papers.title: EvoMaster: A Foundational Evolving Agent Framework for Agentic Science at Scale
papers.abstract_en: The convergence of large language models and agents is catalyzing a new era of scientific discovery: Agentic Science. While the scientific method is inherently iterative, existing agent frameworks are predominantly static, narrowly scoped, and lack the capacity to learn from trial and error. To bridge this gap, we present EvoMaster, a foundational evolving agent framework engineered specifically for Agentic Science at Scale. Driven by the core principle of continuous self-evolution, EvoMaster empowers agents to iteratively refine hypotheses, self-critique, and progressively accumulate knowledge across experimental cycles, faithfully mirroring human scientific inquiry. Crucially, as a domain-agnostic base harness, EvoMaster is exceptionally easy to scale up -- enabling developers to build and deploy highly capable, self-evolving scientific agents for arbitrary disciplines in approximately 100 lines of code. Built upon EvoMaster, we incubated the SciMaster ecosystem across domains such as machine learning, physics, biology, web research, and general science. Evaluations on ten benchmarks spanning scientific research/coding/experimentation, scientific reasoning and information search, and practical scientific problem solving compare EvoMaster against OpenHands, OpenClaw, and Codex. EvoMaster achieves the highest score on nine of the ten benchmarks and the strongest average score (58.0\%) among the four agents, validating its efficacy and generality as the premier foundational framework for the next generation of autonomous scientific discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoMaster 是一个为大规模自主科学发现设计的演化智能体框架，其核心是持续自我进化，允许智能体在实验周期中迭代精炼假设、自我批评和积累知识。该框架领域无关，只需约100行代码即可构建自进化科学智能体。在10个基准测试中，EvoMaster 在9个上取得最高分，平均得分58.0%，优于现有框架。
Motivation: 现有智能体框架多为静态且范围狭窄，缺乏从试错中学习的能力，无法支持科学方法所固有的迭代过程。
Method: 提出 EvoMaster 框架，通过持续自我进化驱动智能体迭代精炼假设、自我批评和逐步积累知识。框架是领域无关的基础工具，易于扩展，基于它孵化了跨多个领域的 SciMaster 生态系统。

papers.title: REALM: Reliable Expertise-Aware Language Model Fine-Tuning from Noisy Annotations
papers.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning of large language models relies on human-annotated data, yet annotation pipelines routinely involve multiple crowdworkers of heterogeneous expertise. Standard practice aggregates labels via majority vote or simple averaging, discarding annotator identity and causing the model to absorb the errors of unreliable annotators directly into its parameters. We propose REALM, a method that jointly learns the model parameters and a scalar expertise value for each annotator entirely unsupervised, requiring no supervision beyond annotator identity. The key idea is to model each observed label as a mixture between the model's prediction and a uniform random guess, weighted by the annotator's learned expertise. We extend REALM to a multi-task setting via a learned expertise matrix that captures per-annotator reliability across tasks. We evaluate on five question answering benchmarks, fine-tuning three sizes of Flan-T5 under simulated noisy annotations. The proposed algorithm consistently outperforms the naive noisy SFT in the large majority of single- and multi-task settings, across datasets, model sizes, and noise types, with accuracy improvements of up to $50\%$ in the most adversarial regime and gains that grow with model capacity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 REALM，一种无需监督即可联合学习语言模型参数和每个标注者标量专业性的方法，将每个观测标签建模为模型预测与均匀随机猜测的混合，权重由学习到的专业性决定。在五个问答基准上使用 Flan-T5 三个尺寸进行实验，在大多数单任务和多任务设置下，该方法在模拟噪声标注中优于朴素有监督微调，最高准确率提升达 50%。
Motivation: 标准监督微调依赖人工标注，但标注者水平参差不齐，简单投票或平均聚合丢弃了标注者身份信息，导致模型吸收不可靠标注者的错误。
Method: 提出联合训练模型参数与每个标注者的可学习标量专业性值。将每个观测标签视为模型预测与均匀随机猜测的混合，混合权重由标注者专业性决定。扩展至多任务设置，引入跨任务的专业性矩阵。
Result: 在五个问答基准上，使用 Flan-T5 三个尺寸（含不同模型容量）进行实验，单任务与多任务场景下，REALM 在大部分设置中均优于朴素有噪声 SFT，在最强噪声情况下准确率提升达 50%，且增益随模型容量增大。
Conclusion: 实验表明，REALM 通过显式建模标注者可靠性能有效缓解噪声标注的影响，且模型容量越大收益越明显。

papers.title: Rule-VLN: Bridging Perception and Compliance via Semantic Reasoning and Geometric Rectification
papers.abstract_en: As embodied AI transitions to real-world deployment, the success of the Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) task tends to evolve from mere reachability to social compliance. However, current agents suffer from a "goal-driven trap", prioritizing physical geometry ("can I go?") over semantic rules ("may I go?"), frequently overlooking subtle regulatory constraints. To bridge this gap, we establish Rule-VLN, the first large-scale urban benchmark for rule-compliant navigation. Spanning a massive 29k-node environment, it injects 177 diverse regulatory categories into 8k constrained nodes across four curriculum levels, challenging agents with fine-grained visual and behavioral constraints. We further propose the Semantic Navigation Rectification Module (SNRM), a universal, zero-shot module designed to equip pre-trained agents with safety awareness. SNRM integrates a coarse-to-fine visual perception VLM framework with an epistemic mental map for dynamic detour planning. Experiments demonstrate that while Rule-VLN challenges state-of-the-art models, SNRM significantly restores navigation capabilities, reducing CVR by 19.26% and boosting TC by 5.97%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Rule-VLN，首个大规模城市规则合规导航基准，包含29k节点和177种规则类别，并分为四个课程级别。同时提出语义导航修正模块（SNRM），一种通用零样本模块，结合粗到细视觉感知VLM框架与认知心理地图进行动态绕路规划。实验表明SNRM显著恢复导航能力，降低CVR 19.26%，提升TC 5.97%。
Motivation: 当前VLN智能体陷入'目标驱动陷阱'，优先考虑几何可通过性而忽视语义规则合规性，导致在现实部署中无法遵守细微的监管约束。
Method: 建立Rule-VLN大规模基准，并提出语义导航修正模块（SNRM），该模块集成了粗到细视觉感知VLM框架和认知心理地图，实现零样本的动态绕路规划。
Result: SNRM在Rule-VLN基准上使碰撞违规率（CVR）降低19.26%，任务完成率（TC）提升5.97%。
Conclusion: 论文强调规则合规导航对于具身AI现实部署的重要性，并证明SNRM作为通用零样本模块可以有效恢复预训练模型的合规导航能力。

papers.title: Zeroth-Order Optimization at the Edge of Stability
papers.abstract_en: Zeroth-order (ZO) methods are widely used when gradients are unavailable or prohibitively expensive, including black-box learning and memory-efficient fine-tuning of large models, yet their optimization dynamics in deep learning remain underexplored. In this work, we provide an explicit step size condition that exactly captures the (mean-square) linear stability of a family of ZO methods based on the standard two-point estimator. Our characterization reveals a sharp contrast with first-order (FO) methods: whereas FO stability is governed solely by the largest Hessian eigenvalue, mean-square stability of ZO methods depends on the entire Hessian spectrum. Since computing the full Hessian spectrum is infeasible in practical neural network training, we further derive tractable stability bounds that depend only on the largest eigenvalue and the Hessian trace. Empirically, we find that full-batch ZO methods operate at the edge of stability: ZO-GD, ZO-GDM, and ZO-Adam consistently stabilize near the predicted stability boundary across a range of deep learning training problems. Our results highlight an implicit regularization effect specific to ZO methods, where large step sizes primarily regularize the Hessian trace, whereas in FO methods they regularize the top eigenvalue.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了基于两点估计的零阶（ZO）优化方法在深度学习中的线性稳定性，给出了精确刻画均方稳定性的步长条件。与一阶方法仅依赖最大Hessian特征值不同，ZO方法的稳定性取决于整个Hessian谱。作者进一步推导了仅依赖于最大特征值和Hessian迹的可处理稳定性边界，并发现全批次ZO方法（如ZO-GD、ZO-GDM、ZO-Adam）在多种深度学习训练中稳定在预测的稳定性边界附近，揭示了ZO方法特有的隐式正则化效应：大步长主要正则化Hessian迹，而一阶方法正则化顶部特征值。
Motivation: 零阶方法在梯度不可用或昂贵时广泛使用，但其优化动态在深度学习中尚未充分理解，特别是稳定性条件。
Method: 提供了一个显式步长条件来精确刻画基于两点估计的ZO方法的均方线性稳定性，并基于最大特征值和Hessian迹推导了可处理的稳定性边界。
Result: 全批次ZO方法（ZO-GD、ZO-GDM、ZO-Adam）在深度学习训练中稳定在预测的稳定性边界附近，且大步长主要正则化Hessian迹，与一阶方法不同。
Conclusion: ZO方法具有特有的隐式正则化效应，步长选择在稳定性边界附近可诱导对Hessian迹的正则化。

papers.title: GUI-Perturbed: Domain Randomization Reveals Systematic Brittleness in GUI Grounding Models
papers.abstract_en: GUI grounding models report over 85% accuracy on standard benchmarks, yet drop 27-56 percentage points when instructions require spatial reasoning rather than direct element naming. Current benchmarks miss this because they evaluate each screenshot once with a single fixed instruction. We introduce GUI-Perturbed, a controlled perturbation framework that independently varies visual scenes and instructions to measure grounding robustness. Evaluating three 7B models from the same architecture lineage, we find that relational instructions cause systematic accuracy collapse across all models, a 70% browser zoom produces statistically significant degradation, and rank-8 LoRA fine-tuning with augmented data degrades performance rather than improving it. By perturbing along independent axes, GUI-Perturbed isolates which specific capability axes are affected-spatial reasoning, visual robustness, reasoning calibration-providing diagnostic signal that aggregate benchmarks cannot. We release the dataset, augmentation pipeline, and a fine-tuned model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了GUI grounding模型在标准基准上表现良好（>85%准确率），但当指令需要空间推理而非直接元素命名时，准确率骤降27-56个百分点。作者提出GUI-Perturbed框架，通过独立变化视觉场景和指令来测量鲁棒性，发现关系指令导致所有测试模型系统性崩溃，70%浏览器缩放造成显著退化，而数据增强的LoRA微调反而降低性能。
Motivation: 现有基准测试每次截图仅使用单一固定指令，无法检测模型对指令变化和视觉扰动的鲁棒性，导致高估模型的实际能力。
Method: 提出GUI-Perturbed域随机化框架，独立扰动视觉场景（如缩放、颜色变换）和指令（如关系型vs直接命名），系统评估GUI grounding模型在不同轴上的鲁棒性。
Result: 三个7B模型在关系指令下准确率大幅下降；70%浏览器缩放导致统计显著的性能退化；使用增强数据的rank-8 LoRA微调反而使性能变差。
Conclusion: GUI-Perturbed能够隔离并诊断模型在空间推理、视觉鲁棒性和推理校准等具体能力轴上的缺陷，提供聚合基准无法提供的诊断信号。

papers.title: From Synchrony to Sequence: Exo-to-Ego Generation via Interpolation
papers.abstract_en: Exo-to-Ego video generation aims to synthesize a first-person video from a synchronized third-person view and corresponding camera poses. While paired supervision is available, synchronized exo-ego data inherently introduces substantial spatio-temporal and geometric discontinuities, violating the smooth-motion assumptions of standard video generation benchmarks. We identify this synchronization-induced jump as the central challenge and propose Syn2Seq-Forcing, a sequential formulation that interpolates between the source and target videos to form a single continuous signal. By reframing Exo2Ego as sequential signal modeling rather than a conventional condition-output task, our approach enables diffusion-based sequence models, e.g. Diffusion Forcing Transformers (DFoT), to capture coherent transitions across frames more effectively. Empirically, we show that interpolating only the videos, without performing pose interpolation already produces significant improvements, emphasizing that the dominant difficulty arises from spatio-temporal discontinuities. Beyond immediate performance gains, this formulation establishes a general and flexible framework capable of unifying both Exo2Ego and Ego2Exo generation within a single continuous sequence model, providing a principled foundation for future research in cross-view video synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对外-第一人称视角视频生成（Exo-to-Ego）中同步数据带来的时空几何不连续性，提出Syn2Seq-Forcing方法。该方法将源和目标视频通过插值形成连续信号，利用扩散强迫变换器（DFoT）进行序列建模，有效捕捉帧间连贯过渡。实验表明，仅视频插值无需位姿插值即可显著提升生成质量，并统一了Exo2Ego与Ego2Exo两种任务。
Motivation: 同步的外-第一人称数据存在固有的时空和几何不连续性，违反标准视频生成的平滑运动假设，使得直接条件生成效果不佳。
Method: 提出Syn2Seq-Forcing，将Exo-to-Ego重新定义为序列信号建模问题：在源和目标视频之间进行插值形成连续序列，再使用扩散强迫变换器（DFoT）进行生成。
Result: 仅对视频进行插值（不进行位姿插值）即可带来显著改进，表明主要困难在于时空不连续性。
Conclusion: 该序列化公式为跨视角视频合成提供了一个统一且灵活的框架，能同时处理Exo2Ego和Ego2Exo生成，为未来研究奠定基础。

papers.title: When Less Latent Leads to Better Relay: Information-Preserving Compression for Latent Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Communication in Large Language Model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems is moving beyond discrete tokens to preserve richer context. Recent work such as LatentMAS enables agents to exchange latent messages through full key-value (KV) caches. However, full KV relay incurs high memory and communication cost. We adapt KV-cache eviction methods to this setting and introduce \textbf{Orthogonal BackFill (OBF)} to mitigate information loss from hard eviction. OBF injects a low-rank orthogonal residual from discarded KV states into the retained KV states. We evaluate OBF against full KV relay on nine benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning, expert and commonsense QA, and coding. With only 9.9%-20.2% of the prompt KV states retained, H-OBF delivers between $97%$ and $120%$ of full KV relay's per-benchmark accuracy across the nine benchmarks. This suggests that more information does not necessarily lead to better communication; preserving the most useful information matters more. Our codebase is included in the supplementary material. Our codebase is publicly available on https://github.com/markli404/When-Less-Latent-Leads-to-Better-Relay.

papers.title: Continuous Knowledge Metabolism: Generating Scientific Hypotheses from Evolving Literature
papers.abstract_en: Identifying promising research directions in fast-moving subareas is one of the most cognitively expensive tasks in modern AI research. Existing LLM-driven scientific discovery systems are typically limited to one-shot prompting on static literature snapshots and are validated only against contemporary judges such as human reviewers, agent peer review, wet-lab assays, or self-evaluation, leaving open whether they can anticipate future trends. We present Continuous Knowledge Metabolism (CKM), an AI workflow for hypothesis generation with three key capabilities: (i) continuous literature metabolism via sliding windows that maintain an evolving knowledge state; (ii) predictive evaluation, which grades hypotheses against papers published after the generation window; and (iii) practitioner-grade failure detection that diagnoses workflow failure modes from its outputs. On a 50-topic machine learning benchmark, CKM-Lite produces at least one validated hypothesis on 72% of topics (36 out of 50), more than doubling a one-shot baseline (30%) at approximately 3 dollars per topic and achieving 91% lower token cost. Validated hypotheses precede their matched papers by an average of 404 days (55 hits across 36 topics; median 399 days, range 66-757 days). Broadly, predictive validation against future literature provides a falsifiable, low-cost alternative to contemporary-judge evaluation protocols and can be applied wherever a corpus has dated publication records.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Continuous Knowledge Metabolism (CKM)，一个利用滑动窗口持续消化文献、用未来论文验证假设的 AI 工作流。在 50 个机器学习主题上，CKM-Lite 在 72% 的主题上生成至少一个被后续论文验证的假设，平均提前 404 天，成本约 3 美元/主题。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 驱动的科学发现系统多基于静态文献快照的一次性提示，且仅通过当代评审验证，无法预测未来趋势。
Method: CKM 包含三个关键能力：滑动窗口持续代谢文献以维护演化知识状态；预测性评估（用生成窗口之后发表的论文评分假设）；从业者级失败检测。
Result: 在 50 主题 ML 基准上，CKM-Lite 在 72% 主题上产生至少一个被验证的假设，是基线（30%）的两倍多；验证的假设平均超前匹配论文 404 天（55 个命中，中位数 399 天）。
Conclusion: 基于未来文献的预测性验证为当代评审评估提供了可证伪、低成本的替代方案，适用于任何具有出版日期记录的语料库。

papers.title: Stitch4D: Sparse Multi-Location 4D Urban Reconstruction via Spatio-Temporal Interpolation
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic urban environments are often captured by cameras placed at spatially separated locations with little or no view overlap. However, most existing 4D reconstruction methods assume densely overlapping views and struggle under sparse multi-location observations, producing unstable reconstructions in unobserved intermediate regions. To address this practical yet underexplored setting, we propose Stitch4D, a unified 4D reconstruction framework that compensates for missing spatial coverage in sparsely observed urban environments. Stitch4D synthesizes intermediate bridge views between distant camera locations and jointly optimizes real and synthesized observations in a unified coordinate frame with inter-location consistency constraints. By recovering intermediate spatial coverage before optimization, Stitch4D mitigates geometric collapse and improves reconstruction stability in sparse regions. To evaluate this setting, we introduce Urban Sparse 4D (U-S4D), a controlled CARLA-based benchmark for free-viewpoint reconstruction under sparse multi-location configurations. Experiments on U-S4D show that Stitch4D consistently outperforms representative 4D reconstruction baselines in image-quality metrics. These results suggest that recovering intermediate spatial coverage is an effective strategy for stabilizing 4D reconstruction in sparse urban environments. The project page is provided in https://stitch4d-project-page.vercel.app/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Stitch4D，一种针对稀疏多位置相机观测的4D城市重建框架，通过合成桥梁视图和联合优化来补偿缺失的空间覆盖，并在新基准U-S4D上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有4D重建方法依赖密集重叠视图，在稀疏多位置观测下（如远程摄像头）产生不稳定重建，而这一实际场景未被充分研究。
Method: Stitch4D在稀疏相机位置之间合成中间桥梁视图，并在统一坐标框架下联合优化真实和合成观测，施加跨位置一致性约束，以恢复中间空间覆盖并减少几何坍缩。
Result: 在基于CARLA的U-S4D基准上，Stitch4D在图像质量指标上持续优于代表性4D重建基线。
Conclusion: 恢复中间空间覆盖是稳定稀疏城市环境中4D重建的有效策略。

papers.title: DriveVA: Video Action Models are Zero-Shot Drivers
papers.abstract_en: Generalization is a central challenge in autonomous driving, as real-world deployment requires robust performance under unseen scenarios, sensor domains, and environmental conditions. Recent world-model-based planning methods have shown strong capabilities in scene understanding and multi-modal future prediction, yet their generalization across datasets and sensor configurations remains limited. In addition, their loosely coupled planning paradigm often leads to poor video-trajectory consistency during visual imagination. To overcome these limitations, we propose DriveVA, a novel autonomous driving world model that jointly decodes future visual forecasts and action sequences in a shared latent generative process. DriveVA inherits rich priors on motion dynamics and physical plausibility from well-pretrained large-scale video generation models to capture continuous spatiotemporal evolution and causal interaction patterns. To this end, DriveVA employs a DiT-based decoder to jointly predict future action sequences (trajectories) and videos, enabling tighter alignment between planning and scene evolution. We also introduce a video continuation strategy to strengthen long-duration rollout consistency. DriveVA achieves an impressive PDM-based planning performance of 90.9 PDM score on the NAVSIM benchmark. Extensive experiments also demonstrate the zero-shot capability and cross-domain generalization of DriveVA, which reduces average L2 error and collision rate by 78.9% and 83.3% on nuScenes and 52.5% and 52.4% on the Bench2Drive built on CARLA v2 compared with the state-of-the-art world-model-based planner.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. 30 pages, 12 figures, 11 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DriveVA 是一种基于视频生成模型的世界模型，联合解码未来视频和动作序列，实现零样本驾驶。在 NAVSIM 上取得 90.9 PDM 分数，并在 nuScenes 和 Bench2Drive 上大幅降低 L2 误差和碰撞率。
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶世界模型泛化能力有限，且规划与视频生成耦合松散，导致视频-轨迹一致性差。
Method: 采用 DiT 解码器联合预测未来动作序列和视频，并引入视频延续策略增强长时序 rollout 一致性。
Result: NAVSIM 上 PDM 分数 90.9；在 nuScenes 上 L2 误差和碰撞率分别降低 78.9% 和 83.3%，在 Bench2Drive 上降低 52.5% 和 52.4%。
Conclusion: DriveVA 展示了基于视频生成先验的零样本驾驶能力，但仅限于自动驾驶领域。

papers.title: Salt: Self-Consistent Distribution Matching with Cache-Aware Training for Fast Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Distilling video generation models to extremely low inference budgets (e.g., 2--4 NFEs) is crucial for real-time deployment, yet remains challenging. Trajectory-style consistency distillation often becomes conservative under complex video dynamics, yielding an over-smoothed appearance and weak motion. Distribution matching distillation (DMD) can recover sharp, mode-seeking samples, but its local training signals do not explicitly regularize how denoising updates compose across timesteps, making composed rollouts prone to drift. To overcome this challenge, we propose Self-Consistent Distribution Matching Distillation (SC-DMD), which explicitly regularizes the endpoint-consistent composition of consecutive denoising updates. For real-time autoregressive video generation, we further treat the KV cache as a quality parameterized condition and propose Cache-Distribution-Aware training. This training scheme applies SC-DMD over multi-step rollouts and introduces a cache-conditioned feature alignment objective that steers low-quality outputs toward high-quality references. Across extensive experiments on both non-autoregressive backbones (e.g., Wan~2.1) and autoregressive real-time paradigms (e.g., Self Forcing), our method, dubbed \textbf{Salt}, consistently improves low-NFE video generation quality while remaining compatible with diverse KV-cache memory mechanisms. Project page: https://xingtongge.github.io/Salt
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自一致分布匹配蒸馏（SC-DMD），通过显式正则化连续去噪更新的端点一致性，解决视频生成模型在极低推理预算（2-4 NFE）下的过平滑和运动弱问题。同时，针对自回归实时视频生成，引入缓存分布感知训练，将KV缓存作为质量条件，通过多步展开的SC-DMD和缓存条件特征对齐目标提升低NFE视频质量。在非自回归（如Wan 2.1）和自回归实时（如Self Forcing）骨干上验证，方法一致改善视频生成质量，兼容多种KV缓存机制。
Motivation: 现有轨迹式一致性蒸馏在复杂视频动态下趋于保守，导致过平滑和弱运动；而分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）虽能恢复尖锐样本，但其局部训练信号未显式规约去噪更新在时间步上的组合，导致组合展开容易漂移。
Method: 提出自一致分布匹配蒸馏（SC-DMD），显式正则化连续去噪更新的端点一致性；进一步针对自回归实时视频生成，提出缓存分布感知训练，将KV缓存视为质量参数化条件，结合多步展开的SC-DMD和缓存条件特征对齐目标。
Result: 在非自回归骨干（如Wan 2.1）和自回归实时范式（如Self Forcing）上，该方法在低NFE（2-4步）下一致提升视频生成质量，并兼容多种KV缓存机制。
Conclusion: 论文强调所提方法在低推理预算下显著改善视频生成质量，适用于实时部署，且与不同KV缓存机制兼容。

papers.title: Crystalite: A Lightweight Transformer for Efficient Crystal Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Generative models for crystalline materials often rely on equivariant graph neural networks, which capture geometric structure well but are costly to train and slow to sample. We present Crystalite, a lightweight diffusion Transformer for crystal modeling built around two simple inductive biases. The first is Subatomic Tokenization, a compact chemically structured atom representation that replaces high-dimensional one-hot encodings and is better suited to continuous diffusion. The second is the Geometry Enhancement Module (GEM), which injects periodic minimum-image pair geometry directly into attention through additive geometric biases. Together, these components preserve the simplicity and efficiency of a standard Transformer while making it better matched to the structure of crystalline materials. Crystalite achieves state-of-the-art results on crystal structure prediction benchmarks, and de novo generation performance, attaining the best S.U.N. discovery score among the evaluated baselines while sampling substantially faster than geometry-heavy alternatives.
papers.comment: 39 pages, 13 figures. Code available at: https://github.com/joshrosie/crystalite
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Crystalite，一种轻量级扩散Transformer用于晶体建模，通过亚原子分词化（Subatomic Tokenization）和几何增强模块（GEM）引入归纳偏置，在晶体结构预测和从头生成任务上达到最先进水平，同时采样速度显著快于几何重模型。
Motivation: 现有基于等变图神经网络的晶体生成模型训练成本高、采样慢，而标准Transformer缺乏对晶体周期性和几何结构的适配。
Method: 设计Subatomic Tokenization以生成紧凑的化学结构原子表示，替代高维独热编码；引入Geometry Enhancement Module (GEM)将周期最小镜像配对几何直接注入注意力机制的加性偏置中。
Result: 在晶体结构预测基准和从头生成任务上取得最先进结果，获得评估基线中最佳S.U.N.发现分数，且采样速度显著快于几何重模型。
Conclusion: Crystalite在保持标准Transformer简洁高效的同时，通过轻量级归纳偏置匹配晶体材料结构，为晶体生成建模提供了高效替代方案。

papers.title: Moiré Video Authentication: A Physical Signature Against AI Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in video generation have made AI-synthesized content increasingly difficult to distinguish from real footage. We propose a physics-based authentication signature that real cameras produce naturally, but that generative models cannot faithfully reproduce. Our approach exploits the Moiré effect: the interference fringes formed when a camera views a compact two-layer grating structure. We derive the Moiré motion invariant, showing that fringe phase and grating image displacement are linearly coupled by optical geometry, independent of viewing distance and grating structure. A verifier extracts both signals from video and tests their correlation. We validate the invariant on both real-captured and AI-generated videos from multiple state-of-the-art generators, and find that real and AI-generated videos produce significantly different correlation signatures, suggesting a robust means of differentiating them. Our work demonstrates that deterministic optical phenomena can serve as physically grounded, verifiable signatures against AI-generated video.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page and code: https://yuanqing-ai.github.io/physical_video_signature/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用莫尔条纹（Moiré effect）这一物理现象，提出一种基于光学几何的物理签名，用于区分真实视频和AI生成视频。作者推导了莫尔运动不变量，证明条纹相位与光栅图像位移呈线性耦合关系，不依赖于观看距离和光栅结构。在多个最新生成器生成的视频上的验证表明，真实与AI生成视频的相关性特征存在显著差异，从而提供了一种鲁棒的鉴别手段。
Motivation: AI生成的视频越来越逼真，传统方法难以区分，亟需一种基于物理原理的可靠认证机制。
Method: 利用相机拍摄紧凑双层光栅结构时产生的莫尔干涉条纹，推导出莫尔运动不变量（Moiré motion invariant），即条纹相位与光栅图像位移之间的线性耦合关系。验证者从视频中提取两个信号并测试其相关性。
Result: 在多个最先进的AI视频生成器生成的视频与真实视频的对比中，莫尔运动不变量相关性特征表现出显著差异，表明该方法能有效区分真假视频。
Conclusion: 确定性光学现象（如莫尔效应）可以作为物理上可验证的签名，为抵抗AI生成视频提供可靠手段。

papers.title: EgoSim: Egocentric World Simulator for Embodied Interaction Generation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce EgoSim, a closed-loop egocentric world simulator that generates spatially consistent interaction videos and persistently updates the underlying 3D scene state for continuous simulation. Existing egocentric simulators either lack explicit 3D grounding, causing structural drift under viewpoint changes, or treat the scene as static, failing to update world states across multi-stage interactions. EgoSim addresses both limitations by modeling 3D scenes as updatable world states. We generate embodiment interactions via a Geometry-action-aware Observation Simulation model, with spatial consistency from an Interaction-aware State Updating module. To overcome the critical data bottleneck posed by the difficulty in acquiring densely aligned scene-interaction training pairs, we design a scalable pipeline that extracts static point clouds, camera trajectories, and embodiment actions from in-the-wild large-scale monocular egocentric videos. We further introduce EgoCap, a capture system that enables low-cost real-world data collection with uncalibrated smartphones. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EgoSim significantly outperforms existing methods in terms of visual quality, spatial consistency, and generalization to complex scenes and in-the-wild dexterous interactions, while supporting cross-embodiment transfer to robotic manipulation. Codes and datasets will be open soon. The project page is at egosimulator.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EgoSim 是一个闭环的第一人称世界模拟器，能够生成空间一致的交互视频并持续更新底层3D场景状态。它通过几何-动作感知的观测模拟模型和交互感知的状态更新模块，实现了具身交互生成。实验表明，EgoSim 在视觉质量、空间一致性和复杂场景泛化上显著优于现有方法，并支持跨具身迁移到机器人操作。
Motivation: 现有第一人称模拟器要么缺乏显式3D接地，导致视角变化时结构漂移；要么将场景视为静态，无法更新多阶段交互后的世界状态。
Method: 提出 EgoSim，将3D场景建模为可更新的世界状态，包含几何-动作感知观测模拟模型和交互感知状态更新模块，并设计可扩展的数据采集流水线从野外大规模单眼第一人称视频中提取点云、相机轨迹和具身动作，同时引入低成本的 EgoCapt 采集系统。
Result: 在视觉质量、空间一致性和复杂场景泛化上显著优于现有方法，并支持向机器人操作的跨具身迁移。
Conclusion: EgoSim 通过可更新的3D世界状态和低成本数据采集解决了现有模拟器的局限，为具身交互生成提供了高效解决方案，代码和数据集将开源。

papers.title: ActivityNarrated: An Open-Ended Narrative Paradigm for Wearable Human Activity Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Wearable human activity recognition (HAR) has made steady progress, yet much of this progress remains grounded in fixed-window, closed-set classification benchmarks. This formulation is poorly matched to everyday behavior, where activities are open-ended, unscripted, personalized, variable in duration, and often compositional. To address this mismatch, we introduce ActivityNarrated, an open-ended narrative paradigm for language-grounded wearable activity understanding. We formulate this setting as dense sensor signal captioning with a comprehensive benchmark protocol that measures temporal localization, caption quality, sensor-language alignment, conventional closed-set classification as a downstream diagnostic, and additional robustness measures. We further present ActNarrator, a 3-stage architecture that discretizes continuous IMU signals into reusable motion tokens and uses an external frozen small language model to generate open-vocabulary activity captions. Experiments show that our method provides high quality dense sensor captioning with superior adaptivity and robustness, enabling various downstream tasks by turning sensor-based human activity understanding into sensor-grounded text-level reasoning. This includes downstream classification where ActNarrator outperforms state-of-the-art HAR models by 3.8 - 31.6 \% in Macro-F1. This paradigm also enables novel activity understanding capabilities such as complex question-answering over long time horizons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ActivityNarrated，一种基于开放叙事范式的可穿戴人体活动理解方法，将密集传感器信号转化为自然语言描述。方法通过3阶段架构将IMU信号离散化为运动令牌，结合冻结小语言模型生成开放词汇活动描述。在基准测试上，该方法在时序定位、描述质量、鲁棒性等方面表现良好，并在下游分类任务中以Macro-F1指标超越现有最优HAR模型3.8%-31.6%。
Motivation: 现有可穿戴活动识别多基于固定窗口的封闭集分类，难以适应实际生活中开放、个性化、时长可变且具有组合性的活动。
Method: 提出ActivityNarrated范式，包含密集传感器信号描述基准协议；并构建ActNarrator架构，将连续IMU信号离散化为可复用运动令牌，通过冻结小语言模型生成开放词汇活动描述。
Result: ActNarrator在下游分类任务中Macro-F1指标超出最优HAR模型3.8%-31.6%，并支持长时域复杂问答等新型理解任务。
Conclusion: 该范式将传感器活动理解转化为基于文本的推理，展现了良好的适应性和鲁棒性，但摘要未明确提及其局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: E-TIDE: Fast, Structure-Preserving Motion Forecasting from Event Sequences
papers.abstract_en: Event-based cameras capture visual information as asynchronous streams of per-pixel brightness changes, generating sparse, temporally precise data. Compared to conventional frame-based sensors, they offer significant advantages in capturing high-speed dynamics while consuming substantially less power. Predicting future event representations from past observations is an important problem, enabling downstream tasks such as future semantic segmentation or object tracking without requiring access to future sensor measurements. While recent state-of-the-art approaches achieve strong performance, they often rely on computationally heavy backbones and, in some cases, large-scale pretraining, limiting their applicability in resource-constrained scenarios. In this work, we introduce E-TIDE, a lightweight, end-to-end trainable architecture for event-tensor prediction that is designed to operate efficiently without large-scale pretraining. Our approach employs the TIDE module (Temporal Interaction for Dynamic Events), motivated by efficient spatiotemporal interaction design for sparse event tensors, to capture temporal dependencies via large-kernel mixing and activity-aware gating while maintaining low computational complexity. Experiments on standard event-based datasets demonstrate that our method achieves competitive performance with significantly reduced model size and training requirements, making it well-suited for real-time deployment under tight latency and memory budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出E-TIDE，一种轻量级、端到端可训练的架构，用于从事件序列预测未来事件表示。它采用TIDE模块（大核混合和活动感知门控）高效捕获时空依赖，无需大规模预训练，在标准数据集上以更小的模型尺寸达到竞争性能。
Motivation: 现有事件张量预测方法依赖计算量大的骨干网络或大规模预训练，限制了在资源受限场景下的应用。
Method: 提出E-TIDE架构，核心为TIDE模块，通过大核混合和活动感知门控实现稀疏事件张量的高效时空交互，保持低计算复杂度。
Result: 在标准事件相机数据集上，E-TIDE以显著更小的模型尺寸和训练需求达到与现有方法竞争的性能。
Conclusion: E-TIDE适合在严格延迟和内存预算下进行实时部署，为事件相机预测提供轻量化方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GaussianGPT: Towards Autoregressive 3D Gaussian Scene Generation
papers.abstract_en: Most recent advances in 3D generative modeling rely on diffusion or flow-matching formulations. We instead explore a fully autoregressive alternative and introduce GaussianGPT, a transformer-based model that directly generates 3D Gaussians via next-token prediction, thus facilitating full 3D scene generation. We first compress Gaussian primitives into a discrete latent grid using a sparse 3D convolutional autoencoder with vector quantization. The resulting tokens are serialized and modeled using a causal transformer with 3D rotary positional embedding, enabling sequential generation of spatial structure and appearance. Unlike diffusion-based methods that refine scenes holistically, our formulation constructs scenes step-by-step, naturally supporting completion, outpainting, controllable sampling via temperature, and flexible generation horizons. This formulation leverages the compositional inductive biases and scalability of autoregressive modeling while operating on explicit representations compatible with modern neural rendering pipelines, positioning autoregressive transformers as a complementary paradigm for controllable and context-aware 3D generation.
papers.comment: Project page: https://nicolasvonluetzow.github.io/GaussianGPT/ - Project video: https://youtu.be/zVnMHkFzHDg - Accepted at ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GaussianGPT，一种基于自回归 Transformer 的 3D 高斯场景生成模型，通过下一个 token 预测直接生成 3D 高斯原语。使用稀疏 3D 卷积自编码器与向量量化将高斯原语压缩为离散潜在网格，序列化后利用带 3D 旋转位置编码的因果 Transformer 建模。与扩散方法不同，该方法逐步构建场景，自然支持补全、外推、温度可控采样和灵活生成范围，与显式表示兼容，可作为可控 3D 生成的互补范式。
Motivation: 当前 3D 生成模型主要依赖扩散或流匹配公式，本文探索完全自回归的替代方案，以利用自回归建模的组合归纳偏置和可扩展性，并支持更灵活的控制。
Method: 通过稀疏 3D 卷积自编码器与向量量化将 3D 高斯原语压缩为离散潜在网格，序列化后使用带 3D 旋转位置编码的因果 Transformer 进行自回归 next-token 预测，逐步生成场景的空间结构和外观。
Result: 摘要未提供定量结果，但声称该方法能生成完整的 3D 场景，并支持补全、外推、温度采样和灵活生成长度。
Conclusion: 自回归公式为可控且上下文感知的 3D 生成提供了补充范式，与显式表示兼容，可集成到现代神经渲染管线中。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Knowdit: Agentic Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection with Auditing Knowledge Summarization
papers.abstract_en: Smart contracts govern billions of dollars in decentralized finance (DeFi), yet automated vulnerability detection remains challenging because many vulnerabilities are tightly coupled with project-specific business logic. We observe that recurring vulnerabilities across diverse DeFi business models often share the same underlying economic mechanisms, which we term DeFi semantics, and that capturing these shared abstractions can enable more systematic auditing. Building on this insight, we propose Knowdit, a knowledge-driven, agentic workflow for smart contract vulnerability detection. Knowdit first constructs an auditing knowledge graph from historical human audit reports, linking fine-grained DeFi semantics with recurring vulnerability patterns. Given a new project, a multi-agent pipeline leverages this knowledge through an iterative loop of specification generation, Proof-of-Concept (PoC) synthesis, PoC execution, and finding reflection, driven by a shared repository index. We evaluate Knowdit on 11 recent Code4rena projects with 84 ground-truth vulnerabilities. Knowdit detects all 21 high-severity and 90% of medium-severity vulnerabilities without false positives, fully covering eight projects, significantly outperforming all baselines. Applied to seven real-world projects, Knowdit further discovers 9 high- and 36 medium-severity previously unknown vulnerabilities, securing millions in liquidity and proving its outstanding performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Knowdit 是一种基于知识的智能合约漏洞检测智能体工作流。它利用从历史审计报告构建的审计知识图谱，将 DeFi 语义与漏洞模式关联，通过多智能体流水线迭代生成规范、合成并在执行后反思 PoC，从而检测与业务逻辑耦合的漏洞。在 11 个 Code4rena 项目上，Knowdit 检测到所有 21 个高严重性漏洞和 90% 的中等严重性漏洞，无假阳性，并在真实项目中发现了 9 个高和 36 个中严重性的未知漏洞。
Motivation: 现有自动化漏洞检测方法难以处理与项目特定业务逻辑紧密耦合的漏洞，而不同 DeFi 业务模型中的重复漏洞常共享相同的底层经济机制（DeFi 语义），捕捉这些抽象有助于更系统的审计。
Method: Knowdit 首先从历史人工审计报告中构建审计知识图谱，连接细粒度 DeFi 语义与重复漏洞模式。对于新项目，多智能体流水线通过共享仓库索引迭代执行规范生成、PoC 合成、PoC 执行和结果反思。
Result: 在 11 个 Code4rena 项目的 84 个真实漏洞上，Knowdit 检测到所有 21 个高严重性漏洞和 90% 的中等严重性漏洞（无假阳性），完全覆盖 8 个项目，显著优于所有基线。在 7 个真实项目中额外发现 9 个高和 36 个中严重性的先前未知漏洞。
Conclusion: Knowdit 证明了知识驱动的智能体工作流在检测与业务逻辑相关的智能合约漏洞方面的有效性，能够发现真实世界中的未知漏洞并保护大量流动性。

summary_sections.result: 在 11 个 Code4rena 项目的 84 个真实漏洞上，Knowdit 检测到所有 21 个高严重性漏洞和 90% 的中等严重性漏洞（无假阳性），完全覆盖 8 个项目，显著优于所有基线。在 7 个真实项目中额外发现 9 个高和 36 个中严重性的先前未知漏洞。
summary_sections.conclusion: Knowdit 证明了知识驱动的智能体工作流在检测与业务逻辑相关的智能合约漏洞方面的有效性，能够发现真实世界中的未知漏洞并保护大量流动性。

papers.title: Planning over MAPF Agent Dependencies via Multi-Dependency PIBT
papers.abstract_en: Modern Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) algorithms must plan for hundreds to thousands of agents in congested environments within a second, requiring highly efficient algorithms. Priority Inheritance with Backtracking (PIBT) is a popular algorithm capable of effectively planning in such situations. However, PIBT, and its variants like Enhanced PIBT (EPIBT), is constrained by its rule-based planning procedure and lacks generality because it restricts its search to paths that collide with at most one other agent. In this paper, we describe a new perspective on solving MAPF by planning over agent dependencies. Taking inspiration from PIBT's priority inheritance logic, we define the concept of agent dependencies and propose Multi-Dependency PIBT (MD-PIBT) that searches over agent dependencies. MD-PIBT is a general framework where specific parameterizations can reproduce PIBT and EPIBT. At the same time, alternative configurations generalize PIBT and EPIBT to multi-step planning capable of reasoning paths that collide with more than one other agent. Our experiments demonstrate that MD-PIBT effectively plans for as many as 10,000 homogeneous agents under various kinodynamic constraints, including pebble motion, rotation motion, and differential drive robots with speed and acceleration limits. We perform thorough evaluations on different variants of MAPF and find that MD-PIBT is particularly effective in MAPF with large agents. Our code is available at https://github.com/lunjohnzhang/MD-PIBT.
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的多智能体路径规划（MAPF）算法MD-PIBT，基于智能体依赖关系搜索，扩展了PIBT和EPIBT的能力，支持多步规划和与多个其他智能体碰撞的路径推理。实验表明该方法可有效规划多达10,000个同质智能体，并在多种运动约束下表现良好。
Motivation: 现有PIBT及其变体受限于规则规划过程，只考虑最多与一个智能体碰撞的路径，缺乏泛化性，无法高效处理拥挤环境中的大规模MAPF问题。
Method: 定义智能体依赖关系概念，并基于PIBT的优先级继承逻辑提出MD-PIBT框架，通过对依赖关系进行搜索并允许不同参数化，可复现PIBT和EPIBT，同时泛化到多步规划。
Result: 在多种运动约束（如卵石运动、旋转运动、差分驱动机器人速度加速度限制）下，MD-PIBT有效规划多达10,000个同质智能体，尤其在大型智能体MAPF中表现突出。
Conclusion: MD-PIBT提供了一种通用框架，通过搜索依赖关系提升PIBT的规划能力，代码已开源。

papers.title: FCL-COD: Weakly Supervised Camouflaged Object Detection with Frequency-aware and Contrastive Learning
papers.abstract_en: Existing camouflage object detection (COD) methods typically rely on fully-supervised learning guided by mask annotations. However, obtaining mask annotations is time-consuming and labor-intensive. Compared to fully-supervised methods, existing weakly-supervised COD methods exhibit significantly poorer performance. Even for the Segment Anything Model (SAM), there are still challenges in handling weakly-supervised camouflage object detection (WSCOD), such as: a. non-camouflage target responses, b. local responses, c. extreme responses, and d. lack of refined boundary awareness, which leads to unsatisfactory results in camouflage scenes. To alleviate these issues, we propose a frequency-aware and contrastive learning-based WSCOD framework in this paper, named FCL-COD. To mitigate the problem of non-camouflaged object responses, we propose the Frequency-aware Low-rank Adaptation (FoRA) method, which incorporates frequency-aware camouflage scene knowledge into SAM. To overcome the challenges of local and extreme responses, we introduce a gradient-aware contrastive learning approach that effectively delineates precise foreground-background boundaries. Additionally, to address the lack of refined boundary perception, we present a multi-scale frequency-aware representation learning strategy that facilitates the modeling of more refined boundaries. We validate the effectiveness of our approach through extensive empirical experiments on three widely recognized COD benchmarks. The results confirm that our method surpasses both state-of-the-art weakly supervised and even fully supervised techniques.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对弱监督伪装目标检测（WSCOD）中SAM存在的非伪装响应、局部响应、极端响应和边界模糊等问题，提出频率感知与对比学习框架FCL-COD。通过频率感知低秩适配（FoRA）将伪装场景知识融入SAM，利用梯度感知对比学习区分前景背景，并采用多尺度频率感知表示学习提升边界精细度。在三个标准COD基准上，该方法超越了现有最先进的弱监督及全监督方法。
Motivation: 弱监督COD性能远低于全监督方法，且SAM在处理伪装场景时存在非伪装响应、局部响应、极端响应和缺乏边界感知等问题，限制了其应用效果。
Method: 提出FCL-COD框架，包含三个组件：1) 频率感知低秩适配（FoRA）将伪装场景频率知识注入SAM；2) 梯度感知对比学习以明确前景-背景边界；3) 多尺度频率感知表示学习用于建模更精细的边界。
Result: 在三个广泛使用的COD基准数据集上，该方法在弱监督设置下优于现有最先进方法，甚至超过了全监督方法。
Conclusion: 通过频率感知和对比学习策略，有效解决了SAM在弱监督伪装目标检测中的关键缺陷，为弱监督COD提供了新的性能上限。

papers.title: Dress-ED: Instruction-Guided Editing for Virtual Try-On and Try-Off
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Virtual Try-On (VTON) and Virtual Try-Off (VTOFF) have greatly improved photo-realistic fashion synthesis and garment reconstruction. However, existing datasets remain static, lacking instruction-driven editing for controllable and interactive fashion generation. In this work, we introduce the Dress Editing Dataset (Dress-ED), the first large-scale benchmark that unifies VTON, VTOFF, and text-guided garment editing within a single framework. Each sample in Dress-ED includes an in-shop garment image, the corresponding person image wearing the garment, their edited counterparts, and a natural-language instruction of the desired modification. Built through a fully automated multimodal pipeline that integrates MLLM-based garment understanding, diffusion-based editing, and LLM-guided verification, Dress-ED comprises over 146k verified quadruplets spanning three garment categories and seven edit types, including both appearance (e.g., color, pattern, material) and structural (e.g., sleeve length, neckline) modifications. Based on this benchmark, we further propose a unified multimodal diffusion framework that jointly reasons over linguistic instructions and visual garment cues, serving as a strong baseline for instruction-driven VTON and VTOFF. Dataset and code available at this link: https://github.com/aimagelab/Dress-ED
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. Project page at https://aimagelab.github.io/Dress-ED/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dress-ED 数据集，首个将虚拟试穿（VTON）、虚拟脱卸（VTOFF）和文本引导的服装编辑统一的大规模基准。数据集包含超过14.6万个经过验证的四元组（店内服装图像、穿着该服装的人物图像、编辑后的对应图像、自然语言修改指令），涵盖三种服装类别和七种编辑类型。基于该数据集，作者进一步提出统一的多模态扩散框架作为指令驱动 VTON 和 VTOFF 的强基线。
Motivation: 现有虚拟试穿/脱卸数据集是静态的，缺乏指令驱动的编辑能力，无法支持可控和交互式时尚生成。
Method: 通过全自动多模态流水线构建数据集，集成多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的服装理解、扩散模型驱动的编辑以及 LLM 引导的验证；提出统一的多模态扩散框架，联合推理语言指令和视觉服装线索。
Result: Dress-ED 数据集包含超过 146k 个经过验证的四元组，覆盖三类服装和七种编辑类型（外观和结构）。提供的基线框架在指令驱动 VTON 和 VTOFF 上表现出色。
Conclusion: Dress-ED 为指令驱动的时尚编辑提供了统一基准，所提出的多模态扩散框架可作为后续研究的强基线。数据集和代码已开源。

papers.title: A Two-stage Transformer Framework for Temporal Localization of Distracted Driver Behaviors
papers.abstract_en: The identification of hazardous driving behaviors from in-cabin video streams is essential for enhancing road safety and supporting the detection of traffic violations and unsafe driver actions. However, current temporal action localization techniques often struggle to balance accuracy with computational efficiency. In this work, we develop and evaluate a temporal action localization framework tailored for driver monitoring scenarios, particularly suitable for periodic inspection settings such as transportation safety checkpoints or fleet management assessment systems. Our approach follows a two-stage pipeline that combines VideoMAE-based feature extraction with an Augmented Self-Mask Attention (AMA) detector, enhanced by a Spatial Pyramid Pooling-Fast (SPPF) module to capture multi-scale temporal features. Experimental results reveal a distinct trade-off between model capacity and efficiency. At the feature extraction stage, the ViT-Giant backbone delivers higher representations with 88.09% Top-1 test accuracy, while the ViT-based variant proves to be a practical alternative, achieving 82.55% accuracy with significantly lower computational fine-tuning costs (101.85 GFLOPs/segment compared to 1584.06 GFLOPs/segment for Giant). In the downstream localization task, the integration of SPPF consistently improves performance across all configurations. Notably, the ViT-Giant + SPPF model achieves a peak mAP of 92.67%, while the lightweight ViT-based configuration maintains robust results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个两阶段Transformer框架用于驾驶员分心行为的时间定位，使用VideoMAE提取特征，结合增强自掩码注意力检测器（Augmented Self-Mask Attention），并引入空间金字塔池化快速模块（SPPF）捕获多尺度时间特征。实验表明模型容量与效率存在权衡：ViT-Giant骨干在特征提取阶段达到88.09% Top-1准确率，但计算成本较高（1584.06 GFLOPs/segment），而轻量级ViT变体以101.85 GFLOPs/segment实现82.55%准确率。在定位任务中，ViT-Giant+SPPF达到92.67%的平均精度（mAP）。
Motivation: 现有时间动作定位方法在驾驶员监控场景中难以平衡准确率与计算效率，尤其适用于交通安全检查或车队管理等周期性检查场景。
Method: 采用两阶段流水线：第一阶段用VideoMAE进行特征提取（可选择ViT-Giant或ViT变体），第二阶段利用增强自掩码注意力（AMA）检测器进行定位，并通过SPPF模块增强多尺度时间特征表示。
Result: ViT-Giant骨干达到88.09% Top-1准确率（1584.06 GFLOPs/segment）；ViT变体达到82.55%准确率（101.85 GFLOPs/segment）。下游定位任务中，ViT-Giant+SPPF取得92.67% mAP，SPPF模块一致提升性能。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了特征提取阶段模型容量与计算效率的显著权衡，SPPF模块可有效提升定位性能，轻量级配置在保持鲁棒结果的同时大幅降低计算开销。

papers.title: Goal-oriented learning of stochastic differential equations using error bounds on path-space observables
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic differential equations (SDEs), which serve as the governing equations for dynamical systems in a broad range of applications, can become cost-prohibitive for numerical simulation at scales necessary for quantifying key properties. Surrogate models of the drift function of an SDE, learned from data of the high-fidelity system, are routinely used to increase the efficiency of simulation and prediction of properties. However, standard choices of loss function for learning the surrogate model fail to provide error guarantees in certain path-dependent observables, such as transition times. This paper introduces an error bound for path-space observables and employs it as a novel variational loss for the goal-oriented learning of the drift function of a SDE. We show the error bound holds for a broad class of observables, including mean first hitting times on unbounded time domains. We derive an analytical gradient of the goal-oriented loss by leveraging the formula for Fréchet derivatives of expected path functionals, which remains tractable for implementation in stochastic gradient descent schemes. We demonstrate that surrogate models of overdamped Langevin systems developed via goal-oriented learning achieve improved accuracy in predicting the statistics of a first hitting time observable and robustness to distributional shift in the data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对随机微分方程（SDE）的替代模型学习问题，提出了一种基于路径空间可观测量误差界的目标导向损失函数。作者证明该误差界适用于包括无界时间域上的首次击中时间均值在内的广泛可观测量，并利用期望路径泛函的Fréchet导数推导了损失的解析梯度。在过阻尼Langevin系统上的实验表明，该方法提高了首次击中时间统计预测的准确性，并增强了模型对数据分布偏移的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有替代模型学习使用标准损失函数（如MSE）无法为路径依赖可观测量（如过渡时间）提供误差保证，这限制了在高保真模拟中关键属性的高效量化。
Method: 引入路径空间可观测量的误差界，并将其作为变分损失函数来学习SDE的漂移函数。利用期望路径泛函的Fréchet导数公式导出目标梯度，适用于随机梯度下降。
Result: 在过阻尼Langevin系统的实验中，目标导向学习方法在预测首次击中时间统计量方面取得了更高的精度，并对数据分布偏移更具鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该方法为路径空间可观测量提供了误差保证的替代模型学习框架，适用于需要准确预测路径相关统计量的应用场景。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在过阻尼Langevin系统的实验中，目标导向学习方法在预测首次击中时间统计量方面取得了更高的精度，并对数据分布偏移更具鲁棒性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法为路径空间可观测量提供了误差保证的替代模型学习框架，适用于需要准确预测路径相关统计量的应用场景。

papers.title: Revisiting Autoregressive Models for Generative Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Class-conditional generative models have emerged as accurate and robust classifiers, with diffusion models demonstrating clear advantages over other visual generative paradigms, including autoregressive (AR) models. In this work, we revisit visual AR-based generative classifiers and identify an important limitation of prior approaches: their reliance on a fixed token order, which imposes a restrictive inductive bias for image understanding. We observe that single-order predictions rely more on partial discriminative cues, while averaging over multiple token orders provides a more comprehensive signal. Based on this insight, we leverage recent any-order AR models to estimate order-marginalized predictions, unlocking the high classification potential of AR models. Our approach consistently outperforms diffusion-based classifiers across diverse image classification benchmarks, while being up to 25x more efficient. Compared to state-of-the-art self-supervised discriminative models, our method delivers competitive classification performance - a notable achievement for generative classifiers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视了基于自回归（AR）模型的生成式图像分类器，指出先前方法依赖固定token顺序的局限性，并利用任意顺序AR模型估计顺序边缘化预测。在多个图像分类基准上，该方法一致地优于扩散模型分类器，同时效率高达25倍，并与最先进的自监督判别模型性能相当。
Motivation: 现有视觉AR生成式分类器依赖固定token顺序，引入了限制性的归纳偏置，导致预测仅依赖部分判别线索。
Method: 本文利用任意顺序AR模型，通过对多个token顺序的预测进行边缘化，获得更全面的分类信号。
Result: 在多个图像分类基准上，该方法一致地优于扩散模型分类器，且推理效率提高多达25倍；与最先进的自监督判别模型相比，取得了有竞争力的分类性能。
Conclusion: 顺序边缘化预测能够释放AR模型在高分类潜力上的能力，使生成式分类器在效率和性能上均具有竞争力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FUMO: Prior-Modulated Diffusion for Single Image Reflection Removal
papers.abstract_en: Single image reflection removal (SIRR) is challenging in real scenes, where reflection strength varies spatially and reflection patterns are tightly entangled with transmission structures. This paper presents a diffusion model with prior modulation framework (FUMO) that introduces explicit priors for spatially adaptive conditioning and structurally faithful restoration. Two priors are extracted directly from the mixed image, an intensity prior that estimates spatial reflection severity and a high-frequency prior that captures detail-sensitive responses via multi-scale residual aggregation. We propose a coarse-to-fine training paradigm. In the first stage, these cues are combined to gate the conditional residual injections, focusing the conditioning on regions that are both reflection-dominant and structure-sensitive. In the second stage, a fine-grained refinement network corrects local misalignment and sharpens fine details in the image space. Experiments conducted on both standard benchmarks and challenging images in the wild demonstrate competitive quantitative results and consistently improved perceptual quality. The code is released at https://github.com/Lucious-Desmon/FUMO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FUMO，一种基于扩散模型的先验调制框架，用于单图像反射去除。方法从混合图像中提取强度先验和高频先验，通过粗到细的训练范式：第一阶段用先验门控条件残差注入，第二阶段精炼网络改善局部对齐和细节。在标准基准和野外图像上取得竞争性定量结果和更好的感知质量。
Motivation: 单图像反射去除中反射强度空间变化且与透射结构纠缠，现有方法难以处理。
Method: 提出先验调制扩散模型，提取强度先验（估计反射严重程度）和高频先验（多尺度残差聚合捕捉细节敏感响应），采用两阶段训练：第一阶段门控条件残差注入聚焦反射主导和结构敏感区域；第二阶段精炼网络修正局部错位并锐化细节。
Result: 在标准基准和挑战性野外图像上取得竞争性定量结果和一致更好的感知质量。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确强调局限，但方法通过先验调制和粗到细训练有效提升反射去除性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SegFly: A Dataset and 2D-3D-2D Paradigm for Aerial RGB-Thermal Semantic Segmentation at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Semantic segmentation for uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs) is fundamental for aerial scene understanding, yet existing RGB and RGB-T datasets remain limited in scale, diversity, and annotation efficiency due to the high cost of manual labeling and the difficulties of accurate RGB-T alignment on off-the-shelf UAVs. To address these challenges, we propose a scalable geometry-driven 2D-3D-2D paradigm that leverages multi-view redundancy in high-overlap aerial imagery to automatically propagate labels from a small subset of manually annotated RGB images to both RGB and thermal modalities within a unified framework. By lifting less than 3% of RGB images into a semantic 3D point cloud and rendering it into all views, our approach enables dense pseudo ground-truth generation across large image collections, automatically producing 97% of RGB labels and 100% of thermal labels while achieving 91% and 88% annotation accuracy without any 2D manual refinement. We further extend this 2D-3D-2D paradigm to cross-modal image registration, using 3D geometry as an intermediate alignment space to obtain fully automatic, strong pixel-level RGB-T alignment with 87% registration accuracy and no hardware-level synchronization. Applying our framework to existing geo-referenced aerial imagery, we construct SegFly, a large-scale benchmark with over 20,000 high-resolution RGB images and more than 15,000 geometrically aligned RGB-T pairs spanning diverse urban, industrial, and rural environments across multiple altitudes and seasons. On SegFly, we establish the Firefly baseline for RGB and thermal semantic segmentation and show that both conventional architectures and vision foundation models benefit substantially from SegFly supervision, highlighting the potential of geometry-driven 2D-3D-2D pipelines for scalable multi-modal aerial scene understanding. Data and Code available at https://github.com/markus-42/SegFly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于几何驱动的2D-3D-2D范式，利用高重叠航拍图像的多视图冗余，从少量手动标注的RGB图像自动生成大规模RGB和热红外语义分割标签，并构建了包含超过2万张高分辨率RGB图像和1.5万对齐RGB-热红外对的SegFly基准数据集。实验表明，该范式能自动生成97%的RGB标签和100%的热红外标签，标注准确率分别达到91%和88%，且无需2D人工精修；跨模态配准准确率达87%。在SegFly上建立的Firefly基线显示，传统架构和视觉基础模型均受益于该数据集监督。
Motivation: 现有RGB和RGB-热红外无人机航拍数据集规模小、多样性不足，且标注成本高、RGB-热红外对齐困难。
Method: 提出几何驱动的2D-3D-2D范式：将少于3%的RGB图像提升为语义3D点云，然后渲染到所有视图，自动生成稠密伪标签；并利用3D几何作为中间对齐空间实现自动像素级RGB-热红外配准。
Result: 仅需手动标注3%的RGB图像，即可自动生成97%的RGB标签和100%的热红外标签，标注准确率分别为91%和88%；跨模态配准准确率87%。构建的SegFly数据集包含20,000+ RGB图像和15,000+对齐RGB-热红外对。
Conclusion: 几何驱动的2D-3D-2D管线可高效构建大规模多模态航拍语义分割基准，其监督信号能有效提升传统架构和视觉基础模型性能。

papers.title: SocialOmni: Benchmarking Audio-Visual Social Interactivity in Omni Models
papers.abstract_en: Omni-modal large language models (OLMs) redefine human-machine interaction by natively integrating audio, vision, and text. However, existing OLM benchmarks remain anchored to static, accuracy-centric tasks, leaving a critical gap in assessing social interactivity, the fundamental capacity to navigate dynamic cues in natural dialogues. To this end, we propose SocialOmni, a comprehensive benchmark that operationalizes the evaluation of this conversational interactivity across three core dimensions: (i) speaker separation and identification (who is speaking), (ii) interruption timing control (when to interject), and (iii) natural interruption generation (how to phrase the interruption). SocialOmni features 2,000 perception samples and a quality-controlled diagnostic set of 209 interaction-generation instances with strict temporal and contextual constraints, complemented by controlled audio-visual inconsistency scenarios to test model robustness. We benchmarked 12 leading OLMs, which uncovers significant variance in their social-interaction capabilities across models. Furthermore, our analysis reveals a pronounced decoupling between a model's perceptual accuracy and its ability to generate contextually appropriate interruptions, indicating that understanding-centric metrics alone are insufficient to characterize conversational social competence. More encouragingly, these diagnostics from SocialOmni yield actionable signals for bridging the perception-interaction divide in future OLMs.
papers.comment: Code is available at https://github.com/MAC-AutoML/SocialOmni and dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/alexisty/SocialOmni
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出SocialOmni基准，用于评估全模态大语言模型（OLMs）在音频-视觉社会交互能力，包括说话人分离、打断时机控制和自然打断生成。对12个OLMs进行基准测试，发现感知准确性与上下文适当的打断生成之间存在脱节。
Motivation: 现有OLM基准专注于静态准确率任务，缺乏评估社会交互能力，尤其是在自然对话中处理动态线索的能力。
Method: 提出SocialOmni基准，包含2000个感知样本和209个交互生成诊断实例，以及音频-视觉不一致场景以测试鲁棒性。
Result: 对12个领先OLMs的评估显示模型间社会交互能力差异显著，且感知准确性与生成恰当打断的能力之间存在脱节。
Conclusion: 摘要指出仅靠理解中心度量不足以表征对话社会能力，SocialOmni可提供弥合感知-交互鸿沟的可行信号。

papers.title: Deep Learning-Driven Black-Box Doherty Power Amplifier with Pixelated Output Combiner and Extended Efficiency Range
papers.abstract_en: This article presents a deep learning-driven inverse design methodology for Doherty power amplifiers (PA) with multi-port pixelated output combiner networks. A deep convolutional neural network (CNN) is developed and trained as an electromagnetic (EM) surrogate model to accurately and rapidly predict the S-parameters of pixelated passive networks. By leveraging the CNN-based surrogate model within a blackbox Doherty framework and a genetic algorithm (GA)-based optimizer, we effectively synthesize complex Doherty combiners that enable an extended back-off efficiency range using fully symmetrical devices. As a proof of concept, we designed and fabricated two Doherty PA prototypes incorporating three-port pixelated combiners, implemented with GaN HEMT transistors. In measurements, both prototypes demonstrate a maximum drain efficiency exceeding 74% and deliver an output power surpassing 44.1 dBm at 2.75 GHz. Furthermore, a measured drain efficiency above 52% is maintained at the 9-dB back-off power level for both prototypes at the same frequency. To evaluate linearity and efficiency under realistic signal conditions, both prototypes are tested using a 20-MHz 5G new radio (NR)-like waveform exhibiting a peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) of 9.0 dB. After applying digital predistortion (DPD), each design achieves an average power added efficiency (PAE) above 51%, while maintaining an adjacent channel leakage ratio (ACLR) better than -60.8 dBc.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种深度学习驱动的逆设计方法，用于Doherty功率放大器（PA）的多端口像素化输出组合器。开发了深度卷积神经网络（CNN）作为电磁（EM）代理模型，快速预测像素化无源网络的S参数。结合基于CNN的代理模型和遗传算法（GA）优化器，有效综合复杂Doherty组合器，使用完全对称器件实现扩展的回退效率范围。制造了两个采用GaN HEMT晶体管的三端口像素化组合器原型，测量显示在2.75 GHz下最大漏极效率超过74%，输出功率超过44.1 dBm，在9-dB回退功率水平下效率仍高于52%。在20-MHz 5G NR类波形测试中，经数字预失真（DPD）后平均功率附加效率（PAE）超过51%，邻道泄漏比（ACLR）优于-60.8 dBc。
Motivation: 传统Doherty功率放大器设计依赖于经验法则和反复电磁仿真，耗时且难以实现宽回退效率范围，尤其是使用对称器件时。
Method: 提出深度学习驱动的逆设计：训练CNN作为电磁代理模型，用于快速准确预测像素化组合器网络的S参数；将其嵌入黑箱Doherty框架，并通过遗传算法优化组合器拓扑，实现扩展效率范围。
Result: 两个原型在2.75 GHz下最大漏极效率>74%，输出功率>44.1 dBm；9-dB回退下效率>52%；20-MHz 5G NR波形下，经DPD后平均PAE>51%，ACLR<-60.8 dBc。
Conclusion: 该方法能高效合成复杂Doherty组合器，利用对称器件扩展回退效率范围，实验结果验证了其有效性和线性度。

papers.title: IRIS: A Real-World Benchmark for Inverse Recovery and Identification of Physical Dynamic Systems from Monocular Video
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised physical parameter estimation from video lacks a common benchmark: existing methods evaluate on non-overlapping synthetic data, the sole real-world dataset is restricted to single-body systems, and no established protocol addresses governing-equation identification. This work introduces IRIS, a high-fidelity benchmark comprising 240 real-world videos captured at 4K resolution and 60fps, spanning both single- and multi-body dynamics with independently measured ground-truth parameters and uncertainty estimates. Each dynamical system is recorded under controlled laboratory conditions and paired with its governing equations, enabling principled evaluation. A standardized evaluation protocol is defined encompassing parameter accuracy, identifiability, extrapolation, robustness, and governing-equation selection. Multiple baselines are evaluated, including a multi-step physics loss formulation and four complementary equation-identification strategies (VLM temporal reasoning, describe-then-classify prompting, CNN-based classification, and path-based labelling), establishing reference performance across all IRIS scenarios and exposing systematic failure modes that motivate future research. The dataset, annotations, evaluation toolkit, and all baseline implementations are publicly released.

papers.title: Interact3D: Compositional 3D Generation of Interactive Objects
papers.abstract_en: Recent breakthroughs in 3D generation have enabled the synthesis of high-fidelity individual assets. However, generating 3D compositional objects from single images--particularly under occlusions--remains challenging. Existing methods often degrade geometric details in hidden regions and fail to preserve the underlying object-object spatial relationships (OOR). We present a novel framework Interact3D designed to generate physically plausible interacting 3D compositional objects. Our approach first leverages advanced generative priors to curate high-quality individual assets with a unified 3D guidance scene. To physically compose these assets, we then introduce a robust two-stage composition pipeline. Based on the 3D guidance scene, the primary object is anchored through precise global-to-local geometric alignment (registration), while subsequent geometries are integrated using a differentiable Signed Distance Field (SDF)-based optimization that explicitly penalizes geometry intersections. To reduce challenging collisions, we further deploy a closed-loop, agentic refinement strategy. A Vision-Language Model (VLM) autonomously analyzes multi-view renderings of the composed scene, formulates targeted corrective prompts, and guides an image editing module to iteratively self-correct the generation pipeline. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Interact3D successfully produces promising collsion-aware compositions with improved geometric fidelity and consistent spatial relationships.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Interact3D 框架，用于从单张图像生成物理上合理的交互式3D组合对象。方法利用生成先验构建高质量独立资产，并通过两阶段组合管道（全局到局部的几何对齐和基于可微有符号距离场（SDF）的优化）避免几何交叉，再结合闭环代理优化（VLM 分析多视图渲染并引导图像编辑模块迭代自校正）。实验表明该方法能生成碰撞感知的组合，并提升几何保真度和空间关系一致性。
Motivation: 现有3D生成方法难以处理遮挡下的多对象组合场景，常常丢失隐藏区域的几何细节并破坏对象之间的空间关系（OOR）。
Method: 首先利用生成先验统一3D引导场景；然后采用两阶段组合：第一阶段通过全局到局部的几何配准确定主要对象位置，第二阶段使用可微SDF优化显式惩罚几何交叉；最后引入闭环代理优化，VLM自动分析多视图渲染，生成校正提示并驱动图像编辑模块迭代修正。
Result: 实验表明 Interact3D 能产生碰撞感知的组合结果，并具有更好的几何保真度和一致的空间关系。
Conclusion: 该框架为从单图生成交互式3D组合对象提供了有效途径，但摘要未明确局限性或泛化边界。
