papers.title: SpatialMosaic: A Multiview VLM Dataset for Partial Visibility
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has enabled 3D scene understanding and spatial reasoning directly from multi-view images, without requiring explicit 3D reconstructions. Nevertheless, key challenges that frequently arise in real-world environments, such as partial visibility, occlusion, and low-overlap conditions that require reasoning from fragmented visual cues, remain under-explored. To address these limitations, we propose a scalable multi-view data generation and annotation pipeline that constructs realistic spatial reasoning QAs, resulting in SpatialMosaic, a comprehensive instruction-tuning dataset with 2M QA pairs. We further introduce SpatialMosaic-Bench, a challenging benchmark for evaluating multi-view spatial reasoning under complex and diverse scenarios, consisting of 1M QA pairs across 11 tasks with both multiple-choice and numerical-answer formats. Our dataset spans both indoor and outdoor scenes, enabling comprehensive evaluation across diverse real-world scenarios. In addition, we provide a practical baseline for multi-view settings by integrating geometry encoders into VLMs for improved cross-view consistency and spatial grounding. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our dataset effectively enhances spatial reasoning under challenging multi-view conditions, validating the effectiveness of our data generation pipeline in constructing realistic and challenging QAs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多视角条件下部分可见性、遮挡和低重叠等现实挑战，提出一个可扩展的多视角数据生成与标注管道，构建了包含200万问答对的空间推理指令调优数据集SpatialMosaic，以及包含100万问答对、覆盖11个任务的基准SpatialMosaic-Bench。实验表明该数据集能有效提升多视角空间推理能力。
Motivation: 现有MLLMs在多视角3D场景理解中忽视了部分可见性、遮挡和低重叠等实际场景中的关键挑战，缺乏相关数据集和基准。
Method: 提出可扩展的多视角数据生成与标注管道，生成真实的空间推理问答对；并将几何编码器集成到VLM中作为多视角设置的基线，以改善跨视角一致性和空间定位。
Result: 构建了包含200万QA对的SpatialMosaic数据集和100万QA对的SpatialMosaic-Bench基准，涵盖11个任务；实验验证了数据集对提升多视角空间推理的有效性。
Conclusion: 论文强调其数据生成管道能构造真实且具有挑战性的问答，有效增强多视角条件下的空间推理能力，但未讨论在完全可见或单视角场景下的推广性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PanoGrounder: Bridging 2D and 3D with Panoramic Scene Representations for VLM-based 3D Visual Grounding
papers.abstract_en: 3D Visual Grounding (3DVG) is a critical bridge from vision-language perception to robotics, requiring both language understanding and 3D scene reasoning. Traditional supervised models leverage explicit 3D geometry but exhibit limited generalization, owing to the scarcity of 3D vision-language datasets and the limited reasoning capabilities compared to modern vision-language models (VLMs). We propose a generalizable 3DVG framework, PanoGrounder, that couples multi-modal panoramic representation with pretrained 2D VLMs for strong vision-language reasoning. Panoramic renderings, augmented with 3D semantic and geometric features, serve as an intermediate representation between 2D and 3D, and offer two major benefits: (i) they can be directly fed to VLMs with minimal adaptation and (ii) they retain long-range object-to-object relations thanks to their 360-degree field of view. We devise a three-stage pipeline that places a compact set of panoramic viewpoints considering the scene layout and geometry, grounds a text query on each panoramic rendering with a VLM, and fuses per-view predictions into a single 3D bounding box via lifting. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art results on ScanRefer and Nr3D, and demonstrates strong generalization to unseen 3D datasets and text rephrasings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PanoGrounder，一个基于全景场景表示的3D视觉定位框架，利用预训练2D VLM实现无需3D标注的强泛化能力。通过多视角全景渲染与3D语义几何特征融合，将文本查询映射为3D边界框，在ScanRefer和Nr3D上取得最优结果，并展示了对未见数据集和文本改写的良好泛化性。
Motivation: 现有3D视觉定位方法依赖显式3D几何和标注数据，泛化能力受限，且无法直接利用现代VLM的强大推理能力。
Method: 采用三阶段流水线：根据场景布局和几何放置紧凑的全景视点；通过VLM在每个全景渲染上定位文本查询；将多视角预测通过提升（lifting）融合为单个3D边界框。全景渲染融合了3D语义和几何特征，保留了360度视野下的长程目标关系。
Result: 在ScanRefer和Nr3D数据集上达到最先进结果，并在未见过的3D数据集和文本改写测试中表现强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 全景中间表示能有效桥接2D VLM与3D场景，为3D视觉定位提供可推广的范式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: End-to-End Training for Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Self-Resampling
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive video diffusion models hold promise for world simulation but are vulnerable to exposure bias arising from the train-test mismatch. While recent works address this via post-training, they typically rely on a bidirectional teacher model or discriminator. To achieve an end-to-end solution, we introduce Resampling Forcing, a teacher-free framework that enables training autoregressive video models from scratch and at scale. Central to our approach is a self-resampling scheme that simulates inference-time model errors on history frames during training. Conditioned on these degraded histories, a sparse causal mask enforces temporal causality while enabling parallel training with frame-level diffusion loss. To facilitate efficient long-horizon generation, we further introduce history routing, a parameter-free mechanism that dynamically retrieves the top-k most relevant history frames for each query. Experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves performance comparable to distillation-based baselines while exhibiting superior temporal consistency on longer videos owing to native-length training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Resampling Forcing 框架，用于端到端训练自回归视频扩散模型。通过自重采样方案在训练时模拟推理误差，使用稀疏因果掩码支持并行训练，并引入历史路由机制动态检索相关历史帧。实验表明该方法与蒸馏方法性能相当，且在长视频生成上具有更好的时间一致性。
Motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型存在暴露偏差，现有后训练方法依赖双向教师或判别器，缺乏端到端解决方案。
Method: 提出 Resampling Forcing 教师无关框架，通过自重采样模拟推理误差，结合稀疏因果掩码实现并行帧级扩散损失，并引入历史路由机制动态检索 top-k 相关历史帧。
Result: 实验性能与蒸馏基线相当，在更长视频上因原生长度训练而展现更强的时序一致性。
Conclusion: 该方法无需教师模型即可端到端训练自回归视频扩散模型，在长视频生成上具有优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GimbalDiffusion: Gravity-Aware Camera Control for Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in text-to-video generation has achieved remarkable realism, yet fine-grained control over camera motion and orientation remains elusive, especially with extreme trajectories (e.g., a 180-degree turnaround, or looking directly up or down). Existing approaches typically encode camera trajectories using relative or ambiguous representations, limiting precise geometric control and offering limited support for large rotations. We introduce GimbalDiffusion, a framework that enables camera control grounded in physical-world coordinates, using gravity as a global reference. Instead of describing motion relative to previous frames, our method defines camera trajectories in an absolute coordinate system, allowing accurate, interpretable control over camera parameters. Using panoramic 360-degree videos for training, we cover the full sphere of possible viewpoints, including combinations of extreme pitch and roll that are out-of-distribution of conventional video data. To improve camera control, we introduce null-pitch conditioning, a strategy that prevents the model from overriding camera specifications in the presence of conflicting prompt content (e.g., generating grass while the camera points toward the sky). Finally, we propose new benchmarks to evaluate gravity-aware camera-controlled video generation, assessing models' ability to generate extreme camera angles and quantify their input prompt entanglement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GimbalDiffusion，一种基于物理世界坐标的重力感知相机控制框架，用于视频生成。该方法使用重力作为全局参考，在绝对坐标系中定义相机轨迹，支持极端旋转（如 180 度翻转、向上或向下看）。通过全景 360 度视频训练覆盖全部视角，并引入空俯仰条件（null-pitch conditioning）防止模型在冲突提示下覆盖相机设置。提出了新的基准来评估重力感知视频生成中的极端相机角度和提示纠缠。
Motivation: 现有文本到视频生成方法对极端相机轨迹（如 180 度翻转、直接向上或向下看）缺乏精确控制，因为传统方法使用相对或模糊的表示，限制了几何精度和大范围旋转支持。
Method: 使用重力作为全局参考的绝对坐标系统定义相机轨迹；采用全景 360 度视频训练以覆盖完整球面视角；引入空俯仰条件（null-pitch conditioning）策略，防止模型在提示内容与相机指向冲突时（如镜头朝天却生成草地）覆盖相机设定。
Result: 实现了对极端相机角度的精确控制，并在新基准上评估了模型的极端角度生成能力和提示与相机参数的纠缠程度。
Conclusion: GimbalDiffusion 在物理世界坐标系中提供了可解释的相机控制，支持极端角度，并通过空俯仰条件减少了提示冲突。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 使用重力作为全局参考的绝对坐标系统定义相机轨迹；采用全景 360 度视频训练以覆盖完整球面视角；引入空俯仰条件（null-pitch conditioning）策略，防止模型在提示内容与相机指向冲突时（如镜头朝天却生成草地）覆盖相机设定。
summary_sections.result: 实现了对极端相机角度的精确控制，并在新基准上评估了模型的极端角度生成能力和提示与相机参数的纠缠程度。
summary_sections.conclusion: GimbalDiffusion 在物理世界坐标系中提供了可解释的相机控制，支持极端角度，并通过空俯仰条件减少了提示冲突。

papers.title: When AI Agents Compete for Jobs: Strategic Capabilities and Economic Dynamics of AI Labour Markets
papers.abstract_en: Emerging agentic marketplaces provide the economic infrastructure for matching and coordinating the large amounts of AI agents used in agentic swarms. Unlike human workers, AI agents can operate on multiple jobs simultaneously, acquire skills rapidly, and labor without wage floors. These differences introduce a new segment of $\textbf{AI labor markets}$, where AI agents interact with each other at a much higher frequency than human markets. Yet we lack frameworks to understand how such markets behave in light of economic forces that shape labor markets, such as adverse selection and reputation dynamics. To explore this, we introduce $\texttt{AI-Work}$, a tractable, simulated gig economy where Large Language Model (LLM) agents compete for jobs, develop skills, and adapt their strategies under uncertainty and competitive pressure. Our experiments examine three domains of capabilities that successful agents possess: $\textbf{metacognition}$ (accurate self-assessment of skills), $\textbf{competitive awareness}$ (modeling rivals and market dynamics), and $\textbf{long-horizon strategic planning}$. Agents with these capabilities consistently achieve higher profits, market share, and stronger adaptation than competing agents. Through $\texttt{AI-Work}$, we hope to provide a foundation to explore the microeconomic properties of AI-only labor markets, and a conceptual framework to study the strategic reasoning capabilities of participating AI agents.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026, Code available at https://github.com/chy-chiu/ai-work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过构建一个模拟的零工经济平台AI-Work，研究大型语言模型代理在AI劳动力市场中竞争、学习技能和适应策略的行为。实验表明，具备元认知（metacognition）、竞争意识（competitive awareness）和长期战略规划能力的代理能获得更高利润和市场份额。
Motivation: 现有代理市场缺乏对AI劳动力市场行为的理解框架，尤其是逆向选择和声誉动态等经济力量的影响。
Method: 提出了AI-Work模拟框架，让LLM代理在不确定性和竞争压力下竞争工作、发展技能并调整策略，重点考察三种能力。
Result: 具备元认知、竞争意识和长期战略规划的代理在利润、市场份额和适应性上 consistently 优于其他代理。
Conclusion: AI-Work为探索AI劳动力市场的微观经济特性提供了基础，并为研究参与AI代理的战略推理能力提供概念框架。

papers.title: NI-Tex: Non-isometric Image-based Garment Texture Generation
papers.abstract_en: Existing industrial 3D garment meshes already cover most real-world clothing geometries, yet their texture diversity remains limited. To acquire more realistic textures, generative methods are often used to extract Physically-based Rendering (PBR) textures and materials from large collections of wild images and project them back onto garment meshes. However, most image-conditioned texture generation approaches require strict topological consistency between the input image and the input 3D mesh, or rely on accurate mesh deformation to match to the image poses, which significantly constrains the texture generation quality and flexibility. To address the challenging problem of non-isometric image-based garment texture generation, we construct 3D Garment Videos, a physically simulated, garment-centric dataset that provides consistent geometry and material supervision across diverse deformations, enabling robust cross-pose texture learning. We further employ Nano Banana for high-quality non-isometric image editing, achieving reliable cross-topology texture generation between non-isometric image-geometry pairs. Finally, we propose an iterative baking method via uncertainty-guided view selection and reweighting that fuses multi-view predictions into seamless, production-ready PBR textures. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that our feedforward dual-branch architecture generates versatile and spatially aligned PBR materials suitable for industry-level 3D garment design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非等距图像驱动的服装纹理生成问题，构建了3D Garment Videos数据集，提出基于Nano Banana的非等距图像编辑方法和不确定性引导的多视图迭代烘焙方法，生成生产级PBR纹理。实验表明双分支网络架构可生成通用且空间对齐的PBR材质。
Motivation: 现有工业3D服装网格覆盖多数真实服装几何形状，但纹理多样性有限；基于图像的纹理生成方法大多要求输入图像与3D网格拓扑一致或依赖精确变形，限制了生成质量与灵活性。
Method: 构建了3D Garment Videos数据集提供跨形变的一致性几何与材质监督；采用Nano Banana进行非等距图像编辑实现跨拓扑纹理生成；提出基于不确定性引导视角选择与重加权的迭代烘焙方法，融合多视角预测为无缝PBR纹理。
Result: 摘要报告该方法生成的PBR纹理在工业级3D服装设计中适用，但未给出具体量化数值。
Conclusion: 本文的方法为非等距图像-网格对的纹理生成提供了可行方案，但依赖数据集和编辑工具的合理性，适用范围可能限于服装领域。

papers.title: RoadBench: Benchmarking MLLMs on Fine-Grained Spatial Understanding and Reasoning under Urban Road Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated powerful capabilities in general spatial understanding and reasoning. However, their fine-grained spatial understanding and reasoning capabilities in complex urban scenarios have not received significant attention in the fields of both research and industry. To fill this gap, we focus primarily on road markings as a typical example of fine-grained spatial elements under urban scenarios, given the essential role of the integrated road traffic network they form within cities. Around road markings and urban traffic systems, we propose \textbf{RoadBench}, a systematic benchmark that comprehensively evaluates MLLMs' fine-grained spatial understanding and reasoning capabilities using Bird's-Eye View (BEV) and First-Person View (FPV) image inputs. This benchmark comprises eight tasks consisting of 3,040 strictly manually verified test cases, constructed from 2,137 unique BEV images and 721 unique FPV images collected from five Chinese cities with relatively consistent traffic conventions. These tasks form a systematic evaluation framework that bridges understanding at local spatial scopes to global reasoning. They not only test MLLMs' capabilities in recognition, joint understanding, and reasoning but also assess their ability to integrate image information with domain knowledge. After evaluating 20 mainstream MLLMs, we confirm that RoadBench is a challenging benchmark for MLLMs while revealing significant shortcomings in existing MLLMs' fine-grained spatial understanding and reasoning capabilities within urban scenarios. In certain tasks, their performance even falls short of simple rule-based or random selection baselines. These findings, along with RoadBench itself, will contribute to the comprehensive advancement of spatial understanding capabilities for MLLMs.
papers.comment: Accepted by ECCV 2026, the code and data are publicly available at: https://github.com/tsinghua-fib-lab/RoadBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RoadBench，一个系统性的基准测试，用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在城市场景下对道路标线等细粒度空间元素的理解与推理能力。基准包含8个任务、3040个严格人工验证的测试用例，使用鸟瞰图（BEV）和第一人称视角（FPV）图像。评估20个主流MLLMs后，发现它们在细粒度空间理解方面存在显著不足，部分任务甚至不如简单规则或随机选择基线。
Motivation: 现有MLLMs在通用空间理解上表现强大，但在复杂城市场景下的细粒度空间理解与推理（例如道路标线）尚未得到充分关注，而这对研究与应用都至关重要。
Method: 构建RoadBench基准，聚焦道路标线作为典型细粒度空间元素，设计8个任务覆盖从局部到全局的空间推理，使用BEV和FPV图像输入，并从中国5个城市采集数据，确保交通规则一致性。
Result: 在20个主流MLLMs上的评估显示，RoadBench是一个具有挑战性的基准；MLLMs在细粒度空间理解上表现不佳，某些任务甚至不如规则或随机基线。
Conclusion: RoadBench揭示了现有MLLMs在城市场景下细粒度空间理解能力的不足，并为该领域提供了系统评估框架，有助于推动MLLMs空间理解能力的全面发展。

papers.title: TetraSDF: Analytic Isosurface Extraction with Multi-resolution Tetrahedral Grid
papers.abstract_en: Extracting an explicit surface that exactly matches the zero-level set of a neural signed distance function (SDF) remains challenging. Sampling-based isosurfacing methods such as Marching Cubes introduce discretization error. In contrast, continuous piecewise affine (CPWA) analytic approaches typically require plain ReLU MLPs, which limits the ability to learn high-frequency SDFs in practice. We present TetraSDF, an analytic isosurface extraction framework for SDFs that retains the expressiveness of grid-based encoders while enabling exact zero-level set extraction, by representing the SDF with a ReLU MLP composed with a multi-resolution tetrahedral positional encoder. Our positional encoder's barycentric interpolation preserves a global CPWA structure, allowing us to track ReLU linear regions within an encoder-induced polyhedral complex. We further introduce a fixed analytic input preconditioner derived from the encoder's metric to reduce directional bias, thereby stabilizing training. Across multiple benchmarks, TetraSDF matches or surpasses existing grid-based encoders in SDF reconstruction accuracy, while faithfully recovering the network's zero-level set as a triangle mesh.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TetraSDF，一种用于神经有符号距离函数 (SDF) 的解析等值面提取框架。通过将 ReLU MLP 与多分辨率四面体位置编码器结合，实现了零水平集的精确提取。编码器的重心插值保持全局连续分段仿射 (CPWA) 结构，可追踪线性区域。引入固定解析输入预处理器减少方向偏差，稳定训练。实验表明，TetraSDF 在 SDF 重建精度上匹配或超越现有网格编码器，并能忠实地将零水平集恢复为三角网格。
Motivation: 现有采样等值面方法（如 Marching Cubes）存在离散化误差；连续分段仿射 (CPWA) 解析方法通常需要简单 ReLU MLP，限制了学习高频 SDF 的能力。需要一种既能保持网格编码器表达能力，又能实现精确零水平集提取的方法。
Method: 提出 TetraSDF 框架：将 ReLU MLP 与多分辨率四面体位置编码器组合，编码器使用重心插值保持全局 CPWA 结构，从而追踪 ReLU 线性区域；引入基于编码器度量的固定解析输入预处理器，减少方向偏差以稳定训练。
Result: 在多个基准上，TetraSDF 在 SDF 重建精度上匹配或超越现有网格编码器，并能将网络零水平集精确提取为三角网格。
Conclusion: TetraSDF 实现了网格编码器表达力与解析等值面提取的结合，为神经 SDF 的表面提取提供了一种新思路。

papers.title: Unifying Convolution and Attention via Convolutional Nearest Neighbors
papers.abstract_en: Convolutional Neural Networks and Vision Transformers are the two dominant architectural families in computer vision, defined by spatially local convolution and global self-attention respectively. Despite their apparent differences, we show that both operations are special cases of a single $k$-nearest neighbor aggregation framework: convolution selects neighbors by spatial proximity while attention selects by feature similarity, placing them at two ends of a shared operational spectrum. We introduce Convolutional Nearest Neighbors (ConvNN), a unified framework that exactly recovers standard and depthwise convolution, self-attention, and sparse attention variants including KVT-attention as special cases, and exposes the design space of neighbor-selection strategies between them through configurable similarity functions, positional encodings, and aggregation kernels. We validate ConvNN on ImageNet-1K classification across two complementary architectures: a hybrid branching layer in ResNet-50 that combines local and global feature learning, improving top-1 accuracy by 3.0% over the ResNet-50 baseline, and ConvNN-attention in ViT-Base that achieves 81.64% top-1 accuracy, surpassing standard multi-head self-attention by 0.7%. Together, these results demonstrate that ConvNN provides a principled foundation for designing operations that bridge convolutional and attention-based computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出卷积最近邻（ConvNN）框架，将卷积和自注意力统一为k近邻聚合的特例：卷积按空间邻近选择邻居，注意力按特征相似度选择邻居。该框架通过配置相似度函数、位置编码和聚合核，能精确恢复标准/深度卷积、自注意力和稀疏注意力变体，并在ImageNet-1K上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 卷积神经网络和视觉Transformer是计算机视觉的两大主流架构，分别基于局部卷积和全局自注意力，但二者看似不同，缺乏统一的理论理解。
Method: 提出ConvNN框架，将两种操作视为共享k近邻聚合谱系的两端：卷积按空间邻近选择邻居，注意力按特征相似度选择邻居。通过可配置的相似度函数、位置编码和聚合核，暴露了中间的设计空间。
Result: 在ImageNet-1K上，将ConvNN作为混合分支集成到ResNet-50，top-1准确率提升3.0%；作为注意力模块用于ViT-Base，达到81.64% top-1准确率，超过标准多头自注意力0.7%。
Conclusion: ConvNN为设计桥接卷积和注意力计算的运算提供了原则性基础。

papers.title: MediRound: Multi-Round Entity-Level Reasoning Segmentation in Medical Images
papers.abstract_en: Despite notable progress in text-guided medical image segmentation nowadays, these methods are limited to single-round dialogues and fail to support multi-round reasoning, which is important for medical education scenarios. In this work, we introduce Multi-Round Entity-Level Medical Reasoning Segmentation (MEMR-Seg), a new task that requires generating segmentation masks through multi-round queries with entity-level reasoning, helping learners progressively develop their understanding of medical knowledge. To support this task, we construct MR-MedSeg, a large-scale dataset of 177K multi-round medical segmentation dialogues, featuring entity-based reasoning across rounds. Furthermore, we propose MediRound, an effective baseline model designed for multi-round medical reasoning segmentation. To mitigate the inherent error propagation within the chain-like pipeline of multi-round segmentation, we introduce a lightweight yet effective Judgment & Correction Mechanism during model inference. Experimental results demonstrate that our method effectively addresses the MEMR-Seg task and outperforms conventional medical referring segmentation methods. The project is available at https://github.com/Edisonhimself/MediRound.

TL;DR: 本文提出医学图像中多轮实体级推理分割新任务MEMR-Seg，并构建包含177K多轮对话的数据集MR-MedSeg，在此基础上提出基线模型MediRound，引入轻量级判断与纠正机制以缓解多轮链式管道中的错误传播。实验表明该方法在MEMR-Seg任务上优于传统医学参考分割方法。
Motivation: 现有医学图像分割方法仅限于单轮对话，无法支持医学教育场景中所需的多轮推理与逐步理解。
Method: 定义MEMR-Seg任务，构建大规模多轮医学分割对话数据集MR-MedSeg，提出MediRound基线模型，并在推理阶段引入判断与纠正机制来抑制错误累积。
Result: 在MEMR-Seg任务上，方法性能优于常规医学参考分割方法。
Conclusion: 本文有效解决了医学图像多轮推理分割问题，项目已开源。

papers.title: Structural Enforcement of Statistical Rigor in AI-Driven Discovery: A Functional Architecture
papers.abstract_en: AI-Scientist systems risk manufacturing spurious discoveries through uncontrolled multiple testing. We present a functional architecture that enforces statistical rigor at two levels: a Haskell embedded domain-specific language (the Research monad) that makes it impossible to test a hypothesis without updating the error budget, and a declarative scaffold, backed by an OS-level sandbox, that makes validation data physically absent from the environment in which LLM-generated code runs. We ground the design in a machine-checked Lean~4 formalization of LORD++ online false-discovery-rate (FDR) control: we derive its error budget and prove both marginal and full FDR control, then close the gap to the implementation by verifying the budget's wealth invariant over IEEE~754 arithmetic in SPARK/Ada. To our knowledge this is the first verified chain from theorem to floating-point implementation for an online FDR procedure. In simulation, the architecture holds the false discovery rate near 1\% against a 5\% target, where a naive approach reaches 41\%. In end-to-end case studies, a valid test avoids the false discoveries a flawed one produces, yet still finds real effects when the data allow. An adversarial evaluation confirms that generated code cannot read the held-out data even when given its exact path.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种在AI驱动科学发现中强制执行统计严谨性的功能架构。该架构通过Haskell领域特定语言（Research monad）确保每次假设检验都更新错误预算，并通过OS级沙箱使验证数据在物理上不可见，从而防止多重检验导致的虚假发现。作者用Lean 4形式化了LORD++在线FDR控制，并在SPARK/Ada中验证了IEEE 754算术上的预算不变性。模拟实验表明，该方法将错误发现率控制在接近1%（目标5%），而朴素方法达到41%。
Motivation: AI科学家系统因未控制的多重检验而容易产生虚假发现，现有方法缺乏从理论到实现的端到端统计严谨性保证。
Method: 架构包含两层：1）Haskell DSL（Research monad）强制每次假设检验更新错误预算；2）OS级沙箱隔离验证数据，使LLM生成代码无法访问。同时使用Lean 4形式化LORD++在线FDR控制，并在SPARK/Ada中验证其浮点实现的预算不变性。
Result: 模拟中，该方法将假发现率控制在1%（目标5%），而朴素方法达41%。端到端案例显示，有效测试避免了虚假发现，但仍能发现真实效应。对抗性评估表明，生成代码即使知道路径也无法读取留出数据。
Conclusion: 这是首个从定理到浮点实现的在线FDR程序验证链，为AI科学发现提供了可执行的统计严谨性保障。

papers.title: Evaluating Implicit Biases in LLM Reasoning through Logic Grid Puzzles
papers.abstract_en: While recent safety guardrails effectively suppress overtly biased outputs, subtler forms of social bias emerge during complex logical reasoning tasks that evade current evaluation benchmarks. To fill this gap, we introduce a new evaluation framework, PRIME (Puzzle Reasoning for Implicit Biases in Model Evaluation), that uses logic grid puzzles to systematically probe the influence of social stereotypes on logical reasoning and decision making in LLMs. Our use of logic puzzles enables automatic generation and verification, as well as variability in complexity and biased settings. PRIME includes stereotypical, anti-stereotypical, and neutral puzzle variants generated from a shared puzzle structure, allowing for controlled and fine-grained comparisons. We evaluate multiple model families across puzzle sizes and test the effectiveness of prompt-based mitigation strategies. Focusing our experiments on gender stereotypes, our findings highlight that models consistently reason more accurately when solutions align with stereotypical associations. This demonstrates the significance of PRIME for diagnosing and quantifying social biases perpetuated in the deductive reasoning of LLMs, where fairness is critical.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PRIME框架，利用逻辑网格谜题系统性地探测大型语言模型在复杂逻辑推理任务中隐含的社会偏见，特别是性别刻板印象。通过生成刻板、反刻板和中性谜题变体，实验发现模型在解决方案符合刻板关联时推理更准确。该框架可用于诊断和量化LLM演绎推理中的社会偏见。
Motivation: 现有安全护栏能抑制显性偏见，但复杂逻辑推理任务中隐性的社会偏见缺乏有效评估基准。
Method: 提出PRIME框架，基于逻辑网格谜题自动生成可验证的刻板、反刻板及中性变体，通过共享谜题结构实现精细对比，并测试提示缓解策略。
Result: 实验聚焦性别刻板印象，发现模型在解决方案符合刻板关联时推理准确率显著更高，表明隐性偏见存在于逻辑推理中。
Conclusion: PRIME框架可有效诊断和量化LLM演绎推理中的社会偏见，对公平性关键场景具有重要价值。

papers.title: CoT-X: An Adaptive Framework for Cross-Model Chain-of-Thought Transfer and Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning enhances the problem-solving ability of large language models (LLMs) but leads to substantial inference overhead, limiting deployment in resource-constrained settings. This paper investigates efficient CoT transfer across models of different scales and architectures through an adaptive reasoning summarization framework. The proposed method compresses reasoning traces via semantic segmentation with importance scoring, budget-aware dynamic compression, and coherence reconstruction, preserving critical reasoning steps while significantly reducing token usage. Experiments on 7{,}501 medical examination questions across 10 specialties show up to 40% higher accuracy than truncation under the same token budgets. Evaluations on 64 model pairs from eight LLMs (1.5B-32B parameters, including DeepSeek-R1 and Qwen3) confirm strong cross-model transferability. Furthermore, a Gaussian Process-based Bayesian optimization module reduces evaluation cost by 84% and reveals a power-law relationship between model size and cross-domain robustness. These results demonstrate that reasoning summarization provides a practical path toward efficient CoT transfer, enabling advanced reasoning under tight computational constraints. Code will be released upon publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CoT-X框架，通过自适应推理总结（语义分割、重要性评分、预算感知压缩、一致性重建）实现跨模型链式思维（CoT）的高效传输和优化，目标是减少推理开销。在7,501道医学考试题目上验证，相同token预算下比简单截断提升高达40%准确率；在8个LLM（1.5B-32B参数）的64个模型对中证实跨模型迁移性；基于高斯过程的贝叶斯优化将评估成本降低84%，并揭示模型规模与跨领域鲁棒性之间存在幂律关系。
Motivation: 大语言模型的CoT推理虽然提升能力，但带来大量推理开销，限制了资源受限环境下的部署。本文旨在解决CoT在不同规模和架构模型之间的高效传输问题。
Method: 提出自适应推理总结框架，包括语义分割与重要性评分、预算感知动态压缩、连贯性重建，从而压缩推理轨迹并保留关键步骤。额外采用高斯过程贝叶斯优化模块降低评估成本。
Result: 在医疗考试数据集上，相同token预算下准确率比截断方法高40%；64个模型对验证跨模型可迁移性；贝叶斯优化降低评估成本84%，并发现模型规模与跨领域鲁棒性的幂律关系。
Conclusion: 推理总结为高效CoT传输提供了实用路径，使在严格计算约束下也能实现高级推理。

papers.title: Rethinking Robust Adversarial Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Concept erasure methods aim to remove specific unsafe target concepts in diffusion models while preserving image generation utility. To address the vulnerability that erased concepts can be easily recovered under adversarial attacks, adversarial concept erasure methods integrate adversarial optimization into the concept erasure process. However, existing adversarial concept erasure methods face a trade-off between robustness and computational cost. We attribute this to adversarial optimization techniques that use random samples to approximate the adversarial objective function. Adversarial optimization that uses a small number of samples fails to produce adversarial embeddings that accurately capture the target concept space. To mitigate this limitation, we propose Semantic-Guided Adversarial Optimization, which uses a single sample to produce adversarial embeddings that better capture the target concept space. We also propose Semantic-Guided Concept Erasure, which automatically maps the target concept to a semantically similar surrogate. Extensive experiments on not-safe-for-work content, artistic styles, and object-related concepts demonstrate that our method, S-GRACE (Semantic-Guided Robust Adversarial Concept Erasure) achieves state-of-the-art erasure robustness and superior image generation utility, with significantly lower computational cost than existing methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/Qhong-522/S-GRACE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散模型中概念擦除方法在对抗攻击下易被恢复的问题，提出语义引导的对抗优化（S-GRACE），通过单样本生成更准确的对抗嵌入，并引入语义引导的概念擦除来自动映射目标概念到语义相似的替代概念。实验在NSFW内容、艺术风格和物体概念上验证了该方法在擦除鲁棒性和图像生成效用上的优势，同时计算成本更低。
Motivation: 现有对抗性概念擦除方法在鲁棒性和计算成本之间存在折衷，因为使用少量随机样本近似对抗目标函数无法生成准确覆盖目标概念空间的对抗嵌入。
Method: 提出语义引导的对抗优化（Semantic-Guided Adversarial Optimization），使用单个样本生成能更好捕捉目标概念空间的对抗嵌入；同时提出语义引导的概念擦除（Semantic-Guided Concept Erasure），将目标概念自动映射到语义相似的替代概念。
Result: 在NSFW内容、艺术风格和物体概念等广泛实验上，S-GRACE实现了最先进的擦除鲁棒性和优越的图像生成效用，且计算成本显著低于现有方法。
Conclusion: 通过语义引导的对抗优化和概念映射，可以同时提升鲁棒性和降低计算开销，为扩散模型的安全概念擦除提供了更实用的方案。

papers.title: Reasoning Up the Instruction Ladder for Controllable Language Models
papers.abstract_en: As large language model (LLM) based systems take on high-stakes roles in real-world decision-making, they must reconcile competing instructions from multiple sources within a single prompt context. Enforcing an instruction hierarchy, where higher-level directives override lower-priority requests, is critical to the reliability and control of LLMs. In this work, we reframe instruction hierarchy resolution as a reasoning task. The model must first "think" about the relationship between a given user prompt and higher-priority instructions before generating a response. To enable this capability, we construct VerIH, a training dataset of constraint-following tasks with verifiable answers, comprising aligned and conflicting system-user instructions. We show that lightweight reinforcement learning with VerIH effectively transfers general reasoning capabilities of models to instruction prioritization. Our method leads to consistent improvements across multiple model families on both instruction following and instruction hierarchy benchmarks, achieving ~20% absolute improvement in conflict setups. Our method also leads to improved alignment to safety-critical scenarios beyond the training distribution, exhibiting increased robustness against jailbreak and prompt injection, reducing absolute attack success rates by up to 20%. Our results establish reasoning over instruction hierarchies as a practical mechanism for improving AI reliability, where targeted updates to system prompts produce predictable, controllable, and robust changes in model behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将大型语言模型中的指令层次遵循问题重构为推理任务，通过构建包含一致和冲突指令的训练数据集VerIH，并采用轻量级强化学习方法，使模型能够在生成响应前优先考虑高优先级指令。实验表明，该方法在冲突场景下指令遵循基准上取得约20%的绝对提升，并将越狱和提示注入攻击成功率降低多达20%，显著提升了模型的可控性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有LLM系统在单个提示中需要调和来自多源的竞争性指令，但缺乏可靠的指令层次执行机制，导致可靠性和可控性不足。
Method: 将指令层次解析建模为推理任务，构建VerIH数据集（包含一致和冲突的系统/用户指令），并采用轻量级强化学习（RL）训练模型，使其学会在生成响应前推理指令间的优先级关系。
Result: 在多个模型族上，该方法在指令遵循和指令层次基准的冲突设置中实现约20%的绝对提升，并将越狱和提示注入攻击的成功率降低高达20%。
Conclusion: 指令层次推理是提升AI系统可靠性的实用机制，通过对系统提示进行针对性更新即可产生可预测、可控且鲁棒的行为变化。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在多个模型族上，该方法在指令遵循和指令层次基准的冲突设置中实现约20%的绝对提升，并将越狱和提示注入攻击的成功率降低高达20%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 指令层次推理是提升AI系统可靠性的实用机制，通过对系统提示进行针对性更新即可产生可预测、可控且鲁棒的行为变化。

papers.title: UltraImageGen: Efficient Ultra-High-Resolution Image Generation with Hierarchical Local Attention
papers.abstract_en: Ultra-high-resolution text-to-image generation is increasingly vital for applications requiring fine-grained textures and global structural fidelity, yet state-of-the-art text-to-image diffusion models such as FLUX and SD3 remain confined to sub 2MP (< $1K\times2K$) resolutions due to the quadratic complexity of attention mechanisms and the scarcity of high-quality high-resolution training data. We present UltraImageGen, a novel framework that introduces hierarchical local attention with low-resolution global guidance, enabling efficient, scalable, and semantically coherent image synthesis at ultra-high resolutions. Specifically, high-resolution latents are divided into hardware aligned fixed-size local windows to reduce attention complexity from quadratic to near-linear, while a low-resolution latent equipped with scaled positional embeddings injects global semantics as an anchor. A lightweight LoRA adaptation bridges global and local pathways during denoising, ensuring consistency across structure and detail. To maximize inference efficiency and achieve scalable ultra-high-resolution generation, we repermute token sequence in window-first order, so that the GPU-friendly dense local blocks in attention calculation equals to the fixed-size local window in 2D regardless of resolution. Together ourwork reliably scales the pretrained model to resolutions higher than $8K$ with more than $10\times$ speed up and significantly lower memory usage. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ourwork achieves superior quality while maintaining computational efficiency, establishing a practical paradigm for advancing ultra-high-resolution image generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UltraImageGen 框架，通过分层局部注意力与低分辨率全局引导，实现高效、可扩展的超高分辨率文本到图像生成，将预训练模型扩展到 8K 以上分辨率，速度提升 10 倍以上且内存占用显著降低。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型受限于注意力机制的二次复杂度和高质量训练数据稀缺，无法生成超过 2MP（<1K×2K）分辨率的图像，阻碍了超高分辨率图像在需要精细纹理和全局结构保真度的应用。
Method: 采用分层局部注意力：将高分辨率潜变量划分为硬件对齐的固定大小局部窗口，使注意力复杂度从二次降至近线性；同时使用带缩放位置编码的低分辨率潜变量注入全局语义作为锚点，并通过轻量级 LoRA 适配连接全局与局部路径；采用窗口优先的 token 重排列以适配 GPU 高效计算。
Result: 可靠地将预训练模型扩展到 8K 以上分辨率，实现超过 10 倍加速和大幅降低内存使用，并在实验中获得优于现有方法的图像质量与计算效率。
Conclusion: 论文声称该方法为超高分辨率图像生成建立了实用范式，但未讨论在极端分辨率下可能出现的伪影或训练数据限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Toward Cybersecurity-Expert Small Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are transforming everyday applications, yet deployment in cybersecurity lags due to a lack of high-quality, domain-specific models and training datasets. To address this gap, we present CyberPal 2.0, a family of cybersecurity-expert small language models (SLMs) ranging from 4B-20B parameters. To train CyberPal 2.0, we generate an enriched chain-of-thought cybersecurity instruction dataset built with our data enrichment and formatting pipeline, SecKnowledge 2.0, which integrates expert-in-the-loop steering of reasoning formats alongside LLM-driven multi-step grounding, yielding higher-fidelity, task-grounded reasoning traces for security tasks. Across diverse cybersecurity benchmarks, CyberPal 2.0 consistently outperforms its baselines and matches or surpasses various open and closed-source frontier models, while remaining a fraction of their size. On core cyber threat intelligence knowledge tasks, our models outperform almost all tested frontier models, ranking second only to Sec-Gemini v1. On core threat-investigation tasks, such as correlating vulnerabilities and bug tickets with weaknesses, our best 20B-parameter model outperforms GPT-4o, o1, o3-mini, and Sec-Gemini v1, ranking first, while our smallest 4B-parameter model ranks second.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CyberPal 2.0，一系列 4B-20B 参数的网络安全专家小语言模型（SLM）。通过 SecKnowledge 2.0 流水线生成增强的链式思维（chain-of-thought）网络安全指令数据集，结合专家引导的推理格式和多步接地。在多个网络安全基准上，CyberPal 2.0 超越基线模型，并与各种开源/闭源前沿模型（包括 GPT-4o、o1 等）匹敌或超越，在核心威胁情报任务中仅次于 Sec-Gemini v1，在威胁调查任务中最佳 20B 模型排名第一。
Motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）在安全领域部署滞后，缺乏高质量、领域特定的模型和训练数据集。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 采用数据增强和格式化流水线 SecKnowledge 2.0，结合专家在环（expert-in-the-loop）引导推理格式和 LLM 驱动的多步接地，生成高保真、任务接地的推理轨迹，用于训练 CyberPal 2.0 系列小语言模型。
Result: 在多个网络安全基准上，CyberPal 2.0 一致超越基线模型，且以更小尺寸匹配或超越各种前沿模型。核心威胁情报知识任务中几乎超越所有测试的前沿模型，仅次于 Sec-Gemini v1；在威胁调查任务中，最佳 20B 模型优于 GPT-4o、o1、o3-mini 和 Sec-Gemini v1，排名第一，最小 4B 模型排名第二。
Conclusion: 摘要强调了小语言模型在网络安全领域的潜力，通过高质量指令数据和专家引导的推理训练，可在特定领域达到甚至超越大模型水平。

papers.title: TCMA: Text-Conditioned Multi-granularity Alignment for Drone Cross-Modal Text-Video Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have become powerful platforms for real-time, high-resolution data collection, producing massive volumes of aerial videos. Efficient retrieval of relevant content from these videos is crucial for applications in urban management, emergency response, security, and disaster relief. While text-video retrieval has advanced in natural video domains, the UAV domain remains underexplored due to limitations in existing datasets, such as coarse and redundant captions. Thus, in this work, we construct the Drone Video-Text Match Dataset (DVTMD), which contains 2,864 videos and 14,320 fine-grained, semantically diverse captions. The annotations capture multiple complementary aspects, including human actions, objects, background settings, environmental conditions, and visual style, thereby enhancing text-video correspondence and reducing redundancy. Building on this dataset, we propose the Text-Conditioned Multi-granularity Alignment (TCMA) framework, which integrates global video-sentence alignment, sentence-guided frame aggregation, and word-guided patch alignment. To further refine local alignment, we design a Word and Patch Selection module that filters irrelevant content, as well as a Text-Adaptive Dynamic Temperature Mechanism that adapts attention sharpness to text type. Extensive experiments on DVTMD and CapERA establish the first complete benchmark for drone text-video retrieval. Our TCMA achieves state-of-the-art performance, including 45.5% R@1 in text-to-video and 42.8% R@1 in video-to-text retrieval, demonstrating the effectiveness of our dataset and method. The code and dataset will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无人机视频文本检索中现有数据集标注粗糙、冗余的问题，构建了包含2,864个视频和14,320条细粒度语义描述的新数据集DVTMD，并提出文本条件多粒度对齐框架TCMA，融合全局视频-句子对齐、句子引导的帧聚合和词引导的补丁对齐。在DVTMD和CapERA数据集上，TCMA在文本到视频检索中达到45.5% R@1，在视频到文本检索中达到42.8% R@1，建立了无人机文本视频检索的首个完整基准。
Motivation: 无人机视频数据量巨大，但现有检索方法主要面向自然视频，无人机领域因缺乏高质量细粒度标注数据集而研究不足。
Method: 构建DVTMD数据集，包含14,320条描述人类动作、物体、背景、环境、视觉风格等多方面语义的细粒度字幕。提出TCMA框架，包括全局视频-句子对齐、句子引导的帧聚合、词引导的补丁对齐，以及用于过滤无关内容的词与补丁选择模块和文本自适应动态温度机制。
Result: 在DVTMD和CapERA数据集上，TCMA在文本到视频检索中R@1为45.5%，视频到文本检索中R@1为42.8%，达到当前最优性能。
Conclusion: 本文的贡献在于构建了高质量的无人机文本视频数据集并提出了有效的多粒度对齐方法，为无人机跨模态检索领域提供了基准。

papers.title: Root Cause Analysis of Outliers in Unknown Cyclic Graphs
papers.abstract_en: We study the propagation of outliers in cyclic causal graphs with linear structural equations, tracing them back to one or several "root cause" nodes. We show that it is possible to identify a short list of potential root causes provided that the perturbation is sufficiently strong and propagates according to the same structural equations as in the normal mode. This shortlist consists of the true root causes together with those of its parents lying on a cycle with the root cause. Notably, our method does not require prior knowledge of the causal graph and yields encouraging results on simulated data and real data from biology and cloud computing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究线性循环因果图中离群点的传播，将其追溯到1个或多个根因节点。证明在扰动足够强且按正常模式的结构方程传播时，可以识别一个包含真根因及其在环上父节点的候选短列表。方法无需预先知道因果图，在模拟数据和来自生物学及云计算的实际数据上取得积极结果。
Motivation: 现有因果根因分析多假设无环图或已知图结构，而真实系统中常存在未知循环因果图，导致根因定位困难。
Method: 利用线性结构方程和离群点传播机制，通过分析扰动强度和传播路径，在未知图结构下输出包含真根因及环上父节点的候选短列表。
Result: 摘要报告在模拟数据和生物学、云计算真实数据上，该方法能有效识别根因候选集。
Conclusion: 该方法无需因果图先验，适用于循环图场景，但依赖强扰动假设和线性结构方程。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Selective Expert Guidance for Effective and Diverse Exploration in Reinforcement Learning of LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become a widely adopted technique for enhancing the reasoning ability of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, the effectiveness of RLVR strongly depends on the capability of base models. This issue arises because it requires the model to have sufficient capability to perform high-quality exploration, which involves both effectiveness and diversity. Unfortunately, existing methods address this issue by imitating expert trajectories, which improve effectiveness but neglect diversity. To address this, we argue that the expert only needs to provide guidance only at critical decision points rather than the entire reasoning path. Based on this insight, we propose MENTOR: Mixed-policy Expert Navigation for Token-level Optimization of Reasoning, a framework that provides expert guidance only at critical decision points to perform effective and diverse exploration in RLVR. Extensive experiments show that MENTOR enables models capture the essence of expert strategies rather than surface imitation, thereby performing high-quality exploration and achieving superior overall performance. Our code is available online.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）中基座模型探索能力不足的问题，提出MENTOR框架，仅在关键决策点提供专家指导，而非整个推理路径，从而在保持有效性的同时促进多样性探索。实验表明，MENTOR使模型掌握专家策略精髓而非表面模仿，实现高质量探索并提升总体性能。
Motivation: 现有RLVR方法依赖基座模型自身探索能力，通过模仿专家轨迹虽能提升有效性却牺牲了多样性，限制了推理能力的进一步提升。
Method: 提出MENTOR（Mixed-policy Expert Navigation for Token-level Optimization of Reasoning）框架，在关键决策点提供专家指导，而非完整推理路径，以平衡有效探索与多样性。
Result: 实验表明，MENTOR使模型掌握专家策略本质而非表面模仿，实现高质量探索，并取得更优的总体性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，专家仅在关键决策点提供指导能够有效提升RLVR中探索的质量和多样性，避免表面模仿。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-Improving Neural Pruning: A Graph Neural Network Framework for Scalable Mixed Bundle Pricing
papers.abstract_en: Mixed bundle pricing is a classic revenue management problem arising in industries such as e-commerce, tourism, and video games. It refers to designing product combinations (i.e., bundles) and determining their prices to maximize expected profit. Exact mixed-bundling formulations capture this structure but are computationally intractable because the number of possible bundles grows exponentially with the number of products. We propose a graph neural network (GNN)-guided pruning framework for scalable (non-)additive bundle pricing. Instead of learning on the exponential bundle-level formulation, we encode each instance as a compact customer-product graph and train an edge-output GNN to learn the product-assignment probabilities from optimal mixed-bundling solutions. The predicted probabilities are then converted into restricted candidate bundle families through fixed cutoff pruning and progressive cutoff pruning; the final prices and assignments are obtained by solving the mixed bundling formulation over the retained bundles. We further introduce a GNN-guided local search and an iterative self-improvement procedure for larger instances. The local search refines the retained bundle family by prioritizing high-confidence add/drop moves, while the iterative self-improvement procedure generates high-quality solutions on larger instances for retraining. Theoretically, we show that under mild distinguishability conditions the proposed edge-output GNN class is expressive enough to recover the optimal product-assignment mapping. Experiments show that the proposed policies recover over 98% of the optimal profit on small instances and outperform bundle-size pricing on larger instances with substantial runtime savings.

papers.title: Predicting LLM Reasoning Performance with Small Proxy Model
papers.abstract_en: Given the prohibitive cost of pre-training large language models, it is essential to leverage smaller proxy models to optimize datasets before scaling up. However, this approach becomes challenging for reasoning capabilities, which exhibit emergent behavior that only appear reliably at larger model sizes, often exceeding 7B parameters. To address this, we introduce rBridge, showing that small proxies ($\leq$1B) can effectively predict large-model reasoning by aligning more closely with (1) the pre-training objective and (2) the target task. rBridge achieves this by weighting negative log-likelihood with task alignment, using reasoning traces from frontier models as gold labels. In our experiments, rBridge (i) reduces dataset ranking costs by over 100x relative to the best baseline, (ii) achieves the strongest correlation across six reasoning benchmarks at 1B to 32B scale, and (iii) zero-shot transfers predictive relationships across pre-training datasets at 1B to 7B scale. These findings indicate that rBridge offers a practical path for exploring reasoning-oriented pre-training at lower cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出rBridge方法，利用小代理模型（≤1B）预测大语言模型的推理性能，通过对齐预训练目标和目标任务，将前沿模型的推理轨迹作为黄金标签，加权负对数似然。实验表明，rBridge在六个推理基准上以1B至32B规模实现最强相关性，数据集排序成本降低100倍以上，且零样本迁移预训练数据集间的预测关系。
Motivation: 预训练大语言模型成本高昂，需用小代理模型优化数据集，但推理能力仅在大模型（>7B）中涌现，小模型难以预测。
Method: 通过任务对齐加权负对数似然，使用推理轨迹作为黄金标签，使小代理模型与大模型的推理行为更一致。
Result: rBridge将数据集排序成本降低100倍以上，在1B至32B规模的六个推理基准上取得最强相关性，且在1B至7B预训练数据集间零样本迁移预测关系。
Conclusion: rBridge为以更低成本探索面向推理的预训练提供了实用路径。

papers.title: Clotho: Measuring Task-Specific Pre-Generation Test Adequacy for LLM Inputs
papers.abstract_en: Software increasingly relies on the emergent capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), from natural language understanding to program analysis and generation. Yet testing them on specific tasks remains difficult and costly: many prompts lack ground truths, forcing reliance on human judgments, while existing test adequacy measures typically rely on output uncertainty and thus are only available after full inference. A key challenge is to assess how useful a test input is in a way that reflects the demands of the task, ideally before even generating any output. We introduce Clotho, a task-specific, pre-generation test adequacy measure that estimates input difficulty directly from LLM hidden states. Given a large pool of unlabelled inputs for a specific task, Clotho uses a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) to adaptively sample the most informative cases for human labelling. Based on this reference set the GMM can then rank unseen inputs by their likelihood of failure. In our empirical evaluation across eight benchmark tasks and three open-weight LLMs, Clotho can predict failures with a ROC-AUC of 0.716, after labelling reference sets that are on average only 5.4% of inputs. It does so without generating any outputs, thereby significantly reducing LLM execution costs compared to output-based uncertainty or confidence measures. Comparison of Clotho and these post-generation adequacy measures shows that the two approaches complement each other. Crucially, we show that adequacy scores learnt from open-weight LLMs transfer effectively to proprietary models, extending the applicability of the approach. When prioritising test inputs for proprietary models, Clotho increases the average number of failing inputs from 18.7 to 42.5 out of 100, compared to random prioritisation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Clotho 是一种针对 LLM 特定任务的预生成测试充分性度量方法，通过高斯混合模型（GMM）从隐藏状态估计输入难度，在不生成输出的情况下预测故障。实验表明，在八个基准任务上，Clotho 仅需标记约 5.4% 的输入即可达到 0.716 的 ROC-AUC，并显著降低执行成本，且其学习到的得分可有效迁移到闭源模型。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 测试严重依赖输出不确定性度量，需要完整推理才能评估输入，且缺乏针对特定任务的预生成充分性度量，导致测试成本高昂且效率低下。
Method: Clotho 使用高斯混合模型（GMM）对 LLM 隐藏状态建模，从未标注的输入池中自适应采样信息量最大的样本进行人工标注，然后基于参考集对未见输入按故障可能性排序。
Result: 在八个基准任务和三种开源 LLM 上，Clotho 预测故障的 ROC-AUC 为 0.716，平均仅需标记 5.4% 的输入。与输出不确定性度量互补，其得分可迁移到闭源模型；优先测试时，故障输入数量从 18.7/100 提升至 42.5/100。
Conclusion: Clotho 提供了一种高效的预生成测试充分性度量，显著降低 LLM 执行成本，且与现有后生成度量互补，可应用于闭源模型。

papers.title: Breaking the Weak Recovery Limit in Random Phase Retrieval with Learned Regularizers
papers.abstract_en: We seek to recover an unknown signal from nonlinear amplitude-only measurements, a challenging inverse problem. Strong theoretical guarantees have been established for idealized random measurements, defining the sampling ratio required for signal recovery. However, these results neglect signal priors, which can fundamentally shift these limits, potentially enabling reconstruction with far fewer measurements and simpler models. We evaluate a variety of image priors in the context of severe undersampling with physically-grounded random measurement models. Our results show that these priors enable accurate recovery well below the weak recovery limit, the theoretical threshold required for recovery better than a random guess.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究通过学习正则化器（learned regularizers）突破随机相位恢复中的弱恢复极限，实验表明在严重欠采样下，利用图像先验可在低于理论阈值时实现精确恢复。
Motivation: 传统随机相位恢复理论忽略了信号先验，导致实际所需采样比过高，限制了少测量下的重建能力。
Method: 在物理驱动的随机测量模型下，系统评估多种图像先验（正则化器）在严重欠采样场景中的恢复性能。
Result: 实验表明，学习正则化器能在低于弱恢复极限的采样比下实现准确重建，远优于无先验方法。
Conclusion: 信号先验可根本改变相位恢复的采样极限，为低测量场景提供新可能。

papers.title: FedIA: Importance-Aware Aggregation for Domain-Robust Federated Graph Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated graph learning (FGL) is a natural paradigm for social-media user graphs, where language communities, regional markets, and service boundaries can prevent raw graph pooling. We use the Twitch Gamers networks as the primary live-streaming social-media benchmark, and study a question that is often hidden by representation-level evaluation: after local message passing, what update signals are actually exposed to server aggregation? Through update-space measurements, we identify an aggregation-level failure in which graph-domain clients gradually place salient update signals on less shared parameter coordinates, while message-passing backbones show weaker cross-domain directional compatibility than an MLP control. This update-support fragmentation means that standard averaging can dilute locally important coordinates even when no raw graph data are exchanged. Across five backbones, homophily remains relevant but is not the dominant correlate of support retention; feature, label, and degree discrepancies show stronger associations. These findings indicate that graph-domain shifts damage not only local representations, but also the coordinate support on which aggregation operates. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose FedIA, a plug-and-play server-side importance-aware aggregation method. Importance Masking selects a shared high-magnitude coordinate support, and Contribution-Aware Momentum Weighting smooths client contributions within that support. FedIA requires no raw graph sharing, no graph-statistics upload, and no auxiliary communication payload, while adding only $O(D+N)$ persistent server state for $D$ model coordinates and $N$ clients.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对联邦图学习（FGL）中客户端更新信号的聚合失败问题，通过分析发现图域客户端的显著更新信号逐渐集中在较少的共享参数坐标上，导致标准平均聚合会稀释局部重要坐标。基于此，提出FedIA，一种即插即用的服务器端重要性感知聚合方法，包含重要性掩码和贡献感知动量加权，无需共享原始图数据或图统计信息。
Motivation: 现有FGL方法在跨图域客户端聚合时，更新信号在参数坐标上的支持逐渐碎片化，标准平均聚合削弱了局部重要坐标，而此前研究多关注表示层面的评估，忽视了聚合层面的这一失败。
Method: 提出FedIA，包含两个组件：1) 重要性掩码（Importance Masking），选择共享的高幅度坐标支持；2) 贡献感知动量加权（Contribution-Aware Momentum Weighting），在该支持内平滑客户端贡献。方法仅需服务器维护O(D+N)的持久状态，无额外通信开销。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但通过Twitch Gamers网络基准实验，验证了更新空间中的聚合失败现象，并表明特征、标签和度数的差异比同质性更显著地影响支持保留。
Conclusion: FedIA是一种轻量级、即插即用的聚合方法，可缓解图域偏移导致的坐标支持碎片化问题，且无需共享原始图数据或上传图统计信息。

papers.title: Reward function compression facilitates goal-dependent reinforcement learning
papers.abstract_en: Humans can uniquely assign value to novel, abstract outcomes to support reinforcement learning. However, this flexibility is cognitively costly and reduces learning efficiency. We propose that goal-dependent learning initially relies on capacity-limited working memory. With consistent experience, learners create a "compressed" reward function - a simplified goal rule -- that transfers to long-term memory for a more automatic evaluation upon receiving feedback. This automaticity frees working memory resources, thereby boosting learning efficiency. Across six experiments, we demonstrate that learning is impaired by the size of the goal space but improves when this space allows for compression. Additionally, faster reward processing correlates with better learning. Although the algorithmic details remain to be established, our behavioral results and computational models suggest that efficient goal-directed learning relies on compressing complex goal information into a stable reward function. These findings illuminate the cognitive mechanisms of intrinsic motivation and can inform behavioral interventions supporting human goal achievement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出人类在目标导向强化学习中，通过将复杂的奖励函数压缩为简化的目标规则（压缩奖励函数），从工作记忆转移到长期记忆，从而释放认知资源并提高学习效率。六项实验表明，目标空间越大学习越困难，但允许压缩时学习表现提升；奖励处理速度与学习效果正相关。行为结果与计算模型支持压缩机制。
Motivation: 人类能够灵活地为新颖、抽象的结果赋值以支持强化学习，但这种灵活性带来认知成本，降低学习效率。论文旨在解释这一矛盾，提出压缩奖励函数是提高目标依赖学习效率的关键机制。
Method: 通过六项行为实验，操纵目标空间大小和可压缩性，测量学习表现与奖励处理速度；并构建计算模型来模拟压缩奖励函数的形成过程。
Result: 学习表现受目标空间大小损害，但可压缩性可以改善；较快的奖励加工与更好的学习显著相关。
Conclusion: 高效的目标导向学习依赖于将复杂的目标信息压缩为稳定的奖励函数，这一机制释放工作记忆并支持自动评估；研究阐明了内在动机的认知基础，可为行为干预提供指导。

papers.title: FSA: An Alternative Efficient Implementation of Native Sparse Attention Kernel
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in sparse attention mechanisms have demonstrated strong potential for reducing the computational cost of long-context training and inference in large language models (LLMs). Native Sparse Attention (NSA), one state-of-the-art approach, introduces natively trainable, hardware-aligned sparse attention that delivers substantial system-level performance boosts while maintaining accuracy comparable to full attention. However, the kernel implementation of NSA forces a loop order that is only efficient with a relatively large number of query heads in each Grouped Query Attention (GQA) group, whereas existing LLMs widely adopt a much smaller number of query heads in each GQA group -- such an inconsistency significantly limits the applicability of this sparse algorithmic advance. In this work, we propose Flash Sparse Attention (FSA), an alternative kernel implementation that enables efficient NSA computation across a wide range of popular LLMs with a varied, smaller number of heads in each GQA group on modern GPUs. Compared to vanilla NSA kernel implementation, our empirical evaluation demonstrates that FSA achieves (i) up to 3.5x and on average 1.6x kernel-level latency reduction, (ii) up to 1.25x and 1.09x on average end-to-end training speedup on state-of-the-art LLMs, and (iii) up to 1.36x and 1.11x on average for prefill-phase speedup in LLM generative inference. The source code is open-sourced and publicly available at https://github.com/Relaxed-System-Lab/Flash-Sparse-Attention.

papers.title: Energy-Efficient Real-Time 4-Stage Sleep Classification at 10-Second Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Sleep stage classification is critical for diagnosing and managing disorders like sleep apnea and insomnia. However, conventional methods like polysomnography are costly and impractical for long-term, home-based monitoring. This study presents an energy-efficient approach for detecting four sleep stages (wake, rapid eye movement (REM), light sleep, deep sleep) using a single-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) signal. We evaluate various machine learning and deep learning models, introducing two windowing strategies: (1) a 5-minute window with 30-second steps for machine learning and (2) a 30-second window with 10-second steps for deep learning, enabling 10-second temporal resolution for real-time predictions. While deep learning models like MobileNet-v1 achieve high accuracy (92%) and F1-score (91%), their energy demands make them unsuitable for wearables. To address this, we design SleepLiteCNN, optimized for ECG-based sleep staging, achieving 89\% accuracy and 89% F1-score while minimizing energy use. Applying 8-bit quantization further reduces energy consumption to 5.48 microJ per inference, with 90% accuracy and F1-score. Additionally, field-programmable gate array (FPGA) deployment shows significant reductions in resource usage. This approach provides a practical, energy-efficient solution for continuous ECG-based sleep monitoring in resource-constrained wearable devices.

papers.title: FLAT: Revealing Hidden Latent-Conditioned Backdoor Failures in Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Horizontal federated learning (HFL) backdoor audits often summarize model behavior through clean accuracy (CA), mean attack success rate (ASR), or a single known-trigger test. Such summaries can hide a different failure mode, in which one target label is activated by many trigger realizations. We study this failure mode with FLAT, a latent-conditioned reliability stress test for HFL backdoors. In FLAT, compromised clients still submit ordinary classifier updates to the server, while an attacker-side generator $G(x,t,z)$ separates target intent $t$ from trigger realization $z$. This separation shifts the audit question from whether one known trigger succeeds to how the hidden behavior varies across targets, latent samples, defenses, and post-stop rounds. On CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny-ImageNet, FLAT preserves clean utility while reaching 99.49%, 99.66%, and 94.10% single-target FedAvg ASR. The evaluation also reveals non-uniform defense responses, where a server rule can suppress one target mode while leaving another active. These observations motivate HFL backdoor audits that report target-wise ASR, worst-target ASR, target coverage, latent-sampled behavior, post-stop persistence, and defense response.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 7 figures. Substantially revised version with expanded reliability analysis, defense evaluation, and post-stop persistence study
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FLAT，一种用于水平联邦学习（HFL）后门攻击的潜在条件可靠性压力测试。FLAT通过分离目标意图和触发实现，揭示传统评估指标（如平均攻击成功率）可能隐藏的故障模式：一个目标标签可由多种触发变体激活。在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和Tiny-ImageNet上，FLAT在保持干净精度的同时达到高单目标FedAvg攻击成功率，并发现防御对不同目标的效果不均匀。
Motivation: 现有的HFL后门审计通常只报告平均攻击成功率或单一已知触发测试，可能掩盖一种故障：一个目标标签可由多个不同触发实现激活。
Method: FLAT引入攻击者侧的生成器G(x,t,z)，将目标意图t与触发实现z分离，从而评估隐藏行为在不同目标、潜在样本、防御和后停止轮次下的变化。
Result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和Tiny-ImageNet上，FLAT分别达到99.49%、99.66%和94.10%的单目标FedAvg攻击成功率，同时保持干净效用。评估还发现防御对某些目标有效但对另一些目标无效。
Conclusion: 摘要建议HFL后门审计应报告目标别攻击成功率、最差目标攻击成功率、目标覆盖率、潜在采样行为、后停止持久性和防御响应。

papers.title: A General Approach to Visualizing Uncertainty in Statistical Graphics
papers.abstract_en: We present a general approach to visualizing uncertainty in static 2-D statistical graphics. If we treat a visualization as a function of its underlying quantities, uncertainty in those quantities induces a distribution over images. We show how to aggregate these images into a single visualization that represents the uncertainty. The approach can be viewed as a generalization of sample-based approaches that use overlay. Notably, standard representations, such as confidence intervals and bands, emerge with their usual coverage guarantees without being explicitly quantified or visualized. As a proof of concept, we implement our approach in the IID setting using resampling, provided as an open-source Python library. Because the approach operates directly on images, the user needs only to supply the data and the code for visualizing the quantities of interest without uncertainty. Through several examples, we show how both familiar and novel forms of uncertainty visualization can be created. The implementation is not only a practical validation of the underlying theory but also an immediately usable tool that can complement existing uncertainty-visualization libraries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种在静态二维统计图形中可视化不确定性的通用方法。该方法将可视化视为底层数量的函数，通过聚合这些数量不确定性所导致的图像分布来生成表示不确定性的单一图形。标准表示如置信区间和置信带无需显式量化即可自动得到。
Motivation: 现有不确定性可视化方法往往针对特定图形类型或需要手动指定不确定性的表现形式，缺乏统一框架。
Method: 将可视化视为底层数量的函数，利用重采样（如IID setting下的重抽样）生成图像分布，再聚合为单一可视化图形。
Result: 通过示例展示了该方法能产生熟悉和新颖的不确定性可视化形式，并提供了开源Python库作为实现。
Conclusion: 该方法是一种通用的不确定性可视化框架，可作为现有不确定性可视化库的补充。

papers.title: Boosting Ensembles for Statistics of Tails at Conditionally Optimal Advance Split Times
papers.abstract_en: Climate science needs more efficient ways to study high-impact, low-probability extreme events. Ensemble boosting, a form of rare event sampling, offers a novel strategy to extract more information from those occasional simulated events, by perturbing them slightly to probe alternative scenarios immediately instead of waiting many simulation-years for the next event. But statistical accuracy and efficiency depend on the perturbation details. In particular for sudden and transient events like precipitation, performance of boosting depends sensitively on the \emph{advance split time} (AST), which must be long enough before the event to let the ensemble diversify, but not so much as to destroy the event. In pursuit of principled guidelines, we study the effect of AST for sampling tracer fluctuations in a quasigeostrophic flow, an idealized but informative model of midlatitude storm track dynamics. We formulate AST selection as an optimization problem for statistical fidelity with a ground truth. Since ground truth is not known in practice, we propose a proxy objective function of \emph{thresholded entropy}, which rewards ensembles with both a high mean and a large spread. We show that ensemble boosting, when given a well-chosen AST and equipped with methods to estimate probabilities, can accurately sample extremes at long return periods. We furthermore find evidence that thresholded entropy successfully identifies an optimal AST, which is roughly 1-3 eddy turnover timescales in the quasigeostrophic system. Moreover, this proxy captures the \emph{variation} of AST with the target location of the tracer within the flow field, suggesting generalizability to climate models. Large-scale deployment of our method will require further development in adaptive optimization strategies, but our work here is an essential first step for establishing what must be optimized.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对气候科学中极端事件采样效率低的问题，研究了一种稀有事件采样方法——集成增强（ensemble boosting），重点优化了前置分裂时间（AST）的选择。通过在准地转流模型中模拟示踪剂波动，作者将AST选择建模为优化问题，并提出阈值熵（thresholded entropy）作为代理目标函数。实验表明，选择合适的AST后，集成增强能准确采样长重现期的极端事件，且阈值熵能有效识别最优AST，约为1-3个涡旋周转时间。
Motivation: 气候科学需要高效研究低概率高影响极端事件，传统方法需长时间模拟。集成增强通过微调模拟事件来获取更多信息，但其统计精度和效率依赖于扰动细节，尤其对于降水等瞬态事件，AST的选择至关重要。
Method: 将AST选择形式化为关于统计保真度的优化问题，提出阈值熵作为代理目标函数，该函数奖励具有高均值和大方差的集成。在准地转流模型中验证方法，展示了其在不同目标位置上的泛化能力。
Result: 集成增强在恰当AST下能准确采样长重现期极端事件；阈值熵成功识别出最优AST（约为1-3个涡旋周转时间），并能捕捉AST随目标位置的变化，暗示方法可推广到气候模型。
Conclusion: 大规模部署需进一步发展自适应优化策略，但本文为确立优化目标提供了必要的第一步。

papers.title: Fraud is Not Just Rarity: A Causal Prototype Attention Approach to Realistic Synthetic Oversampling
papers.abstract_en: Detecting fraudulent credit card transactions remains a significant challenge, due to the extreme class imbalance in real-world data and the often subtle patterns that separate fraud from legitimate activity. Existing research commonly attempts to address this by generating synthetic samples for the minority class using approaches such as GANs, VAEs (Variational Autoencoders), or hybrid generative models. However, these techniques, particularly when applied only to minority-class data, tend to result in overconfident classifiers and poor latent cluster separation, ultimately limiting real-world detection performance. In this study, we propose the Causal Prototype Attention Classifier (CPAC), an interpretable architecture that promotes class-aware clustering and improved latent space structure through prototype-based attention mechanisms and we couple it with the encoder of a Variational Autoencoder-Generative Adversarial Network (VAE-GAN) in order to achieve improved latent cluster separation moving beyond post-hoc sample augmentation. We compared CPAC-augmented models to traditional oversamplers, such as SMOTE, as well as to state-of-the-art generative models, both with and without CPAC-based latent classifiers. Our results show that classifier-guided latent shaping with CPAC delivers superior performance, achieving an F1-score of 93.74% and recall of 92.85%, along with improved latent cluster separation. Further ablation studies and visualizations provide deeper insight into the benefits and limitations of classifier-driven representation learning for fraud detection. The codebase for this work can be found at the following link: https://github.com/claudiunderthehood/VAEGAN-CPAC.git.

Result: CPAC增强模型在信用卡欺诈检测上达到F1=93.74%，召回率92.85%，且潜在聚类分离改善。

papers.title: FusionFactory: Fusing LLM Capabilities with Multi-LLM Log Data
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has created a diverse landscape of models, each excelling at different tasks. This diversity drives researchers to employ multiple LLMs in practice, leaving behind valuable multi-LLM log data. This naturally leads to the question of whether such logs can be fully leveraged to fuse LLMs' complementary capabilities. Although prior work has explored various strategies for integrating multiple LLMs, we argue that practical fusion must meet two essential requirements: (1) compatibility with real-world serving scenarios (e.g., local and API-based serving), and (2) flexibility to operate at different stages of the LLM pipeline to meet varied user needs (e.g., fine-tuning and inference stages). To this end, we introduce LLMFusionBench, a large-scale benchmark for LLM fusion that spans 14 tasks across five domains, with responses from 20 open-source LLMs (8B--671B) totaling 103M tokens. Building on LLMFusionBench, we propose FusionFactory, a systematic framework with three elaborated levels: (1) query-level fusion via tailored LLM routers, (2) thought-level fusion leveraging retrieved abstract reasoning templates, and (3) model-level fusion via distillation from top-ranked responses. Experiments show that FusionFactory consistently outperforms the best individual LLM across all 14 benchmarks, with the optimal fusion configuration varying across benchmarks, highlighting the promise of multi-LLM log data as a practical foundation for fusing diverse LLM capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多LLM日志数据的融合问题，提出了FusionFactory框架，包含查询级融合（定制LLM路由器）、思维级融合（检索抽象推理模板）和模型级融合（从顶级响应蒸馏）三个层次。基于包含20个开源LLM（8B-671B）响应、覆盖14个任务的LLMFusionBench基准，实验表明FusionFactory在所有基准上优于最佳单LLM，且最佳融合配置因任务而异。
Motivation: 现有LLM各有所长，实际应用中常同时使用多个LLM产生大量日志数据，但如何充分利用这些日志融合不同LLM的互补能力尚未解决，且需兼容实际服务场景（如本地和API服务）并支持LLM流水线的不同阶段（如微调和推理）。
Method: 构建LLMFusionBench基准（14个任务，20个LLM，103M tokens），提出FusionFactory框架，包含三个融合层次：查询级融合（定制LLM路由器）、思维级融合（检索抽象推理模板）、模型级融合（从顶级响应蒸馏）。
Result: 在所有14个基准上，FusionFactory始终优于最佳单LLM；最优融合配置因基准而异，表明多LLM日志数据作为融合基础的实用性。
Conclusion: 提出的融合框架和基准为利用多LLM日志数据融合LLM能力提供了实用基础，未来可探索更复杂的融合策略。

papers.title: Flow-Through Tensors: A Unified Computational Graph Architecture for Multi-Layer Transportation Network Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Modern transportation network modeling increasingly involves the integration of diverse methodologies including sensor-based forecasting, reinforcement learning, classical flow optimization, and demand modeling that have traditionally been developed in isolation. This paper introduces Flow Through Tensors (FTT), a unified computational graph architecture that connects origin destination flows, path probabilities, and link travel times as interconnected tensors. Our framework makes three key contributions: first, it establishes a consistent mathematical structure that enables gradient-based optimization across previously separate modeling elements; second, it supports multidimensional analysis of traffic patterns over time, space, and user groups with precise quantification of system efficiency; third, it implements tensor decomposition techniques that maintain computational tractability for large scale applications. These innovations collectively enable real time control strategies, efficient coordination between multiple transportation modes and operators, and rigorous enforcement of physical network constraints. The FTT framework bridges the gap between theoretical transportation models and practical deployment needs, providing a foundation for next generation integrated mobility systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Flow-Through Tensors (FTT)，一种统一的计算图架构，用于多层交通网络优化，连接起讫点流量、路径概率和路段行程时间作为互连张量。该框架支持基于梯度的优化、多维交通模式分析和张量分解以保持大规模应用的可计算性。
Motivation: 现代交通网络建模涉及传感器预测、强化学习、经典流量优化和需求建模等多种方法，但这些方法传统上是孤立开发的，缺乏统一结构。
Method: 提出Flow-Through Tensors计算图架构，将起讫点流量、路径概率和路段行程时间表示为互连张量，实现梯度优化，并应用张量分解技术保证大规模计算可处理。
Result: 摘要声称FTT框架可实现实时控制策略、多模式多运营商协调，并严格施加物理网络约束。
Conclusion: FTT桥接了理论交通模型与实际部署需求，为下一代集成移动系统奠定基础。

papers.title: KungfuBot: Physics-Based Humanoid Whole-Body Control for Learning Highly-Dynamic Skills
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots are promising to acquire various skills by imitating human behaviors. However, existing algorithms are only capable of tracking smooth, low-speed human motions, even with delicate reward and curriculum design. This paper presents a physics-based humanoid control framework, aiming to master highly-dynamic human behaviors such as Kungfu and dancing through multi-steps motion processing and adaptive motion tracking. For motion processing, we design a pipeline to extract, filter out, correct, and retarget motions, while ensuring compliance with physical constraints to the maximum extent. For motion imitation, we formulate a bi-level optimization problem to dynamically adjust the tracking accuracy tolerance based on the current tracking error, creating an adaptive curriculum mechanism. We further construct an asymmetric actor-critic framework for policy training. In experiments, we train whole-body control policies to imitate a set of highly-dynamic motions. Our method achieves significantly lower tracking errors than existing approaches and is successfully deployed on the Unitree G1 robot, demonstrating stable and expressive behaviors. The project page is https://kungfubot.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出KungfuBot，一个基于物理的人形机器人全身控制框架，旨在掌握功夫、舞蹈等高动态人类技能。通过多步运动处理和自适应运动跟踪，框架在Unitree G1机器人上实现了比现有方法更低的跟踪误差，并展现出稳定且富有表现力的行为。
Motivation: 现有算法即使经过精细的奖励和课程设计，也只能跟踪平滑、低速的人类运动，无法处理高动态行为。
Method: 设计运动处理管线进行提取、过滤、纠正和重定向，确保物理约束；构建双层优化动态调整跟踪精度容忍度，形成自适应课程机制；采用异步演员-评论家框架训练策略。
Result: 在多种高动态运动上实现显著更低的跟踪误差，并成功部署在Unitree G1机器人上，展示了稳定和富有表现力的行为。
Conclusion: 该框架有效弥合了人形机器人高动态技能学习与实际部署之间的差距，为复杂行为模仿提供了可行方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Affogato: Open-Vocabulary Affordance Grounding with Automated Data Generation at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Affordance grounding aims to localize where to interact with an object, a fundamental capability for embodied agents. Yet progress is bottlenecked by data: manual annotation is prohibitively expensive and confines existing datasets to a narrow set of predefined object and affordance categories. We introduce Affogato, a framework for open-vocabulary affordance grounding centered on Affogato-750K, a large-scale dataset of 750K 3D affordance heatmaps paired with natural language queries. We build it with a fully automated pipeline that orchestrates foundation models to generate them at scale without human labeling. It covers significantly more diverse categories than any existing dataset. For reliable evaluation, we further provide 5K human-verified test pairs. We also present Espresso-3D and Espresso-2D, simple yet effective models with a unified architecture across both modalities. Pretraining on Affogato-750K improves both Espresso and prior methods and yields the largest gains on unseen object and affordance categories, showing that it provides broadly transferable supervision across architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Affogato框架，用于开放词汇的affordance定位（affordance grounding），核心贡献是自动生成大规模3D affordance热力图数据集Affogato-750K（75万对），无需人工标注，并提供了5K人工验证的测试对。同时提出Espresso-3D和Espresso-2D模型，在Affogato-750K上预训练能提升跨未见类别和物体的迁移性能。
Motivation: 现有affordance定位数据集由人工标注成本高昂，仅覆盖少量预定义类别，限制了开放词汇场景下的泛化能力。
Method: 构建全自动流水线，利用多个基础模型（foundation models）生成大规模3D affordance热力图-自然语言查询对；并设计统一架构的Espresso模型（支持3D和2D模态）。
Result: Affogato-750K预训练在未见物体和未见affordance类别上带来最大性能提升，证明了其跨架构的迁移性。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种可扩展的自动数据生成方法，为开放词汇affordance定位研究提供了大规模监督信号。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sheet Music Benchmark: Standardized Optical Music Recognition Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we introduce the Sheet Music Benchmark (SMB), a dataset of six hundred and eighty-five pages specifically designed to benchmark Optical Music Recognition (OMR) research. SMB encompasses a diverse array of musical textures, including monophony, pianoform, quartet, and others, all encoded in Common Western Modern Notation using the Humdrum **kern format. Alongside SMB, we introduce the OMR Normalized Edit Distance (OMR-NED), a new metric tailored explicitly for evaluating OMR performance. OMR-NED builds upon the widely-used Symbol Error Rate (SER), offering a fine-grained and detailed error analysis that covers individual musical elements such as note heads, beams, pitches, accidentals, and other critical notation features. The resulting numeric score provided by OMR-NED facilitates clear comparisons, enabling researchers and end-users alike to identify optimal OMR approaches. Our work thus addresses a long-standing gap in OMR evaluation, and we support our contributions with baseline experiments using standardized SMB dataset splits for training and assessing state-of-the-art methods.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 26th International Society for Music Information Retrieval Conference (ISMIR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了 Sheet Music Benchmark (SMB)，一个包含 685 页乐谱的数据集，用于标准化光学乐谱识别 (OMR) 评估。同时提出 OMR 归一化编辑距离 (OMR-NED)，这是一种细粒度错误分析指标，基于符号错误率 (SER) 改进，可评估音符、节拍、音高、变音记号等要素。通过基线实验和标准化数据划分支持该基准。
Motivation: OMR 领域长期缺乏统一的评估基准和精细化的评价指标，现有方法难以进行公平比较和深入分析错误类型。
Method: 构建 SMB 数据集（685 页，涵盖单声部、钢琴谱、四重奏等多种音乐织体，采用 Humdrum **kern 格式编码），并提出 OMR-NED 指标，提供对乐谱元素的细粒度错误分析。
Result: 提供了标准化数据划分上的基线实验结果，展示了 OMR-NED 在区分不同方法性能上的有效性。
Conclusion: SMB 和 OMR-NED 填补了 OMR 评估的空白，为研究人员和用户提供了标准化的比较工具。

papers.title: OmniFall: From Staged Through Synthetic to Wild, A Unified Multi-Domain Dataset for Robust Fall Detection
papers.abstract_en: Visual fall detection models are usually trained on small, staged datasets. Their real-world utility remains unclear; such data lacks diversity and evaluation protocols differ from paper to paper. We propose OmniFall, a unified benchmark of 15k videos (80 hours) with frame-level annotations in a single 16-class taxonomy. It spans three domains: OF-Staged unifies eight staged datasets with cross-subject and cross-view splits; OF-Synthetic adds 12k videos (17 h) with controlled demographic and environmental diversity; and OF-In-the-Wild provides a test-only set of genuine accident videos. We evaluate fine-tuned models as well as much larger zero-shot multimodal LLMs. On in-the-wild fall events, both do comparably well. The clinically critical fallen state is where they part: zero-shot models keep confusing fallen with lying, whereas models fine-tuned on synthetic data with explicit fallen-state scenes do substantially better. We release the unified annotations, the synthetic data, and the in-the-wild test set to foster the development of fall and fallen-state detectors for uncontrolled environments. Dataset: https://hf.co/datasets/simplexsigil2/omnifall
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniFall 是一个统一的多域跌倒检测基准，包含 15k 视频（80 小时）和帧级标注，划分为三个阶段（Staged、Synthetic、In-the-Wild）。摘要显示，在真实跌倒事件上，微调模型与零样本多模态大语言模型表现相当，但在关键的“倒下”状态检测中，微调模型明显优于零样本模型。该工作发布了统一标注、合成数据和真实世界测试集，旨在推动非受控环境下的跌倒检测研究。
Motivation: 现有视觉跌倒检测模型仅训练于小型、编排数据集，缺乏多样性且评估协议不统一，导致真实世界实用性不明确。
Method: 提出 OmniFall 基准，整合三个域：OF-Staged（8 个编排数据集）、OF-Synthetic（12k 合成视频，控制人口与环境多样性）和 OF-In-the-Wild（真实事故视频测试集）。采用统一的 16 类分类法，并评估了微调模型与零样本多模态大语言模型。
Result: 在真实世界跌倒视频上，微调模型和零样本模型表现相近；但在“倒下”状态检测上，零样本模型常将倒下与躺下混淆，而微调于含明确倒下场景合成数据的模型表现明显更好。
Conclusion: OmniFall 数据集和标注的发布旨在促进非受控环境下的跌倒与状态检测器开发。

summary_sections.method: 提出 OmniFall 基准，整合三个域：OF-Staged（8 个编排数据集）、OF-Synthetic（12k 合成视频，控制人口与环境多样性）和 OF-In-the-Wild（真实事故视频测试集）。采用统一的 16 类分类法，并评估了微调模型与零样本多模态大语言模型。
summary_sections.result: 在真实世界跌倒视频上，微调模型和零样本模型表现相近；但在“倒下”状态检测上，零样本模型常将倒下与躺下混淆，而微调于含明确倒下场景合成数据的模型表现明显更好。
summary_sections.conclusion: OmniFall 数据集和标注的发布旨在促进非受控环境下的跌倒与状态检测器开发。

papers.title: Multiplicity is an Inevitable and Inherent Challenge in Multimodal Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal learning has seen remarkable progress, particularly with large-scale pre-training across various modalities. Most current approaches are built on the assumption of a deterministic one-to-one alignment between modalities. However, this oversimplifies real-world multimodal relationships, where their nature is inherently many-to-many. The many-to-many property, or multiplicity, is not a side-effect of noise or annotation error, but an inevitable outcome of intra-modal variability, representational asymmetry, and task-dependent ambiguity in multimodal tasks. We argue that multiplicity is a fundamental bottleneck that affects all stages of the multimodal learning pipeline: from data construction to model training and evaluation benchmarks. By formalizing its causes and consequences, we demonstrate how ignoring multiplicity leads to training uncertainty, unreliable evaluation, and degraded dataset quality. This position paper calls for new research directions on multimodal learning, including multiplicity-aware learning frameworks and dataset construction and evaluation protocols.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，论证多模态学习中模态间关系的“多重性”（multiplicity）——即多对多映射——是不可避免且固有存在的挑战。多重性源于模态内变异、表征不对称性和任务依赖的模糊性，而非噪声或标注错误。文章指出忽略多重性会导致训练不确定性、评估不可靠和数据集质量下降，并呼吁发展多重性感知的学习框架、数据集构建和评估协议。
Motivation: 当前多模态学习普遍假设模态间存在确定性的一对一对齐，但现实世界中多模态关系本质上是多对多的。这一简化忽略了多重性，而多重性是多模态学习中的根本瓶颈，影响从数据构建到模型训练和评估的所有阶段。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁多模态学习研究应转向多重性感知的方法，包括新的学习框架、数据集构建和评估协议。文章强调多重性不是噪声副作用，而是内在特征。

papers.title: Towards Accurate State Estimation: Motion Dynamics Kalman Filter for 3D Multi-Object Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Precise 3D state estimation in multi-object tracking (MOT) is critical for self-driving cars, particularly for objects occluded. Motion modeling in the Kalman filter with a constant motion assumption is widely used in MOT methods, but it neglects the continuous changes in objects' motion caused by traffic in urban environments. Although recent research introduces a multimodel Kalman filter that incorporates multiple motion models, these approaches incur significant computational overhead from the simultaneous processing of multiple models. To this end, this work introduces a motion-dynamics Kalman filter (MD-KF) that overcomes the constant-motion assumption while preserving the singularity of the motion model. MD-KF models the changes in objects' motion over successive measurements as Gaussian distributions, and adaptively adjusts a weighted motion model to account for these variations. MD-KF consistently outperforms constant and multimodel KF across multiple datasets with a significant reduction in computation latency compared to multimodel approaches. The proposed approach demonstrates its superiority in trajectory estimation during occlusion and state estimation stability for stationary objects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出运动动力学卡尔曼滤波器（MD-KF），用于3D多目标跟踪中的精确状态估计，克服恒速运动假设的局限，同时保持单模型效率。MD-KF将物体运动变化建模为高斯分布并自适应调整加权运动模型，在多个数据集上优于恒速和多模型KF，且计算延迟显著降低。
Motivation: 现有卡尔曼滤波在3D多目标跟踪中常用恒速假设，忽略城市交通中物体运动的连续变化；多模型方法虽改进但计算开销大。
Method: 提出MD-KF，将物体运动随时间变化建模为高斯分布，自适应调整加权运动模型以反映这些变化。
Result: 在多个数据集上持续优于恒速和多模型KF，计算延迟显著低于多模型方法；在遮挡轨迹估计和静止目标状态估计稳定性上表现优越。
Conclusion: MD-KF兼顾精度和效率，适用于自动驾驶中的3D多目标跟踪。

papers.title: Deep learning with missing data
papers.abstract_en: In the context of multivariate nonparametric regression with missing covariates, we propose Pattern Embedded Neural Networks (PENNs), which can be applied in conjunction with any existing imputation technique. In addition to a neural network trained on the imputed data, PENNs pass the vectors of observation indicators through a second neural network to provide a compact representation. The outputs are then combined in a third neural network to produce final predictions. Our main theoretical result exploits an assumption that the observation patterns can be partitioned into cells on which the Bayes regression function behaves similarly, and belongs to a compositional Hölder class. It provides a finite-sample excess risk bound that holds for an arbitrary missingness mechanism, and in combination with a complementary minimax lower bound, demonstrates that our PENN estimator attains in typical cases the minimax rate of convergence as if the cells of the partition were known in advance, up to a poly-logarithmic factor in the sample size. Numerical experiments on simulated, semi-synthetic and real data confirm that the PENN estimator consistently improves, often dramatically, on standard neural networks without pattern embedding. Code to reproduce our experiments, as well as a tutorial on how to apply our method, is publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多元非参数回归中协变量缺失的问题，提出模式嵌入神经网络（PENNs），可与任意插补技术结合。除了在插补数据上训练的神经网络外，PENNs还将观测指标向量通过第二个神经网络提供紧凑表示，然后通过第三个神经网络组合输出。理论证明在特定假设下，PENN估计量达到极小极大收敛速率（忽略对数因子），数值实验表明相比标准神经网络有显著改进。
Motivation: 协变量缺失是实际回归中的常见问题，现有方法未充分利用缺失模式信息，导致预测性能受限。
Method: 提出模式嵌入神经网络（PENNs）：同时使用插补后数据的神经网络和观测模式指示向量的神经网络，将两者输出组合到第三个网络进行预测。
Result: 理论给出有限样本过剩风险界，并证明在典型情况下达到极小极大最优速率（除多对数因子）。数值实验（模拟、半合成、真实数据）表明PENN显著优于标准神经网络。
Conclusion: PENN是一种可结合任意插补方法、利用缺失模式信息的灵活框架，理论保证和实证效果均支持其有效性。代码公开可用。
