papers.title: Solution space path planning for supporting en-route air traffic control
papers.abstract_en: As technology advances, many path-planning algorithms have been proposed for Air Traffic Management, yet their operational adoption in tactical control remains limited, revealing a misalignment between algorithmic design priorities and air traffic controllers' needs. This underscores the need for decision-support solutions that are inherently interpretable, computationally efficient, and explicitly designed for human use. Focusing on this design challenge, this study develops a conflict-free path-planning algorithm for en-route Air Traffic Control (ATC) designed to be compatible with two guiding considerations: (1) the interpretability and flexibility offered by solution-space displays, which motivate constructing an algorithm that exposes all feasible safe actions and accommodates shifting optimization goals; and (2) the decision logic controllers naturally apply when enforcing operational constraints, such as separation standards, maneuverability limits, waypoint minimization, and routing practicality. Centered on these principles, the algorithm integrates three intent-based conflict detection methods -- distance-based, time-interval-based, and zone-based -- within a solution-space framework to identify conflict-free paths in computationally efficient ways. Additionally, vertex-based and edge-based search nodes are proposed for solution space path planning (SSPP), resulting in two variants -- SSPPV and SSPPE, respectively, which are evaluated in terms of computational speed and solution quality. Empirical results show that SSPPV paired with zone-based conflict detection achieves the best performance, computing paths in 3.69 ms on average in operational-relevant scenarios based on the Delta sector of the Maastricht Upper Area Control Centre (MUAC) using a 5 nmi grid.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对航路空中交通管制（ATC）中的路径规划问题，提出一种基于解空间（solution space）的冲突避免路径规划算法。该算法集成三种意图驱动的冲突检测方法（距离法、时间间隔法、区域法），并引入顶点搜索（SSPPV）和边搜索（SSPPE）两种变体。在马斯特里赫特上部区域管制中心（MUAC）Delta扇区的运行场景下，SSPPV结合区域冲突检测在5海里网格上平均计算时间为3.69毫秒。
Motivation: 现有路径规划算法在战术管制中应用有限，因为设计优先级与管制员实际需求脱节，缺乏可解释性和计算效率，且未充分考虑人类决策逻辑。
Method: 提出解空间路径规划（SSPP）算法，包含三种冲突检测方法（距离、时间间隔、区域）以及顶点搜索（SSPPV）和边搜索（SSPPE）两种节点搜索策略，旨在暴露所有可行安全动作并适应变化的目标。
Result: 基于MUAC Delta扇区的运行场景测试，SSPPV结合区域冲突检测获得最佳性能，平均计算时间为3.69毫秒（5海里网格）。
Conclusion: 该算法具有可解释性和计算效率，能与解空间显示兼容，支持管制员决策，但摘要未提及其他扇区或更复杂场景的泛化性限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spectral Geometry and Bosonic-Bloch Probes: Explorations in Quantum Learning
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies how spectral geometry emerges in quantum learning models and how it can be diagnosed with physically grounded probes. In graph-regularized quantum networks, training reorganizes the output similarity graph, increases the effective spectral dimension Delta S = +0.23, and reshapes the Laplacian spectrum. Edge-resolved two-boson interference directly probes this restructuring: the bosonic enhancement Delta P_uv correlates with the Fiedler edge split |Delta v_2| (r = -0.50), linking learned spectral partitions to interference signatures. A phase diagram shows a nonmonotonic dependence of performance on coupling strength gamma and noise delta, with graph regularization improving fidelity only in a restricted regime; hardware experiments confirm the predicted interference behavior within shot-noise uncertainty. We also analyze a hybrid quantum autoencoder and introduce Bloch-space drift as a geometric diagnostic of its latent representation. With an unsupervised benign-data threshold, the model achieves high ranking performance (ROC-AUC about 0.99) and negligible false-negative rates. Absolute Bloch drift strongly discriminates anomalies (ROC-AUC at least about 0.9), while consecutive drift is near random (ROC-AUC about 0.5), showing that detection arises from persistent state-space displacement rather than local fluctuations. Through the geometry of reduced single-qubit states and associated quantum Fisher information, these results show that learning-induced spectral organization appears as measurable quantum-state structure, establishing a unified spectral-geometric framework for diagnosing quantum learning systems with bosonic and Bloch probes.

papers.title: AlgoBench: Benchmarking Algorithmic Adaptation in Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: High pass rates on established programming benchmarks such as HumanEval and LiveCodeBench do not always show whether a model can reason about algorithms. Many fixed benchmarks eventually become part of the public training ecosystem through released problem statements, editorials, and generated solutions, allowing later models to improve partly by exposure rather than by stronger algorithmic ability. We introduce ALGOBENCH, a framework that automatically builds novel algorithmic problems from known competitive-programming problems through structured constraint-shifting transformations. Each accepted ALGOBENCH variant is traceable to a source problem, but must make the original reference algorithm fail. Beyond pass@$k$, we introduce complexity-aware metrics -- including OPTT, OPTS, TRAPRATE, GAPT, and CONSENS -- to test whether a solution is not only functionally correct but also asymptotically suitable for the generated problem. Experiments across multiple LLMs and prompting strategies show that performance drops sharply on ALGOBENCH variants, retrieval can increase reuse of the old algorithm, and many correct-looking solutions fail to meet the required complexity. Error analysis shows that failures are mainly algorithmic rather than implementation-level, suggesting that ALGOBENCH evaluates adaptation beyond functional correctness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 现有编程基准（如HumanEval）的高通过率不能体现模型的算法推理能力，因为它们可能已被训练数据污染。本文提出ALGOBENCH，通过结构化的约束变换自动从已知竞赛题生成新变体，使原参考算法失效。同时引入复杂度感知指标（OPTT、OPTS等）评估解决方案的功能正确性和渐进复杂度。实验表明，LLMs在ALGOBENCH上性能显著下降，检索会加剧旧算法复用，许多看似正确的解不符合复杂度要求，且失败主要源于算法层面而非实现层面。
Motivation: 现有固定编程基准可能被训练数据污染，导致通过率不能反映真实的算法推理能力，亟需能够评估模型算法适应性的动态基准。
Method: 提出ALGOBENCH框架，从已知竞赛题出发，通过结构化的约束变换（如改变约束条件、操作顺序等）自动生成新的算法变体，确保原参考算法在新变体上失效。并引入复杂度感知指标（OPTT、OPTS、TRAPRATE、GAPT、CONSENS）来评估解的功能正确性和渐进复杂度。
Result: 多个LLM和提示策略在ALGOBENCH变体上的性能急剧下降，检索增强会提高旧算法复用率，许多功能正确的解未能满足所需复杂度要求。错误分析表明失败主要是算法层面的，而非实现层面。
Conclusion: ALGOBENCH能够有效评估模型在功能正确性之外的算法适应能力，揭示现有模型在算法推理上的不足。

papers.title: Synergistic Perception-Reasoning Governance: Grounding Medical MLLMs with Verifiable Anatomical Evidence
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show strong promise for clinical VQA and radiology report generation, yet inference-time hallucinations still undermine trustworthy use: models can produce fluent conclusions that conflict with imaging evidence. Existing mitigation strategies typically rely on additional training, external retrieval/knowledge bases, or multi-stage post-hoc verification, which increases cost and pipeline complexity and often generalizes poorly across models and tasks.To address this, we propose a holistic, training-free evidence-injection framework that systematically mitigates hallucinations through dual-side evidence injection. By leveraging ROI priors acquired using MedSAM in our implementation, we recalibrate the visual perception trajectory via ROI-guided activation modulation while anchoring the textual reasoning trajectory by mapping anatomical coordinates into discrete semantic tokens as verifiable external memory. Then we introduce a task-aware dynamic router to select modality-specific interventions based on task semantics, balancing perceptual grounding and linguistic fluency. We conduct systematic evaluations on 2 tasks and 5 datasets using \texttt{LLaVA-1.5-7B}, \texttt{LLaVA-Med-1.5-7B}, \texttt{Qwen3-VL-8B/32B}, and \texttt{InternVL-3.5-8B/38B}. Controlled ablations and visualizations further validate the framework, which consistently outperforms baselines across medical benchmarks, improving close-ended accuracy by up to $\sim\mathbf{6}\%\uparrow$ and reducing open-ended hallucinations by $\sim\mathbf{35}\%\downarrow$. The code has been made available on GitHub: \href{https://github.com/Henry991115/SPRG}{\textcolor{blue}{https://github.com/Henry991115/SPRG}}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需额外训练的证据注入框架（SPRG），通过双端证据注入缓解医学多模态大模型（MLLMs）的幻觉问题。视觉侧利用MedSAM获取ROI先验，通过激活调制校准感知轨迹；文本侧将解剖坐标映射为离散语义token作为可验证外部记忆。引入任务感知动态路由器选择模态干预策略。在2个任务5个数据集上使用LLaVA-1.5-7B等多个模型评估，闭端准确率提升约6%，开放端幻觉降低约35%。
Motivation: 医学MLLMs在临床VQA和报告生成中存在推理时幻觉，现有缓解方法依赖额外训练或外部知识库，成本高且泛化差。
Method: 提出无训练的证据注入框架：利用MedSAM获取ROI先验进行视觉感知激活调制；将解剖坐标映射为离散语义token作为文本推理锚定；任务感知动态路由器根据任务语义选择模态干预。
Result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B、LLaVA-Med-1.5-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B/32B、InternVL-3.5-8B/38B上，闭端准确率提升约6%，开放端幻觉降低约35%。
Conclusion: 该框架为训练自由的医学MLLM幻觉缓解提供了有效方案，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Joint Medical Image Enhancement and Segmentation with Diffusion-based Symbiotic Information Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Image quality is critical for accurate medical diagnosis. However, MRI, CT, and ultrasound images are often of low resolution and quality due to cost constraints, complicating the visualization of key anatomical structures and lesions. While such limitations are common in practice, traditional methods treat image enhancement as a separate preprocessing step, failing to fully leverage its potential synergy with image segmentation. To address this, we propose DiSIINet (Diffusion-based Symbiotic Information Interaction Network), which is built on the principle that enhancement and segmentation should mutually reinforce each other in a unified model. Based on Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models (DDIM), DiSIINet integrates an enhancement branch and a segmentation branch. These branches interact through a novel Symbiotic Information Interaction (SII) module, which facilitates dynamic, feature-level information exchange via cross-attention during the reverse diffusion process. This design enables both tasks to iteratively improve each other. The DDIM backbone ensures high-quality output and efficient inference through deterministic sampling. Experiments on multi-modal medical datasets (MRI, CT, ultrasound) show that DiSIINet achieves significant performance improvements compared to sequential or independent enhancement and segmentation approaches. The code is available at: https://github.com/Reconsider80/DiSIINet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiSIINet，基于扩散模型的联合医学图像增强与分割框架，通过共生信息交互模块实现特征级动态信息交换，在 MRI、CT 和超声数据集上显著优于顺序或独立处理方法。
Motivation: 传统方法将图像增强视为独立预处理步骤，未能充分利用其与分割的潜在协同效应。
Method: 基于去噪扩散隐式模型（DDIM），构建增强分支和分割分支，通过共生信息交互（SII）模块在反向扩散过程中使用交叉注意力实现动态特征级信息交换。
Result: 在多模态医学数据集（MRI、CT、超声）上取得了显著的性能提升。
Conclusion: 增强与分割在统一模型中的相互强化能够有效提升医学图像分析性能。

papers.title: Enhancing Oracle Bone Inscription Recognition via Multi-Scale Layer Attention
papers.abstract_en: Oracle Bone Inscriptions (OBIs) recognition plays a crucial role in understanding ancient Chinese culture. However, accurately recognizing OBIs remains highly challenging due to their complex, irregular, and often degraded shapes. Traditional methods rely on expert knowledge and manual analysis, which are time-consuming and error-prone. Although deep learning has greatly advanced general image recognition, existing methods struggle to capture the fine-grained details and subtle variations inherent in OBIs, resulting in limited performance. Even most recent and effective layer attention techniques are designed to capture fine-grained dependencies through enhanced inter-layer interactions, yet they still exhibit only marginal improvements in OBIs recognition. To address these limitations, we propose Multi-Scale Layer Attention (MSLA), a novel paradigm that explicitly models both multi-scale and cross-layer feature interactions. By enriching the representation with fine-grained details across multiple spatial scales, MSLA enables more accurate and robust OBIs recognition. Extensive experiments on large-scale OBIs datasets demonstrate that MSLA consistently outperforms existing attention mechanisms while maintaining computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多尺度层注意力（MSLA），通过显式建模多尺度和跨层特征交互，提升甲骨文识别的细粒度细节捕捉能力。实验表明，在大规模甲骨文数据集上MSLA一致优于现有注意力机制，且计算高效。
Motivation: 甲骨文（OBI）识别因字形复杂、不规则且易退化而困难。现有深度学习方法难以捕捉细粒度细节，即使最新的层注意力技术改进也有限。
Method: 提出Multi-Scale Layer Attention (MSLA)，一种新范式，显式建模多尺度和跨层特征交互，通过多空间尺度上的细粒度细节丰富表示。
Result: 在大规模甲骨文数据集上，MSLA一致优于现有注意力机制，同时保持计算效率。
Conclusion: MSLA为甲骨文识别提供了更准确鲁棒的方法，摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Active Sensing for RIS-Aided Tracking and Power Control: A Hybrid Neuroevolution and Supervised Learning Approach
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies energy efficient tracking of power-limited mobile users with the assistance of a Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface (RIS). Since localization pilot transmissions dominate the energy budget of power-constrained devices, we introduce a low-overhead feedback link from the Base Station (BS) to the user to enable dynamic uplink power control. To navigate the discrete and decentralized nature of this active sensing problem, we propose a novel Dual-Agent (DA) deep learning framework that jointly optimizes the discrete RIS phase profiles and the UE's transmit power in real time. Specifically, our approach employs a hybrid training methodology integrating the neuroevolution paradigm with supervised learning, effectively overcoming the non-differentiability of discrete phase responses from the RIS unit elements and the strict information bottleneck of single-bit feedback messages for pilot power control. The proposed DA active sensing framework can be applied with both single- and multi-antenna BSs, the latter with only minor modifications in the structure of one NN: an additional output branch with appropriate structure is included for the latter case to select a valid digital combiner from a finite set. Extensive numerical simulations demonstrate that the proposed scheme achieves highly accurate and robust tracking across diverse target motion models, outperforming extended Kalman and particle filters, as well as, machine learning-based trackers. Furthermore, in static localization, it is shown to significantly outperform traditional fingerprinting schemes, deep reinforcement learning baselines, and standard backpropagation-based estimators.
papers.comment: Submitted to an IEEE journal, 16 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对RIS辅助的功率受限移动用户能量高效跟踪问题，提出一种双智能体深度学习框架，通过混合神经进化和监督学习联合优化离散RIS相位和用户发射功率。该方法利用低开销反馈链路实现动态上行功率控制。数值模拟表明，该方法在多种目标运动模型下实现高精度鲁棒跟踪，优于扩展卡尔曼滤波、粒子滤波以及基于机器学习的跟踪器。在静态定位中，也显著优于传统指纹方案、深度强化学习基线和标准反向传播估计器。
Motivation: 定位导频传输是功率受限设备的主要耗能因素，现有方法未有效利用RIS实现低开销功率控制。该问题具有离散和非中心特性，需要新的优化框架。
Method: 提出Dual-Agent深度学习框架，采用混合训练方法整合神经进化与监督学习，克服RIS离散相位响应的不可微性和单比特反馈的信息瓶颈。支持单/多天线BS，多天线时仅需在NN中添加一个输出分支选择数字合并器。
Result: 数值实验表明，跟踪精度和鲁棒性超过扩展卡尔曼滤波、粒子滤波和基于机器学习的跟踪器；静态定位中优于传统指纹法、深度强化学习和反向传播估计器。
Conclusion: 所提方法能有效解决RIS辅助跟踪中的离散优化和能量效率问题，实现高精度鲁棒跟踪与静态定位。

summary_sections.motivation: 定位导频传输是功率受限设备的主要耗能因素，现有方法未有效利用RIS实现低开销功率控制。该问题具有离散和非中心特性，需要新的优化框架。
summary_sections.method: 提出Dual-Agent深度学习框架，采用混合训练方法整合神经进化与监督学习，克服RIS离散相位响应的不可微性和单比特反馈的信息瓶颈。支持单/多天线BS，多天线时仅需在NN中添加一个输出分支选择数字合并器。

papers.title: SWE-Router: Routing in Multi-turn Agentic Software Engineering Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) embedded in multi-turn agentic harnesses are reshaping software engineering (SWE), but routing every task to a frontier model is wasteful when many issues admit cheap fixes. Existing LLM routers operate on the task description alone, which inherits an information-theoretic Bayes-error floor in agentic settings: a similar issue can hide either a localized typo or a multi-module refactor, and the prompt does not separate the two. We introduce SWE-Router, a value-based temporal approach that lets a cheap model run for a few exploratory turns and reads the resulting partial trajectory before deciding whether to continue cheaply or to escalate to an expensive model. We provide a Bayes-optimality theorem showing that conditioning on the partial trajectory never harms routing and is strictly better whenever exploration is informative. Across the LLM pairs of weak and strong models spanning the contemporary cost--capability frontier, we show that SWE-Router greatly improves the cost efficiency of SWE tasks, while maintaining the majority of the performances of the stronger model. We additionally release a multi-LLM trajectory dataset which allows reproduction of our trajectory-level routing.
papers.comment: The 5th Deep Learning for Code Workshop, ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SWE-Router，一种用于多轮智能体软件工程任务的值基时间路由方法。它允许廉价模型先运行几轮探索，根据部分轨迹决定是否升级到昂贵模型，从而在保持强模型大部分性能的同时大幅提升成本效率。作者给出了贝叶斯最优性定理，并发布了一个多LLM轨迹数据集以支持复现。
Motivation: 现有LLM路由仅依赖任务描述，在智能体设置中存在信息论贝叶斯误差下限，因为类似问题可能隐藏不同复杂度的修复。
Method: SWE-Router采用值基时间方法：先让廉价模型运行少量探索轮次，读取部分轨迹后再决定继续使用廉价模型还是升级到昂贵模型。
Result: 在当代成本-能力边界上的弱-强LLM对中，SWE-Router显著提升了SWE任务的成本效率，同时保持了强模型的大部分性能。
Conclusion: 作者提供了贝叶斯最优性定理，证明基于部分轨迹的条件路由不会损害路由性能，且在探索提供信息时严格更优。

papers.title: AGE: Adaptive-masking for Graph Embedding in Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: GraphRAG is an extension of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) that supports large language models (LLMs) by referring to graph-structured data as external knowledge. While this technique ideally captures intricate relationships, it often struggles with graph representations for LLMs, particularly for frozen LLMs, due to the misalignment between graph-based and text-based latent features. We tackle this issue by introducing the {\it Adaptive-masking for Graph Embedding (AGE)}. AGE employs a Transformer in a mask-based self-supervised learning (SSL) approach. We designed the architecture similar to text embedding encoders, addressing the latent feature misalignment. In contrast to natural language texts, graphs are concise representations, and there exist {\it key nodes} that hold dominant contextual information, which are challenging to predict from their surroundings. Masking such key nodes leads to inefficiency in the SSL process. Therefore, AGE focuses on predicting nodes apart from key nodes, utilizing a learnable node sampler. Our experimental results indicate that AGE significantly improves approaches using non-parametric search component in GraphQA tasks, achieving superior accuracy across four benchmark datasets with distinct characteristics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自适应掩码图嵌入（AGE），用于GraphRAG中解决图与文本潜在特征不对齐问题。AGE采用类似文本编码器的Transformer结构和基于掩码的自监督学习，通过可学习节点采样器避免掩码关键节点导致的低效，在GraphQA任务上四个基准数据集取得更高准确率。
Motivation: GraphRAG中图表示与冻结LLM的文本潜在特征存在不对齐，且图结构中关键节点被掩码会导致自监督学习效率低下。
Method: 设计类似文本嵌入编码器的Transformer架构，采用基于掩码的自监督学习；通过可学习节点采样器仅预测非关键节点，避免掩码关键节点。
Result: 在四个不同特征的GraphQA基准数据集上，AGE显著改进使用非参数搜索组件的方法，实现更高准确率。
Conclusion: 自适应掩码策略和图编码器结构对齐可有效提升GraphRAG系统性能。

papers.title: Spatio-Temporal Gaussian Process for Building Terrain-Incorporating Wind Power Curves
papers.abstract_en: Accurate modeling of wind turbine power curves is crucial for optimal wind farm operation. Nearly all existing power curve models focus on temporal variables such as wind speed and temperature while overlooking the influence of terrain covariates, which governs inflow wind conditions and thus also affects wind power production. This paper proposes a nonparametric spatio-temporal Gaussian process model that integrates temporal environmental covariates with spatial terrain features. The model falls in the category of spatial-temporal Gaussian process models with data on a grid. The challenge to be addressed is that the spatio-temporal modeling require certain temporal alignment among the data, a property that the wind farm data does not have. Our solution strategy is to construct a shared representative temporal covariate set which not only aligns the temporal inputs but also has a size an order of magnitude smaller than the original data size. With this transformation, our resulting model is able to employ a separable kernel structure that captures both spatial and temporal dependencies. Empirical analysis on a real wind farm dataset shows that our method improves predictive accuracy over existing baselines and can be used to quantify the various impact of the terrain characteristics on turbine performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有风力发电机功率曲线模型忽略地形协变量的问题，提出一种非参数时空高斯过程模型，整合时间环境变量与空间地形特征。通过构建共享的代表性时间协变量集，解决了风场数据时间不对齐的问题，并采用可分离核结构捕获时空依赖。在真实风场数据集上，该方法提升了预测精度，并能量化地形特征对风机性能的影响。
Motivation: 现有功率曲线模型主要关注风速、温度等时间变量，忽视了地形协变量对入流条件的影响，导致模型不准确。
Method: 提出一个非参数时空高斯过程模型，利用数据网格上的时空高斯过程框架；通过构建一个共享的代表性时间协变量集来对齐时间输入，该集合大小比原始数据小一个数量级，从而允许使用可分离核结构。
Result: 在真实风场数据集上的实证分析表明，该方法相比现有基线提高了预测精度，并可用于量化地形特征对风机性能的各种影响。
Conclusion: 该模型成功整合了地形信息，为构建考虑地形的功率曲线提供了有效手段，并揭示了地形对风能产量的影响。

papers.title: DigitalCoach: Communication and Grounding Gaps in Human and Agentic Computer Use Coaching
papers.abstract_en: Agents are increasingly capable of automating software tasks, but can they teach humans how to use software themselves? We introduce DigitalCoach, a multimodal dataset of 72 human expert-novice computer use coaching sessions consisting of 22,752 dialogue turns grounded in 28.1 hours of screen and input event recordings across five software applications. We use DigitalCoach to evaluate whether state-of-the-art models can teach humans how to use computers. Automated evaluation shows that models differ from humans in how they coach: models provide more direct instructions, but fewer explanations, error diagnoses, and knowledge-check questions. When we fix the coaching method, models produce utterances similar to human references yet poorly grounded in visual context. Interactive evaluation confirms that model coaches cause learners to passively follow instructions without deeper engagement and fall short in visual grounding. DigitalCoach lays a foundation for collaborative and proactive computer use coaching agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了DigitalCoach，一个包含72次人类专家-新手计算机使用辅导会话的多模态数据集，包含22,752轮对话和28.1小时的屏幕及输入事件记录。自动评估显示，最先进的模型在辅导时更倾向于直接指令，而较少提供解释、错误诊断和知识检查问题。交互评估表明，模型辅导导致学习者被动跟随指令，缺乏深度参与，且在视觉上下文接地方面表现不佳。
Motivation: 现有智能体能够自动化软件任务，但它们在教授人类使用软件方面的能力尚未得到充分研究。
Method: 构建了DigitalCoach数据集，包含人类专家-新手辅导会话，并设计了自动评估和交互评估两种方式，比较人类辅导与模型辅导的差异。
Result: 自动评估显示模型提供更多直接指令，但更少解释、错误诊断和知识检查问题；交互评估表明模型辅导导致学习者被动跟随，且视觉接地不足。
Conclusion: DigitalCoach为协作性和主动性的计算机使用辅导代理奠定了基础，并揭示了当前模型在辅导中的不足。

papers.title: DataComp-VLM: Improved Open Datasets for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Building performant Vision-Language Models (VLMs) requires carefully curating large-scale training datasets, yet the community lacks systematic benchmarks for evaluating such curation strategies. We introduce DataComp for VLMs (DCVLM), a benchmark for controlled data-centric experiments to improve VLM training. As part of DCVLM, we collect 160 datasets spanning four data types -- image-caption pairs, multimodal interleaved documents, text-only, and instruction-tuning data -- into a corpus of 6T multimodal tokens. DCVLM allows participants to test curation strategies (filtering, mixing, formatting, sampling) across 1B-8B models and 6.25B-200B token budgets. Models are then evaluated on a carefully selected suite of up to 52 downstream benchmarks across 9 domains. We conduct extensive experiments on DCVLM and find that data mixing, not filtering, is key to a high-quality training dataset: instruction-heavy mixtures scale better than caption-heavy ones, with gains widening at larger scales. The resulting dataset, DCVLM-Baseline, enables training an 8B VLM to 63.6% accuracy on our 33-task core suite with 200B training tokens. Compared to FineVision, the state-of-the-art open VLM training dataset, this represents an improvement of +5.4pp. DCVLM and all accompanying artifacts will be made publicly available at https://www.datacomp.ai/dcvlm/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 DataComp-VLM (DCVLM)，一个用于视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 数据策展策略的系统性基准测试平台。DCVLM 收集了包含图像-文本对、多模态交错文档、纯文本和指令微调数据的 160 个数据集，共计 6T 多模态 tokens。实验发现数据混合（mixing）比过滤（filtering）更重要，指令密集型混合比标题密集型混合扩展性更好。基于此的 DCVLM-Baseline 数据集在 8B 模型上使用 200B tokens 训练，在 33 个任务核心套件上达到 63.6% 准确率，比 FineVision 提升 5.4 个百分点。
Motivation: 当前 VLM 训练依赖大规模数据集，但缺乏系统性的基准来评估不同的数据策展策略（如过滤、混合、格式化、采样）。
Method: 构建 DCVLM 基准，包含 160 个数据集（4 种数据类型）共 6T tokens，支持在 1B-8B 模型和 6.25B-200B token 预算下测试策展策略。通过大量实验比较数据过滤与混合的效果。
Result: 数据混合是提升训练质量的关键，指令密集型混合在更大规模下优势更明显。DCVLM-Baseline 在 8B 模型、200B tokens 下达到 63.6% 准确率，比 FineVision 高 5.4 个百分点。
Conclusion: DCVLM 为 VLM 数据策展研究提供了标准化平台，并揭示了数据混合策略的重要性。所有资源将公开。

papers.title: Room for Error: Large-Scale Simulation of Over-the-Air Acoustic Attacks
papers.abstract_en: While voice control is rapidly becoming a ubiquitous vector of human-AI communication, the risks facing these systems remain poorly understood. This is, in part, a product of the difficulties in scaling strictly digital adversarial workflows to the physical world. These scale barriers have led the community to abstract away key acoustic factors relating to detectability and the influence of geometry on acoustics. These methodological and metrological shortcomings undermine our understanding of risk. We illuminate these issues through real-world testing, conceptual discussions, and a novel, high-throughput reality simulation framework. By testing over 8 million adversarial evaluations, we demonstrate that acoustic awareness yields relative Word Error Rate increases of up to 94.5\% under Whisper and wav2vec. We employ this framework to explore a formalize and operationalize a Dual-Form Signal to Noise Ratio to decouple source stealth from victim attack efficacy, resolving a crucial limitation in current works. This lays the groundwork for repeatable, verifiable research that embraces, rather than abstracts, the acoustic environment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过大规模模拟研究了空中声学攻击对语音控制系统的威胁，提出了一个高吞吐量的现实仿真框架，并在超过800万次对抗性评估中验证了攻击效果。作者引入双形式信噪比（Dual-Form SNR）概念，以解耦攻击源的隐蔽性与受害者的攻击效能，解决当前研究的局限性。
Motivation: 现有研究难以将数字对抗攻击扩展到物理世界，导致对声学因素（如可检测性和几何影响）的抽象化，削弱了对实际风险的理解。
Method: 提出了一个高吞吐量的现实仿真框架，通过真实世界测试和概念讨论，形式化并操作化了双形式信噪比（Dual-Form Signal-to-Noise Ratio），并进行了超过800万次对抗性评估。
Result: 在Whisper和wav2vec模型下，声学感知攻击导致相对词错误率（WER）提升高达94.5%。
Conclusion: 该框架为可重复、可验证的研究奠定了基础，强调应接纳而非抽象化声学环境。

papers.title: What Was That Again? Certified Robustness for Automatic Speech Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Automatic Speech Recognition systems are notoriously both sensitive to adversarial and benign perturbations. While this has been repeatedly demonstrated using reference datasets, detecting such behaviors in deployed systems is incredibly challenging, due to the absence of oracle knowledge of the true transcription. We demonstrate that employing a certification-inspired mechanism can significantly decrease WER, increase recall, and decrease the Spearman correlation between confidence and WER. We achieve this through a dual-gate diagnostic pipeline: a Two-Sided Atomic Audit that accumulates statistical wealth to certify both token existence and adversarial exclusion, and a Rank-Based Tournament that selects the winning sequence. Our evaluations across four diverse architectures demonstrate up to a 55% relative reduction in Word Error Rate, while also providing granular word- and sentence-level certifications to enhance acoustic security.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动语音识别（ASR）系统对对抗性和良性扰动敏感的问题，提出了一种基于认证的诊断管线，包括双边原子审计（Two-Sided Atomic Audit）和排名锦标赛（Rank-Based Tournament），能够显著降低词错误率（WER）并提高召回率，同时提供词级和句级认证以增强声学安全性。在四种不同架构上的评估显示，WER相对降低高达55%。
Motivation: ASR系统对扰动敏感，但在部署中由于缺乏真实转录的 oracle 知识，检测此类行为极为困难。现有方法难以在无法获取真实转录时可靠地识别错误。
Method: 提出一个双门诊断管线：1）双边原子审计，通过累积统计证据来认证令牌存在性和对抗性排除；2）排名锦标赛，选择获胜序列。该方法受认证机制启发。
Result: 在四种不同ASR架构上，词错误率（WER）相对降低高达55%，同时召回率提升，置信度与WER之间的Spearman相关性降低。提供细粒度的词级和句级认证。
Conclusion: 该认证驱动的诊断方法能有效提升ASR系统对扰动的鲁棒性，并增强声学安全性，但局限于特定认证设置和评估架构。

papers.title: Variable Bound Tightening for Nash Equilibrium Computation in Multiplayer Imperfect-Information Games
papers.abstract_en: There has been significant recent progress in algorithms for approximation of Nash equilibrium in large two-player zero-sum imperfect-information games and exact computation of Nash equilibrium in multiplayer strategic-form games. While counterfactual regret minimization and fictitious play are scalable to large games and have convergence guarantees in two-player zero-sum games, they do not guarantee convergence to Nash equilibrium in multiplayer games. Recently, an approach has been presented for exact computation of Nash equilibrium in multiplayer imperfect-information games that solves a quadratically constrained program based on a nonlinear complementarity problem formulation derived from the sequence-form game representation. This formulation was solved using Gurobi's nonconvex quadratic solver, which employs spatial branch-and-bound to iteratively refine variable bounds by solving convex relaxations of bilinear terms via McCormick envelopes. During presolve, Gurobi introduces auxiliary variables and, in some cases, binary variables, leading to an internal MIQCP reformulation. This approach was demonstrated to outperform prior algorithms from the Gambit software suite and quickly solve three-player Kuhn poker after removal of dominated actions; however, the algorithm was not able to solve the full version of the game within 24 hours. In this paper, we derive finite bounds on slack and multiplier variables in the nonlinear complementarity formulation. These bounds strengthen the convex relaxations used within spatial branch-and-bound and lead to substantial computational improvements. We demonstrate the impact of the proposed bounds on exact Nash equilibrium computation in three-player Kuhn poker.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多人非完美信息博弈中的纳什均衡精确计算问题，在前人基于非线性互补问题（NCP）的序列形式求解方法基础上，推导了松弛变量和乘子变量的有限界，这些界加强了空间分支定界法中使用的凸松弛，从而显著提升计算效率。以三人Kuhn扑克为例验证了改进效果。
Motivation: 现有方法在求解多人非完美信息博弈的纳什均衡时，使用Gurobi的非凸二次求解器，但受限于变量界的松弛质量，对于完整版本的三人Kuhn扑克无法在24小时内求解。
Method: 通过推导NCP公式中松弛变量和乘子变量的有限界，这些界在空间分支定界法的预处理阶段用于加强McCormick包络的凸松弛，减少分支定界搜索空间。
Result: 在三人Kuhn扑克上，所提出的有限界显著加速了精确纳什均衡的计算，使得完整版本的游戏可解，而此前无法在24小时内完成。
Conclusion: 作者强调有限界的推导是提升多人非完美信息博弈均衡求解效率的关键技术，且该方法具有推广到其他博弈的潜力。

papers.title: Inverse Reinforcement Learning for Interpretable Keystroke Biomarkers in Parkinson's Disease
papers.abstract_en: Keystroke dynamics have been explored extensively as a passive digital biomarker for Parkinson's disease (PD), typically by extracting summary statistics from typing timing and training a classifier to discriminate PD from healthy controls. We instead apply inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) to keystroke data, modeling each keystroke as a discrete choice over typing speed and recovering, per subject, an interpretable reward function that explains their observed timing behavior. To our knowledge this is the first application of IRL to keystroke dynamics. On the public neuroQWERTY MIT-CSXPD dataset (85 subjects, 42 with PD), an initial four-parameter reward decomposition (speed, effort, smoothness, hand-alternation cost) was found to suffer severe feature collinearity between two terms ($r=1.000$ in typical contexts); we diagnose and correct this, yielding an identifiable three-parameter model. The recovered speed-preference weight correlates with UPDRS-III severity at $r=-0.607$ ($p<0.001$, $n=42$), replicates independently across two sub-cohorts, is stable across nine sensitivity configurations, and retains a statistically significant contribution beyond raw typing speed alone (incremental $R^2$ from 0.194 to 0.338, $p=0.006$). Two other recovered weights (consistency, hand-alternation) did not survive confound checks and are reported as negative results. We document two implementation bugs found during adversarial code review (session-boundary contamination, a rolling-window data leakage) and show the headline result is materially unchanged after fixing both. We discuss this result in the context of a literature where reported accuracies vary widely between studies (pooled AUC 0.85, I^2=94% in a 2022 meta-analysis), and argue that the validation process itself, not only the correlation coefficient, is part of the contribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次将逆向强化学习应用于键盘动力学数据，为帕金森病构建可解释的生物标记物。通过建模每次按键作为打字速度的离散选择，恢复每位受试者的奖励函数。在公共数据集上，恢复的速度偏好权重与UPDRS-III严重程度显著相关，且独立于原始打字速度。
Motivation: 现有键盘动力学生物标记物通常提取汇总统计并训练分类器，缺乏可解释性。本文试图通过逆向强化学习恢复个体化的、可解释的奖励函数，以更好地理解帕金森病的运动控制缺陷。
Method: 应用逆向强化学习对键盘动力学建模，将每次按键视为对打字速度的离散选择，每名受试者恢复一个可解释的奖励函数。初始四参数模型存在严重共线性，修正后采用可识别的三参数模型（速度、一致性、手交替成本）。
Result: 速度偏好权重与UPDRS-III严重程度相关系数 r=-0.607 (p<0.001, n=42)，在两个子队列中独立复现，九种敏感性设置下稳定，且对原始打字速度有增量解释力（R²从0.194增至0.338, p=0.006）。一致性和手交替权重未通过混杂检查，报告为阴性结果。
Conclusion: 逆向强化学习可从键盘动力学中提取可解释的帕金森病生物标记物，但验证过程的严谨性本身是贡献的重要组成部分。该结果在文献中广泛变化的报告准确率背景下具有意义。

papers.title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Compounding Failures in Agentic Persuasion via Taxonomic Strategy Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Foundation-model agents in multi-step, open-ended environments frequently suffer from compounding errors, where early mistakes contaminate long-horizon trajectories. While Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) succeeds in deterministic domains, agents in subjective tasks like persuasion experience severe problem drift and sycophantic conformity. We identify semantic leakage in standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) as a reproducible trigger for these failures, as standard RAG prioritizes vocabulary overlap over logical necessity. To eliminate this leakage, we introduce Taxonomic Strategy RAG (TS-RAG), a systems intervention that routes strategies through a discrete categorical bottleneck to decouple argumentative structure from topical content. Zero-shot, cross-domain evaluations demonstrate that TS-RAG significantly improves the transfer of abstract logic where standard semantic retrieval collapses. Crucially, TS-RAG acts as a "capability bridge" in asymmetric deployments, empowering lightweight persuaders to consistently defeat parametrically superior opponents (improving win rates from 70.5 to 78.5) and accelerating argumentative efficiency. Finally, we introduce trace-level diagnostics via a turn-by-turn Debate State Representation (DSR), demonstrating the necessity of strict constraints to prevent evaluation collapse via default agentic sycophancy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文诊断了基础模型代理在多步开放环境中因语义泄漏导致的复合错误，尤其是在主观说服任务中。提出Taxonomic Strategy RAG（TS-RAG），通过离散分类瓶颈解耦论证结构与主题内容，消除标准RAG的语义泄漏。零样本评估显示TS-RAG能改善抽象逻辑迁移，使轻量说服者击败参数更优对手（胜率从70.5提升至78.5），并引入辩论状态表示（DSR）进行诊断。
Motivation: 在主观说服任务中，多代理辩论（MAD）易出现问题漂移和谄媚从众，标准RAG因优先词汇重叠而非逻辑必要性导致复合错误。
Method: 提出Taxonomic Strategy RAG（TS-RAG），通过离散分类瓶颈路由策略，将论证结构与主题内容解耦，避免语义泄漏。
Result: 零样本跨域评估显示，TS-RAG显著改善了标准语义检索失效情况下的抽象逻辑迁移；在非对称部署中，轻量说服者胜率从70.5%提升至78.5%，并加速论证效率。
Conclusion: TS-RAG作为能力桥梁，通过严格约束防止评估崩溃，DSR诊断揭示了默认代理谄媚的危害。

papers.title: PorTEXTO: A European Portuguese Benchmark for Visual Text Extraction
papers.abstract_en: European Portuguese (pt-PT) is largely absent from OCR benchmarks, which skew toward high-resource languages. The few benchmarks that cover pt-PT focus on historical artifacts and literature. This work addresses modern OCR applications, introducing PorTEXTO, the first benchmark for contemporary and culturally relevant pt-PT visual text extraction. To ascertain quality, we employ an annotation pipeline combining transcriptions from a frontier LVLM with exhaustive review by native speakers. We observe a sharp performance drop from synthetic to real world samples in most models, and find that, currently, specialized multilingual data is a better driver for pt-PT performance than model size or resolution budget, motivating the release of open pt-PT OCR resources.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PorTEXTO，首个针对当代欧洲葡萄牙语（pt-PT）视觉文本提取的基准，填补了OCR基准中低资源语言的空白。通过结合前沿LVLM转录和母语者审查的标注流程，发现合成数据到真实世界的性能显著下降，且专用多语言数据比模型规模或分辨率更能提升pt-PT性能。
Motivation: 欧洲葡萄牙语（pt-PT）在OCR基准中缺失，现有基准聚焦历史文献，缺乏现代OCR应用，因此需要建立首个当代pt-PT视觉文本提取基准。
Method: 构建PorTEXTO基准，采用结合LVLM转录和母语者详尽审查的标注流程以确保数据质量。
Result: 观察到大多数模型从合成样本到真实世界样本的性能急剧下降；发现当前专用多语言数据比模型大小或分辨率预算更能驱动pt-PT性能。
Conclusion: 强调需要开放pt-PT OCR资源，并表明多语言数据比模型规模更重要。

papers.title: Multimodal and Multiscale Spatial-Temporal Semantic Search and Recommendation with AI Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Semantic search and recommendation of similar documents, such as news and reports about unusual environmental events (e.g., a dead whale washed ashore in Alaska) that contain spatial and temporal information, is a critical task in Geographic Information Retrieval (GIR). This work presents a novel framework that leverages AI foundation models, including Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs), to enable effective similarity search and ranking for such event documents. To support this goal, we introduce two new strategies: (1) CAMERA (Context-Aware Multimodal Event Retrieval Algorithm), which fuses textual and visual information to generate richer embeddings than those derived from text alone; and (2) ASTRA (Adaptive Spatial and Temporal Re-ranking Algorithm), which improves similarity ranking by incorporating scale-dependent spatiotemporal relevance alongside semantic similarity. Experimental results, using a dataset from the Local Environmental Observer Network, demonstrate that our VLM-enhanced methods outperform unimodal, LLM-based approaches in similarity ranking effectiveness. By automatically linking relevant event reports, the proposed framework helps both data curators and the general public gain deeper insights into environmental change and its localized impacts. These findings highlight the potential of AI foundation models to advance GIR through multifaceted, intelligent analysis that integrates key geographic concepts: space, time, scale, and semantics.

TL;DR: 本文提出一个利用AI基础模型（LLM和VLM）进行多模态多尺度时空语义搜索与推荐的框架，用于检索和排序包含时空信息的环境事件文档（如死鲸搁浅新闻）。该方法包括CAMERA算法融合文本和视觉信息生成更丰富的嵌入，以及ASTRA算法引入尺度相关的时空相关性重排序。在Local Environmental Observer Network数据集上，VLM增强方法优于纯文本LLM方法。
Motivation: 地理信息检索中，环境事件文档（如异常环境事件报告）的语义搜索和推荐需要同时考虑文本、视觉、时空和尺度信息，现有方法往往只利用单一模态或忽视时空尺度。
Method: 提出CAMERA算法融合文本和视觉特征生成多模态嵌入，以及ASTRA算法在相似度排序中引入尺度依赖的时空相关性重排序，两者均基于LLM和VLM实现。
Result: 在Local Environmental Observer Network数据集上，VLM增强方法在相似度排序有效性上优于单模态LLM方法。
Conclusion: AI基础模型通过整合空间、时间、尺度和语义等多维度信息，有望推进地理信息检索的智能分析。

papers.title: Nonlinear Bayesian Estimator for Parameter Learning: A Fixed-Point Characterization
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a nonlinear parameter estimator for Wiener-type state-space models obtained as a fixed-point architecture that couples two affine minimum mean-squared error (MMSE) estimators: one for the unknown parameters and one for latent variables. The architecture retains the functional structure of the optimal affine MMSE parameter estimator while incorporating Dynamic Basis Statistics (DBS) estimates that summarize nonlinear basis-function evaluations. Two DBS construction strategies are developed, leading to two nonlinear estimator frameworks. The dual basis-parameter estimator combines an affine basis estimator with the affine parameter estimator, whereas the dual state-parameter estimator first computes affine state estimates and their covariances, then maps these state-estimate statistics through a Gaussian DBS operator to obtain DBS estimates. Both dual estimators admit fixed-point characterizations that alternate between estimating each component using the updated prior of the other, obtained from that component's plug-in estimate statistics from the previous iteration. The efficacy of the proposed methods is examined via extensive Monte Carlo experiments, showing that the dual basis-parameter estimator attains parameter mean-squared errors comparable to those of the purely affine parameter estimator, while the dual state-parameter estimator achieves the lowest parameter mean-squared error, outperforming both the dual basis-parameter and purely affine parameter estimators, as well as sequential Monte Carlo variants of classical Particle Gibbs and Expectation-Maximization schemes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Wiener型状态空间模型的参数估计问题，提出一种非线性参数估计器，其结构为耦合两个仿射最小均方误差（MMSE）估计器的固定点架构。通过引入动态基统计（DBS）估计，提出两种双估计器框架：双基-参数估计器和双状态-参数估计器。实验结果验证了双状态-参数估计器在参数均方误差上优于其他方法。
Motivation: 现有仿射MMSE参数估计器对非线性模型性能有限，需要更有效的非线性估计方法。
Method: 提出固定点架构，耦合两个仿射MMSE估计器，分别用于未知参数和潜变量。利用DBS估计总结非线性基函数评估，发展两种DBS构造策略，形成双基-参数估计器和双状态-参数估计器。二者均通过交替迭代更新实现固定点表征。
Result: 大量蒙特卡洛实验表明，双状态-参数估计器取得最低参数均方误差，优于双基-参数估计器、纯仿射参数估计器以及序贯蒙特卡洛粒子吉布斯和期望最大化方法。
Conclusion: 论文提出的双估计器框架为Wiener型模型的参数学习提供了有效非线性方案，其中双状态-参数估计器性能最优。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Large language model-enabled automated data extraction for concrete materials informatics
papers.abstract_en: The promise of data-driven materials discovery remains constrained by the scarcity of large, high-quality, and accessible experimental datasets. Here, we introduce a generalizable large language model (LLM)-powered pipeline for automated extraction and structuring of materials data from unstructured scientific literature, using concrete materials as a representative and particularly challenging example. The pipeline exhibits robust performance across a broad range of LLMs and achieves an $F_1$ score of up to 0.98 for diverse composition--process--property attributes. Within one hour, it extracts nearly 9,000 high-quality records with over 100 attributes from a corpus screened from more than 27,000 publications, enabling the construction of the largest open laboratory database for blended cement concrete. Machine learning analyses underscore the importance of large, diverse, and information-rich datasets for enhancing both in-distribution accuracy and out-of-distribution generalization to unseen materials. The proposed pipeline is readily adaptable to other materials domains and accelerates the development of scalable data infrastructures for materials informatics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的通用流水线，用于从非结构化科学文献中自动提取并结构化材料数据，以混凝土材料作为代表性案例。该流水线在多种LLM上表现稳健，对组成-工艺-性能属性的F1分数高达0.98，一小时内从筛选自27,000余篇出版物的语料中提取近9,000条高质量记录（含100余个属性），构建了最大的混合水泥混凝土开放实验室数据库。机器学习分析表明，大规模、多样且信息丰富的数据集对提升分布内准确性和对未见材料的分布外泛化至关重要。该流水线可轻松推广至其他材料领域，加速材料信息学的可扩展数据基础设施建设。
Motivation: 数据驱动材料发现的潜力受限于缺乏大规模、高质量且可访问的实验数据集，现有方法难以自动从文献中高效提取结构化数据。
Method: 提出一个LLM驱动的自动化流水线，通过语言模型从非结构化科学文献中提取和结构化组成-工艺-性能数据，无需人工标注。
Result: F1分数最高达0.98，一小时内提取近9,000条记录（超过100个属性），构建了最大的混合水泥混凝土开放数据库。
Conclusion: 该流水线可适应其他材料领域，加速了材料信息学中大规模数据基础设施的开发。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hardening x402: PII-Safe Agentic Payments via Pre-Execution Metadata Filtering
papers.abstract_en: AI agents that pay for resources via the x402 protocol embed payment metadata - resource URLs, descriptions, and reason strings - in every HTTP payment request. This metadata is transmitted to the payment server and to the centralised facilitator API before any on-chain settlement occurs; neither party is typically bound by a data processing agreement. We present presidio-hardened-x402, the first open-source middleware that intercepts x402 payment requests before transmission to detect and redact personally identifiable information (PII), enforce declarative spending policies, and block duplicate replay attempts. To evaluate the PII filter, we construct a labeled synthetic corpus of 2,000 x402 metadata triples spanning seven use-case categories, and run a 42-configuration precision/recall sweep across two detection modes (regex, NLP) and five confidence thresholds. The recommended configuration (mode=nlp, min_score=0.4, all entity types) achieves micro-F1 = 0.894 with precision 0.972, at a p99 latency of 5.73ms - well within the 50ms overhead budget. The middleware, corpus, and all experiment code are publicly available at https://github.com/presidio-v/presidio-hardened-x402.
papers.comment: 2: corrected NLP-mode precision/recall after a recogniser fix that lifts the US_SSN and PHONE detection v1 understated, and revised the recommended threshold to min_score=0.5 (the curve is flat, not peaked). Section 5 tables, the threshold analysis, and Figures 1-2 are updated; headline micro-F1 = 0.898
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 presidio-hardened-x402，首个开源中间件，在 x402 协议支付请求传输前拦截并检测/编辑个人可识别信息（PII），执行声明式支出策略，并阻止重复重放攻击。使用 2000 条合成数据评估，推荐配置（NLP 模式，min_score=0.4）达到微平均 F1=0.894，精度 0.972，p99 延迟 5.73ms。
Motivation: x402 协议中 AI 代理支付时传输的元数据（资源 URL、描述、理由字符串）在链下结算前会发送到支付服务器和中心化 facilitator API，通常无数据处理协议约束，存在 PII 泄露风险。
Method: 开发 presidio-hardened-x402 中间件，拦截 x402 支付请求，利用正则表达式或 NLP 模式进行 PII 检测与编辑，同时集成支出策略和重放攻击防护。
Result: 在合成数据集上，推荐配置（NLP 模式，min_score=0.4，所有实体类型）微平均 F1=0.894，精度 0.972，p99 延迟 5.73ms，远低于 50ms 预算。
Conclusion: 该中间件能有效保护 x402 支付中的 PII，满足延迟约束，并且代码、语料和实验均开源。

papers.title: Rethinking Visual Privacy: A Compositional Privacy Risk Framework for Severity Assessment with VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Existing visual privacy benchmarks largely treat privacy as a binary property, labeling images as private or non-private based on visible sensitive content. We argue that privacy is fundamentally compositional. Attributes that are benign in isolation may combine to produce severe privacy violations. We introduce the Compositional Privacy Risk Taxonomy (CPRT), a regulation-aware framework that organizes visual attributes according to standalone identifiability and compositional harm potential. CPRT defines four graded severity levels and is paired with an interpretable scoring function that assigns continuous privacy severity scores. We further construct a taxonomy-aligned dataset of 6.7K images and derive compositional risk scores. By evaluating frontier and open-weight VLMs we find that frontier models align well with compositional severity when provided structured guidance, but systematically underestimate composition-driven risks. Smaller models struggle to internalize graded privacy reasoning. To bridge this gap, we introduce a deployable 8B SFT model that closely matches frontier-level performance on compositional privacy assessment
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种组合式视觉隐私风险评估框架（CPRT），将隐私视为组合性的而非二元的，根据属性的独立可识别性和组合危害潜力划分四个严重等级，并构建了包含6.7K图像的评估数据集。实验发现前沿VLM在提供结构指导时能较好对齐组合严重性，但系统性低估组合驱动风险；小模型难以内化分级隐私推理。作者进而提出了一个8B的SFT模型以接近前沿性能。
Motivation: 现有视觉隐私基准将隐私视为二元属性，忽略了属性组合可能产生严重隐私泄露的情况，缺乏对隐私严重性的分级评估。
Method: 提出组合隐私风险分类法（CPRT），定义四种严重等级，并设计可解释的评分函数分配连续隐私严重性分数；构建对齐分类法的6.7K图像数据集，评估多种VLM并训练8B SFT模型。
Result: 前沿VLM在结构化引导下能较好对齐组合严重性，但系统低估组合驱动风险；小模型难以内化分级推理；提出的8B SFT模型接近前沿性能。
Conclusion: 视觉隐私评估应考虑组合性，CPRT框架和SFT模型为分级隐私评估提供了可行思路，但模型对组合风险的认知仍有提升空间。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: KGS-GCN: Kinematics-Driven Gaussian Splatting and Probabilistic Topology for Skeleton-Based Action Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Skeleton-based action recognition is widely applied in sensor-based systems, including human-computer interaction and intelligent surveillance. However, typical sensors produce sparse and discrete joint coordinates, often leading to the loss of fine-grained spatiotemporal information during dynamic movements. Furthermore, predefined physical topologies restrict modeling potential long-range dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose KGS-GCN, which integrates kinematics-driven Gaussian splatting and probabilistic topology within a graph convolutional network. A Gaussian splatting module constructs anisotropic covariance matrices by extracting instantaneous joint velocity vectors, rendering sparse skeleton sequences into multi-view continuous heatmaps rich in spatiotemporal semantics. Additionally, a probabilistic topology construction strategy transcends physical connectivity limitations by utilizing the Bhattacharyya distance to quantify statistical correlations between joint Gaussian distributions, generating an adaptive prior adjacency matrix. Finally, the lightweight multi-view rendering branch and topological GCN backbone are unified through a visual context gating mechanism, enabling seamless fusion of continuous dynamic cues with structural priors while maintaining high computational efficiency, requiring only 1.4M parameters and 1.3 GFLOPs. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that KGS-GCN significantly enhances the modeling of complex spatiotemporal dynamics and achieves competitive performance at low computational cost, establishing an efficient paradigm for improving the perceptual robustness of low-fidelity sensor data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于骨架的动作识别中传感器数据稀疏离散、时空信息丢失以及物理拓扑限制长程依赖建模的问题，提出 KGS-GCN。该方法利用运动学驱动的高斯喷溅（Gaussian splatting）将稀疏骨架序列渲染为多视角连续热图，并通过概率拓扑构造策略（基于 Bhattacharyya 距离）生成自适应先验邻接矩阵，最后通过视觉上下文门控机制融合连续动态线索与结构先验。实验表明，KGS-GCN 在多个基准上以 1.4M 参数和 1.3 GFLOPs 的低计算成本取得了有竞争力的性能。
Motivation: 典型传感器产生的稀疏离散关节坐标丢失了细粒度时空信息，且预定义的物理拓扑限制了长程依赖建模能力。
Method: 提出 KGS-GCN，包含三个核心模块：1) 运动学驱动的高斯喷溅，通过提取瞬时速度向量构建各向异性协方差矩阵，渲染多视角连续热图；2) 概率拓扑构造，利用 Bhattacharyya 距离量化关节高斯分布间的统计相关性生成自适应邻接矩阵；3) 视觉上下文门控机制，融合多视角渲染分支与拓扑 GCN 主干。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上，KGS-GCN 以 1.4M 参数和 1.3 GFLOPs 的低计算成本实现了对复杂时空动态建模的显著提升，取得有竞争力的性能。
Conclusion: 本文为提升低保真传感器数据的感知鲁棒性提供了一种高效范式，但未提及在极高噪或遮挡场景下的表现。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对基于骨架的动作识别中传感器数据稀疏离散、时空信息丢失以及物理拓扑限制长程依赖建模的问题，提出 KGS-GCN。该方法利用运动学驱动的高斯喷溅（Gaussian splatting）将稀疏骨架序列渲染为多视角连续热图，并通过概率拓扑构造策略（基于 Bhattacharyya 距离）生成自适应先验邻接矩阵，最后通过视觉上下文门控机制融合连续动态线索与结构先验。实验表明，KGS-GCN 在多个基准上以 1.4M 参数和 1.3 GFLOPs 的低计算成本取得了有竞争力的性能。
summary_sections.motivation: 典型传感器产生的稀疏离散关节坐标丢失了细粒度时空信息，且预定义的物理拓扑限制了长程依赖建模能力。
summary_sections.method: 提出 KGS-GCN，包含三个核心模块：1) 运动学驱动的高斯喷溅，通过提取瞬时速度向量构建各向异性协方差矩阵，渲染多视角连续热图；2) 概率拓扑构造，利用 Bhattacharyya 距离量化关节高斯分布间的统计相关性生成自适应邻接矩阵；3) 视觉上下文门控机制，融合多视角渲染分支与拓扑 GCN 主干。
summary_sections.result: 在多个基准数据集上，KGS-GCN 以 1.4M 参数和 1.3 GFLOPs 的低计算成本实现了对复杂时空动态建模的显著提升，取得有竞争力的性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文为提升低保真传感器数据的感知鲁棒性提供了一种高效范式，但未提及在极高噪或遮挡场景下的表现。

papers.title: Active View Selection with Perturbed Gaussian Ensemble for Tomographic Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Sparse-view computed tomography (CT) is critical for reducing radiation exposure to patients. Recent advances in radiative 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have enabled fast and accurate sparse-view CT reconstruction. Despite these algorithmic advancements, practical reconstruction fidelity remains fundamentally bounded by the quality of the captured data, raising the crucial yet underexplored problem of X-ray active view selection. Existing active view selection methods are primarily designed for natural-light scenes and fail to capture the unique geometric ambiguities and physical attenuation properties inherent in X-ray imaging. In this paper, we present Perturbed Gaussian Ensemble, an active view selection framework that integrates uncertainty modeling with sequential decision-making, tailored for X-ray Gaussian Splatting. Specifically, we identify low-density Gaussian primitives that are likely to be uncertain and apply stochastic density scaling to construct an ensemble of plausible Gaussian density fields. For each candidate projection, we measure the structural variance of the ensemble predictions and select the one with the highest variance as the next best view. Extensive experimental results on arbitrary-trajectory CT benchmarks demonstrate that our density-guided perturbation strategy effectively eliminates geometric artifacts and consistently outperforms existing baselines in progressive tomographic reconstruction under unified view selection protocols.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向稀疏视角CT重建的主动视图选择框架Perturbed Gaussian Ensemble，通过在3D高斯泼溅中引入不确定性建模和序贯决策，选择方差最大的投影视角以消除几何伪影。实验表明该方法在任意轨迹CT基准上优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有稀疏视角CT重建方法受限于数据质量，而X射线主动视图选择问题尚未被充分研究；自然场景的视角选择方法无法处理X射线成像的几何歧义和物理衰减特性。
Method: 识别低密度高斯基元并施加随机密度缩放，构建高斯密度场集合；对每个候选投影计算集合预测的结构方差，选择方差最大的视角作为下一最佳视图。
Result: 在任意轨迹CT基准上，该方法有效消除几何伪影，并在统一视图选择协议下持续优于现有基线。
Conclusion: 密度引导的扰动策略适用于X射线高斯泼溅的主动视图选择，可提升渐进式断层重建质量。

papers.title: Calibrated Test-Time Guidance for Bayesian Inference
papers.abstract_en: Test-time guidance is a widely used mechanism for steering pretrained diffusion models toward outcomes specified by a reward function. Existing approaches, however, focus on maximizing reward rather than sampling from the true Bayesian posterior, leading to miscalibrated inference. In this work, we show that common test-time guidance methods do not recover the correct posterior distribution and identify the structural approximations responsible for this failure. We then propose consistent alternative estimators that enable calibrated sampling from the Bayesian posterior. We significantly outperform previous methods on a set of Bayesian inference tasks, and set a new state-of-the-art PSNR in black hole image reconstruction.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/mandt-lab/Calibrated-Guidance
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出常用的测试时引导方法（如扩散模型中的奖励引导）未能从正确的贝叶斯后验采样，导致推断失准。作者识别了导致此问题的结构近似，并提出一致的替代估计器，从而实现校准的后验采样。在黑洞图像重建任务上达到了新的PSNR最优。
Motivation: 现有测试时引导方法注重最大化奖励，而非从真实贝叶斯后验采样，导致推断结果失准。需要一种可校准的引导机制。
Method: 分析了常见测试时引导方法无法恢复正确后验的原因，识别了结构近似误差，并提出了能够产生一致后验估计的替代估计器。
Result: 在贝叶斯推断任务上显著优于先前方法，并在黑洞图像重建中取得了新的最优PSNR。
Conclusion: 所提方法可实现校准的贝叶斯后验采样，在特定重建任务中表现领先。

papers.title: GameDevBench: Evaluating Agentic Capabilities Through Game Development
papers.abstract_en: Despite rapid progress on coding agents, progress on their multimodal counterparts has lagged behind. A key challenge is the scarcity of evaluation testbeds that combine the complexity of software development with the need for deep multimodal understanding. In game development, agents must navigate large, dense codebases while manipulating intrinsically multimodal assets such as shaders, sprites, and animations within a visual game scene. We present GameDevBench, the first benchmark for evaluating agents on game development tasks. GameDevBench consists of 333 tasks derived from web and video tutorials. Tasks require significant multimodal understanding and are complex: the average solution requires over three times the lines of code and file changes compared to prior software development benchmarks. Agents struggle with game development, with the best agent and method solving only 53.8% of tasks. We find a strong correlation between perceived task difficulty and multimodal complexity, with average success rate dropping from 51.4% on gameplay-oriented tasks to 33.0% on 2D graphics tasks. To improve multimodal capability, we introduce two simple image- and video-based feedback mechanisms for agents. Despite their simplicity, these methods consistently improve performance, increasing GPT-5.4's performance from 41.1% to 52.0% when given visual feedback.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GameDevBench，首个评估智能体在游戏开发任务上的基准，包含333个来源于网络和视频教程的任务。任务要求多模态理解和复杂代码操作，平均解决方案的代码行数和文件修改量是先前软件开发基准的三倍以上。最佳智能体（GPT-5.4结合视觉反馈）仅解决52.0%的任务，且任务难度与多模态复杂性密切相关。
Motivation: 现有编码智能体评估多局限于纯文本任务，缺乏结合软件开发复杂性和多模态理解的测试平台。游戏开发需处理着色器、精灵、动画等多模态资产，现有基准无法全面评估智能体的多模态能力。
Method: 构建GameDevBench基准，包含333个游戏开发任务，要求智能体导航大型代码库并操作多模态资产。引入两种简单的基于图像和视频的反馈机制，以提升智能体的多模态处理能力。
Result: 最佳智能体（GPT-5.4）在无反馈时解决41.1%的任务，加入视觉反馈后提升至52.0%。2D图形任务成功率（33.0%）显著低于游戏玩法任务（51.4%），表明多模态复杂度是主要瓶颈。
Conclusion: 当前智能体在游戏开发任务上表现有限，多模态理解是核心挑战。简单的视觉反馈能一致提升性能，但仍有近半数任务未被解决，未来需进一步改进多模态推理能力。

papers.title: When Less is More: 8-bit Quantization Improves Continual Learning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Catastrophic forgetting poses a fundamental challenge in continual learning, particularly when models are quantized for deployment efficiency. We systematically investigate the interplay between quantization precision (FP16, INT8, INT4) and replay buffer strategies in large language models, revealing unexpected dynamics. While FP16 achieves superior initial task performance (74.44% on NLU), we observe a striking inversion on subsequent tasks: quantized models outperform FP16 by 8-15% on final task forward accuracy, with INT4 achieving nearly double FP16's performance on Code generation (40% vs 20%). Critically, even minimal replay buffers (0.1%) dramatically improve retention - increasing NLU retention after Math training from 45% to 65% across all precision levels - with INT8 consistently achieving the optimal balance between learning plasticity and knowledge retention. We hypothesize that quantization-induced noise acts as implicit regularization, preventing the overfitting to new task gradients that plagues high-precision models. These findings challenge the conventional wisdom that higher precision is always preferable, suggesting instead that INT8 quantization offers both computational efficiency and superior continual learning dynamics. Our results provide practical guidelines for deploying compressed models in continual learning scenarios: small replay buffers (1-2%) suffice for NLU tasks, while Math and Code benefit from moderate buffers (5-10%), with quantized models requiring less replay than FP16 to achieve comparable retention. Code is available at https://github.com/Festyve/LessIsMore.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了LLM中量化精度（FP16、INT8、INT4）与重放缓冲区策略在持续学习中的交互。实验发现，尽管FP16在初始任务上表现最佳（NLU 74.44%），但量化模型在后续任务上反超8-15%，其中INT4在代码任务上性能接近FP16的两倍（40% vs 20%）。极小的重放缓冲区（0.1%）即可显著提升知识保留，INT8在可塑性与保留之间达到最佳平衡。作者认为量化噪声充当隐式正则化，防止高精度模型过拟合新任务梯度。
Motivation: 灾难性遗忘是持续学习的核心挑战，而模型量化常被用于部署效率，但两者间的相互作用尚不明确。已有研究多聚焦于高精度模型，忽略了量化可能带来的正则化效应。
Method: 采用多精度（FP16、INT8、INT4）与不同大小重放缓冲区（0%、0.1%、1%、2%、5%、10%）的全面实验设计，在NLU、Math、Code三类任务上评估持续学习性能，并分析遗忘曲线与任务间迁移。
Result: FP16初始任务准确率74.44%，但在后续任务上量化模型领先8-15%；INT4在代码任务上准确率40% vs FP16的20%；0.1%的重放缓冲区将NLU保留率从45%提升至65%；INT8在所有设置中实现最佳折中。
Conclusion: 挑战了高精度量化天然有利的假设，表明INT8量化不仅节省计算资源，还能通过隐式正则化改善持续学习动态。实践建议：NLU任务仅需1-2%重放，Math和Code需5-10%，且量化模型需更少重放即可达到同等保留效果。

papers.title: Audio-Visual Camera Pose Estimation with Passive Scene Sounds and In-the-Wild Video
papers.abstract_en: Understanding camera motion is a fundamental problem in embodied perception and 3D scene understanding. While visual methods have advanced rapidly, they often struggle under visually degraded conditions such as motion blur or occlusions. In this work, we show that passive scene sounds provide cues complementary to vision for relative camera pose estimation for in-the-wild videos. We introduce a simple but effective audio-visual framework that integrates direction-of-arrival (DOA) spectra and binauralized embeddings into a state-of-the-art vision-only pose estimation model. Our results on two large datasets show consistent gains over strong visual baselines, plus robustness when the visual information is corrupted. To our knowledge, this represents the first work to successfully leverage audio for relative camera pose estimation in real-world videos, and it establishes incidental, everyday audio as an unexpected but promising signal for a classic spatial challenge. Project: http://vision.cs.utexas.edu/projects/av_camera_pose.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种音频-视觉框架，利用被动场景声音（包括到达方向谱和双耳化嵌入）辅助视觉相机姿态估计，在视觉退化（如运动模糊、遮挡）条件下提升鲁棒性。在两个大规模视频数据集上的实验表明，该方法相比纯视觉基线获得一致提升，且对视觉信息损坏具有稳健性。这是首个在真实视频中成功利用音频进行相对相机姿态估计的工作。
Motivation: 视觉相机姿态估计方法在运动模糊或遮挡等视觉退化条件下表现不佳，现有方法未充分利用音频作为互补线索。
Method: 将到达方向（DOA）谱和双耳化嵌入集成到现有视觉姿态估计模型中，形成简单的音频-视觉框架。
Result: 在两个大规模数据集上，音频-视觉方法在多种视觉退化条件下均优于强视觉基线。
Conclusion: 被动场景声音可作为视觉姿态估计的有效补充信号，尤其适用于视觉信息受损的真实视频场景。

papers.title: Computing Evolutionarily Stable Strategies in Imperfect-Information Games
papers.abstract_en: We present an algorithm for computing evolutionarily stable strategies (ESSs) in symmetric perfect-recall extensive-form games of imperfect information. Our main algorithm is for two-player games, and we describe how it can be extended to multiplayer games. The algorithm is sound and computes all ESSs in nondegenerate games and a subset of them in degenerate games which contain an infinite continuum of symmetric Nash equilibria. The algorithm is anytime and can be stopped early to find one or more ESSs. We experiment on an imperfect-information cancer signaling game as well as random games to demonstrate scalability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种算法，用于计算不完全信息完美回忆扩展式博弈中的进化稳定策略（ESS）。该算法适用于两人博弈，并可扩展到多人博弈；在非退化博弈中能计算所有ESS，在退化博弈中能计算一部分ESS。实验在癌症信号博弈和随机博弈上验证了可扩展性。
Motivation: 进化稳定策略是演化博弈论的核心概念，但此前缺乏在不完全信息扩展式博弈中高效计算ESS的通用算法。该论文填补了这一空白。
Method: 提出一个任意时间的算法，通过搜索对称纳什均衡子集并检验ESS条件，在两人对称完美回忆不完全信息博弈中计算ESS，并给出多人扩展思路。
Result: 算法能计算非退化博弈的全部ESS，以及在退化博弈（存在连续统对称纳什均衡）中的部分ESS；在癌症信号博弈和随机博弈上实验证明可扩展。
Conclusion: 该算法为不完全信息博弈中的ESS计算提供了首个通用框架，但退化博弈中只能找到子集，且计算复杂度随博弈规模增长。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SONIC: Spectral Optimization of Noise for Inpainting with Consistency
papers.abstract_en: We propose a novel training-free method for inpainting with off-the-shelf text-to-image models. While guidance-based methods in theory allow generic models to be used for inverse problems such as inpainting -- in practice their effectiveness is limited, leading to the necessity of specialized inpainting-specific models. In this work, we argue the missing ingredient for training-free generic model usage is proper optimization of the initial noise sample. We optimize the initial noise to approximately reproduce the unmasked image, in as few as tens of optimization steps, then use it with a conventional training-free inpainting method. Critically, we propose two core ideas that make this possible: (i) we perform linear approximation that avoids the costly and often impractical unrolling required to relate the initial noise sample to model output -- which potentially is why this relationship was previously overlooked; and (ii) perform spectral preconditioning by optimizing the initial noise sample in the spectral domain with Adam, which stabilizes the optimization. We demonstrate our method on various inpainting tasks, outperforming the state of the art. Project website: https://ubc-vision.github.io/sonic/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的图像修复方法，通过优化初始噪声样本，利用线性近似和频谱预处理，使现成文本到图像模型能用于修复任务，无需专门修复模型。方法在多个修复基准上超越现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 现有指导方法在理论上允许通用模型用于图像修复等逆问题，但实际效果有限，需要专门修复模型。本文认为关键缺失是对初始噪声样本的适当优化。
Method: 提出两个核心思想：线性近似避免昂贵的展开操作来关联初始噪声与模型输出；频谱预处理在频域使用Adam优化初始噪声，稳定优化过程。
Result: 在多个图像修复任务上超越现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 本文方法无需训练，适用于现成文本到图像模型，通过优化初始噪声实现高效修复。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MonoMSK: Monocular 3D Musculoskeletal Dynamics Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing biomechanically realistic 3D human motion - recovering both kinematics (motion) and kinetics (forces) - is a critical challenge. While marker-based systems are lab-bound and slow, popular monocular methods use oversimplified, anatomically inaccurate models (e.g., SMPL) and ignore physics, fundamentally limiting their biomechanical fidelity. In this work, we introduce MonoMSK, a hybrid framework that bridges data-driven learning and physics-based simulation for biomechanically realistic 3D human motion estimation from monocular video. MonoMSK jointly recovers both kinematics (motions) and kinetics (forces and torques) through an anatomically accurate musculoskeletal model. By integrating transformer-based inverse dynamics with differentiable forward kinematics and dynamics layers governed by ODE-based simulation, MonoMSK establishes a physics-regulated inverse-forward loop that enforces biomechanical causality and physical plausibility. A novel forward-inverse consistency loss further aligns motion reconstruction with the underlying kinetic reasoning. Experiments on BML-MoVi, BEDLAM, and OpenCap show that MonoMSK significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in kinematic accuracy, while for the first time enabling precise monocular kinetics estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MonoMSK 是一个混合框架，能够从单目视频中同时估计生物力学逼真的 3D 人体运动学（运动）和动力学（力与力矩）。它采用解剖学准确的肌肉骨骼模型，结合基于 Transformer 的逆动力学与可微的正向运动学和动力学层（基于 ODE 模拟），形成物理调节的逆-正循环。实验在 BML-MoVi、BEDLAM 和 OpenCap 数据集上表明，MonoMSK 在运动学精度上显著优于现有方法，并首次实现了精确的单目动力学估计。
Motivation: 现有单目方法大多使用过度简化的解剖学不准确模型（如 SMPL），且忽略物理规律，导致生物力学保真度受限。
Method: 提出 MonoMSK 混合框架，整合数据驱动学习与基于物理的仿真：包含解剖学肌肉骨骼模型、基于 Transformer 的逆动力学、可微的正向运动学与动力学层（ODE 模拟），以及物理调节的逆-正循环，并引入正向-逆一致性损失。
Result: 在 BML-MoVi、BEDLAM 和 OpenCap 上，运动学精度显著超越当前最优方法，并首次实现精确的单目动力学（力和力矩）估计。
Conclusion: MonoMSK 为单目视频提供了一种生物力学逼真的 3D 人体运动估计方法，同时恢复运动学与动力学，推动了无标记人体运动分析的物理保真度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VisReason: A Large-Scale Dataset for Visual Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has proven remarkably effective for eliciting complex reasoning in large language models (LLMs). Yet, its potential in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remains largely untapped, hindered by the absence of large-scale datasets that capture the rich, spatially grounded reasoning intrinsic to visual understanding. Existing visual-CoT resources are typically small, domain-specific, or lack the human-like stepwise structure necessary for compositional visual reasoning. In this paper, we introduce VisReason, a large-scale dataset designed to advance visual Chain-of-Thought reasoning. VisReason comprises 489K annotated examples spanning four diverse domains, each featuring multi-round, human-like rationales that guide MLLMs through interpretable visual reasoning steps. Building upon this, we curate VisReason-Pro, a 165K subset produced with a stronger expert-level GPT annotator, enriched with detailed reasoning traces and 3D spatial grounding via depth-informed annotations. Fine-tuning the state-of-the-art Qwen2.5-VL model on VisReason and VisReason-Pro yields substantial improvements in step-by-step visual reasoning accuracy, interpretability, and cross-benchmark generalization. These results demonstrate that VisReason equips MLLMs with more systematic and generalizable reasoning capabilities. We envision VisReason as a cornerstone for cultivating human-like visual reasoning, paving the way toward the next generation of multimodal intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VisReason，一个大规模视觉链式推理数据集，包含 489K 条多领域注释，每条包含多轮类人推理步骤。基于此，又用更强注释器构建了 165K 的子集 VisReason-Pro，并加入深度感知的 3D 空间信息。在 Qwen2.5-VL 模型上微调后，显著提升了逐步视觉推理的准确率、可解释性和跨基准泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有的视觉链式推理数据集规模小、领域局限，且缺乏类似人类的逐步推理结构，阻碍了多模态大模型在视觉理解中利用思维链提示。
Method: 收集并注释了 489K 个多领域样本，每个样本包含多轮类人推理路径；再通过更强的 GPT 注释器精心标注 165K 子集 VisReason-Pro，并提供深度信息以增强 3D 空间理解。
Result: 使用 VisReason 和 VisReason-Pro 微调 Qwen2.5-VL 模型，在多个视觉推理基准上实现了逐步推理准确率和泛化能力的显著提升。
Conclusion: VisReason 可作为培养类人视觉推理的基础性资源，推动多模态智能的发展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FlowPath: Learning Data-Driven Manifolds with Invertible Flows for Robust Irregularly-sampled Time Series Classification
papers.abstract_en: Modeling continuous-time dynamics from sparse and irregularly-sampled time series remains a fundamental challenge. Neural controlled differential equations provide a principled framework for such tasks, yet their performance is highly sensitive to the choice of control path constructed from discrete observations. Existing methods commonly employ fixed interpolation schemes, which impose simplistic geometric assumptions that often misrepresent the underlying data manifold, particularly under high missingness. We propose FlowPath, a novel approach that learns the geometry of the control path via an invertible neural flow. Rather than merely connecting observations, FlowPath constructs a continuous and data-adaptive manifold, guided by invertibility constraints that enforce information-preserving and well-behaved transformations. This inductive bias distinguishes FlowPath from prior unconstrained learnable path models. Empirical evaluations on 18 benchmark datasets and a real-world case study demonstrate that FlowPath consistently achieves statistically significant improvements in classification accuracy over baselines using fixed interpolants or non-invertible architectures. These results highlight the importance of modeling not only the dynamics along the path but also the geometry of the path itself, offering a robust and generalizable solution for learning from irregular time series.
papers.comment: Published at the 40th Annual AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI 2026). https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/39643
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FlowPath，一种通过可逆神经流学习控制路径几何形状的新方法，用于鲁棒的稀疏不规则采样时间序列分类。FlowPath构建连续且数据自适应的流形，与固定插值或不可逆架构相比，在18个基准数据集和真实世界案例上显著提高了分类精度。
Motivation: 现有神经控制微分方程方法在稀疏不规则采样时间序列中性能高度依赖控制路径的构造，固定插值方案引入的简单几何假设常偏离数据流形，尤其在高缺失率下表现不佳。
Method: FlowPath利用可逆神经流学习控制路径的几何形状，通过可逆性约束强制信息保留和良好行为变换，构建连续自适应流形，区别于先前无约束的可学习路径模型。
Result: 在18个基准数据集和真实世界案例上，FlowPath相比使用固定插值或不可逆架构的基线，在分类精度上取得统计显著的提升。
Conclusion: 论文强调不仅要建模路径上的动态，还要建模路径本身的几何形状，为不规则时间序列学习提供了鲁棒且泛化的解决方案。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Large language models replicate and predict human cooperation across experiments in game theory
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as decision-making agents in high-stakes domains and as imitators of human behavior in the social and behavioral sciences. Yet how closely LLMs mirror human decision-making remains poorly understood. This gap is critical: misalignment could produce harmful outcomes in practice, while failure to replicate human behavior renders LLMs ineffective as social simulators. Here, we address this gap by replicating large-scale game-theoretic experiments and by introducing a systematic prompting and probing framework for machine-behavioral evaluation. We test three open models typically used to power agents (Llama, Mistral, and Qwen). Across 121 dyadic games spanning four classical game types, Llama reproduces human cooperation patterns with high fidelity, while Qwen aligns closely with Nash equilibrium predictions. Characterizing models through behavioral phenotyping, we find that humans and Llama share an envious decision profile, while Qwen and Mistral exhibit different profiles. An attention-based analysis of payoff salience reveals Llama processes payoff information in a structured, layer-dependent manner absent in Qwen and Mistral, suggesting a mechanistic basis for its closer alignment with human behavior. Population-level behavioral replication is achieved without persona-based prompting, simplifying the simulation process. Extending the experimental parameter space beyond the original human-tested games, we generate and preregister testable hypotheses for novel game configurations. Our findings demonstrate appropriately configured LLMs can replicate aggregate human behavioral patterns, exhibit human-like decision phenotypes, and enable systematic exploration of unexplored experimental spaces, offering a complementary approach to traditional behavioral research that generates new empirical predictions about human social decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过复制大规模博弈论实验并引入系统提示和探测框架，评估了Llama、Mistral和Qwen三种开放LLM在121个双人博弈中复制人类合作模式的能力。结果表明Llama高度复现人类合作模式，Qwen接近纳什均衡预测；人类和Llama共享“嫉妒型”决策轮廓。基于注意力的分析显示Llama以结构化的层依赖方式处理收益信息，这可能是其与人类行为更接近的机制基础。研究发现无需角色提示即可实现种群水平行为复制，并可生成新实验假设。
Motivation: 当前LLM在现实决策和社会模拟中广泛应用，但其与人类决策的相似性尚不明确。对齐不足可能导致实际有害后果，而无法复制人类行为则使LLM作为社会模拟器失效。
Method: 通过复制大规模博弈论实验，引入系统提示和探测框架进行机器行为评估。测试了Llama、Mistral和Qwen三种模型，在121个双人博弈（涵盖四类经典博弈）中评估其行为。使用行为表型分析和基于注意力的收益显著性分析。
Result: Llama高保真度地复现了人类合作模式；Qwen接近纳什均衡预测。人类和Llama共享“嫉妒型”决策轮廓，而Qwen和Mistral不同。Llama以层依赖方式处理收益信息，这在其机制上与人类行为更接近。
Conclusion: 适当配置的LLM能够复制人类群体行为模式，展现类人决策表型，并允许系统探索未实验的空间。该方法为传统行为研究提供了补充，并能生成关于人类社会决策的新经验预测。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 适当配置的LLM能够复制人类群体行为模式，展现类人决策表型，并允许系统探索未实验的空间。该方法为传统行为研究提供了补充，并能生成关于人类社会决策的新经验预测。

papers.title: Recursively Enumerably Representable Classes and Computable Versions of the Fundamental Theorem of Statistical Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study computable probably approximately correct (CPAC) learning, where learners are required to be computable functions. It had been previously observed that the Fundamental Theorem of Statistical Learning, which characterizes PAC learnability by finiteness of the Vapnik-Chervonenkis (VC-)dimension, no longer holds in this framework. Recent works recovered analogs of the Fundamental Theorem in the computable setting, for instance by introducing an effective VC-dimension. Guided by this, we investigate the connection between CPAC learning and recursively enumerable representable (RER) classes, whose members can be algorithmically listed. Our results show that the effective VC-dimensions can take arbitrary values above the traditional one, even for RER classes, which creates a whole family of (non-)examples for various notions of CPAC learning. Yet the two dimensions coincide for classes satisfying sufficiently strong notions of CPAC learning. We then observe that CPAC learnability can also be characterized via containment of RER classes that realize the same samples. Furthermore, it is shown that CPAC learnable classes satisfying a unique identification property are necessarily RER. Finally, we establish that agnostic learnability can be guaranteed for RER classes, by considering the relaxed notion of nonuniform CPAC learning.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究可计算PAC（CPAC）学习，探讨递归可枚举可表示类（RER classes）与CPAC学习之间的联系。结果表明，即使对于RER类，有效VC维也可以取任意大于传统VC维的值；两个维数在满足强CPAC学习时相等。CPAC可学习性可通过RER类的包含关系刻画，满足唯一辨识性质的CPAC可学习类必然是RER类。此外，对RER类通过非统一CPAC学习可保证agnostic可学习性。
Motivation: 统计学习基本定理在可计算框架下不再成立，近期工作通过引入有效VC维恢复了类似定理。本文旨在进一步揭示CPAC学习与RER类之间的深层联系，阐明有效VC维的可能取值及其对可学习性的影响。
Method: 通过理论分析，定义RER类等概念，证明有效VC维可以取任意大于传统VC维的值；利用RER类的包含关系刻画CPAC可学习性；研究唯一辨识性质与RER类的关系；给出非统一CPAC学习下RER类的agnostic可学习保证。
Result: 有效VC维可以取任意大于传统VC维的值，即使对RER类也成立；两个维数在满足强CPAC学习时相等；CPAC可学习性等价于RER类的包含关系；满足唯一辨识性质的CPAC可学习类是RER类；非统一CPAC学习可保证RER类的agnostic可学习性。
Conclusion: 论文系统揭示了CPAC学习与RER类的联系，为可计算学习理论提供了新见解，并回答了会议版本中的开放问题。

papers.title: K-Merge: Online Continual Merging of Adapters for On-device Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: On-device deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently leverages Low-Rank Adapters (LoRAs) to support diverse downstream tasks under tight resource constraints. To address the limited storage capacity of mobile devices, recent works have explored model merging techniques to fuse multiple LoRAs into a single one. In practice, however, LoRAs are often delivered incrementally, as users request support for new tasks (e.g., novel problem types or languages). This scenario introduces a new challenge: on-device online continual merging, where the objective is to incorporate new LoRAs while preserving the performance on previously supported tasks. In this paper, we propose a data-free and computationally efficient strategy for selecting and merging LoRAs when a new one becomes available, assuming the device can store only a limited number of adapters. Extensive experiments across real-world tasks demonstrate the superiority of our approach compared to alternative strategies while adhering to the storage budget and compute limitations of on-device settings. The project page is available at: https://donaldssh.github.io/K-Merge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对设备端大语言模型（LLM）中适配器（LoRA）的在线持续合并问题，提出了一种无需数据且计算高效的策略，在存储和计算预算有限的情况下，动态选择并合并新到的LoRA，同时保持对已有任务的支持。实验表明该方法优于现有替代方案。
Motivation: 设备端LLM常使用LoRA适配器支持多种下游任务，但存储空间有限，且新的LoRA会不断送达，需要在线合并以保留旧任务性能，现有方法未考虑这种增量场景。
Method: 提出一种数据无关、计算高效的策略，当新LoRA可用时，基于存储预算和任务重要性进行选择与合并，仅需少量计算即可完成。
Result: 在多个真实任务上的实验显示，所提方法在遵守存储和计算限制的条件下，性能优于其他比较策略。
Conclusion: 该方法为设备端LLM的在线持续适配器合并提供了可行方案，强调数据无关和高效性，适合资源受限场景。

papers.title: Quadratic Programming Approach for Nash Equilibrium Computation in Multiplayer Imperfect-Information Games
papers.abstract_en: There has been significant recent progress in algorithms for approximation of Nash equilibrium in large two-player zero-sum imperfect-information games and exact computation of Nash equilibrium in multiplayer strategic-form games. While counterfactual regret minimization and fictitious play are scalable to large games and have convergence guarantees in two-player zero-sum games, they do not guarantee convergence to Nash equilibrium in multiplayer games. We present an approach for exact computation of Nash equilibrium in multiplayer imperfect-information games that solves a quadratically-constrained program based on a nonlinear complementarity problem formulation from the sequence-form game representation. This approach capitalizes on recent advances for solving nonconvex quadratic programs. Our algorithm is able to quickly solve three-player Kuhn poker after removal of dominated actions. Of the available algorithms in the Gambit software suite, only the logit quantal response approach is successfully able to solve the game; however, the approach takes longer than our algorithm and also involves a degree of approximation. Our formulation also leads to a new approach for computing Nash equilibrium in multiplayer strategic-form games which we demonstrate to outperform a previous quadratically-constrained program formulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于多人不完美信息博弈中精确计算纳什均衡的方法，通过求解基于序列形式博弈表示的非线性互补问题导出的二次约束规划。该方法利用非凸二次规划的最新进展，在移除支配动作后能快速求解三人Kuhn扑克。与Gambit软件套件中的logit quantal response方法相比，该算法更快且不涉及近似。
Motivation: 现有方法如反事实遗憾最小化（CFR）和虚拟博弈在两人零和游戏中可扩展且有收敛保证，但在多人博弈中不能保证收敛到纳什均衡。本文旨在提供一种精确计算多人不完美信息博弈纳什均衡的方法。
Method: 基于序列形式博弈表示的非线性互补问题，构建一个二次约束规划，并利用求解非凸二次规划的最新进展来求解。
Result: 在三人Kuhn扑克（移除支配动作后）上能够快速求解；与Gambit中的logit quantal response方法相比，算法更快且不涉及近似。在多人战略式博弈的纳什均衡计算中，该公式也优于之前的二次约束规划公式。
Conclusion: 本文提供了精确计算多人不完美信息博弈纳什均衡的新方法，并在小规模博弈上展示了速度和准确性优势。但未讨论扩展到更大博弈的可行性或限制。

papers.title: CWT-Enhanced Vibration Sensing With Time-Frequency Region Localization Using YOLO
papers.abstract_en: This letter presents a CWT-enhanced vibration sensing framework for bearing fault monitoring through localized time-frequency region detection on continuous wavelet transform (CWT) spectrograms. Vibration signals are transformed into CWT spectrograms to improve the observability of weak and non-stationary fault signatures, and YOLOv9, YOLOv10, and YOLOv11 are employed to detect and identify localized fault-related energy regions in the time-frequency domain. Experiments on the CWRU, PU, and IMS datasets show that the proposed framework improves the detectability and robustness of fault-related sensing patterns compared with conventional time-series models, modern vision backbones, and short-time Fourier transform (STFT)-based representations, achieving mean average precision (mAP) values up to 99.4%, 97.8%, and 99.5%, respectively. In addition, the localized region detection framework provides a more interpretable relationship between time-frequency energy distributions and characteristic bearing fault frequencies. These results demonstrate an effective and generalizable approach for interpretable vibration sensing in noisy industrial environments.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于CWT增强的振动传感框架，通过YOLO检测CWT时频谱上的局部时频区域，用于轴承故障监测。在CWRU、PU和IMS数据集上，mAP分别达到99.4%、97.8%和99.5%，优于传统时间序列模型和STFT方法，并提供了可解释的时频能量分布与故障频率关系。

Conclusion: 该方法在噪声工业环境中有效且可泛化，提供了可解释的振动传感。

papers.title: TANDEM: Temporal Attention-guided Neural Differential Equations for Missingness in Time Series Classification
papers.abstract_en: Handling missing data in time series classification remains a significant challenge in various domains. Traditional methods often rely on imputation, which may introduce bias or fail to capture the underlying temporal dynamics. In this paper, we propose TANDEM (Temporal Attention-guided Neural Differential Equations for Missingness), an attention-guided neural differential equation framework that effectively classifies time series data with missing values. Our approach integrates raw observation, interpolated control path, and continuous latent dynamics through a novel attention mechanism, allowing the model to focus on the most informative aspects of the data. We evaluate TANDEM on 30 benchmark datasets and a real-world medical dataset, demonstrating its superiority over existing state-of-the-art methods. Our framework not only improves classification accuracy but also provides insights into the handling of missing data, making it a valuable tool in practice.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TANDEM，一种基于注意力机制的神经微分方程框架，用于处理时间序列分类中的缺失数据。该框架结合原始观测、插值控制路径和连续潜在动态，通过注意力机制聚焦数据中最有信息量的部分。在30个基准数据集和真实医疗数据集上，TANDEM的分类准确率优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 时间序列分类中缺失数据处理是长期挑战，传统插值方法可能引入偏差或无法捕捉底层时间动态。
Method: 提出注意力引导的神经微分方程（Neural ODE）框架，通过新颖的注意力机制融合原始观测、插值控制路径和连续潜在动态。
Result: 在30个基准数据集和真实医疗数据集上，TANDEM的分类准确率优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: TANDEM不仅提升分类准确率，还提供了处理缺失数据的见解，是一个有价值的实践工具。
