papers.title: scDataset: Scalable Data Loading for Deep Learning on Large-Scale Single-Cell Omics
papers.abstract_en: Training deep learning models on single-cell datasets with hundreds of millions of cells requires loading data from disk, as these datasets exceed available memory. While random sampling provides the data diversity needed for effective training, it is prohibitively slow due to the random access pattern overhead, whereas sequential streaming achieves high throughput but introduces biases that degrade model performance. We present scDataset, a PyTorch data loader that enables efficient training from on-disk data with seamless integration across diverse storage formats. Our approach combines block sampling and batched fetching to achieve quasi-random sampling that balances I/O efficiency with minibatch diversity. On Tahoe-100M, a dataset of 100 million cells, scDataset achieves more than two orders of magnitude speedup compared to true random sampling while working directly with AnnData files. We provide theoretical bounds on minibatch diversity and empirically show that scDataset matches the performance of true random sampling across multiple classification tasks and model architectures.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026); camera-ready version. 17 pages, 8 figures, 2 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 scDataset，一个用于大规模单细胞组学数据的 PyTorch 数据加载器，通过块采样和批量获取实现准随机采样，在保证 I/O 效率的同时保持小批量多样性。在 1 亿细胞的 Tahoe-100M 数据集上，相比随机采样加速超过两个数量级，且性能匹配随机采样。
Motivation: 单细胞数据集包含数亿细胞，超出内存容量，需从磁盘加载。随机采样数据多样性好但 I/O 缓慢，顺序流式处理速度快但引入偏差降低模型性能。
Method: 提出块采样和批量获取相结合的策略，实现准随机采样，平衡 I/O 效率与小批量多样性。提供小批量多样性的理论界限，并直接支持 AnnData 文件格式。
Result: 在 Tahoe-100M 数据集上，scDataset 相比真正随机采样加速超过两个数量级，并且在多个分类任务和模型架构上性能与随机采样匹配。
Conclusion: scDataset 在大规模单细胞数据训练中实现了高效的数据加载，兼顾速度和多样性，具有实际应用价值。

papers.title: Optimization on the Oblique Manifold for Sparse Simplex Constraints via Multiplicative Updates
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank optimization problems with sparse simplex constraints involve variables that must satisfy nonnegativity, sparsity, and sum-to-1 conditions, making their optimization particularly challenging due to the interplay between low-rank structures and constraints. These problems arise in various applications, including machine learning, signal processing, environmental fields, and computational biology. In this work, we propose a novel manifold optimization approach to efficiently tackle these problems. Our method leverages the geometry of oblique manifolds to reformulate the problem and introduces a new Riemannian optimization method based on Riemannian gradient descent that strictly maintains the simplex constraints. By exploiting the underlying manifold structure, our approach improves optimization efficiency. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method compared to standard Euclidean and Riemannian methods, paving the way for broader applications.

papers.title: Generated Contents Enrichment
papers.abstract_en: We study Generated Contents Enrichment (GCE), a conditional image-generation task in which a sparse scene description is first enriched through an explicit scene representation and then rendered into semantically richer visual content. Conventional image-generation systems can produce visually realistic outputs from limited scene descriptions, but the added content is usually implicit in the generator rather than represented as an inspectable intermediate structure. In contrast, GCE seeks to make scene enrichment explicit at the scene-representation level while examining its visual consequences during generation, with the goal of encouraging generated content that is visually plausible, structurally coherent, and semantically richer than the sparse input. To instantiate GCE, we propose a jointly trained adversarial framework that enriches scene graphs by modeling object semantics and inter-object relations. Our approach first represents the input description as a scene graph, where nodes model objects and edges capture inter-object relations. The framework uses graph convolutional networks to predict additional objects and their relations to the existing scene. Finally, the enriched scene graph is passed through the downstream image-generation pipeline to generate the corresponding visual content. We evaluate the framework with proxy scene graph enrichment metrics, image-quality comparisons, qualitative examples, and user studies on the Visual Genome dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出生成内容丰富化（GCE）任务，即从稀疏场景描述出发，通过显式场景表示进行丰富化，再生成视觉上更丰富的图像。作者采用联合训练的对抗框架，将输入表示为场景图，使用图卷积网络预测额外对象及其关系，然后通过图像生成流水线输出内容。在Visual Genome数据集上使用代理场景图丰富化指标、图像质量比较、定性示例和用户研究进行评估。
Motivation: 传统的图像生成系统可以从有限描述生成逼真内容，但添加的内容通常是隐式的，缺乏可检查的中间结构。GCE旨在显式地在场景表示层面进行丰富，鼓励生成的视觉内容更逼真、结构连贯且语义丰富。
Method: 提出一个联合训练的对抗框架：首先将输入描述表示为场景图（节点为对象，边为对象间关系），使用图卷积网络预测额外对象及其与现有场景的关系，然后将丰富后的场景图送入下游图像生成流水线产生视觉内容。
Result: 在Visual Genome数据集上，通过代理场景图丰富化指标、图像质量比较、定性示例和用户研究对框架进行了评估，展示了生成内容在丰富性和连贯性上的提升。
Conclusion: 该框架显式地进行场景丰富化，能够生成视觉上合理、结构连贯且语义更丰富的内容，在数据集评估中表现良好。

papers.title: Learn Once, Edit Anywhere: Visual Direction Transfer for Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of diffusion models has enabled the generation of high-fidelity images from textual prompts, yet achieving precise, disentangled control over specific attributes remains a significant challenge. A fundamental limitation arises because visual differences between images are often far more descriptive and nuanced than what can be captured through human-crafted text descriptions, which frequently fail to convey fine-grained semantic details. To address this, we introduce ViDiT (Visual Direction Transfer for Diffusion), a framework that expands the editing vocabulary by capturing latent semantics directly from image-edit pairs. ViDiT learns the underlying transformation by optimizing a single, global, and continuous editing direction from a small set of ``before-and-after'' examples. This optimization process transfers visual changes into the diffusion model's conditioning space, allowing for detailed edits that text alone cannot easily describe. ViDiT operates on a ``Learn Once'' principle, which completely eliminates the need for model fine-tuning or expensive per-image optimization during inference. Once learned, these continuous directions enable ``Edit Anywhere'' capabilities, allowing users to apply highly disentangled manipulations, such as changes in facial features, animal attributes, or artistic styles, to any image in a zero-shot manner with granular control over the edit intensity. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate that ViDiT outperforms existing text-based editing methods in maintaining input faithfulness while achieving precise, scalable attribute control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ViDiT (Visual Direction Transfer for Diffusion) 框架，通过学习图像编辑对中的潜在语义方向，实现零样本、无需微调的图像编辑。该框架从少量“前-后”示例中优化一个全局连续的编辑方向，并将其转移到扩散模型的条件空间中，支持精细属性调整（如面部特征、动物属性、艺术风格）且强度可控。实验表明 ViDiT 在保持输入保真度方面优于现有文本编辑方法。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型对特定属性的精确解耦控制仍困难，因为图像间的视觉差异往往比文本描述更细致，人类自然语言难以精确捕捉细粒度语义。
Method: ViDiT 通过从图像编辑对中优化一个单一的全局连续编辑方向，将视觉变化转移到扩散模型的条件空间，实现“一次学习，任意编辑”的零样本推断。
Result: 定量和定性评估显示 ViDiT 在保持输入保真度方面优于现有基于文本的编辑方法，并能实现精确、可扩展的属性控制。

papers.title: Prompting GPT-5 on Scrum Certification Questions: An Empirical Accuracy Study
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in Agile Software Development for documentation, coaching, and training. As practitioners adopt these tools to prepare for certifications such as Professional Scrum Master (PSM), a key question is whether LLMs can reliably reason about Scrum, a framework with normative, well-defined rules described in the Scrum Guide (2020). This paper examines how different prompt techniques affect the factual accuracy of LLM responses to Scrum certification-style questions. A dataset of 993 validated PSM-aligned questions was answered by GPT-5 using three techniques: zero-shot, chain-of-thought, and with-source citation. All prompts achieved certification-level accuracy above 85\%, with the citation-based variant performing best (89.1\%) and yielding the lowest error rate. Correct answers concentrated in well-defined topics, such as \emph{Definition of Done}, Events, and Product Backlog Management, and in single-answer multiple-choice items, while multi-select questions and more interpretive areas, such as Scrum Team and Product Value, were less stable. Among questions where at least one prompt failed (16.2\%), errors clustered into misalignment with the Scrum Guide (28\%), content outside its scope (34\%), and outdated or biased interpretations (38\%). Overall, prompt techniques produced modest but consistent improvements, particularly in reducing misinterpretation and version drift, supporting more reliable use of LLMs in Agile learning and certification preparation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估GPT-5在Scrum认证问题上的准确性，使用993个PSM级别问题测试三种提示技术（零样本、思维链、带来源引用）。所有提示准确率超过85%，基于引用的方法最佳（89.1%）。错误集中在与Scrum指南不一致（28%）、超出范围（34%）和过时/偏差解释（38%）。提示技术带来适度改进。
Motivation: LLM在敏捷开发和培训中应用广泛，但需要验证其在规范性框架Scrum上的事实推理能力，以确保认证准备的可靠性。
Method: 构建993个经过验证的PSM认证问题，对GPT-5应用零样本、思维链和基于来源引用三种提示技术，比较准确率并分析错误类型。
Result: 所有提示准确率超85%，引用变体最优（89.1%）。16.2%的问题至少一种提示失败，错误分布为：与Scrum指南不一致28%，超出范围34%，过时/偏差解释38%。
Conclusion: 提示技术可减少误解和版本漂移，但改进有限，支持LLM在敏捷学习和认证中的更可靠使用。

papers.title: Comparing Large Language Models on Scrum Certification-Style Questions: Accuracy, Stability, and Error Patterns
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in exam- and certification-style question answering tasks, where their ability to retrieve, interpret, and apply domain-specific knowledge can be systematically assessed. In Software Engineering, such settings are particularly relevant when questions depend on strict adherence to normative definitions, roles, artifacts, and rules. This paper evaluates the performance of three contemporary LLMs, \textit{GPT-5 mini}, \textit{Gemini 3 Flash}, and \textit{DeepSeek Chat 3.2}, in answering 993 Scrum certification-style questions aligned with the Professional Scrum Master I (PSM I) assessment format. We evaluated the models under three prompting strategies (\textit{zero-shot}, \textit{chain-of-thought}, and \textit{source-grounded}), with repeated executions to assess intra-model stability. We also analyzed performance across Scrum topics and question formats, complemented by a qualitative analysis of recurring error patterns in incorrect answers. Results revealed clear differences among models, with Gemini 3 Flash achieving the highest accuracy, followed by GPT-5 mini and DeepSeek Chat 3.2, while intra-model variability remained low across all conditions. By question format, the models achieved the highest accuracy on single-answer multiple-choice items, whereas multi-select and True/False questions were more error-prone. By topic, performance was more consistent in normatively explicit areas such as Artifacts, Empiricism, and Product Value, but more fragile in Scrum Values, Self-Managing Teams, and Stakeholders \& Customers. The qualitative analysis showed that errors were systematic rather than random, involving overgeneralization, restrictive wording, compound distractors, and conflicts between common market interpretations and strict Scrum definitions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了GPT-5 mini、Gemini 3 Flash和DeepSeek Chat 3.2三个LLM在993个Scrum认证风格问题（PSM I）上的表现，采用了零样本、思维链和基于源三种提示策略，并分析了模型内稳定性、不同主题和格式的准确性以及错误模式。结果显示Gemini 3 Flash准确率最高，模型内变异性低；单选题表现最好，多选和是非题易错；错误具有系统性，包括过度泛化、限制性措辞等。
Motivation: 需要系统评估LLM在严格遵循规范性定义的知识问答任务中的能力，特别是在软件工程认证场景中，以了解其可靠性和局限性。
Method: 使用993个与PSM I考试一致的问题，在三种提示策略（零样本、思维链、基于源）下重复执行，评估准确性、稳定性，并按主题和问题格式进行分析，同时进行定性错误模式分析。
Result: Gemini 3 Flash准确率最高（具体数值未在摘要中给出），GPT-5 mini次之，DeepSeek Chat 3.2最低；模型内变异性低；单选题准确率最高，多选和是非题错误率更高；在Artifacts、Empiricism等规范明确主题上表现一致，在Scrum Values、Self-Managing Teams等主题上较弱；错误是系统性的，包括过度泛化、限制性措辞、复合干扰项等。
Conclusion: 不同LLM在Scrum认证问题上的表现存在显著差异，提示策略影响有限，错误模式具有系统性，表明模型在严格遵循规范定义方面仍有局限。

papers.title: Vertigo Vertigo: Reconstructing a Cinematic Ideal through its Predictive AI Double
papers.abstract_en: Vertigo Vertigo is a scene-for-scene AI reconstruction of Hitchcock's Vertigo (1958), generated from only 2.78% of the original film's frames. Using this sparse set of keyframe anchors, we perform first-last frame interpolation via a large video diffusion model to predict the intervening sequences. Vertigo is itself a film about the obsessive reconstruction of an artificial ideal; Vertigo Vertigo extends this logic to the material of the film, treating the canonical text as a probe for the normative conventions of classical cinema encoded within generative systems. Evaluated through computational analysis and critical feedback from media theorists (Lev Manovich, Shane Denson, Kevin L. Ferguson), the artifact demonstrates remarkable structural fidelity: 73.1% of frames are recognizable as plausible renditions of Vertigo and only 3.6% fail catastrophically. This fidelity suggests that cinematic norms are deeply compressed within the model's latent priors. Aesthetically, the reconstruction is rendered as an unstable overlay between the original film and its predictive shadow, fueling a persistent doubt in the viewer's perception of authenticity -- a 21st-century vertigo. The work argues that generative media is not a paradigm shift from cinema but an acceleration of its logic of desire and false authenticity, extending from classical Hollywood through to the predictive media environments now reshaping contemporary perception.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用大型视频扩散模型，仅利用原片2.78%的关键帧进行首尾帧插值，逐场景重建了希区柯克的电影《迷魂记》(Vertigo)。重建结果展现出惊人的结构保真度：73.1%的帧被视为可信的《迷魂记》版本，仅3.6%完全失败。作品认为生成式媒体并非电影范式的转变，而是对其欲望与虚假真实性逻辑的加速。
Motivation: 探讨经典电影文本如何作为探针，揭示生成系统内编码的古典电影规范惯例，并反思生成式媒体与电影在真实性感知上的延续性。
Method: 从原始影片中提取2.78%的关键帧作为锚点，利用大规模视频扩散模型执行首尾帧插值，预测中间序列，从而逐场景重建全片。
Result: 计算分析和媒体理论家反馈表明，73.1%的帧可识别为《迷魂记》的合理再现，仅3.6%完全失败，显示电影规范深度压缩在模型潜在先验中。

papers.title: Destination-Labeled Self-Looping Systems with Dwell: Intrinsic Characterization, Realization Cost, and Recognition
papers.abstract_en: We study a finite-state symbolic controller for systems in which the admissible visible transitions are fixed in advance and each visible state carries a minimum dwell requirement. The resulting model, which we call a destination-labeled self-looping system with dwell (DLSL system), records the visible graph together with local decision maps; dwell memory appears only after phase expansion. The main structural issue is that, once dwell is imposed, the current visible state no longer determines whether a departure is allowed. This leads to the converse problem: which deterministic transducers arise as phase-expanded realizations of DLSL systems over a fixed visible graph? We show that the answer is exactly the class of fiber-linear graph-respecting transducers. Under natural reachability and realizable-departure assumptions, equivalent accessible realizations over the same visible graph are isomorphic; in particular, the visible transduction determines the dwell vector and the local decision maps. We also prove that any graph-preserving deterministic realization enforcing dwell values $(d_i)$ requires exactly $\sum_i d_i$ control states. Finally, we give an $O(|Q||Ω|)$ recognition and reconstruction procedure, and extend the analysis to an edge-entry variant in which transitions may enter interior phases of successor fibers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一种带有最小停留时间要求的有限状态符号控制器模型——destination-labeled self-looping system with dwell (DLSL系统)。作者给出了这类系统的内在特征化，证明在固定可见图下，其相位展开实现等价于纤维线性图尊重传感器类，并且任何强制停留值(d_i)的图保持实现恰好需要∑d_i个控制状态。此外，还提供了一个O(|Q||Ω|)的识别与重构算法，并扩展到边入口变体。
Motivation: 在带有停留时间的系统中，当前可见状态是否允许离开不再由状态本身决定，这引发了逆向问题：哪些确定性传感器可以通过DLSL系统在固定可见图上实现？论文旨在给出系统的内在特征化和实现代价。
Method: 定义DLSL系统模型，引入相位展开将停留内存表示为相位，通过纤维线性图尊重传感器刻画可实现的传感器类。在自然可达性和可实现出发假设下，证明等价实现同构，并给出最小状态数下界和识别重构算法。
Result: 任何强制停留值(d_i)的图保持实现恰好需要∑d_i个控制状态；给出了一个O(|Q||Ω|)的识别与重构过程。DLSL系统的相位展开实现等价于纤维线性图尊重传感器类。
Conclusion: 论文给出了固定可见图下DLSL系统的精确特征化、实现代价和识别算法，提供了理论完备性。

papers.title: ATM: CID-Brokered Pre-Write Admission for Multi-Agent Code Co-Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems can decompose software-engineering work into planning, generation, validation, and repair, but a narrower systems problem remains: before any governed shared mutation is applied, a system must decide which concurrently formed write intents may proceed in parallel, which require deterministic composition or serialization, and which must take a fail-closed path. We address this problem with the AI-Atomic-Framework (ATM), a specification-grounded governance substrate for software agents operating within a single governance domain. ATM binds task intent, repository scope, write admission, validation, and evidence obligations into one governance chain. A Content Identifier (CID) broker serves as the shared-mutation admission subsystem. Adapter-guided atomization maps write intents to semantic atoms and bounded regions; when persistent atom-map coverage is incomplete, virtual atoms provide temporary auditable governance units for conservative comparison and routing. Governed shared writes are ultimately applied by a neutral steward rather than directly by proposing agents. Evaluation combines controlled, field, adoption, and extension evidence, including a 12-scenario deterministic design matrix, three archived runner cases, ATM-AdmissionBench, three archived same-file boundary cases, a three-week external-adopter study, and an operational recovery-routing benchmark. The results support feasibility, auditability, and bounded recoverability within the observed single-domain settings, but do not claim broad comparative superiority or cross-clone governance.
papers.comment: 40 pages, 8 figures. Source code and supplementary artifact links are described in the manuscript appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ATM (AI-Atomic-Framework)，一个基于规范的多代理 LLM 系统代码协同编写治理框架。ATM 通过内容标识符 (CID) 中介的写入准入机制，决定并发写入意图的并行、序列化或失败关闭路径，并将任务意图、仓库范围、验证和证据绑定到单一治理链。评估在单域设置下验证了可行性、可审计性和有界可恢复性。
Motivation: 多代理 LLM 系统在软件工程中面临并发写入意图的协调问题：需要决定哪些写入可并行、哪些需序列化或失败关闭，现有系统缺乏统一的、基于规范的治理机制。
Method: 提出 ATM 框架，包含 CID 中介的写入准入子系统、适配器引导的原子化（将写入意图映射到语义原子和虚拟原子）、以及中立管理员应用治理共享写入。评估使用控制实验、现场存档案例、基准测试和外部采用者研究。
Result: ATM 在 12 场景确定性设计矩阵、三个 runner 案例、ATM-AdmissionBench 基准等评估中展示了可行性、可审计性和有界可恢复性，但未声称广泛的比较优势或跨克隆治理能力。
Conclusion: ATM 在单域多代理代码协同场景中提供了有效的治理链，但需注意其适用范围限于单一治理域，且未验证跨克隆扩展性。

papers.title: Measuring Racial Disparities in Rent Growth Under Algorithmic Landlord Concentration in U.S. Metros
papers.abstract_en: The 2024 Department of Justice antitrust complaint against RealPage, Inc. named five major residential REITs for coordinating algorithmic rent pricing across hundreds of thousands of apartment units in major US metropolitan areas. This paper studies whether census-tract-level corporate landlord concentration (CLC), measured from SEC EDGAR 10-K property filings geocoded to census tracts, the first such application in the literature, is associated with rent growth 2019-2023, and whether that association is larger in majority-minority neighborhoods. Rent outcomes are measured using the Zillow Observed Rent Index (ZORI). To account for the possibility that corporate landlords preferentially locate in neighborhoods already seeing rent appreciation, all regressions control for a fully novel Algorithmic Housing Burden Index (AHBI), a composite of pre-existing rent burden and market tightness from ACS data. Across 665 census tracts in ten US metropolitan areas, doubling REIT concentration is associated with 2.8 percentage points higher rent growth (p = 0.086, p = 0.030, HC1 robust). This association is significantly stronger in majority-minority tracts. Within the same metro, high-CLC majority-minority tracts are associated with 5.9 percentage points higher rent growth than comparable white tracts (p = 0.039). An XGBoost model predicts 44 percent of out-of-sample rent growth variance, with SHAP analysis independently confirming that CLC's contribution is positive in minority tracts and negative in white tracts. Taken all together, these findings provide the first tract-level evidence consistent with corporate landlord concentration being associated with disproportionately higher rent growth in communities of color.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用 SEC EDGAR 10-K 文件中的房产信息，首次构建了美国人口普查区级别的企业房东集中度（CLC）指标，并研究其与 2019-2023 年租金增长的关系，特别关注种族差异。研究发现，REIT 集中度翻倍与租金增长 2.8 个百分点相关（p=0.086, HC1 稳健 p=0.030），且在多数族裔社区中关联更强。XGBoost 模型可解释 44% 的租金增长方差，SHAP 分析证实 CLC 在少数族裔区贡献为正，在白人区为负。
Motivation: 2024 年司法部针对 RealPage 提起反垄断诉讼，指控其协调算法租金定价。现有研究缺乏基于普查区的企业房东集中度数据，也鲜少关注其对不同种族社区的差异化影响。
Method: 从 SEC EDGAR 10-K 文件提取房产信息并地理编码至普查区，构建 CLC 指标；使用 Zillow 观察租金指数（ZORI）衡量租金增长；构建算法住房负担指数（AHBI）作为控制变量；采用回归分析和 XGBoost 模型进行预测和 SHAP 解释。
Result: 在 10 个都市区 665 个普查区中，REIT 集中度翻倍与 2.8 个百分点的租金增长相关；在同一都市区内，高 CLC 的多数族裔区比类似白人区租金增长高 5.9 个百分点；XGBoost 预测 44% 的租金增长方差。
Conclusion: 提供了首个普查区层面的证据，表明企业房东集中度与有色人种社区不成比例的租金增长相关。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Making Failure Safe: A Constrained, Verifiable Agent Framework for Open-Web Data Collection
papers.abstract_en: LLMs and agents can generate web scrapers from natural-language requirements, but direct generation remains unreliable because of dependency errors, broken selectors, schema mismatches, and heterogeneous page structures. We propose a constrained, verifiable agent framework that shifts LLM output from free-form code to typed JSON collector configurations, combining a six-type collector taxonomy, template and utility-function constraints, static Airflow DAG execution, rule-based quality checking, and structured feedback correction. Experiments on 138 tasks show that the taxonomy supports description-based requirement typing, while confirming that stable instantiation requires completing source, field, and execution constraints beyond the initial description. On 80 independently source-verified tasks, the framework runs with zero execution-stage LLM tokens and the lowest average wall-clock time, trading moderate one-shot quality for a reusable, deterministic, and verifiable execution path suited to repeated scheduled collection. These results position the framework as a reusable, low-cost, and verifiable execution path for repeated open-web data collection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM和agent直接生成网络爬虫时因依赖错误、选择器失效、模式不匹配等问题而不可靠的情况，提出一个受限且可验证的agent框架。该框架将LLM输出从自由形式代码转换为类型化的JSON收集器配置，结合六类收集器分类法、模板和效用函数约束、静态Airflow DAG执行、基于规则的质量检查和结构化反馈修正。实验表明，该框架在138个任务上支持基于描述的需求分类，并在80个独立源验证任务中以零执行阶段LLM token和最低平均壁钟时间运行，为重复的开放网络数据收集提供了可重用、确定且可验证的执行路径。
Motivation: 现有LLM和agent直接生成网络爬虫在开放网络数据收集场景中不可靠，主要因为依赖错误、选择器失效、模式不匹配以及页面结构异构等问题，缺乏约束和可验证性。
Method: 提出一个受限的可验证agent框架，核心是将LLM输出从自由形式代码转换为类型化的JSON收集器配置，具体包括六类收集器分类法、模板和效用函数约束、静态Airflow DAG执行、基于规则的质量检查以及结构化反馈修正机制。
Result: 在138个任务上验证了分类法支持基于描述的需求类型确定，但稳定实例化需满足源、字段和执行约束。在80个独立源验证任务上，框架以零执行阶段LLM token和最低平均壁钟时间运行，其一次生成质量中等，但提供了可重用、确定且可验证的执行路径。
Conclusion: 该框架为重复的开放网络数据收集提供了一种可重用、低成本且可验证的执行路径，尽管一次生成质量并非最佳，但通过确定性执行和结构化反馈确保了长期可靠性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Dexterous Manipulation Using Contact Wrench Guidance From Human Demonstration
papers.abstract_en: Dexterous robot manipulation can benefit from the abundance of human demonstrations, but transferring such demonstrations to robot policies remains challenging. We present Contact Wrench Guidance from Human Demonstration in Robotic Dexterous Manipulation (CHORD), a framework for long-horizon manipulation of rigid and articulated objects with reinforcement learning. The key idea is object-centric contact wrench space guidance: we represent human and robot motions by the forces and torques they can induce on the object, enabling similarity to be measured by the induced instantaneous motions. This guidance makes reinforcement learning more scalable for contact-rich dexterous manipulation. We further introduce a large-scale simulation benchmark with 4,739 bimanual dexterous manipulation tasks, constructed from motion-capture datasets and reconstructed in-house videos. Evaluated on 1,831 benchmark tasks, CHORD achieves an average success rate of 82.12%, demonstrating strong scalability. CHORD also generalizes to whole-body manipulation from hand-only and third-person demonstrations, achieving a 90.77% success rate, and the learned policies transfer to the real world in both open-loop and closed-loop settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CHORD框架，利用人类演示中的接触扳手引导（contact wrench guidance）进行灵巧机器人操作，通过强化学习实现长时域操作。核心思想是用物体上的力和力矩表示人与机器人的动作，从而衡量相似性，提升强化学习可扩展性。研究还构建了包含4739个双手灵巧操作任务的大规模仿真基准，在1831个任务上平均成功率达82.12%，并展示了从手部演示和第三人称演示到全身操作的泛化能力（成功率达90.77%），且策略可迁移到真实世界。
Motivation: 人类演示丰富但难以直接迁移到机器人策略，现有方法在接触丰富的灵巧操作中可扩展性不足。
Method: CHORD框架：以物体为中心的接触扳手空间引导，将人类和机器人动作统一表示为对物体产生的力/力矩，通过诱导的瞬时运动衡量相似性，并在此基础上进行强化学习。
Result: 在1831个任务上平均成功率82.12%；从手部和第三人称演示泛化到全身操作成功率达90.77%；策略可在开环和闭环设置下迁移到真实世界。
Conclusion: CHORD利用接触扳手引导有效提升强化学习在灵巧操作中的可扩展性，且能够泛化到不同演示类型并迁移到真实环境。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The MMM Data Model -- A Normative Specification for Knowledge Interoperability in a Decentralisable Knowledge Commons
papers.abstract_en: Many information systems are built around documents: self-contained units optimised for print production and linear reading. While effective for large-scale dissemination, the document-centric organisation constrains how knowledge can be structured, updated, shared, and reused. Formal approaches address some of these limitations but struggle to achieve widespread contribution and adoption due to their prioritisation of formal structure over other system properties such as human usability and scope. AI systems are reshaping document production, but without providing a unified portable alternative to traditional documents for humans' expression and exchange of knowledge. This paper presents MMM, a data model for knowledge documentation that emerged from the practical needs of interdisciplinary collaborative research, and positioned here within a comparative analysis of the design space of information systems. MMM combines a small set of normative constraints with the expressive freedom of free-text labels. It is designed for interoperability across disciplines, applications and deployments without requiring semantic convergence. A reference implementation and pilot deployment data demonstrate implementability and early usability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MMM数据模型，一种用于知识文档的规范说明，旨在实现跨学科、跨应用的知识互操作性。该模型结合少量规范约束与自由文本标签的灵活表达，并通过参考实现和试点部署数据验证了可行性和早期可用性。
Motivation: 现有信息系统以文档为中心，限制了知识的结构化、更新、共享和复用；形式化方法虽能解决部分问题但难以推广；AI系统未提供统一的文档替代方案。
Method: MMM数据模型采用少量规范约束（如实体、关系、属性）与自由文本标签结合，强调互操作性而不要求语义收敛，参考实现和试点部署用于验证。
Result: 摘要报告了模型的可行性和早期可用性，但未提供具体定量结果。
Conclusion: MMM模型为知识文档提供了一种新的数据模型，适合跨学科协作，但需要进一步评估其在实际应用中的效果。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Memory-Native Non-Terrestrial Networks for Embodied Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Non-terrestrial networks (NTN) provide ubiquitous connectivity for embodied intelligence (EI), enabling robots in wilderness to leverage cloud resources or report critical information to remote centers. However, the synergy is nontrivial due to the highly-dynamic, resource-constrained, topology-varying, and task-oriented environment. Existing memoryless NTN protocols become inefficient, since the decisions are driven by local channel conditions and instantaneous service demands. To address these limitations, this paper proposes the memory-native NTN (MemNTN) paradigm that leverages long-horizon contexts for memory augmented system optimization. To realize this paradigm shift, we establish a dual-memory architecture that distinguishes between physical memory representing the state of the world and digital memory encoding historical network experience. We develop memory acquisition, compression, valuation, update, and utilization mechanisms that facilitate cross-layer, memory-native decision-making, spanning from the physical and access layers up to the network and application layers. Experiments in satellite embodied question answering (SEQA) demonstrate that the proposed MemNTN significantly outperforms conventional stateless NTN and terrestrial approaches.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables, submitted to IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出记忆原生非地面网络（MemNTN）范式，用于解决具身智能在动态、资源受限环境中的通信问题。通过双内存架构区分物理内存和数字内存，并设计内存获取、压缩、估值、更新和利用机制，实现跨层决策。在卫星具身问答（SEQA）实验中，MemNTN显著优于传统无状态NTN和地面方法。
Motivation: 现有无状态NTN协议因依赖局部信道条件和瞬时服务需求，在高度动态、资源受限且任务驱动的环境中效率低下。
Method: 提出MemNTN范式，建立双内存架构（物理内存表示世界状态，数字内存编码历史网络经验），并开发内存获取、压缩、估值、更新和利用机制，实现跨层内存原生决策。
Result: 在卫星具身问答（SEQA）实验中，MemNTN显著优于传统无状态NTN和地面方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调MemNTN利用长程上下文进行内存增强系统优化，有效解决了现有NTN的局限性。

papers.title: Urban Deceleration Behavior Modes Under Scene Context: An Early-Kinematic Classifier from Argoverse 2 Multi-Agent Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Urban deceleration is one of the most empirically studied yet least taxonomically organized behaviors in car-following research. Recent perception-equipped autonomous-vehicle datasets enable trajectory-anchored mode discovery. We extract 1,219 sustained deceleration events from 234 urban driving logs of the Argoverse 2 Sensor dataset, encode each event in a 19-dimensional kinematic feature vector, discover behavioral modes via K-means clustering with bootstrap stability analysis, and quantify modulation by eleven scene-context variables. A HistGradientBoosting classifier predicts mode membership from the first 1.0 s of each event. Four stable modes emerge with a bootstrap Adjusted Rand Index of 0.897 across 50 resamples: anticipatory soft (62.8%), reactive closing (30.6%), brake-like jerk (4.8%), and an outlier category (1.8%). Only pair age shows a medium effect (epsilon^2 = 0.085); scene geometry and vulnerable-road-user proximity show negligible effects. The early-event classifier achieves macro-F1 = 0.758 at 1.0 s, with scene context contributing +0.059 F1 over kinematics alone. Modes are regime-invariant in medium-speed driving (ARI = 0.817) but regime-dependent at low speed (ARI = 0.166). A small set of stable kinematic modes structures urban deceleration; early-window jerk dominates predictive signal; and pair age is the primary contextual modulator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从Argoverse 2数据集中提取1219个持续减速事件，通过19维运动学特征和K-means聚类发现四种稳定模式：预期性软减速（62.8%）、反应性接近（30.6%）、制动式急动（4.8%）和异常类别（1.8%）。早期1秒数据使用HistGradientBoosting分类器预测模式，macro-F1达0.758；场景上下文（尤其是配对年龄）仅提供微小提升（+0.059 F1）。
Motivation: 城市减速是跟车研究中实证充分但缺乏分类组织的行为，现有工作未系统利用轨迹数据发现运动模式。
Method: 从Argoverse 2传感器数据集的234段城市驾驶日志中提取减速事件，编码为19维运动学特征向量，通过K-means聚类和bootstrap稳定性分析发现模式，并用HistGradientBoosting分类器从1.0秒早期窗口预测模式。
Result: 四种模式稳定（调整兰德指数0.897），其中预期性软减速占62.8%；早期分类macro-F1=0.758，场景上下文贡献+0.059 F1；配对年龄是主要调节变量（epsilon^2=0.085）。
Conclusion: 城市减速行为可由少量稳定运动学模式构成，早期急动信号是主要预测特征，配对年龄是主要场景调制因素。

papers.title: FLYNN: Robust Neural Network for Robot Navigation using Fly Brain Topology
papers.abstract_en: While deep learning models achieve state-of-the-art performance in complex tasks, they remain brittle when faced with new environments or sensory deprivation. In contrast, biological systems exhibit remarkable tolerance to these challenges. We address this vulnerability by developing a recurrent neural network (RNN) whose architecture is directly derived from the synaptic-resolution brain connectome of the fruit fly Drosophila melanogaster. We demonstrate the feasibility of training the fly connectome neural network (FLYNN) to perform vision-based navigation in MuJoCo, achieving performance comparable to modern hand-crafted networks of similar parameter counts. Crucially, FLYNN exhibits superior resistance to out-of-distribution (OOD) data and tolerance to sensory loss without further training. It remained functional even under total vision loss while hand-crafted networks largely failed, even when specifically trained with camera dropout. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) of the internal state of FLYNN suggests that it exhibits a particularly high degree of representational modularity, which might be related to its robustness. Our work provides a new direction for designing resilient artificial agents following the topology of biological brains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FLYNN，一种直接从果蝇大脑连接体导出的循环神经网络，用于视觉导航任务。在MuJoCo环境中，FLYNN性能与现代手工网络相当，但展现出更强的分布外数据鲁棒性和感官丢失容忍性，即使在完全失明条件下仍能工作，而手工网络即使经过专门训练也会失效。PCA分析表明其内部状态具有高度表征模块化，可能与其鲁棒性相关。
Motivation: 深度学习模型在复杂任务中表现出色，但在面对新环境或感官缺失时脆弱；生物系统则具有显著容错性。本文旨在通过果蝇脑连接体拓扑设计人工神经网络，以克服这一脆弱性。
Method: 直接利用果蝇Drosophila melanogaster的突触分辨脑连接体构建循环神经网络（FLYNN），并在MuJoCo中训练其执行基于视觉的导航任务。
Result: FLYNN在参数数量相近的情况下达到与现代手工网络相当的性能；在分布外数据和感官丢失（包括完全失明）条件下，FLYNN仍保持功能，而手工网络即使经过丢失训练也基本失效。
Conclusion: 基于生物脑拓扑设计神经网络可显著提升鲁棒性，为构建弹性人工智能体提供新方向。

papers.title: Aligning Sentence Embeddings to Human Concepts via Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Dense sentence embeddings are fundamental to modern Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems but suffer from a lack of interpretability due to feature superposition. This opacity hinders the alignment of retrieval processes with human intent, as the entangled representations are difficult to analyze or control. In this work, we propose a method to disentangle the dense representations of sentence transformers (e.g., E5) into human-interpretable concepts using Top-k Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs). We demonstrate that these disentangled features align with specific semantic, syntactic, and pragmatic categories. Furthermore, we introduce an activation steering mechanism that allows for precise intervention in the retrieval process. By clamping specific latent features, we show that it is possible to re-rank search results to better align with user constraints without retraining the backbone model. Our findings suggest that SAE-based decomposition offers a viable path toward transparent and steerable neural information retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出使用Top-k稀疏自编码器（SAEs）将句子变换器（如E5）的稠密表示分解为可解释的语义、句法和语用概念，并引入激活引导机制来干预检索过程，无需重新训练即可重新排序搜索结果以对齐用户约束。
Motivation: 稠密句子嵌入在检索增强生成系统中缺乏可解释性，特征叠加阻碍了检索过程与人类意图的对齐，难以分析和控制。
Method: 采用Top-k稀疏自编码器对句子变换器的稠密表示进行概念分解，并通过钳制特定潜在特征实现激活引导，从而调节检索结果。
Result: 实验表明分解后的特征与语义、句法、语用类别对齐，且引导机制能够有效地重新排序搜索结果以符合用户约束。
Conclusion: 基于SAE的分解为透明且可引导的神经信息检索提供了可行路径，无需重新训练骨干模型。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LLMs in the Real World: Evaluating "AI" in Emergency Contexts
papers.abstract_en: This paper offers a call to action. We urge our colleagues in the research community to play a greater role in the articulation of our findings to the public. To illustrate the stakes we present a case study on the initial stages of an LLM-based machine translation application's deployment in a real-world context: a text-2-911 system advertising capabilities in 55 languages for use in emergencies in which it may be difficult to call operators directly. We identify a number of common misconceptions about technologies such as these, concluding with a set of concrete recommendations and best practices for stakeholders at every stage of the development and deployment pipeline. While the advancement of scientific research often lies in solving the "hard" problems, we argue it is often the "easy" ones -- problems for which the latest technology is often unnecessary -- that are most overlooked.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACL Findings 2026 in San Diego
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇呼吁性论文，敦促研究社区在向公众传达研究成果方面发挥更大作用。以基于LLM的机器翻译系统在文本-911紧急服务中的部署为案例，指出关于此类技术的常见误解，并提出开发和部署各阶段的具体建议。论文认为，往往是最简单的、不需要最新技术的问题最容易被忽视。
Motivation: 研究社区在向公众准确传达AI技术的能力和局限方面参与不足，导致部署中产生误解；同时，简单但重要的问题常被忽视。
Method: 采用案例研究方法，分析一个声称支持55种语言的文本-911系统在紧急情境下部署的初始阶段，识别误解并提炼最佳实践。
Result: 识别出关于LLM翻译系统的常见误解，并为利益相关者提供了一组具体建议和最佳实践。

papers.title: Learning User-Aware Recall: Personalized Retrieval in Long-Term Conversational Memory
papers.abstract_en: Long-term conversational agents are expected to remember past interactions, but memory is useful only when the right evidence is recalled for the right user. Existing memory-augmented LLM agents have made progress in building compact memory banks, yet retrieval is still often driven by query-centered similarity or fixed ranking rules, leaving user-conditioned relevance underexplored.To address this gap, we propose Profile-guided Personalized Retrieval Optimization (PPRO), a retrieval-centric framework that makes memory retrieval both user-aware and optimizable.PPRO builds episodic and semantic memory banks from dialogue histories and derives a user profile from accumulated memories.The profile serves as an explicit personalized prior in memory ranking, allowing retrieval to account for stable user attributes, preferences, and relationships.PPRO further trains a query rewriter with Group Relative Policy Optimization, using both evidence retrieval quality and downstream answer quality as feedback while keeping the memory banks and answer model fixed.Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S show consistent gains over training-free memory systems and training-based baselines.Ablation studies further show that both profile-guided ranking and retrieval-oriented rewriting contribute substantially to performance, highlighting retrieval optimization as a key factor in personalized long-term memory use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Profile-guided Personalized Retrieval Optimization (PPRO) 框架，用于长程对话记忆中的个性化检索。PPRO 从对话历史构建记忆库和用户画像，利用画像作为个性化先验进行记忆排序，并通过组相对策略优化训练查询重写器，以证据检索质量和答案质量作为反馈。实验在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval-S 上显示一致提升。
Motivation: 现有记忆增强的 LLM 代理在检索时多依赖查询中心相似度或固定排序规则，忽略了用户条件相关性。
Method: 提出 PPRO 框架，构建情景和语义记忆库，从累积记忆中提取用户画像作为显式个性化先验用于记忆排序；采用组相对策略优化训练查询重写器，以检索质量和答案质量作为反馈，保持记忆库和答案模型固定。
Result: 在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval-S 基准上，PPRO 一致优于无训练记忆系统和基于训练的基线。
Conclusion: 检索优化是个性化长程记忆使用的关键因素，消融研究表明画像引导排序和检索导向重写均贡献显著。

papers.title: Libra: Training the Environment for Agentic Information Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Information localization within massive repositories is a cornerstone of agentic LLM systems. While synthetic data-driven optimization has proven successful in training LLMs, little attention has been paid to optimizing the agent's working environment (the repository itself) in a data-driven manner. To bridge this gap, we present Libra, a self-evolving framework that introduces mutable "catalogs" (hierarchical Markdown files serving as navigable indices) into the repository. Libra runs an LLM-driven optimization loop where a Prompter generates synthetic queries, a frozen Solver attempts to resolve them by navigating the catalogs, and a Healer rewrites the catalogs in response to the Solver's localization failures. Evaluations across 12 SWE-bench Lite repositories demonstrate that this environmental healing yields continual, logarithmic improvements in code localization accuracy. Furthermore, these environmental improvements transfer zero-shot across different LLMs and problem sets. Although the focus of this paper is to study the general behavior of such a system, we also demonstrate that a minimalist coding agent equipped with Libra-optimized catalogs outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/salesforce-misc/Libra and data at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Salesforce/Libra.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Libra框架，通过引入可变的Markdown目录（catalogs）作为导航索引，利用LLM驱动的优化循环（Prompter生成查询、Solver解决定位、Healer重写目录）持续改进智能体工作环境。在12个SWE-bench Lite仓库上，该方法实现了代码定位准确率的对数级持续提升，且优化后的环境能零样本迁移到不同LLM和问题集。
Motivation: 现有研究多聚焦于优化LLM本身，但忽略了智能体工作环境（仓库）的优化。代码定位任务中，仓库结构直接影响信息检索效率，因此需要数据驱动的环境优化方法。
Method: Libra框架包含三个组件：Prompter生成合成查询，Solver（冻结的LLM）通过导航目录尝试定位，Healer根据定位失败重写目录。三者形成闭环优化，持续改进仓库结构。
Result: 在12个SWE-bench Lite仓库中，环境更新带来对数级的持续定位精度提升；优化后的目录能零样本迁移至不同LLM和问题集。配备优化目录的最小代码智能体在性能上超越了现有最强基线。
Conclusion: 实验表明，智能体工作环境的数据驱动优化是提升信息检索性能的有效途径，且环境改进具有跨模型迁移能力。

papers.title: Towards an automated AI-based framework for floor plan compliance checks for residential buildings
papers.abstract_en: To improve residents' well-being in Australia's urban areas, governments have introduced policy reforms such as SEPP65, BADS, and SPP7.3 to enhance apartment design quality. These regulations require precise geometric and spatial analysis to evaluate health-related features, including daylight access, natural ventilation, privacy, and space efficiency. However, compliance checking remains challenging due to its manual, time-intensive nature. Additionally, evolving policies limit scalability for large-scale assessments across thousands of apartments. Existing automated floor plan analysis methods are fragmented and typically focus on single apartments, lacking a unified framework for multi-unit compliance checking. This article explores current advancements in automated floor plan analysis, particularly AI-driven approaches, and highlights key challenges in their practical adoption. To address these gaps, a conceptual framework is proposed for automated compliance checking in multi-apartment buildings. A Large Language Model (LLM) is used within a Rule Engine to convert textual building codes into executable, explainable rules. A Data Extraction Engine segments floor plan images into elements such as walls, rooms, fixtures, text, and symbols, and transforms them into a structured building graph with topological relationships. This structured representation is then evaluated by a Compliance Check Engine, which leverages LLM-generated rules for assessment. The proposed framework offers a scalable, consistent, and transparent approach to automated compliance checking across jurisdictions, supporting efficient enforcement of apartment design standards and promoting healthier, higher-density urban development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对澳大利亚公寓设计规范（如SEPP65等）的合规检查自动化问题，提出一个基于AI的框架。框架使用大语言模型将建筑规范文本转换为可执行规则，并通过数据提取引擎将平面图分割为元素并构建结构化建筑图，最后由合规检查引擎进行评估。摘要指出该方法可扩展、一致且透明，支持跨辖区的自动化合规检查。
Motivation: 现有建筑平面图合规检查依赖人工，耗时且难以大规模应用；现有自动分析方法碎片化，缺乏统一框架。
Method: 提出概念框架，包括三个引擎：规则引擎使用LLM将建筑规范文本转化为可解释规则；数据提取引擎将平面图图像分割为墙、房间、固定装置等元素，并转换为结构化建筑图；合规检查引擎利用LLM生成的规则对结构化表示进行评估。
Result: 摘要未提供具体的实验数值结果，仅描述框架设计。
Conclusion: 该框架提供可扩展、一致且透明的自动化合规检查方法，支持多单元公寓的设计标准执行，促进健康高密度城市发展。

papers.title: GRACE-RAG: Governed Retrieval Architecture for Canonical Evidence Synthesis, Enabling Lightweight Deployment in Closed-Domain Institutional Settings
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are widely used in institutional question answering settings where responses must be grounded in authoritative documentation (Gao et al., 2023). In entity-dense domains where relevant information is distributed across heterogeneous documents, vector-only retrieval often produces fragmented evidence and increases dependence on inference-time reasoning (Zhao et al., 2024). This paper introduces GRACE-RAG, a retrieval-governed, graph-augmented RAG architecture that externalizes structural reasoning from the generative stage to a structured retrieval layer, resolving structural ambiguity offline, enabling deployment on self-hosted lightweight models calibrated to closed-domain institutional vocabulary. Experiments across three model capacities: Mistral 24B, GPT OSS 120B, and Gemini 2.5 Flash show consistent improvements in completeness, depth, and anticipatory coverage, with overall quality gains of up to 20% under mid-scale models, indicating that retrieval architecture governs structural quality over model scale, reducing computational and latency footprint without dependence on proprietary systems.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to COLM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GRACE-RAG，一种检索治理的图增强RAG架构，将结构推理外化到检索层，从而在封闭域机构场景下实现轻量级部署。实验表明，在Mistral 24B、GPT OSS 120B和Gemini 2.5 Flash三种规模模型上，该方法在完整性、深度和预期覆盖率上均取得一致改进，中等规模模型整体质量提升最高达20%，说明检索架构决定结构质量而非模型规模。
Motivation: 在实体密集的机构问答场景中，向量检索常产生碎片化证据，增加推理时依赖，且需要大规模模型。现有RAG系统在封闭域、异构文档环境下效率低下。
Method: 提出检索治理的图增强RAG架构（GRACE-RAG），将结构推理从生成阶段外化到结构化的检索层，离线解决结构歧义，支持在自托管轻量模型上部署。
Result: 在Mistral 24B、GPT OSS 120B和Gemini 2.5 Flash上，GRACE-RAG在完整性、深度和预期覆盖率上均提升，中等规模模型整体质量增益高达20%。
Conclusion: 检索架构决定结构质量，而不是模型规模；该方法能减少计算和延迟开销，且不依赖专有系统。

papers.title: PRA-RAG: Provably Robust Aggregation in Retrieval-Augmented Generation against Retrieval Corruption
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances Large Language Models (LLMs) by incorporating external knowledge, effectively mitigating their inherent knowledge limitations. However, RAG remains vulnerable to poisoning attacks that manipulate retrieved texts to mislead model outputs. Existing defense mechanisms often lack theoretical robustness guarantees and perform unreliably when the LLM has limited knowledge of the retrieved content. In this work, we propose PRA-RAG, a provably robust retrieval aggregation algorithm designed to defend against poisoning attacks on retrieved texts. PRA-RAG samples multiple combinations of retrieved texts and utilizes geometric structures in the embedding space to identify a robust subset, from which a stable aggregated representation is derived. We provide theoretical bounds on the maximum impact of poisoned retrieved content and establish a quantitative measure of RAG's robustness. Experiments across multiple benchmarks and RAG architectures demonstrate that PRA-RAG reduces the attack success rate to as low as 1% while maintaining an accuracy of 71%, significantly outperforming representative state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PRA-RAG，一种可证明鲁棒的检索聚合算法，用于防御检索增强生成（RAG）中针对检索文本的投毒攻击。该方法通过采样检索文本的多种组合，利用嵌入空间的几何结构识别鲁棒子集，并推导稳定聚合表示，提供理论上的鲁棒性界。实验表明，PRA-RAG在多个基准和RAG架构上将攻击成功率降至1%，同时保持71%的准确率，显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: RAG易受投毒攻击操纵检索文本误导模型输出，现有防御缺乏理论鲁棒性保证，且在LLM对检索内容知识有限时不可靠。
Method: 提出PRA-RAG算法，采样多种检索文本组合，利用嵌入空间的几何结构识别鲁棒子集，从中推导稳定聚合表示，并给出受污染内容最大影响的理论界。
Result: 在多个基准和RAG架构上，PRA-RAG将攻击成功率降至1%，同时保持71%的准确率，显著优于代表性最先进方法。
Conclusion: PRA-RAG提供了可证明的鲁棒聚合，有效防御检索文本投毒攻击，理论界量化了RAG的鲁棒性。

papers.title: SkillSelect-Serve: Budget-Controllable and QoS-Aware Skill Service Recommendation and Composition for Small LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reusable skill libraries are becoming important infrastructure for large language model (LLM) agents, yet existing selection methods often treat skills as retrievable documents and return fixed top-k lists. This paper presents SkillSelect-Serve, a budget-controllable and QoS-aware framework that formulates agent skill selection as Skill Service Recommendation and Composition. SkillSelect-Serve represents raw skills as structured Skill Services with functional descriptions, dependencies, context cost, risk, and QoS-related attributes. A local Micro-Agent Requirement Planner converts natural-language tasks into structured service requirements, while a shared discovery backbone retrieves candidate services from a large registry. The framework then performs dual-granularity utility modeling with skill-level marginal suitability estimation and bundle-level calibration for coverage, redundancy, cost, and risk trade-offs. Experiments on 35,353 skills and 586 task queries show that SkillSelect-Serve consistently improves same-budget bundle recall and mean utility over fixed top-k retrieval baselines.
papers.summary_zh:

Method: SkillSelect-Serve框架包含：局部微代理需求规划器（将自然语言任务转为结构化服务需求）、共享发现骨干（从注册中心检索候选服务）、以及双粒度效用建模（技能级边际适宜性估计和包级校准，平衡覆盖、冗余、成本和风险）。
Result: 在35,353个技能和586个任务查询上的实验表明，SkillSelect-Serve在相同预算下持续优于固定top-k检索基线，提高了包召回率和平均效用。
Conclusion: 该框架证明了将技能选择建模为服务推荐与组合问题，并引入双粒度效用建模，能有效提升预算可控和QoS感知的代理性能。

papers.title: Prompt Optimization for User Simulation in Conversational Recommender Systems: A Multi-Objective Framework
papers.abstract_en: Conversational recommender systems (CRSs) are a core component of next-generation intelligent recommender systems because they enable users to actively elicit preferences, clarify intentions, and adapt recommendations in real time. However, there are two key obstacles in the CRS domain: evaluation and access to training data. Evaluating CRSs through real human studies is more critical than for traditional recommender systems, yet such studies are both costly and time-consuming. Moreover, CRS interaction data are often difficult to obtain for model training due to privacy concerns. Large language model (LLM)-based user simulators have shown promise in addressing both challenges by generating synthetic user interactions for evaluation and training. However, existing approaches suffer from systematic positive bias, data leakage, and limited behavioral diversity, and they rely on brittle manual prompt engineering that requires extensive domain expertise. In this paper, we propose a framework to automatically optimize prompts for LLM-based user simulators in CRSs, simultaneously mitigating these issues. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves improved behavioral alignment with human interaction patterns compared to baseline methods across diverse prompt settings.
papers.comment: to be published in 2026 IEEE 42nd International Conference on Data Engineering Workshops (ICDEW)

TL;DR: 本文针对会话推荐系统（CRS）中用户模拟器提示词优化问题，提出一个多目标框架自动优化LLM模拟器的提示，旨在减少系统性正偏、数据泄露和有限行为多样性。实验证明相比基线方法，该方法在不同提示设置下实现了与人类交互模式更好的行为对齐。

Method: 提出一个自动优化提示的多目标框架，同时缓解多个问题，并通过实验验证其有效性。
Result: 该框架在多种提示设置下相比基线方法，实现了更好的与人类交互模式的行为对齐。
Conclusion: 自动提示优化可以改善LLM用户模拟器的行为真实性，但对CRS的实际效果需进一步验证。

papers.title: Controllable Narrative Rendering for Enhanced Assisted Writing
papers.abstract_en: Despite the remarkable proficiency of large language models (LLMs) in basic writing assistance, their utility in creative writing is fundamentally hindered by a persistent binary failure. This issue manifests as an oscillation between safe, surface-level editing, referred to as remedial polishing, and destructive, uncontrolled plot expansion. This dilemma defines a critical trade-off between narrative fidelity and descriptive intensity. We propose Loom, an assisted writing framework grounded in the narratological distinction between story and discourse. Loom employs a three-layer pipeline that operationalizes an intent-centered semiotic chain-of-thought to enforce precise control over narrative intent and rendering density. This architecture separates the generation of perceptual material from syntactic insertion, ensuring that enhancement occurs without violating the original event structure. Our comprehensive evaluation, which includes LLM-based metrics and human assessment, demonstrates that Loom successfully resolves this fundamental tension. Loom achieves the highest overall quality score, yielding substantial gains in factual integrity and descriptive intensity compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型在创意写作中存在的二元失败问题（在安全表面编辑与破坏性情节扩展之间振荡），提出基于叙事学中故事与话语区分的辅助写作框架Loom。Loom采用三层管线，通过以意图为中心的语义链思维实现对叙事意图和渲染密度的精确控制，将感知材料生成与句法插入分离，确保增强不破坏原始事件结构。评估表明Loom在事实完整性和描述强度上显著优于当前最优基线。
Motivation: 当前LLM在创意写作辅助中面临安全表面编辑与破坏性情节扩展之间的二元困境，无法同时保证叙事保真度和描述强度。
Method: 提出Loom框架，基于叙事学区分故事与话语，采用三层管线：意图中心语义链思维（intent-centered semiotic chain-of-thought）控制叙事意图和渲染密度，将感知材料生成与句法插入分离。
Result: Loom在整体质量评分上最高，相比基线在事实完整性和描述强度上取得显著提升。
Conclusion: 论文表明通过叙事学理论和分离生成与插入的架构，可以有效解决LLM创意写作中的保真度-强度权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SchemaRAG: Dynamic Large Schema Reduction for LLM-driven Structured Information Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Extracting structured data from unstructured text using large language models (LLMs) becomes challenging when target schemas are large and complex. In such cases, including the full schema in the prompt increases cost and latency, risks lost-in-the-middle performance degradation, and can exceed context length limits. We propose SchemaRAG, a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework that dynamically prunes the output schema space for schema-conditioned information extraction tasks by leveraging schema metadata and few-shot examples when available. We evaluate SchemaRAG on real-world healthcare and e-commerce datasets. Our results show that SchemaRAG can achieve up to an 8.8% increase in micro-F1, a 47% reduction in latency, and a 48% reduction in token costs, demonstrating its practicality for large-schema extraction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SchemaRAG，一种检索增强生成（RAG）框架，用于LLM驱动的结构化信息提取，通过动态裁剪大型输出模式空间来降低成本和延迟。在真实医疗和电商数据集上，微F1提升8.8%，延迟降低47%，token成本降低48%。
Motivation: 大型复杂模式导致提示中完整包含模式会增加成本、延迟，存在中间丢失性能下降风险，并可能超出上下文长度限制。
Method: SchemaRAG利用模式元数据和少样本示例动态裁剪输出模式空间，实现大型模式下的高效信息提取。
Result: 在真实医疗和电商数据集上，SchemaRAG实现微F1提升8.8%，延迟降低47%，token成本降低48%。
Conclusion: SchemaRAG展示了在大规模模式提取中的实用性，平衡了性能、成本和延迟。

papers.title: BaRA: BFS-and-Reflection Web Data Collection Agent
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based web agents reduce manual scripting for web data collection, yet on live websites, they often miss relevant pages, return incomplete multimodal outputs, or return media URLs that are not directly downloadable. We present BFS-and-Reflection Agent (BaRA), a framework for site-level collection under a fixed interaction budget. The framework combines bounded breadth-first search (BFS) traversal with history-based self-reflection. We evaluate BaRA on 50 synthetic websites with ground-truth reference sets. We additionally test on three public websites with cluttered or dynamic layouts. BaRA outperforms Pure LLM, SeeAct-Vision, and Browser-use on link discovery and downloadable multimodal extraction, with the largest gains in download-valid image and video recovery. Our code is available at https://github.com/MLAI-Yonsei/BaRA-Agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BaRA，一种基于广度优先搜索和自反思的Web数据收集框架，用于在固定交互预算下高效抓取网站。该方法结合有界BFS遍历与历史自反思，在50个合成网站和3个公共网站上优于纯LLM、SeeAct-Vision和Browser-use方法，尤其在可下载的图片和视频恢复方面提升显著。
Motivation: 基于LLM的Web代理在实时网站上常遗漏相关页面、返回不完整的多模态输出或无法下载媒体URL，现有方法缺乏系统性的站点级收集策略。
Method: 提出BFS-and-Reflection Agent (BaRA)，结合有界广度优先搜索遍历与基于历史的自反思机制，在固定交互预算下进行站点级数据收集。
Result: 在50个合成网站（有真值参考集）和3个公共网站（杂乱或动态布局）上，BaRA在链接发现和可下载多模态提取方面超越Pure LLM、SeeAct-Vision和Browser-use，其中可下载图片和视频恢复的增益最大。
Conclusion: BaRA能有效提升Web数据收集的覆盖率和下载有效性，尤其适用于需要完整多模态数据的场景。

papers.title: Persona Without Substrate: Regime-Dependence and the LLM Individuation Problem
papers.abstract_en: Beckmann & Butlin's (2026) ontological framework for the LLM individuation problem inherits an unargued cross-regime co-reference assumption from the persona-vectors literature: that the same direction picks out the same content under prompt-conditioning, gradient-descent fine-tuning, and inference-time steering. We present four empirical wedges from persona-topology experiments on Qwen3-4B-Instruct and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 - non-collinearity of prompt-extracted vectors and fine-tune basins; fictional personas displacing the model along real-anchor directions more strongly than real anchors do; contradictory-valenced mixtures biased toward a training-history-determined attractor; and asymmetric compositional algebra under inference-time arithmetic versus fine-tune-time chimera training - that jointly undermine the assumption. We propose regime-indexed individuation: the identity unit for representational content is a (vehicle, regime) pair, not a vehicle alone. Under this framework, Beckmann & Butlin's three candidate positions describe three different regime-internal objects rather than competing for the same referent; the same diagnosis applies to Mollo & Millière, Chalmers, and Cerullo.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Replies to Beckmann & Butlin (arXiv:2604.17031)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Beckmann & Butlin（2026）的LLM个体化本体论框架，指出其继承了未论证的跨模态共指假设（即相同方向在提示调节、梯度下降微调和推理时引导下指向相同内容）。通过在Qwen3-4B-Instruct和Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2上进行人物拓扑实验，给出四个经验楔子（非共线性、虚构人物位移更强、矛盾情感混合偏向训练历史吸引子、推理时算术与微调时嵌合训练的不对称组合代数），共同削弱该假设。提出模态索引个体化：表示内容的身份单位是（载体，模态）对，而非单独载体。
Motivation: 现有LLM个体化本体论框架（如Beckmann & Butlin）继承了来自人物向量文献的未论证跨模态共指假设，该假设可能不成立，需要经验检验。
Method: 在Qwen3-4B-Instruct和Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2上设计人物拓扑实验，包括特征向量的非共线性、虚构人物沿真实锚点方向的位移强度、矛盾情感混合与吸引子、推理时算术与微调时嵌合训练的不对称性等四个维度，检验跨模态共指假设。
Result: 实验结果表明跨模态共指假设被违反，提出（载体，模态）对作为表示内容的身份单位，即模态索引个体化框架。
Conclusion: Beckmann & Butlin的三种候选立场（以及Mollo & Millière、Chalmers、Cerullo的立场）描述的是不同模态内部的对象，而非竞争同一指称物。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Topological Void Analysis A Mathematical Framework for Systematic Technical Innovation Discovery in Knowledge Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Identifying where to innovate in a dense technical domain - such as operating systems or hardware/software co-design - is fundamentally a search problem in a high-dimensional knowledge space. Existing approaches rely on keyword search, citation proximity, or human intuition, none of which formalise the notion of an unexplored region that is simultaneously relevant to a target goal and absent from prior art. We present Topological Void Analysis (TVA), a mathematical framework that defines topological voids as triads (A, B, C) in a dense-sparse hybrid embedding space. A void requires three conditions: (i) both concepts A and B are semantically cohesive with domain anchor C; (ii) their pairwise similarity falls within a calibrated marginality band - avoiding both obvious combinations and unrelated noise; and (iii) they share a sparse lexical bridge while the geodesic midpoint on the embedding hypersphere is unoccupied. Applied to ~140k indexed documents, TVA generates 2,128 invention candidates across 96 targets; 90% survive automated quality filtering, yielding 191 REVISE and 1 APPROVE verdict from four-specialist adversarial review (0.05% end-to-end). Two case studies demonstrate the framework surfaces non-obvious connective tissue rather than merely obvious related pairs.

TL;DR: 本文提出拓扑空洞分析（TVA）框架，将技术领域中的创新发现形式化为高维知识空间中的搜索问题。TVA通过定义三元组（A, B, C）在密集-稀疏混合嵌入空间中的拓扑空洞，并施加三个条件（语义连贯性、边际相似性、稀疏词汇桥梁及未占据的测地中点），从约14万索引文档中生成2128个发明候选，经自动化过滤和专家审查后获得191个REVISE和1个APPROVE判定。案例研究表明该方法能够发现非显而易见的关联。
Motivation: 现有技术发现方法依赖关键词搜索、引文接近性或人工直觉，缺乏对同时满足目标相关性和现有技术空白区域的形式化定义。
Method: 提出拓扑空洞分析（TVA），在密集-稀疏混合嵌入空间中定义拓扑空洞为三元组（A, B, C），要求满足三个条件：A和B与领域锚点C语义一致，A和B的相似度落在校准的边际带内，且A和B共享稀疏词汇桥而嵌入超球面上的测地中点未被占据。
Result: TVA应用于约14万索引文档，生成2128个发明候选，90%通过自动化质量过滤，经四位专家对抗性审查后获得191个REVISE和1个APPROVE判定（端到端通过率0.05%）。
Conclusion: TVA为系统化技术发现提供了数学框架，能够识别非显而易见的关联而非简单的相关对，但当前评估仅限于已索引文档且通过率极低。

papers.title: Why Advanced Encoders Lag on Sparse Retrieval? The Answer and an Approach to Bridging Vocabulary Gaps
papers.abstract_en: While advanced foundation models like ModernBERT significantly outperform older architectures in dense retrieval, they surprisingly lag behind the aging BERT-base baseline in learned sparse retrieval (LSR). We identify the root cause as the \textit{Vocabulary Gap}: modern tokenizers utilize raw, case-sensitive vocabularies designed for lossless reconstruction, which map single semantic units to redundant surface forms, wasting model capacity on morphological noise and hindering lexical matching. We formalize this intuition through a theoretical framework, demonstrating that appropriate vocabulary coarse-graining can tighten the generalization bounds by reducing complexity of the hypothesis class, provided that semantic integrity is preserved. To resolve this, we propose \textbf{Vocabulary Transfer (VT)}, a model-agnostic framework that migrates advanced encoders to sparse-friendly, normalized vocabularies with minimal computational cost. VT utilizes a novel \textbf{Semantic Initialization} via spatial topology to preserve geometric structure and an \textbf{Activation Potential Calibration (APC)} mechanism to align pre-trained manifolds with sparsity constraints, preventing the dead neuron and dense collapse observed in standard fine-tuning. Empirically, VT is universally effective: it enables ModernBERT to achieve state-of-the-art performance on the BEIR benchmark (\textbf{52.4} nDCG, a \textbf{+4.7} improvement), resuscitates failing models like RoBERTa-large, and generalizes seamlessly to inference-free architectures and specialized domains. These results confirm that the performance lag is not an architectural deficiency but a solvable vocabulary mismatch. We've released our code and models.\footnote{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/vocab-transfer/. All details included.}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现现代编码器（如ModernBERT）在稀疏检索中性能落后于旧架构BERT-base，根本原因是词汇差距（vocabulary gap）：现代tokenizer采用原始、大小写敏感的词汇表，将同一语义单元映射到多种表面形式，浪费模型容量并阻碍词法匹配。作者提出词汇迁移（VT）框架，通过语义初始化（Semantic Initialization）和激活势校准（APC）将先进编码器迁移到稀疏友好的标准化词汇表，在BEIR基准上将ModernBERT的nDCG提升至52.4（+4.7），并拯救了RoBERTa-large等模型。
Motivation: 现代基础模型在密集检索中表现优异，但在学习型稀疏检索（LSR）中却不如旧版BERT-base，原因未知。本文旨在找出这一性能差距的根本原因并提供解决方案。
Method: 提出Vocabulary Transfer (VT)框架，包含语义初始化（通过空间拓扑保留几何结构）和激活势校准（APC，对齐预训练流形与稀疏性约束，防止死神经元和密集坍塌），将先进编码器迁移到稀疏友好的标准化词汇表。
Result: 在BEIR基准上，ModernBERT达到52.4 nDCG（+4.7提升），RoBERTa-large等此前无效的模型也被复活，且方法适用于无推理架构和专门领域。
Conclusion: 性能滞后并非架构缺陷，而是可解的词汇不匹配问题。VT框架通用有效，已开源代码和模型。

papers.title: From "Strings" to "Things" for Personal Knowledge Graphs: Evaluating LLM Triple Extraction for Recommendation Systems
papers.abstract_en: Personal Knowledge Graphs (PKGs) offer a privacy-preserving framework for modeling user preferences, yet constructing them from unstructured, decentralized conversational data remains a challenge. This paper bridges the gap between conversational "strings" and semantic "things" by presenting a reproducible pipeline for extracting structured user-preference triples using lightweight Large Language Models. We evaluate Qwen- and Gemma-based models on their ability to extract RDF-compliant triples linked to Wikidata identifiers from conversational data for PKG construction. Our evaluation assesses both the semantic extraction fidelity and the utility of the resulting graphs in a downstream recommendation task. We found that certain models performed well and had proportionally high downstream performance relative to their triple extraction performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用轻量级大语言模型从非结构化的对话数据中提取结构化用户偏好三元组，以构建个人知识图谱（PKG）的可复现流程。作者评估了Qwen和Gemma系列模型在提取符合RDF标准、关联Wikidata标识符的三元组方面的性能，并在下游推荐任务中检验了所得图结构的实用性。
Motivation: 个人知识图谱（PKG）为建模用户偏好提供了隐私保护的框架，但如何从非结构化的、分散的对话数据中自动构建PKG仍是挑战。
Method: 提出一个可复现的流水线，使用轻量级大语言模型从对话数据中提取RDF兼容的三元组，并将其链接到Wikidata标识符。
Result: 某些模型在三元组提取和下游推荐性能上均表现良好，且下游性能与三元组提取性能成比例。
Conclusion: 该工作验证了使用轻量级LLM从对话数据构建PKG的可行性，并为推荐系统提供了语义增强的用户表示。

papers.title: Bounded Morality: Defining the Space of Moral Computation
papers.abstract_en: Moral cognition has traditionally been modeled as adherence to fixed ethical theories--deontology, consequentialism, virtue ethics--implemented as static rules or value functions. We propose Bounded Morality, a formal framework for analyzing the computational demands of moral problems faced by finite agents. Extending Herbert Simon's notion of bounded rationality, we formalize moral situations along two orthogonal dimensions: moral breadth, the scope of entities treated as morally relevant, and moral depth, the inferential integration required to evaluate their interactions. Limited resources impose an unavoidable tradeoff between these dimensions, defining a feasible space of moral computation. Within this space, ethical theories correspond to locally efficient strategies adapted to different demand regimes rather than competing accounts of moral truth. The framework yields a formal notion of moral regret and moral progress under constraint, and implies that moral alignment in artificial systems depends on the scaling and allocation of moral reasoning capacity rather than on direct imitation of human judgments.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出有界道德（Bounded Morality）框架，将道德认知建模为有限智能体在道德广度与深度之间的权衡。该框架将伦理理论解释为适应不同需求模式的局部高效策略，而非绝对真理，并得出道德对齐依赖于推理能力的扩展与分配而非直接模仿人类判断的结论。
Motivation: 传统道德认知模型依赖固定伦理理论（如义务论、后果论）的静态规则或价值函数，未能考虑有限智能体的计算约束。
Method: 借鉴赫伯特·西蒙的有界理性概念，从道德广度（受道德对待的实体范围）和道德深度（评估交互所需的推理整合）两个正交维度形式化道德情境，并证明有限资源迫使二者存在不可避免的权衡，从而定义可行道德计算空间。
Result: 框架给出了有限制下的道德遗憾（moral regret）和道德进步的形式化定义，并指出人工系统中的道德对齐取决于道德推理能力的扩展与分配，而非直接模仿人类判断。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一个分析有限智能体道德计算需求的普适性框架，暗示当前AI道德对齐方法需要从模仿转向能力扩展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Constructive Alignment: Governing Preference Dynamics in Human-AI Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Most approaches to AI alignment treat human preferences as fixed targets to be inferred and optimized. This assumption conflicts with extensive empirical evidence showing that preferences are layered, dynamic, and constructed through interaction--particularly with adaptive technologies. As AI systems become more persistent, personalized, and socially embedded, they increasingly participate in shaping what people attend to, value, and endorse over time. We introduce Constructive Alignment, a paradigm that reframes alignment as a control problem over evolving human preference trajectories rather than static preference satisfaction. Drawing on behavioral economics, psychology, and constructivist social theory, we model preferences as layered state variables that evolve under interaction with AI systems. We formalize this view using a control-theoretic framework in which system actions and interaction design jointly influence both world states and human evaluative states. We argue that alignment is not primarily about controlling AI behavior, but about regulating how AI systems influence the evolution of human preferences--ensuring that value trajectories remain coherent, reflectively endorsed, epistemically grounded, bounded against manipulation, and empowering under uncertainty. Alignment thus becomes a problem of governing long-term value formation rather than simply satisfying static preferences.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 1 figure; Proceedings of the AAAI-26 Workshop on Machine Ethics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“建构性对齐”（Constructive Alignment）范式，将AI对齐问题重新定义为控制人类偏好随时间演化的轨迹，而非满足静态偏好。基于行为经济学、心理学和建构主义理论，将偏好建模为分层状态变量，并用控制理论框架分析系统动作与交互设计如何共同影响世界状态和人类评价状态。认为对齐的核心是规范AI系统对偏好演化的影响，确保价值轨迹保持连贯、反思性认可、认知基础、抗操纵性，并在不确定性下赋予自主性。
Motivation: 现有AI对齐方法大多将人类偏好视为固定目标进行推断和优化，但大量实证表明偏好是分层、动态且通过交互（尤其是与自适应技术）建构的。随着AI系统更持久、个性化和社会嵌入，它们越来越参与塑造人们的注意力、价值观和认可，因此需要新范式。
Method: 引入建构性对齐范式，采用控制理论（control-theoretic）框架，将偏好视为受系统动作和交互设计共同影响的分层状态变量，从而将对齐问题形式化为对偏好演化轨迹的控制问题。
Result: 该论文是概念框架，未提供具体实验数值或定量结果。主要贡献在于问题重新定义和理论建模。
Conclusion: 对齐的主要挑战不是控制AI行为，而是调节AI系统如何影响人类偏好的演化，即治理长期价值形成而非满足静态偏好。强调偏好轨迹应保持连贯、反思性认可、认知基础、抗操纵，并在不确定性下赋能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UltraFlux: Data-Model Co-Design for High-quality Native 4K Text-to-Image Generation across Diverse Aspect Ratios
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion transformers have recently delivered strong text-to-image generation around 1K resolution, but we show that extending them to native 4K across diverse aspect ratios exposes a tightly coupled failure mode spanning positional encoding, VAE compression, and optimization. Tackling any of these factors in isolation leaves substantial quality on the table. We therefore take a data-model co-design view and introduce UltraFlux, a Flux-based DiT trained natively at 4K on MultiAspect-4K-1M, a 1M-image 4K corpus with controlled multi-AR coverage, bilingual captions, and rich VLM/IQA metadata for resolution- and AR-aware sampling. On the model side, UltraFlux couples (i) Resonance 2D RoPE with YaRN for training-window-, frequency-, and AR-aware positional encoding at 4K; (ii) a simple, non-adversarial VAE post-training scheme that improves 4K reconstruction fidelity; (iii) an SNR-Aware Huber Wavelet objective that rebalances gradients across timesteps and frequency bands; and (iv) a Stage-wise Aesthetic Curriculum Learning strategy that concentrates high-aesthetic supervision on high-noise steps governed by the model prior. Together, these components yield a stable, detail-preserving 4K DiT that generalizes across wide, square, and tall ARs. On the Aesthetic-Eval at 4096 benchmark and multi-AR 4K settings, UltraFlux consistently outperforms strong open-source baselines across fidelity, aesthetic, and alignment metrics, and-with a LLM prompt refiner-matches or surpasses the proprietary Seedream 4.0.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UltraFlux，一种基于Flux的扩散Transformer（DiT），专为原生4K分辨率及多样化宽高比的文本到图像生成而设计。通过数据-模型协同设计，包括Resonance 2D RoPE位置编码、非对抗VAE后训练、SNR-Aware Huber Wavelet损失和阶段式审美课程学习，在MultiAspect-4K-1M数据集上训练，显著提升了4K图像的质量。在Aesthetic-Eval@4096基准和多宽高比4K设置中，UltraFlux在保真度、美感和对齐指标上持续优于开源基线，并借助LLM提示精炼器匹配或超越了专有模型Seedream 4.0。
Motivation: 现有扩散Transformer在1K分辨率下表现良好，但直接扩展到原生4K及多种宽高比时，位置编码、VAE压缩和优化之间存在紧密耦合的失败模式，孤立解决任一因素都无法获得理想质量。
Method: 采用数据-模型协同设计：构建1M张4K图像的多宽高比数据集MultiAspect-4K-1M，包含双语描述和丰富的VLM/IQA元数据；模型侧结合Resonance 2D RoPE与YaRN实现位置编码、非对抗VAE后训练提升4K重建保真度、SNR-Aware Huber Wavelet目标平衡时频域梯度、以及阶段式审美课程学习。
Result: 在Aesthetic-Eval@4096基准和多宽高比4K设置中，UltraFlux在图像保真度、美学质量和文本对齐指标上持续超越强开源基线，并利用LLM提示精炼器达到或超过专有Seedream 4.0的水平。
Conclusion: 所提出的数据-模型协同设计方法能够稳定生成细节丰富的原生4K图像，并泛化至多种宽高比，展示了扩散Transformer在高分辨率生成中的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Surfacing Variations to Calibrate Perceived Reliability of MLLM-generated Image Descriptions
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide new opportunities for blind and low vision (BLV) people to access visual information in their daily lives. However, these models often produce errors that are difficult to detect without sight, posing safety and social risks in scenarios from medication identification to outfit selection. While BLV MLLM users use creative workarounds such as cross-checking between tools and consulting sighted individuals, these approaches are often time-consuming and impractical. We explore how systematically surfacing variations across multiple MLLM responses can support BLV users to detect unreliable information without visually inspecting the image. We contribute a design space for eliciting and presenting variations in MLLM descriptions, a prototype system implementing three variation presentation styles, and findings from a user study with 15 BLV participants. Our results demonstrate that presenting variations significantly increases users' ability to identify unreliable claims (by 4.9x using our approach compared to single descriptions) and significantly decreases perceived reliability of MLLM responses. 14 of 15 participants preferred seeing variations of MLLM responses over a single description, and all expressed interest in using our system for tasks from understanding a tornado's path to posting an image on social media.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过系统性地呈现多个多模态大语言模型（MLLM）对同一图像描述的变体，帮助盲人或低视力用户检测不可靠信息。用户研究表明，相比单一描述，该方法将识别不可靠声明的能力提升4.9倍，并降低感知可靠性。14/15参与者偏好变体呈现，所有参与者均表示有兴趣将该系统用于多种日常任务。
Motivation: 盲人和低视力用户难以察觉MLLM生成的图像描述中的错误，现有交叉验证方法费时且不实用，存在安全和社会风险。
Method: 提出了一个设计空间来引出和呈现MLLM描述的变体，并实现了一个原型系统，包含三种变体呈现风格。
Result: 用户研究显示，呈现变体使识别不可靠声明的能力提升4.9倍，并显著降低对MLLM响应的感知可靠性。14/15参与者偏好变体呈现，所有参与者均希望将该系统用于从理解龙卷风路径到在社交媒体发布图像等任务。
Conclusion: 摘要强调表面变体可以有效校准盲人用户对MLLM描述可靠性的感知，提升信任判断的准确性。
